meaningZh: 高度，海拔高度；高位，高等；[天]地平纬度

examples.text: We are flying at an altitude of 20000 feet.
examples.translationZh: 我们的飞行高度是20000英尺。

examples.text: Air pressure decreases with altitude.
examples.translationZh: 气压随海拔高度的增加而下降。

examples.text: At this altitude there is no screening from the sun's rays.
examples.translationZh: 在这种海拔高度，没有遮阳处。

meaningZh: 影像；肖像；概念，意向

examples.text: We have an image of the U.S. as a very rich country.
examples.translationZh: 我们印象中的美国是个富国。

examples.text: How can we improve our image?
examples.translationZh: 我们该怎样来改善自己的形象呢？

examples.text: Her image rose before him.
examples.translationZh: 她的影像在他眼前浮现。

meaningZh: [化] 可溶的；可以解决的；可以解释的

examples.text: Soluble metallic hydroxides are bases that are alkalies.
examples.translationZh: 可溶解的金属氢氧化合物都是碱。

examples.text: A subsequent wet depithing serves to remove soluble and strongly adhering pith.
examples.translationZh: 后续的除髓工序可以继续除去可溶解的和粘附牢固的蔗髓。

meaningZh: 桩；刑柱；股份

examples.text: He drove a stake into the ground.
examples.translationZh: 他向地里打了一根桩子。

examples.text: This decision puts our lives at stake.
examples.translationZh: 这么一决定,我们的生命就吉凶难卜了。

examples.text: Most parents feel that they have a stake in their children's future,and so will use every effort to help them.
examples.translationZh: 大多数家长认为，孩子们的前途和他们有利害关系，所以尽一切努力帮助他们。

meaningZh: （在国外的访问者）在当地居民家居住的时期

examples.text: My homestay family made me feel welcome.
examples.translationZh: 寄宿家庭让我感到很受欢迎。

meaningZh: 曲棍球；冰球

examples.text: Football and hockey players wear shoulder pads.
examples.translationZh: 足球和曲棍球球员都戴垫肩。

examples.text: I broke my foot while playing hockey.
examples.translationZh: 在打曲棍球时我的脚骨折了。

meaningZh: 贫民窟，贫民区；vi. （因好奇而）逛贫民区

examples.text: They've demolished the slum district.
examples.translationZh: 贫民区已拆除。

examples.text: The bar in the slum is a den of iniquity.
examples.translationZh: 这个贫民窟里的小酒吧是一个充满罪恶的场所。

examples.text: The slum area was sordid and filthy beyond belief.
examples.translationZh: 该贫民区之污秽肮脏简直令人难以置信。

meaningZh: 公顷

examples.text: Total floor soace per hectare plot.
examples.translationZh: 每公顷建筑用地上容纳的建筑物的总建筑面积。

examples.text: The rate of production per hectare is very high in England.
examples.translationZh: 在英国每公顷土地的产量很高。

meaningZh: 小装饰品；小件饰物；无价值的琐细杂物

examples.text: A small, exquisitely wrought trinket.
examples.translationZh: 珠宝，首饰小巧精致的装饰物

examples.text: A small mass-produced article, such as a toy or trinket.
examples.translationZh: 新奇的小物件创新大量生产的小物件，如玩具或小装饰品

examples.text: He buy her trinket and take her to the theater.
examples.translationZh: 他给她购买小装饰品并带她去看戏。

meaningZh: 接吻，一种帆船；v. 接吻，亲吻

examples.text: He bussed to the city.
examples.translationZh: 他乘公共汽车进城。

examples.text: He spent the summer bussing table in a downtown grill.
examples.translationZh: 整个夏季，他都在城里一个烧烤店帮助清理餐桌。

meaningZh: 骰子；掷骰游戏；v. 将…切成丁

examples.text: It's your turn to throw the dice.
examples.translationZh: 轮到你掷骰子了。

examples.text: One of the dice has rolled under the table.
examples.translationZh: 有一粒骰子滚到桌子下面去了。

examples.text: It's foolish to risk money on a throw of the dice.
examples.translationZh: 掷骰子赌博，是很愚蠢的。

meaningZh: 处女，童男；童贞玛利亚（耶稣之母）；adj. 处女的

examples.text: I could call her nothing in my own mind save "stainless virgin".
examples.translationZh: 我的心里除了叫她为“白壁无瑕的处女”而外，实在找不出其它的称呼来。

examples.text: She remained a virgin all her life.
examples.translationZh: 她终生未婚。

examples.text: There are vast expanses of virgin land in the remote regions.
examples.translationZh: 在边远地区有大片大片未开垦的处女地。

meaningZh: （烟、煤气、新的油漆等发出的）难闻的气味；烟雾，气味( fume的名词复数 )；v. 愤怒( fume的第三人称单数 )

examples.text: She felt sick from breathing in paint fumes.
examples.translationZh: 她因吸入油漆气味而感到恶心。

examples.text: The air was thick with tobacco fumes.
examples.translationZh: 空气中有浓厚的菸草气味。

examples.text: They are not affected by poisonous fumes or gases.
examples.translationZh: 他们不受有毒烟雾或气体影响。

meaningZh: 想家的，患思乡病的；莼鲈之思

examples.text: Now I know where to go when I feel homesick.
examples.translationZh: 现在我知道想家的时候该去哪儿了。

examples.text: My American friend tells me, she is never as homesick as during this time of year, around Thanksgiving.
examples.translationZh: 我的美国朋友跟我说，每年的感恩节前后，是她最想家的时候。

meaningZh: 使腐蚀，侵蚀

examples.text: Iron corrodes easily.
examples.translationZh: 铁易锈损。

examples.text: This acid may corrode iron.
examples.translationZh: 这种酸能腐蚀铁。

examples.text: Certain chemicals will corrode if left on bare metal.
examples.translationZh: 有些化学药品如留在裸露的金属上会起腐蚀作用。

meaningZh: 原子的；原子能的，原子武器的；极微的

examples.text: The ship was sunk by an atomic submarine.
examples.translationZh: 这艘船是被一艘核潜艇击沉的。

examples.text: The Second World War brought the atomic bomb into being.
examples.translationZh: 第二次世界大战使原子弹产生。

examples.text: The atomic explosion is always accompanied by huge fireball.
examples.translationZh: 原子弹爆炸总是伴随着巨大的火球。

meaningZh: 自动地；无意识地；不自觉地

examples.text: The generator shuts off automatically.
examples.translationZh: 这台发动机能自动停止运转。

examples.text: The supermarket doors shut automatically.
examples.translationZh: 超级市场的门是自动关的。

examples.text: Pelting is done automatically by machines.
examples.translationZh: 剥皮是机器自动完成的。

meaningZh: 有抵抗力的，抵抗的；顽固的；n. 抵抗者

examples.text: A healthy diet creates a body resistant to disease.
examples.translationZh: 保健饮食有助于增强体内对疾病的抵抗力。

examples.text: The high walls of rock are made of weather-resistant quartzite.
examples.translationZh: 那高高的岩石墙壁是由对风化有抵抗的石英岩组成的。

examples.text: This new type of infection is resistant to antibiotics.
examples.translationZh: 这种新的传染病对抗菌素有抗药性。

meaningZh: 居民，居住者(dwell的派生)

examples.text: Dwellers here live a happy life now.
examples.translationZh: 现在这里居民的生活很幸福。

examples.text: The traffic noise is a constant irritation to city dwellers.
examples.translationZh: 车辆的噪音对城市居民是永无止境的骚扰。

examples.text: The dweller is the only architect.
examples.translationZh: 居住者才是唯一的建筑师。

meaningZh: 企业家；主办人；承包人

examples.text: He is a shipping entrepreneur.
examples.translationZh: 他是个航运企业家。

examples.text: The entrepreneur has become a news figure.
examples.translationZh: 这位企业家变成了新闻人物。

meaningZh: 先进的；高等的，高深的；年老的

examples.text: England is an advanced industrial country.
examples.translationZh: 英国是一个发达的工业国家。

examples.text: The ancient Egyptians had advanced civilization.
examples.translationZh: 古埃及人曾经拥有高度文明。

examples.text: Our bean curd processing line is the most advanced and well- know in the world.
examples.translationZh: 我们的豆腐生产线是世界上最为先进的，久负盛名。

meaningZh: 边的，边缘的；旁注的；临界的，最低限度的

examples.text: Economists call these marginal changes.
examples.translationZh: 经济学家称这些为边际的变化。

examples.text: The marginal illustration is very interesting.
examples.translationZh: 页边的插图很有趣。

examples.text: He won the most marginal seat by only two votes.
examples.translationZh: 他只以两票的微弱优势当选。

meaningZh: 比，比率；[数学]比例（法）；面积

examples.text: A large proportion of my time is spent in studying.
examples.translationZh: 我的大部分时间花在学习上。

examples.text: This door is narrow in proportion to its height.
examples.translationZh: 这扇门就其高度的比例而言窄了些。

examples.text: The two windows are in admirable proportion.
examples.translationZh: 这两扇窗户十分相称.

meaningZh: 比较（上）的；按比较估计的；相当的，还可以的

examples.text: He majored in comparative literature.
examples.translationZh: 他的专业是比较文学。

examples.text: To illustrate my point I have done a comparative analysis.
examples.translationZh: 为说明我的观点，我做了对比分析。

examples.text: The expedition was a comparative success.
examples.translationZh: 那次探险相当成功。

meaningZh: 精确度，准确（性）；[语]精确；adj. 精确的，准确的，细致的

examples.text: The teacher laid emphasis on the precision of the translation from the outset.
examples.translationZh: 老师从一开始就强调翻译准确性。

examples.text: Your report lacks precision.
examples.translationZh: 你的报告不够准确。

examples.text: Every argument was stated with logical precision.
examples.translationZh: 每一个论点都阐述得精确严密，符合逻辑。

meaningZh: 实际上；几乎；事实上

examples.text: Bread was practically non-existent.
examples.translationZh: 实际上没有面包。

examples.text: Practically, the plan didn't work well.
examples.translationZh: 实际上该计划进行得不顺利。

examples.text: He is practically ruined.
examples.translationZh: 他几乎破产了。

meaningZh: 孵蛋；沉思；焦急地考虑

examples.text: The bird was trying to find food for its brood.
examples.translationZh: 鸟儿在为它的一窝小鸟觅食。

examples.text: She grew up amidst a lively brood of brothers and sisters.
examples.translationZh: 她是在一群活泼的兄弟姐妹中间长大的。

examples.text: A brood of modern paintings will be exhibited at the museum.
examples.translationZh: 一批现代画将在博物馆展览。

meaningZh: 挖掘；开凿；挖出

examples.text: It took a long time to excavate the ancient city of Troy.
examples.translationZh: 挖掘古老的特洛伊城，花了很长时间。

examples.text: I let him excavate around the mine.
examples.translationZh: 我准许他在金矿周围挖掘。

examples.text: They plan to excavate a large hole.
examples.translationZh: 他们计划挖个大洞。

meaningZh: 笔迹学；图解法；字音学

examples.text: Graphology studies handwriting.
examples.translationZh: 笔迹学研究书写特征。

meaningZh: 鳄鱼；鳄鱼皮革；鳄类动物

examples.text: The crocodile was crawling along the riverbed.
examples.translationZh: 这条鳄鱼正沿着河床爬行。

examples.text: And then I saw this little crocodile.
examples.translationZh: 这个时候，我看到了一只小鳄鱼。

meaningZh: 相互作用；互相影响；互动

examples.text: These factors interact intimately and cannot be separated.
examples.translationZh: 这些因素相互之间紧密联系，不能分开。

examples.text: Mother and baby interact in a very complex way.
examples.translationZh: 母亲与婴儿以非常复杂的方式相互影响。

examples.text: Economists also study how people interact with one another.
examples.translationZh: 经济学家也研究人们之间的相互影响。

meaningZh: 山峰；最高点；尖端

examples.text: In Yersa I noticed a spike on the peak of the pyramid-shaped roof of a church.
examples.translationZh: 在叶拉萨村,我发现一座教堂的金字塔屋顶的尖端有一颗尖钉。

examples.text: The mountain peaks are covered with snow all year.
examples.translationZh: 山顶上终年积雪。

examples.text: Many mountaineers have reached that mountain peak.
examples.translationZh: 许多登山家都登上过那座大山的顶峰。

meaningZh: 付款，支付；报酬，报答；偿还

examples.text: They demand prompt payment.
examples.translationZh: 他们要求立即付款。

examples.text: You may defer payment until next week.
examples.translationZh: 你可延期至下周支付。

examples.text: We have still not yet received your payment.
examples.translationZh: 我们仍未收到贵公司支付的款项。

meaningZh: 急速发展的；v. 激增( boom的现在分词 )；猛涨

examples.text: Perhaps the biggest near-term problem is that the country's once booming private sector is struggling.
examples.translationZh: 也许最大的近期问题是国家曾经兴旺的私有企业目前苦苦挣扎。

examples.text: But even in booming Duisburg old habits are fading more slowly than the industries that fostered them.
examples.translationZh: 但即使是在兴旺的多伊士堡，那些旧习仍比那些产生它们的工业消失得更慢。

examples.text: Some people say that it is a booming city.
examples.translationZh: 有些人说它是个繁荣的城市。

meaningZh: 看出；理解，了解；识别，辨别

examples.text: Sometimes it's not easy to discern between the true and the false.
examples.translationZh: 有时辨别真伪并不容易。

examples.text: He was just able to discern the road in the dark.
examples.translationZh: 他在黑暗中勉强能辨出道路。

examples.text: They can discern me in spite of the fog.
examples.translationZh: 虽然有雾，但他们能认得出我。

meaningZh: 郊区，城郊；边缘；附近，周围

examples.text: They proposed setting up a school in the suburb.
examples.translationZh: 他们建议在这个郊区成立一所学校。

examples.text: The factory is located in the suburb.
examples.translationZh: 那家工厂坐落于郊区。

examples.text: Ronaldo grew up in Bento Ribeiro, a suburb of Rio.
examples.translationZh: 罗纳尔多在里约热内卢的一个叫本托.

meaningZh: 职业的，行业的；天职的；有助于职业的

examples.text: Vocational training will fit them for a good job.
examples.translationZh: 职业的培训使他们能找到一个好工作。

examples.text: Education is an approach for establishing individual human capital, and it also affects the vocational propensity of individuals.
examples.translationZh: 摘要教育不但是个人人力资本积累的途径，也会形成个人职业的趋向和偏好。

meaningZh: 兼容的，相容的；和谐的，协调的；[生物学]亲和的

examples.text: The proposed new regulation is not compatible with the existing policy.
examples.translationZh: 提出的新规定与现有的政策不符。

examples.text: We should remain the compatible family relationships.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该维持和谐的家庭关系。

examples.text: He and his wife are not compatible
examples.translationZh: 他跟他的妻子合不来。

meaningZh: 共有的；共同的；相互的

examples.text: Other organizations have joined the confederation for mutual benefit.
examples.translationZh: 其他组织为了共同的利益也加入了这个联盟。

examples.text: My friend and I have mutual enthusiasm for music.
examples.translationZh: 我和我的朋友对音乐有着共同的爱好。

examples.text: Let's give mutual support and inspiration to each other.
examples.translationZh: 让我们互相支持，互相鼓励。

meaningZh: 管理的，行政的；行政职位；非战斗性行政勤务的

examples.text: This job is mainly administrative.
examples.translationZh: 这份工作主要是行政性的。

examples.text: He regarded all these administrative details as beneath his notice.
examples.translationZh: 他认为行政管理上的这些琐事都不值一顾。

examples.text: The manager lacks administrative ability.
examples.translationZh: 经理缺乏管理能力。

meaningZh: 对手；反对者；敌手

examples.text: He was assailed by his political opponent.
examples.translationZh: 他遭到政敌的攻击。

examples.text: I tried to comfort him after he was defeated by his opponent.
examples.translationZh: 他被对手击败后，我尽力安慰他。

examples.text: He knocked down his opponent with a powerful left.
examples.translationZh: 他一记有力的左手拳将对手击倒。

meaningZh: 栎树；橡木色；栎木，橡木

examples.text: The birds nested in the oak tree.
examples.translationZh: 鸟在橡树上筑巢。

examples.text: Pine wood saws more easily than oak.
examples.translationZh: 松树要比橡树容易锯。

examples.text: The wine is left to mature in oak barrels.
examples.translationZh: 葡萄酒在橡木桶中陈酿。

meaningZh: 软木；软木塞；（钓鱼用）软木浮子

examples.text: The cork's too big, it won't go in.
examples.translationZh: 这软木塞太大了，塞不进去。

examples.text: Do you have any tools to draw out the cork?
examples.translationZh: 你有工具把软木塞拔开吗？

examples.text: The cork is tight in the bottle.
examples.translationZh: 软木瓶塞紧紧地塞在瓶中。

meaningZh: 战争，战争状态；斗争，冲突；军事行为

examples.text: This is as true of warfare as it is of diplomacy.
examples.translationZh: 这是真正的战争，就像刚才提到的外交。

examples.text: Warfare has always expedited military technology.
examples.translationZh: 战争总是在促进军事科技的进步。

examples.text: In countries like Nigeria they precipitate coups or tribal warfare.
examples.translationZh: 而在尼日利亚这样的国家，则敏感到会导致政变和部族冲突。

meaningZh: 誓言；郑重宣布；vt.& vi. 起誓，发誓

examples.text: You'd better carry out your solemn vow.
examples.translationZh: 你最好是履行你那庄严的誓约。

examples.text: All the men took a vow of loyalty to their leader.
examples.translationZh: 所有士兵都发誓效忠他们的指挥官。

examples.text: Once he took the vow his loyalty never wavered.
examples.translationZh: 他一旦宣了誓，他就一直忠贞不渝。

meaningZh: 空的，空虚的，没人住的；（职位）空缺着的；无效的

examples.text: Void function may not return a value
examples.translationZh: 空函数不可返回一个值。

examples.text: The court ruled that the claim was null and void.
examples.translationZh: 法庭裁决此项要求无效。

examples.text: His suggestions are totally void of common sense.
examples.translationZh: 他的建议完全缺乏常识。

meaningZh: 暴虐；专横；暴行

examples.text: They will fight tyranny to the death.
examples.translationZh: 他们誓死反对暴政。

examples.text: Revolution is a frequent outgrowth of tyranny.
examples.translationZh: 革命是暴政促成的常有结果。

examples.text: Tyranny is fiercer than a tiger.
examples.translationZh: 苛政猛于虎。

meaningZh: 怜悯，同情；恻隐之心

examples.text: I had compassion for him.
examples.translationZh: 我怜悯他。

examples.text: He teaches us to have compassion on the poor.
examples.translationZh: 他教导我们对穷人应有怜悯心。

examples.text: Compassion is a sign of weakness.
examples.translationZh: 怜悯是弱者的标志。

meaningZh: 热的，保热的；温热的；n. 上升的暖气流

examples.text: An improved thermal head boosts image quality.
examples.translationZh: 经过改进的热敏头,提高了图像质量。

examples.text: The thermal energy has become more and more important.
examples.translationZh: 热能变得越来越重要了。

examples.text: These are thermal units.
examples.translationZh: 这是热量单位。

meaningZh: 瓦片，瓷砖；空心砖；麻将牌

examples.text: The reconciled reptiles rest on a fragile tile.
examples.translationZh: 和解的爬行动物歇在易碎的瓷砖上。

examples.text: We have put tiles on the wall behind the bath.
examples.translationZh: 我们在浴缸后的墙上贴了瓷砖。

examples.text: I entered the kitchen, with its old tile floor and its cherrywood cabinets.
examples.translationZh: 我走进了厨房，年月久远的瓷砖地面，樱桃木材质的各色橱柜。

meaningZh: 综合；合成；综合体

examples.text: The ribosome is the site of protein synthesis.
examples.translationZh: 核糖体是合成蛋白质的地方。

examples.text: His work is a synthesis of several ideas.
examples.translationZh: 他的作品是由几种构想综合而成的。

examples.text: Our beliefs are a synthesis of Eastern and Western religions.
examples.translationZh: 我们的信仰是东西方宗教的综合体。

meaningZh: 然而；尽管如此；不过

examples.text: Our defeat was expected；nevertheless，it was disappointing.
examples.translationZh: 我们的失败是意料中的事；尽管如此,还是令人失望。

examples.text: We can't take your advice. Nevertheless, thank you for putting it.
examples.translationZh: 我们不能接受您的建议。不过,谢谢您提出来。

examples.text: Despite his injured ankle, he nevertheless succeeded in gaining the final against Germany.
examples.translationZh: 尽管踝骨受伤,他仍然打入了与德国队的决赛。

meaningZh: 推断；猜想，推理；暗示

examples.text: We can infer the meaning of the word in the context.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以从上下文中推断这个词的含义。

examples.text: They infer a conclusion from the facts.
examples.translationZh: 他们从事实中推断出结论。

examples.text: I infer that my proposal has been accepted.
examples.translationZh: 我推测我的建议已被接受。

meaningZh: 刺激；激怒，恼怒，生气；兴奋

examples.text: Discontinue use if irritation or rash appear.
examples.translationZh: 如果发生刺激或丘疹请停止使用。

examples.text: May cause respiratory tract irritation.
examples.translationZh: 五月引起呼吸器官的广阔地面刺激。

examples.text: Aspirated material may also produce inflammation from chemical irritation, as with gastric contents.
examples.translationZh: 吸入物如同胃内容物一样由于化学刺激物的作用可引起炎症。

meaningZh: 足够；有能力；vt. 满足…的需要

examples.text: The rations will suffice until next week.
examples.translationZh: 这些口粮足够吃到下星期。

examples.text: An hour should suffice for the journey.
examples.translationZh: 这点路程一小时足够了。

examples.text: The rules will suffice for all ordinary needs.
examples.translationZh: 这些规定将能满足所有一般场合的需要。

meaningZh: 附带的，附属的，次要的；助的，帮助的；补足的

examples.text: A lack of corporate interest has made the subsidiary an orphan.
examples.translationZh: 因缺乏共同利益,这家附属机构无人管理。

examples.text: I plan to study journalism as a subsidiary course.
examples.translationZh: 我打算辅修新闻学。

examples.text: Public transportation plays a subsidiary role.
examples.translationZh: 公共交通起辅助的作用。

meaningZh: 争论不休的；（指问题等）棘手的；争论不休的问题

examples.text: The best age for marriage is a vexed question.
examples.translationZh: 什么年龄结婚最合适是一个众说纷纭的问题。

examples.text: He was vexed at his missing the train.
examples.translationZh: 他因未赶上火车而烦躁。

examples.text: I am even more vexed than ordinary times.
examples.translationZh: 我比平时更心烦。

meaningZh: 租约；租契；租赁物

examples.text: Our present lease on the flat expires next month.
examples.translationZh: 我们这套公寓的租约下月到期。

examples.text: An astute tenant always reads the small print in a lease.
examples.translationZh: 精明的租户对租契上的每个细小之处都要讲究。

examples.text: Does your current lease provide for showings prior to the tenant vacating the property?
examples.translationZh: 您当前的租契是否规定了在房客搬出房间之前可以提前展售？

meaningZh: 意识到；察觉，发觉；理解

examples.text: I plainly perceive some objections remain.
examples.translationZh: 我清楚地察觉到还有一些反对意见。

examples.text: We can perceive his sorrow by the looks on his face.
examples.translationZh: 我们从他的表情中觉察出悲伤。

examples.text: Indeed, this problem is greater than one may perceive.
examples.translationZh: 确实，这个问题远大于你所能感知到的。

meaningZh: 洞察力，洞悉；直觉，眼光；领悟

examples.text: I've got an insight into the problem.
examples.translationZh: 我对问题豁然开朗。

examples.text: The book is filled with remarkable insights.
examples.translationZh: 这本书很有真知卓见。

examples.text: In this new book he hits off the American temperament with amazing insight.
examples.translationZh: 在这本新书里，他对美国人性格的描写表现出惊人的洞察力。

meaningZh: 闷热的，不通气的；古板的，保守的；枯燥无味的

examples.text: Lacking fresh air; stuffy.
examples.translationZh: 不通风的缺乏新鲜空气的; 闷气的

examples.text: The office was so stuffy that, knowing the Chief was away, the Secretary stripped to the shirt.
examples.translationZh: 办公室里十分闷热，由于知道主任出去了，这个秘书脱得剩衬衫。

examples.text: The atmosphere is very stuffy in here can we open a window?
examples.translationZh: 这的空气很闷--咱们能把窗户打开吗?

meaningZh: 斗争；争吵；冲突

examples.text: She was faint with strife and dejected.
examples.translationZh: 她被争吵弄得精疲力竭，情绪低落。

examples.text: We really shouldn't intervene in their marital strife.
examples.translationZh: 我们不该介入他们夫妻间的争吵。

examples.text: The internecine strife was caused by a shortage of food.
examples.translationZh: 这次内部冲突，是由于食物匮乏而引致的。

meaningZh: 错觉；幻想；错误观念

examples.text: Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
examples.translationZh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

examples.text: A mirage is an optical illusion.
examples.translationZh: 海市蜃楼是一种视错觉。

examples.text: I thought I saw a ghost but it was just an optical illusion.
examples.translationZh: 我以为我看见鬼了，其实只是一种幻觉。

meaningZh: 密度；稠密，浓厚；[物]浓度，比重

examples.text: Mercury has a much greater density than water.
examples.translationZh: 水银的密度比水大得多。

examples.text: The density of population in this city is very high.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市的人口密度非常高。

examples.text: The driver had to stop because the density of the fog made it difficult to see.
examples.translationZh: 由於浓雾使道路很难看清,司机不得不停车。

meaningZh: 立体声的；有立体感的；n. 立体声

examples.text: Who originated the concept of stereo sound?
examples.translationZh: 立体声是谁发明的？

examples.text: We're being deafened by next door's stereo.
examples.translationZh: 隔壁的立体声音响要把我们耳朵震聋。

examples.text: This is no time to lash out on a new stereo.
examples.translationZh: 现在不是奢侈花钱买新立体音响的时候。

meaningZh: 规格；详述；说明书

examples.text: Can you give me a price list with specification?
examples.translationZh: 你能否给我一份有规格说明的价目单吗？

examples.text: In case of need we can offer you some other brand of the same specification.
examples.translationZh: 万一有需要,我们可供应同样规格的其它品牌货品。

examples.text: I want to know his specification of details.
examples.translationZh: 我想知道他对细节的详述。

meaningZh: 微风；轻而易举的事；vi. 吹微风

examples.text: The wheat rippled in the breeze.
examples.translationZh: 小麦在微风中起伏波动。

examples.text: We are enjoying the cool breeze that comes from the lake.
examples.translationZh: 我们享受着湖面上吹来的凉爽微风。

examples.text: We got the job done in a breeze.
examples.translationZh: 我们轻而易举就把这件事办了。

meaningZh: （使某物）蒸发掉；vi. 消失；发散气体

examples.text: If you heat the water,it will evaporate.
examples.translationZh: 你要是把水加热，水会蒸发的。

examples.text: He was afraid his savings would evaporate overnight.
examples.translationZh: 他担心他的储蓄隔夜就蒸发了。

examples.text: Once you have seen fear and depression evaporate in the hot, intense beacon of awareness, you want to repeat the process.
examples.translationZh: 但你发现在热烈的，强度的觉知下，恐惧与压抑消失了，你会想去重复这个过程。

meaningZh: （液体）渗；渗透；渗出

examples.text: Blood was beginning to seep through the bandages.
examples.translationZh: 血开始从绷带上渗出来。

examples.text: Oil is seeping out through a crack in the tank.
examples.translationZh: 油箱的裂缝漏出油来了。

examples.text: The teacher stopped speaking to allow time for the meaning of his words to seep through.
examples.translationZh: 那位老师停止讲话，以便留出时间(让学生们)理解他所讲的意思。

meaningZh: 电视机；total volume 总量；test vehicle 实验用飞行器

examples.text: There was no sale for black and white TV sets.
examples.translationZh: 黑白电视机没有销路。

examples.text: We sold these TV sets at rock-bottom prices.
examples.translationZh: 我们以最低价出售了这些电视机。

meaningZh: 村民；乡村居民

examples.text: The enemy raped the country and killed many villagers.
examples.translationZh: 敌人掠夺了这个地区，并且杀害了许多村民。

examples.text: This clergyman is respected by all the villagers.
examples.translationZh: 这位教士受到所有村民的尊敬。

examples.text: The villagers knew about the scandal.
examples.translationZh: 村子里的居民知道这件丑事。

meaningZh: 满足，满意，舒服；妥善处理；（债务的）清偿

examples.text: Your satisfaction is guaranteed.
examples.translationZh: 包你满意。

examples.text: His face was expressive of satisfaction.
examples.translationZh: 他的脸上露出满意的神情。

examples.text: The winner beamed with satisfaction.
examples.translationZh: 获胜者满意地笑了。

meaningZh: 相关的；相对的；相互有关的

examples.text: Motion is absolute while stagnation is relative.
examples.translationZh: 运动是绝对的,而静止是相对的。

examples.text: They are now living in relative comfort.
examples.translationZh: 他们现在过着比较安逸的生活。

examples.text: Relative to the size, the city is sparsely populated.
examples.translationZh: 与其面积相比, 这个城市的人口是稀少的。

meaningZh: 距离，路程；远处；疏远

examples.text: He judged the distance to a nicety.
examples.translationZh: 他判断距离很正确。

examples.text: My house is four miles distance from the sea.
examples.translationZh: 我家离海四英里。

examples.text: We can see a windmill in the distance.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以望见远处有架风车。

meaningZh: 电冰箱；冷冻机

examples.text: She can mend the fridge by herself.
examples.translationZh: 她能自己修理冰箱。

examples.text: The butter will soften out of the fridge.
examples.translationZh: 黄油从冰箱中取出会变软。

meaningZh: 镇定的；平静的；（海洋，天气等）安静的，平静的

examples.text: The calm sea gave no hint of the storm that was coming.
examples.translationZh: 平静的海上没有一点迹象显示暴风雨即将来临。

examples.text: She always remains cool, calm and collected in a crisis.
examples.translationZh: 她在危难中总能保持冷静、 平静和镇静。

examples.text: You should keep calm even in face of danger.
examples.translationZh: 即使面临危险，你也应当保持镇静。

meaningZh: 磁盘；唱片；圆盘

examples.text: The moon's disk was reflected in the pond.
examples.translationZh: 似盘的月亮倒映在池塘里。

examples.text: I have many disks.
examples.translationZh: 我有许多唱片。

examples.text: I have no disk that may interest you.
examples.translationZh: 我没有一张唱片能引起你的兴趣。

meaningZh: 教育，教导；训练，培养；vt. 使理解或接受

examples.text: It is not easy to educate teenagers.
examples.translationZh: 教育青少年不是件容易的事。

examples.text: An educator must first educate himself.
examples.translationZh: 教育者必须自己先受教育。

examples.text: He tried to educate his wife's taste in literature.
examples.translationZh: 他试图培养他太太对文学的爱好。

meaningZh: 在那里；那里；在那一点上

examples.text: He has a house there and a cottage near the sea.
examples.translationZh: 他在那里有一所房子,在海边还有一个小屋。

examples.text: He drove quickly in order to get there on time.
examples.translationZh: 他开得飞快,以便准时赶到那里。

examples.text: Don't panic! We'll soon get you out of there.
examples.translationZh: 别害怕,我们马上就把你从那里带出去。

meaningZh: 向前，向前方；露着的，往外的；[废语]出外，离家

examples.text: The guard walked back and forth in front of the gate.
examples.translationZh: 警卫在大门前走来走去。

examples.text: He went forth into the desert to pray
examples.translationZh: 他向前走到沙漠中祈祷。

examples.text: Suddenly oil sprang forth from the pipe.
examples.translationZh: 油突然从管子里喷了出来。

meaningZh: 狮子；名人；[天文学、占星术]狮子（星）座

examples.text: He is regarded as a lion.
examples.translationZh: 大家认为他是个很勇猛的人。

examples.text: The lion attacked its victim with great ferocity.
examples.translationZh: 狮子凶猛地扑向猎物。

examples.text: The lion lay asleep in its den.
examples.translationZh: 狮子躺在洞里睡觉。

meaningZh: 小孩；小山羊，小山羊皮制品；vt.& vi. 欺骗，戏弄，取笑

examples.text: The kid dug a tunnel in the sand.
examples.translationZh: 小孩在沙堆里挖了一个地道。

examples.text: She sees me as a little kid who counts for nothing.
examples.translationZh: 她认为我还是目个无足轻重的小孩子。

examples.text: Half the kids round here are unemployed.
examples.translationZh: 这里的年轻人有一半失业。

meaningZh: 合适的，适当的，适宜的，恰当的

examples.text: These films are suitable for adults only.
examples.translationZh: 这些电影只适宜成人观看。

examples.text: All the students are assigned to suitable jobs.
examples.translationZh: 所有的学生都分到了合适的工作。

examples.text: The director is looking for a suitable locale for his new film.
examples.translationZh: 导演在为新片物色合适的拍摄场地。

meaningZh: 教练；（铁路）旅客车厢；长途客运汽车

examples.text: The football coach was criticized by the local paper.
examples.translationZh: 这位足球教练受到了当地报纸的批评。

examples.text: The coach is bringing on some girls in the reserve team.
examples.translationZh: 教练正教导预备队的女孩们练球。

examples.text: Only soft drinks are complimentary in coach.
examples.translationZh: 在经济舱内,只有软性饮料是免费的。

meaningZh: 提到，说起；提名表扬；n. 提及

examples.text: Speaking of Macao, it is necessary to mention lotus flowers.
examples.translationZh: 说到澳门,就不得不提到莲花了。

examples.text: Paul is highly intelligent, not to mention good-looking and rich.
examples.translationZh: 保罗学识渊博,更不用说他还英俊富有呢!

examples.text: He made no mention of having met her.
examples.translationZh: 他不提他曾经和她见面。

meaningZh: 产品；结果；乘积

examples.text: If our product is properly marketed, it shall sell very well.
examples.translationZh: 如果我们的产品适当加以推销,销路应该很好。

examples.text: The hand is not only the organ of labour, it is also the product of labour.
examples.translationZh: 手不仅是劳动的器官,它还是劳动的产物。

examples.text: The eastern frontier of France was the product of centuries of historical accidents.
examples.translationZh: 法国东部的边境是百年来历史上风云变幻的结果。

meaningZh: 挤，榨，捏；压迫，压榨；vt. 榨取，汲取

examples.text: Kara squeezed the bottle, and the water rushed out.
examples.translationZh: 卡拉挤压着那个瓶子,水一下子喷了出来。

examples.text: It took some ingenuity to squeeze all the furniture into the little room.
examples.translationZh: 把全部家具都塞进那个小房间是很费了一番心思的。

examples.text: Supermarkets are accused of squeezing both customers and suppliers.
examples.translationZh: 超市因压榨顾客和供货商而遭到指控。

meaningZh: 公平的；合理的；晴朗的

examples.text: He won the game fair and square.
examples.translationZh: 他赢得这次比赛是公平的。

examples.text: Soames said that he was not getting a fair go.
examples.translationZh: 索米斯说他没有得到公平的对待。

examples.text: The rainbow promises fair weather.
examples.translationZh: 虹预示晴朗的天气。

meaningZh: 富裕；充裕；adv. 大量

examples.text: She has plenty of imagination.
examples.translationZh: 她的想象力非常丰富。

examples.text: I padded out my answer with plenty of quotations.
examples.translationZh: 我用了大量引文把答案拉长。

examples.text: You have plenty of time to read.
examples.translationZh: 你有大量的时间读书。

meaningZh: 消化；整理；vt. 吸收

examples.text: This is a digest of the week's news.
examples.translationZh: 这是一周新闻摘要。

examples.text: The baby is too small to digest meat.
examples.translationZh: 婴儿太小,吃肉不消化。

examples.text: Saliva helps one chew and digest food.
examples.translationZh: 唾液能帮助咀嚼和消化食物。

meaningZh: 我自己，亲自

examples.text: I started to enjoy this kind of music myself.
examples.translationZh: 我自己也喜欢上这类音乐。

meaningZh: 翅膀，翼；飞翔；派系，派别

examples.text: The hen tucked her head under her wing.
examples.translationZh: 那母鸡把头缩在翅膀下。

examples.text: A seagull fluttered down with an injured wing.
examples.translationZh: 一只海鸥拍打着翅膀飞落下来。

examples.text: The bird's left wing was hurt.
examples.translationZh: 这只鸟的左翼受伤了。

meaningZh: 浓的，茂密的；厚的，粗大的；稠密的

examples.text: He put on a thick sweater since it was cold in the morning.
examples.translationZh: 早晨很冷，他穿上了一件厚毛衣。

examples.text: The mountain was covered with a thick layer of snow.
examples.translationZh: 山上覆盖了一层厚厚的白雪。

examples.text: There is a thick forest behind the village.
examples.translationZh: 村子后面有一片密密的森林。

meaningZh: 长度，长；时间的长短；（语）音长

examples.text: The room is 15 feet in length and 10 feet in breadth.
examples.translationZh: 这房间长15英尺，宽10英尺。

examples.text: The length of your talk must be at least 10 minutes.
examples.translationZh: 你的演讲时间至少要保持在10分钟。

examples.text: The pier was lit up along its entire length.
examples.translationZh: 整个桥墩从头到尾都沐浴在灯火之中。

meaningZh: 直言的；坦率的；毫无保留的

examples.text: He is an outspoken critic of the government.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个直言批评政府的人。

examples.text: His outspoken remarks made him an easy target for the opposition.
examples.translationZh: 他那番直言不讳的言语使他成了反对派的主要抨击对象。

examples.text: Uncle Frank is an outspoken man.
examples.translationZh: 弗朗克叔叔是个坦率的人。

meaningZh: 他（她，它）们的；在提及性别不详的人时，用以代替 him 或 her

examples.text: They washed their faces.
examples.translationZh: 他们洗了脸。

examples.text: Children depend on their parents for food and clothing.
examples.translationZh: 小孩依赖他们的父母供给衣食。

examples.text: Young mothers are gushing over their babies.
examples.translationZh: 年轻的母亲滔滔不绝地谈论她们的婴儿。

meaningZh: 专科学校；学会，学院；一般的高等教育

examples.text: He is a student in an academy of music.
examples.translationZh: 他是一所音乐学院的学生。

examples.text: He was expelled from the Academy of Sciences.
examples.translationZh: 他被科学院开除了。

examples.text: The Royal Academy is regarded as the sanctuary by artists.
examples.translationZh: 英国皇家艺术学会被艺术家视为圣殿。

meaningZh: 虽然，尽管；即使；纵然

examples.text: Though we have tried our best, we lost the game.
examples.translationZh: 虽然我们已尽了最大的力量,但还是输了。

examples.text: I don't know him well though I've known him for a long time.
examples.translationZh: 我对他并不了解，虽然我认识他已经很长时间了。

examples.text: Though the task was difficult,they managed to accomplish it on time.
examples.translationZh: 尽管任务困难,他们仍按时完成了。

meaningZh: 孤独的，孤单的；寂寞的；荒凉的，幽静的

examples.text: I feel very lonely without my dog.
examples.translationZh: 我的狗不在旁边我就很寂寞。

examples.text: The lonely student is starving for friendship.
examples.translationZh: 那个寂寞的学生渴望友谊。

examples.text: Living on a lonely island can be very lonely.
examples.translationZh: 生活在荒凉的岛屿上会很孤独。

meaningZh: 发言人，代言人

examples.text: He was the spokesman for the workers on strike.
examples.translationZh: 他是罢工工人的发言人。

examples.text: This journalist distorted the spokesman's remarks.
examples.translationZh: 这名记者曲解了该发言人的话。

meaningZh: 分界线；范围；（球场）边线

examples.text: We crossed the state boundary at midnight.
examples.translationZh: 我们在午夜穿过了州界。

examples.text: They marked the boundaries of the football fields.
examples.translationZh: 他们画出了足球场地的边界。

examples.text: Scientists continue to push back the boundaries of knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 科学家不断地把知识领域的边缘向外扩展。

meaningZh: 生气的；愤怒的，发怒的；（颜色等）刺目的

examples.text: His imperious look makes us angry.
examples.translationZh: 他那飞扬跋扈的样子令我们生气。

examples.text: Don't be angry over such trivial matters.
examples.translationZh: 别为这些琐事生气。

examples.text: He shouts when he gets angry, as is often the case.
examples.translationZh: 他生气时就大叫，这是常有的情形。

meaningZh: 音乐的，用于音乐的；喜爱[精通]音乐的；音调优美的

examples.text: The mother found that her son had a musical talent.
examples.translationZh: 母亲发现儿子有音乐天赋。

examples.text: Since he can play many musical instruments, he may well be called a man of accomplishments.
examples.translationZh: 他能演奏许多乐器，当然称得上是个多才多艺的人。

examples.text: Everyone in my family is very musical.
examples.translationZh: 我家所有人都很喜欢音乐。

meaningZh: 彩色蜡笔或粉笔；vt.& vi. 用彩色蜡笔[粉笔]画

examples.text: The baby daubed up the wall with his crayon.
examples.translationZh: 小孩用蜡笔把墙上画得斑斑点点。

examples.text: The boy wants to draw in crayon.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩想用蜡笔画画。

meaningZh: 组，团体；群，批；（雕塑等的）群像

examples.text: She has a very wide group of friends.
examples.translationZh: 她有一大群朋友。

examples.text: A group of boys dashed out of the classroom.
examples.translationZh: 一群男孩子从教室里冲出来。

examples.text: That group harmonizes well.
examples.translationZh: 那一组用和声演唱得很出色。

meaningZh: 涌出；倾，倒；vi. 涌流

examples.text: Blood was pouring from the wound.
examples.translationZh: 血从伤口中流出。

examples.text: Although I poured it carefully, I spilt some of the oil.
examples.translationZh: 虽然我倒油时很小心，但还是洒了一些。

examples.text: She watched the rain pouring down the windows.
examples.translationZh: 她注视著顺著窗户往下流的大雨。

meaningZh: 小包；信息包；邮船

examples.text: The Government has clapped an extra ten pence on a packet of cigarettes.
examples.translationZh: 政府对每包香烟额外提价十便士。

examples.text: The postman tried to crush the packet through the letter-box.
examples.translationZh: 邮递员使劲把邮件塞进信箱里。

examples.text: There will be a packet to Calais.
examples.translationZh: 明天有邮船开到加莱去。

meaningZh: 安排；排列；约定

examples.text: He introduced to us the symmetrical arrangement of the garden.
examples.translationZh: 他为我们介绍了花园中对称的布局。

examples.text: He knew the room arrangement well.
examples.translationZh: 他对房间的布局是很清楚的。

examples.text: This arrangement is agreeable to both sides.
examples.translationZh: 这样安排对双方都合适。

meaningZh: 出租车；滑行；vi. 乘出租车

examples.text: Let me go shares with you in the taxi fare.
examples.translationZh: 我和你分摊计程车费吧。

examples.text: If you want to ensure that you catch the plane, take a taxi.
examples.translationZh: 你要想确保能赶上那班飞机，就坐出租车去吧。

examples.text: That may be our taxi now!
examples.translationZh: 那辆可能就是我们的计程车了。

meaningZh: 奖章，奖牌；勋章；纪念章

examples.text: He got a medal for bravery.
examples.translationZh: 他因勇敢而获得一枚奖章。

examples.text: She was awarded a medal for bravery.
examples.translationZh: 她因勇敢而获得奖章。

examples.text: He got a medal for his gallantry.
examples.translationZh: 他因勇敢而赢得一枚勋章。

meaningZh: 好奇的；好求知的；奇妙的

examples.text: I am curious how she will receive the news.
examples.translationZh: 我很想知道她如何接受那消息。

examples.text: The boy was curious about everything he saw.
examples.translationZh: 那男孩对所见的一切都感到好奇。

examples.text: I caught a curious sound in the neighboring room.
examples.translationZh: 我听到隔壁房间里有奇怪的响声。

meaningZh: 建立，组成；体格；构成方式

examples.text: The President swore to uphold the constitution.
examples.translationZh: 总统宣誓维护宪法。

examples.text: The country's constitution embodies the ideals of freedom and equality.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的宪法体现了自由和平等的理想。

examples.text: The constitution of a primitive society is not necessarily simple.
examples.translationZh: 原始社会的结构并不一定就是简单的。

meaningZh: 采用，采取，采纳；收养；正式接受，接受

examples.text: They adopt new techniques in raising sheep.
examples.translationZh: 他们采用新的养羊技术。

examples.text: The schools must adopt new methods of teaching foreign languages.
examples.translationZh: 学校应采用新的外语教学法。

examples.text: She was left an orphan and a poor peasant woman adopted her.
examples.translationZh: 她成了孤儿，一位贫农妇女收养了她。

meaningZh: 协会，社团；联合，联系；联想

examples.text: Have you joined the teachers' association?
examples.translationZh: 你加入教师协会了吗?

examples.text: About 20 people have registered in the association.
examples.translationZh: 大约有20人已登记加入这一协会。

examples.text: There is a hide-and-seek association with a leader who is nowhere to be found.
examples.translationZh: 有一个躲猫猫社团，他们的团长现在还没有找到。

meaningZh: 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的，适中的；端庄的

examples.text: We should be modest and prudent.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该谦虚谨慎。

examples.text: She is very modest about her success.
examples.translationZh: 她对自己的成就很谦虚。

examples.text: I bought the house at a modest price.
examples.translationZh: 我以适中的价格买下了这所房子。

meaningZh: 小窍门；小费；末梢

examples.text: He charged me 20 yuan for tip.
examples.translationZh: 他向我要了20元小费.

examples.text: It's common to leave a tip in many Western countries.
examples.translationZh: 在很多西方国家,给小费是很平常的。

examples.text: This manual is full of useful tips.
examples.translationZh: 这本小册子里有很多实用的小建议。

meaningZh: 新的，崭新的；新鲜的，新到的；现代的

examples.text: I'll just sew up that tear, and the coat will be as good as new.
examples.translationZh: 我把大衣的破处缝好，就会完好如新了。

examples.text: They sell new and used furniture.
examples.translationZh: 他们出售新旧家具。

examples.text: The book seemed to open up before me a new world.
examples.translationZh: 那本书好象在我面前揭示出一个崭新的世界。

meaningZh: 谈判，协商，交涉；vt. 谈判达成；成功越过

examples.text: We've decided to negotiate with the employers about our wage claim.
examples.translationZh: 我们决定就工资问题与雇主谈判。

examples.text: We are happy to negotiate with you in that way.
examples.translationZh: 我们很高兴用这种方式来和贵方协商交易。

examples.text: Trade union leaders went back to negotiate with the government.
examples.translationZh: 工会领导回去和政府进行交涉。

meaningZh: 公司；法人；社团，团体

examples.text: He works for a large American corporation.
examples.translationZh: 他为美国一家大型公司工作。

examples.text: Several new members have come into this corporation.
examples.translationZh: 这个公司又有新人员加入。

examples.text: The British Broadcasting Corporation is very famous across the world.
examples.translationZh: 英国广播公司在世界上很出名。

meaningZh: 设计；绘制；vt. 设计

examples.text: This dress is of the latest design.
examples.translationZh: 这件衣服是最新设计。

examples.text: He chalked out a design on the blackboard.
examples.translationZh: 他用粉笔在黑板上勾划出一个图样。

examples.text: The bedcover was quilted in a flower design.
examples.translationZh: 床罩被缝成花卉图案。

meaningZh: 坚强的，坚韧的，不屈不挠的；艰苦的，困难的，难办的；牢固的，强壮的

examples.text: The government is taking a tough line on drug abuse.
examples.translationZh: 政府对滥用麻醉药品采取强硬方针。

examples.text: I am well aware that this is a tough job.
examples.translationZh: 我深知这是一件棘手的工作。

examples.text: Conditions are rather tough here.
examples.translationZh: 这里条件比较艰苦。

meaningZh: 讨论；辩论；争论

examples.text: After a long debate, the house of commons approved the bill.
examples.translationZh: 经过长时间的辩论，下议院通过了议案。

examples.text: We had a long debate as to whether we should spend so much money on space technology.
examples.translationZh: 至于我们要否花那么多钱在太空技术上,我们辩论了很久。

examples.text: Her resignation caused much public debate.
examples.translationZh: 她辞职一事引起群众议论纷纷。

meaningZh: 锁；水闸，船闸；（机器部件等的）锁定

examples.text: He chiseled a hole in the door to fit a new lock.
examples.translationZh: 他在门上凿了个孔，以便装一把新锁。

examples.text: Water went rushing through the lock gates.
examples.translationZh: 水流经水闸时十分湍急。

examples.text: He keeps a lock of her hair.
examples.translationZh: 他保存着她的一绺头发。

meaningZh: 警告，告诫；通知；预告

examples.text: He warned me against going there at night.
examples.translationZh: 他警告我晚上不要到那去。

examples.text: They warn her that if she do it again she will be sent to prison.
examples.translationZh: 他们警告她说她再这么干就把她关进监狱。

examples.text: The police warn us not to go out at night.
examples.translationZh: 警察告诫我们夜间不要出门。

meaningZh: 正方形；广场；平方

examples.text: The little girl drew a square on the paper.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩在纸上画了一个正方形。

examples.text: Everybody goes to this vast square in the evening.
examples.translationZh: 每天傍晚，人人都上这宽阔的广场上来。

examples.text: The crowds in the square were elated by the news.
examples.translationZh: 这消息使广场上的人群欢欣鼓舞。

meaningZh: 包袱，包裹；（土地的）一块；一批，一群

examples.text: He snipped the string and untied the parcel.
examples.translationZh: 他剪断绳子，解开包裹。

examples.text: He tied the parcel with twine.
examples.translationZh: 他用细绳来捆扎包裹。

examples.text: Her stinginess is part and parcel of her nature.
examples.translationZh: 她生性吝啬。

meaningZh: 牛排；肉排；鱼排

examples.text: I want my steak well-done.
examples.translationZh: 我要全熟的牛排。

examples.text: I would like some steak and bread.
examples.translationZh: 我要牛排和面包。

examples.text: The steak was so tough that I couldn't eat it.
examples.translationZh: 牛排太老了,我咬不动它。

meaningZh: 铸造；投掷；投射

examples.text: The angler cast her line into the stream.
examples.translationZh: 那个垂钓者把鱼线掷进了小溪里。

examples.text: The storm cast the little rowboat onto the rocks.
examples.translationZh: 风暴把这条小划艇抛到岩石上。

examples.text: The two world wars cast a shadow over the people all over the world.
examples.translationZh: 两次世界大战在全世界人民中投下了阴影。

meaningZh: 屏幕；银幕；屏风

examples.text: The advertisement is full of the TV screen today.
examples.translationZh: 今天，电视屏幕被广告占据。

examples.text: Buzz suddenly appeared on my computer screen.
examples.translationZh: 巴兹突然出现在我的电脑屏幕上。

examples.text: Familiar scenes were imaged on the screen.
examples.translationZh: 银幕上映出了熟悉的景象。

meaningZh: 催促；推进，驱策；力劝，规劝

examples.text: He urged the horses on with a whip.
examples.translationZh: 他用鞭子策马前行。

examples.text: Many physicians urge aerobic exercise.
examples.translationZh: 很多医生鼓励有氧运动。

examples.text: We will urge them to adhere to the Paris Agreement.
examples.translationZh: 我们将敦促他们遵守巴黎协议。

meaningZh: 书包

examples.text: The schoolbag is for Mary for her new school year.
examples.translationZh: 书包是给玛丽的新学年礼物。

examples.text: My brother always misplaces his schoolbag.
examples.translationZh: 我弟弟常常乱放他的书包。

meaningZh: 君主,国王；重要的人、动物或事物; 大王

examples.text: The lion is called the king of beasts.
examples.translationZh: 狮子号称百兽之王。

examples.text: The king is the most important person in a kingdom.
examples.translationZh: 国王是一个王国中最重要的人物。

examples.text: You can also get a glimpse of the King of All Teas.
examples.translationZh: 还可以一睹茶中之王的风采。

meaningZh: 摩擦；冲突，不和；摩擦力

examples.text: Constant friction wore out the heels of my shoes.
examples.translationZh: 不断的摩擦磨损了我的鞋跟。

examples.text: Matches are lighted by friction.
examples.translationZh: 火柴由摩擦而生火。

examples.text: Friction lowers the efficiency of a machine.
examples.translationZh: 摩擦减低机器的效率。

meaningZh: 困难，麻烦，难事；难度；异议，争论，纠葛

examples.text: He experienced great difficulty in getting a visa to leave the country.
examples.translationZh: 他申请出国签证经历了很大的困难。

examples.text: He faced the difficulty with courage.
examples.translationZh: 他勇敢地面对困难。

examples.text: Have you any concrete thoughts on how to deal with this difficulty?
examples.translationZh: 处理这种困难你有什么具体的想法？

meaningZh: vt. & vi. (使)急速行进; 仓促完成；vt. 催促；vt. 突然袭击

examples.text: I really hate to rush off like this.
examples.translationZh: 我真的不喜欢这样匆匆离去。

examples.text: They rushed up the stairs.
examples.translationZh: 他们冲到楼上。

examples.text: He did not like us to rush him.
examples.translationZh: 他不喜欢我们催他。

meaningZh: 婚礼；婚宴；结婚纪念日

examples.text: We decided to delay our wedding until next year.
examples.translationZh: 我们决定把婚礼推迟到明年。

examples.text: She reproached her husband for having forgotten their wedding anniversary.
examples.translationZh: 她责怪丈夫忘了他们的结婚周年纪念日。

examples.text: The coalition government was obviously a shotgun wedding.
examples.translationZh: 这个联合政府显然是勉强的结合。

meaningZh: 献身，奉献；忠诚；信仰，祈祷

examples.text: Through great effort perhaps he is just cultivating a little devotion.
examples.translationZh: 尽管经过了很大的努力，他也许只是培养出少许的虔诚。

examples.text: We were deeply moved by their devotion.
examples.translationZh: 我们为他们的献身精神所感动。

examples.text: His devotion to science is well known.
examples.translationZh: 他对科学的献身精神为人熟知。

meaningZh: 洪水；泛滥；溢流

examples.text: The cellar floods whenever it rains heavily.
examples.translationZh: 一下大雨地窖里就灌满了水。

examples.text: The river had burst its banks and flooded the valley.
examples.translationZh: 河水冲破堤岸,淹没了山谷。

examples.text: The office was flooded with complaints.
examples.translationZh: 办事处收到如洪水般涌至的投诉信件。

meaningZh: 在大西洋里的，近大西洋的；n. （the Atlantic）大西洋

examples.text: It took them several days to cross the Atlantic Ocean.
examples.translationZh: 他们花了好几天的时间穿越大西洋。

examples.text: A strong gale swept down on the atlantic coast.
examples.translationZh: 狂风突然猛袭大西洋海岸。

examples.text: He was the first airpilot to cross the Atlantic.
examples.translationZh: 他是飞越大西洋的第一个飞行员。

meaningZh: 受痛苦；受损害；变糟

examples.text: They suffered huge losses in the financial crisis.
examples.translationZh: 他们在经济危机时遭受了巨大的损失。

examples.text: She couldn't suffer criticism.
examples.translationZh: 她受不了批评。

examples.text: I can suffer your treachery, but not you incompetence.
examples.translationZh: 我可以忍受你的背叛,但不能忍受你的无能。

meaningZh: 空闲的；空缺的；空虚的

examples.text: Absence of occupation is not rest, a mind quite vacant is a mind distress.
examples.translationZh: 无所事事不是休息，十分空虚的心灵是痛苦的心灵。

examples.text: The sky remains infinitely vacant for earth there to build its heaven with dreams.
examples.translationZh: 天空总是无限空虚地用梦在大地构筑天堂。

examples.text: He was appointed to the vacant post.
examples.translationZh: 他被委派填补那空缺。

meaningZh: 使大为吃惊，使惊奇；n. 吃惊，好奇

examples.text: He amazed me by his audacity.
examples.translationZh: 他的无理让我惊骇。

examples.text: I was amazed to find her there.
examples.translationZh: 发现她在那，我感到很吃惊。

examples.text: We were amazed at the change in his appearance.
examples.translationZh: 他的样子变得使我们大为惊讶。

meaningZh: 无论什么；任何（事物）；诸如此类

examples.text: We shall remain friends whatever may betide.
examples.translationZh: 无论发生什么事，我们将永远是朋友。

examples.text: Whatever nonsense the papers print, some people always believe it.
examples.translationZh: 不管报纸胡说什么,总有一些人信以为真。

examples.text: Whatever requests you make will be granted.
examples.translationZh: 你提的任何请求都会得到许可

meaningZh: 寝具；基底，基坑；adj. 适于花坛种植的

examples.text: Straw is used as temporary bedding.
examples.translationZh: 以稻草做为暂时的寝具。

examples.text: I fold up the bedding and put it in the closet.
examples.translationZh: 我折叠寝具把它放在柜子里。

meaningZh: 假装，伪装；假称；装扮

examples.text: She pretends that she likes them so that she can get their help.
examples.translationZh: 她假装很喜欢他们，借以获得他们的帮助。

examples.text: The young actor pretended to be Hamlet.
examples.translationZh: 那个年轻演员扮演哈姆雷特。

examples.text: She closed her eyes and pretended to be asleep.
examples.translationZh: 她闭上眼睛,装作睡着了。

meaningZh: 仍，仍然；更，还要；静静地

examples.text: Beware of silent dog and still water.
examples.translationZh: 提防不吠的犬,小心静止的水。

examples.text: The room was still at the end of the speech.
examples.translationZh: 演讲结束的时候，房间里寂静无声。

examples.text: Although she felt ill, she still went to work.
examples.translationZh: 她虽然觉得身体不舒服，但仍然去上班了。

meaningZh: 马戏，马戏团；马戏表演（常在大帐篷里进行）；环形广场，（用于某些地名）圆形广场

examples.text: He performs riding stunts in the circus.
examples.translationZh: 他在马戏团表演骑马绝技。

examples.text: The circus placarded the city with advertisements.
examples.translationZh: 马戏团满城张贴广告。

examples.text: The fascinations of the circus are endless.
examples.translationZh: 马戏表演非常吸引人。

meaningZh: 〈口〉橡皮底帆布鞋；〈美〉鬼鬼祟祟的人

examples.text: This pair of sneakers looks very nice.
examples.translationZh: 这双运动鞋看起来很好看。

examples.text: He pulled on his trousers and shirt and sneakers.
examples.translationZh: 他套上裤子，穿上衬衣，蹬上那双帆布胶鞋。

meaningZh: 难以忍受的，不能忍受的，经受不住的；承受不住的

examples.text: The uncertainty is unbearable!
examples.translationZh: 事情定不下来真让人难以忍受！

examples.text: The politician found the piteous cries of the starving children unbearable.
examples.translationZh: 这个政治家发现饥饿的孩子们可怜的哭声让人不忍心听下去。

meaningZh: 事件，形势；东西，事物；家伙

examples.text: That was the only thing they could count on.
examples.translationZh: 那是他们唯一依靠的东西。

examples.text: I happened on just the thing I'd been looking for.
examples.translationZh: 我偶然发现了我一直在寻找的东西。

examples.text: He explained the whole thing from way back.
examples.translationZh: 他把整件事情解释得很透彻。

meaningZh: 古老的，古代的；过时的，古董的；古时制造的

examples.text: The antique table went to the lady in the pink hat.
examples.translationZh: 这张古董桌子卖给那位戴粉红色帽子的女士了。

examples.text: In the museum we saw many antique plates.
examples.translationZh: 我们在博物馆看到了很多古时候的盘子.

examples.text: The antique furniture was made in 1700.
examples.translationZh: 这件古老的家具是1700年制造的。

meaningZh: 撕裂；拉掉；挣开

examples.text: Take the book from Alice, she will tear it.
examples.translationZh: 把书从艾丽斯那拿开，她会撕了它的。

examples.text: Nails that project may tear your clothes.
examples.translationZh: 突出的钉子会刮坏你的衣服。

examples.text: Her heart was torn by anxiety.
examples.translationZh: 她焦虑得心都快碎了。

meaningZh: 关于；大约；在…周围

examples.text: Tell me all about it.
examples.translationZh: 告诉我关于这件事的一切。

examples.text: It is about six o'clock now.
examples.translationZh: 现在是六点钟左右。

examples.text: It was a long flight and it took about fourteen hours.
examples.translationZh: 时间真长,飞了大约十四个小时。

meaningZh: 河，江；溪，巨流

examples.text: The guide led us to the river.
examples.translationZh: 向导带领我们到河边。

examples.text: Growing along the river are tall palm trees.
examples.translationZh: 沿着这条河生长的是高大的棕树。

examples.text: Navigation is difficult on this river because of the hidden rocks.
examples.translationZh: 因为河上有暗礁，所以在这条河上航行很困难。

meaningZh: 短处，缺点

examples.text: Not being punctual is his greatest shortcoming.
examples.translationZh: 不守时间是他的最大缺点。

examples.text: Donna is sensible of his shortcoming.
examples.translationZh: 唐纳知道他自己的缺点。

examples.text: No matter who point out our shortcoming, we will correct them.
examples.translationZh: 不管谁指出我们的缺点，我们都改正。

meaningZh: 骆驼

examples.text: The camel is a herbivorous animal.
examples.translationZh: 骆驼是一种食草动物。

examples.text: The merchant decided to use camels to carry his goods across the desert.
examples.translationZh: 商人决定用骆驼载运货物穿过沙漠。

examples.text: The favorite, of course, is camel.
examples.translationZh: 最受欢迎的自然是驼色。

meaningZh: 热烈地拥抱，抱住，紧抱；vt. 紧靠…走；抱有，持有

examples.text: It's common to hug when people meet in the US.
examples.translationZh: 在美国,见面拥抱是件很平常的事。

examples.text: He hurries down the gangplank to hug his waiting wife.
examples.translationZh: 他匆匆忙忙走下跳板,张开双臂去拥抱等候着他的妻子。

examples.text: The child was hugging her doll.
examples.translationZh: 那孩子紧抱着她的洋娃娃。

meaningZh: 危险；危险物，威胁

examples.text: She was on the danger list, but is much better now.
examples.translationZh: 她曾一度病危，现在好多了。

examples.text: The operation is a success and now the patient is out of danger.
examples.translationZh: 手术成功了，病人现在已脱离危险。

examples.text: Violent criminals like that are dangers to society.
examples.translationZh: 那种暴力罪犯对社会是一种危害。

meaningZh: 狼

examples.text: The pups played with the mother wolf.
examples.translationZh: 小狼们跟母狼玩耍。

examples.text: He saw a hungry wolf on the prowl with his telescope.
examples.translationZh: 他通过望远镜看到了一头四处觅食的饿狼。

examples.text: Peter is a good footballer, but he is a lone wolf.
examples.translationZh: 彼得是个好足球队员，但他是个不与人合作的人。

meaningZh: 人类；男性，男子

examples.text: Mankind learns its first language in early childhood.
examples.translationZh: 人类是在幼年开始学习第一种语言的。

examples.text: Christ's atonement is for the sins of mankind.
examples.translationZh: 耶稣的赎罪是为了人类的罪恶。

examples.text: Sympathy is the feeling characteristic of mankind.
examples.translationZh: 同情心是人类特有的感情。

meaningZh: 答复；解答；答辩

examples.text: The question is simple enough to answer.
examples.translationZh: 这个问题很简单,容易回答。

examples.text: she fell into a rage and refused to answer.
examples.translationZh: 他勃然大怒,拒不回答。

examples.text: He answered that he knew nothing about it.
examples.translationZh: 他答复说关于此事他一无所知。

meaningZh: 比较，对照；vt. 比拟，喻为；[语]构成

examples.text: I compared the copy with the original, but there was not much difference.
examples.translationZh: 我比较了复印件和原件，但是差别不是很大。

examples.text: The police compared the suspect's fingerprints with those found at the crime scene.
examples.translationZh: 警察将嫌疑犯的指纹和犯罪现场的指纹进行了对比。

examples.text: Life is poetically compared to the morning dew.
examples.translationZh: 在诗歌中，人生被比喻为朝露。

meaningZh: [法]确认，批准；证实；使有效

examples.text: His letter confirmed everything.
examples.translationZh: 他的信证实了一切。

examples.text: The treaty was confirmed by the president.
examples.translationZh: 条约已被总统批准。

examples.text: Could you confirm the dispatch date?
examples.translationZh: 您可以确定发货日期吗?

meaningZh: 公园；停车场；vt. & vi. 停车

examples.text: He leaves his car in the hotel car park.
examples.translationZh: 他把车停放在旅馆的停车场。

examples.text: I often take my children to play in the park.
examples.translationZh: 我经常带我的孩子们去公园玩。

examples.text: Water, electricity, steam, natural gas and plant air will supplied by the park.
examples.translationZh: 水、电、蒸汽、天然气、工业气体等由园区统一供给。

meaningZh: 肩膀；（衣服的）肩部；山肩

examples.text: The bullet wounded his shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 子弹打伤了他的肩膀。

examples.text: Her hand rested lightly upon his shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 她的手轻轻地搭在他的肩膀上。

examples.text: The bullet went clean through his shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 子弹穿透他的肩膀。

meaningZh: 布，织物；一块布；用作某种用途的布，桌布，擦布，揩布

examples.text: This piece of cloth was eaten by a moth.
examples.translationZh: 这块布被蠹虫蛀坏了。

examples.text: Cloth is sold by the yard.
examples.translationZh: 布是按码卖的。

examples.text: This piece of cloth has bad coloration.
examples.translationZh: 这块布料染的不好。

meaningZh: 回收利用；使再循环；vi. 重复利用

examples.text: We should try to recycle all our waste paper.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该把所有废纸回收再利用。

examples.text: One thing you can't recycle is wasted time.
examples.translationZh: 唯一无法回收利用的是你浪费掉的时间。

examples.text: We should recycle the used things.
examples.translationZh: 我们应回收利用旧东西。

meaningZh: 电话；电话机；（电话机的）话筒

examples.text: Let me note down your address and telephone number.
examples.translationZh: 让我记下你的地址和电话号码。

examples.text: He put the telephone bill down as a business cost.
examples.translationZh: 他把电话费用作为办公费记下。

examples.text: You can telephone your order through to the shop.
examples.translationZh: 你可以打电话向商店购货。

meaningZh: 煮沸，沸腾；疔，疖子；[医]疡肿，脓肿

examples.text: The kettle is boiling.
examples.translationZh: 壶里的水开了。

examples.text: I am boiling the milk.
examples.translationZh: 我正在煮牛奶。

examples.text: This new type of electromagnetic boiler takes only 3 minutes to boil water.
examples.translationZh: 这样的新型电磁炉煮沸一锅水只用3分钟。

meaningZh: 有，所有，拥有；领地；财产，所有权，占有物，所有物

examples.text: He was found in possession of dangerous drugs.
examples.translationZh: 她被发现藏有危险物品。

examples.text: We've bought the house, but we can't get possession of it before July.
examples.translationZh: 我们买下了这所房子, 但要到七月份才算实际拥有。

examples.text: The people had to gather up their few possessions and escaped abroad.
examples.translationZh: 人们不得不收拾起仅有的一点财物逃到国外去。

meaningZh: 长颈鹿

examples.text: The giraffe is much taller than the deer.
examples.translationZh: 长颈鹿比鹿高多了。

examples.text: The giraffe eats tender leaf from the tree highly.
examples.translationZh: 长颈鹿从高高的树上吃掉嫩树叶子。

examples.text: The giraffe must get up at six in the morning if it wants to have its breakfast in its stomach by nine.
examples.translationZh: 长颈鹿得要在早上六点起来，如果它想早饭在九点钟之前到达胃里的话。

meaningZh: 先生；绅士；有身份地位的人

examples.text: The old gentleman had on a classic suit.
examples.translationZh: 那位老年绅士穿著一套古朴的传统服装。

examples.text: Please bring this gentleman a cup of coffee.
examples.translationZh: 请给这位先生拿一杯咖啡。

examples.text: I looked up at the gentleman in the clericals.
examples.translationZh: 我抬头看著这位身穿教士服的先生。

meaningZh: 真，真正；实在，果真；实际上

examples.text: It's really cold today.
examples.translationZh: 今天可真冷。

examples.text: It's really too bad that the teacher couldn't find someone to substitute for her when she was sick.
examples.translationZh: 她生病时,老师找不到人代替她,实在太遗憾了。

examples.text: Go ahead. Do whatever you really love.
examples.translationZh: 去吧,去做你真正喜爱的事。

meaningZh: 新郎

examples.text: The bridegroom was dressed in a grey suit.
examples.translationZh: 新郎穿一套灰色礼服。

examples.text: Bride and bridegroom start from Mohandseen.
examples.translationZh: 新郎和新娘一起从婚纱影楼出发。

meaningZh: 含糊的，不明确的；引起歧义的；有两种或多种意思的

examples.text: He gave us an ambiguous answer .
examples.translationZh: 他给了我们一个模棱两可的答复。

examples.text: In fact, your ambiguous words amount to a refusal.
examples.translationZh: 实际上,你说的那些模棱两可的话等于是拒绝。

examples.text: Her account was deliberately ambiguous.
examples.translationZh: 她的陈述故意含混不清。

meaningZh: 力；武力；（社会）势力

examples.text: When persuasion failed they used force.
examples.translationZh: 劝说无效时,他们就使用武力了。

examples.text: We'll settle the problem by force if necessary.
examples.translationZh: 如果有必要的话,我们会用武力解决这个问题。

examples.text: If you do not open the door, I am authorized to enter by use of force.
examples.translationZh: 如果你不开门,我有权使用暴力闯入。

meaningZh: 按钮，电钮；纽扣，扣子；扣状物

examples.text: One of the buttons has come off my coat.
examples.translationZh: 我上衣上的一颗扣子掉了。

examples.text: You may stop the machine by pushing this button.
examples.translationZh: 按下这个按钮你就可以关掉这个机器。

examples.text: It's very warm, he didn't even button his coat.
examples.translationZh: 天气很暖和,他甚至都没扣他外衣的钮扣。

meaningZh: 大概；或许；很可能

examples.text: I'll be probably free then.
examples.translationZh: 那时我大概就有空了。

examples.text: That hotel probably costs no less than 20 dollars a night.
examples.translationZh: 那间旅馆的住宿费大约要20元一晚呢。

examples.text: He can probably tell us all the details we want.
examples.translationZh: 他也许能告诉我们所需的全部详情。

meaningZh: 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；美妙；胜

examples.text: Never before have I seen such a wonderful film .
examples.translationZh: 我从未看过如此精彩的影片。

examples.text: Let's share the wonderful dolphin show together.
examples.translationZh: 让我们一起欣赏海豚的精彩的表演吧。

examples.text: Rowing is a wonderful water sport.
examples.translationZh: 赛艇是一项精彩的水上运动。

meaningZh: 款待；招待；乐事

examples.text: We should treat people and animals with humanity.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该仁慈地对待人和动物。

examples.text: Do not treat a naughty child rough.
examples.translationZh: 不要粗暴地对待顽皮的孩子。

examples.text: I decided to treat his remark as a joke.
examples.translationZh: 我决定把他的话当作戏言。

meaningZh: （与某人）搏斗；（与…）摔跤；斟酌

examples.text: He wrestled his opponent to the floor/ground.
examples.translationZh: 他把对手摔倒在地上。

examples.text: He taught his little brother how to wrestle.
examples.translationZh: 他教他小弟弟如何摔跤。

examples.text: We have to wrestle with difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须同困难作斗争。

meaningZh: 音乐；乐曲；乐谱

examples.text: He is interested in music.
examples.translationZh: 他对音乐有兴趣。

examples.text: Listening to the music has a calming influence on her.
examples.translationZh: 听音乐对她起了一种镇静的作用。

examples.text: I was enchanted with the sweet music.
examples.translationZh: 这美妙的音乐使我心醉。

meaningZh: 友好的，亲密的；有帮助的；互助的

examples.text: The meeting is gone on in very friendly atmosphere.
examples.translationZh: 会议在非常友好的气氛中进行。

examples.text: He cloaked his evil purpose under friendly words.
examples.translationZh: 他用友好的语言来掩盖他罪恶的目的。

examples.text: He was not very friendly to us.
examples.translationZh: 他对我们不太友善。

meaningZh: 钢，钢铁；钢制品；兵器

examples.text: The doctor inserted a steel plate into his damaged leg.
examples.translationZh: 医生在他受伤的腿中植入了一块钢板。

examples.text: The output value of iron and steel makes up one quarter of the country's national income.
examples.translationZh: 钢铁制品创造的产值占据了国民收入的四分之一。

examples.text: He is a man of steel who has experienced a lot of wars.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个经历过许多战争、有着钢铁般意志的男人。

meaningZh: 学生，大学生；研究者，学者；中学生

examples.text: A student should always be curious to learn.
examples.translationZh: 学生应该始终具有强烈的求知欲。

examples.text: A young student fainted in the hot sun.
examples.translationZh: 有个年幼的学生在炎炎烈日下晕倒了。

examples.text: John is more diligent than any other student in his class.
examples.translationZh: 约翰比班上其他的同学用功。

meaningZh: 这些的；pron. 这些

examples.text: These are my books.
examples.translationZh: 这些是我的书。

examples.text: I'm just going to check in these books at the library.
examples.translationZh: 我要去图书馆还这些书。

examples.text: We have been working hard these days.
examples.translationZh: 这些天来，我们一直在努力工作。

meaningZh: 黄昏，傍晚；幽暗；adj. 微暗的

examples.text: The lights go on at dusk.
examples.translationZh: 一到黄昏灯就亮了。

examples.text: He usually goes out for a walk at dusk.
examples.translationZh: 他通常在黄昏时出去散步。

examples.text: He works from dawn till dusk.
examples.translationZh: 他从天亮工作到天黑。

meaningZh: 说， 讲；表明，宣称；假设

examples.text: He said hello to me with a smile.
examples.translationZh: 他面带微笑地和我打了个招呼。

examples.text: She said that she liked singing.
examples.translationZh: 她说她喜欢唱歌。

examples.text: He will of course say yes to my proposal.
examples.translationZh: 他一定会同意我的建议的。

meaningZh: 盆；盆地；流域

examples.text: This basin is made of iron.
examples.translationZh: 这个盆子是铁做的。

examples.text: He washed his hands in a basin.
examples.translationZh: 他在盆里洗了手。

examples.text: He first poured some water in the basin.
examples.translationZh: 他先在脸盆里倒了一些水。

meaningZh: 海军；船队

examples.text: He is a gunner of the British navy.
examples.translationZh: 他是英国海军的一名炮手。

examples.text: Beiyang Navy is the earliest naval force of China.
examples.translationZh: 北洋水师是中国最早的海军部队。

examples.text: The army, navy and airforce are all controlled by the Ministry of Defense.
examples.translationZh: 陆海空军皆由国防部控制。

meaningZh: 身体；尸体；团体

examples.text: A balanced diet provides nutrition for your body.
examples.translationZh: 均衡的食物使你的身体获得营养。

examples.text: Alcoholic drink can have a bad effect on your body.
examples.translationZh: 含酒精的饮料会对你身体有很坏的影响。

examples.text: He is not mentioned in the main body of the text.
examples.translationZh: 文章的主体中没有提到他。

meaningZh: 毫米

examples.text: The deviation is reduced to one millimetre.
examples.translationZh: 偏差减为一毫米。

examples.text: One second of arc movement is one thirtieth of a millimetre.
examples.translationZh: 一弧秒的移动是一毫米的三十分之一。

meaningZh: [机]套筒，套管；袖子，袖套；唱片套

examples.text: If it is necessary to have the joints under water, they must be bedded into a box or sleeve which absolutely prevents water from penetrating in.
examples.translationZh: 如果有必要在水下接头，就必须把它们安置于绝对不渗水的密封盒子或套管中。

examples.text: A stranger plucked at my sleeve as I was leaving.
examples.translationZh: 我刚要离去，一个陌生人拽我的袖子。

examples.text: He rolled up his sleeves and got to work in the garden.
examples.translationZh: 他卷起了袖子，在花园里干起活来。

meaningZh: 指责，谴责；指控

examples.text: How dare you accuse me of lying!
examples.translationZh: 你怎敢谴责我说谎!

examples.text: We resolve not to accuse them to avoid troubles.
examples.translationZh: 我们决定不起诉他们

examples.text: I mustered up enough courage to accuse him.
examples.translationZh: 我鼓起足够的勇气控告他。

meaningZh: 牛肉；菜牛（饲养以供肉食的牛）；体力

examples.text: Do you like stewed beef?
examples.translationZh: 你喜欢吃炖牛肉吗？

examples.text: Africa is exporting beef to Europe.
examples.translationZh: 非洲向欧洲出口牛肉。

examples.text: He's got plenty of beef.
examples.translationZh: 他肌肉发达。

meaningZh: 望远镜；vt.& vi. （使某物）变短（叠缩在一起）；（使某物）叠缩，嵌入

examples.text: He saw a hungry wolf on the prowl with his telescope.
examples.translationZh: 他通过望远镜看到了一头四处觅食的饿狼。

examples.text: What is the range of this telescope?
examples.translationZh: 这架望远镜的有效距离多大?

examples.text: He was too poor to buy an astronomical telescope.
examples.translationZh: 他太穷了，买不起天文望远镜。

meaningZh: 富的,富裕的,富有的；贵重的,昂贵的,豪华的；盛产,丰富,多

examples.text: He is a rich man.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个富有的人。

examples.text: The rich man left his son nothing in the will.
examples.translationZh: 那位富翁在遗嘱中什么都没给他儿子留下。

examples.text: Our country is a rich land.
examples.translationZh: 我们是一个富饶的国家。

meaningZh: [C] 夏,夏天,夏季；黄金时代,鼎盛时期；岁数

examples.text: We must use a canopy in summer.
examples.translationZh: 夏天必须使用遮阳伞。

examples.text: The stream is reduced to a mere trickle in summer.
examples.translationZh: 夏天那条小河的水量减少，成了涓涓溪流。

examples.text: The congregation of sightseers increases in the summer.
examples.translationZh: 夏季，旅游观光的人增加了。

meaningZh: 美味的，可口的；有趣的；喷香

examples.text: She can produce delicious meal from very simple ingredients.
examples.translationZh: 她能用简单配料烹调出美味的饭菜。

examples.text: The hunter entertained us with venison which was very delicious.
examples.translationZh: 猎人拿出了非常美味的鹿肉招待我们。

examples.text: The bannock is delicious.
examples.translationZh: 这种薄饼很可口。

meaningZh: 烤架；户外烧烤；v. 烧烤

examples.text: The sunshine bodes well for our barbecue.
examples.translationZh: 明媚的阳光对我们的烤肉野餐是个吉兆。

examples.text: The rain loused up the barbecue.
examples.translationZh: 下雨弄砸了烤肉野餐。

examples.text: If you're not busy Sunday, we'd love to have you both over for a barbecue.
examples.translationZh: 如果你周日有空，我们想请你们俩来吃烧烤。

meaningZh: （引导名词性从句）谁；无论谁，任何人；不管谁…

examples.text: Whoever leaves the office should tell me.
examples.translationZh: 无论是谁离开办公室都应该告诉我。

examples.text: Whoever visits the town will be welcome.
examples.translationZh: 不管谁来镇上参观都受欢迎。

examples.text: Whoever commits the crime shall be sentenced to ten years in prison.
examples.translationZh: 任何人犯了此罪就要被判处十年徒刑。

meaningZh: 忽视，不顾；[法律]驳回（诉讼）

examples.text: If you ignore your diet, trouble will follow.
examples.translationZh: 如果你忽视自己的饮食，必然会遇到麻烦

examples.text: I agree in principle, but we can't ignore the differences.
examples.translationZh: 我原则上同意,但我们不能忽视这些差异。

examples.text: The wisest course would be to ignore it.
examples.translationZh: 上上策是不予理睬。

meaningZh: 量，数量；总额；本利之和

examples.text: A petrol gauge shows the amount of petrol left in a car.
examples.translationZh: 汽油表指示出汽车里所剩的汽油数量。

examples.text: He has a large amount of mail to answer every day.
examples.translationZh: 他每天有大量的信件要回复。

examples.text: Remember to tell the guest the amount of the bill.
examples.translationZh: 记得告诉客人帐单的总额。

meaningZh: 欢迎，致敬；vt. 向…致意；赞扬，赞颂

examples.text: We salute the flag everyday at school.
examples.translationZh: 我们在学校每天向国旗行礼。

examples.text: This ignoramus failed to salute me.
examples.translationZh: 这个蠢汉看见我不行礼。

examples.text: They saluted each other by raising their hats.
examples.translationZh: 他们举起帽子互相致意。

meaningZh: 困恼的，为难的；担心的；v. 担心( worry的过去式和过去分词)

examples.text: It was what she left unsaid that worried me.
examples.translationZh: 叫我担心的是她觉察到而未说出的。

examples.text: Gorman worried that the problems be solved.
examples.translationZh: 戈尔曼担心的难题迎刃而解。

meaningZh: 图表，曲线图；词的拼法；vt. 用曲线图表示，把…绘入图表

examples.text: The graph shows a bulge in the price of meat.
examples.translationZh: 图表显示肉类价格上涨。

examples.text: Our research results are displayed in the form of a graph.
examples.translationZh: 我们的研究结果已用图表列出.

examples.text: This is a simple graph of legislative process.
examples.translationZh: 这是立法过程的简易示意图。

meaningZh: 与…相像，类似于

examples.text: The brothers resemble each other in taste.
examples.translationZh: 那对兄弟兴趣相似。

examples.text: She resembles her sister in appearance but not in character.
examples.translationZh: 她和她姐姐外貌相似，但性格不同。

examples.text: You resemble your mother very closely.
examples.translationZh: 你非常像你的母亲。

meaningZh: 玫瑰,玫瑰花; 蔷薇

examples.text: He plucked a rose for his lover.
examples.translationZh: 他为情人摘了一朵玫瑰花。

examples.text: I found him pruning his roses.
examples.translationZh: 我看到他正在给玫瑰修剪枝条。

examples.text: Botanists refer this flower to the rose family.
examples.translationZh: 植物学家将这花归入蔷薇科。

meaningZh: 刀；匕首；刃部

examples.text: He cleaved an apple with a knife.
examples.translationZh: 他用一把刀子将苹果切开。

examples.text: I picked up the knife and threw it out of the window.
examples.translationZh: 我拿起了那把刀，把它扔到了窗外。

examples.text: His cheek was badly scarred by a knife cut.
examples.translationZh: 他的面颊上留有严重的刀疤。

meaningZh: 解放；释放，逸出

examples.text: We came off relief grain shortly after liberation.
examples.translationZh: 解放后不久，我们就不吃救济粮了。

examples.text: Only after liberation is he able to go to school.
examples.translationZh: 只是在解放后，他才能去上学。

examples.text: The national liberation movement was gathering.
examples.translationZh: 民族解放运动正日益高涨。

meaningZh: 气喘吁吁的，喘不过气来的；（紧张得）屏住气息的；透不过气的

examples.text: Bob was breathless with excitement.
examples.translationZh: Bob激动得喘不过气来.

examples.text: I was completely breathless when I got to the top of the mountain.
examples.translationZh: 当我到达山顶上时，我已经上气不接下气了。

examples.text: The children are breathless as they watch the tightrope act.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们在看走绳索表演时呼吸都屏住了。

meaningZh: 短袜；（尤指用拳头）猛击，重击；vt. 重击

examples.text: There is a hole in my sock.
examples.translationZh: 我的袜子上有个洞。

examples.text: He selected a pair of socks to match his suit.
examples.translationZh: 他挑选了一双与他衣服相配的短袜。

meaningZh: 描写，形容；叙述；描绘，作图

examples.text: The police asked me to describe exactly how it happened.
examples.translationZh: 警察让我描述一下这事是怎样发生的。

examples.text: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
examples.translationZh: 语言难以描述那景色之美丽。

examples.text: He describes himself as a doctor.
examples.translationZh: 他自称是医生。

meaningZh: 绝对的，完全的；不受任何限制[约束]的；无条件的

examples.text: There is no absolute standard for beauty.
examples.translationZh: 美是没有绝对的标准的。

examples.text: Motion is absolute, while stillness is relative.
examples.translationZh: 运动是绝对的，而静止是相对的。

examples.text: There is no absolute freedom in the world.
examples.translationZh: 世上没有绝对的自由。

meaningZh: 庆祝；祝贺；举行宗教庆典

examples.text: Let's celebrate!
examples.translationZh: 让我们好好庆祝一下吧！

examples.text: People in the city held a great party to celebrate their victory.
examples.translationZh: 本市的市民举行了盛大的晚会庆祝他们的胜利。

examples.text: They had a family feast to celebrate it.
examples.translationZh: 他们举办家宴以示庆贺。

meaningZh: 农作物；产量；庄稼

examples.text: The flood did a lot of damage to the crops.
examples.translationZh: 洪水毁坏了大量农作物。

examples.text: We have had the biggest wheat crop ever this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年我们的小麦收获量是有史以来最好的。

examples.text: The crop died due to a lack of rain for 5 months.
examples.translationZh: 5个月没下雨了,庄稼枯死了。

meaningZh: 英镑；磅；兽栏

examples.text: I lost several pounds last month.
examples.translationZh: 我上个月瘦了好几磅。

examples.text: The shop is selling choice apple, so I buy 3 pound.
examples.translationZh: 那商店在卖上选苹果,所以我买了三磅。

examples.text: There is a 1 pound admission charge.
examples.translationZh: 入场费为1英镑。

meaningZh: 血，血液；流血，杀戮，杀人（罪），牺牲；有…类型的血的，血统

examples.text: The dog's fur was matted with blood.
examples.translationZh: 那只狗的毛皮上沾有血迹。

examples.text: She was sick at the sight of the blood.
examples.translationZh: 她一见到血就感到恶心。

examples.text: A drop of blood slid down his leg.
examples.translationZh: 他的腿上流着一点儿血。

meaningZh: 童年，儿童时代；早期

examples.text: I have only misty memories of my early childhood.
examples.translationZh: 我对自己的童年只剩一些模糊的记忆。

examples.text: He had a lively remembrance of his childhood.
examples.translationZh: 他对他的童年生活记忆犹新。

examples.text: Childhood is a period of rapid growth.
examples.translationZh: 幼年是生长迅速的时期。

meaningZh: 技巧；技能；技术

examples.text: The technique is still at the experimental stage.
examples.translationZh: 这项技术正处于实验阶段。

examples.text: The workers are trying to apply modern techniques to this traditional craft.
examples.translationZh: 工人们试图将现代技术用于这项传统工业。

examples.text: In many sports physical fitness is not as important as technique.
examples.translationZh: 在许多体育运动中，体能没有技巧重要。

meaningZh: 在…下面，在表面之下；在…的假定表面或掩饰下；少于，小于

examples.text: The watch cannot be sold for under 100 yuan.
examples.translationZh: 这块表低于100元不卖。

examples.text: The total is under what was expected.
examples.translationZh: 总数低于预计数。

examples.text: No one under the rank of captain may enter the room.
examples.translationZh: 级别低于上尉者禁止入内。

meaningZh: vt. 抵制; 拒绝参加

examples.text: are shown.
examples.translationZh: 如果

meaningZh: 提出（离婚诉讼或其他讼案）；把…归档；用锉锉

examples.text: Put this letter in the main file.
examples.translationZh: 把这封信放在主要文件夹中。

examples.text: Would you please take a seat while I look into our file?
examples.translationZh: 你先坐一下,我给你查一下我们的卷宗?

examples.text: Put this letter in the main file.
examples.translationZh: 把这封信放在主要文件夹中。

meaningZh: 边；优势；（悬崖、峭壁的）边缘，端

examples.text: Look out! You could fall off the edge here!
examples.translationZh: 小心!你会从这边缘掉下的。

examples.text: New houses have mushroomed on the edge of the town.
examples.translationZh: 城市边缘的新建房屋犹如雨后春笋。

examples.text: In the second half of the game, the home team got the edge on the visitors and kept it.
examples.translationZh: 比赛下半场,主队比客队略占上风,并把这一优势保持到终场。

meaningZh: 装饰；点缀；粉刷

examples.text: We decorated the house for Christmas.
examples.translationZh: 我们装饰房屋过圣诞节。

examples.text: My mother likes to decorate rooms.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈非常喜欢装饰房间。

examples.text: I'll bring some balloons to decorate.
examples.translationZh: 我要带些气球去装饰装饰。

meaningZh: 有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的；（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的；有病的，不舒服的

examples.text: The story was very funny.
examples.translationZh: 这个故事非常可笑。

examples.text: He closed his speech with a funny joke.
examples.translationZh: 他用一则有趣的笑话结束了演讲。

examples.text: Her hair was done up in a very funny way.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发非常滑稽地盘在头上。

meaningZh: （用于第二人称单复数现在时，第一、三人称复数现在时）是；n. 公亩（等于100平方米）

examples.text: Don't cry, you are a big boy now.
examples.translationZh: 别哭，你现在已经是大男孩了。

examples.text: There are enough people to do the job.
examples.translationZh: 有足够的人做这项工作。

meaningZh: （主持会议的）主席；委员长；（委员会的）委员长

examples.text: The chairman exhorted the party workers to take action.
examples.translationZh: 主席敦促党的工作人员采取行动。

examples.text: In the absence of the chairman of the council,the vice chairman does duty for him.
examples.translationZh: 委员会会长缺任时，便由副会长代理职务。

examples.text: Minority of board member opposed the chairman.
examples.translationZh: 董事会成员中的少数人反对董事长。

meaningZh: 交通工具的运行时间表，时刻表；计划；课程表

examples.text: I'll change my timetable to fay in with yours.
examples.translationZh: 我将改变时间表以便和你们的吻合起来。

examples.text: There have been a few alterations to the timetable.
examples.translationZh: 时间表上有一些变动。

examples.text: The timetable is subject to change without notice.
examples.translationZh: 本时刻表随时可能改变，不另行通知。

meaningZh: 佛教；释；佛门

examples.text: Some young people study Zen Buddhism or Bahai.
examples.translationZh: 有些年轻人研究禅宗佛教或伊斯兰巴哈教派的教义。

examples.text: Mr White has converted to Buddhism.
examples.translationZh: 怀特先生已改信佛教。

meaningZh: 下午；后期，后部

examples.text: Good afternoon!
examples.translationZh: 下午好！

examples.text: She could knit up a baby's coatee in an afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 她一个下午就能编结好一件婴孩的紧身短上衣。

examples.text: I met him in a hot and breathless afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 我是在一个又闷又热的下午遇到他的。

meaningZh: 打呵欠；张开，裂开；张开大口

examples.text: His long boring story made me yawn.
examples.translationZh: 他的冗长的故事听得我直打呵欠。

examples.text: He closed the book, yawned, and went to bed.
examples.translationZh: 他合起书, 打了个呵欠, 然后上床睡觉了。

examples.text: The deep crevasse yawned at their feet.
examples.translationZh: 他们脚下的冰川有一道深深的裂缝。

meaningZh: 将要；必须；可以

examples.text: Shall we all go to the film tonight?
examples.translationZh: 我们今晚都去看电影吗?

examples.text: Everything shall be in good order.
examples.translationZh: 一切都应该井然有序。

examples.text: World peace is a cause we shall all work for.
examples.translationZh: 争取世界和平是一项我们都应该为之而努力的事业。

meaningZh: 寡妇,遗孀

examples.text: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
examples.translationZh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。
examples.author: fucongcong

meaningZh: 骑自行车（脚踏车）的人

examples.text: The cyclist was run down by a lorry.
examples.translationZh: 卡车把骑自行车的人撞倒了。

meaningZh: 暖和的，温暖的；保暖的；热情的

examples.text: It's a nice and warm today.
examples.translationZh: 今天的天气晴朗而且温暖。

examples.text: Take your coat off. It's warm in the room.
examples.translationZh: 把外衣脱掉,室内很暖和。

examples.text: He was pleased with their warm welcome.
examples.translationZh: 他们的热烈欢迎使他很高兴。

meaningZh: 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切

examples.text: Thank you for everything.
examples.translationZh: 感谢你做的一切。

examples.text: Money isn't everything.
examples.translationZh: 金钱不是一切。

examples.text: His standard for everything is excellence.
examples.translationZh: 他对所有事物的标准是卓越。

meaningZh: 折叠；包裹，缠绕；使搭接

examples.text: The child sat on its mother's lap.
examples.translationZh: 小孩坐在妈妈的膝上。

examples.text: For quite some time, everything fell into his lap.
examples.translationZh: 好长一段时间他事事称心如意。

examples.text: The leading car crashed midway through the tenth lap.
examples.translationZh: 领先的那辆赛车在第十圈的中途撞毁了。

meaningZh: 采用（某种方式）；穿着，带着；（表示位置）在…里面，（表示领域，范围）在…以内

examples.text: The telephone was in the little study on the ground floor.
examples.translationZh: 电话在底楼的小书房里。

examples.text: The books are printed in Hong Kong.
examples.translationZh: 这些书在香港印刷。

examples.text: They are in research of this new technique.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在研究这种新工艺。

meaningZh: 委员会

examples.text: The committee meets at three today.
examples.translationZh: 委员会今天三点开会。

examples.text: Moderates have displaced the extremists on the committee.
examples.translationZh: 在委员会中，稳健派人士取代了激进派人士。

examples.text: Some members of the committee expressed reservations about the proposal.
examples.translationZh: 委员会一些成员对这项提议持保留态度。

meaningZh: 释义 无轨电车

examples.text: Bus and trolleybus are homebred.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车和无轨电车都是国产的。

examples.text: He often goes to school by trolleybus.
examples.translationZh: 他经常乘无轨电车上学。

meaningZh: 关系；领带，绳子；平局

examples.text: He doesn't want any ties; that's why he never married.
examples.translationZh: 他不愿受束缚，所以不结婚。

examples.text: Pets can be a tie when you want to go away on holiday.
examples.translationZh: 要想外出度假时，宠物会成为牵累。

examples.text: The firm has ties with an American corporation.
examples.translationZh: 该商行与美国一家公司有关系。

meaningZh: 针；针状物；刺激性言行

examples.text: The needle pierced her finger.
examples.translationZh: 针刺进了她的手指。

examples.text: She pricked herself on a needle.
examples.translationZh: 她被针扎了一下。

examples.text: The road looks beautiful covered by golden pine needles.
examples.translationZh: 这条路上铺满了金黄色的松针，看上去美极了。

meaningZh: 西北，西北方向；西北部；adj. 在西北的

examples.text: There is a large hilly area in the northwest.
examples.translationZh: 西北部有一大片丘陵地带。

examples.text: The city is located in the northwest part of Canada.
examples.translationZh: 这座城市位于加拿大的西北部。

examples.text: The park is northwest from the city.
examples.translationZh: 公园在该市的西北。

meaningZh: 蘑菇；蘑菇状物，蘑菇形物体；（女用）蘑菇形草帽

examples.text: Some mushrooms are poisonous.
examples.translationZh: 有些蘑菇有毒。

examples.text: I gathered many mushrooms after rain.
examples.translationZh: 雨后我采了很多蘑菇。

examples.text: The mushroom cloud of the A-bomb hung over the desert again.
examples.translationZh: 原子弹爆炸的蘑菇云再度笼罩在沙漠的上空。

meaningZh: （动植物的）克隆；无性繁殖系；复制人（或动植物）

examples.text: Above all, we must first clone a panda.
examples.translationZh: 最重要的是我们必须首先克隆一只熊猫。

examples.text: The first clone farm has appeared in New Zealand.
examples.translationZh: 第一家克隆农场在新西兰出现。

examples.text: At the outset they must contain several ramets of every selected clone.
examples.translationZh: 在开始时每个入选无性系必须包括几个无性繁殖后代。

meaningZh: 画廊，走廊；（教堂，议院等的）边座；旁听席

examples.text: The gallery has a show of French oil painting.
examples.translationZh: 这个美术馆在展出法国油画。

examples.text: She is a frequent visitor to the gallery.
examples.translationZh: 她经常参观这个美术馆。

examples.text: The gallery is a treasure trove of medieval art.
examples.translationZh: 这个画廊是中世纪艺术的宝库。

meaningZh: 山，山岳；山脉；一大堆

examples.text: I have a mountain of work to do.
examples.translationZh: 我有一大堆工作要做。
