examples.text: The mountain is 3500 meters high.
examples.translationZh: 这座山有3500米高。

examples.text: The mountain tops are covered with snow.
examples.translationZh: 白雪覆盖着山顶。

meaningZh: 旅行者，观光客；〈美〉冬季到南部做工的流动工人

examples.text: The tourist complained that the room was too dirty.
examples.translationZh: 游客抱怨说房间太脏了。

examples.text: The tourist is a Hungarian.
examples.translationZh: 这名游客是匈牙利人。

examples.text: London is full of tourists in the summer.
examples.translationZh: 夏季伦敦有很多游客。

meaningZh: 风；气流；吞下的气

examples.text: A gust of wind blew my hat off.
examples.translationZh: 一阵大风吹走了我的帽子。

examples.text: The higher the tree, the stronger the wind.
examples.translationZh: 树越高, 风越大。

examples.text: The day was very still, without a breath of wind.
examples.translationZh: 天空十分平静

meaningZh: 鸡蛋，蛋；卵；家伙

examples.text: The egg nestled in the long grass.
examples.translationZh: 蛋隐藏在高草中。

examples.text: The black hen lays an egg a day.
examples.translationZh: 那只黑母鸡每天生一个蛋。

examples.text: The tadpole hatches from the egg.
examples.translationZh: 蝌蚪从卵中孵化出来。

meaningZh: 水手，海员；驾船人

examples.text: He went about in the disguise of a sailor.
examples.translationZh: 他伪装成海员到处流窜。

examples.text: The sailor was rated as an ordinary seaman.
examples.translationZh: 那个水手被列为普通海员。

examples.text: A sailor is at the mercy of the weather.
examples.translationZh: 水手受到天气的摆布。

meaningZh: 大使，使节；（派驻联合国等国际组织的）代表；特使

examples.text: He was appointed ambassador to the United States.
examples.translationZh: 他被任命为驻美国大使。

examples.text: He never failed to send the ambassador a report each week.
examples.translationZh: 他每个礼拜必送报告给大使。

examples.text: The ambassador expects that his next posting will be (to) Paris.
examples.translationZh: 那位大使预期他下次派驻巴黎。

meaningZh: 损害；伤害；危害

examples.text: If we interfere, it may do more harm than good.
examples.translationZh: 倘若我们进行干预，那可能弊多利少。

examples.text: It wouldn't do him any harm to work a bit harder.
examples.translationZh: 工作努力点对他没什么害处。

examples.text: The army defends the people from harm .
examples.translationZh: 军队保护人民免遭伤害。

meaningZh: 直到…时（为止）；在…之前；vt. 耕种

examples.text: The meeting adjourned till five o'clock.
examples.translationZh: 会议延至五点召开。

examples.text: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
examples.translationZh: 今日事今日毕。

examples.text: Not till then did I realize the danger of the situation.
examples.translationZh: 直到那个时候我才感到形势的危险。

meaningZh: 砖，砖块；砖块状物体；一砖的厚度

examples.text: His new house was built by himself, brick by brick.
examples.translationZh: 他的新房子是他自己一块砖一块砖砌起来的。

examples.text: Her husband is a brick layer.
examples.translationZh: 她丈夫是个砌砖匠。

examples.text: He had a brick thrown at him at that meeting.
examples.translationZh: 那次集会时，他的头部被一块砖头击中。

meaningZh: 视觉，视力；见解，观察；眼力

examples.text: Is your eyesight failing recently?
examples.translationZh: 你近来视力有所变差吗？

examples.text: The eye drops will help to improve your eyesight.
examples.translationZh: 这种眼药水能改善你的视力。

meaningZh: 灵魂；精神；幽灵

examples.text: Creativity is the soul of a nation.
examples.translationZh: 创新是一个民族进步的灵魂。

examples.text: No words can express the secret agony of my soul.
examples.translationZh: 没有任何语言能够表达我心灵中的隐痛。

examples.text: The eye is the window of the soul.
examples.translationZh: 眼睛是心灵的窗户。

meaningZh: 管理；控制；规章

examples.text: We need the regulation of share prices.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要对股票价格的管制。

examples.text: From now on any violation of the regulation must be cruelly punished.
examples.translationZh: 今后任何违反秩序的行为会受到严厉惩罚。

examples.text: It's wrong of you to get around the regulation.
examples.translationZh: 你存心规避规章制度是不对的。

meaningZh: 外甥女；侄女

examples.text: Her niece is wearing a bright yellowish skirt.
examples.translationZh: 她的侄女穿著一条鲜明的淡黄色裙子。

examples.text: My niece has practiced ballet for six years.
examples.translationZh: 我侄女已练了六年芭蕾舞了。

examples.text: My niece was left in my trust for the weekend.
examples.translationZh: 我受托周末照顾我的外甥女。

meaningZh: 可以,许可；也许,可能；但愿

examples.text: Well, and who may you be?
examples.translationZh: 那麽，你是谁呢?

examples.text: That might be our taxi.
examples.translationZh: 那辆有可能是我们的计程车。

examples.text: That may be our taxi now!
examples.translationZh: 那辆可能就是我们的计程车了。

meaningZh: 有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的

examples.text: It's windy today.
examples.translationZh: 今天有风。

examples.text: Hold on to the hat on a windy day.
examples.translationZh: 在有风的日子里请紧紧抓住帽子。

examples.text: In spring, it's warm, sunny and windy.
examples.translationZh: 春天是一个温暖、多日照和多风的季节。

meaningZh: 影响；假装；感动

examples.text: How does interest rate affect the price of bonds?
examples.translationZh: 利率如何影响债券的价格?

examples.text: She was deeply affected by the sad story.
examples.translationZh: 她深深被那个悲伤的故事感动了。

examples.text: His charm doesn't affect or impress me.
examples.translationZh: 他的魅力对我不起作用.

meaningZh: 毛衣，运动衫；出汗（过多）的人，发汗剂；榨取别人血汗的人（或工厂、公司等）

examples.text: This woolen sweater may keep you warm in winter.
examples.translationZh: 这件羊毛衫在冬天可以保暖。

examples.text: She slipped into the sweater and dashed out of the door.
examples.translationZh: 她匆匆穿上毛衣, 冲出门去。

examples.text: He put on a thick sweater since it was cold in the morning.
examples.translationZh: 早晨很冷，他穿上了一件厚毛衣。

meaningZh: 名气，名声；好名声；信誉，声望

examples.text: This store has an excellent reputation for fair dealing.
examples.translationZh: 这家商店因公平交易而获好名声。

examples.text: He has not too good a reputation in the matter of honesty.
examples.translationZh: 就诚实而言, 他的名声不太好。

examples.text: He trades on his father's reputation.
examples.translationZh: 他用他父亲的名誉牟利。

meaningZh: 炉，火炉；窑；干燥室，烘房

examples.text: I have to buy a more economical stove.
examples.translationZh: 我得买一个更节省燃料的火炉。

examples.text: Please warm up this milk over the stove.
examples.translationZh: 请把这杯牛奶放在炉子上热一热。

examples.text: The erected stove is specially made for firing limestone.
examples.translationZh: 这座立窑是专门用来烧制石灰石的。

meaningZh: 合唱；合唱队；（歌曲的）副歌

examples.text: The audience chimed in on the chorus.
examples.translationZh: 听众开始跟合唱队一起唱起来。

examples.text: The chorus is dressed as fairies.
examples.translationZh: 歌舞队的人都装扮成仙子。

examples.text: When I asked questions, they answered up in chorus.
examples.translationZh: 我提问题时,他们迅速齐声回答。

meaningZh: 汉堡包；碎牛肉；牛肉饼

examples.text: She ordered a hamburger and French fries.
examples.translationZh: 她叫了一客汉堡包和炸薯条。

examples.text: I had a hamburger and a fried chicken leg.
examples.translationZh: 我吃一个汉堡包，一个炸鸡腿。

examples.text: Don't always eat hamburgers for meals, or else you'll get malnourished.
examples.translationZh: 别总把汉堡包当饭吃，不然你会营养不良的。

meaningZh: 哈喽，喂；你好，您好；表示问候

examples.text: Hello, it's me.
examples.translationZh: 喂，是我呀。

examples.text: Hello, it's us back again!
examples.translationZh: 喂，是我们回来了！

examples.text: Say hello to your husband.
examples.translationZh: 问你的丈夫好。

meaningZh: 虫，蠕虫；（昆虫的）幼虫；寄生虫

examples.text: The worm was crushed under the feet.
examples.translationZh: 虫被脚踏扁了。

examples.text: The bird had a worm in its beak.
examples.translationZh: 鸟儿嘴里叼着一条虫。

examples.text: The most infamous is known as the Internet Worm.
examples.translationZh: 其中最臭名昭著的是因特网蠕虫。

meaningZh: 液体；流音；adj. 液体的

examples.text: The doctor recommended that the patient be fed liquid food.
examples.translationZh: 医生建议病人应吃流质食物。

examples.text: Air whether in the gaseous or liquid state is a fluid.
examples.translationZh: 空气，无论是气态的还是液态的，都是一种流体。

examples.text: The earth is believed to have a liquid core.
examples.translationZh: 人们相信地球有一个液态核。

meaningZh: 直接的；直的；直系的

examples.text: I' m in direct contact with the hijackers.
examples.translationZh: 我与劫机者保持着直接的联系.

examples.text: Keep product away from direct sunlight and store in a dry cool place.
examples.translationZh: 置放在不受阳光直射,干燥通风的地方。

examples.text: He is very direct, so you always know what his real views are.
examples.translationZh: 他为人很直率, 所以你总能知道他的真实想法。

meaningZh: 塔，楼塔；要害地；〈罕〉（负伤鸟的）笔直向上飞

examples.text: There is a sonorous bell in the tower.
examples.translationZh: 塔里有一口洪亮的钟。

examples.text: The tower was blown to atoms by the force of the explosion.
examples.translationZh: 爆炸的力量把塔炸得粉碎。

examples.text: The bell tower is the emblem of this city.
examples.translationZh: 这座钟楼是这个城市的象征。

meaningZh: 超重的；过重的；超过规定重量的

examples.text: Too many people in the States are overweight.
examples.translationZh: 超重的美国人太多了。

examples.text: Overweight women who undergo axillary lymph node dissection are more likely to develop lymphedema.
examples.translationZh: 超重的妇女在进行腋窝淋巴结清扫后更容易产生淋巴水肿。

examples.text: The baggage is two kilos overweight.
examples.translationZh: 那件行李超重两公斤。

meaningZh: 吠叫；厉声说话；vt. 大声喊出

examples.text: The dog barked when the stranger came near.
examples.translationZh: 当陌生人走近时，狗叫了起来。

examples.text: An old dog does not bark for nothing.
examples.translationZh: 老狗不会无事而吠。

examples.text: When you speak to people, don't bark at them.
examples.translationZh: 当你和人说话时不要咆哮。

meaningZh: 步，脚步；步骤，手段；步调

examples.text: The government is taking steps to control the rising crime rate.
examples.translationZh: 政府正采取措施以控制不断上升的犯罪率。

examples.text: We should take steps to prevent war.
examples.translationZh: 我们应当采取措施制止战争。

examples.text: However, the next step can be started.
examples.translationZh: 然而,下一步骤可以开始。

meaningZh: 谢谢，感谢；责怪，把…归于；n. 感谢，谢谢，道谢的话

examples.text: Thank you all the same.
examples.translationZh: 不管怎样，还是要谢谢你。

examples.text: I don't know how I can possibly thank you enough.
examples.translationZh: 我不知道该怎样来感谢你才好。

examples.text: I'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their hard work on the project.
examples.translationZh: 我愿借此机会感谢每一位为这个项目辛勤工作的人。

meaningZh: 意志；目的；作用

examples.text: What is the purpose of your visit?
examples.translationZh: 你来访的目的是什么？

examples.text: He was a man of purpose.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个意志坚强的人

examples.text: I am sure that he came here with ill purpose.
examples.translationZh: 我敢断定,他这次来意图不轨。

meaningZh: （计算机）文档，证件；公文；vt. 证明

examples.text: She signed her name to the document.
examples.translationZh: 她在文件上签了名。

examples.text: He persuaded her to sign the document by guile.
examples.translationZh: 他用欺骗手段说服她在文件上签字。

examples.text: The official document was misworded.
examples.translationZh: 这公文的措词不当。

meaningZh: 平日，普通日；工作日

examples.text: I don't stay out late on weekdays.
examples.translationZh: 工作日的时候我不在外面呆得很晚。

examples.text: The library is open on weekdays only.
examples.translationZh: 这个图书馆星期一至星期六都开放。

examples.text: You can have your goods delivered on any weekday.
examples.translationZh: 您要求在任何工作日装运货物均可。

meaningZh: 浅的，肤浅的；表面的，皮毛的；（水，器物等）浅的

examples.text: This shallow ford made it possible for us to cross the river.
examples.translationZh: 我们有可能从这片浅滩过河。

examples.text: That dish is too shallow to serve soup in.
examples.translationZh: 那只盘子太浅了，不能盛汤。

examples.text: Homesickness is a shallow strait, I stand here, my homeland is on the other side.
examples.translationZh: 乡愁是一湾浅浅的海峡,我在这头,大陆在那头。

meaningZh: 表现，象征；代表，代理；扮演

examples.text: Monsters in dreams often represent fears.
examples.translationZh: 怪物在梦里经常表现为恐惧。

examples.text: Both represent the triumph of passion over reason.
examples.translationZh: 两者都表现出理智之外的激情。

examples.text: Dotted arrows represent flow of information.
examples.translationZh: 虚矢线表示信息流程。

meaningZh: 试验；考验；测验

examples.text: We achieved within seven months an agreement that has stood the test of time.
examples.translationZh: 我们在七个月内完成一项协议,而且经受住了时间的考验。

examples.text: Our test flight was to discover the bugs in the new plane.
examples.translationZh: 试验飞行是为了发现新飞机有何毛病。

examples.text: Tomorrow we'll have a history test.
examples.translationZh: 明天我们将进行历史测验。

meaningZh: 放映；计划；发射

examples.text: Our project was scrubbed.
examples.translationZh: 我们的计划被取消了。

examples.text: They doubted of the feasibility of the project.
examples.translationZh: 他们怀疑这个计划的可行性。

examples.text: The project is proceeding as planned.
examples.translationZh: 工程正在按计划进行。

meaningZh: 花；精华；开花植物

examples.text: She picked up a pink flower from a foxglove.
examples.translationZh: 她从毛地黄上摘了一朵粉花。

examples.text: I dare not touch the flower for its tenderness.
examples.translationZh: 这花太娇嫩了，我不敢碰它。

examples.text: The plant has a brilliant purple flower.
examples.translationZh: 那棵植物开著一朵鲜艳的紫花。

meaningZh: 规则，规定；统治，支配；章程

examples.text: Can you explain the thirty-second rule to me?
examples.translationZh: 可以给我解释一下30秒规则吗?

examples.text: It's against the rule to pick up the ball.
examples.translationZh: 捡球是犯规的。

examples.text: Is this rule in operation yet?
examples.translationZh: 这一条例生效了吗?

meaningZh: 橱柜；衣柜；食物柜

examples.text: I put the dishes in the cupboard.
examples.translationZh: 我把菜放在碗橱里。

examples.text: He stored foods in his cupboard.
examples.translationZh: 他把食品存放在碗橱里。

examples.text: All our glass and china is kept in the cupboard.
examples.translationZh: 我们所有的玻璃和陶瓷器皿都放在柜橱里。

meaningZh: 天文学

examples.text: Physics and astronomy are cognate sciences.
examples.translationZh: 物理学和天文学是相关联的科学。

examples.text: Astronomy, as distinct from astrology, is an exact science.
examples.translationZh: 天文学是一门严谨的科学，与占星术完全不同。

examples.text: Astronomy is the scientific study of the sun, moon, and stars and other heaven bodies.
examples.translationZh: 天文学是研究太阳、月亮、星星和其他天体的科学。

meaningZh: 氢

examples.text: Hydrogen is highly explosive.
examples.translationZh: 氢极易爆炸。

examples.text: Hydrogen and oxygen are gases.
examples.translationZh: 氢和氧是气体。

examples.text: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

meaningZh: 自行车；摩托车；电动自行车

examples.text: I've decided to buy that bike.
examples.translationZh: 我已决定购买那辆自行车。

examples.text: The lost bike was discovered at the bus stop.
examples.translationZh: 丢了的脚踏车在公车站找到了。

examples.text: John's parents vetoed his plan to buy a motor bike.
examples.translationZh: 约翰的父母不同意他买摩托车。

meaningZh: 看法；风景；视域

examples.text: The valley was hidden from view in the mist.
examples.translationZh: 溪谷隐没在雾霭之中，看不见了。

examples.text: His view of life is different from yours.
examples.translationZh: 他的人生观与你的不同。

examples.text: I enjoy the view of the bay in the starlight.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢星光下的海湾风景。

meaningZh: 飞机，航空器

examples.text: The wings of the aircraft had iced up.
examples.translationZh: 机翼上结了一层冰。

examples.text: A large passenger aircraft will land on the airfield.
examples.translationZh: 一架大型民航班机将降落在这个飞机场。

examples.text: Only experienced pilots fly large passenger aircraft.
examples.translationZh: 只有有经验的飞行员才能驾驶大型客机。

meaningZh: 准确的；严密的；精密的，精确的

examples.text: She's a very exact person.
examples.translationZh: 她是个一丝不苟的人。

examples.text: We need exact instruments.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要精密仪器。

examples.text: What is the exact size of the room?
examples.translationZh: 这个房间的确切面积是多少？

meaningZh: 咀嚼，咬；深思，考虑；n. 咀嚼

examples.text: Many people like to chew mint gum in the summer.
examples.translationZh: 许多人喜欢在夏天嚼薄荷口香糖。

examples.text: You must chew your food well before you swallow it.
examples.translationZh: 食物吞下去之前先要细细咀嚼。

examples.text: Chew your food well before swallow.
examples.translationZh: 吞下食物以前必须要好好咀嚼。

meaningZh: 老的；古老的；以前的

examples.text: The old lady fondled her cat as it sat beside her.
examples.translationZh: 老妇人抚摸着蹲在身边的小猫。

examples.text: He invited me to his home to talk over old times.
examples.translationZh: 他邀我到他家里去聊聊过去的事。

examples.text: The cupboard was stuffed with old fishing tackle.
examples.translationZh: 小橱里塞满了旧的钓鱼用具。

meaningZh: 谷物；玉米；鸡眼

examples.text: Corn shot up to seventy-three cents a bushel.
examples.translationZh: 谷物猛涨到一蒲式耳七十三美分。

examples.text: The corn grinds easily.
examples.translationZh: 谷物容易磨成粉。

examples.text: The ground was plowed and planted with corn.
examples.translationZh: 地翻耕后种上了玉米。

meaningZh: 爆米花；保护物品的小片：大量用于包装及运输中保护物品的一种小片，如聚苯乙烯；淡黄色

examples.text: I bought a cup of coke and some popcorn.
examples.translationZh: 我买一杯可口可乐和一些爆米花。

examples.text: Popcorn is popular with various people.
examples.translationZh: 爆米花受到各种人的欢迎。

meaningZh: 释义 博士

examples.text: Dr Hardy was a founder member of the club.
examples.translationZh: 哈迪博士是俱乐部的创始会员之一。

examples.text: Dr Smith attended her in hospital.
examples.translationZh: 史密斯医生在医院中给她治病。

meaningZh: 薄雾；视线模糊不清；液体喷雾

examples.text: A mist of perfume hung in the air.
examples.translationZh: 空气中飘溢著香水的雾气。

examples.text: Everything was covered in mist.
examples.translationZh: 一切都笼罩在雾霭中。

examples.text: She could hardly recognize her son through the mist of tears that filled her eyes.
examples.translationZh: 她泪眼蒙蒙，几乎不能认出自己的儿子。

meaningZh: 模型；模特儿；模式

examples.text: His mother is a model of industry.
examples.translationZh: 他母亲是勤劳的模范。

examples.text: Lily is a fashion model.
examples.translationZh: 莉莉是个时装模特儿。

examples.text: The model has an individual way of dressing.
examples.translationZh: 这个模特儿有著独特的穿衣方式。

meaningZh: 供给；补充；弥补（缺陷、损失等）

examples.text: They wrote off for a fresh supply of penicillin.
examples.translationZh: 他们发信要求再供应一批青霉素。

examples.text: Our wood supply proved insufficient.
examples.translationZh: 我们的木材供应证明是不够的。

examples.text: A tight blockade cut Napoleon's supply lines.
examples.translationZh: 严密的封锁切断了拿破仑的补给线。

meaningZh: 流行性感冒，流感

examples.text: I got flu and was out of commission for a week.
examples.translationZh: 我得了流感，一星期没工作。

examples.text: The school was closed because of the flu.
examples.translationZh: 因为流行性感冒全校停止上课。

examples.text: I caught a flu and had to lie in the bed.
examples.translationZh: 我得了流感，不得不卧床休息。

meaningZh: 文书工作；纸上作业

examples.text: Paperwork consumed much of the committee's time.
examples.translationZh: 文书工作耗费了委员会许多时间。

examples.text: Behind the desk a single clerk busied himself with paperwork.
examples.translationZh: 桌子后面，一名职员正在埋头处理文书工作。

examples.text: My secretary can not cope with the backlog of paperwork
examples.translationZh: 我的秘书无力处理积压下来的文书作业。

meaningZh: 字母，S字形之物

examples.text: The word “class” ends with an ess.
examples.translationZh: 单词 class 以字母 S 结尾。

meaningZh: 在附近的，位于附近的；adv. 附近地，不远地

examples.text: He usually trades at the nearby supermarket.
examples.translationZh: 他通常在附近的超市购物。

examples.text: He roped his horse on a nearby tree.
examples.translationZh: 他把马拴到附近的一棵树上。

examples.text: I can hear the hymn from the nearby church.
examples.translationZh: 我能听到从附近的教堂传来的圣歌。

meaningZh: 熊；（在证券市场等）卖空的人；蛮横的人

examples.text: The hunter slashed at the bear with his knife.
examples.translationZh: 猎人挥刀向熊猛烈砍去。

examples.text: The bear has lived up to his reputation for stupidity.
examples.translationZh: 这只熊果然名不虚传，笨得出奇。

examples.text: I can't bear young people casting away their youth.
examples.translationZh: 我无法忍受年轻人虚掷青春。

meaningZh: 粗筛；谜语；猜不透的难题，难解之谜

examples.text: That painting is still a riddle to us.
examples.translationZh: 那幅画对我们仍然是个谜。

examples.text: He could not solve the riddle.
examples.translationZh: 他猜不出这个谜。

examples.text: He got the answer to the riddle as quick as a flash.
examples.translationZh: 他一下子就猜中了谜底。

meaningZh: (轮船、飞机等的)乘务员，服务员；(俱乐部、旅馆、工会等的)管理员

examples.text: His neighbor is a chief steward.
examples.translationZh: 他的邻居是一个乘务员领班。

examples.text: We thanked the steward for his good service.
examples.translationZh: 我们感谢了乘务员所提供的优质服务。

examples.text: Sometimes he sent his house steward in his place.
examples.translationZh: 有时他派管家替他去。

meaningZh: 中等的，中级的；普通的；平均的

examples.text: The blue cap is a medium size.
examples.translationZh: 那顶蓝色的帽子就是中号的。

examples.text: The clothes should be washed at medium temperature.
examples.translationZh: 这衣服需以适中温度洗涤。

examples.text: Commercial television is an effective medium for advertising.
examples.translationZh: 商业电视是有效的广告宣传工具。

meaningZh: 赶上；接住；引起

examples.text: We're just in time to catch the train.
examples.translationZh: 我们正好赶上了火车。

examples.text: The police are tracking down him and hope to catch him soon.
examples.translationZh: 警察正在搜捕他并希望能很快抓住他。

examples.text: It is natural for a cat to catch mice.
examples.translationZh: 猫捉老鼠是本能。

meaningZh: 幸福的；快乐的；巧妙的

examples.text: I am so happy to hear of your engagement.
examples.translationZh: 听到你订婚我很高兴。

examples.text: This has been the happiest day of my life.
examples.translationZh: 这是我生活中最快乐的一天。

examples.text: I wish you a very happy future.
examples.translationZh: 我祝你有非常幸福的未来。

meaningZh: （私立学校的）校长

examples.text: The headmaster patted the pupil on the shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 校长轻轻拍拍那个学生的肩膀。

examples.text: My father is a headmaster of a primary school.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲是小学校长。

meaningZh: 移民，侨民；殖民者；决定者

examples.text: The settlers were soon acclimated.
examples.translationZh: 移居者很快就适应了。

examples.text: One of his forefathers was an early settler in America.
examples.translationZh: 他的祖先之一是美洲的早期移民。

examples.text: It is said that the first settlers of this country are prisoners.
examples.translationZh: 据说第一批到达这个国家的移民是囚犯。

meaningZh: 自助餐；火车饮食柜台；车站快餐部

examples.text: We serve buffet during lunchtime only.
examples.translationZh: 我们只在午餐时间供应自助餐。

examples.text: We had a buffet supper last evening.
examples.translationZh: 昨天晚上，我们吃了一次自助晚餐。

examples.text: In the corner of the room there was a small buffet.
examples.translationZh: 在屋子角落里有一小的餐具柜。

meaningZh: （使）浮动；（使）漂浮；自由浮动

examples.text: There is not enough water to float the ship.
examples.translationZh: 没有足够的水使船漂浮起来。

examples.text: These plants float on the surface of the water.
examples.translationZh: 这些植物漂浮在水面上。

examples.text: They float the canoe out into the middle of the river.
examples.translationZh: 他们将独木舟漂浮到河中央。

meaningZh: 政策；策略；保险单

examples.text: They expressed their dissent from official policy.
examples.translationZh: 他们对官方的政策表示出异议。

examples.text: I will never swerve from my declared policy on this matter.
examples.translationZh: 我决不背离我已经宣布的在这个问题上的政策。

examples.text: This latest incident may be the lever needed to change government policy.
examples.translationZh: 最近的事件或许可以作为迫使政府改变政策所需的手段。

meaningZh: 打字员

examples.text: She worked as a typist in a law firm.
examples.translationZh: 她在一家律师事务所当打字员。

examples.text: Our typist is away on holiday this week.
examples.translationZh: 我们这儿的打字员这星期因休假没上班。

meaningZh: 肚子，腹部；（物体的）圆形或凸起部份；胃口，食欲

examples.text: My belly is empty.
examples.translationZh: 我肚子饿了。

examples.text: A hungry belly has no ears.
examples.translationZh: 人肚子饿了就听不进道理。

examples.text: The robber stabbed the young man in the belly.
examples.translationZh: 强盗刺伤了这名年轻人的腹部。

meaningZh: 远足，郊游，短途旅行；散步；v. 伸出( out的现在分词)

examples.text: I think we should postpone the outing.
examples.translationZh: 我认为我们应该推迟这次郊游。

examples.text: It is such a fine day for an outing.
examples.translationZh: 今天是这样一个适合于郊游的好日子。

examples.text: We went for an outing on a crisp fall day.
examples.translationZh: 我们在一个秋高气爽的日子去远足了。

meaningZh: 歌曲；歌唱（艺术）；诗歌，韵文

examples.text: The song has plaintive melody.
examples.translationZh: 这首歌曲的曲调悲伤。

examples.text: I woke up and was greeted by bird song.
examples.translationZh: 我一觉醒来，鸟鸣之声不绝于耳。

examples.text: The song of birds heralds spring.
examples.translationZh: 鸟儿的歌唱预报春到。

meaningZh: 农场，农庄；农家；畜牧场

examples.text: We work on the farm.
examples.translationZh: 我们在农场工作。

examples.text: Increasingly, farm land is yielding to property development.
examples.translationZh: 地产的发展逐渐占据了农田。

examples.text: Our farm land was adjacent to the river.
examples.translationZh: 我们的农田在河边。

meaningZh: 演员（尤指男演员）；行动者；参与者

examples.text: The young actor pretended to be Hamlet.
examples.translationZh: 那个年轻演员扮演哈姆雷特。

examples.text: John promises well as an actor.
examples.translationZh: 约翰有希望成为演员。

examples.text: An actor have to learn to laugh off bad review.
examples.translationZh: 演员需学会能对贬斥性评论一笑置之的本事。

meaningZh: 飞；飞行；（旗）飘荡

examples.text: The aircraft was flying above thick fog.
examples.translationZh: 飞机在浓雾上空飞行。

examples.text: How time flies!
examples.translationZh: 时间过得真快！

examples.text: She will drive to, but fly back from, London.
examples.translationZh: 她将坐汽车去伦敦，坐飞机从伦敦回来。

meaningZh: 政治；政治事务；政治观点

examples.text: This letter does not pertain to politics.
examples.translationZh: 这封信的内容与政治无关。

examples.text: He is not interested in politics.
examples.translationZh: 他不喜欢政治。

examples.text: In politics Britain has preferred evolution to revolution.
examples.translationZh: 在政治上，英国喜欢渐进而不喜欢革命。

meaningZh: 运动；游戏；娱乐

examples.text: Baseball is more popular than any other sport in Japan.
examples.translationZh: 在日本，棒球比其他任何运动都受人欢迎。

examples.text: Football is my favorite sport.
examples.translationZh: 足球是我最喜欢的运动。

examples.text: Sport is being debased by commercialism.
examples.translationZh: 体育运动的价值受商业化的影响而逐渐下降。

meaningZh: 帮助；援助；机器助手

examples.text: A team of nurses assisted the doctor in performing the operation.
examples.translationZh: 一组护士协助医生施行手术。

examples.text: I saw the angels standing near us, waiting to assist us, rejoicing in our accomplishments and joys.
examples.translationZh: 我看见天使站在我们旁边,等着帮助我们,为我们的成就及喜悦而欢呼。

examples.text: Sixty years ago, George Marshall came to this commencement and announced a plan to assist the nations of post-war Europe.
examples.translationZh: 六十年前，乔治·马歇尔也是在这个地方的毕业典礼上，宣布了一个计划，帮助那些欧洲国家的战后建设。

meaningZh: 平的；单调的；不景气的

examples.text: Most of our county is as flat as a pancake.
examples.translationZh: 我们县大部分地方非常平坦。

examples.text: In flat open country there is plenty of grass for the cattle to feed on.
examples.translationZh: 在开阔平坦的地区有大量的青草供牛群食用。

examples.text: People used to think that the earth was flat.
examples.translationZh: 过去人们认为地球是扁平的。

meaningZh: 围裙；[航] 停机坪；[机]（防护）挡板

examples.text: My apron is so dirty that I have to wash it.
examples.translationZh: 我的围裙太脏了，我不得不洗它。

examples.text: She tied an apron around her waist.
examples.translationZh: 她将围裙系在腰间。

examples.text: She made up the remaining cloth into an apron.
examples.translationZh: 她把余下来的布缝成一条围裙。

meaningZh: 亲爱的；敬爱的；昂贵的

examples.text: They interred their dear comrade in the arms.
examples.translationZh: 他们埋葬了他们亲爱的战友。

examples.text: Dear Julia, I hope you're feeling better now.
examples.translationZh: 亲爱的朱莉,我希望你现在感觉能好点。

examples.text: Dear young ladies--I am deeply touched by your remembrance.
examples.translationZh: 亲爱的姑娘们，你们的纪念品使我深受感动。

meaningZh: 百年，一世纪；百个；（板球）一百分

examples.text: This book was written centuries ago.
examples.translationZh: 这本书是几百年前写的。

examples.text: Many centuries have passed since that time.
examples.translationZh: 从那时起，几百年过去了。

examples.text: He flourished in the early 18th century.
examples.translationZh: 他在18世纪早期享有盛名。

meaningZh: 喜剧；喜剧性；喜剧体裁

examples.text: This comedy has had them rolling in the aisles for two weeks.
examples.translationZh: 这出喜剧让观众们连续两个星期乐得前仰后合。

examples.text: I prefer comedy to tragedy.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢喜剧而不喜欢悲剧。

examples.text: The drama may be termed a comedy.
examples.translationZh: 这部戏剧可称为喜剧。

meaningZh: 航线；航空公司

examples.text: Beijing to Guangzhou is a daily airline of CAAC.
examples.translationZh: 北京到广州是中国民航每天的定期航线。

examples.text: The airline company launched a European route for the first time.
examples.translationZh: 这个航空公司首度放飞欧洲航线。

examples.text: The airline has checked his luggage out.
examples.translationZh: 航空公司已把他的行李运走了。

meaningZh: 光秃秃的；（房间、柜子等）空的；赤裸的

examples.text: The fierce sun parched the bare earth.
examples.translationZh: 灼热的阳光炙烤着光秃秃的大地。

examples.text: The boy likes to walk on the sand with bare feet.
examples.translationZh: 这男孩喜欢赤脚在沙滩上走。

examples.text: The little room was almost bare of furniture.
examples.translationZh: 这个小房间几乎没有什么家俱。

meaningZh: 精确的；绝对的；严格的，严谨的

examples.text: Our manager is very strict with us.
examples.translationZh: 我们的经理对我们要求很严格。

examples.text: There are strict controls on immigration into this country.
examples.translationZh: 移民到这个国家有严格的限制。

examples.text: Anything you tell us is in the strictest confidence.
examples.translationZh: 你告诉我们的都是绝密信息。

meaningZh: 棒球；[体]棒球运动

examples.text: Rain interrupted our baseball game.
examples.translationZh: 下雨中断了我们的捧球比赛。

examples.text: Baseball is the national game of the USA.
examples.translationZh: 棒球是美国全民喜爱的运动。

examples.text: We're rooting for the college baseball team.
examples.translationZh: 我们在给学院的棒球队加油。

meaningZh: 现在的；目前的；出席的

examples.text: He bought me a valuable diamond ring as a birthday present.
examples.translationZh: 他给我买了一只贵重的钻戒作生日礼物。

examples.text: I wish to make you a present in token of my gratitude.
examples.translationZh: 我想送你一件礼物，以表示对你的感谢之情。

examples.text: Focusing on the future instead of the present can cripple any activity.
examples.translationZh: 不注意现在只考虑将来就可能做不成任何事。

meaningZh: 铁器，铁制品；熨斗，烙铁；坚强

examples.text: The iron hissed as it pressed the wet cloth.
examples.translationZh: 熨斗压在湿布上时发出嘶嘶声。

examples.text: They analyzed the ore and found iron in it.
examples.translationZh: 他们分析了矿砂,从中发现了铁。

examples.text: Tom didn't iron his shirt yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 汤姆昨天没有熨衬衣。

meaningZh: 宽容,怜悯,仁慈；幸运之事,侥幸

examples.text: Mercy to the enemies means cruelty to the people.
examples.translationZh: 对敌人的仁慈就意味着对人民的残忍。

examples.text: They showed their enemies no mercy.
examples.translationZh: 他们不给敌人半点仁慈。

examples.text: They never appealed to us for mercy.
examples.translationZh: 他们从不向我们乞求怜悯。

meaningZh: 说话；讨论；讲，说

examples.text: I wish to talk with you in private.
examples.translationZh: 我希望能私下里同你谈话。

examples.text: We need to hold another meeting next week to talk about some technical problems.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要在下周再举行一次会议,来讨论一些技术性的问题。

examples.text: In the hall a woman was talking on diet and health.
examples.translationZh: 在那个大厅里,一名女性正在就饮食与健康发表演讲。

meaningZh: 用电的，与电有关的，电学的；令人激动的，紧张的，惊人的

examples.text: There is a fault in the electrical system.
examples.translationZh: 电路系统出了故障。

examples.text: Now electrical appliances have entered into ordinary families.
examples.translationZh: 现在家用电器已经步入普通家庭。

examples.text: There are some electrical apparatus in the room.
examples.translationZh: 房间里有些电器。

meaningZh: 邮递员，邮差

examples.text: The postman has brought a parcel for you.
examples.translationZh: 邮递员给你送来了一个包裹。

examples.text: Our dog went at the postman again this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天我们的狗又扑咬邮递员了。

meaningZh: [电]电池，蓄电池；[军]炮台，炮位；一组

examples.text: They are electrifying the battery.
examples.translationZh: 他们正给电池充电。

examples.text: My car battery has run down; it needs recharging.
examples.translationZh: 我的汽车电池没电了，需要充电。

examples.text: We would undergo a battery of tests.
examples.translationZh: 我们要进行一系列试验。

meaningZh: 沙发

examples.text: The sofa functions as a bed at night.
examples.translationZh: 这沙发在夜里可以当床。

examples.text: There's little spring in this sofa.
examples.translationZh: 这张沙发几乎没什么弹性。

meaningZh: （演出或活动的）程序；计划；节目

examples.text: The government has initiated a programme of economic reform.
examples.translationZh: 政府已开始实施经济改革方案。

examples.text: We now have a new Quality Assurance programme.
examples.translationZh: 我们现在用的是一套新的质保程序。

examples.text: The news programme overran the allotted time.
examples.translationZh: 新闻节目超出了规定的时间。

meaningZh: 兔子，野兔；兔子皮毛；兔子肉

examples.text: The rabbit burrowed under the fence.
examples.translationZh: 兔子在篱笆下打洞。

examples.text: The magician conjured a rabbit out of his hat.
examples.translationZh: 魔术师从他的帽子里变出一只兔子。

examples.text: She is as timorous as a rabbit.
examples.translationZh: 她胆小得像只兔子。

meaningZh: 完成，达到；成就，成绩

examples.text: Effort and achievement are always in full accord.
examples.translationZh: 努力和成就总是相辅相承的。

examples.text: You haven't realized the magnitude of her achievement.
examples.translationZh: 你没有认识到她这一成就的重大意义。

examples.text: I felt a great sense of achievement when I reached the top of the mountain.
examples.translationZh: 当我到达山顶的时候，我有一种巨大的成就感。

meaningZh: 不幸的，倒霉的；不吉利的；不成功的

examples.text: The unfortunate man shot himself afterwards.
examples.translationZh: 那个不幸的男人后来开枪自杀了。

examples.text: This is unfortunate but this has happened.
examples.translationZh: 这是令人遗憾的事情，但事情确实发生了。

examples.text: His indifference to future needs is unfortunate.
examples.translationZh: 他对未来的需要漠不关心真令人遗憾。

meaningZh: 签证；vt. 签发签证

examples.text: We've had to cut a few corners to get your visa ready in time.
examples.translationZh: 我们得简化手续才能将你的签证及时办妥。

examples.text: He is applying to the Consul for a visa.
examples.translationZh: 他正向领事申请签证。

examples.text: He experienced great difficulty in getting a visa to leave the country.
examples.translationZh: 他申请出国签证经历了很大的困难。

meaningZh: 运气；好运；机遇

examples.text: He came to Beijing to try his luck.
examples.translationZh: 他来到北京，想碰碰运气。

examples.text: He had wonderful luck in all his ventures.
examples.translationZh: 他干任何事情运气都好。

examples.text: He ascribes his success to good luck.
examples.translationZh: 他把他的成功归功于幸运。

meaningZh: 历史，历史学；发展史；履历，经历

examples.text: The English language has an interesting history.
examples.translationZh: 英语有着饶有趣味的发展历史。

examples.text: China is an oriental country with a long history.
examples.translationZh: 中国是一个有着悠久历史的东方国家。

examples.text: He specializes in oriental history.
examples.translationZh: 他专门研究东方史。

meaningZh: 食谱；处方；秘诀

examples.text: What's your recipe for success?
examples.translationZh: 你取得成功有什么窍门？

examples.text: He knows the recipe for this dish.
examples.translationZh: 他知道这道菜的烹饪方法。

examples.text: This recipe will be enough for four servings.
examples.translationZh: 本食谱为四人食用分量。

meaningZh: 自己的事物；自己人；vt. 拥有

examples.text: But I can't hold on to my own principles, either.
examples.translationZh: 但是,我也没有能够坚持自己的主张。

examples.text: The writer has his own brand of humour.
examples.translationZh: 这位作家有他独特的幽默感。

examples.text: Children need toys of their own.
examples.translationZh: 儿童需要有自己的玩具。

meaningZh: 生态学；社会生态学；个体生态学

examples.text: Ecology helps us understand complex problems.
examples.translationZh: 生态学帮助我们把握复杂问题。

examples.text: He started to study ecology and decided to devote his whole life to the science.
examples.translationZh: 他开始研究生态学,并决心将他的一生献身于这门学科。

examples.text: Fossils allow us to reconstruct ancient ecology.
examples.translationZh: 化石可以让我们知道古时的生态环境。

meaningZh: 访问者；参观者；游客

examples.text: When in New York City, it is customary for the visitor to take in a Broadway show.
examples.translationZh: 参观者到了纽约市，通常都会去百老汇观看演出。

examples.text: The visitor twisted his neck to look at the photograph on the wall behind him.
examples.translationZh: 参观者扭过头看他身后墙上的照片。

examples.text: Always remember, you're never more than one-click away from visitor abandonment.
examples.translationZh: 请记住，访问者一旦放弃浏览你的网站，他们就不会再点击你的站点了。

meaningZh: 退休；撤退；后退，退却

examples.text: My father retired at the age of 60.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲六十岁时退休了。

examples.text: The old worker decided to retire to the country.
examples.translationZh: 那们老工人决定退休后搬到乡下去。

examples.text: Our forces retired to prepared positions.
examples.translationZh: 我们的部队撤退到既设阵地上。

meaningZh: 不；[用以表示否定、否认、拒绝、禁止等]不是；几乎不

examples.text: I'm not really sure.
examples.translationZh: 我不太清楚。

examples.text: It's not your fault.
examples.translationZh: 不是你的错。

examples.text: We are not teachers.
examples.translationZh: 我们不是老师。

meaningZh: 可以喝的，适合饮用的；n. 饮料

examples.text: They voraciously drank all the potable water at one time.
examples.translationZh: 他们贪婪地一下就喝光所有饮用水。

examples.text: They set up purifying systems in places where the water was not potable.
examples.translationZh: 他们在许多水质不适合饮用的地方建立了净化系统。

meaningZh: 舒适的；安逸的，处于轻松的；充裕的

examples.text: Were it not for science, we could not live a comfortable live.
examples.translationZh: 若非科学，我们无法过着舒适的生活。

examples.text: Neither chair is comfortable.
examples.translationZh: 两把椅子坐起来都不舒服。

examples.text: A comfortable house may be an Eden.
examples.translationZh: 一个舒适的家可以是一个乐园。

meaningZh: 大灾难；惨败；悲剧的结局

examples.text: The earthquake was a terrible catastrophe.
examples.translationZh: 这次地震是个可怕的灾难。

examples.text: He is teetering on the edge of catastrophe.
examples.translationZh: 他在大灾难的边缘徘徊。

examples.text: The catastrophe would be stamped in their minds.
examples.translationZh: 那场灾难将会深深地印在他们的头脑里。

meaningZh: 发表；递送；交付

examples.text: The mailman delivers letters and parcels every morning.
examples.translationZh: 邮差每天早晨递送信件和包裹。

examples.text: He delivered a long prose.
examples.translationZh: 他发表了一篇冗长乏味的演讲。

examples.text: We deliver the goods in batches.
examples.translationZh: 我们分批交付货物。

meaningZh: 明亮的，鲜亮的；聪明的；辉煌的

examples.text: The bright moonlight showed the Taj Mahal in all its glory.
examples.translationZh: 泰姬陵在明亮的月光下显得光彩夺目。

examples.text: He grew up in the country, but then found he preferred the bright lights.
examples.translationZh: 他在乡村长大，但後来觉得很喜欢繁华的都市生活。

examples.text: He is not bright, but he always works hard.
examples.translationZh: 他并不聪明，但工作总是勤勤恳恳。

meaningZh: 哭；喊，叫；vt. 哭着说

examples.text: She cried with grief when she heard news of her friend's death.
examples.translationZh: 听到朋友死亡的消息，她难过地哭了。

examples.text: She began to cry in the face of failure.
examples.translationZh: 面对失败，她开始哭了起来。

examples.text: He cried that he had found the key.
examples.translationZh: 他大声地叫喊找到了钥匙。

meaningZh: （口技演员使用的）木偶；玩偶；纨绔子弟

examples.text: My daughter has many beautiful dolls.
examples.translationZh: 我女儿有许多漂亮的洋娃娃。

examples.text: She wanted very much a doll for Christmas.
examples.translationZh: 她非常想要一个玩具娃娃作为圣诞节的礼物。

examples.text: My grand-daughter is a little doll.
examples.translationZh: 我的孙女是个小可人儿。

meaningZh: 促进，推进；提升，助长；促销

examples.text: They discussed how to promote cooperation between the two countries.
examples.translationZh: 他们讨论如何促进两国间的合作。

examples.text: He has been promoted to general manager.
examples.translationZh: 他已被提升为总经理。

examples.text: He failed to get promoted for lack of resolution.
examples.translationZh: 他因缺乏果断力而未能得到升迁。

meaningZh: 叉（挖掘用的园艺工具）；餐叉；叉状物

examples.text: He stabbed the meat with his fork/stabbed his fork into the meat.
examples.translationZh: 他用叉子叉肉。

examples.text: We came to a fork in the road and could not decide which fork we should take.
examples.translationZh: 我们来到了岔路口，不能决定走哪一条岔路。

examples.text: We parted at the fork of a road.
examples.translationZh: 我们在叉路口分手。

meaningZh: 高兴的；欣喜的；v. 使高兴

examples.text: I'd be most delighted if you will.
examples.translationZh: 如果您愿意，我会非常高兴的。

examples.text: Lennie's face broke into a delighted smile.
examples.translationZh: 伦尼的脸辗然露出高兴的笑容。

examples.text: I am delighted to see all so happy.
examples.translationZh: 看见大家这么快乐我很高兴。

meaningZh: 相册；集邮簿；签名册

examples.text: This is one of the songs from her latest album.
examples.translationZh: 这是她最新歌集里的一首歌。

examples.text: The album contains many memorable songs.
examples.translationZh: 这张唱片中包括许多值得收集的歌曲。

examples.text: My album of boyhood photographs often reminds me of the past happiness.
examples.translationZh: 童年时的相册经常让我想起儿时的欢乐。

meaningZh: 班；等级；阶级

examples.text: I wouldn't put him in the same class as Verdi.
examples.translationZh: 我没把他看作是与维迪一个级别的。

examples.text: All of us are working class.
examples.translationZh: 我们都是工人阶级。

examples.text: They are the leading class in our country.
examples.translationZh: 在我们国家,他们是领导阶级。

meaningZh: 女人，妇女；成年女子；女拥人或女下属

examples.text: She is a career woman rather than a housewife.
examples.translationZh: 她是职业妇女而不是家庭主妇。

examples.text: The chief conductor turned out to be a young woman.
examples.translationZh: 列车长原来是一位青年妇女。

examples.text: She seems a pleasant woman.
examples.translationZh: 她似乎是一个友善的女人。

meaningZh: 约会；任命；职务

examples.text: I've made an appointment for a facial next week.
examples.translationZh: 我已经预约了下周去美容。

examples.text: He wants to change his appointment from Monday to Wednesday.
examples.translationZh: 他想把他的约会从星期一改到星期三。

examples.text: His promotion to manager was a popular appointment.
examples.translationZh: 他升任经理是众望所归的。

meaningZh: 仇恨，憎恨；厌恶；对…感到不喜欢或讨厌

examples.text: They hate each other.
examples.translationZh: 他们彼此憎恨。

examples.text: I hate to squabble with my wife about money.
examples.translationZh: 我厌恶为钱的事兴太太争吵。

examples.text: The boys hate doing homework on Sundays.
examples.translationZh: 男孩们讨厌在星期日做家庭作业。

meaningZh: 搬运工人；门卫

examples.text: Did you remember to tip the porter?
examples.translationZh: 你记得给搬运工小费了吗？

examples.text: The porter will carry your luggage to your room.
examples.translationZh: 搬运工会把你的行李搬到你的房间去的。

examples.text: The porter was weighed down by all the luggage.
examples.translationZh: 搬运工扛着这些行李压得直不起腰来。

meaningZh: 喜欢的；多情的；溺爱的，宠爱的

examples.text: A fond mother may spoil her child.
examples.translationZh: 溺爱的母亲可能会宠坏她的孩子。

examples.text: The fond father smiled with pleasure.
examples.translationZh: 溺爱孩子的父亲高兴地微笑了。

examples.text: I am not fond of solitude.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢孤独。

meaningZh: 娱乐，消遣；招待，款待；娱乐节目

examples.text: There are few entertainments in that town.
examples.translationZh: 那个镇上几乎没有娱乐设施。

examples.text: Television provides universal entertainment.
examples.translationZh: 电视提供大众化的娱乐。

examples.text: Wrestling is in a twilight zone between sport and entertainment.
examples.translationZh: 摔跤是介於运动和娱乐两者之间的活动。

meaningZh: （使）发生联系；（使）联合；结交

examples.text: I always associate her with roses.
examples.translationZh: 我总是把她与玫瑰花联想在一起。

examples.text: We should associate ourselves with this large firm.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该和这家大公司联合。

examples.text: Mr. Miller is a business associate of our company.
examples.translationZh: 米勒先生是我们公司的生意伙伴。

meaningZh: 残废的，有缺陷的；v. 使无能力( disable的过去式和过去分词)；使残废

examples.text: He was disabled from walking by the accident.
examples.translationZh: 由于车祸，他不能走路了。

examples.text: Employers are being encouraged to hire disabled workers.
examples.translationZh: 雇主受鼓励雇用残废的工人。

examples.text: Now that he was disabled, his house had become a prison to him.
examples.translationZh: 因为他残废了，他的房子就成了他的牢笼。

meaningZh: 结果；端；终止

examples.text: The battle finally brought the war to an end.
examples.translationZh: 这一仗使这场战争终告结束。

examples.text: At the end of the film, the hero wept bitterly.
examples.translationZh: 在影片的结尾，主人公伤心地哭了。

examples.text: He makes a knot in the end of the string.
examples.translationZh: 他在绳子末端打了个结。

meaningZh: 想像；设想；想要

examples.text: She wants to buy a handbag, not fancy but strong.
examples.translationZh: 我想买一个手提包不要花俏,而要耐用。

examples.text: These fancy arguments befuddled us.
examples.translationZh: 这些复杂的论据令我们疑惑不已。

examples.text: All eyes were rested on the fancy car.
examples.translationZh: 所有的眼神都注视那部新奇的车。

meaningZh: 装载；控诉；使充电

examples.text: As group leader, you should take charge.
examples.translationZh: 你身为组长, 应当负起责任来。

examples.text: He was arrested on a charge of armed robbery.
examples.translationZh: 他被指控犯武装抢劫罪而遭逮捕。

examples.text: Rub the leather and the rubber will produce the charge.
examples.translationZh: 摩擦皮毛和橡胶会产生电荷。

meaningZh: 机器，机械；机械般的人；核心

examples.text: This machine has been specially adapted for underwater use.
examples.translationZh: 这机器是为水下使用而特别改装的。

examples.text: My mother-in-law has a sewing machine.
examples.translationZh: 我婆婆有一台缝纫机。

examples.text: The team is a well-oiled machine right now.
examples.translationZh: 这个团队现在运转十分良好。

meaningZh: 支持；帮助；支撑

examples.text: The lawyer cite a previous case to support his argument.
examples.translationZh: 律师引用了以前的案例来支持他的论点。

examples.text: Will you use your influence to prevail upon them to support the suggestion?
examples.translationZh: 你能不能利用你的影响劝他们支持这个建议呢?

examples.text: The pillars support the weight of the roof.
examples.translationZh: 这些柱子支撑着屋顶的重量。

meaningZh: 想，设想；想像；料想，猜想

examples.text: You can imagine how surprised I was.
examples.translationZh: 你可以想象我是多么惊讶。

examples.text: It is hard to imagine the scale of the universe.
examples.translationZh: 很难想像宇宙有多大。

examples.text: Imagine yourself to be on a desert island.
examples.translationZh: 设想一下你身处荒岛的情形。

meaningZh: 杂物，垃圾；（一窝）幼崽；褥草

examples.text: There was litter strewn all over the pavement.
examples.translationZh: 人行道上到处都是扔的垃圾。

examples.text: The desk was covered with a litter of documents.
examples.translationZh: 书桌上满满地放着一堆杂乱的文件。

examples.text: His litter strewn room really needed to be cleaned.
examples.translationZh: 他杂乱的房间该好好收拾一下了。

meaningZh: 向西的；n. 西部，西方；adv. 向西方

examples.text: They went westward.
examples.translationZh: 他们向西走了。

examples.text: The frontier was pushed westward.
examples.translationZh: 边疆向西扩展。

examples.text: As you travel westward, does the land get higher or lower?
examples.translationZh: 当你向西旅行时，地势是否变得越来越高还是越来越低？

meaningZh: 快乐，高兴；使人高兴的东西或人；vt. 使高兴，使欣喜

examples.text: She clapped her hands in delight.
examples.translationZh: 她高兴地拍手。

examples.text: The children were prancing about with delight.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们高兴得蹦蹦跳跳。

examples.text: He takes great delight in painting.
examples.translationZh: 他爱好绘画。

meaningZh: 布满灰尘的；尘状的；浅灰色的

examples.text: Sunlight filtered in through the dusty window.
examples.translationZh: 阳光从满是灰尘的窗子透进去。

examples.text: The trays on the desk were filled by papers dusty with inattention.
examples.translationZh: 办公桌上的公文格里堆积着满是灰尘的文件。

meaningZh: 柠檬汽水；一杯（或一瓶）柠檬饮料

examples.text: The waitress brought us a pitcher of lemonade.
examples.translationZh: 服务小姐给我们送来一壶柠檬水。

examples.text: She filled my glass with lemonade.
examples.translationZh: 她给我倒了一杯柠檬水。

meaningZh: 叫回，召回；使想起，回想；取消

examples.text: Do you have any recall of that meeting?
examples.translationZh: 你还记得那次会见吗?

examples.text: The new law is now established beyond recall.
examples.translationZh: 新法律现已制定，不得撤销。

examples.text: The experiment sample the raw test of novel Hero Borns to test for times , and it acquires an accuracy of 86.93% , while an recall rate of 91.83%.
examples.translationZh: 实验对小说《英雄出世》的生文本进行了多次抽样测试

meaningZh: 记得；牢记；vt. 记着

examples.text: I remember his objecting to the scheme.
examples.translationZh: 我记得他曾经反对该计划。

examples.text: Remember to write us when you get there.
examples.translationZh: 到了那儿别忘了给我们写信。

examples.text: I'm sorry, I can't remember your name.
examples.translationZh: 对不起，我想不起你的名字了。

meaningZh: 冰淇淋的，乳白色的；n. 冰淇淋

examples.text: The boys were regaling on ice cream cones.
examples.translationZh: 男孩们在美滋滋地大吃冰淇淋。

examples.text: Mother knows how to make ice cream.
examples.translationZh: 母亲会做冰淇淋。

meaningZh: 那个，那；pron. 那个，那；conj. 多么

examples.text: What is the difference between this and that?
examples.translationZh: 这个和那个之间的区别是什么？

examples.text: I walked to the gate that opened towards the lake.
examples.translationZh: 我走向那扇临湖的大门。

examples.text: The output of steel this year has increased by 20% compared with that in 1992.
examples.translationZh: 今年钢产量比一九九二年增长了百分之二十。

meaningZh: [U]森林,丛林

examples.text: He went to the forest on horseback.
examples.translationZh: 他骑马去森林了。

examples.text: The deer escaped to the deep forest.
examples.translationZh: 那鹿逃入了丛林深处。

examples.text: There is a pine forest near our house.
examples.translationZh: 我们家附近有片松树林。

meaningZh: 入口，进口；进入；进入方法，进入方式

examples.text: There is an entrance just around the corner.
examples.translationZh: 拐角处有个入口。

examples.text: I'll meet you at the entrance of the zoo tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我会在动物园的入口处和你见面。

examples.text: A lighthouse marks the entrance to the harbour.
examples.translationZh: 灯塔是进入海港航道的标志。

meaningZh: 识别，认出；确定；使参与

examples.text: Identify how the incident occurred.
examples.translationZh: 鉴定事故如何出现。

examples.text: The test can identify the presence of abnormalities in the unborn child.
examples.translationZh: 这项化验能鉴定胎儿是否有不正常现象。

examples.text: The markings are so blurred that it is difficult to identify.
examples.translationZh: 标记模糊不清，难以识别。

meaningZh: 顽固的，固执的；顽强的或有决心的；坚持的

examples.text: That stubborn man always cleaves to his idea.
examples.translationZh: 那固执的人不愿改变想法。

examples.text: The child has a stubborn temper.
examples.translationZh: 这个小孩脾气执拗。

examples.text: This detergent can remove stubborn stains.
examples.translationZh: 这种去污剂能去除难洗的污渍。

meaningZh: （把…）联系起来；讲，叙述（故事等）；vt. 讲述，叙述

examples.text: To what events did your remarks relate?
examples.translationZh: 你的话指的是什么事?

examples.text: It is difficult to relate cause and effect in this case.
examples.translationZh: 这个案件中的动机与结果很难联系起来。

examples.text: These two events were related to each other.
examples.translationZh: 这两个事件相互有联系。

meaningZh: 记者

examples.text: The reporter had a red-hot story.
examples.translationZh: 那个记者掌握著最新消息。

meaningZh: 方便的；手边的，附近的；便于使用的

examples.text: An electric kettle is very handy.
examples.translationZh: 电水壶使用非常方便。

examples.text: The sailors clung to anything handy.
examples.translationZh: 水手们紧紧抓住手边任何东西。

examples.text: He is very handy at repairing clocks.
examples.translationZh: 他修钟表很灵巧。

meaningZh: 授予，奖给，判给；判归，判定；n. 奖品

examples.text: It is impossible to honor her with the award.
examples.translationZh: 奖品授给她是不可能的。

examples.text: The child smiled at his teacher as he received the award.
examples.translationZh: 孩子接过奖品时朝老师微笑着。

examples.text: It is the highest award a producer can receive.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个制作人所能获得的最高奖项。

meaningZh: 笔，笔尖；笔法，文笔；作家

examples.text: The pen slips out of my fingers.
examples.translationZh: 钢笔从我指缝中滑下去了。

examples.text: Put down my pen and stop fiddling!
examples.translationZh: 把我的钢笔放下，别用手玩弄！

examples.text: He dipped his pen in the ink.
examples.translationZh: 他拿钢笔蘸墨水。

meaningZh: 吞，咽；忍耐，忍受；vt. 不流露

examples.text: There are many swallows flying in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 天空中有许多燕子。

examples.text: The swallow has made a nest under our eaves.
examples.translationZh: 燕子在我们的屋檐下垒了一个窝。

examples.text: He downed the medicine at one swallow.
examples.translationZh: 他一口便把药全吞下了。

meaningZh: 盛会；宴会；宗教节日

examples.text: The king held a feast for us.
examples.translationZh: 国王为我们举行了盛大的宴会。

examples.text: Enough is as good as a feast.
examples.translationZh: 知足常乐。

examples.text: Preparing for the Christmas Eve feast makes me at my wit's end.
examples.translationZh: 筹办圣诞宴会简直使我智穷才竭。

meaningZh: 一（个）；每一（个）；任一（个）

examples.text: There is a pen on the table.
examples.translationZh: 桌子上有一支笔。

examples.text: We have a problem.
examples.translationZh: 我们有个问题。

examples.text: I can only carry two at a time.
examples.translationZh: 我一次只能带两个。

meaningZh: 劳动；劳工；分娩，临产阵痛

examples.text: Labour is not only a necessity but also a pleasure.
examples.translationZh: 劳动不仅是人生所必需的，而且是一种乐趣。

examples.text: It takes a lot of labour to build a railway.
examples.translationZh: 修筑一条铁路要花费许多劳动力。

examples.text: A vigorous labour movement began that winter.
examples.translationZh: 那年冬天，展开了蓬蓬勃勃的劳工运动。

meaningZh: 移动，搬动；vi. 搬家；行动

examples.text: The army is on the move.
examples.translationZh: 军队在移动。

examples.text: This move is now in preparation.
examples.translationZh: 这一步骤，目前正在准备中。

examples.text: Their move to Latin America was a leap in the dark.
examples.translationZh: 他们迁居拉丁美洲是件冒险的事。

meaningZh: 洗衣店，洗衣房；洗好的衣服；待洗的衣服

examples.text: Send these clothed over to the laundry.
examples.translationZh: 把这些衣服送到洗衣店去洗。

examples.text: This laundry makes deliveries on Thursday.
examples.translationZh: 这个洗衣店星期四送衣服。

examples.text: I'd like to have laundry service.
examples.translationZh: 我需要洗衣服务。

meaningZh: 问，询问；需要；要求，请求

examples.text: May I ask a question?
examples.translationZh: 我可以问一个问题吗？

examples.text: I'm calling to ask you about the delivery.
examples.translationZh: 我打电话给你,是询问发货的事。

examples.text: He'll lend you the money if you ask him.
examples.translationZh: 如果你请求他的话，他就会把钱借给你。

meaningZh: 几乎，差不多；将近；快要

examples.text: He slipped and almost fell.
examples.translationZh: 他脚下一滑，险些跌倒。

examples.text: She was almost mad with grief when her son died.
examples.translationZh: 她的儿子死去时，她悲伤得几乎疯了。

examples.text: This event was almost simultaneous with that one.
examples.translationZh: 这件事几乎是与那件事同时发生的。

meaningZh: 哪里，在哪里；到哪里；某种情势或位置

examples.text: Where did she get the news?
examples.translationZh: 她从哪儿得到这个消息的？

examples.text: I know a place where you can have a picnic.
examples.translationZh: 我知道一个你可以野餐的地方。

examples.text: We then moved to Paris, where we lived for six years.
examples.translationZh: 我们後来搬到巴黎

meaningZh: 整洁的，干净的；灵巧的；匀整的

examples.text: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
examples.translationZh: 他在花园里铺上整洁的小路，并在池塘上架起木桥。

examples.text: The headmaster praised the boys for their neat turn-out.
examples.translationZh: 校长表扬男同学服装整齐。

examples.text: He gave a neat summary of the financial situation.
examples.translationZh: 他对财务状况做了简要的概括。

meaningZh: 旅行者，旅客；[机]移动式起重机；[船]（铁杆或缆索上的）活环，带有活环的铁杆

examples.text: The traveller carries about a camera.
examples.translationZh: 旅行者随身带着一只照相机。

examples.text: The traveller fought through the snowstorm single-handed.
examples.translationZh: 那个旅行者单枪匹马冒着暴风雪前进。

meaningZh: 眼睛；视力；眼状物

examples.text: He could not meet his father's eye.
examples.translationZh: 他不敢正视父亲的目光。

examples.text: She reads with a sharp eye for idiom.
examples.translationZh: 她阅读时以敏锐的目光审视语言的习惯用法。

examples.text: He has weak eyes.
examples.translationZh: 他的视力不佳。

meaningZh: 做，制造；生产，制定；使成为

examples.text: If I had the time, I 'd make something better.
examples.translationZh: 如果有时间的话,我会做些更好吃的东西。

examples.text: In the old China, we can't even make a nail, let alone machines.
examples.translationZh: 在旧中国,我们连一个钉子都造不了,更不用说制造机器了。

examples.text: Her jokes made us all laugh.
examples.translationZh: 她说的笑话把我们都逗乐了。

meaningZh: 开发；（从容器等）汲取（液体）；割[打]开…取[放]液体

examples.text: The water leaked from the tap drop by drop.
examples.translationZh: 水一滴一滴地从龙头漏出来。

examples.text: She left the tap on and the bath ran over.
examples.translationZh: 她没有关水龙头，澡盆里的水溢出来了。

examples.text: The tap on the cask was dirty.
examples.translationZh: 桶上的塞子很脏。

meaningZh: 辗；使（眼球等）左右转动；（使）原地转圈

examples.text: Love comes quick and passes away quick too. Only the pork roll will go on.
examples.translationZh: 爱情来得快去得也快,只有猪肉卷才是永恒的。

examples.text: The desk calculator use a roll of paper.
examples.translationZh: 这台台式计算机使用卷纸。

examples.text: A ball can roll smoothly on a plane.
examples.translationZh: 球可以在水平面上流畅地滚动。

meaningZh: 皱纹；妙计，窍门；vt. 使起皱纹

examples.text: She's beginning to get wrinkles round her eyes.
examples.translationZh: 她的眼角开始有皱纹了。

examples.text: My findings add a new wrinkle to each scenario.
examples.translationZh: 我的发现为两种说法都提供了一点想法。

examples.text: Too much sunbathing will wrinkle your skin.
examples.translationZh: 皮肤晒得过分就能起皱纹。

meaningZh: 作用；地位；角色

examples.text: The Panama Canal has played a very important role in transportation.
examples.translationZh: 巴拿马运河在运输上起到了非常重要的作用。

examples.text: The key role of the teacher in the learning process should not be neglected.
examples.translationZh: 教师在学习中的关键作用是不该忽视的。

examples.text: The role of the railway declines in the transport system.
examples.translationZh: 在运输系统中,铁路的重要性逐渐下降。

meaningZh: 家庭主妇；家庭妇女

examples.text: She typifies the bored housewife.
examples.translationZh: 她是那种百无聊赖的家庭主妇的典型。

examples.text: Many women chose to be a housewife after marriage.
examples.translationZh: 许多妇女选择了在婚后当家庭主妇。

meaningZh: 蜘蛛网，网状物；[机]万维网；织物

examples.text: A spider weaves a web to catch prey.
examples.translationZh: 蜘蛛为捕猎昆虫而织网。

examples.text: The tiger was enmeshed in the web laid by hunter.
examples.translationZh: 老虎缠在猎人布下的网里。

examples.text: Do you think art and design are melding on the web?
examples.translationZh: 你认为在网络上艺术和设计是相结合的吗？

meaningZh: 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞团

examples.text: He did a sketch of the ballet dancers.
examples.translationZh: 他为这些芭蕾舞者画了一张素描。

examples.text: She invited us to see the ballet.
examples.translationZh: 她邀请我们去看芭蕾舞。

meaningZh: 数字化视频光盘

examples.text: Visible Record, as an organization promoting documentary films, is to build a DVD distribution network of the latest and finest Chinese documentary films.
examples.translationZh: 采风电影搜集了各地最新最出色的华语纪录片，制作成影碟发行。

meaningZh: 怀疑，疑虑；未确定；vt. 怀疑，疑惑

examples.text: There is no doubt that we will be successful.
examples.translationZh: 毫无疑问我们会成功的。

examples.text: Although a very religious man, he is still troubled by occasional doubts.
examples.translationZh: 他虽然笃信宗教，但有时仍感到迷惘。

examples.text: The outcome of this discussion is still in doubt.
examples.translationZh: 这次讨论的结果还未定。

meaningZh: 几何学；几何形状；几何图形

examples.text: I feel that geometry is a difficult subject.
examples.translationZh: 我认为几何是一门难学的课程。

examples.text: Today we have a lesson in geometry.
examples.translationZh: 今天，我们有一节几何课。

examples.text: Leon didn't finish his geometry homework because his mind kept jumping the track to think about the new girl in class.
examples.translationZh: 利昂没完成几何作业，因为他思想总在开小差，想着班上新来的女生。

meaningZh: 服从，听从；vt. 遵守，遵循

examples.text: Soldiers are expected to obey their orders without question.
examples.translationZh: 军人应当绝对服从命令。

examples.text: We should obey the law.
examples.translationZh: 我们应当遵守法律。

examples.text: The abbot told him to obey the rules.
examples.translationZh: 修道院院长告诉他要遵守规定。

meaningZh: 蜡烛；烛光；蜡烛状物

examples.text: He put the candle on the silver candlestick.
examples.translationZh: 他把蜡烛放在银烛台上。

examples.text: The candle was blown out by the wind.
examples.translationZh: 蜡烛被风吹灭了。

examples.text: A solitary candle lightened the darkness of the room.
examples.translationZh: 一支孤烛使黑暗的房间亮了起来。

meaningZh: 值得做的；值得花时间的；有价值的

examples.text: Thank you for making my visit so worthwhile. I shall treasure your friendship and kind hospitality you have given me.
examples.translationZh: 感谢你们使我的访问如此有价值。我将珍惜我们之间的友谊及你们给予我的盛情款待。

examples.text: That's worthwhile.
examples.translationZh: 那是值得的。

meaningZh: 期望；预料；要求

examples.text: This is what we expect to happen.
examples.translationZh: 这就是我们所预期将会发生的。

examples.text: He is expected to get through to the finals.
examples.translationZh: 我们期待他进入决赛。

examples.text: At last they got the telegram they had been expecting.
examples.translationZh: 最后他们收到了他们盼望的电报。

meaningZh: 挨饿；[非正式用语] 饥饿；受饿

examples.text: They were suffered to starve on the pavement.
examples.translationZh: 他们流流街头，忍饥挨饿。

examples.text: They would starve if food was difficult to find.
examples.translationZh: 如果很难找到食物，他们就会挨饿。

examples.text: They would rather starve than give way.
examples.translationZh: 他们宁愿饿死也不妥协。

meaningZh: 草莓；草莓色

examples.text: This strawberry jam is still runny: I can't get it to jell.
examples.translationZh: 这草莓酱还是太稀，凝结不起来。

examples.text: All the strawberry jellies had been eaten.
examples.translationZh: 草莓冻都吃光了。

examples.text: We have different pies, such as apple, cherry, and strawberry pies.
examples.translationZh: 我们有不同的派，例如苹果、樱桃和草莓派。

meaningZh: 组织；筹备；安排

examples.text: We will organise wine tasting parties for you.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以组织大小中型的专业红酒品尝会。

examples.text: I will hire that company to organise the gig.
examples.translationZh: 我要雇那家公司组织赛艇赛事。

examples.text: I need to organise a driver for tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 我得为明天的活动安排一个司机。

meaningZh: 多山的；巨大的；山一般的

examples.text: He lives in a mountainous district.
examples.translationZh: 他住在山区。

examples.text: Our country is very mountainous.
examples.translationZh: 我国是一个多山的国家。

examples.text: The mountainous waves swallowed up the ship.
examples.translationZh: 山一般的巨浪吞没了那艘航船。

meaningZh: 市中心区；（市中）商业区；adj. 商业区的，闹市区的

examples.text: Most of the old buildings in the downtown were plucked down, and new ones erected.
examples.translationZh: 市中心的大部分建筑物都拆掉了，建起了新的房子。

examples.text: A new skyscraper has been put up downtown.
examples.translationZh: 市中心又建起了一座摩天大厦。

examples.text: The family lived far away from downtown.
examples.translationZh: 那家人住在离市中心很远的地方。

meaningZh: 假日，休息日；节日；vi. 度假，休假

examples.text: Our holiday plans are still at an indeterminate stage.
examples.translationZh: 我们的假日计划还没有确定。

examples.text: Did you have a nice holiday?
examples.translationZh: 你假期过得愉快吗？

examples.text: We are going to France to spend our holidays.
examples.translationZh: 我们将去法国度假。

meaningZh: 性别；两性之一；性，性特征

examples.text: Everybody can come to this school,without respect to class, race, or sex.
examples.translationZh: 不论阶级、种族、性别,人人都可以进这所学校上课。

examples.text: She disguised her true sex under a man's garment.
examples.translationZh: 她身穿男装来掩饰自己的真实性别。

examples.text: Hunger and sex are elemental drives of human beings.
examples.translationZh: 食欲和性欲是人类的原始冲动。

meaningZh: 女孩；姑娘，未婚女子；女职员，女演员

examples.text: The girl has a light hand for knitting.
examples.translationZh: 这女孩手巧，精于编织。

examples.text: My father left me forever when I was only a girl.
examples.translationZh: 在我还是小女孩时,我父亲就已去世了。

examples.text: This picture represents a girl playing the piano.
examples.translationZh: 这幅画描绘一个在弹钢琴的少女。

meaningZh: 洗手间，厕所

examples.text: His new house has a big washroom.
examples.translationZh: 他的新家有一个很大的盥洗室。

examples.text: The washroom is to the left of the entrance, near the stairs.
examples.translationZh: 盥洗室在进口处左边，靠近楼梯。

examples.text: Can you tell me where the washroom is, please?
examples.translationZh: 能告诉我厕所在哪儿吗?

meaningZh: 任何人，无论谁；随便哪一个人；n. 重要的人，有声名的人

examples.text: He didn't want to team up with anybody.
examples.translationZh: 他不想与任何人合作。

examples.text: By anybody's standards that work of art is A-1.
examples.translationZh: 那件艺术品按任何人的标准都是第一流的。

meaningZh: (it的所有格形式)它的；厥

examples.text: The word here is used in its figurative sense.
examples.translationZh: 此词在这儿取的是它的比喻意义。

examples.text: He felt the cloth to see its quality.
examples.translationZh: 他摸摸布看它的品质。

meaningZh: 制动器，闸；刹车；阻碍

examples.text: There's too much travel on the brake, it needs tightening.
examples.translationZh: 制动器太松了，需要调紧。

examples.text: After the work, remember to shut off the brake and remain neatness.
examples.translationZh: 使用后必须拉闸,要保持卫生。

examples.text: The brake doesn't grip properly.
examples.translationZh: 刹车不灵了。

meaningZh: 墨水，油墨；（乌贼分泌的）墨液；vt. 给…上油墨（以供印刷、签订合同等）

examples.text: There's an ink stain on your shirt.
examples.translationZh: 你的衬衫上有一个墨水斑。

examples.text: He has run out of red ink.
examples.translationZh: 他的红墨水用完了。

examples.text: He swore at the boy who dropped ink on the book.
examples.translationZh: 他对那把墨水倒翻在书上的孩子臭骂了一顿。

meaningZh: 腿；支柱，支架；裤腿

examples.text: The breaking of his right leg made him walk on crutches only.
examples.translationZh: 他右脚的折断使他只有靠拐杖走路。

examples.text: The leg of my tights has torn.
examples.translationZh: 我的裤袜的裤腿破了。

examples.text: The car won't start, so we'll have to leg it.
examples.translationZh: 汽车发动不起来了,我们只好走着去了。

meaningZh: 严守时刻的， 准时的，正点的

examples.text: My cat makes a punctual appearance at mealtimes.
examples.translationZh: 我的猫一到用餐时间就会准时出现。

examples.text: Please be punctual in futurity.
examples.translationZh: 今后请准时。

examples.text: He likes his guests to be punctual.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢客人守时。

meaningZh: 休克；震惊；震动

examples.text: It gave me quite a shock to be told I was seriously ill.
examples.translationZh: 听说我的病很严重，我吃了一惊。

examples.text: His death was a great shock to us all.
examples.translationZh: 他的死使我们大家都大为震惊。

examples.text: We must take steps to prevent shock in the patient.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须采取措施防止病人休克。

meaningZh: 咖啡豆；咖啡粉；（一杯）咖啡

examples.text: He put some sugar into his coffee.
examples.translationZh: 他往咖啡里加了些糖。

examples.text: Have some cream in your coffee.
examples.translationZh: 在你的咖啡里加点奶油吧。

examples.text: We had cookies and coffee.
examples.translationZh: 我们吃了甜饼和咖啡。

meaningZh: 笑话，玩笑；笑柄，笑料；vt.& vi. 开玩笑

examples.text: He closed his speech with a funny joke.
examples.translationZh: 他用一则有趣的笑话结束了演讲。

examples.text: I'm sorry but I can't see the joke.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉,我看不出来有什么可笑的。

examples.text: It is no joke.
examples.translationZh: 这可不是开玩笑的事。

meaningZh: 在（某人或某事物的）前面；向前；预先

examples.text: By doing extra homework, he soon got ahead of his class-mates.
examples.translationZh: 他靠多做家庭作业，很快在班上名列前茅。

examples.text: He will be ahead of others in English.
examples.translationZh: 他在英语方面将超过别人。

examples.text: Pay ahead, and you'll receive a discount.
examples.translationZh: 若预先付款，你便可以享受折扣

meaningZh: 小麦

examples.text: This old man is a leading authority on wheat diseases.
examples.translationZh: 这位老人是小麦病虫害方面的权威。

examples.text: This machine crushes wheat grain to make flour.
examples.translationZh: 这台机器把麦子磨成面粉。

examples.text: Wheat is transported from the farms to the mills.
examples.translationZh: 把小麦从农场运到面粉厂。

meaningZh: 重要性；重要地位，显著；骄傲，自大

examples.text: Character is of sovereign importance.
examples.translationZh: 人品最为重要。

examples.text: What was said was of prime importance.
examples.translationZh: 说过的那件事是很重要的。

examples.text: This matter is of vital importance to us.
examples.translationZh: 这件事对我们来说至关重要。

meaningZh: 正确的；合适的；符合公认准则的

examples.text: Your answer to the question is correct.
examples.translationZh: 你对这个问题的回答是正确的。

examples.text: So far no correct conclusion has arrived at.
examples.translationZh: 到目前为止,还没有得出任何正确的结论。

examples.text: Such casual dress would not be correct for a formal occasion.
examples.translationZh: 这样的便服不宜在正式的场合穿。

meaningZh: 在…的时候；在…期间，当…之时；其间

examples.text: He swims every day during the summer.
examples.translationZh: 他夏天每天游泳。

examples.text: The thief broke into the house during the night.
examples.translationZh: 小偷在夜间破门进入住宅。

examples.text: He was born in China during World War II and educated in England.
examples.translationZh: 他在二次大战期间生于中国,后来在英国受。

meaningZh: 绿豆；鹰嘴豆；绿豆种子

examples.text: A dust particle weighs only a thousandth of a gram.
examples.translationZh: 一粒尘埃的重量仅有千分之一克。

examples.text: Sorry,but we sell the roast Beijing duck by the gram.
examples.translationZh: 对不起，我们是按克出售北京烤鸭的。

meaningZh: 少数，少量；一把（的量）；难以控制的人（或动物）

examples.text: He dipped into the bag and brought out a handful of sample wheat.
examples.translationZh: 他把手伸进袋里，取出一把小麦样品。

examples.text: All the trouble is being caused by a handful of malcontents.
examples.translationZh: 这些是非都是由一小撮不满分子搬弄的。

examples.text: We invited twenty people, but only a handful of them came.
examples.translationZh: 我们邀请了20 个人，但只来了寥寥数人。

meaningZh: 油[水]箱；坦克；贮水池

examples.text: Is there any water left in the water tank?
examples.translationZh: 水箱里还有水剩下吗？

examples.text: The gas is stored under pressure in the tank.
examples.translationZh: 该气体在压缩状态下贮存于罐中。

examples.text: I need a funnel to pour petrol into the tank.
examples.translationZh: 我需要一个漏斗把汽油灌进油箱。

meaningZh: 膝；膝盖；vt. 用膝盖碰

examples.text: I've bumped my knee on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 我的膝盖撞上了墙壁。

examples.text: I bounced the baby on my knee.
examples.translationZh: 我把婴儿放在膝上上下颠着。

examples.text: His left knee was hurt in a traffic accident.
examples.translationZh: 他的左膝在一次交通事故中受伤了。

meaningZh: 环境，境遇；事实，细节；典礼，仪式

examples.text: He was forced by the circumstances to do this.
examples.translationZh: 他做此事是为环境所迫。

examples.text: The choice of technique is, therefore, a matter of preference, and in some cases circumstance.
examples.translationZh: 因此,技术的选择是偏好的问题,在某些情况下也与环境有关。

examples.text: I cannot recollect the exact circumstance.
examples.translationZh: 我总是想不起确实的情况。

meaningZh: 加强，巩固；勉励，激励；增加…的艺术效果

examples.text: He has been brought in to strengthen the defence.
examples.translationZh: 已请他来加强后卫力量。

examples.text: We will strengthen the protection of wet land.
examples.translationZh: 我们将加强湿地保护。

examples.text: Every effort was made to strengthen unity.
examples.translationZh: 大家尽力加强团结。

meaningZh: 偶然的；临时的；随便的

examples.text: He was wearing casual clothes.
examples.translationZh: 他穿着便服。

examples.text: The plan grew out of a casual conversation.
examples.translationZh: 这个计划出自于一次非正式的谈话。

examples.text: He sidled past, trying to seem casual.
examples.translationZh: 他悄悄地溜了过去,竭力装作漫不经心的样子。

meaningZh: 真正的；真实的；忠实的

examples.text: She gave the true account of what had happened.
examples.translationZh: 她如实地讲述了发生的事情。

examples.text: On what grounds do you say that is true?
examples.translationZh: 你根据什么说那是真的?

examples.text: We both thought that he had given a true judgement.
examples.translationZh: 我们都认为他给出了正确的判断。

meaningZh: 连接；联系，关系；连接点

examples.text: What is the connection between the two ideas?
examples.translationZh: 这两个概念之间有何联系？

examples.text: There is no connection between them.
examples.translationZh: 他们之间没有什么关系。

examples.text: Your connection with the press served out turn.
examples.translationZh: 你与新闻界的关系正适应了我们的需要。

meaningZh: 痛苦的；（肉体）疼的；费力的，（工作）困难的

examples.text: It was painful for him to renounce his son.
examples.translationZh: 宣布与儿子脱离关系对他来说是很痛苦的。

examples.text: His wife's death left a painful void in his life.
examples.translationZh: 他妻子的死给他的人生留下了痛苦的空虚感。

examples.text: The sting of a jellyfish is very painful.
examples.translationZh: 让水母刺着是很痛的。

meaningZh: 餐后甜食；甜点

examples.text: I like to have ice cream for dessert.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢在正餐后吃冰淇淋当甜点。

examples.text: Can I have some fruit instead of the dessert?
examples.translationZh: 可不可以不要甜点改要水果？

meaningZh: （用于姓名或姓之前，对未婚女子的称呼）小姐；女士；失误

examples.text: Miss Williams can read and write French very well.
examples.translationZh: 威廉斯小姐能够很自如地用法语看书和写东西。

examples.text: I do miss the children. The house seems as silent as the tomb without them.
examples.translationZh: 我真想念孩子们。他们不在家里显得太沉静了。

examples.text: It's the chance of a lifetime. You shouldn't miss it.
examples.translationZh: 这是一生中难得的机会，你不应错过。

meaningZh: （某一语言的）词汇；（尤指外语教科书中附有释义的）词汇表

examples.text: You can look up this word in the vocabulary.
examples.translationZh: 你可以在词汇表里查这个词。

examples.text: He has an extensive vocabulary.
examples.translationZh: 他词汇很丰富。

examples.text: That if your vocabulary is limited your chances of success are limited.
examples.translationZh: 如果你的词汇量不大，你成功的机会也就不多。

meaningZh: 动摇；摇头；使发抖

examples.text: Give the bottle a couple of shakes before pouring the juice.
examples.translationZh: 倒果汁前，先把瓶子摇几下。

examples.text: He shook his head in disapproval.
examples.translationZh: 他摇了摇头表示反对。

examples.text: His voice shook with fear.
examples.translationZh: 他害怕得声音发抖。

meaningZh: 范围；射程；类别

examples.text: The houses are sold out within this price range.
examples.translationZh: 在这个价位范围之内的房子已售完。

examples.text: It has come within the range of practical politics.
examples.translationZh: 这就属于可实施性政治的范围了。

examples.text: He used a whistle to decoy the birds within range.
examples.translationZh: 他用口哨把鸟群诱至射程内。

meaningZh: 正午，中午；全盛期，顶点；〈古〉午夜

examples.text: At noon, the sun is high in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 正午，烈日当空。

examples.text: We need to be there before noon.
examples.translationZh: 我们要在正午前赶到那儿。

examples.text: She anchors a 45-minute news show at noon.
examples.translationZh: 她每天中午主持四十五分钟的新闻广播。

meaningZh: 除非，如果不；prep. 除了，…除外

examples.text: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
examples.translationZh: 除非我被邀请，否则我不会去参加晚会的。

examples.text: I sleep with the window open unless its really cold.
examples.translationZh: 我总是开著窗户睡觉，除非天气非常冷才关上窗户。

examples.text: Iron corrodes unless it is greased or kept clean.
examples.translationZh: 如果不涂油或保持清洁铁便会腐蚀。

meaningZh: 救护车；野战医院

examples.text: An ambulance dashed to the scene of the accident.
examples.translationZh: 救护车风驰电掣赶往事故现场。

examples.text: An ambulance was racing along with its sirens wailing.
examples.translationZh: 救护车响着警报急驰而过。

examples.text: The injured man was fairly far gone by the time the ambulance arrived.
examples.translationZh: 救护车到时那伤者已生命垂危。

meaningZh: 先生

examples.text: This project is now under the charge of Mr White.
examples.translationZh: 这项工程现在由怀特先生主管。

examples.text: Mr Smith launched out on an enterprise.
examples.translationZh: 史密斯先生精力充沛地创办一个企业。

meaningZh: （服务的）对象；目标；（射击的）靶子

examples.text: The sights of the gun must be in alignment with the target.
examples.translationZh: 枪的瞄准器必须与射击目标对准成一线。

examples.text: The shot was way off target.
examples.translationZh: 这次射得远离目标。

examples.text: A stationary target is easiest to aim at.
examples.translationZh: 静止的目标是最容易瞄准的。

meaningZh: 猴；猿；淘气鬼

examples.text: When the tree falls, the monkeys scatter.
examples.translationZh: 树倒猢狲散。

examples.text: He's as mischievous as a monkey!
examples.translationZh: 他像猴子那麽顽皮！

examples.text: It is dangerous to monkey around in the workshop.
examples.translationZh: 在车间里胡闹是危险的。

meaningZh: 疼痛；vi. 疼痛；渴望

examples.text: There was a little ache in her fancy of all he described.
examples.translationZh: 她想象着他所描绘的一切，心里不禁有些刺痛。

examples.text: You'll make your back ache if you carry those heavy buckets.
examples.translationZh: 如果你背那些沉重的桶，你的背会痛的。

examples.text: He felt a dull ache in his shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 他感到肩膀隐隐作痛。

meaningZh: 洞穴；〈方〉地窖；vt.& vi. （使）塌陷，倒塌

examples.text: This cave was used by smugglersin the eighteenth century.
examples.translationZh: 这个洞穴是十八世纪走私的人使用的。

examples.text: The cliffs are riddled with caves.
examples.translationZh: 岩壁上布满洞穴。

examples.text: We kindled a firebrand in the cave.
examples.translationZh: 我们在山洞里点燃火把。

meaningZh: 东南，东南方，（美国）东南部；东南地区；adv. 在东南

examples.text: Taiwan is in the southeast of China.
examples.translationZh: 台湾在中国的东南部。

examples.text: The wind is in the southeast.
examples.translationZh: 东南部有风。

examples.text: Kowloon is a city of southeast China.
examples.translationZh: 九龙是中国东南一城市。

meaningZh: 表达；表示；显而易见

examples.text: The express is as swift as an arrow.
examples.translationZh: 快车似箭一般地飞驶。

examples.text: We have to change here for an express.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须在这里换乘快车。

examples.text: I sent the letter by express.
examples.translationZh: 我这封信寄的是快递。

meaningZh: 地基，基址图；（戏剧、小说等的）情节；一块地

examples.text: The plot thickens.
examples.translationZh: 情节复杂起来了。

examples.text: They are brewing a plot behind the scenes.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在幕后策划一个阴谋。

examples.text: The silly ending robs the plot of any credibility.
examples.translationZh: 这愚蠢的结尾使得整个情节变得一点都不可信。

meaningZh: 给…看；表现出；显露出

examples.text: The study shows an increase in the disease among the elderly.
examples.translationZh: 这项研究证明这种疾病在老年人群中的发病率呈上升趋势。

examples.text: Her laziness showed in her exam results.
examples.translationZh: 她平时懒惰从她的考试成绩可以看得出来。

examples.text: Let's show a picture to our audience.
examples.translationZh: 要给大家展示一幅画卷啊。

meaningZh: 器具，工具；（有助于做工或完成某事的）用具；受人利用的人

examples.text: Don't injure yourself with that tool.
examples.translationZh: 不要让那工具伤害到你。

examples.text: The metal tool clanged when it hit the ground.
examples.translationZh: 金属工具碰到地面时发出叮当声。

examples.text: A vacuum cleaner is a handy household tool.
examples.translationZh: 吸尘器是一种使用方便的家庭用具。

meaningZh: 额外的，补充的，附加的；特大的，特别的；n. 附加物，额外的事物

examples.text: There were so many people that the company put on extra buses.
examples.translationZh: 人数太多，公司加开了公共汽车。

examples.text: Guests at this hotel can use the gym at no extra cost.
examples.translationZh: 这家饭店的客人们可以使用健身房,不再额外收费。

examples.text: Her school fees are 440 a term; music and dancing are extras.
examples.translationZh: 她的学费是每学期440英镑，音乐和舞蹈课另外收费。

meaningZh: 立方形，立方体；立方，三次幂；小房间

examples.text: A cube is a three-dimensional object.
examples.translationZh: 立方体是三维物体。

examples.text: Three cubed is twenty-seven.
examples.translationZh: 三的立方是二十七。

examples.text: If you cube 1 0 , the result is 1 0 0 0 .
examples.translationZh: 如果你求10的立方，得出的结果是1000。

meaningZh: 斜着，斜向一边；以侧面对着；adj. 斜向一边的

examples.text: The trees are bushing out sideways.
examples.translationZh: 这些树正往四周长杈。

examples.text: He dropped the box sideways, so it hit me.
examples.translationZh: 他把箱子向旁边一扔

examples.text: He looked sideways at me in the meeting.
examples.translationZh: 他在会议上斜着眼看我。

meaningZh: （文章的）一段；经过；通路，通道

examples.text: The bridge is not strong enough to allow the passage of vehicles.
examples.translationZh: 这座桥不够牢固，车辆不能通行。

examples.text: The police kept a clear passage for the traffic.
examples.translationZh: 警方使来往车辆畅通无阻。

examples.text: We discovered a secret passage behind the wall.
examples.translationZh: 我们在墙后发现了一个秘密通道。

meaningZh: 年幼的,年轻的,幼小的,新发展的；有朝气的,有青春活力的；年轻人

examples.text: The young look is in fashion this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年时兴扮年轻人的样子。

examples.text: Those clothes she's wearing are much too young for her.
examples.translationZh: 她穿的那些衣服显得太年轻了。

examples.text: The evening is still young.
examples.translationZh: 晚间刚开始不久。

meaningZh: 反常的，异常的；不规则的；变态的，畸形的

examples.text: We were very surprised at his abnormal behavior.
examples.translationZh: 我们对他的反常行为感到非常吃惊。

examples.text: At one time, she is fine, but at another, she is abnormal.
examples.translationZh: 有时候，她表现得很好，有时候又失常。

examples.text: He is mentally abnormal.
examples.translationZh: 他精神不正常。

meaningZh: 可可，可可粉；可可饮料；深褐色

examples.text: Cocoa is used in making chocolate.
examples.translationZh: 可可粉用来做巧克力。

examples.text: The country's main products are gold and cocoa.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的主要产品是可可和黄金。

examples.text: He has a mug of cocoa before bed.
examples.translationZh: 他临睡前喝一缸子可可。

meaningZh: 头昏眼花的；使人眩晕的，引起头晕的；昏乱的

examples.text: The airplane climbed to a dizzy height.
examples.translationZh: 飞机爬到令人头晕目眩的高度。

examples.text: Riding on merry-go-round makes me feel dizzy.
examples.translationZh: 骑木马让我觉得眩晕。

examples.text: Prices keep rising at a dizzy rate.
examples.translationZh: 物价以极快的速度不断上涨。

meaningZh: 在楼下；向[往]楼下；adj. 楼下的

examples.text: Your downstairs neighbor let me in.
examples.translationZh: 楼下的邻居让我进来的。

examples.text: The young man downstairs is a lawyer.
examples.translationZh: 楼下的那位年轻人是律师。

examples.text: The children made a loud noise downstairs.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们在楼下大声喧哗。

meaningZh: 松树；松木；凤梨，菠萝

examples.text: The pine trees defy severe cold.
examples.translationZh: 松树不畏严寒。

examples.text: It's a noted place for its pine tree and springs.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个以松树和泉水著称的地方。

examples.text: There is a pine forest near our house.
examples.translationZh: 我们家附近有片松树林。

meaningZh: 衬衣，内衣

examples.text: She changes her underwear every day.
examples.translationZh: 她每天换内衣内裤。

examples.text: My mother has bought the thermal underwear for me.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈已经给我买了保暖内衣。

meaningZh: 祈祷；祈祷（习惯）；祈祷文

examples.text: She had a wakeful night spent in prayer.
examples.translationZh: 她整夜祈祷。

examples.text: The congregation in the church knelt in prayer.
examples.translationZh: 教堂的会众跪下来祈祷。

examples.text: I say my prayers every night before going to bed.
examples.translationZh: 每天晚上上床前，我都要祈祷。

meaningZh: 幸福；高兴；恰当

examples.text: Human happiness is so fragile.
examples.translationZh: 人生幸福易逝。

examples.text: I desire happiness.
examples.translationZh: 我渴望幸福。

examples.text: Money can't buy happiness.
examples.translationZh: 金钱买不来幸福。

meaningZh: 分离，分开；间隔，距离；[矿]分选

examples.text: Separation from her children was a terrible wrench.
examples.translationZh: 同她的孩子们分别是一项很大的痛苦。

examples.text: He reminded me of the separation of church and state.
examples.translationZh: 他提醒我政教是分离的。

examples.text: Friends managed to reconcile him with his wife after years of separation.
examples.translationZh: 经过多年分居后朋友们设法使他与妻子重修旧好。

meaningZh: 吹口哨，吹哨子，鸣汽笛；呼啸；（动物）发出刺耳的叫声

examples.text: The whistle goes at the end of the match.
examples.translationZh: 比赛结束时哨声响了。

examples.text: He gave a loud whistle of gladness.
examples.translationZh: 他吹了一声响亮的口号表示高兴。

examples.text: The whistle went and the man knocked off for lunch.
examples.translationZh: 汽笛响了，工人们停工午餐。

meaningZh: 雇用；使用，利用；n. 受雇

examples.text: They employ casual labor to pick the fruit
examples.translationZh: 他们雇佣临时工摘水果。

examples.text: You must employ someone to oversee the project.
examples.translationZh: 你得雇个人监督这一工程。

examples.text: Why do you think we should employ you?
examples.translationZh: 你认为我们为何要雇佣你?

meaningZh: 仔细的，小心的；周到的；慎

examples.text: He is careful in his speech.
examples.translationZh: 他说话谨慎。

examples.text: Be careful in dealing with such people.
examples.translationZh: 与这种人打交道要小心谨慎。

examples.text: You should be more careful with your money.
examples.translationZh: 你花钱要慎重一些。

meaningZh: 以前的，从前的；在前的；前任的

examples.text: Of these two men, the former is dead but the latter is still alive.
examples.translationZh: 这两个人中，前者已死，而后者仍然活着。

examples.text: Mr. Heath is the former Prime Minister of Britain.
examples.translationZh: 希思先生是英国前任首相。

examples.text: I paid a visit to my former English teacher.
examples.translationZh: 我拜访了我以前的英语老师。

meaningZh: 无线电；收音机；无线电广播台

examples.text: I'm afraid this old radio is beyond repair.
examples.translationZh: 恐怕这台旧收音机不能修了。

examples.text: Radio reception isn't very good here.
examples.translationZh: 这里的无线电接收情况不太好。

examples.text: Every ship is required to radio its position.
examples.translationZh: 要求每一艘船用无线电报告各自所在的位置。

meaningZh: [物]极点，顶点；地极；杆

examples.text: Pole vaulters need long run-ups.
examples.translationZh: 撑竿跳需要长距离助跑。

examples.text: The hut was made of poles covered with grass mats.
examples.translationZh: 茅屋用木杆搭成，上面以草席覆盖。

examples.text: He had put up a basket on a pole in the back yard.
examples.translationZh: 他在后院一根柱子上安一个球篮。

meaningZh: 不喜欢；厌恶；n. 厌憎

examples.text: We dislike to have anyone patronize us.
