examples.translationZh: 我们不喜欢任何人对我们以恩人自居。

examples.text: What do you dislike most about this movie?
examples.translationZh: 这部电影你最不喜欢什么？

examples.text: I saw everything I began to dislike, in retrospect.
examples.translationZh: 我看见的一切都让我开始厌恶了，回想起来。

meaningZh: 聪明的，灵巧的；英俊的，风采优雅的；性情温良的

examples.text: It's a clever speech, but there was no real meat in it.
examples.translationZh: 这演说很动听，可是没什么内容。

examples.text: He's so clever, he makes me feel inferior.
examples.translationZh: 他那么聪明，让我自愧不如。

examples.text: Mr. Jones is a clever carpenter.
examples.translationZh: 琼斯先生是个巧木匠。

meaningZh: 钝的；迟钝的；呆滞的

examples.text: Jack had all work but no play, making him a dull boy.
examples.translationZh: 杰克只学不玩,这使得他成为一个呆笨的孩子。

examples.text: It's impossible to cut a pineapple with such a dull knife.
examples.translationZh: 用一把这么钝的刀子切菠萝是不可能的。

examples.text: The mind becomes dull if the body doesn't get on exercise.
examples.translationZh: 要是身体得不到锻炼,头脑也会迟钝的。

meaningZh: （热带）丛林；丛林音乐；乱七八糟的一堆事物

examples.text: We should have cut away the jungle brush.
examples.translationZh: 我们本应该把丛林的灌木砍掉。

examples.text: This jungle juice will knock you for a loop.
examples.translationZh: 你喝了这种烈酒会醉倒的。

examples.text: There's not much jungle 100 miles inland.
examples.translationZh: 向内地100英里处丛林较少。

meaningZh: 分配，散布；散发，分发；把…分类

examples.text: Please distribute books among the students.
examples.translationZh: 把书发给学生。

examples.text: Clothes and blankets have been distributed among the refugees.
examples.translationZh: 向难民分发了衣服和毯子。

examples.text: We distribute handbills on the street every weekend.
examples.translationZh: 我们每周都要在街上散发传单。

meaningZh: 旅行；进行；移动

examples.text: You are hardly fit to travel alone at present.
examples.translationZh: 照目前的情况,你不宜单独旅行。

examples.text: I travel 40 miles to work every day.
examples.translationZh: 我每天奔波40英里去上班。

examples.text: When we speak, sound waves begin to travel in all directions.
examples.translationZh: 我们说话时,声波就开始向四面八方传播扩散。

meaningZh: 赚得；获得；赢得

examples.text: He has earned a lot of money in this month.
examples.translationZh: 这个月他已经赚了好多钱了。

examples.text: He works hard, but he does not earn much money.
examples.translationZh: 他工作很努力，但钱赚得不多。

examples.text: How does she earn her living?
examples.translationZh: 她靠什么谋生？

meaningZh: 寒冷的；冷淡的，无情的；失去知觉的

examples.text: We lunched out on cold meat and salad.
examples.translationZh: 我们午饭在外面吃的是凉肉和色拉。

examples.text: It was bitterly cold that night.
examples.translationZh: 那个夜晚,天气十分寒冷。

examples.text: His cold manner holds people off.
examples.translationZh: 他的冷淡态度使人们不敢接近他。

meaningZh: 使…疲惫；使…厌烦；vi. 厌烦

examples.text: There is no tread on the tire - you should put on a new one.
examples.translationZh: 这条轮胎已经磨平了，你应该换一条新的。

examples.text: The tires of this car don't have enough air in them.
examples.translationZh: 这辆汽车的轮胎气不足了。

examples.text: I never tire of reading Shakespeare.
examples.translationZh: 我对莎士比亚的作品百读不厌。

meaningZh: 原谅；饶恕；对不起

examples.text: Forgive me.
examples.translationZh: 请原谅我。

examples.text: If he is really repentant, we should forgive him.
examples.translationZh: 如果他真心悔过，我们就应该原谅他。

examples.text: He is not a man who forgives easily.
examples.translationZh: 他不是一个肯轻易宽恕人的人。

meaningZh: 爱慕；崇拜；非常喜欢

examples.text: Men can only adore women who are adorable.
examples.translationZh: 男人们只爱慕那些让人爱慕的女人。

examples.text: The kids adore their father and confide in him.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们崇拜并信赖他们的父亲。

examples.text: The boys adore their mothers.
examples.translationZh: 男孩们敬慕他们的母亲。

meaningZh: 熊猫；猫熊

examples.text: I have never seen a panda.
examples.translationZh: 我从未见过熊猫。

examples.text: The panda is now a rare animal.
examples.translationZh: 熊猫现在是稀有动物。

examples.text: Pandas are loved by people all over the world.
examples.translationZh: 熊猫被全世界的人们喜爱。

meaningZh: 积极的，活跃的，有生气的；迅速的，敏捷的；有效的，起作用的

examples.text: Ms. Brown is active in the party.
examples.translationZh: 布朗女士在晚会上很活跃。

examples.text: He is an active member of the school's stamp club.
examples.translationZh: 他是学校集邮俱乐部的一名活跃会员。

examples.text: She was active as a left-winger in the party.
examples.translationZh: 她是党内积极的左翼分子。

meaningZh: 护士，看护；奶妈，保姆，阿妈，保育员；保护人，培养者，养成所，发祥地

examples.text: A nurse came to put on a clean dressing for him.
examples.translationZh: 一位护士来给他包上干净的绷带。

examples.text: The nurse diluted the drug with saline water.
examples.translationZh: 护士用生理盐水把药加以稀释。

examples.text: The nurse is preparing the child to go to hospital.
examples.translationZh: 保姆正在为孩子住院作准备。

meaningZh: 青春期；青年期

examples.text: Adolescence is no time to be lulled to sleep.
examples.translationZh: 青春期不是让人哄着入睡的时候了。

examples.text: Can excessive masturbation affect adolescence long?
examples.translationZh: 青春期过度手淫会影响长个吗？

meaningZh: 纺纱；吐（丝），作（茧），结网；快速旋转

examples.text: My sister can spin on her toes like a dancer.
examples.translationZh: 我妹妹能像舞者一样踮着脚尖旋转。

examples.text: The motorcycles were spinning along at full speed.
examples.translationZh: 摩托车正全速疾驰。

examples.text: Mother used to spin her own yarn.
examples.translationZh: 母亲过去一直是自己纺纱的。

meaningZh: 发现；碰见；撞见

examples.text: He was later discovered to have been a spy.
examples.translationZh: 后来发现他原来是间谍。

examples.text: The fact is that he did not discover it.
examples.translationZh: 事实是他没有发现它。

examples.text: I discovered him kissing my wife.
examples.translationZh: 我撞见他在吻我的妻子。

meaningZh: 取得；获得；实现

examples.text: I've achieved only half of what I'd hoped to do.
examples.translationZh: 我希望做到的,我仅完成了一半。

examples.text: Work hard, and you will achieve your goal.
examples.translationZh: 好好干,你就会达到自己的目标。

examples.text: You will achieve your ambition if you work hard.
examples.translationZh: 如果你努力, 你的抱负是可以实现的。

meaningZh: 小孩，孩子；幼稚的人；产物

examples.text: He's still but a child.
examples.translationZh: 他仅仅是个小孩子。

examples.text: He tutored the child in physics.
examples.translationZh: 他给这小孩辅导物理。

examples.text: They cherished the child as one of their own.
examples.translationZh: 他们把这孩子当作自己亲生子女一般。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. 爱;热爱；vt. 喜爱;喜好;喜欢；爱,爱情

examples.text: He swore to love her for evermore.
examples.translationZh: 他发誓永远爱她。

examples.text: I love my motherland.
examples.translationZh: 我爱我的祖国。

examples.text: The children love playing out in the open.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。

meaningZh: 讲，谈；演说；从某种观点来说

examples.text: Does anyone speak English here?
examples.translationZh: 这儿有人会说英语吗？

examples.text: I'm quite capable of speaking for myself, thank you!
examples.translationZh: 我还是有能力把话说清楚的，谢谢你吧。

examples.text: The patient is too weak to speak.
examples.translationZh: 病人太衰弱了，不能说话。

meaningZh: 同事；同僚；同行

examples.text: Please allow me to introduce my colleague Professor Zhang to you.
examples.translationZh: 请允许我把我的同事张教授介绍给你。

meaningZh: 广告；公元

examples.text: That's an interesting ad.
examples.translationZh: 那是有趣的广告。

examples.text: I got four replies to my ad about the bicycle for sale.
examples.translationZh: 已经收到了四份对我出售自行车广告的回信。

examples.text: The ad was run in the paper for a week.
examples.translationZh: 这则广告在报上连续刊登了一个星期。

meaningZh: 美好的，愉快的；正派的；友好的，亲切的

examples.text: It's a nice day today.
examples.translationZh: 今天天气很好。

examples.text: How nice of you to do that!
examples.translationZh: 你那样做真是太好了！

examples.text: I brought her a very nice present from Soochow.
examples.translationZh: 我从苏州给她带来一件美妙的礼物。

meaningZh: 人口；全体居民；特定[生物]种群

examples.text: What is the population of this country?
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的人口是多少？

examples.text: The density of population in this city is very high.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市的人口密度非常高。

examples.text: There has been a steady decrease in population in this city.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市的人口在持续下降。

meaningZh: 可怕的；极不友好的；极讨厌的

examples.text: His heart sickened at the thought of that horrible scene.
examples.translationZh: 他一想到那种可怕的情景就感到恶心。

examples.text: Everything is in a horrible muddle.
examples.translationZh: 一切都陷入可怕的混乱。

examples.text: The sight of the battlefield was horrible.
examples.translationZh: 战场的情景令人毛骨悚然。

meaningZh: 照片，画像；图画，图片；影片

examples.text: May I take a picture of you?
examples.translationZh: 我可以给你照相吗？

examples.text: The Pianist is the fourth movie nominated for Best Picture.
examples.translationZh: 《钢琴家》是第4部获得最佳影片提名的电影。

examples.text: The book gives a good picture of everyday life in ancient rome.
examples.translationZh: 那部书对古罗马人的日常生活描写得很生动。

meaningZh: 烤，烘，焙；vt. 嘲讽，挖苦；n. 烤肉

examples.text: Let's have a nice roast for Sunday dinner.
examples.translationZh: 我们星期天晚上好好吃一顿烤肉吧。

examples.text: His mouth watered at the sight of roast.
examples.translationZh: 他看见烤肉就垂涎三尺。

examples.text: They had a hot dog roast last Sunday.
examples.translationZh: 他们上星期天举行了一次烤热狗野餐会。

meaningZh: 穿旧的，用旧的；穿坏的，用坏的；筋疲力尽的

examples.text: The worn brakes require replacement.
examples.translationZh: 磨损的刹车需要替换。

examples.text: His worn jacket revealed his elbows.
examples.translationZh: 他的破上衣露出了肘部。

examples.text: They were shivering in thin, worn sweaters.
examples.translationZh: 他们穿着很薄的破毛衣，冻得发抖。

meaningZh: 阳光充足的,阳光明媚的；令人愉快的,快活的

examples.text: We basked ourselves on the sunny beach.
examples.translationZh: 我们在阳光充足的海滩上晒太阳。

examples.text: Sunny weather alternated with rain.
examples.translationZh: 天气晴雨相间。

examples.text: Sunny days are driving up the temperature.
examples.translationZh: 阳光明媚的日子使气温上升。

meaningZh: 褪去，失去光泽；逐渐消逝；凋谢，衰老

examples.text: Hopes of a peaceful settlement are now fading.
examples.translationZh: 和平解决的希望正在消失。

examples.text: The closing music fades out when the hero rides off into the sunset.
examples.translationZh: 当男主角策马向夕阳驰去时，尾声音乐逐渐消失。

examples.text: As evening came the coastline faded into darkness.
examples.translationZh: 夜晚来临，海岸线融入茫茫夜色中。

meaningZh: 使清楚，澄清；vt. （尤指通过加热使黄油）纯净；说明

examples.text: These brief remarks may serve to clarify the fact.
examples.translationZh: 这些简要的评论可以澄清事实。

examples.text: The teacher's explanation clarified the puzzling problem.
examples.translationZh: 老师的说明澄清了困扰的问题。

examples.text: Would you please clarify your question?
examples.translationZh: 请你把你的问题说清楚好吗？

meaningZh: 目录，一览表；（美）大学情况便览；展览目录

examples.text: The catalogue is under revision.
examples.translationZh: 目录正在修订之中。

examples.text: You can look for the book in the library catalogue.
examples.translationZh: 你可以在图书馆的图书目录上查找这本书。

examples.text: Please fax me the layout for the new catalogue.
examples.translationZh: 请用传真机把新目录的版面编排图样传送给我。

meaningZh: 分，分钟；瞬间，片刻；备忘录

examples.text: The park is only five minutes from downtown.
examples.translationZh: 这个花园离市中心只有五分钟的路程。

examples.text: Please wait a minute, I'll go with you right now.
examples.translationZh: 请等一下,我马上跟你走。

examples.text: She has the habit of making a minute of daily businesses.
examples.translationZh: 她有记录每天各种事务的习惯。

meaningZh: 收集；收藏；接走

examples.text: He used to collect cards, but now he likes to collect stamps.
examples.translationZh: 他以前收集卡片,现在却喜欢收集邮票。

examples.text: A crowd soon collected at the scene of the accident.
examples.translationZh: 群众迅速聚集在出事现场。

examples.text: He's collecting (money) for famine relief.
examples.translationZh: 他正在为赈济饥民募捐.

meaningZh: 满的，装满的；完全的，完整的；丰富的

examples.text: Hotels are often full in season
examples.translationZh: 在度假旺季,旅馆经常客满。

examples.text: He gave a boring speech full of stale jokes.
examples.translationZh: 他的发言很乏味,满是陈腐的笑话。

examples.text: The bottle is full of water.
examples.translationZh: 瓶子里装满了水。

meaningZh: 等级；职别；成绩等级

examples.text: This grade of wool can be sold at a fairly low price.
examples.translationZh: 这种等级的羊毛只能以相当低的价格卖出。

examples.text: He's not in the first grade as a musician.
examples.translationZh: 他不是第一流的音乐家。

examples.text: He is in the third grade.
examples.translationZh: 他读三年级。

meaningZh: 细胞；小牢房；电池

examples.text: The prisoner was locked in a cell.
examples.translationZh: 那囚犯被关在单人牢房内。

examples.text: She was found prostrate on the floor of the cell.
examples.translationZh: 有人发现她趴在小屋的地板上。

examples.text: The cancer cell may invade other parts of the body.
examples.translationZh: 癌细胞可能侵袭身体的其他部分。

meaningZh: 发出光；反射光，闪耀；出类拔萃，表现突出

examples.text: The curtain was suddenly drawn and a bright light shone in.
examples.translationZh: 突然窗帘拉了开来，一道强光照了进来。

examples.text: He shines at golf.
examples.translationZh: 他高尔夫球打得很出色。

examples.text: The sun is shinning brightly.
examples.translationZh: 今天阳光格外明媚。

meaningZh: 挑战；盘问；质疑

examples.text: The crossing of this dangerous river was a challenge to most of us.
examples.translationZh: 对我们大多数人来说,横渡这条充满危险的大河确实是个挑战。

examples.text: He accepted his friend's challenge to swim across the river.
examples.translationZh: 他接受朋友提出的挑战，游过这条河。

examples.text: We accepted their challenge to a baseball game.
examples.translationZh: 我们接受了他们棒球邀请的挑战。

meaningZh: 缺席的，不在场的；缺少的，缺乏的；不在意的，茫然的

examples.text: Professor Li is absent, I will take the lesson in the place of him.
examples.translationZh: 李教授不在，我替他上课。

examples.text: Many students were absent, notably the monitor.
examples.translationZh: 许多学生缺席，特别是连班长也没来。

examples.text: You should not be absent from class.
examples.translationZh: 你不应当旷课。

meaningZh: 邮票；标志，印记；跺脚

examples.text: My husband is a stamp collector.
examples.translationZh: 我丈夫是个集邮者。

examples.text: He is looking for his rubber stamp.
examples.translationZh: 他正在找他的橡皮印章。

examples.text: Please bring a photograph of yourself.We have to affix a stamp on the corner of it.
examples.translationZh: 请带一张你的照片来,我们要在它的角上盖个印儿。

meaningZh: 晚的，迟到的；时间不早的；已故的

examples.text: I'm afraid I may be a little late.
examples.translationZh: 恐怕我可能稍晚一点。

examples.text: The train was 10 minutes late.
examples.translationZh: 火车晚点了10 分钟。

examples.text: This country was founded in the late eighteenth century.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家是在18世纪末期建立的。

meaningZh: 危险，冒险；保险额；被保险人或物

examples.text: He saved my life at the risk of his own.
examples.translationZh: 他冒着自己的生命危险救了我的命。

examples.text: Investors in Central Asia have to face political risk.
examples.translationZh: 在中亚,投资者还得面临政治风险。

examples.text: Loans to farmers are now considered to be a bad risk.
examples.translationZh: 贷款给农民现在被认为要承受糟糕的投资报酬风险。

meaningZh: 女学生

examples.text: A schoolgirl there who was just admitted by a university wrote me a letter.
examples.translationZh: 在这里，一个刚刚考上大学的女生给我写了一封信。

examples.text: The ratio of schoolboys to schoolgirls is 2 to 1.
examples.translationZh: 男学生和女学生的比例是2比1。

examples.text: I was a twelve-year-old schoolgirl.
examples.translationZh: 我当时是一个十二岁的女学生。

meaningZh: 紧张，不安；紧张气氛；[物]张力，拉力

examples.text: The tension is building up.
examples.translationZh: 形势逐步紧张起来。

examples.text: The tension soon transmitted itself to all the members of the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 这种紧张情绪很快感染了人群中所有的人。

examples.text: A positive-stress component means tension.
examples.translationZh: 正应力分量表示拉力。

meaningZh: 弄脏；污染；被玷污

examples.text: The stain on his shirt is difficult to clean off.
examples.translationZh: 他衬衣上的污点很难去除掉。

examples.text: It will remain an indelible stain on his memory.
examples.translationZh: 这将成为他记忆中一个不可磨灭的污点。

examples.text: Such a man is a stain to humanity.
examples.translationZh: 这种人是人类的耻辱。

meaningZh: 秘书；干事，书记员；部长，大臣

examples.text: He was the then secretary of Defense.
examples.translationZh: 他是当时的国防部长。

examples.text: He buzzed for his secretary to come.
examples.translationZh: 他按蜂鸣器叫秘书进来。

examples.text: My secretary is an absolute gem.
examples.translationZh: 我的秘书真是个难能可贵的人。

meaningZh: 推，推动；vt. 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫

examples.text: The little boy pushed the door open.
examples.translationZh: 小男孩把门推开了。

examples.text: They jeep is too heavy for him to push.
examples.translationZh: 吉普车太重,他推不动。

examples.text: You may push this button to call the elevator.
examples.translationZh: 你可以按这个按钮叫电梯。

meaningZh: 修建，建造；构成；创立

examples.text: This factory was constructed by our company.
examples.translationZh: 这家工厂是由我们公司建设的。

examples.text: They are planning to construct a new supermarket.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在计划建造一个新的超级市场。

examples.text: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.
examples.translationZh: 你必须学会怎样确立合乎逻辑的论点。

meaningZh: 位置，方位；地位，职位；态度

examples.text: Can you find our position on this map?
examples.translationZh: 你能在这幅地图上找到我们的位置吗?

examples.text: I can tell the time from the position of the sun.
examples.translationZh: 我可以从太阳的位置知道时刻。

examples.text: The position of manager is still open.
examples.translationZh: 经理职位仍然空缺。

meaningZh: （人的）情况；局面，形势，处境；位置

examples.text: The overall situation is worsening.
examples.translationZh: 整体形势在日益恶化。

examples.text: The economic situation is now different.
examples.translationZh: 现在经济形势不同了。

examples.text: You dealt with an awkward situation very tactfully.
examples.translationZh: 你很巧妙地处理了一个困难的局面。

meaningZh: 尾；尾部；燕尾服

examples.text: He drove into the back of my truck and smashed the tail light.
examples.translationZh: 他开车撞进我卡车的后部，把我的尾灯撞得粉碎。

examples.text: Lizards have four legs and a long tail.
examples.translationZh: 蜥蜴有四条腿和一条长尾巴。

examples.text: The sting of a scorpion is in its tail.
examples.translationZh: 蝎子的毒钩在其尾部。

meaningZh: 肉；食物；实质

examples.text: The meat will rot if it isn't kept cool.
examples.translationZh: 肉如果不冷藏就会腐败。

examples.text: She gave some of the meat to the cat.
examples.translationZh: 她把一些肉给猫吃了。

examples.text: There's not much meat on that bone.
examples.translationZh: 那块骨头上没多少肉。

meaningZh: 火鸡；蠢货；失败之作

examples.text: It's traditional in England to eat turkey on Christmas Day.
examples.translationZh: 圣诞节时吃火鸡是英格兰的传统。

examples.text: People often drink white wine with turkey.
examples.translationZh: 人们经常边吃火鸡肉边喝白葡萄酒。

examples.text: Russia thereupon declared war upon Turkey.
examples.translationZh: 俄国于是对土耳其宣战。

meaningZh: 练习；实践；（医生或律师的）业务

examples.text: Daily practice is the trick in learning a foreign language.
examples.translationZh: 每天练习是学会一门外语的诀窍。

examples.text: We must put our plans into practice.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须将计划付诸实行。

examples.text: You should make a practice of being on time for work.
examples.translationZh: 你应该养成准时上班的习惯。

meaningZh: 顾客，客户；主顾；家伙

examples.text: My father asked me to see the customer to the door.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲要我送顾客到门口。

examples.text: The new store across the road has taken away most of my customers.
examples.translationZh: 路那边的那家新店抢走了我的许多主顾。

meaningZh: 鼻子；嗅觉；芳香，香气

examples.text: He quirked up his nose to make a face.
examples.translationZh: 他鼻子一扬作了个鬼脸。

examples.text: I wrinkled up my nose at the nasty smell.
examples.translationZh: 我闻到那股难闻的味，皱起了鼻子。

examples.text: The child pressed her nose against the window.
examples.translationZh: 那小女孩把鼻子贴在窗户上。

meaningZh: 港口；（事情的）意义；（计算机与其他设备的）接口

examples.text: Rick often watched the boats returning to port in the late afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 瑞克常常看到小船在傍晚回到港口。

examples.text: The priest blessed the ship before it left port.
examples.translationZh: 牧师在船离港之前为其祝福。

meaningZh: 陌生人，不认识的人；外地人；局外人

examples.text: A sergeant asked the stranger to show his pass.
examples.translationZh: 警官要求这个陌生人出示通行证。

examples.text: A stranger plucked at my sleeve as I was leaving.
examples.translationZh: 我刚要离去，一个陌生人拽我的袖子。

examples.text: His habitual place at the table was occupied by a stranger.
examples.translationZh: 他惯常坐在桌旁的位置被一个陌生人占据了。

meaningZh: 闪电般的，快速的；n. 闪电，雷电；vi. 打闪

examples.text: The little girl is afraid of thunder and lightning.
examples.translationZh: 这小女孩害怕雷声和闪电。

examples.text: The tree was struck by lightning and splintered.
examples.translationZh: 那棵树被闪电劈裂了。

examples.text: He drove the car with lightning speed.
examples.translationZh: 他以闪电般的速度开车。

meaningZh: 猛冲；赶紧离开；vt. 猛撞

examples.text: He dashed across the street and ran towards me.
examples.translationZh: 他冲过马路，向我跑过来。

examples.text: He dash the glass bowl to bit on a rock.
examples.translationZh: 他对著石块把玻璃碗砸得粉碎。

examples.text: Don't dash the paint on the wall like that.
examples.translationZh: 别那样在墙上乱涂漆。

meaningZh: 首饰，饰物；等于jewelry；珍宝

examples.text: The thieves stole 1 million worth of jewellery.
examples.translationZh: 窃贼偷走了价值100万英镑的珠宝。

examples.text: The police recovered the stolen jewellery.
examples.translationZh: 警察找回了被盗的珠宝。

examples.text: She never wears jewellery.
examples.translationZh: 她从不戴首饰。

meaningZh: 跳，弹跳；限制；接壤

examples.text: It's bound to rain soon.
examples.translationZh: 过一会儿肯定会下雨。

examples.text: You are not legally bound to answer these questions.
examples.translationZh: 在法律上，你没有义务非回答这些问题不可。

examples.text: We are bound hand and foot by the contract, so we are unable to help you.
examples.translationZh: 我们受到合同的约束而不能帮你。

meaningZh: 买得起；担负得起；提供

examples.text: Only the well-to-do can afford these houses.
examples.translationZh: 只有富人能买得起这些房子。

examples.text: I can't afford a holiday this summer.
examples.translationZh: 今年夏天我无法度假。

examples.text: We can afford to overlook minor offences.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以不计较小过。

meaningZh: 胡椒；辣椒；胡椒粉

examples.text: The pepper in the food caused me to sneeze.
examples.translationZh: 这食物中的胡椒味儿呛得我直打喷嚏。

examples.text: This kind of green pepper is very hot.
examples.translationZh: 这种青辣椒非常辣。

examples.text: You don't have to pepper the soup.
examples.translationZh: 你不一定要往汤里撒胡椒粉。

meaningZh: 小心；警告；〈英〉担保

examples.text: The teacher gave Tom a caution and told him never to do it again.
examples.translationZh: 老师给了汤姆一次警告,叫他不许再那样做。

examples.text: He told us to proceed with caution.
examples.translationZh: 他要我们谨慎行事。

examples.text: Always he sought someone to whom he could talk without caution.
examples.translationZh: 他一直在找一个能够随便谈谈的人。

meaningZh: 帽子；（帽子所表示的）职位，职务；vt. 给…戴上帽子，为…提供帽子

examples.text: She bought a hat yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 她昨天买了一顶帽子。

examples.text: He took off the hat and revealed his bald head.
examples.translationZh: 他脱下帽子，露出秃头。

examples.text: He always wears a panama hat.
examples.translationZh: 他总戴着一顶巴拿马草帽。

meaningZh: 床；苗圃；河床

examples.text: Life isn't a bed of roses.
examples.translationZh: 人生并非事事称心如意。

examples.text: Can you give me a bed for the night?
examples.translationZh: 你能给我安置一个床铺过夜吗？

examples.text: The machine rests on a bed of concrete.
examples.translationZh: 机器安装在混凝土基座上。

meaningZh: 学院的，大学的，学会的，（学术，文艺）协会的；学究的，学理上的，空谈的，非实用的；〈美〉文科的，文学的

examples.text: Sir Lawrence Alma-Tadema was an English painter in the academic tradition.
examples.translationZh: 阿尔玛·台德玛是学院派的英国画家。

examples.text: With my strong academic background, I am competent.
examples.translationZh: 依我良好的学术背景,我能胜任。

examples.text: Applicant must possess good conduct and obtain satisfactory academic results.
examples.translationZh: 申请者必须拥有良好品性,并考获令人满意的成绩;

meaningZh: 邮筒；信箱

examples.text: A passing truck banged up the mailbox.
examples.translationZh: 一辆过路的卡车把邮筒撞坏了。

examples.text: I drop the letter in the mailbox on the corner.
examples.translationZh: 我把信投在拐角处的邮箱里。

meaningZh: 罐；一罐；（某种用途的）容器

examples.text: Will you help me to wash up all these pots and pans?
examples.translationZh: 帮我洗洗这些锅碗瓢盆好吗？

examples.text: She stayed up all night writing the paper with a pot of coffee at her elbow.
examples.translationZh: 她熬了一整夜写论文,身边放着一壶咖啡。

examples.text: He has earned a pot of money.
examples.translationZh: 他赚了一大笔钱。

meaningZh: 思考；想法，思想；意见

examples.text: Independent thinking is an absolute necessity.
examples.translationZh: 独立思考是绝对必要的。

examples.text: Night is a good time for my thinking.
examples.translationZh: 夜间是我思考的好时候。

examples.text: I need some time to orient my thinking.
examples.translationZh: 我需要一些时间来使我的思想适应。

meaningZh: 火焰；热情，激情；〈俚〉爱人，情人

examples.text: The candle flame flickered and went out.
examples.translationZh: 烛火摇曳着，随即熄灭了。

examples.text: Billows of flame swept through the forest.
examples.translationZh: 熊熊烈火席卷森林。

examples.text: He and I were kindled by a great flame of patriotism.
examples.translationZh: 我和他由于一股爱国主义的热情都激动起来了。

meaningZh: 病房，病区；区，行政区；受监护的未成年者

examples.text: The hospital has a medical ward and a surgical ward.
examples.translationZh: 这医院有内科病房和外科病房。

examples.text: The patient lay quietly on his bed in the medical ward.
examples.translationZh: 病人安静地躺在内科病房的床上。

examples.text: There are two nurses in the ward.
examples.translationZh: 病房里有两个护士。

meaningZh: 单独的；独一无二的；独自的

examples.text: Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
examples.translationZh: 并不只是汤姆一人认为和里克难以共事。

examples.text: I was alone in the classroom.
examples.translationZh: 我独自在教室里。

examples.text: To tell you the truth, I don't feel like being alone tonight.
examples.translationZh: 说实话,我今晚不想孤单一人。

meaningZh: 建筑学；建筑风格；体系结构

examples.text: He obtained a diploma in architecture.
examples.translationZh: 他获得了建筑学的学位证书。

examples.text: The architecture of this house is very substantial.
examples.translationZh: 这座房子的结构很牢固。

examples.text: The new house he bought was colonial architecture.
examples.translationZh: 他新买的房子是美国初期的建筑。

meaningZh: 习语，成语；方言，土语；（语言）风格

examples.text: This idiom cannot be translated literally.
examples.translationZh: 这个成语无法照字面翻译。

examples.text: From that story comes the idiom "Draw a snake and add feet to it".
examples.translationZh: “画蛇添足”这个成语就是从这个故事来的。

examples.text: "Let the cat out of the bag"is an idiom meaning to tell a secret by mistake.
examples.translationZh: “让猫从袋子里跑出来”是惯用语，意思是无意中泄露秘密。

meaningZh: 撤走；拿走；撤退

examples.text: In view of members reservation and request for further information, the Administration agreed to withdraw the item.
examples.translationZh: 鉴于委员有所保留,并要求取得进一步资料,政府当局同意撤回该项目。

examples.text: He wanted to withdraw his name from the guest list.
examples.translationZh: 他想从客人名单中撤出自己的名字。

examples.text: I'd like to withdraw some money from my account.
examples.translationZh: 我想从户头里提出一些钱。

meaningZh: 店员；办事员，职员；书记员

examples.text: The bank clerk peered at the customer through/from behind the grille.
examples.translationZh: 银行的职员从格栅後面看著顾客。

examples.text: The bank manager was really to blame, though he tried to pin it on a clerk.
examples.translationZh: 真正受责备的应该是银行经理，可是他却想把责任推到一个职员身上。

examples.text: She is the filing clerk of our company.
examples.translationZh: 她是我们公司的档案员。

meaningZh: 行李；辎重；精神包袱

examples.text: Let me put your baggage in the trunk.
examples.translationZh: 我来把你的行李放在汽车后部的行李箱内。

examples.text: Our baggage has cleared customs.
examples.translationZh: 我们的行李已通过海关检查。

meaningZh: 谷物，粮食；（沙，金，盐等的）颗粒；谷粒，籽粒

examples.text: We ship grain to Africa.
examples.translationZh: 我们把谷物运往非洲。

examples.text: There are a few grains of rice in a bowl.
examples.translationZh: 碗中有几颗米粒。

examples.text: There isn't a grain of truth in it.
examples.translationZh: 那事无丝毫真实性。

meaningZh: 剩余物，残骸；残余；遗迹

examples.text: We must learn to conserve what remains.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须学会保存那些剩余的资源。

examples.text: I didn't remain long in the city.
examples.translationZh: 我没在那个城市逗留很长时间。

examples.text: Though the sore being healed, yet a scar may remain.
examples.translationZh: 伤口虽然痊愈, 却可能留下伤疤。

meaningZh: （政府的）部；神职；牧师职位

examples.text: She's on attachment to the Ministry of Defense.
examples.translationZh: 她现在隶属于国防部。

examples.text: The army, navy and airforce are all controlled by the Ministry of Defense.
examples.translationZh: 陆海空军皆由国防部控制。

examples.text: The Ministry released him on compassionate grounds.
examples.translationZh: 内阁因同情而将他释放。

meaningZh: 梗概，大纲，提纲，草稿，要点，主要原则；外形，轮廓，轮廓线，轮廓画法，略图（画法）；vt. 概述

examples.text: He wrote down the outline of his lecture.
examples.translationZh: 他写下演讲的提纲。

examples.text: She drew the outline with a sure hand.
examples.translationZh: 她笔力雄健地画出了轮廓。

examples.text: He saw the outline of the house in the moonlight.
examples.translationZh: 在月光下,他看到了那座屋子的轮廓。

meaningZh: 类似的；同类的；相似的

examples.text: The two buildings are similar on the whole.
examples.translationZh: 从整体来看，这两幢楼是相似的。

examples.text: I sympathize with you; I've had a similar unhappy experience myself.
examples.translationZh: 我很同情你，我自己也有过类似的不幸遭遇。

examples.text: He talked about it in a similar way.
examples.translationZh: 他对此事有相似的说法。

meaningZh: 也；同样；并且

examples.text: We should also take account of difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 我们也应该考虑到困难。

examples.text: London was also called the modern Babylon.
examples.translationZh: 伦敦也被称为现代巴比伦。

examples.text: This book is not only interesting but also good.
examples.translationZh: 这本书不仅有趣,而且内容也非常好。

meaningZh: 英寸（相当于 2。54 厘米，一英尺有12英寸）；少量，少许；身高

examples.text: She shortened the shirt by an inch.
examples.translationZh: 她把衬衫截短了一英寸。

examples.text: The candle grew down until only an inch was left.
examples.translationZh: 蜡烛越来越短,最后只剩下一英寸了。

examples.text: There was an inch of snow on the ground.
examples.translationZh: 地上积着一英寸厚的白雪。

meaningZh: 移居；移民人数；移民局检查站

examples.text: He is talking about immigration.
examples.translationZh: 他正在谈论移居国外的事.

examples.text: There are strict controls on immigration into this country.
examples.translationZh: 移民到这个国家有严格的限制。

examples.text: The increased immigration strengthened the colony.
examples.translationZh: 移民的增加巩固了这个殖民地。

meaningZh: 量，数量；定量，大批；数目

examples.text: This company is more concerned with quality than with quantity.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司对质量比对产量更重视。

examples.text: He ate a small quantity of rice.
examples.translationZh: 他吃了少量的米饭。

examples.text: It was a bad year for films, in terms of both quantity and quality.
examples.translationZh: 今年的电影无论从数量上还是质量上都说不上好。

meaningZh: 选择；选择权；精选品

examples.text: I believe that he can make a judicious choice.
examples.translationZh: 我相信他能作出明智的选择。

examples.text: The choice rests entirely with you.
examples.translationZh: 这完全由你来选择。

examples.text: We have no choice except to trust ourselves.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须依靠自己,没有其他选择。

meaningZh: 诗；韵文；诗一样的作品

examples.text: He wrote a poem praising her loveliness.
examples.translationZh: 他写了一首诗赞扬她的美丽。

examples.text: The girl repeated the poem after I had read it twice.
examples.translationZh: 我读了两遍这首诗，这个小女孩就会背诵了。

examples.text: The poem showed great intensity of feeling.
examples.translationZh: 这篇韵文表现出强烈的激情。

meaningZh: （数字）一；一个；（基数）一，第一

examples.text: A person has one head and one neck.
examples.translationZh: 每人都有一个头，一个脖子。

examples.text: No one can live without breathing.
examples.translationZh: 没有一个人可以不呼吸而生存。

examples.text: If only problems would come one at a time!
examples.translationZh: 要是问题一次只发生一个该多好！

meaningZh: 经验，体验；经历，阅历；vt. 亲身参与，亲身经历

examples.text: He has had no previous experience in this kind of job.
examples.translationZh: 他从前没有做这种工作的经验。

examples.text: I know from my own experience how difficult the work can be.
examples.translationZh: 从我自己的经验我明白这项工作会有多难。

examples.text: I had a singular experience in Africa.
examples.translationZh: 我在非洲时有过一次奇特的经历。

meaningZh: 总数；数数；罪状

examples.text: Material control and cycle count.
examples.translationZh: 基本掌握物料控制及周期计算知识。

examples.text: It's not humanly possible to count so quickly.
examples.translationZh: 计算得这么快是人力无法做到的。

examples.text: Fruity cocktails count as health food, study finds.
examples.translationZh: 研究发现，水果鸡尾酒可被视为健康食品。

meaningZh: 姐妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；修女

examples.text: Joan and Lily are sisters.
examples.translationZh: 琼和丽丽是姐妹。

examples.text: You should take care of your niece for the sake of your sister.
examples.translationZh: 看在姐妹的份上，你应该照顾你的侄女。

examples.text: She looks nothing like her sister.
examples.translationZh: 她一点也不像她姐妹

meaningZh: 那时；然后；那么

examples.text: He'll be looking for a new secretary then?
examples.translationZh: 那么,他就要找个新秘书了？

examples.text: He took his hat and then left.
examples.translationZh: 他拿起帽子，随即离开了。

examples.text: We lived in the country then.
examples.translationZh: 我们那时住在乡下。

meaningZh: 吉他；六弦琴；vi. 弹吉他

examples.text: He plays the guitar and sings too.
examples.translationZh: 他会弹吉他，也会唱歌。

examples.text: I write my own songs and I play the guitar as well.
examples.translationZh: 我唱自己谱曲的歌，也弹吉他。

examples.text: It is fun to play the guitar.
examples.translationZh: 弹吉他是好玩的。

meaningZh: 影片；电影；胶片

examples.text: He made a film about Egypt.
examples.translationZh: 他拍了一部关于埃及的电影。

examples.text: I'm going to see a film this Sunday.
examples.translationZh: 在本星期天,我打算看一场电影。

examples.text: There was a film of grease on the water.
examples.translationZh: 水上有一层油。

meaningZh: 植物，草木；设备；工厂

examples.text: All plants need water and light.
examples.translationZh: 所有的植物都需要水和阳光。

examples.text: THe plant will come into bud in spring.
examples.translationZh: 那种植物将在春天发芽。

examples.text: After that we went on a tour of the plant.
examples.translationZh: 然后我们参观了工厂。

meaningZh: 乘；（使）相乘；（使）增加

examples.text: If you multiply four by five, the answer is twenty.
examples.translationZh: 四乘以五,答案是二十。

examples.text: Let us multiply the height by the width to determine the area.
examples.translationZh: 用宽乘以高来确定面积。

examples.text: This will multiply our chances of success.
examples.translationZh: 这将增加我们成功的机会。

meaningZh: 太阳的，日光的；利用太阳能的；根据太阳决定或测定的

examples.text: The sun is the center of our solar system.
examples.translationZh: 太阳是太阳系的中心

examples.text: Solar irradiance decreases towards the poles.
examples.translationZh: 太阳辐照率向两极递减。

examples.text: The solar cell can convert the energy of sunlight into electric energy.
examples.translationZh: 太阳能电池能把阳光的能量转化为电能。

meaningZh: 凌乱的，散乱的；肮脏的，污秽的；复杂的，麻烦的，难以应付的

examples.text: I can't find anything on this messy desk.
examples.translationZh: 在这张堆放得乱七八糟的桌子上我什么也找不到。

examples.text: She doesn't know how to tidy up the messy room.
examples.translationZh: 她不知道该怎样整理这个凌乱的房间。

examples.text: It is shaping up to be a dirty, messy campaign.
examples.translationZh: 这绝对会成为一场卑鄙而肮脏的竞选。

meaningZh: 机会; 时机；某事物发生的可能性；碰运气的事; 运气

examples.text: That would be a daunting task with little chance of success.
examples.translationZh: 那样做的话任务过于艰巨,且成功的可能性微乎其微。

examples.text: Is there any chance of getting tickets for tonight's performance?
examples.translationZh: 有可能得到今晚演出的票吗?

examples.text: Please give me a chance to explain.
examples.translationZh: 请给我个机会让我解释一下。

meaningZh: 重的，沉重的；大量的，浓密的；激烈的

examples.text: As we are booking heavy orders, we would advise your order at once.
examples.translationZh: 因为我方的订单量非常大,我方建议贵公司毫不犹豫地立即下订单。

examples.text: He made efforts to move the heavy furniture.
examples.translationZh: 他努力搬动沉重的家具。

examples.text: The lead is heavy and the plastic is light.
examples.translationZh: 铅是重的，而塑料是轻的。

meaningZh: 建筑师，设计师；创造者，缔造者；造物主

examples.text: He is known as a successful architect.
examples.translationZh: 他以成功的建筑师闻名。

examples.text: The author of the guidebook is an architect by profession.
examples.translationZh: 该旅行指南的作者任职建筑师。

examples.text: The architect was given/presented with a blank cheque to design a new city centre.
examples.translationZh: 设计师被授予全权设计一个新的城市中心区。

meaningZh: 他们的；他的或她的

examples.text: Theirs are blue.
examples.translationZh: 他们的是蓝色的。

examples.text: Our house adjoins theirs.
examples.translationZh: 我们的房屋与他们的毗连。

examples.text: It was his fault, not theirs.
examples.translationZh: 这是他的过错，不是他们的。

meaningZh: 医院；收容所；养老院

examples.text: When I left the hospital I was completely cured.
examples.translationZh: 出院时，我已经完全痊愈了。

examples.text: If you go to a private hospital you must pay.
examples.translationZh: 如果你去一家私立医院就诊，你得付费。

meaningZh: 乌龟；行动迟缓的人（或物）

examples.text: He bought two small tortoises for me.
examples.translationZh: 他给我买了两只小乌龟。

examples.text: Do you remember the story about race between the hare and the tortoise?
examples.translationZh: 你们还记得那个关于龟兔赛跑的故事么？

examples.text: The tortoise crept along at an agonizingly slow speed.
examples.translationZh: 乌龟以极其缓慢的速度爬行着。

meaningZh: 门；闸门；登机门

examples.text: There are soldiers on guard at the gate.
examples.translationZh: 大门口有士兵在守卫。

examples.text: The gate is too narrow for a car.
examples.translationZh: 大门太窄，汽车进不去。

examples.text: The carriage passed through the palace gate.
examples.translationZh: 马车进入了宫殿的大门。

meaningZh: 厘米，公分；=“centimeter”（美）

examples.text: Round each measurement to the nearest whole inch or centimetre.
examples.translationZh: 将每个测量数目四舍五入到最近的英寸或厘米整数。

meaningZh: 准备，预备；准备工作；配制品

examples.text: He didn't do any preparation for this exam, so he failed.
examples.translationZh: 他考试前没做任何准备，所以不及格。

examples.text: Preparations for the Queen's visit are almost complete.
examples.translationZh: 女王访问的筹备工作已基本就绪。

examples.text: The preparation for his cough included camphor.
examples.translationZh: 为医治他的咳嗽而调制的药中包括樟脑。

meaningZh: 诗人；空想家；古典芭蕾舞大师

examples.text: A great poet is a master melody.
examples.translationZh: 大诗人也是音律大师。

examples.text: It is written by an obscure young poet.
examples.translationZh: 这是一位不知名的年轻诗人写的。

examples.text: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
examples.translationZh: 诗人表达了他对所爱的女子火一般的激情。

meaningZh: 文化；[生物学]（微生物等的）培养；修养

examples.text: He has to learn the culture of bees.
examples.translationZh: 他得学养蜂。

examples.text: She has studied the cultures of Oriental countries.
examples.translationZh: 她研究过东方各国的文化。

examples.text: He is a man of little culture.
examples.translationZh: 他没多少文化修养。

meaningZh: 动机；动力；诱因

examples.text: Without direction and motivation, a person would not know what to do.
examples.translationZh: 一个人缺乏方向和动力就不知道该干些什么。

examples.text: The most intrinsic motivation for learning is the child's spontaneous interests.
examples.translationZh: 学习的最为内在的刺激是儿童自发的兴趣。

examples.text: They lack the motivation to study.
examples.translationZh: 他们缺乏学习的积极性。

meaningZh: 食堂；自助餐厅

examples.text: They had their lunch in a cafeteria.
examples.translationZh: 他们在一家自助餐厅吃了午饭。

examples.text: The cafeteria is on the basement level.
examples.translationZh: 自助餐厅在地下一层。

examples.text: I found him work in a cafeteria by chance.
examples.translationZh: 我偶然发现他在一家自助餐厅工作。

meaningZh: 战胜，克服；压倒，制服，…不堪；vt. 被（烟、感情等）熏[压]倒，使受不了

examples.text: I realized that there is no way I can overcome it.
examples.translationZh: 我意识到自己没有办法战胜它。

examples.text: There will be no difficulty in the world that they cannot overcome.
examples.translationZh: 世界上任何困难他们都可以克服。

examples.text: We can and must overcome our shortcomings.
examples.translationZh: 我们能够而且必须克服我们的缺点。

meaningZh: 鸭子，野鸭；鸭肉；（表示友好的称呼）乖乖

examples.text: The special today is pressed duck with walnuts.
examples.translationZh: 今天的特色菜是桃仁酥鸭。

examples.text: They visited a duck farm operated by the corporation.
examples.translationZh: 他们参观了这个公司办的养鸭场。

examples.text: You cannot teach an old duck new tricks.
examples.translationZh: 老鸭学不会新把戏。

meaningZh: 可笑的，荒谬的；荒唐的，愚蠢的；胡枝扯叶

examples.text: His social pretensions make him appear ridiculous.
examples.translationZh: 他冒充上流社会人士而出尽洋相。

examples.text: His aristocratic manners seemed ridiculous in this poor area.
examples.translationZh: 在这个贫穷的地区，他的贵族气派显得很可笑。

examples.text: I'll show you how to settle such ridiculous stuff.
examples.translationZh: 你瞧我怎样来对付这种无稽之谈。

meaningZh: 摩托车；机动车；vi. 骑摩托车

examples.text: His parents vetoed his plan to buy a motorcycle.
examples.translationZh: 他的父母反对他买摩托车的计划。

examples.text: My brother's rinky-dink motorcycle just fell apart.
examples.translationZh: 我兄弟那辆破摩托车已经解体了。

examples.text: The man on the motorcycle wore a helmet.
examples.translationZh: 骑摩托车的人戴了一顶头盔。

meaningZh: 家庭；家族；孩子

examples.text: There are five people in my family.
examples.translationZh: 我家里有五口人。

examples.text: He was born in a wealthy family.
examples.translationZh: 他出生在一个富裕的家庭。

examples.text: He had to work hard to support his family.
examples.translationZh: 他不得不努力工作来养家。

meaningZh: 办公室；办公楼；问询处

examples.text: He keeps his office neat and tidy.
examples.translationZh: 他保持办公室清洁整齐。

examples.text: The corridor opens into his office.
examples.translationZh: 这走廊通到他的办公室。

examples.text: He held this office for ten years.
examples.translationZh: 他担任这一职务有十年。

meaningZh: 数据库；资料库；信息库

examples.text: Can you set up a database?
examples.translationZh: 你能建一个数据库吗?

examples.text: This database is only accessible by the authorized manager.
examples.translationZh: 只有授权的管理员才可以访问此数据库。

examples.text: The database is updated monthly.
examples.translationZh: 数据库每月更新。

meaningZh: 出席；仪表；风度

examples.text: We shall be very glad to have your presence.
examples.translationZh: 你如能出席,我们将感到很高兴。

examples.text: She was so quiet that her presence was hardly noticed.
examples.translationZh: 她那么安静，几乎没有人注意到她在这里。

examples.text: He made believe not to be aware of my presence.
examples.translationZh: 他假装不知道我在那里。

meaningZh: 玻璃；玻璃制品；镜子

examples.text: I cut my hand on some broken glass.
examples.translationZh: 碎玻璃割伤了我的手。

examples.text: I ran up against a glass door and hurt my head.
examples.translationZh: 我撞到一扇玻璃门上，把头撞伤了。

examples.text: He put down his glass.
examples.translationZh: 他放下杯子。

meaningZh: 国家；州；状况，情况

examples.text: She wept to see him in such a state.
examples.translationZh: 她一见他那种情形簌簌泪下。

examples.text: The house has fallen into a state of neglect.
examples.translationZh: 这所房屋已处于荒废的状态。

examples.text: The head of state was deposed by the army.
examples.translationZh: 国家元首被军队废黜了。

meaningZh: 生长；增长；一茬植株

examples.text: Their growth rate is quite slow, but continuous.
examples.translationZh: 其增长速度是相当缓慢,但持续。

examples.text: We are entering a period of rapid population growth.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在进入人类快速增长的时期。

examples.text: Lack of demand will slow (down) our economic growth.
examples.translationZh: 市场需求低就要拖慢我们的经济增长速度。

meaningZh: 马达，发动机，[火箭]助推器；原动者，原动力；汽车

examples.text: At six o'clock the motor started up.
examples.translationZh: 6点钟时马达开动起来。

examples.text: If the battery is dead, the motor won't turn over.
examples.translationZh: 电池要是用完了，马达就转不起来了。

examples.text: We switched off the motor and started to drift (along).
examples.translationZh: 我们关闭发动机开始滑行。

meaningZh: [牌戏]分；分配；经营

examples.text: We did a deal with the management on overtime.
examples.translationZh: 在加班问题上我们与管理部门达成一项协议。

examples.text: After weeks of negotiating, they're finalizing the deal today.
examples.translationZh: 经过几周协商,他们今天会搞定交易。

examples.text: In addition to leaves, these animals eat a great deal of fruit.
examples.translationZh: 除了树叶之外,这些动物还吃大量的水果。

meaningZh: 窃贼；破门盗窃者；夜盗

examples.text: The governor pardoned the burglar.
examples.translationZh: 州长赦免了那个窃贼。

examples.text: Did a burglar break into your house last night?
examples.translationZh: 昨晚有个窃贼闯进你家吗？

meaningZh: 对人友好的，开朗的；出发的，外出的；即将离职的

examples.text: He is an outgoing and lively person.
examples.translationZh: 他是个性格开朗而又活泼的人。

examples.text: My twin brother is more outgoing than me.
examples.translationZh: 我的双胞胎兄弟比我更外向。

examples.text: I was totally affected by this outgoing girl.
examples.translationZh: 我被这个性格外向的女孩子深深感染了。

meaningZh: 信号，暗号；预兆，征象；动机

examples.text: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
examples.translationZh: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

examples.text: I corrected my watch by the time signal.
examples.translationZh: 我按报时信号校正我的表。

examples.text: I've called several times, but I keep getting a busy signal.
examples.translationZh: 我打了好几次了,可是一直是忙音。

meaningZh: 共产主义；共产主义制度

examples.text: Communism is based on Marxism.
examples.translationZh: 共产主义是以马克思主义为基础。

examples.text: Our ultimate aim is to realize communism.
examples.translationZh: 我们的最终目的是实现共产主义。

examples.text: Marx is the progenitor of Communism.
examples.translationZh: 马克思是共产主义的创始人。

meaningZh: 图书管理员；[计算机]库管理程序

examples.text: The librarian saved the rare books from the fire.
examples.translationZh: 这位图书管理员从火中救出了一些珍本书。

meaningZh: （人或车辆）行列，长队；辫子；vi. （人、车等）排队等候

examples.text: People had to stand in a queue for hours to buy a ticket.
examples.translationZh: 人们买票得排几小时的队。

examples.text: At the head of the queue was an old woman.
examples.translationZh: 在队列的前面有一个老妇人。

examples.text: It was quite easy to tell that this queue was false.
examples.translationZh: 很容易看出这个辫子是假的。

meaningZh: 女王；王后；杰出女性

examples.text: The queen consort has come together with the king.
examples.translationZh: 王后也随同国王前来。

examples.text: Mary, Queen of Scots, was put to death in1587.
examples.translationZh: 苏格兰王后玛丽于1587年被处死。

examples.text: They were bowing as the king and queen walking in.
examples.translationZh: 当国王和王后进来时他们屈膝致敬。

meaningZh: 译员；翻译者；翻译家

examples.text: The copyright in the work shall be enjoyed by the adaptor and translator.
examples.translationZh: 本作品的著作权应由改编者及翻译者共享有。

examples.text: To truly translate, the translator has to modify the writers original meaning and word order to design a new sentence.
examples.translationZh: 对真正的翻译来说，翻译者必须修饰作者的原意，改变词序，设计一个新句子。

meaningZh: 金子般的,金色的,贵如黄金的；珍贵的,幸运的

examples.text: The best archer would be awarded a golden arrow.
examples.translationZh: 最优秀的弓箭手将获得一只金箭。

examples.text: My parents are celebrating their golden jubilee.
examples.translationZh: 我父母正在庆祝他们的金婚纪念。

examples.text: Her hair has a beautiful golden sheen.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发有美丽的金色的光泽。

meaningZh: （表示方向）越过；（部份或全部覆盖）在…上面；由于

examples.text: The lamp hung over the table.
examples.translationZh: 那盏灯悬挂在桌子上方。

examples.text: He sprinkled sugar over his cereal.
examples.translationZh: 他在麦片粥里撒上了糖。

examples.text: He scattered his clothes all over the floor.
examples.translationZh: 他把衣服扔了一地。

meaningZh: 折叠；合拢；抱住

examples.text: Dark clouds folded the hills.
examples.translationZh: 乌云笼罩着群山。

examples.text: I folded the handkerchief and put it in my pocket.
examples.translationZh: 我折好手绢，放进口袋里。

examples.text: The paper should be folded in half.
examples.translationZh: 这张纸应该对折。

meaningZh: 分；一分钱的硬币；零钱

examples.text: I'm a hundred per cent certain.
examples.translationZh: 我百分之百地肯定。

examples.text: I don't have a cent with me.
examples.translationZh: 我身上一分钱也没有。

examples.text: The coins of the lowest denomination is the cent.
examples.translationZh: 钱币的最低单位是分。

meaningZh: 将来的，未来的；[语法学]将来时的；n. 前途

examples.text: Take no thought for your future needs.
examples.translationZh: 不必为将来的需要而操心。

examples.text: Do you really care nothing about your future?
examples.translationZh: 你真的一点也不关心你的将来？

examples.text: He felt at ease and confident about the future.
examples.translationZh: 他对未来感到轻松自在并且充满信心。

meaningZh: 微湿的，潮湿的；消沉的，沮丧的；沉闷的

examples.text: Damp wood doesn't burn well.
examples.translationZh: 潮湿的木头不好烧。

examples.text: The building was cold and damp.
examples.translationZh: 这房子又冷又湿。

examples.text: The cheese molded in the damp cellar.
examples.translationZh: 乳酪在潮湿的地下室中长了霉。

meaningZh: 引路；指导；操纵

examples.text: I know the place well, so let me be your guide.
examples.translationZh: 我熟悉那地方

examples.text: As a university graduate, I am seeking a job as a tourist guide.
examples.translationZh: 作为一名大学毕业生,我正在谋求一份当导游的工作。

examples.text: These philosophical views serve as a guide in life.
examples.translationZh: 这些哲学观点可以作为处世指南。

meaningZh: 个人的，私人的；身体的；亲自的

examples.text: I have something personal to discuss with you.
examples.translationZh: 我有点私事和你商量。

examples.text: I need your advice on a personal matter, but it's not about me.
examples.translationZh: 有一件私事我想听听你的建议,但不是我的事。

examples.text: It is my own, growing out of my personal concern.
examples.translationZh: 是我自己提出的,完全出于我个人的关切。

meaningZh: 美德；德行；价值

examples.text: Fidelity to engagement is a virtue.
examples.translationZh: 信守诺言是一种美德。

examples.text: My neighbor is a man of highest virtue.
examples.translationZh: 我的邻居是一个具有高尚品德的人。

examples.text: He said his plan had the virtue of being the easiest to implement.
examples.translationZh: 他说他的计划的优点是最简单易行。

meaningZh: 分歧，意见不合；异议，争论；不一致

examples.text: We are not blind to the reality of disagreement.
examples.translationZh: 我们不会忽视意见不合的事实。

examples.text: The recent disagreement points up the differences between the two sides.
examples.translationZh: 最近的争执清楚显示双方有分歧。

examples.text: He had a loud disagreement with his boss.
examples.translationZh: 他和老板大吵了一场。

meaningZh: 影响；势力；有影响的人（或事物）

examples.text: Don't let me influence your decision.
examples.translationZh: 不要让我影响你的决定。

examples.text: The labour enthusiasm of the workers strongly influenced us.
examples.translationZh: 工人们的劳动热情极大地感染了我们。

examples.text: He makes a nice drink for women by influencing orange juice.
examples.translationZh: 他在橘子汁里加了少量烈性酒即制成了适于女性的爽口饮料。

meaningZh: 建议，提议；暗示；使想起

examples.text: I suggested going for a walk.
examples.translationZh: 我建议去散步。

examples.text: I suggested to him that we should tackle the problem another way.
examples.translationZh: 我向他建议我们用另一种方式处理这个问题。

examples.text: He had the effrontery to suggest that she enjoyed being unhappy.
examples.translationZh: 他无耻地大胆暗示，她喜欢不幸。

meaningZh: 向后的；反向的；怯生生的

examples.text: He took a backward step and ran away.
examples.translationZh: 他向后退了一步,跑了。

examples.text: This part of the country is still backward.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的这个地区仍很落后。

examples.text: Although he is clever, he is backward in giving his views.
examples.translationZh: 他虽然很聪明，却不善发表他的意见。

meaningZh: 无味的；味道差的；乏味的

examples.text: The sauce was thin and tasteless.
examples.translationZh: 这酱汁淡而无味。

examples.text: He thinks the vegetable is a bit tasteless.
examples.translationZh: 他觉得蔬菜没有什么味道。

examples.text: It was tasteless of you to say that.
examples.translationZh: 你说那种话真是庸俗。

meaningZh: 粥；麦片粥；稀饭

examples.text: She spooned out bowls of porridge.
examples.translationZh: 她用匙舀出了几碗粥。

examples.text: The dog quickly lapped up all the porridge.
examples.translationZh: 狗不一会儿就把所有的粥都舐光了。

examples.text: I had a bowl of porridge for breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 我早餐吃了一碗麦片粥。

meaningZh: 清单，目录；倾斜；布边，布头

examples.text: We should get the samples on the list to check.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该索取目录上的样品来检验一下。

examples.text: She complained about the omission of her name from the list.
examples.translationZh: 她抱怨名单上遗漏了她的名字。

examples.text: He wrote down his name on the list.
examples.translationZh: 他将他的名字写在清单上。

meaningZh: 书桌，办公桌；服务台；部门

examples.text: There are three books on the desk.
examples.translationZh: 书桌上有三本书。

examples.text: The speaker had a sheaf of notes on the desk in front of him.
examples.translationZh: 演讲者在他面前的桌子上放着一叠笔记。

examples.text: He was rifling through her desk in a desperate search for the letter.
examples.translationZh: 他拼命在她的书桌里搜寻那封信。

meaningZh: 缺点，缺陷；过错，责任；[电]故障

examples.text: I like him despite his faults.
examples.translationZh: 虽然他有很多缺点，我仍然喜欢他。

examples.text: He has many faults, but vanity is not one of them.
examples.translationZh: 他有很多缺点，但并没有虚荣心。

examples.text: There is a fault in the electrical system.
examples.translationZh: 电路系统出了故障。

meaningZh: 年轻；青年，小伙子；初期，少年（青年）时期

examples.text: In his youth, he had shown great promise.
examples.translationZh: 他在青少年时代就显得很有出息。

examples.text: He mused over memories of his youth.
examples.translationZh: 他重温青年时期的往事。

examples.text: Youth glided past without our awareness.
examples.translationZh: 青春在我们不知不觉中逝去。

meaningZh: 混乱，紊乱；（天地未出现的）浑沌世界；〈古〉无底深渊

examples.text: The wintry weather has caused chaos on the roads.
examples.translationZh: 因风雪交加,道路上混乱不堪。

examples.text: After the failure of the electricity supplies, the city was in chaos.
examples.translationZh: 电力供应中断,城市陷于混乱之中。

examples.text: Without rules, people would live in a state of chaos.
examples.translationZh: 若无规则,人们将在混乱状态中生活。

meaningZh: 甚至；更加；即使

examples.text: A billiard-table must be perfectly even.
examples.translationZh: 台球桌必须十分平.

examples.text: He spoke lightly in even tones.
examples.translationZh: 他以平和的语调温和地讲话。

examples.text: Cars with license plates ending in even numbers must go in this way.
examples.translationZh: 牌照以偶数结尾的汽车必须走这条路。

meaningZh: 演讲；训斥，教训；vi. 作演讲

examples.text: She ran over her notes before giving the lecture.
examples.translationZh: 她讲课前把讲稿匆匆看了一遍。

examples.text: His lecture covered various aspects of language.
examples.translationZh: 他的讲课涉及到语言诸方面的问题。

examples.text: They could not follow the lecture.
examples.translationZh: 他们听不懂这次演讲。

meaningZh: 冲突；战斗；相互干扰

examples.text: Both sides suffered heavy casualties in the border armed conflict.
examples.translationZh: 在这次边界武装冲突中双方都遭到了重大伤亡。

examples.text: He was wounded in the conflict.
examples.translationZh: 他在战斗中负伤。

examples.text: This is an irreconcilable conflict.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个不可调和的矛盾。

meaningZh: 矛；枪；（某些植物的）嫩枝

examples.text: The fisher used a spear as his weapon.
examples.translationZh: 渔夫用矛作为武器。

examples.text: The hunter hurled his spear at the tiger.
examples.translationZh: 猎人用力把他的长矛向虎投去。

examples.text: The spear curved through the air.
examples.translationZh: 标枪在空中沿曲线运动。

meaningZh: 费；票价；乘客

examples.text: Let me go shares with you in the taxi fare.
examples.translationZh: 我和你分摊计程车费吧。

examples.text: She didn't have enough money for the bus fare.
examples.translationZh: 她的钱不够付车费。

examples.text: He didn't have enough money to pay his train fare.
examples.translationZh: 他没有足够的钱来付火车费。

meaningZh: 插入；嵌入；（在文章中）添加

examples.text: She inserted the key into the lock.
examples.translationZh: 她把钥匙插入锁中。

examples.text: You can insert additional pages into that book.
examples.translationZh: 你可以把附加的散页插入那本书里。

examples.text: The next procedure is to insert the battery.
examples.translationZh: 接下来的步骤是装进电池。

meaningZh: 过敏的；过敏症的；对…极讨厌的

examples.text: Ben is allergic to pollen.
examples.translationZh: 班对花粉过敏。

examples.text: I like cats but unfortunately I'm allergic to them.
examples.translationZh: 我很喜欢猫,但遗憾的是我对猫过敏。

examples.text: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
examples.translationZh: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

meaningZh: 操练；钻头；军事训练

examples.text: The dentist's drill made a lot of noise.
examples.translationZh: 牙钻发出很大的噪音。

examples.text: Jack used a drill to bore a hole in the wall above the fireplace.
examples.translationZh: 杰克用钻子在壁炉上方的墙上钻孔。

examples.text: Today's art lesson came to an abrupt end when the gongs sounded for a fire drill.
examples.translationZh: 今天的美术课因火灾演习的铃声大作而突然结束。

meaningZh: 稍微，有点；相当，颇；宁愿

examples.text: Poultry is rather cheap now.
examples.translationZh: 现在的禽肉相当便宜。

examples.text: I would rather stay at home.
examples.translationZh: 我宁可呆在家里。

examples.text: I would rather fail than cheat in the examination.
examples.translationZh: 我宁愿考不及格，也不愿意考试作弊。

meaningZh: 节日；节期；贺宴，会演

examples.text: We all wore festival costumes to the ball.
examples.translationZh: 我们都穿著节日的盛装去参加舞会。

examples.text: The carnival was immersed in a festival atmosphere.
examples.translationZh: 嘉年华沉浸在节日的气氛中。

examples.text: We all immersed in the gaiety of the Spring Festival.
examples.translationZh: 我们都沉浸在春节的欢乐之中。

meaningZh: 典型的；传统式样的；著名的

examples.text: "War and Peace"is a literary classic.
examples.translationZh: 《战争与和平》是一部经典文学著作。

examples.text: The idea of a classic is historically bound up with the view.
examples.translationZh: 从历史上来看，古典的想法和这个观点有着密切的联系。

examples.text: This is a really classic French champagne.
examples.translationZh: 这确实是上等的法国香槟酒。

meaningZh: 交通，运输量；（非法的）交易；通信量

examples.text: Traffic reaches a peak between 8 and 9 in the morning.
examples.translationZh: 早晨八九点钟是交通的高峰时刻。

examples.text: His left knee was hurt in a traffic accident.
examples.translationZh: 他的左膝在一次交通事故中受伤了。

examples.text: There's usually a lot of traffic at this time of day.
examples.translationZh: 每天在这段时间往来车辆都很多。

meaningZh: 沐浴；洗澡；浴缸，澡盆

examples.text: He takes a cold bath every day.
examples.translationZh: 他每天洗一个冷水澡。

examples.text: The idea came to him in his bath.
examples.translationZh: 他洗澡时想出了这个主意。

examples.text: I want a double room with a bath.
examples.translationZh: 我要一间有浴室的双人房。

meaningZh: 使兴奋；激发；刺激

examples.text: The good news excited everybody.
examples.translationZh: 这个好消息使每一个人都很兴奋。

examples.text: Nothing seemed to surprise or excite him.
examples.translationZh: 好像他对什么事情都不惊讶或兴奋似的。

examples.text: Don't excite him. He remembers nothing but his daughter.
examples.translationZh: 不能让他太激动,他现在只记得跟他女儿有关的事。

meaningZh: 为，为了；倾向于；关于

examples.text: A party was held for them.
examples.translationZh: 设宴招待他们。

examples.text: They jumped for joy.
examples.translationZh: 他们高兴地跳了起来。

examples.text: I am speaking for all the workers in this firm.
examples.translationZh: 我代表公司全体工作人员讲话。

meaningZh: 堆积，积累；vi. （数量）逐渐增加，（质量）渐渐提高

examples.text: They set out to accumulate a huge mass of data.
examples.translationZh: 他们开始积累大量的资料。

examples.text: Dust and dirt soon accumulates if a house is not cleaned regularly.
examples.translationZh: 房屋不经常打扫,尘土很快就越积越多。

examples.text: True poetry accumulates meaning every time it is read.
examples.translationZh: 真正好诗愈念涵义愈丰富。

meaningZh: 谋杀；杀戮；极艰难[令人沮丧]的经历

examples.text: He did a long stretch for attempted murder.
examples.translationZh: 他因谋杀未遂罪坐了很长时间的牢。

examples.text: The law arrived on the scene of murder.
examples.translationZh: 警察来到谋杀现场。

examples.text: There have been several murders this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年发生了好几起谋杀案。

meaningZh: 增加，增大，增多；vt. 增强，增进；[缝纫]放（针）

examples.text: We anticipate that demand is likely to increase.
examples.translationZh: 我们预料需求可能增加。

examples.text: Wide reading will increase your vocabulary.
examples.translationZh: 博览群书会增加你的词汇量。

examples.text: They have increased the price of petrol again.
examples.translationZh: 他们又提高了汽油的价格。

meaningZh: 陪伴，陪同；附加，补充；与…共存

examples.text: She asked me to accompany her to the airport.
examples.translationZh: 她要求我陪她到机场去。

examples.text: Lightning usually accompanies thunder.
examples.translationZh: 闪电通常伴有雷声。

examples.text: The text is accompanied by illustration.
examples.translationZh: 正文附有插图。

meaningZh: 物理学家；唯物论者；自然科学家

examples.text: The physicist fudged on his experimental data.
examples.translationZh: 那位物理学家捏造实验数据。

examples.text: He came to the fore as a physicist at an early age.
examples.translationZh: 他在早年就成了杰出的物理学家。

meaningZh: 底部；末端；臀部

examples.text: There are tea leaves in the bottom of my cup.
examples.translationZh: 我的杯底有茶叶。

examples.text: They sent the enemy ship to the bottom of the sea.
examples.translationZh: 他们把敌舰击沉。

examples.text: He was always bottom of the class in maths.
examples.translationZh: 他的数学成绩在班上总是垫底。

meaningZh: 联邦（制）的；同盟的；n. 联邦主义者

examples.text: Switzerland is a federal republic.
examples.translationZh: 瑞士是联邦制的共和国。

examples.text: Expenditures by the Federal Government have been steadily pared.
examples.translationZh: 联邦政府的开支正在逐渐削减。

meaningZh: 恐怖小说；使人毛骨悚然的东西；令人感到兴奋的事

examples.text: He is at an absorbing thriller and can't be disturbed.
examples.translationZh: 他正在阅读一部引人入胜的惊险小说，什么也惊动不了他。

examples.text: I always take a thriller to read on the train.
examples.translationZh: 我乘火车时，总带一本惊险小说看。

examples.text: This thriller portrays the exploits of a deranged serial killer.
examples.translationZh: 该部惊悚片描绘了一个疯狂的连环杀手的作案经过。

meaningZh: 窗，窗户；窗口；〈美俚〉眼镜

examples.text: The fresh air blew in from the open window.
examples.translationZh: 新鲜空气从开着的窗户吹进来。

examples.text: Snowflakes were patting against the window.
examples.translationZh: 雪花轻轻拍打着窗户。

examples.text: He looked out of the window.
examples.translationZh: 他向窗外看去。

meaningZh: 先前的；以前的；过早的

examples.text: His previous attempts had been unsuccessful.
examples.translationZh: 他以前的尝试没有成功。

examples.text: It happened previous to his arrival there.
examples.translationZh: 事件发生于他到那儿以前。

examples.text: You must collect enough materials previous to your writing.
examples.translationZh: 你在写作之前必须收集好足够的材料。

meaningZh: 以前；过去的；之前

examples.text: The dinosaurs disappeared long ago.
examples.translationZh: 恐龙很久以前就绝种了。

examples.text: A hundred years ago, Britain had a large empire.
examples.translationZh: 一百年以前，英国有一个很大的帝国。

meaningZh: 任何东西；（用于否定句、疑问句中以及 if 或 whether 和 prevent、ban、avoid 等动词后，代替 something）任何东西；重要东西

examples.text: If you remember anything at all, please let us know.
examples.translationZh: 你要是想起什么来，就告诉我们。

examples.text: The hotel was anything but satisfactory.
examples.translationZh: 这家旅馆太不让人满意了。

examples.text: Is there anything for me?
examples.translationZh: 有东西给我吗？

meaningZh: 永远；曾经，这以前；究竟，到底

examples.text: I don't think I ever met you.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得我没见过你。

examples.text: Have you ever been to Beijing?
examples.translationZh: 你去过北京吗?

examples.text: Nothing ever happens in this village.
examples.translationZh: 这村里从来没有发生过什么事情。

meaningZh: 后悔，悔恨；遗憾，抱歉；悼念，哀悼

examples.text: I now regret having made a promise that I would join in the scheme.
examples.translationZh: 我现在后悔答应参加该计划的事。

examples.text: We deeply regret that this big fire has taken away two young men's lives.
examples.translationZh: 这次大火夺走了两个年轻人的生命,我们为此感到深深的惋惜。

examples.text: We regret that we have to place the entire shipment at your disposal.
examples.translationZh: 很遗憾，我们只得将全部货品退回贵方自行处理。

meaningZh: 可获得的；有空的；可购得的

examples.text: Do you have a room available?
examples.translationZh: 你们有空房间吗？

examples.text: The swimming pool is available only in summer.
examples.translationZh: 这个游泳池只在夏天开放。

examples.text: All sorts of lamps are available in that shop.
examples.translationZh: 在那家商店可买到各式各样的灯具。

meaningZh: 篮；一篮；（篮球运动的）篮

examples.text: Several baskets of fruit were eaten at the party.
examples.translationZh: 宴会上，大家吃掉了好几篮水果。

examples.text: The little girl stared at the little cats tumbling over each other in their basket.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩凝视着在篮子里互相翻来滚去的小猫。

examples.text: Put the scraps of paper in the wastepaper basket.
examples.translationZh: 把纸屑丢进废纸篓。

meaningZh: 胃；腹部；食欲

examples.text: He had had too much to eat and his stomach started to kick up.
examples.translationZh: 他吃得太多了,胃不舒服。

examples.text: Anxiety may disorder the stomach.
examples.translationZh: 忧虑可能会引起胃部不适。

examples.text: The stomach revolts at such food.
examples.translationZh: 这样的食物倒胃囗。

meaningZh: 能力，资格；能耐，才能

examples.text: This is a task well within your ability.
examples.translationZh: 这完全是你力所能及的工作。

examples.text: She has the ability to keep calm in an emergency.
examples.translationZh: 她有处变不惊的本事。

examples.text: He is a man of great executive ability.
examples.translationZh: 他是个具有极高管理才能的人。

meaningZh: 骨头；尸骨；骨质物

examples.text: Scientists have dated the fossils by their bone structure.
examples.translationZh: 科学家根据那些化石的骨骼结构确定其年代。

examples.text: Surgeons have made a great breakthrough in the bone operation.
examples.translationZh: 外科医生们在骨骼手术方面取得了重大突破。

examples.text: He broke a bone in his leg.
examples.translationZh: 他摔断了一根腿骨。

meaningZh: 左边的，左侧的；左派的；n. 左，左面

examples.text: Do you always write left-handed?
examples.translationZh: 你一向用左手写字吗?

examples.text: He supports the left wing of the Labour Party.
examples.translationZh: 他支持工党中的左翼.

examples.text: As a result of a serious illness, she couldn't move her left leg.
examples.translationZh: 患重病后,她的左腿不能动了。

meaningZh: 纪念品；礼物；vt. 把…留作纪念

examples.text: Can you mail this souvenir to America for me?
examples.translationZh: 您能帮我把这件纪念品邮到美国吗?

examples.text: I bought this bag as a souvenir of my visit to London.
examples.translationZh: 我买了这个袋子作为访问伦敦的纪念品。

examples.text: My favorite souvenir is my key chain from China.
examples.translationZh: 我最喜欢的纪念品是在中国买的钥匙链。

meaningZh: 停留；停止；坚持

examples.text: I stayed late at the party last night.
examples.translationZh: 昨晚我在晚会上呆到很晚。

examples.text: You can stay at home and watch TV.
examples.translationZh: 你可以待在家里并且看电视。

examples.text: Why don't you come to stay with us next time you visit Durham?
examples.translationZh: 下次来达勒姆就住在我们这儿好吗?

meaningZh: 顶，顶部；（箱子）盖，（书页等的）上栏；首席

examples.text: The mountain tops are covered with snow.
examples.translationZh: 白雪覆盖着山顶。

examples.text: The staircase was short, and they were soon at the top.
examples.translationZh: 梯子是短的,他们一下子就到了顶上。

examples.text: The green book is at the bottom of the pile and the red one is on top.
examples.translationZh: 绿皮书在那一堆书的底下，红皮书在上边。

meaningZh: 任何的；一点，一些；普通的

examples.text: I can't stay any longer.
examples.translationZh: 我一刻也不能再呆下去了。

examples.text: I can't see things getting any better
examples.translationZh: 我看不出事情有丝毫好转

meaningZh: 垃圾箱；灰箱；尘箱

examples.text: Please put the garbage in the dustbin.
examples.translationZh: 请把垃圾放在桶里。

examples.text: She tipped the rubbish into a dustbin.
examples.translationZh: 她把垃圾倒进垃圾箱。

meaningZh: 灵活的；易弯曲的；柔韧的

examples.text: This tube is flexible but tough.
examples.translationZh: 这管子柔软但很坚固。

examples.text: We need a foreign policy that is more flexible.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要一个更为灵活的外交政策。

examples.text: People use Java because it is flexible and runs on multiple platforms.
examples.translationZh: 人们使用Java是因为它的灵活性及在多种平台上可以运行。

meaningZh: 完成；结束；吃光

examples.text: When do you finish your college course?
examples.translationZh: 你什么时候完成大学课程？

examples.text: She should finish with him he treats her very badly.
examples.translationZh: 她应该和他断绝关系－－他对她太不好了。

examples.text: I've finished with gambling it's a waste of money.
examples.translationZh: 我已经戒赌了－－赌博完全是浪费钱财。

meaningZh: 椭圆形的；卵形的；n. 椭圆形

examples.text: There are many oval stones at the bottom of the stream.
examples.translationZh: 在小河底上有许多卵形的石头。

examples.text: The mirror is oval.
examples.translationZh: 镜子是椭圆的。

examples.text: The path of the earth around the sun is oval.
examples.translationZh: 地球围绕太阳公转的轨道是椭圆形的。

meaningZh: 包括；包含；计入

examples.text: His writings include poetry and prose.
examples.translationZh: 他的作品包括诗和散文。

examples.text: The graphic arts include calligraphy and lithography.
examples.translationZh: 平面造型艺术包括书法和平版印刷术。

examples.text: Is service included in the bill?
examples.translationZh: 帐单中包含服务费吗？

meaningZh: 侍者；服务员；托盘

examples.text: A waiter of the Japanese restaurant bowed him in.
examples.translationZh: 那家日本餐馆的侍者鞠着躬将他迎了进去。

examples.text: It is customary to tip the waiter.
examples.translationZh: 给侍者小费是一种习俗。

examples.text: He sent the waiter for a packet of cigarettes.
examples.translationZh: 他让侍者去拿一盒香烟。

meaningZh: 席子，垫子；（体育运动用的）厚垫子；衬边

examples.text: There are some clods of soil on the mat.
examples.translationZh: 垫子上有些土块。

examples.text: He lifted the mat and slid the key under (it).
examples.translationZh: 他掀起垫子把钥匙悄悄放在下面。

examples.text: I wiped my shoes on the mat before I came in.
examples.translationZh: 我在进门前把鞋在垫子上擦了擦。

meaningZh: 奶奶；外婆；婆婆妈妈的人

examples.text: I can't believe, sometimes, that granny is dead. If I close my eyes I can just see her knitting away in that armchair as large as life, with her specs half-way down her nose.
examples.translationZh: 有时我真不相信祖母经去世。只要我闭上眼睛，就会看她活生生地坐在一把扶椅上，眼镜挂在鼻梁上，手里织着毛线衣。

examples.text: My granny has always been good to me.
examples.translationZh: 我外婆总是对我很好。

meaningZh: 刑罚，惩罚；严厉对待；给吃苦头

examples.text: He has received a just punishment.
examples.translationZh: 他已受到应得的惩罚。

examples.text: Punishment had very little effect on him.
examples.translationZh: 惩罚对他没有什么效果。

meaningZh: 号码，编号

examples.text: The sick man is no better.
examples.translationZh: 那病人一点也没有好转。

examples.text: You are very selfish sometimes.---No,I'm not.
examples.translationZh: 你有时很自私的。--不,我不自私。

examples.text: He has no money.
examples.translationZh: 他没有钱。

meaningZh: 首要的，主要的；最早的，原始的；[地质学]原生的

examples.text: The primary task for socialism is to develop the productive forces.
examples.translationZh: 社会主义的首要任务是发展社会生产力。

examples.text: Another primary reason is that there seems to be too many private cars and not enough public buses.
examples.translationZh: 另一个主要原因是私家车过多而公交车不够。

examples.text: The demand for primary products is on the increase in European market.
examples.translationZh: 欧洲市场对初级产品的需求在增长。

meaningZh: 宗教；支配自己生活的大事；教派

examples.text: He is a disciple of religion.
examples.translationZh: 他是宗教信徒。

examples.text: Jesus was the founder of the Christian religion.
examples.translationZh: 耶稣是基督教的创始人。

examples.text: Politics and religion are daily topics of conversation.
examples.translationZh: 政治和宗教是人们平常交谈的主要话题。

meaningZh: 胡同，小巷；小径；球道

examples.text: The thief slunk down the dark alley.
examples.translationZh: 那个贼偷偷钻进黑胡同里。

examples.text: Davies' house is down a long narrow alley.
examples.translationZh: 戴维斯的家在一条狭长的胡同里。

examples.text: The alley was strewn with garbage.
examples.translationZh: 垃圾散布于巷道上。

meaningZh: 肥皂；肥皂剧；[化]皂，脂肪酸盐

examples.text: The soap slipped out of my hand.
examples.translationZh: 肥皂从我手上滑落了。

examples.text: Tallow can be used for making soap.
examples.translationZh: 动物脂可以用来做香皂。

examples.text: I only caught the end of the soap opera.
examples.translationZh: 我只看到了肥皂剧的结尾。

meaningZh: 释义 应该；将会；可能

examples.text: You should take advantage of it.
examples.translationZh: 你应该好好利用这个机会。

examples.text: It should cost roughly 10.
examples.translationZh: 这大约10英镑。

examples.text: You should give it a try.
examples.translationZh: 你应该试一试。

meaningZh: 是；有，存在；做，成为

examples.text: It is necessary that he be sent there at once.
examples.translationZh: 有必要马上派他到那里去。

examples.text: There will be rain in all parts of the country.
examples.translationZh: 全国各地将有雨。

examples.text: A successful businessman must be aggressive.
examples.translationZh: 一个成功的商人必须有进取心。

meaningZh: 程序，手续；工序，过程，步骤；诉讼程序，（议会的）议事程序

examples.text: These procedures are highly irregular.
examples.translationZh: 这些程序是很不合乎规则的。

examples.text: What's the procedure for opening a savings account?
examples.translationZh: 开一个储蓄帐户有什么手续?

examples.text: The next procedure is to insert the battery.
examples.translationZh: 接下来的步骤是装进电池。

meaningZh: 擦，刮；擦痛，擦伤；在…处搔痒

examples.text: The dog is scratching at the door.
examples.translationZh: 狗正在抓门。

examples.text: He pretended to scratch his ear.
examples.translationZh: 他假装搔耳朵。

examples.text: I had to scratch my head to remember his name.
examples.translationZh: 我只想苦苦地回忆他的名字。

meaningZh: 汇票；草稿；选派

examples.text: He drew a draft of the car.
examples.translationZh: 他画了一张汽车的草图。

examples.text: He has drawn up the design draft.
examples.translationZh: 他拟订了设计草图。

examples.text: He drew a draft on a pad then began his formal work.
examples.translationZh: 他在便笺簿上画了草图，然后就开始正式工作了。

meaningZh: 贵重的，宝贵的；有价值的；可评估的

examples.text: This old table is a valuable piece of furniture.
examples.translationZh: 这张旧桌子是一件很珍贵的家具。

examples.text: This painting is very valuable.
examples.translationZh: 这幅绘画非常名贵。

examples.text: He gave us a valuable insight into the problems of education.
examples.translationZh: 他在教育问题上给我们提供了宝贵的见解。

meaningZh: 真正；精确地，正确地；忠实的，诚实地

examples.text: The performance truly exalted the audience.
examples.translationZh: 演出确使观众情绪高昂。

examples.text: She didn't let anyone know what she truly felt.
examples.translationZh: 她不让别人知道她的真实感情。

examples.text: The birth of a baby is truly a blessed event.
examples.translationZh: 生个孩子真是喜事。

meaningZh: 蜜蜂

examples.text: A bee pricks the skin with its sting.
examples.translationZh: 蜜蜂用螫针刺皮肤。

examples.text: He can hear the hum of the bee in the garden.
examples.translationZh: 他听得见花园里蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。

meaningZh: 极好的；华丽的；丰盛的，豪华的

examples.text: The sports facilities are superb in this city.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市的运动设施是一流的。

examples.text: The goalkeeper brought off a superb save.
examples.translationZh: 守门员漂亮地救出了险球。

examples.text: Ideas will come to you easily and some will prove to be superb.
examples.translationZh: 你总很容易就能想到好计划，其中一些将得到极好的证实。

meaningZh: 巧克力；巧克力糖；巧克力色

examples.text: Never eat chocolate before dinner.
examples.translationZh: 饭前不要吃巧克力。

examples.text: Would you like a cup of chocolate?
examples.translationZh: 你想要杯巧克力饮料吗？

examples.text: The boy spent 10 pennies on chocolate.
examples.translationZh: 这男孩花了10便士买巧克力糖。

meaningZh: 死去的；完全的；无感觉的

examples.text: It lay there with its eyes closed, dead as a doornail.
examples.translationZh: 它躺在那里眼睛闭著，确实死了。

examples.text: He has been dead for two years.
examples.translationZh: 他已死了两年。

examples.text: The phone went dead.
examples.translationZh: 电话打不通了。

meaningZh: 下午

examples.text: The meeting ended at 4 p.m.
examples.translationZh: 会议于下午4点结束。
examples.author: Martha

meaningZh: 记忆，记忆力；回忆，往事；[计]存储器，内存

examples.text: He has a good visual memory.
examples.translationZh: 他有良好的视觉记忆力。

examples.text: She is always moaning about her bad memory.
examples.translationZh: 她总是抱怨自己的记性不好。

examples.text: His best music was inspired by the memory of his mother.
examples.translationZh: 他最好的乐曲创作灵感来自怀念他的母亲。

meaningZh: 气球；热气球；[建]球饰

examples.text: A balloon floated across the sky.
examples.translationZh: 有个气球从空中飘过。

examples.text: He balloons his cheeks when he is hesitant.
examples.translationZh: 他迟疑不决时会鼓起双颊。

examples.text: He tried to balloon around the earth but storms forced him to land in China.
examples.translationZh: 他试图乘气球做环球旅行，但风暴迫使他降落在中国。

meaningZh: 忘记，忘却；忽略，疏忽；遗落

examples.text: I'm sorry; I've forgotten your name.
examples.translationZh: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。

examples.text: I almost forget to pay the phone bill.
examples.translationZh: 我几乎忘记电话费用。

examples.text: We must not forget about the grass roots.
examples.translationZh: 我们绝不能忘记民众。

meaningZh: 自私的，利己的

examples.text: A selfish person always thinks about himself.
examples.translationZh: 一个自私的人总是想着自己。

examples.text: I am becoming more and more irritated by his selfish behaviour.
examples.translationZh: 我对他那种自私的行为愈加恼火起来。

examples.text: I call his behaviour mean and selfish.
examples.translationZh: 我认为他的行为卑鄙、 自私。

meaningZh: 脸颊，脸蛋；无礼而放肆的行为，厚颜；半边屁股

examples.text: A bullet grazed his cheek.
examples.translationZh: 子弹擦伤了他的面颊。

examples.text: She has a tiny mole on her cheek.
examples.translationZh: 她面颊上有一颗小痣。

examples.text: Philip stroked the baby's little cheek.
examples.translationZh: 菲利浦摸着那婴儿的小脸蛋。

meaningZh: 口袋，钱袋；金钱，财富；容器

examples.text: He took a book out of his pocket.
examples.translationZh: 他从口袋里拿出一本书。

examples.text: You will find information about safety procedures in the pocket in front of you.
examples.translationZh: 在您座位前方的袋子里有安全措施须知。

examples.text: Hit the ball into one of the side pockets.
examples.translationZh: 把球打进其中一个侧边袋。

meaningZh: （使）轻松；（使）松弛；放宽

examples.text: I just want to sit down and relax.
examples.translationZh: 我只想坐下休息会。

examples.text: I felt my shoulders relax a little.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得我的肩膀放松了好多。

examples.text: His muscles relaxed.
examples.translationZh: 他的肌肉松弛了。

meaningZh: 蚂蚁

examples.text: Afterwards I allowed an ant to visit them.
examples.translationZh: 我于是让一只蚂蚁去接近它们。

examples.text: A dove heard the ant and flew over to help.
examples.translationZh: 一只鸽子听到蚂蚁的呼救声就飞过去救它。

examples.text: An ant will sacrifice himself for his friends.
examples.translationZh: 每只蚂蚁都愿意为了朋友牺牲自己.

meaningZh: 对，双；配偶，夫妻；几个，两三个

examples.text: They are a nice couple.
examples.translationZh: 他们是很美满的一对。

examples.text: The couple seemed to be on cloud nine.
examples.translationZh: 那对夫妇看上去极其幸福。

examples.text: Next door to us there's a couple from the USA.
examples.translationZh: 我们隔壁住著来自美国的一对夫妇。

meaningZh: 泥泞的；暗的；模糊的

examples.text: It's muddy underfoot.
examples.translationZh: 地上很泥泞。

examples.text: The country roads were muddy and full of furrows left by farm carts.
examples.translationZh: 乡间道路泥泞不堪，布满了牛车压出的车辙。

examples.text: The police dredged up the parcel from the muddy river.
examples.translationZh: 警方从浑浊的河水中捞出包裹。

meaningZh: 恶习；不道德行为；（肉体的）缺陷，疾病

examples.text: He who thinks too much of his virtues reminds others of his vice.
examples.translationZh: 念念不忘自己长处的人,会使别人想起他的缺点。

examples.text: The vice of drinking is increasing.
examples.translationZh: 酗酒之风正在增长。

examples.text: Virtue and vice are two different things: the former leads to peace, the latter to misery.
examples.translationZh: 美德与邪恶是不同的：前者带来和平,后者导致痛苦。

meaningZh: 提供，供给，供应；vt. 规定；提供(+for)

examples.text: Sheep provide us with wool.
examples.translationZh: 羊供给我们羊毛。

examples.text: The hotel provides a reservation of tickets for its residents.
examples.translationZh: 这家旅馆为旅客提供订票服务。

examples.text: We have to provide for possible accidents.
examples.translationZh: 我们要为可能发生的意外作些准备。

meaningZh: （使）窘迫，（使）局促不安；（使）困难

examples.text: She dragged up that incident just to embarrass me.
examples.translationZh: 她又扯起那件事故意想使我难堪。

examples.text: He was embarrassed by many debts.
examples.translationZh: 他被很多债务弄得焦灼不安。

examples.text: She may embarrass you with her uncouth behavior.
examples.translationZh: 她的粗野行为可能会让你尴尬。

meaningZh: 令人敬畏的；使人畏惧的；可怕的

examples.text: An awesome thunderstorm struck the city yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 昨天,一场可怕的暴风雨侵袭了这个城市。

examples.text: The archaeologist stood in awesome silence before the ancient ruins.
examples.translationZh: 那名考古学家在古代遗址前充满敬畏地默立着。

meaningZh: 社会；上流社会；社团

examples.text: This event had a pernicious influence on society.
examples.translationZh: 这件事情对社会造成了有害的影响。

examples.text: The whole fabric of the society was changed by the war.
examples.translationZh: 战争改变了整个社会结构。

examples.text: Credit is the life-blood of the consumer society.
examples.translationZh: 信誉是消费界的生命线。

meaningZh: 灾难；彻底的失败；不幸

examples.text: They had led the country into economic disaster.
examples.translationZh: 他们把国家带入了经济灾难中。

examples.text: The disaster caused him to waver in his faith.
examples.translationZh: 这件灾难使他对信仰发生了动摇。

examples.text: He spoke darkly of possible future disaster.
examples.translationZh: 他悲观地说将来可能大难临头。

meaningZh: 禁止；阻止；阻碍

examples.text: Smoking is forbidden in this office.
examples.translationZh: 这间办公室禁止吸烟。

examples.text: I forbid you to call me late at night.
examples.translationZh: 我禁止你在深夜给我打电话。

examples.text: Lack of time forbids any further discussion at the point.
examples.translationZh: 由于时间不够，现在不能深入讨论这个问题。

meaningZh: 分裂；分开；（迅速）离开

examples.text: The party split into petty factions.
examples.translationZh: 该党分裂成若干小派系。

examples.text: The vote split the Labour Party.
examples.translationZh: 那场选举使工党分裂了。

examples.text: She split the class into groups of four.
examples.translationZh: 她按四人一组把全班分成若干小组。

meaningZh: 许可进入；承认，供认；vt. 允许

examples.text: He made a terrible mistake, but he refused to admit it.
examples.translationZh: 他犯了一个严重的错误,可是他拒不承认。

examples.text: We have to admit that there is still room for improvement.
examples.translationZh: 我们不得不承认,在这方面有尚待改进的地方。

examples.text: Each ticket admits two people to the party.
examples.translationZh: 每张票可供两人入场参加聚会。

meaningZh: 一星期，周；工作周（一个星期中的工作时间）

examples.text: The alterations to your coat will take a week.
examples.translationZh: 你的外衣改一改要花一个星期。

examples.text: The boys have decided to go camping next week.
examples.translationZh: 男孩子们已决定下个星期去露营。

examples.text: I got a new coat in that store last week.
examples.translationZh: 上礼拜我在那家店买了一件新外套。

meaningZh: 宏大的，宏伟的；（最）重要的；豪华的

examples.text: This is a grand occasion.
examples.translationZh: 这是个盛大的场面。

examples.text: He was born in the purple and was brought up in the grand palace.
examples.translationZh: 他出身于皇族,在宏伟的宫殿中长大。

examples.text: How grand the mountains look in the early evening!
examples.translationZh: 暮色中群山是多么壮丽！

meaningZh: 坚持；强调；坚决要求

examples.text: He insisted that he had done right.
examples.translationZh: 他坚决认为自己做对了。

examples.text: They insist that I stay there for supper.
examples.translationZh: 他们坚决要求让我留下吃晚饭。

examples.text: Since you insist, I must amend the letter of credit.
examples.translationZh: 既然你坚持，我就只好修改信用证。

meaningZh: 演变；进化；发展

examples.text: Charles Darwin and Alfred Russell Wallace discovered evolution independently.
examples.translationZh: 查尔斯·达尔文和阿尔弗雷德· 罗素·华莱士各自独立地发现了进化论。

examples.text: Within 30 years,humans could be debating whether to take charge of their own evolution.
examples.translationZh: 不出30年，人类将讨论是否要掌控自身的进化。

examples.text: Our watchword is: ‘Evolution, not revolution’.
examples.translationZh: 我们的口号是: ‘要循序渐进,不要剧烈变革’。

meaningZh: 法院，法庭；院子，天井；宫廷

examples.text: Sherman recommended that Clarke be disciplined, but higher-ups rejected the idea.
examples.translationZh: 谢尔曼建议对克拉克进行纪律惩戒，但高层拒绝了这个意见。

examples.text: My court is deserted but I do not care.
examples.translationZh: 我的庭院一片荒芜但是我无心照看。

examples.text: The court of King Solomon was noted for its splendor.
examples.translationZh: 所罗门国王的宫廷以其华丽著称。

meaningZh: 这，这个；这事，这人；这时

examples.text: This is, in part, my own mistake.
examples.translationZh: 在某种程度上来说,这是我自己的错。

examples.text: Now don't laugh when you hear this.
examples.translationZh: 听了这个你不要笑。

examples.text: It's about this high.
examples.translationZh: 大约有这样高。

meaningZh: 青蛙；〈侮辱〉青蛙佬，对法国人的蔑称；[交]铁路辙叉

examples.text: The witch changed the prince into a frog.
examples.translationZh: 巫婆把王子变成了青蛙。

examples.text: We call the breast-stroke the frog style.
examples.translationZh: 我们称蛙泳为蛙式。

examples.text: He sang with a frog in his throat.
examples.translationZh: 他用略带沙哑的嗓音唱歌。

meaningZh: 刷子，画笔；灌木丛；小冲突

examples.text: He painted the wall with a brush.
examples.translationZh: 他用刷子涂墙。

examples.text: The painter swept a brush over his canvas.
examples.translationZh: 画家的画笔在画布上飞掠。

examples.text: I'll give my coat a good brush.
examples.translationZh: 我要把我的衣服好好刷一下。

meaningZh: 爆发；喷发；突然发生

examples.text: Violence has erupted on the streets.
examples.translationZh: 大街上突然发生了暴乱。

examples.text: The demonstration erupted into violence.
examples.translationZh: 示威游行中突然出现了武斗。

examples.text: An active volcano may erupt at any time.
