examples.translationZh: 活火山随时可能喷发。

meaningZh: 理发师；剃具，刮刀，剃刀；〈古〉骗子，掠夺者

examples.text: I want to buy an electric shaver.
examples.translationZh: 我想买把电动剃须刀。

examples.text: Please fetch me the electric shaver from the room upstairs.
examples.translationZh: 请帮我把楼上房间里的电动剃须刀拿来。

examples.text: You cheeky young shaver!
examples.translationZh: 你这个毛头小伙子！

meaningZh: 发出隆隆声；快速发展；暴涨

examples.text: It's a boom year this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年是繁荣昌盛的一年。

examples.text: He made his pile during the property boom.
examples.translationZh: 在房地产生意兴隆期间他发了大财。

examples.text: The oil market is enjoying a boom.
examples.translationZh: 石油市场欣欣向荣。

meaningZh: 日常的，平常的；普通的；每天的

examples.text: Using the tips below, you can make thankfulness an everyday habit.
examples.translationZh: 看一看以下的建议吧，你会把感恩变成日常的习惯。

examples.text: Slowly insidiously the fog of the everyday has returned to enshroud me.
examples.translationZh: 慢慢地，不知不觉地，日常的迷雾又回来笼罩了我。

examples.text: In a bizarre profession anything which belongs to an everyday routine gains great values.
examples.translationZh: 从事不寻常职业的人，日常生活中任何一件极平常的事物对他都具有不平凡的价值。

meaningZh: 愚人，傻瓜；受骗者；有癖好的人

examples.text: What a fool I was to believe he is a good man.
examples.translationZh: 我竟然相信他是个好人，我真是个傻瓜。

examples.text: I am a fool to have refused the job.
examples.translationZh: 我真傻,拒绝了那项工作。

examples.text: He played the fool to entertain the king in that opera.
examples.translationZh: 在那部歌剧中他扮演小丑来逗国王开心。

meaningZh: 微笑，笑容；vt. 以微笑表示；以微笑完成

examples.text: A smile often denotes pleasure and friendship.
examples.translationZh: 微笑常常表示高兴和友善。

examples.text: Her smile makes her even more beautiful.
examples.translationZh: 她的微笑使她更美丽了。

examples.text: The most poor person in the world is the one without smile!
examples.translationZh: 世界上最贫穷的人,就是没有笑容的人!

meaningZh: 擦，拭；擦去，消除；涂上

examples.text: She wiped her tears away.
examples.translationZh: 她擦掉了眼泪。

examples.text: I wiped my shoes on the mat before I came in.
examples.translationZh: 我在进门前把鞋在垫子上擦了擦。

examples.text: When you have washed the car , wipe it down well .
examples.translationZh: 你把汽车冲洗过后，要好好用布揩拭一下。

meaningZh: 鱼苗，鱼秧；弗赖伊（姓氏）；油炸食物

examples.text: The eggs are frying in the pan.
examples.translationZh: 鸡蛋正在平底锅里煎着。

examples.text: We cut it into thin slices and fry it.
examples.translationZh: 我们把它切成薄片并用油煎。

examples.text: Shall I fry the fish for dinner?
examples.translationZh: 晚饭要不要我炸鱼？

meaningZh: 乡村；郊野；乡下的全体居民

examples.text: They lived a tranquil life in the countryside.
examples.translationZh: 他们在乡下过着宁静的生活。

examples.text: I feel healthier after a visit to the countryside.
examples.translationZh: 到乡下走了一趟后我觉得身体更健康。

examples.text: Modern agriculture is spoiling our beautiful countryside.
examples.translationZh: 现代农业正在破坏我们美丽的农村。

meaningZh: 生的，未加工的；无经验的；新近完成的

examples.text: We imported raw rubber from Malaysia.
examples.translationZh: 我们从马来西亚进口生胶。

examples.text: Do you want your vegetables cooked or raw?
examples.translationZh: 你要把蔬菜煮熟还是生吃？

examples.text: The factory is in frequent scarcity of raw materials.
examples.translationZh: 这个工厂经常原料不足。

meaningZh: 开始；着手；创始

examples.text: The meeting will begin at nine.
examples.translationZh: 会议将在九点开始。

examples.text: I have to begin with an apology.
examples.translationZh: 我得首先表示歉意。

examples.text: When did you begin learning English?
examples.translationZh: 你何时开始学习英语的？

meaningZh: 债务；负债情况；义务

examples.text: He promised to pay his debt within a month.
examples.translationZh: 他保证在1个月内偿还债务。

examples.text: If I pay all my debts I'll have no money.
examples.translationZh: 我若还请所有欠债就分文不剩了。

examples.text: We owe you a debt of gratitude for you help.
examples.translationZh: 承蒙帮助，感恩不尽。

meaningZh: 正义; 公正,合理；法律制裁; 司法; 审判；法官

examples.text: I won't dispute the justice of his remarks.
examples.translationZh: 我不怀疑他的话是公平合理的。

examples.text: Marriage is, first of all, a contract which must be governed by justice.
examples.translationZh: 婚姻首先是一种契约，它必须以公正为制约。

examples.text: Justice triumphs in the end.
examples.translationZh: 正义终将得胜。

meaningZh: 爷爷，外公，老太爷

examples.text: Grandpa and grandma sat in the back of the car.
examples.translationZh: 爷爷和奶奶坐在汽车後排的座位上。

examples.text: Grandpa still walks without a stick.
examples.translationZh: 爷爷走路仍不拄拐杖。

examples.text: Her grandpa is an expert in finance.
examples.translationZh: 她外公是个财务专家。

meaningZh: 在（船、飞机、车）上，上（船、飞机、车）；上车；adv. 在船（或飞机、车）上，上船（或飞机、车）

examples.text: Little Tom and the sailors spent two months aboard.
examples.translationZh: 小汤姆和水手们在船上过了两个月。

examples.text: All passengers aboard fell into the river.
examples.translationZh: 船上所有乘客皆落入河中。

examples.text: A limited menu is available aboard the train, but a nice bottle of vin rouge and a simple picnic hamper will enhance your Orient-Express fantasy.
examples.translationZh: 在火车上提供的食物很有限，自备一瓶上好法国红葡萄酒和一份简单的野餐食盒，将会提升你东方快车之旅的乐趣。

meaningZh: 雪茄；叶卷烟

examples.text: He exhaled a billow of cigar smoke.
examples.translationZh: 他吐出一股雪茄烟。

examples.text: Your cigar tinctures the room with an awful smell.
examples.translationZh: 你吸雪茄烟弄得满屋子都是臭味。

meaningZh: 连接，联结；使…有联系；为…接通电话

examples.text: The plumber connected up all the pipes and turned on the tap.
examples.translationZh: 管子工连接上所有管子，然后打开了水龙头。

examples.text: These terminals are connected to our mainframe computer.
examples.translationZh: 这些终端设备都和我们的计算机主机相连。

examples.text: Has the phone been connected yet?
examples.translationZh: 电话接通了吗？

meaningZh: 难看的；丑陋的；有敌意的

examples.text: Toads have an ugly appearance but they are useful.
examples.translationZh: 蟾蜍外表丑陋，但很有用。

examples.text: You can't persuade me to buy this ugly vase!
examples.translationZh: 你不能劝服我买这个丑陋的花瓶！

examples.text: His face was covered in ugly red blotches.
examples.translationZh: 他脸上有许多难看的红色大斑点。

meaningZh: 商业，交易；生意；事务，业务

examples.text: He had no head for business.
examples.translationZh: 他毫无商业头脑。

examples.text: He was inexperienced in business.
examples.translationZh: 他在商业方面缺乏经验。

examples.text: It's none of my business.
examples.translationZh: 这不关我的事。

meaningZh: 阅读；宣读；读物

examples.text: He spent all his time reading.
examples.translationZh: 他把全部时间都花在阅读上。

examples.text: I have benefited a lot from extensive reading.
examples.translationZh: 广泛的阅读使我受益匪浅。

examples.text: That book is not healthy reading for a child.
examples.translationZh: 对孩子来说那书不是本健康读物。

meaningZh: 功能，作用；应变量，函数；职务

examples.text: What is his function on the committee?
examples.translationZh: 他在委员会里担任什么职务?

examples.text: The teacher did not explain its grammatical function.
examples.translationZh: 老师没有解释它的文法功能。

examples.text: The function of the ear is to listen.
examples.translationZh: 耳的功能是听。

meaningZh: 西南，西南方；西南部；adv. 向西南

examples.text: Wales is in the southwest of the British Island.
examples.translationZh: 威尔士在大不列颠岛的西南部。

examples.text: Plentiful rainfall is expected in Southwest China.
examples.translationZh: 中国西南地区会出现明显降水。

examples.text: Tainan is situated in the southwest part of Taiwan not far from Kaohsiung.
examples.translationZh: 台南位于台湾的西南方，在离高雄不远处。

meaningZh: 伸展，扩大；延长，延期；[医]牵引

examples.text: This cord is not long enough! do you have an extension?
examples.translationZh: 这条绳子不够长！你有长一点的吗？

examples.text: His leg was now capable of full extension.
examples.translationZh: 他的腿现在能够伸展自如了。

examples.text: He asked for an extension of his visa.
examples.translationZh: 他申请延长签证有效期。

meaningZh: 扶手椅；adj. 脱离实际的；安逸的

examples.text: This armchair is made of bamboo.
examples.translationZh: 这个扶手椅是用竹子做成的。

examples.text: He ensconced himself in a armchair.
examples.translationZh: 他安坐在扶手椅上。

examples.text: He got up slowly from the armchair.
examples.translationZh: 他慢慢从单人沙发上站起身来。

meaningZh: 阳台；（电影院等的）楼厅，楼座；包厢

examples.text: The prospect from the balcony was breathtaking.
examples.translationZh: 从阳台上看去景色美极了。

examples.text: He planted some flowers on the balcony that projects over the street.
examples.translationZh: 他在那个伸出到街上的阳台上种了些花。

examples.text: He was watching a performance from the balcony.
examples.translationZh: 他正在从楼厅上看电影。

meaningZh: 弱点，缺点；软弱，优柔寡断；弱，衰弱，虚弱

examples.text: Don't take his patience as a sign of weakness.
examples.translationZh: 别把他的耐心看作软弱的表示。

examples.text: She thoroughly despised him for his weakness.
examples.translationZh: 她因为他的软弱而十分鄙视他。

examples.text: Forehand return is my greatest weakness.
examples.translationZh: 正手回球是我最大的弱点。

meaningZh: 犹豫，踌躇；不愿；支吾

examples.text: Do not hesitate to tell us if you have a problem .
examples.translationZh: 你有问题就直截了当地告诉我们。

examples.text: I would hesitate to get involved in this adventure.
examples.translationZh: 我犹豫是否参加这次探险。

examples.text: She hesitated to hurt the child's feelings.
examples.translationZh: 她不想伤害孩子的感情。

meaningZh: 时刻表，进度表；清单，明细表；预定计划

examples.text: I'll work out the schedule.
examples.translationZh: 我来拟定时间表。

examples.text: Please show me the taxation schedule.
examples.translationZh: 请让我看看税收一览表。

examples.text: Owing to various delays en route, we arrived two days behind schedule.
examples.translationZh: 由于路上的种种耽搁, 我们比原计划迟到了两天。

meaningZh: 终于，最后；竟；总归

examples.text: It was a long journey, but we eventually arrived.
examples.translationZh: 旅程很长，但我们最后还是到达了。

examples.text: He struggled with his assailants and eventually drove them off.
examples.translationZh: 他同攻击他的人进行搏斗，最后把他们赶走了。

examples.text: She eventually got back the book she had lent him.
examples.translationZh: 她终于收回了借给他的书。

meaningZh: 交易；市集；需求

examples.text: The market is rather depressed at the moment.
examples.translationZh: 目前的市场相当萧条。

examples.text: The sales manager wants to open up new markets in the Far East.
examples.translationZh: 销售经理想在远东开辟新市场。

examples.text: I bought a coconut in the market.
examples.translationZh: 我在集市上买了一个椰子。

meaningZh: 计划；打算；平面图

examples.text: As far as I am concerned, I'm not against your plan.
examples.translationZh: 就我而言，我并不反对你的计划。

examples.text: Then a courageous police officer came up with a daring, desperate plan.
examples.translationZh: 然后,一位勇敢的警官孤注一掷想出了一个大胆的方法。

examples.text: The police worked out a plan to catch the thief.
examples.translationZh: 警察制定出了策略捉贼。

meaningZh: 依靠；依赖；信赖

examples.text: Children depend on their parents for food and clothing.
examples.translationZh: 小孩依赖他们的父母供给衣食。

examples.text: He is a man whom you can depend on.
examples.translationZh: 他是个你可以信赖的人。

examples.text: The country depends heavily on its tourist trade.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的经济在很大程度上依靠其旅游业。

meaningZh: 全部课程，课程

examples.text: Our curriculum comprises Politics, Chinese, English and History.
examples.translationZh: 我们的课程共有四门：政治、汉语、英语、历史。

examples.text: Our mathematics curriculum is much more complicated now.
examples.translationZh: 我们的数学课现在复杂得多了。

meaningZh: 突然的，意外的；无理的，唐突的；不连贯的

examples.text: The river takes an abrupt bend to the west.
examples.translationZh: 这河突然向西转弯。

examples.text: His speech comes to an abrupt stop.
examples.translationZh: 他的演讲突然停止了。

examples.text: That young man has an abrupt manner.
examples.translationZh: 那个年轻人态度很无礼。

meaningZh: 胡萝卜；〈非正式〉好处，回报；不能兑现的报酬

examples.text: Have some more carrot.
examples.translationZh: 再吃点胡萝卜。

examples.text: The dish of boiled beef and carrot tastes good.
examples.translationZh: 那道清炖牛肉胡萝卜的菜味道不错。

examples.text: You should eat such vegetables as carrot, celery and spinach.
examples.translationZh: 你应该吃胡萝卜、芹菜和菠菜这类的蔬菜。

meaningZh: 的确，确实，实在；实际上，真正地；真的，真是

examples.text: I was very glad indeed to hear the news.
examples.translationZh: 我听到这消息的确非常高兴。

examples.text: He is a great man indeed.
examples.translationZh: 他实在是一个伟人。

examples.text: Indeed he has a solemn face, but he is very humorous at heart.
examples.translationZh: 他的确有一副严肃的脸孔，但内心却是很富幽默感。

meaningZh: （尤指小说中的）宇宙飞船

examples.text: The computer decelerated the spaceship.
examples.translationZh: 计算机使宇宙飞船减速。

examples.text: Spaceship make it possible to travel to the moon.
examples.translationZh: 宇宙飞船使去月球旅行成为可能。

meaningZh: 踝，踝关节；脚脖子

examples.text: The doctor has taped up my swollen ankle.
examples.translationZh: 医生用绷带把我肿起的脚踝包扎起来。

examples.text: She stepped on a loose stone and twisted her ankle.
examples.translationZh: 她踩到一块松动的石头上，扭伤了脚踝。

examples.text: He gave a wrench to his ankle when he jumped down.
examples.translationZh: 他跳下去的时候扭伤了足踝。

meaningZh: 试图；尝试；n. 进攻

examples.text: He attempted to smother up the scandal about his family.
examples.translationZh: 他企图掩饰有关他家庭的丑闻。

examples.text: I would be the last to attempt to answer the question.
examples.translationZh: 我是最不可能去尝试回答这个问题。

examples.text: The enemy failed in their attempt to land on the island.
examples.translationZh: 敌人在岛上登陆的企图失败了。

meaningZh: 扇子，风扇；迷，粉丝；扇形物

examples.text: We have an extractor fan in the kitchen to get rid of the smell of cooking.
examples.translationZh: 我们的厨房里有台排气扇，用来消除油烟。

examples.text: Please turn the electric fan on.
examples.translationZh: 请打开电风扇。

examples.text: She glanced shyly at him from behind her fan.
examples.translationZh: 她羞怯地从她的扇子后面看了他一眼。

meaningZh: 感激；欣赏；领会

examples.text: I really appreciate his complete absorption in his work.
examples.translationZh: 我很欣赏他对工作的极端专注。

examples.text: I've decided to learn photography in order that I may better appreciate the beauty of nature.
examples.translationZh: 我决定学摄影以便能更好地欣赏自然的美。

examples.text: Very few people really appreciate his works.
examples.translationZh: 没人赏识他的作品。

meaningZh: 走向；趋向；时尚，时髦

examples.text: The trend of prices is still upward.
examples.translationZh: 物价仍有上涨趋势。

examples.text: The youth like to follow the latest trends in fashion.
examples.translationZh: 年轻人喜好追求最新的流行款式。

examples.text: This quartet represents a major new trend in modern music.
examples.translationZh: 这首四重奏的曲子反映了现代音乐中一种主要的新趋向。

meaningZh: 里面的，内部的；内幕的；内侧的

examples.text: All the inside rooms were skylighted.
examples.translationZh: 所有里面的房间都装了天窗。

examples.text: Maybe it is in your inside pocket.
examples.translationZh: 它可能在你衣服里面的口袋里。

examples.text: She shook it to make certain there was nothing inside.
examples.translationZh: 她把它摇了摇，想知道里面确实没有东西。

meaningZh: 明显的，明白的；昭著；彰

examples.text: Now it became evident that he spoke two languages at once.
examples.translationZh: 现在我才明白，原来他心里一套表面一套。

examples.text: Inertia is evident in our every day experiences.
examples.translationZh: 惯性在我们日常生活中是很常见的。

examples.text: The purpose may not be immediately evident.
examples.translationZh: 这种目的不一定显而易见。

meaningZh: 特有的；独特的；表示特性的

examples.text: Ambition is a characteristic of all successful businessmen.
examples.translationZh: 雄心勃勃是所有成功生意人的共同特点。

examples.text: Kindness is one of his characteristics.
examples.translationZh: 和善是他的特性之一。

examples.text: A characteristic of the camel is its ability to live for a long time without water.
examples.translationZh: 骆驼的特点是不喝水也能活很长时间。

meaningZh: 居所；避难所；（无家可归者或受虐待者的）收容所

examples.text: The refugees' main requirements are food and shelter.
examples.translationZh: 难民的主要必需品是食物和住所。

examples.text: In the storm I took shelter under the tree.
examples.translationZh: 暴风雨时，我正在树下躲避。

examples.text: The spectators scuttled for shelter when it began to rain.
examples.translationZh: 一下起雨来，观众就纷纷找地方躲避。

meaningZh: 大洋洲；澳洲

examples.text: Oceania is the smallest continent.
examples.translationZh: 大洋洲是最小的洲。

examples.text: Oceania is a separate landmass,but it is separated from Asia by very shallow water.
examples.translationZh: 大洋洲是一块单独的陆地，但它与亚洲之间只隔着很浅的水域。

meaningZh: 尖声喊叫，拼命叫喊；喊叫着说出；尖叫得使变…

examples.text: The patient gave out a scream of pain.
examples.translationZh: 病人痛苦地尖叫一声。

examples.text: A scream broke the silence of the night.
examples.translationZh: 一声尖叫划破了寂静的夜空。

examples.text: The boy was screaming with pain.
examples.translationZh: 这男孩痛得尖叫起来。

meaningZh: 桔子，橙子；[植]桔树；橙色

examples.text: Would you peel me an orange?
examples.translationZh: 你给我剥一个橘子好吗？

examples.text: Which one do you prefer, an apple or an orange?
examples.translationZh: 你想要哪个，苹果还是橘子？

examples.text: There are some oranges on the table.
examples.translationZh: 桌子上有几个橘子。

meaningZh: 一致的；连续的；不矛盾的

examples.text: She is a consistent girl in her feeling.
examples.translationZh: 在感情方面她是个始终如一的女孩。

examples.text: Our aim is to ensure a consistent growth.
examples.translationZh: 我们的目标是确保持续的增长。

examples.text: Your conduct is not consistent with what you say.
examples.translationZh: 你的言行不一致。

meaningZh: 你；你们，您们；各位

examples.text: Do you speak English?
examples.translationZh: 你会说英语吗？

examples.text: I shall await you at seven-thirty or thereabouts.
examples.translationZh: 我将在7点30分左右等着你。

examples.text: You must all listen carefully.
examples.translationZh: 你们都必须仔细听着。

meaningZh: 城市；全市居民；（由国王或女王授予特权，通常有大教堂的）特许市

examples.text: Beijing is a large city.
examples.translationZh: 北京是一座大城市。

examples.text: I live in the west of the city.
examples.translationZh: 我住在该城市的西部。

examples.text: The city is held by the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这座城市已被敌人占领。

meaningZh: 挨饿；饥饿；饿死

examples.text: The old woman died of starvation.
examples.translationZh: 老妇人被活活饿死。

examples.text: These people are living on the verge of starvation.
examples.translationZh: 这些人正在饥饿线上挣扎。

examples.text: He suffered from starvation and disease.
examples.translationZh: 他因饥饿和疾病而受苦。

meaningZh: 重量，体重；重担，重任；重要

examples.text: The pillars have to support the weight of the roof.
examples.translationZh: 这些柱子须承受屋顶的重量。

examples.text: He gained some weight recently.
examples.translationZh: 近来，他的体重增加了。

examples.text: He has put on weight since I last saw him.
examples.translationZh: 自从我上次见到他以来，他又长胖了。

meaningZh: 在外部；户外；缺少

examples.text: Without the sun, nothing would grow.
examples.translationZh: 没有太阳，就不会有生物。

examples.text: It is hard to sleep without a cooler in this room.
examples.translationZh: 没有空气调节器，在这间屋里很难入睡。

examples.text: I just want an ordinary car without the frills.
examples.translationZh: 我只要一辆没有多余装饰的普通汽车。

meaningZh: 教，讲授；教导，指导；通知

examples.text: His uncle instructed him in French.
examples.translationZh: 他的叔叔教他法语。

examples.text: Don't instruct your secretary to say you are out when you are in.
examples.translationZh: 不要教你的秘书在你在的时候说不在。

examples.text: It does not pertain to the young to instruct their elders.
examples.translationZh: 年轻人不应该对老年人发号施令。

meaningZh: 接吻；轻拂；轻微碰撞

examples.text: Look like he's going to haul off and kiss the girl.
examples.translationZh: 看上去他会突然吻那个姑娘一下。

examples.text: How do you steal a kiss from a girl like that?
examples.translationZh: 你怎么赢得像那样了不起的女孩的吻的？

examples.text: How do you steal a kiss from a girl like that?
examples.translationZh: 你怎么赢得像那样了不起的女孩的吻的？

meaningZh: 现代的；近代的；新式的

examples.text: Modern agriculture is spoiling our beautiful countryside.
examples.translationZh: 现代农业正在破坏我们美丽的农村。

examples.text: He can't adjust himself to the whirl of modern life in this big city.
examples.translationZh: 他无法适应这个大都市的现代生活的忙碌。

examples.text: Her novel depicts life in modern London.
examples.translationZh: 她的小说描写的是伦敦现代的生活。

meaningZh: 关于；属于…的；由…制成

examples.text: I have heard of him.
examples.translationZh: 我听说过他。

examples.text: This is a photograph of my dog.
examples.translationZh: 这是一张我的狗的照片。

examples.text: He is a friend of my father.
examples.translationZh: 他是我父亲的朋友。

meaningZh: 表，目录；桌子；手术台，工作台，游戏台

examples.text: He moved the table over to the center of the room.
examples.translationZh: 他把桌子移到房间中心。

examples.text: Mother told me to lay the table for breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 母亲让我摆好桌子准备吃早饭。

examples.text: We prefer a table besides the window in non-smoking.
examples.translationZh: 我们要不抽烟区靠窗的台子。

meaningZh: 饼干；软烤饼；松饼（食用时常佐以肉汁）

examples.text: He had some biscuits before the dinner.
examples.translationZh: 晚饭前，他吃了一些饼干。

examples.text: I caught her with her fingers in the biscuit tin.
examples.translationZh: 我看见她手指还在饼干盒里呢。

examples.text: Children like to eat the biscuit.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们喜欢吃饼干。

meaningZh: 打，打击；碰撞；vt. 击（球）

examples.text: The ball hits against the wall.
examples.translationZh: 球撞到了墙上。

examples.text: She hits at him.
examples.translationZh: 她朝他打去。

examples.text: His career reached a new high with the hit song.
examples.translationZh: 该首大热歌曲助他的歌唱事业达到一个新的高峰。

meaningZh: 人行道；硬路面；铺过的路面

examples.text: Two cars skidded on the icy pavement.
examples.translationZh: 两辆汽车在结冰的路面上打滑。

examples.text: The pavement was covered with dogs' excrement.
examples.translationZh: 便道上满是狗屎。

examples.text: She is a pavement sweeper.
examples.translationZh: 她是一个打扫人行道的清扫工人。

meaningZh: 糖果；冰糖；〈美俚〉古柯碱，可卡因

examples.text: The greedy little boy ate all the candy at the party.
examples.translationZh: 那个贪吃的小男孩把宴会上所有的糖果都吃光了。

examples.text: The mother distributed candy among children.
examples.translationZh: 母亲给孩子们发糖果。

examples.text: They candy fruit in autumn every year.
examples.translationZh: 他们每年秋天都做蜜饯水果。

meaningZh: 总是，老是；永远，始终；常常

examples.text: I'm always at home in the evenings.
examples.translationZh: 晚上我总是在家里。

examples.text: A live band is always a good draw at a party.
examples.translationZh: 现场演奏的乐队在聚会上总是很吸引人的。

examples.text: We should always help each other.
examples.translationZh: 我们应始终互相帮助。

meaningZh: 发起者，主办者；担保者；倡议者，提案人

examples.text: Your sponsor may assist in organising this insurance.
examples.translationZh: 你的担保人可以帮助你办理此类保险。

examples.text: Mr. Robert Brown was announced as the sponsor.
examples.translationZh: 罗勃特·布朗先生被宣布为赞助人。

examples.text: A wealthy sponsor came to our rescue with a generous donation.
examples.translationZh: 有个富有的赞助人慷慨捐赠来解救我们。

meaningZh: 在…之前；先于，优于；当着…的面

examples.text: B comes before C in the alphabet.
examples.translationZh: B在字母表里排在C之前。

examples.text: He made a statement before the House of Commons.
examples.translationZh: 他在下议院当众发表了一个声明。

examples.text: He always put the interests of others before his own.
examples.translationZh: 他总把他人的利益放在第一位。

meaningZh: 突然的，未预见到的；急躁的，仓促的；快的，迅速的

examples.text: His sudden death upset everybody.
examples.translationZh: 他的突然去世使大家深感悲伤。

examples.text: A sudden smile illuminated her face.
examples.translationZh: 突然的微笑使她容光焕发。

examples.text: She was dazzled by her sudden success.
examples.translationZh: 突然的成功使她感到迷惘。

meaningZh: 油；石油；油画

examples.text: The country is rich in oil and coal.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家石油和煤的资源丰富。

examples.text: You should oil the sewing machine to stop the squeaking.
examples.translationZh: 你应该给缝纫机上点油，以免发出轧轧声。

examples.text: He slicks his hair down with oil every day.
examples.translationZh: 他每天搽油把头梳得光溜溜的。

meaningZh: 新娘，即将（或刚刚）结婚的女子；姑娘

examples.text: The bride wore a beautiful white dress.
examples.translationZh: 新娘穿了一身美丽的白色礼服。

examples.text: We must drink to the health of the bride.
examples.translationZh: 我们要为新娘的健康干杯。

examples.text: The bride brought many dowries to her husband.
examples.translationZh: 新娘带着很多嫁妆给她丈夫。

meaningZh: 有用的，有益的，有帮助的；令人满意的

examples.text: It is a useful book and, what is more, not an expensive one.
examples.translationZh: 这是有用的书，更难得的是不贵。

examples.text: The book contains much useful information.
examples.translationZh: 这本书包含了许多有用的资料。

examples.text: John always tries to cultivate people who are useful to him.
examples.translationZh: 约翰经常设法和对他有用的人结交。

meaningZh: 梳子；梳棉机；鸡冠状的东西

examples.text: She wore a small comb as an ornament.
examples.translationZh: 她佩戴了一把小梳子作为装饰品。

examples.text: She swept her hair back with a comb.
examples.translationZh: 她用梳子将头发往后梳。

examples.text: Morris said taco sauce makes her comb light up bright red.
examples.translationZh: 莫里斯说，吃蘸酱墨西哥煎玉米卷让小鸡的鸡冠变得油亮鲜红。

meaningZh: 软的，柔软的；温和的，柔和的；不含酒精的

examples.text: The new leaves in springtime have a soft touch.
examples.translationZh: 春天的新芽有柔软的触感。

examples.text: It's very comfortable to step on the soft ground in the spring.
examples.translationZh: 春天的时候，踩在松软的地面上非常舒服。

examples.text: The room was flooded with soft light.
examples.translationZh: 房间里充满了柔和的光。

meaningZh: 树干；象鼻；躯干

examples.text: The branch has separated from the trunk of the tree.
examples.translationZh: 这个树枝已从树干上脱落了。

examples.text: I eulogize the tall and straight trunk of the white poplar.
examples.translationZh: 我赞美白杨树那挺拔的树干。

examples.text: The trunk is chock-full. There is no more room.
examples.translationZh: 车尾行李箱里塞满了东西。一点空隙都没有了。

meaningZh: 企（事）业单位；事业，计划；事业心，进取心

examples.text: This enterprise is now on a firm footing and should soon get profits.
examples.translationZh: 现在这家企业基础稳固，很快就会赢利。

examples.text: They are involved in an exciting scientific enterprise.
examples.translationZh: 他们投身于一项激动人心的科学事业。

examples.text: We need a spirit of enterprise if we are to overcome our difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 如果我们要克服困难，我们就要有进取精神。

meaningZh: 每人，人人

examples.text: On this job everyone works straight-time.
examples.translationZh: 在这项工作中，每人干满正常工作时间。

examples.text: The ruling was not fair to everyone.
examples.translationZh: 这项裁决并非对每人都公正。

examples.text: Everyone should be guarded by legal barricades.
examples.translationZh: 人人都应受法律保障。

meaningZh: 雾；烟雾；迷惑

examples.text: The headlamps penetrated the fog.
examples.translationZh: 车的前灯的光射进雾中。

examples.text: Fog will persist throughout the night.
examples.translationZh: 雾将整夜不散。

examples.text: They used dry ice to fog the stage.
examples.translationZh: 他们用乾冰于舞台变得一片朦胧。

meaningZh: 向，朝着；到；关于

examples.text: This will be a great boost to the economy.
examples.translationZh: 这对于经济发展将是一个巨大的促进。

examples.text: We come here to see you .
examples.translationZh: 我们来这里是为了看你。

examples.text: Her dress reached down to her ankles.
examples.translationZh: 她的连衣裙垂至脚踝。

meaningZh: 手帕；方巾，围巾

examples.text: She was playing with her handkerchief all the while during the speech.
examples.translationZh: 她在演讲时一直都在玩弄手帕。

examples.text: I polished my buttons with a handkerchief.
examples.translationZh: 我用手帕把钮扣擦亮。

examples.text: She embroidered her initials on the handkerchief.
examples.translationZh: 她把她姓名的起首字母绣在手帕上。

meaningZh: 或，或者；还是；不然，否则

examples.text: You can send letters by mail or by hand.
examples.translationZh: 你可以邮寄或者派人送信件。

examples.text: Is that painting an original or a reproduction?
examples.translationZh: 那幅画是原作还是复制品？

examples.text: Which do you prefer, lamb chops or pork chops?
examples.translationZh: 你比较喜欢小羊排,还是猪排?

meaningZh: （织机的）梭子；航天飞机；（缝纫机的）滑梭

examples.text: The shuttle flies back and forth on the loom.
examples.translationZh: 织布机上梭子来回飞动。

examples.text: He refined the whole art of shuttle diplomacy.
examples.translationZh: 他把穿梭外交艺术提高到炉火纯青的地步。

examples.text: There is a shuttle service between the city center and the air station.
examples.translationZh: 在市中心和飞机场之间有往返的穿梭运行班车。

meaningZh: 慷慨的，大方的；丰盛的；肥沃的

examples.text: She was always very generous in her charity.
examples.translationZh: 她行善时总是很慷慨。

examples.text: Such generous actions stamp him as a man of honour.
examples.translationZh: 他的这些慷慨行为表明他是个君子。

examples.text: I regret having been so generous to that scoundrel.
examples.translationZh: 我后悔不该对那坏家伙如此宽宏大量。

meaningZh: 招呼，问候；敬礼；祝贺

examples.text: "How are you?"is a conventional greeting.
examples.translationZh: “你好”是一个习惯问候语。

examples.text: Her greeting was cold and strained.
examples.translationZh: 她的问候冷淡而勉强。

examples.text: He acknowledged the greeting with a nod.
examples.translationZh: 他点一点头，回答了对他的问候。

meaningZh: 同等，平等；[数]相等，等式

examples.text: In some countries black people do not have equality with white people.
examples.translationZh: 在某些国家黑人没有和白人同等的权利。

examples.text: Genuine racial equality still seems light-years away.
examples.translationZh: 真正的种族平等似乎仍遥遥无期。

examples.text: The country's constitution embodies the ideals of freedom and equality.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的宪法体现了自由和平等的理想。

meaningZh: 可靠的；可信赖的；真实可信的

examples.text: I don't think he is a reliable man.
examples.translationZh: 我认为他不是一个可靠的人。

examples.text: She may be slow but at least she's reliable.
examples.translationZh: 她迟钝是迟钝，但无论如何她很可靠。

examples.text: A reliable car is worth its weight in gold.
examples.translationZh: 靠得住的汽车就是无价之宝。

meaningZh: 仪器；手段，工具；乐器

examples.text: This instrument monitors the patient's heartbeats.
examples.translationZh: 这台仪器监听病人的心跳。

examples.text: He can play nearly every musical instrument.
examples.translationZh: 他几乎能演奏每一件乐器。

examples.text: A plough is an instrument used for farming.
examples.translationZh: 犁是用于耕作的工具。

meaningZh: 期待；预期；前程

examples.text: It is really out of my expectation.
examples.translationZh: 这真是出乎我的意料。

examples.text: There's no expectation of snow tonight.
examples.translationZh: 今晚预料无雪.

examples.text: His parents have great expectations for his future.
examples.translationZh: 他父母对他的前途深寄厚望。

meaningZh: 乙醇，酒精；含酒精的饮料

examples.text: Whisky contains a large percentage of alcohol.
examples.translationZh: 威士忌所含酒精的百分比很高。

examples.text: Alcohol has a very bad effect on drivers.
examples.translationZh: 酒精对司机的影响很大。

examples.text: This substance is soluble in alcohol.
examples.translationZh: 这种物质能够溶解在酒精中。

meaningZh: 精力充沛的，充满活力的；精力旺盛的，精神饱满的；（措施等）积极的，有力的

examples.text: His son is an energetic child.
examples.translationZh: 他的儿子是个精力旺盛的孩子。

examples.text: He seems an energetic person.
examples.translationZh: 他似乎是一个精力充沛的人。

examples.text: Her wiry athletic body seems energetic.
examples.translationZh: 她瘦长结实的身体看上去精力充沛。

meaningZh: 契约，协定；交易；特价商品

examples.text: He made a satisfactory bargain with them.
examples.translationZh: 他和他们做了一笔满意的交易。

examples.text: If you promote our goods, we will give you a good discount as our part of the bargain.
examples.translationZh: 若你方经销我们的货物，我方愿给予你相当大的优惠作为回报。

examples.text: She knows a bargain when she sees one.
examples.translationZh: 她有辨别便宜货的能力。

meaningZh: 体系，系统；制度；身体

examples.text: The drainage system has been aged.
examples.translationZh: 排水系统已经老化了。

examples.text: The magazine is produced using a desktop publishing system.
examples.translationZh: 这本杂志用一个桌面的出版系统做出来的。

examples.text: They are introducing a very sophisticated system for delivering information.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在介绍一个非常复杂的传递信息的体系。

meaningZh: 月亮，月球；卫星；月状物，新月状物

examples.text: The moon goes round the earth.
examples.translationZh: 月亮绕着地球转。

examples.text: Last night there was a full moon.
examples.translationZh: 昨晚是满月。

examples.text: The moon peeped out from behind the clouds.
examples.translationZh: 月亮从云层中隐现。

meaningZh: 雕像，塑像；vt. 用雕像装饰

examples.text: The statue is twice life-size.
examples.translationZh: 该雕像大小为实体的两倍。

examples.text: They decided to perpetuate the memory of their leader by erecting a statue.
examples.translationZh: 他们为永远纪念那位领袖决定建一座雕像。

examples.text: The statue was carved out of marble.
examples.translationZh: 这座雕像是用大理石雕刻的。

meaningZh: 瞬间，片刻；时刻；重要，紧要

examples.text: I'll be back in a moment.
examples.translationZh: 我一会儿就回来。

examples.text: Would you take a seat for a moment?
examples.translationZh: 请你稍坐片刻好吗?

examples.text: He thought for a moment and then spoke.
examples.translationZh: 他想了片刻，然後说。

meaningZh: 烦扰的；令人不安的；v. 打扰(disturb的现在分词)

examples.text: We do not tell each other what is disturbing us.
examples.translationZh: 我们不告诉彼此什么是烦扰的我们。

examples.text: The disturbing news made us sad.
examples.translationZh: 这个令人烦扰的消息让我们很难过。

examples.text: He had a novel and disturbing experience last year.
examples.translationZh: 去年他有一次新奇而又令人不安的经历。

meaningZh: 裁缝，成衣工；vi. 做裁缝；vt. 调整使适应

examples.text: This tailor is famous for making good suit.
examples.translationZh: 这位裁缝以做高级西装而出名。

examples.text: The tailor made a suit for Dick.
examples.translationZh: 这位裁缝师为迪克做了一套西装。

examples.text: He tailored me a tweed suit.
examples.translationZh: 他为我缝制了一套苏格兰粗呢的衣服。

meaningZh: 令人生厌的；无聊的

examples.text: I had planned to go to your party, but you know I had to finish that tiresome paper.
examples.translationZh: 我原本打算去参加你的晚会，可你知道我还得完成那令人厌倦的考卷。

examples.text: His speech is really tiresome.
examples.translationZh: 他的演讲实在令人厌倦。

examples.text: Deliver me from such tiresome people.
examples.translationZh: 让我离开这些讨厌的人们吧。

meaningZh: 叔叔；伯父；舅父

examples.text: My uncle is a professor in this university.
examples.translationZh: 我的伯父是这所大学的一名教授。

examples.text: They are not really my aunt and uncle.
examples.translationZh: 其实他们并不是我的姑姑和姑父。

examples.text: My uncle is a sure-enough cowboy.
examples.translationZh: 我舅舅是个地道的牛仔。

meaningZh: 不断的，持续的；永恒的，始终如一的；坚定

examples.text: In our world nothing seems constant.
examples.translationZh: 在我们这个世界上似乎没有东西是永恒不变的。

examples.text: The birth rate in this city is almost constant.
examples.translationZh: 这城市的出生率几乎是不变的。

examples.text: The machinery requires constant maintenance.
examples.translationZh: 这些机器需要经常保养维修。

meaningZh: 擦光；磨光；修改

examples.text: A hot plate will spoil the polish on this table.
examples.translationZh: 热盘子会毁坏桌面的光泽。

examples.text: This car polish is an effective shield against rust.
examples.translationZh: 这种汽车上光蜡很有防锈作用。

examples.text: With this polish you can give a good high gloss to the wood.
examples.translationZh: 使用这种上光蜡可使木器表面极为光亮平滑。

meaningZh: 芥末，芥菜；芥末色，深黄色；强烈的兴趣

examples.text: This meat should be seasoned with salt and mustard.
examples.translationZh: 这肉里应该加些盐和芥末。

examples.text: He put some mustard into the dish.
examples.translationZh: 他向菜里放了些芥末。

examples.text: In France, mustard seeds are soaked and then grinded to a paste.
examples.translationZh: 在法国，芥菜籽被浸透，然后再磨成浆糊状。

meaningZh: 平衡；天平；平衡力

examples.text: The girl lost her balance and fell off the balance beam.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩失去了平衡，从平衡木上摔了下来。

examples.text: Great care must be taken in the use of the balance.
examples.translationZh: 这种天平使用时必须十分当心。

examples.text: He used a very sensitive torsion balance.
examples.translationZh: 他利用了一架非常灵敏的扭力天平。

meaningZh: 典礼，仪式；礼仪，礼节；虚礼，客气

examples.text: The marriage ceremony took place in the church.
examples.translationZh: 婚礼在教堂举行。

examples.text: They hold a mystic religious ceremony.
examples.translationZh: 他们举行了一个神秘的宗教仪式。

examples.text: There's no need for ceremony between friends.
examples.translationZh: 朋友之间不必拘礼.

meaningZh: 卧室，寝室；adj. 城郊住宅区的；两性关系的，男女性爱的

examples.text: There was an angry squall from the bedroom.
examples.translationZh: 卧室里传出一声愤怒的喊叫。

examples.text: My bedroom is smaller than yours.
examples.translationZh: 我的卧室比你的小。

meaningZh: 汽油

examples.text: Petrol is volatile.
examples.translationZh: 汽油容易挥发。

examples.text: The petrol is running out.
examples.translationZh: 汽油快要耗尽了。

examples.text: My car is rather heavy on petrol.
examples.translationZh: 我的汽车很费油。

meaningZh: 成员；分子；身体部位（尤指胳膊或腿）

examples.text: He declared himself a member of their party.
examples.translationZh: 他声明他本人是他们政党的成员。

examples.text: I am a member of our school football club.
examples.translationZh: 我是我们学校足球俱乐部的成员。

examples.text: The club took in a new member last week.
examples.translationZh: 俱乐部上星期又吸收了一名新会员。

meaningZh: （以不同的方式或语言）复述，重述

examples.text: The teacher asked the students to retell the story they just read.
examples.translationZh: 老师要求学生们复述他们刚读的故事。

examples.text: After you have read these stories, retell them in your own words.
examples.translationZh: 把这些故事看完之后，用你自己的话再讲一遍。

meaningZh: 到处，处处，无论什么地方；四下里；漫

examples.text: New factories are going up everywhere.
examples.translationZh: 到处在兴建新工厂。

examples.text: I hunted for my book everywhere.
examples.translationZh: 我到处找我的书。

meaningZh: 疾病；某种具体疾病；不健康

examples.text: His illness diminished his health.
examples.translationZh: 疾病侵蚀了他的健康。

examples.text: He will pull through his illness soon.
examples.translationZh: 他很快就会恢复健康的。

examples.text: Worry and illness had made him prematurely old.
examples.translationZh: 他心事重重、 疾病缠身，落得个未老先衰。

meaningZh: 类型，部门，种类，类别，类目；[逻，哲]范畴；体重等级

examples.text: There are different categories of books in a library.
examples.translationZh: 图书馆里有各种不同种类的书籍。

examples.text: They fall into different categories.
examples.translationZh: 他们属于不同的类别。

examples.text: They misplaced this book under another category.
examples.translationZh: 他们把它错放到另一个类别去了。

meaningZh: 投掷；丢；抛

examples.text: Pick out some good apples from the box, and throw away the rest.
examples.translationZh: 把好苹果从盒子里捡出来,剩下的扔了。

examples.text: The trees threw long shadows across the lawn.
examples.translationZh: 树在草坪上都投下长长的影子。

examples.text: It's your turn to throw the dice.
examples.translationZh: 轮到你掷骰子了。

meaningZh: 阶层，等级；军衔；次序，顺序

examples.text: He is above me in rank.
examples.translationZh: 他的级别比我高。

examples.text: They are people of all ranks and classes.
examples.translationZh: 他们来自各阶层各阶级。

examples.text: Taxis stand in a taxi rank waiting to be hired.
examples.translationZh: 出租汽车排成一行等人雇车。

meaningZh: 容许；承认；忍受

examples.text: The school cannot tolerate cheating on exams.
examples.translationZh: 该学校不容许在考试中有作弊现象。

examples.text: We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
examples.translationZh: 我们绝不容许歧视的存在。

examples.text: He can not tolerate the extremes of heat in the desert.
examples.translationZh: 他忍受不住沙漠里的酷热。

meaningZh: 舒适的，惬意的；畅快的；亲切友好的

examples.text: He lives in a cosy little room.
examples.translationZh: 他住在一个舒适的小屋里。

examples.text: "Oh dear,"thought Brown, "It's going to be one of those cosy chat sessions."
examples.translationZh: “哦，天哪，”布朗想，“又得来一次亲切友好的谈话了。”

examples.text: He has been accused of cosying up to the new US president.
examples.translationZh: 他被指责讨好新任美国总统。

meaningZh: 糟糕的；可怕的；非常的

examples.text: It would be awful if he found out the truth.
examples.translationZh: 如果他发现了真相，那就糟了。

examples.text: I left Harvard with no real awareness of the awful inequities in the world.
examples.translationZh: 当我离开哈佛时,我并没真正有意识到这个世界存在着可怕的不平等现象。

examples.text: He seemed to be very awful while serving the famous actress.
examples.translationZh: 他在招待那位著名的女演员时,看上去非常的敬畏。

meaningZh: 阵雨，降雨；降雨量

examples.text: A rainfall will settle the dust on the road.
examples.translationZh: 一场雨使马路上的尘埃落定。

examples.text: There was another rainfall early this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天清晨又下了一场雨。

examples.text: This area has very low rainfall.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区雨量稀少。

meaningZh: 指导，引导；导航；领导

examples.text: Under his guidance, we finished the work smoothly.
examples.translationZh: 在他的指导下，我们顺利地完成了工作。

examples.text: She is a marriage guidance counselor.
examples.translationZh: 她是婚姻问题的顾问。

examples.text: Religion provides many people with guidance.
examples.translationZh: 宗教为很多人起到引导的作用。

meaningZh: 博物馆

examples.text: The museum has many immemorial cultural relics.
examples.translationZh: 该博物馆收藏了很多极其古老的文物。

examples.text: The museum displays the specimen of ancient Chinese porcelain.
examples.translationZh: 这个博物馆展出中国古瓷器标本。

examples.text: Flashes are not allowed to be used in this museum.
examples.translationZh: 这个博物馆里不准使用闪光灯。

meaningZh: 腕，手腕；腕关节；（衣袖等的）腕部

examples.text: He fell downstairs and broke his wrist.
examples.translationZh: 他从楼梯跌下，摔伤了手腕。

examples.text: She wears a ring round her wrist.
examples.translationZh: 她的手腕上戴着一只镯子。

examples.text: The nurse lapped a bandage round his wrist.
examples.translationZh: 护士把他的腕部包上绷带。

meaningZh: 不合法的，违法的；违反规则的；n. 非法移民，非法劳工

examples.text: The jewellery firm is just a front for their illegal trade in diamonds.
examples.translationZh: 该珠宝公司不过是进行非法的钻石交易的幌子。

examples.text: All protests are brutally repressed by the government as illegal.
examples.translationZh: 所有的抗议活动都遭到当局的野蛮镇压，并被宣布为非法。

examples.text: Their speculative buying of grain is illegal.
examples.translationZh: 他们投机购买谷物是不合法的。

meaningZh: 通讯，通信；交流；书信

examples.text: Most important of all, computers create wide communication around the world.
examples.translationZh: 最重要的是,计算机在世界范围内建立了广泛的交流。

examples.text: Being able to hold a conversation does not necessarily mean having effective communication.
examples.translationZh: 能够对话并不意味着在进行有效的交流。

examples.text: This area has not been covered by the communication net.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区还不在通讯网的覆盖之内。

meaningZh: 发现，发觉；（剧情的）发展；被发现的事物

examples.text: The new discovery caused a great sensation.
examples.translationZh: 这项新发现很轰动。

examples.text: New scientific discoveries are being made everyday.
examples.translationZh: 每天都有新的科学发现。

examples.text: A collector of rare insects will show us some of his latest discoveries.
examples.translationZh: 一位稀有昆虫采集家将给我们看一些他的最新发现。

meaningZh: 传统的；习用的，平常的；依照惯例的

examples.text: Her book is a hilarious send-up of a conventional spy story.
examples.translationZh: 她写的书用的是取笑传统侦探小说的笔法，令人捧腹。

examples.text: According to conventional wisdom, voters usually make their choice on the basis of domestic issues.
examples.translationZh: 按一般人在这些问题上的看法，选民常常着眼于国内问题来选择候选人。

examples.text: After a conventional opening remarks, he made a brilliant speech.
examples.translationZh: 在一个常规的开场白后,他做了个很精彩的演讲。

meaningZh: 浴缸，澡盆

examples.text: Clean out the bathtub when you are done.
examples.translationZh: 洗完澡后请把浴缸洗干净。

meaningZh: 大约；旋转；到处，四处

examples.text: He runs around the playground.
examples.translationZh: 他在运动场上到处跑。

examples.text: I saw him around the place this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天早上我看见他就在那儿附近。

examples.text: The earth moves around the sun.
examples.translationZh: 地球围绕太阳运动。

meaningZh: 重建；重新组装；再形成某事物

examples.text: It's necessary to rebuild our alma mater.
examples.translationZh: 有必要重建我们的母校。

examples.text: Plans have been put forward to pull down and rebuild the area.
examples.translationZh: 已提出计划，要把这个地区的房屋推掉重建。

examples.text: He paid his living expenses through graduate school by rebuilding engines.
examples.translationZh: 他在攻读研究生期间靠重新组装发动机维持日常开销。

meaningZh: 用以构成完成式及完成式的不定式，表示已经…；vt. 有，具有；拿，取得

examples.text: A country must have the will to repel any invader.
examples.translationZh: 一个国家得有决心击退任何入侵者。

examples.text: The police have absolute proof of his guilt.
examples.translationZh: 警方有他犯罪的确凿证据。

examples.text: Have a glass of beer to rinse your dinner down.
examples.translationZh: 喝杯啤酒把你吃的晚饭冲下去。

meaningZh: 羊毛制的；毛织的；呢绒的

examples.text: The woollen cloth prickles (my skin).
examples.translationZh: 穿毛料衣服(使我的皮肤)有被扎的感觉。

examples.text: China's woollen textile industry is forging ahead to meet the needs of the country.
examples.translationZh: 中国的毛纺工业正迅速发展以适应国家的需要。

examples.text: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
examples.translationZh: 一个男人躺在箱子里的一堆毛织品上。

meaningZh: 老虎；各种猫科动物；凶恶的人，虎狼之徒

examples.text: The tiger is a representative of the cat family.
examples.translationZh: 老虎是猫科动物的典型。

examples.text: The hunter hurled his spear at the tiger.
examples.translationZh: 猎人用力把他的长矛向虎投去。

examples.text: The tiger dragged its kill into the jungle.
examples.translationZh: 这只老虎拖着它的猎物进了丛林。

meaningZh: （通常因悲伤）哭泣；流泪；悲哀

examples.text: She wept bitter tears over her lost youth.
examples.translationZh: 她为自己逝去的青春痛苦地流泪。

examples.text: It is better to laugh than (to) weep.
examples.translationZh: 笑比哭好。

examples.text: I weep for the loss of your husband.
examples.translationZh: 我为你失去丈夫而哭泣。

meaningZh: 翻译；译本；转变

examples.text: I am making a verbal translation.
examples.translationZh: 我正在逐字的翻译。

examples.text: The effect of the novel loses in translation.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说经过翻译失色不少。

examples.text: I think her translation of the article is much better than his.
examples.translationZh: 我认为她对这篇文章的翻译要比他强的多。

meaningZh: （批评、判断等的）标准，准则；规范

examples.text: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth.
examples.translationZh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准。

examples.text: He thinks that the criterion of success is the ability to work joyfully.
examples.translationZh: 他认为成功的检验标准是看能否愉快地生活。

examples.text: We have a clear-cut criterion to go by.
examples.translationZh: 我们有个可供遵循的明确标准。

meaningZh: 啤酒，麦酒；（一般）发酵饮料；[印，纺]比尔

examples.text: He bought a barrel of beer.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一桶啤酒。

examples.text: I like drinking beer.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢喝啤酒。

meaningZh: 卖，出卖；销售额，销售；销路

examples.text: This is a showpiece, not for sale.
examples.translationZh: 这是个样品,不出售。

examples.text: The law forbids the sale of alcohol to people under 18.
examples.translationZh: 法律禁止向18岁以下的人出售含有酒精的饮料。

examples.text: The local dress shop is having a sale.
examples.translationZh: 附近的时装店正在大拍卖。

meaningZh: 灵巧的，熟练的；制作精巧的；圆熟

examples.text: His skillful manipulation vivified this puppet.
examples.translationZh: 他熟练的操作让木偶栩栩如生。

examples.text: He is a skillful English-speaking professor.
examples.translationZh: 他是位英语讲得很熟练的教授。

examples.text: Her skillful fingers spun the wool out to a fine thread.
examples.translationZh: 她那灵巧的手指把羊毛纺织成了细线。

meaningZh: 大使夫人；女大使

examples.text: The president sent a letter to the ambassadress, requesting her to call at her earliest convenience.
examples.translationZh: 总统致函女大使，请她在方便的时候尽快到访。

meaningZh: 笔记簿；笔记本电脑；手册

examples.text: I record all my thoughts in a notebook.
examples.translationZh: 我在笔记本上记下我所有的想法。

examples.text: She filled her notebook with sketches.
examples.translationZh: 她在笔记本上画满素描。

examples.text: The ultimate big prize will be notebook one!
examples.translationZh: 终极大奖将是笔记本电脑一台！

meaningZh: 我们的

examples.text: Your house is much bigger than ours.
examples.translationZh: 你们的房子比我们的大多了。

examples.text: Their opinion jarred with ours.
examples.translationZh: 他们的意见与我们不一致。

examples.text: Ours is small.
examples.translationZh: 我们的是小的。

meaningZh: 火箭；火箭发射器；火箭发动机

examples.text: They sent a distress rocket.
examples.translationZh: 他们发出了一枚呼救信号火箭。

examples.text: A rocket manned by trained astronauts will launch soon.
examples.translationZh: 载有受过训练的宇航员的火箭马上就要发射了。

examples.text: Scientists have computed the probable course of the rocket.
examples.translationZh: 科学家利用计算机计算了火箭可能运行的轨道。

meaningZh: 任何人；任何一个；谁

examples.text: We dislike to have anyone patronize us.
examples.translationZh: 我们不喜欢任何人对我们以恩人自居。

examples.text: She never heeded anyone's warning.
examples.translationZh: 她从不理会任何人的警告。

meaningZh: 敞开的，开着的；公开的，公共的；坦率的

examples.text: The fresh air blew in from the open window.
examples.translationZh: 新鲜空气从开着的窗户吹进来。

examples.text: One day, I came home to find my garage open.
examples.translationZh: 有一天，我到家时发现车库的门是开着的。

examples.text: She has fall asleep with an open book in her lap.
examples.translationZh: 她睡着了,腿上还摊开着一本书。

meaningZh: 考虑，考察；照顾，关心；报酬

examples.text: Please give the matter your careful consideration.
examples.translationZh: 此事请你仔细考虑。

examples.text: He showed no consideration for his wife.
examples.translationZh: 他不体贴他的妻子。

examples.text: Thank you for all your consideration and help.
examples.translationZh: 谢谢您的关心和帮助。

meaningZh: 听到，听见；vt. 听说；得知

examples.text: How did you hear about us? How did you hear about this job?
examples.translationZh: 你是如何得知我们的?如何得知这个工作的?

examples.text: Have you heard the news?
examples.translationZh: 你听到那消息了吗？

examples.text: I heard (that) he was ill.
examples.translationZh: 我听说他病了。

meaningZh: 上衣，外套；vt. 给…穿上上衣[外套]；盖上

examples.text: You may hang your coat on the hook.
examples.translationZh: 你可以把外套挂在钩子上。

examples.text: She was wearing a woolen coat, with a cotton blouse underneath.
examples.translationZh: 她外面穿了一件毛外套，里面穿一件棉布衬衫。

examples.text: Jane bought a fur coat yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 简昨天买了一件裘皮大衣。

meaningZh: 边；镶边；包边

examples.text: We have a herbaceous border round our garden.
examples.translationZh: 我们的花园四周种有草本植物。

examples.text: A series of provocations led up to the border war.
examples.translationZh: 一系列的挑衅事件导致了边境战争的发生。

examples.text: Enemy troops raided our border areas.
examples.translationZh: 敌军对我边境地区进行袭击。

meaningZh: 有酸味的；敌对的；坏脾气的

examples.text: Most green fruit is sour.
examples.translationZh: 大多数未熟的水果都是酸的。

examples.text: The dish's gone sour.
examples.translationZh: 这菜已经变质了。

examples.text: He's always got a sour look on his face, and he has never said anything friendly.
examples.translationZh: 他总是板着脸,从来不说一句好听的话。

meaningZh: 甜瓜；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西

examples.text: We garnished the melon with strawberries.
examples.translationZh: 我们给甜瓜配上草莓。

examples.text: Saya mempunyai sebuah Kiwi dan sebuah Melon.
examples.translationZh: 我有一个猕猴桃和一个甜瓜。

meaningZh: 长靴，皮靴；防护罩；[多用于英国]行李箱

examples.text: My foot won't go into this boot.
examples.translationZh: 我的脚伸不进这只靴子。

examples.text: Italy vaguely resembles a boot.
examples.translationZh: 意大利国的形状像只靴子。

examples.text: The door wouldn't open so I gave it a boot.
examples.translationZh: 门开不了,所以我朝门猛踢一脚。

meaningZh: 综合性大学；大学人员；大学校舍

examples.text: John is one of his alumni in the university.
examples.translationZh: 约翰是他大学时的校友之一。

examples.text: My uncle is a professor in this university.
examples.translationZh: 我的伯父是这所大学的一名教授。

examples.text: There are many foreign professors in this university.
examples.translationZh: 这所大学有许多外国教授。

meaningZh: 松的，宽的；模糊的；散漫的

examples.text: The screw worked itself loose and the door fell off the cupboard.
examples.translationZh: 螺丝松了，门从橱柜上掉下来了。

examples.text: She wore loose garments in the summer.
examples.translationZh: 她在夏天穿宽松的衣服。

examples.text: Loose labour regulations are one reason.
examples.translationZh: 宽松的劳动规则是原因之一。

meaningZh: 照相机；摄影机

examples.text: Her camera strap has broken.
examples.translationZh: 她的照相机吊带断了。

examples.text: This wall will do as a rest for your camera.
examples.translationZh: 这面墙可以作为你照相机的依托。

examples.text: We have a video camera.
examples.translationZh: 我们有一架摄像机。

meaningZh: 在…上面；当…时候

examples.text: All our hopes rested upon this venture.
examples.translationZh: 我们所有的希望都寄托在这次冒险上了。

examples.text: The water splashed out of the tub upon the floor.
examples.translationZh: 水从缸里飞溅出来，落在地板上。

examples.text: Upon his release, Davis went immediately to his mother.
examples.translationZh: 戴维斯一被释放就立即回到了母亲身边。

meaningZh: 限制，限定；拘束，束缚；管制

examples.text: The swimming club is open to families in the neighborhood without restriction.
examples.translationZh: 这个游泳俱乐部对邻近地区的家庭开放，不受限制。

examples.text: The sale of firearms is subject to many legal restrictions.
examples.translationZh: 出售枪支受到许多法律限制。

examples.text: There are currency restrictions on the sums allowed for foreign travel.
examples.translationZh: 到国外旅行允许携带的款额有所限制。

meaningZh: 方式；样式；时髦

examples.text: The letter is written in formal style.
examples.translationZh: 这封信是用正式文体写的。

examples.text: I wouldn't tell lies to you; that's not my style.
examples.translationZh: 我不会跟你撒谎，那不是我的风格。

examples.text: The style of this skirt is just in season.
examples.translationZh: 这条裙子的款式正当时令。

meaningZh: 窗帘，门帘；帐幕之物，幕布；启幕，落幕

examples.text: The curtain was suddenly drawn and a bright light shone in.
examples.translationZh: 突然窗帘拉了开来，一道强光照了进来。

examples.text: She came upon a low curtain she had not noticed before.
examples.translationZh: 她发现刚才没有注意到的一个低垂的门帘。

examples.text: She kept peering through the side curtain.
examples.translationZh: 她不时地从旁边的幕帐向外窥视。

meaningZh: 空的，空虚的，空洞的；空闲的，无效的，徒劳的；无聊的，愚蠢的

examples.text: His room is empty.
examples.translationZh: 他的房间是空的。

examples.text: His wordy and empty speech was a frost.
examples.translationZh: 他的冗长空洞的讲话使人厌烦。

examples.text: He didn't want to retire and lead an empty life.
examples.translationZh: 他不想退休过空虚的生活。

meaningZh: 适当的，相当的，正当的，应该的，正式的，正常的；固有的，特有的，独特的；本来的，真正的，严格意义上的

examples.text: He could not come up with a proper answer.
examples.translationZh: 他想不出一个合适的回答。

examples.text: It's not proper for you to catch him up very short.
examples.translationZh: 你突然打断他的话是不恰当的。

examples.text: The company does not take proper fire precaution.
examples.translationZh: 公司未采取正当的防火措施。

meaningZh: 痕迹,污点,斑；分数,等级符号；记号,标记

examples.text: The trade mark is an intangible asset of every enterprise.
examples.translationZh: 商标是企业的一项无形资产。

examples.text: A recorder pen makes a mark on a chart.
examples.translationZh: 记录器的笔在记录卡上划一个记号。

examples.text: War has left its mark on the country.
examples.translationZh: 战争给该国留下了不可磨灭的痕迹。

meaningZh: 海港，港口；港湾；避难所

examples.text: This harbour is a natural harbour.
examples.translationZh: 这个港口是天然港。

examples.text: We lay at anchor outside the harbour.
examples.translationZh: 我们在港外抛锚停泊。

examples.text: Harbour lights were blinking on the horizon.
examples.translationZh: 海港的灯火在水平线上闪烁着。

meaningZh: 做广告，做宣传；通告，通知；宣扬

examples.text: We decided to advertise our new product.
examples.translationZh: 我们决定为我们的新产品做广告。

examples.text: We can advertise on the Internet.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以在网上登广告。

examples.text: I must advertise for a new secretary.
examples.translationZh: 我得刊登广告聘请一位新秘书。

meaningZh: 后者的；末了的；较后的

examples.text: I prefer the former design to the latter.
examples.translationZh: 比起后者的设计方案,我更喜欢前者的。

examples.text: One can travel there by ship or plane. Most people choose the latter.
examples.translationZh: 乘船或乘飞机都可以到那,人们多选择后者。

examples.text: The latter point is the most important.
examples.translationZh: 后面提及的那一点是最重要的。

meaningZh: 由…组成；在于；符合

examples.text: The United Kingdom consists of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
examples.translationZh: 联合王国由大不列颠和北爱尔兰组成。

examples.text: How many players does a baseball team consist of?
examples.translationZh: 棒球队由几名队员组成?

examples.text: Matters consist of molecules, and molecules of atoms.
examples.translationZh: 物质由分子构成，而分子由原子构成。

meaningZh: 使恐怖，使惊吓；恐吓，吓唬；威胁

examples.text: Or will carelessness or corruption allow the theft of a nuclear device to terrify us all?
examples.translationZh: 会不会由于安全部门的疏忽或腐败，让恐怖分子得到核装置用来威胁民众？

meaningZh: 吸烟者

examples.text: It transpired that the fire was caused by a careless smoker.
examples.translationZh: 据传这场大火是由一位粗心的吸烟者造成的。

examples.text: Non-smokers often disapprove of smoking in public.
examples.translationZh: 不吸烟的人往往不赞成别人在公共场合吸烟。

examples.text: Shall we sit in a smoker or a non-smoker?
examples.translationZh: 我们坐吸烟车厢还是非吸烟车厢？

meaningZh: 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的

examples.text: The feudal barons were cruel to the people.
examples.translationZh: 封建贵族对人民很残酷。

examples.text: That emperor was a cruel despot.
examples.translationZh: 那个皇帝是个残酷的专制君主。

examples.text: The death of their daughter was a cruel blow.
examples.translationZh: 女儿的死对他们是一个残酷的打击。

meaningZh: 使出血；勒索，敲诈；vi. 流血

examples.text: All the young soldiers are ready to bleed for the country.
examples.translationZh: 所有的年轻战士都愿意为祖国洒热血。

examples.text: If you cut your finger it will bleed.
examples.translationZh: 如果你割破手指,那么它会流血的。

examples.text: A page trimmed so as to bleed.
examples.translationZh: 被剪裁的页次经切裁以印成出血版的纸页

meaningZh: 装饰瓶，花瓶

examples.text: That's an alabaster vase.
examples.translationZh: 那是个雪花石膏做的花瓶。

examples.text: The flaw in this vase makes it less valuable.
examples.translationZh: 这个花瓶因为有点缺陷，不那么值钱了。

examples.text: The broken vase lay in shatters.
examples.translationZh: 那只打碎了的花瓶的碎片撒了一地。

meaningZh: 组织；机构；团体

examples.text: Our company is the epitome of a well organized, efficient organization.
examples.translationZh: 我们公司是一个组织完备、有效率的典範机构。

examples.text: They have established a student organization.
examples.translationZh: 他们建立了一个学生组织。

examples.text: He's involved in the organization of a new club.
examples.translationZh: 他参与了新俱乐部的组织工作。

meaningZh: 棉,棉花；棉线,棉布

examples.text: India exports tea and cotton to many different countries.
examples.translationZh: 印度向许多国家出口茶叶和棉花。

examples.text: This district used to grow cotton on a large scale.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区过去大量种棉花。

examples.text: The import of cotton goods went up sharply in 1986.
examples.translationZh: 在1986年，棉织品的进口猛增。

meaningZh: 现象，事件；奇迹；非凡的人

examples.text: Their so-called prosperity is only a temporary phenomenon.
examples.translationZh: 但他们所谓的繁荣只是一个暂时的现象。

examples.text: International terrorism is not just a recent phenomenon.
examples.translationZh: 国际恐怖主义并不是近年才有的现象。

examples.text: Magnetism is a natural phenomenon.
examples.translationZh: 磁力是一种自然现象。

meaningZh: 衬衫，衬衣；内衣，汗衫

examples.text: She shortened the shirt by an inch.
examples.translationZh: 她把衬衫截短了一英寸。

examples.text: What size of collar is this shirt?
examples.translationZh: 这衬衣领子的尺寸是多少？

examples.text: Will you stitch a button on this shirt?
examples.translationZh: 请你在这件衬衫上钉一颗钮扣好吗？

meaningZh: 和平的，爱好和平的，太平的；平静的；平时的

examples.text: The night was pacific.
examples.translationZh: 黑夜静悄悄的。

examples.text: He developed a pacific disposition in his childhood.
examples.translationZh: 童年时他养成了温和的性情。

examples.text: The result of this pacific policy was that no troops were called up.
examples.translationZh: 这项和平政策的结果是不调集任何军队。

meaningZh: 大学；（英国）学院；学会

examples.text: He is studying in the theological college.
examples.translationZh: 他在那所神学院学习。

examples.text: He is at law college.
examples.translationZh: 他在法学院读书。

examples.text: He had passed the entrance examination of the college.
examples.translationZh: 他已经通过了大学的入学考试。

meaningZh: （受人咨询的）顾问；会诊医生，（顾问）医生；求教者，（与人）商议者，征求意见者，查阅者，咨询者

examples.text: Of all the consultants, only Mr. Wang gave us some proposals in point.
examples.translationZh: 所有的顾问当中，只有王先生提了一些中肯的建议。

examples.text: The spy's cover was that she was a consultant engineer.
examples.translationZh: 那女间谍伪装成顾问工程师。

examples.text: The consultant was a woman who had many unanswered questions.
examples.translationZh: 这个女性咨询者有许多有待解决的问题。

meaningZh: 建议，意见，暗示；联想，启发；微量

examples.text: What a ridiculous suggestion!
examples.translationZh: 多么荒唐的建议！

examples.text: I put the computer over there at your suggestion.
examples.translationZh: 根据你的建议，我把计算机放在那边了。

examples.text: Can you give me any suggestion on this matter?
examples.translationZh: 关于这件事，你能给我一些建议吗？

meaningZh: 气候；氛围；状况

examples.text: Britain has a temperate climate.
examples.translationZh: 英国气候温和。

examples.text: She adapted herself quickly to the new climate.
examples.translationZh: 她很快就适应了这种新气候。

examples.text: The small city has the climate that is changeable in the extreme.
examples.translationZh: 这座小城有变化多端的气候。

meaningZh: 检查；考试；询问，审问

examples.text: The issue needs further examination.
examples.translationZh: 这个问题需要进一步考查。

examples.text: None of these explanations can stand up under close examination.
examples.translationZh: 这些解释没有一个能经得住严格的考查。

examples.text: I have no other wish except to pass the examination.
examples.translationZh: 我除了要通过考试之外，没有别的心愿。

meaningZh: 孙子；孙女；外孙

examples.text: His grandchild is a naughty boy.
examples.translationZh: 他的孙子是个淘气的男孩。

examples.text: He loves his grandchild very much.
examples.translationZh: 他非常喜欢他的孙儿。

examples.text: Have you no consideration for my grandchild's future?
examples.translationZh: 你就不为我孙女的终身大事想想吗?

meaningZh: 显微镜

examples.text: He focuses the lens of a microscope.
examples.translationZh: 他调整显微镜的透镜以定焦点。

meaningZh: [物]能量；活力；精力

examples.text: Young people usually have more energy than the old.
examples.translationZh: 青年人通常比老年人精力充沛。

examples.text: Don't waste your time and energy on trifles.
examples.translationZh: 别把你的时间和精力浪费在琐事上。

examples.text: Auckland is a city full of energy.
examples.translationZh: 奥克兰是个充满活力的城市。

meaningZh: 我们的，we的所有格形式；我们家；敝

examples.text: He enrolled our names.
examples.translationZh: 他把我们的名字登记下来了。

examples.text: That's not our business.
examples.translationZh: 那事与我们不相干。

examples.text: Our partnership dates back to (ie We have been partners since) 1960.
examples.translationZh: 我们从1960年就合伙了。

meaningZh: 虚伪的；不正的，非法的；假造的，摹造的

examples.text: The impostor traveled on a false passport.
examples.translationZh: 那个伪装者用一本假护照旅行。

examples.text: Lucy had a pair of false eyelashes today.
examples.translationZh: 露西今天戴了一副假睫毛。

examples.text: They lulled me into a false sense of security.
examples.translationZh: 他们哄骗我，让我产生了一种虚假的安全感。

meaningZh: 奇妙的；钦佩的；远超过预期的

examples.text: There was a look of wonder in his eyes.
examples.translationZh: 他眼中露出惊奇的神色。

examples.text: They were filled with wonder at the new waterfall.
examples.translationZh: 他们对新瀑布感到非常惊奇。

examples.text: Colour television is realty a wonder.
examples.translationZh: 彩色电视真是一个奇迹。

meaningZh: 允许；批准，正式认可，认可

examples.text: They entered the area without permission.
examples.translationZh: 他们未经许可擅入该地。

examples.text: You were wrong to take the car without permission.
examples.translationZh: 你未得许可就把汽车开走是不应该的。

examples.text: You must ask permission if you want to leave early.
examples.translationZh: 如果你想早走的话，必须得到允许。

meaningZh: （长篇）小说；[法]新法，附律；adj. 新奇的

examples.text: The novel is considered a brilliant performance.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说被认为是出色的佳作。

examples.text: I like reading novels in my spare time.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢闲暇时读小说。

examples.text: This film is based on a novel by D.H.Lawrence.
examples.translationZh: 这部影片是根据D.

meaningZh: 方面；面貌；方位，方向

examples.text: This is only one aspect of the problem.
examples.translationZh: 这只是问题的一个方面。

examples.text: He has made progress in every aspect.
examples.translationZh: 他在各方面都有起色。

examples.text: The building has a southern aspect.
examples.translationZh: 那座建筑是朝南的。

meaningZh: 通过，穿过；经由；透过

examples.text: The crowd fell back to let the players through.
examples.translationZh: 人群后退让运动员们通过。

examples.text: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water through.
examples.translationZh: 把咖啡放入过滤器里让水流过。

examples.text: "Did you stop in Oxford on the way?""No, we drove straight through."
examples.translationZh: “你们路径牛津时停车了吗？”“没有，我们一直来过来的。”

meaningZh: 赛跑；人种；竞争

examples.text: Every morning he spent two hours training for the race.
examples.translationZh: 他每天早晨花两个小时练习赛跑。

examples.text: We are all involved in a rat race, whether we want to be or not.
examples.translationZh: 不管我们愿不愿意,我们都进行着激烈的竞争。

examples.text: The Chinese belong to the yellow race.
examples.translationZh: 中国人属于黄种人。

meaningZh: 轮胎

examples.text: A bald tyre is no longer safe to use.
examples.translationZh: 磨光了的轮胎用起来不安全。

examples.text: A tyre expands when you pump air into it.
examples.translationZh: 轮胎一打气就鼓起来。

meaningZh: 性格；特点；字母

examples.text: The boy has a strong character.
examples.translationZh: 这孩子个性很强。

examples.text: He is remembered for the nobility of his character.
examples.translationZh: 他因品质高尚而被人怀念。

examples.text: We need only keep track of the last marked character.
examples.translationZh: 我们只要记住最后标记的字符。

meaningZh: 旅游，出行；摔倒，绊倒；绊（使某人跌倒的动作）

examples.text: They planned to make a wedding trip to Paris.
examples.translationZh: 他们计划到巴黎旅行度蜜月。

examples.text: He who carries three baskets must put one on his head, which is apt to tumble and trip him up.
examples.translationZh: 有三只篮子的人就得把一只篮子顶在头上，这样很容易摔倒。

examples.text: He tried to trip me up.
examples.translationZh: 他想把我绊倒。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. (使)结冰霜；vt. 冻坏；vt. 在…上覆以白糖

examples.text: The windscreen was covered with frost.
examples.translationZh: 挡风玻璃上结了霜。

examples.text: Sweet potatoes decayed after the frost.
examples.translationZh: 霜下了之后,地瓜烂掉了。

examples.text: The crops were blasted by frost.
examples.translationZh: 农作物被霜冻毁了。

meaningZh: 真的；真实的，现实的；事实上的

examples.text: Children believe that these characters are real.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们相信这些人物是真实的。

examples.text: His face was drawn but the curtains were real.
examples.translationZh: 他的脸是画的,但窗帘是真的。

examples.text: You will try some real Chinese cuisine this time.
examples.translationZh: 这次您将品尝正宗的中国菜。

meaningZh: 走过；通过；批准

examples.text: The bill passed and became law.
examples.translationZh: 议案通过后成了法律。

examples.text: I passed the store on my way to the library.
examples.translationZh: 我在去图书馆的路上经过了那家商店。

examples.text: Where did you pass the vacation?
examples.translationZh: 你在什么地方度过假期的？

meaningZh: 庙,寺,神殿

examples.text: The heathen temple was torn down by a crowd of religions fanatics.
examples.translationZh: 异教徒的神殿被一群宗教狂热分子拆除了。

examples.text: He who does good comes to the temple gate, he who loves reaches the shrine.
examples.translationZh: 行善者站在神殿门口，博爱者步入殿堂。

examples.text: We reached the temple through an unfrequented mountain track.
examples.translationZh: 我们沿着一条人迹罕至的小径到达了寺庙。

meaningZh: 角落，角；拐角；困境

examples.text: The news soon spread to the farthest corner.
examples.translationZh: 消息很快传到最远的角落。

examples.text: She sat in the corner, watching my every move.
examples.translationZh: 她坐在角落里注视著我的一举一动。

examples.text: She waved to me as she turned the corner.
examples.translationZh: 她拐弯时向我挥了挥手。

meaningZh: 平底锅；盘状的器皿；淘盘子，金盘，秤盘

examples.text: I cracked two eggs into the frying pan.
examples.translationZh: 我往平底锅里打了两个鸡蛋。

examples.text: Take a pan or box and fill it with sand or cat litter.
examples.translationZh: 拿一个盘子或盒子，里面装上沙子或者干草。

examples.text: The water was run off from the pan so that the sand remained.
examples.translationZh: 把淘盘里的水放掉，让沙留着。

meaningZh: 条，棒；（门、窗等的）闩；障碍

examples.text: There are several bars in the hotel.
examples.translationZh: 这家旅馆里有好几个酒吧。

examples.text: A bar of chocolate is enough to stop his crying.
examples.translationZh: 一条巧克力就可以让他不哭了。

examples.text: There's a strong bar on the door.
examples.translationZh: 门上有一个很坚固的闩。

meaningZh: 生存；居住；生活，过活

examples.text: People cannot live without air.
examples.translationZh: 没有空气，人们就不能生存。

examples.text: After she died he had nothing to live for.
examples.translationZh: 她去世后,他便没有了生活目标。

examples.text: He's a tramp and used to living rough.
examples.translationZh: 他是流浪汉,惯于风餐雨卧。

meaningZh: 挑战性的；引起兴趣的；令人深思的

examples.text: Jigsaw puzzle is a very challenging game for me.
examples.translationZh: 拼图对我而言是很具挑战性的游戏。

examples.text: The new play poses some challenging questions.
examples.translationZh: 这出新戏提出了一些富有挑战性的问题。

examples.text: She finds her new job very challenging.
examples.translationZh: 她感到新工作很有挑战性。

meaningZh: 预防；阻碍；阻止

examples.text: Scientists are trying to find ways to prevent disease.
examples.translationZh: 科学家们正试图找到预防疾病的方法。

examples.text: It is the job of the police to prevent crime.
examples.translationZh: 防止犯罪是警察的职责。

examples.text: Nothing can prevent us from carrying out the plan.
examples.translationZh: 什么也无法阻挡我们去实施这个计划。

meaningZh: 猜疑（是）；怀疑，不信任；怀疑…有罪

examples.text: They suspected an ambush.
examples.translationZh: 他们怀疑有埋伏。

examples.text: I suspect he was lying by the boy's abnormal behaviour.
examples.translationZh: 从那个男孩的反常举动中,我怀疑他在撒谎。

examples.text: Just at that time, I began to suspect whether to tell her that matter.
examples.translationZh: 只是在那个时候,我开始怀疑我是否应该告诉她那件事。

meaningZh: 酒馆，酒店；客栈

examples.text: I ran into an old friend in a pub.
examples.translationZh: 我在酒吧碰到了一位老朋友。

examples.text: We make our ritual visit to the pub.
examples.translationZh: 我们照例去了酒吧。

examples.text: I passed the pub on my way to the library.
examples.translationZh: 我在去图书馆的路上经过了那个酒馆。

meaningZh: 恐慌，惊慌；（金融方面）大恐慌；成功

examples.text: There was a panic when the building caught fire.
examples.translationZh: 大楼起火时, 人们一片惊慌。

examples.text: Rumours of an imminent earthquake startled a panic.
examples.translationZh: 谣传即将发生地震引起了一阵恐慌。

examples.text: The thunder panicked the horse.
examples.translationZh: 雷声使马受惊了。

meaningZh: 打扫，清理；扫除；彻底搜索

examples.text: He picked up the broom to help me sweep the floor.
examples.translationZh: 他拿起扫帚帮我扫地。

examples.text: They asked the little boy to sweep the room clean.
examples.translationZh: 他们叫那个小男孩把房间打扫干净。

examples.text: His fingers swept the keys of the piano.
examples.translationZh: 他的手指在钢琴键盘上轻快地移动。

meaningZh: 压，按；逼迫；紧抱

examples.text: Please press the controller to turn the machine on.
examples.translationZh: 请按控制器来开机。

examples.text: Press this button in case of fire.
examples.translationZh: 遇火灾时按下此钮。

examples.text: The book is crumpled and needs press.
examples.translationZh: 书皱了需要压一压。

meaningZh: 奶酪；微笑；vt. 停止

examples.text: This cheese is rather bland.
examples.translationZh: 这干酪没什么味道。

examples.text: The cheese was emitting a strong smell.
examples.translationZh: 干酪散发出强烈的气味。

examples.text: Just have a taste of this cheese!
examples.translationZh: 尝一点儿这种乳酪吧！

meaningZh: 带来，引来；促使，引起；提供

examples.text: She brought her boyfriend to the party.
examples.translationZh: 她带着男朋友来参加聚会。

examples.text: Rot it! I forgot to bring my book with me.
examples.translationZh: 糟了!忘记带书来了。

examples.text: Floods brought destruction to the vally.
examples.translationZh: 洪水给山谷造了大灾害。

meaningZh: 部门，部；系，学部；知识范围

examples.text: He worked in community welfare department.
examples.translationZh: 他在社会福利部工作。

examples.text: He works in the drapery department of the store.
examples.translationZh: 他在商店的纺织品部工作。

examples.text: He was elected the dean of our department.
examples.translationZh: 他被选为我们系的系主任。

meaningZh: 海鸥

examples.text: A seagull fluttered down with an injured wing.
examples.translationZh: 一只海鸥拍打着翅膀飞落下来。

examples.text: We praised the courage of the seagull.
examples.translationZh: 我们赞颂海鸥的勇敢。

meaningZh: 生气；愤怒；怒气

examples.text: His charges were met with cries of anger.
examples.translationZh: 他的指控遭到一阵愤怒的反对声。

examples.text: His face was inflamed with anger.
examples.translationZh: 他的脸因愤怒而涨得通红。

examples.text: He was inflamed with anger.
examples.translationZh: 他满腔怒火。

meaningZh: 家具，有家具的；v. 陈设，布置( furnish的过去式和过去分词)；提供，装备

examples.text: The room was cheaply furnished.
examples.translationZh: 屋里配置了便宜的家具。

examples.text: The room was furnished in warm reds and browns.
examples.translationZh: 这个房间是用红色和棕色装饰的暖色调。

examples.text: The room was furnished in austere style.
examples.translationZh: 这间屋子陈设得简单朴素。

meaningZh: 世界；地球；领域

examples.text: He is the richest man in the world.
examples.translationZh: 他是世界上最富有的人。

examples.text: There is a map of the world on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 墙上有张世界地图。

examples.text: Long ago, people believed that the world was flat.
examples.translationZh: 很久以前人们相信地球是平的。

meaningZh: 鼓掌欢迎，欢呼；称赞，赞许；赞成，同意

examples.text: He leaped to his feet and began to applaud.
examples.translationZh: 他跳起来开始鼓掌。

examples.text: Please don't applaud until everyone has performed.
examples.translationZh: 请在每个人表演完毕后再鼓掌。

examples.text: Should I applaud my husband or chastise him?
examples.translationZh: 我是该称赞还是责罚我的丈夫呢？

meaningZh: 学校；上学；学院

examples.text: She studies in a high school.
examples.translationZh: 她在一所中学学习。

examples.text: Soon, the whole school knew about her win.
examples.translationZh: 不久，全校师生都知道她获胜了。

examples.text: This is the argument of the school.
examples.translationZh: 这就是流行学派的论据。

meaningZh: 席位，座位；所在地；场所

examples.text: He sat down on the nearest available seat.
examples.translationZh: 他在最近的空座位上坐下来。

examples.text: She got on the bus and picked a seat up front.
examples.translationZh: 她上了公车,找了个最前面的座位。

examples.text: His body was flung across the cell and fetched up against the base of the lavatory seat.
examples.translationZh: 他的身体倒到牢房另一头去，掉在便盆的底座前。

meaningZh: 工作，任务；作业；苦差事

examples.text: It's an arduous task.
examples.translationZh: 这是一项艰巨的任务。

examples.text: It is an irksome task.
examples.translationZh: 那是件令人厌烦的工作。

examples.text: Her work is a laborious task.
examples.translationZh: 她的工作很艰苦。

meaningZh: 放置，安置；使处于某种状况；设置

examples.text: He set aside the book and lit a cigarette.
examples.translationZh: 他把书放置在一边,点燃了香烟。

examples.text: How do we set the enrollment criteria?
examples.translationZh: 我们如何设定录取标准?

examples.text: We have set the date for the wedding.
examples.translationZh: 我们已经确定了婚期。

meaningZh: 社交聚会；党，党派；当事人

examples.text: It's a pity that you can't come to the party.
examples.translationZh: 你不能来参加这次聚会，真可惜。

examples.text: There was a liberal supply of drinks at the party.
examples.translationZh: 那次宴会上有大量饮料供应。

examples.text: The Labour party went out in 1980.
examples.translationZh: 工党于1980年下野。

meaningZh: 一套外衣；西装，套装；诉讼

examples.text: It is the convention for men to wear suits on formal occasions.
examples.translationZh: 男子在正式场合穿套装是一种社会习俗。

examples.text: He was dressed in a quiet grey suit and looked very well bred and every inch a gentleman.
examples.translationZh: 他身着素灰色套装，看上去很有涵养，一副绅士派头。

examples.text: She filed a suit against the college for sex discrimination.
examples.translationZh: 她对那所大学提出性别歧视的诉讼。

meaningZh: （动物的）爪；（蟹等的）钳；爪形器具

examples.text: Cats have sharp claws.
examples.translationZh: 猫有锋利的爪子。

examples.text: A hen's claw has three toes.
examples.translationZh: 母鸡的脚爪有三个脚趾。

examples.text: The editor got his claws into the opposition in a vicious editorial.
examples.translationZh: 那个编辑在一篇社论中恶毒地攻击了反对派。

meaningZh: 步行者；行人；adj. 徒步的

examples.text: We enjoy all pedestrian activities.
examples.translationZh: 我们喜欢所有的步行活动。

examples.text: They ought to stop at the pedestrian crossing.
examples.translationZh: 他们该停在人行横道上。

examples.text: He was rather a pedestrian student.
examples.translationZh: 他原是个相当平常的学生。

meaningZh: 流畅的；流利的；液态的

examples.text: She speaks fluent and idiomatic French.
examples.translationZh: 她说得一口又流利又地道的法语。

examples.text: She likes him all the better for his fluent spoken English.
examples.translationZh: 正因为他操一口流利的英语，她更爱他。

examples.text: His work is rather fluent and felicitous.
examples.translationZh: 他的作品十分流畅，措辞巧妙。

meaningZh: 力量；优点，长处；（光、声、色等的）力度

examples.text: I have hardly enough strength left to move my feet.
examples.translationZh: 我连移动双脚的力气都几乎没有了。

examples.text: In this game, you need more science than strength.
examples.translationZh: 在这项比赛中，技巧比力气更重要。

examples.text: By doing so, you can test the strength of steel.
examples.translationZh: 这样做,你可以试验一下钢的强度。

meaningZh: 很好吃的

examples.text: This cake is really yummy.
examples.translationZh: 蛋糕非常美味。

examples.text: Chocolate cake for tea? How yummy!
examples.translationZh: 有巧克力蛋糕当茶点? 多好吃啊！

examples.text: I could eat a whole pot of that hot, yummy carrot.
examples.translationZh: 我可以吃一锅那样的又热又好吃的胡萝卜。

meaningZh: 冷静的；凉爽的；一流的

examples.text: A brisk walk in cool weather is invigorating.
examples.translationZh: 在凉爽的天气里轻松地散步令人心旷神怡。

examples.text: A cool breeze blew from the lake.
examples.translationZh: 湖边吹来了一阵凉凉的微风。

examples.text: As it was a hot day, she wore a cool dress.
examples.translationZh: 因为天气热,她穿了一件凉快的衣服。

meaningZh: 绿色的；未熟的，青春的；未成熟的

examples.text: The paper turned green as if by magic.
examples.translationZh: 这纸魔术般地变成了绿色。

examples.text: The green fields came into sight.
examples.translationZh: 一片绿色的田野展现在眼前。

examples.text: The country is very green in spring.
examples.translationZh: 春天的时候，乡村一片青葱碧绿。

meaningZh: 和，与；而且；于是，然后

examples.text: My father and mother went for a walk.
examples.translationZh: 爸爸妈妈去散步了。

examples.text: She majored in maths and physics (at university).
examples.translationZh: 她(在大学)主修数学和物理。

examples.text: She demonstrated that 2 and 2 are four.
examples.translationZh: 她证明2加2等于四。

meaningZh: 彻底的，全面的，充分的，彻头彻尾的，根本的，详尽的，严密的；十足的，考虑周到的；非常精确的，（对细节）不厌其烦的

examples.text: I gave the radio a thorough inspection before buying it.
examples.translationZh: 我把收音机彻底检查了一遍才买了下来。

examples.text: We are trying to get a thorough understanding of the government's fiscal policy.
examples.translationZh: 我们正努力对政府的财政政策进行全面的了解。

examples.text: She underwent a thorough examination at the hospital.
examples.translationZh: 她在医院里接受了全面检查。

meaningZh: 放；表达；给予（重视、信任、价值等）

examples.text: He put his hands in his pockets.
examples.translationZh: 他把手放在口袋里。

examples.text: She put the grapes onto the platter.
examples.translationZh: 她把葡萄放到一个大盘子上。

examples.text: Put down my pen and stop fiddling!
examples.translationZh: 把我的钢笔放下，别用手玩弄！

meaningZh: 圆腹雅罗鱼

examples.text: Hey! I've got this really good ide we make this investment which will bring us a lot of benefits.
examples.translationZh: 嘿！我有一个非常好的主意：我们进行投资，这会给我们带来很多的利润。

meaningZh: 试验；[法]审讯，审判；磨难，困难

examples.text: He went through hell during the trial.
examples.translationZh: 审讯期间他吃尽了苦头。

examples.text: The flier is flying a new-type jet plane on trial.
examples.translationZh: 飞行员正在驾驶一架新式喷气机作试验飞行。

examples.text: She agreed to employ me for a trial period.
examples.translationZh: 她同意试用我一段时间。

meaningZh: 腰，腰部；（衣服的）腰身；船腰

examples.text: Her hair nearly reached down to her waist.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发几乎垂到了腰部。

examples.text: She wears a ribbon belt round her waist.
examples.translationZh: 她在腰部束了一条缎带。

examples.text: If the skirt is too big, we can take in the waist.
examples.translationZh: 要是裙子太大了，我们可以把腰部收紧一些。

meaningZh: 唯一的；仅有的；最好的，最适当的

examples.text: This colt is only two months old.
examples.translationZh: 这只小雄驹只有两个月大。

examples.text: He had only a few coppers with him.
examples.translationZh: 他身边只有几枚铜币。

examples.text: You're only a child in his eyes.
examples.translationZh: 在他眼里你仅仅是个孩子。

meaningZh: 回转，返回；复发，又来；送还

examples.text: We must return to Dalian within three days.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须在3日内回到大连。

examples.text: What time does your husband return from work?
examples.translationZh: 你丈夫什么时候下班回家？

examples.text: Don't forget to return my keys.
examples.translationZh: 别忘了还我钥匙。

meaningZh: 干的干燥的，干旱的；干旱的，口渴的；干咳的

examples.text: The soil is too dry for planting.
examples.translationZh: 土太干了，不能种东西。

examples.text: After these dry days, everyone hopes for rain.
examples.translationZh: 干燥的天气之后，人人都希望下雨。

examples.text: We should prepare for more dry weather.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该为更干旱的天气做准备。

meaningZh: 成功的，如愿以偿的

examples.text: She made a successful debut.
examples.translationZh: 她初次登台获得成功。

examples.text: He aims to be a successful writer.
examples.translationZh: 他的目标是成为一个成功的作家。

examples.text: They are highly successful in business.
examples.translationZh: 他们经商非常成功。

meaningZh: 感觉；认为；触摸

examples.text: Can you feel the tension in this room?
examples.translationZh: 你能觉察出这房间里的紧张气氛吗？

examples.text: Take a deep breath, and you will feel relaxed.
examples.translationZh: 深深地吸一口气,那样你会觉得轻松的。

examples.text: She felt the child's forehead to see if he was feverish.
examples.translationZh: 她摸孩子的前额去看他是不是发烧了。

meaningZh: 声音，声响；音调，声调；声波

examples.text: The man was gone: his footsteps made no sound.
examples.translationZh: 那人走了,他的脚步没有发出一点声音。

examples.text: I caught a curious sound in the neighboring room.
examples.translationZh: 我听到隔壁房间里有奇怪的响声。

examples.text: He plays an original jazz-gospel sound.
examples.translationZh: 他演奏了一曲自己独创的爵士福音。

meaningZh: （空间）在近处；在附近；（时间）临近

examples.text: His flat's very near.
examples.translationZh: 他的公寓就在附近。

examples.text: We will meet in Beijing in the near future.
examples.translationZh: 在不久的将来，我们将在北京见面。

examples.text: The supermarket is very near to the station.
examples.translationZh: 超级市场离车站很近。

meaningZh: 鱼，鱼肉，鱼类；〈口〉（特殊的）人物，家伙，东西；[建]接合板，夹片，鱼尾板

examples.text: We caught three little fishes.
examples.translationZh: 我们捉到三条小鱼。

examples.text: The fish plopped back into the river.
examples.translationZh: 那鱼扑通一声跃回河中。

examples.text: There is much fish on the plate.
examples.translationZh: 盘子里有不少鱼肉。

meaningZh: 把…借给；贷（款）；贡献，给予

examples.text: Would you please lend me your pencil?
examples.translationZh: 请把铅笔借给我用用好吗？

examples.text: I can't possibly lend you so much money.
examples.translationZh: 我没有可能借给你这麽多钱。

examples.text: The bank refused to lend the money to us.
examples.translationZh: 银行拒绝向我们贷款。

meaningZh: 两星期，十四天

examples.text: It's a fortnight to National Day.
examples.translationZh: 离国庆节还有两星期。

examples.text: The patient lived out another fortnight.
examples.translationZh: 病人又活了两星期。

examples.text: I'd get a sickening sense of dread for the fortnight leading up to them, knowing that I would become a sleep-deprived grumpy, spotty hermit.
examples.translationZh: 十四天的夜班后我发现感到胆战心惊的害怕，我很清楚的知道自己会变成一个睡眠不足的，性情乖戾情绪不稳的隐士。

meaningZh: 雕刻（术），塑像；雕刻品；刻纹

examples.text: He was a professor of sculpture at the Academy.
examples.translationZh: 他在学院是一位雕塑教授。

examples.text: The smooth contour of the sculpture is wonderful.
examples.translationZh: 雕塑物平滑的轮廓线简直太美了。

examples.text: She studied sculpture at art school.
examples.translationZh: 她在美术学校学习雕刻。

meaningZh: 高尔夫球；高尔夫球运动；vi. 打高尔夫球

examples.text: Let's play a round of golf.
examples.translationZh: 我们打一场高尔夫球吧。

examples.text: I have a special liking for golf.
examples.translationZh: 我特别喜欢高尔夫球运动。

examples.text: He won the golf match by two shots.
examples.translationZh: 他以两杆的成绩赢得了这场高尔夫球赛。

meaningZh: 向上的，上升的；升高的；adv. 向上地，上升地

examples.text: We must keep a healthy and upward mood.
examples.translationZh: 要保持健康向上的心态。

examples.text: An upward force must be exerted on it so as to lift an object.
examples.translationZh: 要提起重物必须向它施加一个向上的力。

examples.text: Prices continue to show an upward tendency.
examples.translationZh: 物价继续呈现上升的趋势。

meaningZh: 地球；陆地；泥土

examples.text: The moon goes round the earth.
examples.translationZh: 月亮绕着地球转。

examples.text: What percentage of the earth is covered by oceans?
examples.translationZh: 地球上百分之多少被海水覆盖着？

examples.text: He dived his hand into the earth.
examples.translationZh: 他将手插入泥土中。

meaningZh: 药丸；弹丸；口服避孕药

examples.text: Father must take his pill on the hour.
examples.translationZh: 父亲必须在每点钟准点吃药丸。

examples.text: The baby spat out the nasty pill.
examples.translationZh: 婴儿吐出了难吃的药丸。

examples.text: This pill will help to settle your nerves.
examples.translationZh: 你吃了这片药神经就不那麽紧张了。

meaningZh: 导弹；投射物；adj. 导弹的

examples.text: The missile deflected from its trajectory.
examples.translationZh: 导弹已偏离轨道。

examples.text: The smallest deflection of the missile could bring disaster.
examples.translationZh: 导弹有极微小的偏斜也可能酿出大祸。

examples.text: The missile had blown the battleship asunder.
examples.translationZh: 炮弹把战舰炸碎了。
