meaningZh: 许可，准许；默许，放任；允许，容许

examples.text: You can't work here without a work permit.
examples.translationZh: 你没有许可证就不能在这里工作。

examples.text: He said that if he had a permit he could get a job.
examples.translationZh: 他说如果他有执照就能找到工作。

examples.text: I'll come after the meeting if time permits.
examples.translationZh: 如果时间许可的话，我开完会就来。

meaningZh: （为…）服务；任（职）；提供

examples.text: We must serve the people heart and soul.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须全心全意地为人民服务。

examples.text: The waiter is serving another customer.
examples.translationZh: 侍应正侍候另一位客人。

examples.text: He served as a naval officer during the war.
examples.translationZh: 战时他在海军当军官。

meaningZh: 弯曲的；决心的；腐败的

examples.text: The branches bent in the wind.
examples.translationZh: 树枝被风吹弯了。

examples.text: Judy bent her face low over the notebook.
examples.translationZh: 朱迪把脸凑近笔记本。

examples.text: The branch bent but didn't break when the boy climbed along it.
examples.translationZh: 那男孩爬上树枝时，树枝弯曲了，但是没有折断。

meaningZh: 食糖；一匙糖；宝贝儿，亲爱的

examples.text: I bought him a packet of sugar.
examples.translationZh: 我给他买了一袋糖果。

examples.text: He put some sugar into his coffee.
examples.translationZh: 他往咖啡里加了些糖。

examples.text: If the lemonade tastes bitter,sugar it.
examples.translationZh: 如果柠檬水发苦，就加糖。

meaningZh: 离开；遗弃；忘了带

examples.text: I will leave you to attend to the matter .
examples.translationZh: 我委托你办此事。

examples.text: You can leave it with us for safe keeping for no more than a month, or abandon it.
examples.translationZh: 您可以委托我们替您保管，但为期只有一个月时间，或者您选择放弃。

examples.text: I leave the gay saloon of New York for the green glade of the country.
examples.translationZh: 我离开了纽约欢乐的酒店，来到乡村绿色的林间空地。

meaningZh: 实验，试验；尝试；vi. 做实验，进行试验

examples.text: The researchers are repeating the experiment on rats.
examples.translationZh: 研究人员用老鼠反覆做该试验。

examples.text: The students will have an experiment in the laboratory tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 学生们明天要在实验室里做实验。

examples.text: Fortunately, these folks love to experiment.
examples.translationZh: 幸运的是，你们喜欢尝试。

meaningZh: 股；（参与、得到等的）份；（分享到的或贡献出的）一份

examples.text: Children should be taught to share their toys.
examples.translationZh: 应该教育孩子们分享玩具。

examples.text: Keep your fears to yourself but share your courage with others.
examples.translationZh: 把恐惧留给自己,和他人分享勇气。

examples.text: Share the fruit among your friends.
examples.translationZh: 把水果分给你的朋友们。

meaningZh: 妈妈

examples.text: I talk to my mom on the phone every Saturday.
examples.translationZh: 我每个周六给母亲打电话。

examples.text: My mom used to make the best peanut brittle.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈过去经常做最好吃的花生糖。

meaningZh: 全部的；整个的；全体的

examples.text: I am in entire agreement with you.
examples.translationZh: 我完全同意你。

examples.text: The entire population was wiped out by the terrible disease.
examples.translationZh: 所有的居民都被可怕的疾病夺去了生命。

examples.text: He wrote the entire play in only two weeks.
examples.translationZh: 整个剧本只花了他两个星期时间。

meaningZh: 胡桃（树）；胡桃木；胡桃木色

examples.text: Walnut is a local specialty here.
examples.translationZh: 核桃是此地的土特产。

examples.text: Fruit trees, large patio area, Walnut school dist.
examples.translationZh: 果树，庭院面积大，是属于核桃学区。

examples.text: The dining table and chairs are all in black walnut.
examples.translationZh: 餐桌及椅子都是黑核桃木的。

meaningZh: 帮助；恩惠；赞同

examples.text: Would you please do me a favour, Ben?
examples.translationZh: 本，你能帮助我吗?

examples.text: May I ask a favour of you?
examples.translationZh: 请你帮帮忙好吗?

examples.text: The prevalent opinion is in favour of reform.
examples.translationZh: 一般舆论都支持改革。

meaningZh: 钉；别针，扣针，饰针；大头针

examples.text: I bought a tie pin for my husband yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 昨天我给丈夫买了一支领带别针。

examples.text: He pinned the notice to the board.
examples.translationZh: 他把通知钉在布告牌上。

examples.text: Pin the bills together so you don't lose them.
examples.translationZh: 把账单别在一起以防遗失。

meaningZh: 价钱，代价；花费，费用；牺牲

examples.text: We calculated the cost of building a new house .
examples.translationZh: 我们计算了造1座新房子的费用。

examples.text: We have to sum up the costs of production.
examples.translationZh: 我们得计算一下生产成本。

examples.text: I'm determined to attain my purpose at any cost.
examples.translationZh: 我决心不惜任何代价达到目的。

meaningZh: 锡；罐头盒；马口铁

examples.text: We fuse copper and tin to make bronze.
examples.translationZh: 我们把铜和锡熔制成青铜。

examples.text: They'd mined the hillside for tin.
examples.translationZh: 他们曾在小山坡上开采锡。

examples.text: I caught her with her fingers in the biscuit tin.
examples.translationZh: 我看见她手指还在饼干盒里呢。

meaningZh: 大使馆；大使馆全体成员；大使的职务（地位）

examples.text: The terrorists have occupied the Embassy.
examples.translationZh: 恐怖分子占领了大使馆。

examples.text: A crowd had already collected outside the embassy gates.
examples.translationZh: 使馆大门外已经聚集了一群人。

examples.text: Two attaches at the embassy were expelled from the country.
examples.translationZh: 大使馆的两名随员已驱逐出境。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. 希望,期望；[C]希望,期望；有希望的人或事物

examples.text: I hope to announce the winner shortly.
examples.translationZh: 我希望马上宣布胜利者的名字。

examples.text: After these dry days, everyone hopes for rain.
examples.translationZh: 干燥的天气之后，人人都希望下雨。

examples.text: I hope he will be adequate to the job.
examples.translationZh: 我希望他将胜任这一工作。

meaningZh: 垃圾；无意义的东西；废话

examples.text: The dustman comes once a week to collect the rubbish.
examples.translationZh: 垃圾工每周来收一次垃圾。

examples.text: That new TV show is absolutely rubbish.
examples.translationZh: 那个新的电视节目一点儿价值都没有。

examples.text: He was gulled into buying rubbish.
examples.translationZh: 他被骗买了废物。

meaningZh: 嘴唇；（杯，壶等的）口，边缘；〈俚〉无理的回答

examples.text: He kissed her on the lips.
examples.translationZh: 他吻了她的嘴唇。

examples.text: She bit her lip to keep from crying.
examples.translationZh: 她咬着嘴唇克制着自己不要哭。

examples.text: After a moment's hesitation she lipped her request.
examples.translationZh: 她犹豫了一会儿,然後轻声提出请求。

meaningZh: 茄子

examples.text: The braised eggplant is delicious today.
examples.translationZh: 今天的红烧茄子很好吃。

meaningZh: 原子；原子能；微粒，微量

examples.text: Scientists have unlocked the secret of the atom.
examples.translationZh: 科学家已经揭开了原子的秘密。

examples.text: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

examples.text: The atom bomb is the offspring of the 20th century physics.
examples.translationZh: 原子弹是20世纪物理学的产物。

meaningZh: 苦干的，不辞辛劳的；用功；昧旦晨兴

examples.text: She is considered to be the most hardworking in the office.
examples.translationZh: 她被认为是办公室最努力工作的人。

examples.text: China is full of hardworking people.
examples.translationZh: 中国到处都是勤奋的人。

examples.text: Hardworking students may see a quick improvement in their English level after a few weeks of study at our school.
examples.translationZh: 勤奋的学生在我们的学校学习几个星期以后他们的英语水平就会有很明显的进步。

meaningZh: 疾病；恶心；呕吐

examples.text: Chicken pox is a common childhood sickness.
examples.translationZh: 水痘是一种常见的儿童期疾病。

examples.text: The holy man healed them of their sickness.
examples.translationZh: 那位神职人员治好了他们的疾病。

examples.text: The boy didn't take the exam under the pretence of sickness.
examples.translationZh: 那个男孩借口生病没有参加考试。

meaningZh: 飞行员；引航员；向导

examples.text: A pilot must be awake to the changes in the weather.
examples.translationZh: 飞行员必须警觉天气的变化。

examples.text: Mark used to be a pilot on the Mississippi River.
examples.translationZh: 马克曾在密西西比河上当过领航员。

examples.text: JULES I think her biggest deal was she starred in a pilot.
examples.translationZh: 朱尔斯：我想她最重要的演出是在一个试片里担任主角。

meaningZh: 问题；疑难问题；习题

examples.text: That's your problem.
examples.translationZh: 那是你的问题。

examples.text: We had no time to deliberate on the problem.
examples.translationZh: 我们没有时间仔细思考这个问题.

examples.text: The problem is when to get the money we need.
examples.translationZh: 问题是什么时候能得到我们所需要的钱。

meaningZh: 传达，传递；运送，输送；[法]让与，转让（财产等）

examples.text: I find it hard to convey my feelings in word.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得难以用言语表达我的感情。

examples.text: Word will suffice to convey his grief.
examples.translationZh: 他的悲伤足以用言辞表达。

examples.text: A vibrating membrane in the ear helps to convey sounds to the brain.
examples.translationZh: 耳膜的振动帮助声音传送到大脑。

meaningZh: 系牢，钉牢；使坚固或稳固；使合在一起：封合

examples.text: Do not fasten all the windows up while you sleep.
examples.translationZh: 睡觉时不要将所有的窗户都关紧。

examples.text: For your own safety,please fasten your seat belts.
examples.translationZh: 安全起见，请系紧安全带。

examples.text: I fastened the pages together with a paperclip.
examples.translationZh: 我用一个纸夹把那几页纸夹在一起。

meaningZh: 任何一个；无论哪个；究竟哪一个

examples.text: Whichever nation explodes an atomic bomb will engage the whole world in war.
examples.translationZh: 无论哪个国家使用原子弹都会使全世界卷入战争。

examples.text: Whichever nation explodes an atomic bomb will engage the whole world in war.
examples.translationZh: 无论哪个国家使用原子弹都会使全世界卷入战争。

meaningZh: 培根；熏猪肉；咸猪肉

examples.text: I'll plump for bacon and eggs rather than breakfast cereal.
examples.translationZh: 我宁愿吃咸肉和鸡蛋，而不愿吃谷类制作的早餐食品。

examples.text: The bacon is all frizzled up!
examples.translationZh: 腌肉都煎糊了！

examples.text: I'll rustle up some eggs and bacon for you.
examples.translationZh: 我给你弄些鸡蛋和腌猪肉。

meaningZh: 可选择的；随意的，任意的；非强制的

examples.text: The insurance cover is optional.
examples.translationZh: 保险范围可以随意选择。

examples.text: It is optional with you.
examples.translationZh: 那是你的自由。

examples.text: The goods are optional, but only one.
examples.translationZh: 这些物品是可以任选的, 但只能选一个。

meaningZh: 大大地；夸大地；详细地

examples.text: Shanghai is a large city.
examples.translationZh: 上海是一个大城市。

examples.text: The oceans are large bodies of water.
examples.translationZh: 海洋是广大的水域。

examples.text: The hill was surmounted with a large castle.
examples.translationZh: 小山上有一座巨大的城堡。

meaningZh: 树枝,枝条；分支,分科,分系；vi. 出枝

examples.text: Can we drop the car off at any of your branch?
examples.translationZh: 我们可以在你们的任何一家分公司还车吗？

examples.text: Mr. Smith works in an executive branch of the government.
examples.translationZh: 史密斯先生在政府的行政部门工作。

examples.text: Send these orders down to our branch office.
examples.translationZh: 把这些订货单发送到我们的分店。

meaningZh: 小路，小道；痕迹，踪迹；轨道，音轨

examples.text: The tram is being switched on to another track .
examples.translationZh: 电车正被移至另外一条轨道上。

examples.text: The cyclist went at full sail along the track.
examples.translationZh: 自行车手沿着跑道全速前进。

examples.text: I quickly lose her track in the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 我在人群中失去了她的踪迹。

meaningZh: 羔羊，小羊；羔羊肉；耶稣

examples.text: The lamb had to be brought up by hand.
examples.translationZh: 这只小羊要用奶瓶喂养。

examples.text: The dying lamb fell, its legs flailing (about) helplessly.
examples.translationZh: 小羊快要死了，倒在地上四条腿又踢又蹬。

examples.text: Veal is young beef and lamb is a baby sheep.
examples.translationZh: 小牛肉是小牛犊身上的肉，小羊肉是羔羊身上的肉。

meaningZh: 地位较高的；上面的；内地的

examples.text: The upper valley is also noted for its valuable woodland and birds.
examples.translationZh: 在较高的山谷也有不少珍贵树林和雀鸟。

examples.text: He locked his diary in the upper drawer.
examples.translationZh: 他把日记锁在上层抽屉里。

examples.text: She lived in one of the upper rooms.
examples.translationZh: 她住在上面的房间之一。

meaningZh: 运动；竞选运动；战役

examples.text: The campaign was a blockbuster.
examples.translationZh: 这次竞选运动声势浩大。

examples.text: They are planning a new campaign against corruption.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在策划一个新的反贪污运动。

examples.text: The campaign to seize the city was a failure.
examples.translationZh: 攻占这个城市的战役失败了。

meaningZh: 车辆；交通工具；传播媒介，媒介物

examples.text: No entry for vehicle!
examples.translationZh: 禁止车辆入内！

examples.text: It is time for the yearly check of vehicle safety.
examples.translationZh: 到车辆安全年审的时间了。

examples.text: Subway is a convenient vehicle for those white collars.
examples.translationZh: 地铁对于白领阶层来说是很方便的交通工具。

meaningZh: 酒精的，含酒精的；酒精中毒的；n. 酗酒者，酒鬼

examples.text: Alcoholic drink can have a bad effect on your body.
examples.translationZh: 含酒精的饮料会对你身体有很坏的影响。

examples.text: Prohibit the sale of alcoholic beverages.
examples.translationZh: 禁止出售含酒精的饮料。

examples.text: Alcoholic drink can have a bad effect on your body.
examples.translationZh: 含酒精的饮料会对你身体有很坏的影响。

meaningZh: 存在；生物；人

examples.text: I don't like being pent up in the house all the time.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢整天给关在屋子里。

examples.text: It is fun eating by stealth without being found.
examples.translationZh: 偷吃而不被人发现很有趣。

examples.text: Earthenware has an advantage over wood in being more easily kept clean.
examples.translationZh: 陶器的优点在于比木器更容易保持清洁。

meaningZh: 意识到的；知道的；觉察到的

examples.text: If you were aware of all that, you would change your mind.
examples.translationZh: 如果你知道了那一切,你会改变主意的。

examples.text: Then he became aware that they were regarding him with interest.
examples.translationZh: 这时,他意识到他们都在饶有兴趣地看着他。

meaningZh: 律师，法学家

examples.text: His lawyer decided to take an appeal to a higher court.
examples.translationZh: 他的律师决定向高一级法院上诉。

examples.text: Nothing can weaken his resolve to become a lawyer.
examples.translationZh: 什么也动摇不了他要当律师的决心。

examples.text: A good lawyer can always find a loophole.
examples.translationZh: 精明的律师总能找到漏洞。

meaningZh: 螺母，螺帽；坚果，坚果果仁；难对付的人

examples.text: He carefully cracked a nut and then give it to me.
examples.translationZh: 他仔细敲开一颗坚果,然后递给了我。

examples.text: The little boy is trying to crack the shell open to get at the nut
examples.translationZh: 这个小男孩在使劲敲破外壳取得果仁。

examples.text: When we turn the nut, we raise or lower the bob.
examples.translationZh: 我们一转动螺母，就会升高或降低摆锤。

meaningZh: 几乎不；简直不；刚刚

examples.text: Hardly anybody came.
examples.translationZh: 几乎没有人来。

examples.text: He could hardly refrain himself.
examples.translationZh: 他几乎不能自制。

examples.text: The desert air contains hardly any moisture.
examples.translationZh: 沙漠的空气几乎不含一点湿气。

meaningZh: 唯一的，仅有的；独一无二的，独特的；不平常的，特别的

examples.text: He occupies a unique place in English literature.
examples.translationZh: 他在英国文学中占有独特的地位。

examples.text: The elephant's trunk is a unique form of appendage.
examples.translationZh: 象的鼻子是一种独特的附肢。

examples.text: It's a unique work of art.
examples.translationZh: 这是独一无二的艺术作品。

meaningZh: 章，回；（俱乐部、协会等的）分会；人生或历史上的重要时期

examples.text: One of the funniest episodes in the book occurs in chapter 6.
examples.translationZh: 书中最有趣的情节是在第6章。

examples.text: He has got prepared to write a new chapter.
examples.translationZh: 他已经准备动手写新的一章。

examples.text: Let us revert to the earlier part of the chapter.
examples.translationZh: 让我们回到本章的前面部分。

meaningZh: 许可；许可证；放纵

examples.text: His licence was suspended for drunk driving.
examples.translationZh: 他的驾驶执照因酗酒开车被暂时吊销。

examples.text: Applicant shall hold a valid driving licence.
examples.translationZh: 申请者须有持效的驾驶执照。

examples.text: He grants his neighbour a licence to use his field.
examples.translationZh: 他许可他的邻居使用他的一块地。

meaningZh: 释义 [人名] 齐珀

examples.text: The zipper is a wonderful invention.
examples.translationZh: 拉链是个了不起的发明。

examples.text: No, seriously, your zipper's down.
examples.translationZh: 不，认真的，你的拉链开拉。

meaningZh: 他[她，它]们自己；他们亲自；“himself”的复数

examples.text: They finished the work by themselves.
examples.translationZh: 他们自己完成了这项工作。

examples.text: They demand the right to govern themselves.
examples.translationZh: 他们要求自治权。

examples.text: They painted the house themselves.
examples.translationZh: 他们亲自油漆了房屋。

meaningZh: 代替，替换，代用；n. 代替者；替补（运动员）

examples.text: Water is not a proper substitute for wine.
examples.translationZh: 水不是酒的适当代用品。

examples.text: Is saccharin a good substitute for sugar?
examples.translationZh: 糖精是糖的良好替代品吗?

examples.text: We recommend this brand as a good substitute.
examples.translationZh: 我们推荐的新品种可以完全替代原来的产品。

meaningZh: 蜂蜜；〈口〉亲爱的; 宝贝；可爱的东西

examples.text: This jar of pure honey weighs 350 grams net.
examples.translationZh: 这瓶纯蜂蜜净重三百五十克。

examples.text: We can use honey as a substitute of sugar.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以蜂蜜作为糖的代替品。

examples.text: Love is a mixture of honey and bitterness.
examples.translationZh: 爱情混杂着甜蜜和苦涩。

meaningZh: 胜利；克服；成功

examples.text: The soldiers exulted at their victory.
examples.translationZh: 战士们为取得胜利而欢跃。

examples.text: I have every reason to be confident of our victory.
examples.translationZh: 我有充分的理由坚信胜利是属于我们的。

examples.text: People in the city held a great party to celebrate their victory.
examples.translationZh: 本市的市民举行了盛大的晚会庆祝他们的胜利。

meaningZh: 蝙蝠；短棍，（棒球等的）球棒，（网球等的）球拍；白话，口语，成语，俗话

examples.text: He just tipped the ball with his bat.
examples.translationZh: 他只是用球棒擦击来球。

examples.text: The other boys coveted his new bat.
examples.translationZh: 其他的男孩都想得到他的新球棒。

examples.text: I want to buy a new tennis bat.
examples.translationZh: 我想要买一个新网球拍。

meaningZh: 紧的，牢固的；绷紧的；不漏的

examples.text: This pair of trousers is too tight for me.
examples.translationZh: 这条裤子我穿太紧了。

examples.text: This drawer is too tight for me to open it.
examples.translationZh: 这抽屉太紧了，我打不开。

examples.text: That fat woman looked ridiculous in her tight golden dress.
examples.translationZh: 那位胖妇人穿着金色的紧身礼服，显得滑稽可笑。

meaningZh: 公元前（基督教会历法用）；British Columbia （加拿大）不列颠哥伦比亚省；bachelor of commerce 化学学士

examples.text: This temple was built in 200 BC.
examples.translationZh: 这座寺庙建于公元前200年。

meaningZh: 丝，蚕丝；丝绸，丝织物；（用于缝纫的）丝线

examples.text: A cocoon is a kind of silk covering made by an insect.
examples.translationZh: 蚕茧是由昆虫制造的一种由丝组成的外包层。

examples.text: She has a scarf made of a triangular piece of blue silk.
examples.translationZh: 她有一条用三角形蓝绸子做的围巾。

examples.text: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
examples.translationZh: 他们的主要出口货物是纺织品，特别是丝绸和棉布。

meaningZh: 胡须；[虫]口鬃，[动]颌毛；（牡蛎等的）鳃

examples.text: Why don't you shave your beard off?
examples.translationZh: 你怎麽不把胡子刮掉?

examples.text: To my great amusement his false beard fell off.
examples.translationZh: 使我感到极其好笑的是他的假胡子掉下来了。

examples.text: He thought I was not brave enough to beard him, but he was wrong because I did it.
examples.translationZh: 他以为我没有那么大勇气向他挑战，但是他错了，我就这么做了。

meaningZh: 放弃，抛弃；离弃，丢弃；使屈从

examples.text: Those who abandon themselves to despair can not succeed.
examples.translationZh: 那些自暴自弃的人无法成功。

examples.text: Despite some difficulties, they're not going to abandon the plan.
examples.translationZh: 尽管他们遇到了一些困难,但并不打算放弃这个计划。

examples.text: The cruel man abandoned his wife and child.
examples.translationZh: 那个狠心的男人抛弃了他的妻儿。

meaningZh: 美元；一元纸[硬]币；金钱

examples.text: The Japanese yen rebounded against the dollar.
examples.translationZh: 日元与美元的比价回升了。

examples.text: Can you lend me five dollars?
examples.translationZh: 你能借给我五美元吗？

examples.text: The pound stayed firm against dollar in London but fell a little in New York.
examples.translationZh: 在伦敦英镑对美元仍坚挺，但在纽约却跌了一点儿。

meaningZh: 著作家；作者；创造者

examples.text: This book shows that he is an ingenious author.
examples.translationZh: 这本书表明他是一个有创造力的作家。

examples.text: The book was translated without the sanction of the author.
examples.translationZh: 这本书未经作者许可就给翻译了。

examples.text: The book is authored by six leading historians.
examples.translationZh: 这本书由六名权威的历史学家编写而成。

meaningZh: 最近的；新近的；近代的

examples.text: Recent discoveries will bear his prediction out.
examples.translationZh: 近来的种种发现将会证实他的预言。

examples.text: The government's control over the newspapers has loosened in recent years.
examples.translationZh: 近年来政府对报纸的控制已经变松了。

examples.text: The teapot looked old but was a recent fake.
examples.translationZh: "这把茶壶貌似古董,却是一件新近制作的赝品。"

meaningZh: 真理；真相，事实；忠实，忠诚

examples.text: It is far from the truth.
examples.translationZh: 这哪里是事实。

examples.text: The truth verified the allegations.
examples.translationZh: 事实证明了这些说法。

examples.text: Practice is the sole criterion of truth.
examples.translationZh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准。

meaningZh: 邻居；邻近的人[物]；邻国

examples.text: My neighbour is always putting on airs.
examples.translationZh: 我的邻居总是装腔作势。

examples.text: I'll board out my children with my neighbour.
examples.translationZh: 我将把孩子们寄在邻居家膳宿。

examples.text: When the big tree fell, it brought down two of its smaller neighbours.
examples.translationZh: 那棵大树一倒把附近的两棵小树也弄倒了。

meaningZh: （心脏等）跳动；搜索；（风、雨等）吹打

examples.text: His father beat the disobedient boy.
examples.translationZh: 他的父亲打那个不听话的男孩。

examples.text: If we don't prepare for the speech contest, they will beat us.
examples.translationZh: 如果这场演讲比赛我们不做好准备的话,他们就会打败我们。

examples.text: He's alive；his heart is still beating.
examples.translationZh: 他还活著－－心脏还在跳。

meaningZh: 图书馆，藏书楼；藏书；书屋，书斋

examples.text: The town has its own public library and public gardens.
examples.translationZh: 那城市有自己的公用图书馆和公园。

examples.text: In the library, the books on history are all kept in one bay.
examples.translationZh: 在图书馆里，历史方面的书都放在同一隔间里。

examples.text: Professor Hunter has a library of about five thousand books.
examples.translationZh: 汉特教授约有五千册藏书。

meaningZh: 过程；工序；做事方法

examples.text: Building a car is a long process.
examples.translationZh: 制造一辆小汽车有很长的工序。

examples.text: They went over every process again, but without result.
examples.translationZh: 他们把每道工序又检查了一遍，却仍没有结果。

examples.text: Growth and decay are vital processes.
examples.translationZh: 生长和衰亡是生命过程。

meaningZh: 炊具；锅；炉灶

examples.text: The cooker has several temperature settings.
examples.translationZh: 这个炉具有几个温度定位挡。

examples.text: Clean the area round the cooker.
examples.translationZh: 把炊具周围弄干净。

examples.text: These apples are good cookers.
examples.translationZh: 这些苹果宜於烹饪.

meaningZh: 在明天，在明日；n. 明天；最近，不远的将来

examples.text: We will play basketball tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 我们明天打篮球。

examples.text: I will take an examination tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我将参加一场考试。

examples.text: If weather permits, we will go to the park tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 如果天气好的话,明天我们去公园。

meaningZh: (who的宾格)谁

examples.text: I don't know whom he has in mind for the job.
examples.translationZh: 我不知道他想让谁来做这项工作。

examples.text: From whom did you learn that he was ill?
examples.translationZh: 你从谁那儿知道他生病了？

meaningZh: 开会，会议；（法庭的）开庭；会期，学期

examples.text: If the negotiations between the rich northerly nations and poor southerly nations make headway, it is intended that a ministerial session in December should be arranged.
examples.translationZh: 要是北方富国和南方穷国之间的谈判获得进展的话,就打算在十二月份安排召开部长级的会议。

examples.text: Several bills were enacted at the end of this session of Parliament.
examples.translationZh: 这届国会结束时，好几个议案制定成为法律。

examples.text: Is Parliament in session during the summer?
examples.translationZh: 议会在夏季是开会期吗?

meaningZh: 责骂；vi. 责骂；斥责

examples.text: Don't scold the child without reason.
examples.translationZh: 不可无缘无故地责骂小孩。

examples.text: You shouldn't scold him on the slightest pretence.
examples.translationZh: 你不应该以一点点借口就责骂他。

examples.text: I hate to scold, but you mustn't scatter your things all over the place.
examples.translationZh: 我不想训斥你，但你总不该把东西到处乱丢。

meaningZh: 俱乐部，会所；社团；夜总会

examples.text: The tennis club has organized a dance.
examples.translationZh: 网球俱乐部组织了一次舞会。

examples.text: He is an active member of the school's stamp club.
examples.translationZh: 他是学校集邮俱乐部的一名活跃会员。

examples.text: I was a slave under club and fist.
examples.translationZh: 在他们的棍棒和拳脚下，我就是一个奴隶。

meaningZh: [乐]音阶，度；[数]度，度数；程度

examples.text: He went down without taking a degree.
examples.translationZh: 他没获得学位就离开了大学。

examples.text: To do this job, you must have a degree in English.
examples.translationZh: 从事这个工作你必须具有英语专业的大学学位。

examples.text: She has also been affected, but to a lesser degree.
examples.translationZh: 她也受到波及，但程度较轻。

meaningZh: 下雨的，多雨的

examples.text: Summer is a rainy season in China.
examples.translationZh: 在中国，夏天是一个多雨的季节。

examples.text: I work both on sunny days and on rainy ones.
examples.translationZh: 我风雨无阻地工作。

examples.text: The rainy weather made hay of our holiday plans.
examples.translationZh: 我们的度假计划全给下雨天气破坏了。

meaningZh: 猎人；猎犬；猎狐马，猎食其他动物的野兽

examples.text: The hunter steadied his rifle and fired.
examples.translationZh: 猎人端稳了猎枪，然后开了火。

examples.text: The fox ran away before the hunter shot it.
examples.translationZh: 那只狐狸在猎人向它射击前跑掉了。

examples.text: The hunter agreed to take us to go hunting tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 那位猎人同意明天带我们去打猎。

meaningZh: 穆斯林，伊斯兰教徒；adj. 穆斯林的；na. “Muslin”的变体

examples.text: Yesterday when we went to the post office, we ran across a Moslem.
examples.translationZh: 作天我们去邮局的时候，遇到一个回教徒。

examples.text: Richard the Lionhearted, leader of the Third Crusade, intends to take the fight to Moslem leader Saladin.
examples.translationZh: 狮王李察率领十字军第三次东征，意图歼灭回教徒酋长沙拉丁。

meaningZh: 柔弱的，虚弱的；无力的，软弱的；不中用的，愚钝的

examples.text: The troops were too weak to withstand.
examples.translationZh: 军队太弱了,抵挡不住下一次进攻。

examples.text: The small weak child became the scorn of the class.
examples.translationZh: 这个瘦小软弱的孩子成为全班嘲笑的对象。

examples.text: He was too weak even to lift his hand.
examples.translationZh: 他虚弱得连手都抬不起来。

meaningZh: （人）弄错的，理解错误的；（行动、想法、判断等）错误的；被误解的

examples.text: I suppose you're mistaken there.
examples.translationZh: 我认为在这点上您错了。

examples.text: It appears to me that you are all mistaken.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得你们全搞错了。

examples.text: He is bedeviled by his mistaken ideas.
examples.translationZh: 他被错误思想弄糊涂了。

meaningZh: 黑暗的；乌黑的；忧郁的

examples.text: It's a dark and moonless night.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个黑暗无月的夜晚。

examples.text: The baby had dark eyes and dark curls.
examples.translationZh: 那婴孩长着深色的眼睛和深色的鬈发。

examples.text: He ran against a lamp post in the dark.
examples.translationZh: 在黑暗中他撞上了一根电线杆。

meaningZh: 鼓；鼓状物；鼓声

examples.text: The beats of the drum were steady and slow.
examples.translationZh: 鼓声平稳而缓慢。

examples.text: The oil flowed over the rim of the drum.
examples.translationZh: 油从汽油桶的边缘流出。

examples.text: The drum on the battlefield stimulated the soldiers to fight more bravely.
examples.translationZh: 战场上的鼓声鼓舞了战士们,使他们更加英勇的作战。

meaningZh: 保证；确保；为…保险

examples.text: I want to insure my residence.
examples.translationZh: 我要为自己的住宅保险。

examples.text: I'd like to insure this package for 50 dollars.
examples.translationZh: 我想要这包东西保险50美元。

examples.text: I am insured for all risks.
examples.translationZh: 我给自己保了综合险。

meaningZh: 小型公共汽车，小巴

examples.text: Some of the children go to school in a minibus.
examples.translationZh: 有些孩子乘坐小型公共汽车去上学。

examples.text: Minibus is most popular in towns.
examples.translationZh: 小面包车在城镇很吃香。

examples.text: We will go in the minibus from Calgary.
examples.translationZh: 我们将从卡尔加利乘小巴出发。

meaningZh: 欢乐的,愉快的；喝得微醉的

examples.text: There is a merry smile on her face.
examples.translationZh: 她脸上露出愉快的微笑。

examples.text: He is in a very merry mood today.
examples.translationZh: 他今天心情极为愉快。

examples.text: Merry Christmas!
examples.translationZh: 圣诞快乐！

meaningZh: 女商人；女实业家；（尤指）女经理

examples.text: A businesswoman created a special shelter to house injured animals.
examples.translationZh: 一个女商人找到了一所房子饲养这些狗。

examples.text: A Chinese businesswoman became very rich recycling waste paper.
examples.translationZh: 一名中国的女商人靠循环利用废纸发了财。

meaningZh: 校长；总统；总裁

examples.text: The president gave the Prince and his attendants a farewell banquet.
examples.translationZh: 总统为王子和他的随员举行了告别宴会。

examples.text: She was exalted to the position of president.
examples.translationZh: 她被提升为校长。

examples.text: The president has just come to see me.
examples.translationZh: 校长刚才来看我来了。

meaningZh: 一条（块）面包；v. 游荡；游手好闲

examples.text: That small loaf won't go far among this large family!
examples.translationZh: 那一小条面包全家人吃不了多久的。

examples.text: He bought a loaf of bread.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一大块奶酪。

examples.text: He used to loaf about and ultimately took to drink.
examples.translationZh: 他过去终日游手好闲，最终沉溺于酗酒。

meaningZh: 基础；基地；根据

examples.text: I found a small leaf at the base of the flower.
examples.translationZh: 我在那朵花的底部发现一片小叶。

examples.text: Our mission was over, and went back to our base.
examples.translationZh: 我们的任务结束了,我们返回了基地。

examples.text: Many languages have Latin as their base.
examples.translationZh: 许多语言都以拉丁语为基础。

meaningZh: 抱负；渴望得到的东西；追求的目标

examples.text: You should persist in your ambition.
examples.translationZh: 你应该坚持你的雄心大志。

examples.text: The glory of his country is his ambition.
examples.translationZh: 为国增光是他的雄心。

examples.text: You will achieve your ambition if you work hard.
examples.translationZh: 如果你努力, 你的抱负是可以实现的。

meaningZh: 使工作；使运作；操作

examples.text: She had been out of work for a year.
examples.translationZh: 她已失业一年了。

examples.text: It's difficult to find work in present economic climate.
examples.translationZh: 在目前这种经济气候下很难找到工作。

examples.text: My line of work pays pretty well.
examples.translationZh: 我的职业报酬颇丰厚。

meaningZh: 构成疑问句和否定句；代替动词；用于加强语气

examples.text: He is doing his homework.
examples.translationZh: 他正在做他的家庭作业。

examples.text: Do what I tell you.
examples.translationZh: 按照我告诉你的去做。

examples.text: To tell you the truth, I hate to do it.
examples.translationZh: 老实告诉你,我不愿意做这事。

meaningZh: 人行横道，十字路口；交叉，相交；横越

examples.text: When we need to cross the street, we should always use the pedestrian crossings or pedestrian bridges.
examples.translationZh: 过马路时，我们一定要走人行横道或过街天桥。

examples.text: We came to a crossing.
examples.translationZh: 我们来到一个十字路口。

examples.text: He was arrested by guards at the border crossing.
examples.translationZh: 他在越境地点被卫兵逮捕。

meaningZh: [动]袋鼠

examples.text: The kangaroo is a native of Australia.
examples.translationZh: 袋鼠是产于澳大利亚的动物。

examples.text: A kangaroo carries its young in a pouch.
examples.translationZh: 大袋鼠以肚袋装小袋鼠。

examples.text: The kangaroo uses its back legs to jump.
examples.translationZh: 袋鼠是用牠的后脚在跳。

meaningZh: 交换；交易；交易所

examples.text: May I exchange seats with you?
examples.translationZh: 我和你调一个座位好吗?

examples.text: You can exchange your car at our nearest office.
examples.translationZh: 你可以到我们附近的公司换车。

examples.text: We exchanged our opinions about the event at the meeting.
examples.translationZh: 在会上，我们就此事交换了意见。

meaningZh: 婴儿；婴孩；幼崽

examples.text: She gave birth to a fine healthy baby.
examples.translationZh: 她生了一个健康漂亮的婴儿。

examples.text: The mother rocked the baby to sleep in its cradle.
examples.translationZh: 母亲摇动摇篮使婴儿入睡。

examples.text: We've turned the smallest bedroom into a nursery for our new baby.
examples.translationZh: 我们已将最小的那间卧室改成新生婴儿的幼儿室。

meaningZh: 锤,铁锤；vt. & vi. 锤打；vt. 击败

examples.text: He hit the nail into the wall with a hammer.
examples.translationZh: 他用一把锤子把钉子打进墙里去。

examples.text: He smashed a hole in the window with a hammer.
examples.translationZh: 他用锤子在玻璃上打了个洞。

examples.text: He took a hammer and recessed a hole into the wall.
examples.translationZh: 他拿起一个榔头，在墙上敲出一个洞。

meaningZh: 最低限度；最小量；最低消费

examples.text: That is the minimum number necessary to complete the circuit.
examples.translationZh: 这是完善循环的最低限度人数。

examples.text: The minimum wage is 4.25 dollars an hour.
examples.translationZh: 最低工价为每小时四点二五美元。

examples.text: Repairing your car will cost a minimum of 100 dollars.
examples.translationZh: 修理你的汽车最低限度要100美元。

meaningZh: 象，大象

examples.text: The elephant smashed through the trees.
examples.translationZh: 大象在树林中横冲直撞。

examples.text: He said he could eat an elephant to appease his hunger.
examples.translationZh: 他说他吃光一头大象才能充饥。

examples.text: Jan's factory is an absolute white elephant.
examples.translationZh: 简的那个工厂成了一个大包袱。

meaningZh: 汽车；车厢；轿车

examples.text: A new type of car is on the market now.
examples.translationZh: 现在一种新型小汽车正在上市。

examples.text: Repairing your car will cost a minimum of 100 dollars.
examples.translationZh: 修理你的汽车最低限度要100美元。

examples.text: The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I had to brake.
examples.translationZh: 我前面那辆小汽车突然停住，我只好刹车。

meaningZh: 最后期限；截止期限；死线

examples.text: I hope we can finish this before the deadline.
examples.translationZh: 我希望我们能在最后期限之前完成这项工作。

examples.text: She was working in haste to meet the deadline.
examples.translationZh: 她匆忙工作是为了赶上最后期限。

examples.text: We pulled out all the stops to meet the deadline.
examples.translationZh: 我们竭尽全力在截止日期前完成了工作。

meaningZh: 西瓜

examples.text: This kind of watermelon is remarkable for its size.
examples.translationZh: 这种西瓜个头儿大。

examples.text: The hostess iced the watermelon.
examples.translationZh: 女主人把西瓜冰镇上了。

meaningZh: 在…之间；私下，暗中；在…中任择其一

examples.text: Children must attend school between 5 and 16.
examples.translationZh: 5至16岁的孩子必须上学。

examples.text: There is a generation gap between my parents and I.
examples.translationZh: 我父母和我之间有代沟。

examples.text: She tried to intervene between her husband and son.
examples.translationZh: 她想调解丈夫和儿子之间的争吵。

meaningZh: 有魅力的；引人注目的；迷人的

examples.text: Ice-cream is attractive to children.
examples.translationZh: 冰淇淋对孩子们非常有吸引力。

examples.text: It's an attractive idea.
examples.translationZh: 这是个使人感兴趣的想法。

examples.text: It's a very attractive offer, and I'm tempted to accept.
examples.translationZh: 这项建议很有吸引力,我确实有些动心。

meaningZh: 毕业文凭；学位证书；公文

examples.text: He obtained a diploma in architecture.
examples.translationZh: 他获得了建筑学的学位证书。

examples.text: The youth won his diploma after only three years.
examples.translationZh: 那青年仅用了3 年时间就取得毕业文凭。

examples.text: When a person has successfully completed a certain course of study, he is given a diploma by the school.
examples.translationZh: 当一个人成功地完成了某一课程的研读,学校将授予他一张文凭。

meaningZh: 主教；象

examples.text: This priest wants to become a bishop.
examples.translationZh: 这位牧师想成为主教。

examples.text: The new church was consecrated by the Bishop of Chester.
examples.translationZh: 在切斯特的主教主持下举行了新教堂的奉献礼。

examples.text: She played her bishop.
examples.translationZh: 她走了象。

meaningZh: 奴隶身份；奴隶制度；苦役，奴隶般的劳动

examples.text: They were delivered from slavery.
examples.translationZh: 他们从奴役中被解放出来。

examples.text: We shall never submit ourselves to slavery.
examples.translationZh: 我们不甘受奴役。

examples.text: Lincoln was an unbending foe of slavery.
examples.translationZh: 林肯是奴隶制的死敌。

meaningZh: 管理；实行；（政府）行政机关

examples.text: He is responsible for the administration of justice.
examples.translationZh: 他负责赏罚。

examples.text: He works in hospital administration.
examples.translationZh: 他从事医院管理工作.

examples.text: The company developed rapidly under his administration.
examples.translationZh: 在他的管理下，公司发展得很快。

meaningZh: 邀请；请求；引诱

examples.text: I've invited the Smiths round for drinks next Friday.
examples.translationZh: 我已邀请史密斯一家下周五来家中小酌。

examples.text: We invited all our relatives to the wedding.
examples.translationZh: 我们邀请了所有的亲戚来参加婚礼。

examples.text: After his speech he invited questions and comments(from the audience).
examples.translationZh: 他讲完话后请听众提出问题和意见。

meaningZh: 醒着的；警惕的；vt.& vi. 唤醒

examples.text: The children are still wide awake.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们仍然完全醒着。

examples.text: The smart of his wound kept him awake.
examples.translationZh: 伤痛使他无法入睡。

examples.text: A pilot must be awake to the changes in the weather.
examples.translationZh: 飞行员必须警觉天气的变化。

meaningZh: 意见，主张；评价；鉴定，判定

examples.text: I can't agree with your opinion in this respect.
examples.translationZh: 在这方面,我不赞同你的意见。

examples.text: No matter what you say, I shall stick to my opinion.
examples.translationZh: 不管你说什么,我都坚持我的主张。

examples.text: I'd like to have your opinion on the 1995 World Expo.
examples.translationZh: 我想听听您对1995年世界博览会的看法。

meaningZh: 香蕉；芭蕉属植物；喜剧演员

examples.text: The banana is her favorite fruit.
examples.translationZh: 香蕉是她最喜欢的水果。

examples.text: A banana is mainly pulp, except for its skin.
examples.translationZh: 香蕉除了果皮之外，主要是果肉。

examples.text: I gave Mary an apple in exchange for my favorite banana.
examples.translationZh: 我送给玛丽一个苹果换我最喜欢吃的香蕉。

meaningZh: 永远；不断地，无休止地；老是，经常

examples.text: This terrible event is etched forever in my memory.
examples.translationZh: 这一可怕事件永远深深地印刻在我的记忆中。

examples.text: The vassal swore that he would be loyal to the king forever.
examples.translationZh: 这位封臣宣誓他将永远忠诚于国王。

examples.text: The lovers promised to be faithful forever.
examples.translationZh: 这对情人互相许诺永不变心。

meaningZh: 种植；扩大；扩展

examples.text: How tall you've grown!
examples.translationZh: 你都长这麽高了!

examples.text: Plants cannot grow well in the absence of water.
examples.translationZh: 没有水,植物就不能茁壮地生长。

examples.text: She is growing into a beautiful young woman.
examples.translationZh: 她渐渐出落成美丽的姑娘。

meaningZh: 艺术；艺术作品；（需要技术、工艺的）行业

examples.text: She displayed great ardor for art.
examples.translationZh: 她对艺术表现出极大的热心。

examples.text: She joined the university art society.
examples.translationZh: 她加入了大学里的艺术协会。

examples.text: She has an appreciation of art and music.
examples.translationZh: 她对于美术和音乐有了解。

meaningZh: 恤，短袖汗衫；样式类似T恤的外衣

examples.text: Which T-shirt is red?
examples.translationZh: 哪一件T恤是红色的？
examples.author: cienias

meaningZh: 鲨鱼；坑蒙拐骗的人，诈骗者；[俚]老手

examples.text: The shark snapped its jaws shut.
examples.translationZh: 鲨鱼啪嗒一声把嘴合上了。

examples.text: The shark is dangerous to swimmers.
examples.translationZh: 鲨鱼对游泳的人来说很危险。

examples.text: He told me he once caught a shark, but I know he was swinging the lead.
examples.translationZh: 他告诉我有一回他捕到了一条鲨鱼，我知道他是在胡诌。

meaningZh: 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生

examples.text: Sir Peter was raised to the peerage.
examples.translationZh: 彼得先生被封为贵族。

examples.text: Maybe you could take a seat in the lobby,sir.
examples.translationZh: 或许您可以在大堂休息一下，先生。

examples.text: I am heated and excited, sir, I know I am.
examples.translationZh: 我真又恼火又生气，阁下，我知道我实在气不过。

meaningZh: 努力，尝试；工作；成就

examples.text: They are making every effort to decrease the production cost.
examples.translationZh: 他们正尽力减少生产成本。

examples.text: All my efforts were fruitless.
examples.translationZh: 我所有的努力都白费了。

meaningZh: 文学（上）的；精通文学的；爱好文学的

examples.text: He is endowed with literary talent.
examples.translationZh: 他有文学天分。

examples.text: Dickens' A Tale of Two Cities is a literary classic.
examples.translationZh: 狄更斯的《双城记》是文学名著。

examples.text: I don't like to read his literary criticism.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢读他的文学批评。

meaningZh: 可能，可能性；希望，可能发生的事物

examples.text: I see great possibilities in the scheme.
examples.translationZh: 我看这计划很可能成功。

examples.text: We must accept the possibility that we might be wrong.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须承认，我们有可能搞错了。

examples.text: She saw the possibilities of the scheme from the beginning.
examples.translationZh: 她从一开始就预见到这计划可能成功。

meaningZh: 文本，原文；课文，教科书；主题

examples.text: The text is accompanied by illustrations.
examples.translationZh: 正文附有插图。

examples.text: It was edited from the original text.
examples.translationZh: 这是根据原文本编译的。

examples.text: Read the text first and then explain the new words.
examples.translationZh: 先读课文，然后解释生词。

meaningZh: 幽默；幽默感；感觉

examples.text: Her humour adds salt to her conversation.
examples.translationZh: 她很幽默，谈起话来妙趣横生。

examples.text: He is completely devoid of humour.
examples.translationZh: 他十分缺乏幽默。

examples.text: His new novel is tinged with thinnish humour.
examples.translationZh: 他的新小说略带诙谐。

meaningZh: 接替人员，替班；传递；接力赛

examples.text: Images of the war were relayed around the world.
examples.translationZh: 世界各地转播了战争的图像。

examples.text: I will relay your opinion to the headmaster.
examples.translationZh: 我愿把你的意见转告校长。

examples.text: The Relay Agent could not start up its main thread.
examples.translationZh: 中继代理无法启动其主线程。

meaningZh: 理发；发型；发式

examples.text: Where do you go to get a haircut?
examples.translationZh: 你去哪儿理发？

examples.text: She teased him into getting a haircut.
examples.translationZh: 她喋喋不休地哄他去理发。

examples.text: He sprang a new haircut on his wife.
examples.translationZh: 他为妻子创作了一个新的发式。

meaningZh: 小时，钟头；时间，时刻；固定时间

examples.text: It took him half an hour to finish the work.
examples.translationZh: 他花了半个小时做完这项工作。

examples.text: The London bus departs every hour on the hour.
examples.translationZh: 伦敦的公共汽车每小时零分开出一趟。

examples.text: You can hire a bicycle by the hour to go around the city.
examples.translationZh: 你可以按钟点租辆自行车在城里观光。

meaningZh: 西,西部,西方；国家的西部；在西方的,西部的,朝西的

examples.text: The earth rotates from west to east.
examples.translationZh: 地球从西向东旋转。

examples.text: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
examples.translationZh: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

examples.text: I live in the west of the city.
examples.translationZh: 我住在该城市的西部。

meaningZh: （在…中）获胜，赢；战胜（对手）；vt. （通过努力等）赢得

examples.text: That horse is a cinch to win the next race.
examples.translationZh: 那匹马在下一场比赛中肯定赢。

examples.text: She has a fervent desire to win.
examples.translationZh: 她有著强烈的获胜欲望。

examples.text: She needs to win this point to level the score.
examples.translationZh: 她要赢得这一分才能将比分扳平。

meaningZh: 试映，预演；预告片；象征，预示

examples.text: They sent the recording for our preview.
examples.translationZh: 他们把那录音送来给我们预先审查。

examples.text: After a sneak preview of the film they decided to shelve it.
examples.translationZh: 该影片在试映后，他们决定把它搁置起来。

examples.text: Please do the preview and review work.
examples.translationZh: 请做好预习和复习工作。

meaningZh: 业余爱好；嗜好，兴趣；小马

examples.text: His hobby is entomology.
examples.translationZh: 他爱好昆虫学。

examples.text: Angling is his main hobby.
examples.translationZh: 钓鱼是他的主要爱好。

examples.text: Some people like horseback ride, but I prefer golf as a hobby.
examples.translationZh: 一些人喜欢马术，但是我宁愿把打高尔夫球作为一种业余爱好。

meaningZh: 厨房；厨师

examples.text: I have to mop the kitchen floor at least once a day.
examples.translationZh: 我每天至少要把厨房地板擦洗一次。

examples.text: I guess there are mice in the kitchen.
examples.translationZh: 我猜想厨房里有老鼠。

examples.text: I was cooking in the kitchen when the telephone rang.
examples.translationZh: 电话铃响的时候我正在厨房里做饭。

meaningZh: 十字路口；转折点，重大的抉择时刻

examples.text: The horse swayed left at the crossroads.
examples.translationZh: 在交叉路口，那匹马往左偏转。

examples.text: An accident happened at a crossroads a few metres away from bank.
examples.translationZh: 在离一家银行几米处的一个交叉路口发生了车祸。

examples.text: The accident took place at the crossroads.
examples.translationZh: 事故就发生在十字路口。

meaningZh: 南方的，南部的；来自南方的；n. 南方人，南部人

examples.text: He lives in southern China.
examples.translationZh: 他住在中国南部。

examples.text: Only in the southern part of Taiwan have I seen such scenery as this.
examples.translationZh: 唯有在南台湾我才见过像这样的风景。

examples.text: The secession of some southern states from the USA in the 1860s led to the civil war.
examples.translationZh: 由于南部某些州于十九世纪六十年代脱离美国而导致了南北战争。

meaningZh: 妇女政治家

examples.text: She was respected as an experienced stateswoman.
examples.translationZh: 她作为一位经验丰富的女政治家备受尊敬。

meaningZh: 白色的，纯洁的；无色的，透明的；白衣的

examples.text: This parapet is white.
examples.translationZh: 这个栏杆是白色的。

examples.text: He was white with fury.
examples.translationZh: 他气得脸色发白。

examples.text: Borax is a kind of white powder.
examples.translationZh: 硼砂是一种白色粉末。

meaningZh: 教堂的唱诗班；唱诗队；公开表演的合唱团

examples.text: The choir sang the 23rd Psalm.
examples.translationZh: 唱诗班唱《旧约·诗篇》之第23篇。

examples.text: The choir sang the amens beautifully.
examples.translationZh: 唱诗班唱的阿门非常优美。

examples.text: The choir sang sweetly, and none more so than the Welsh boy.
examples.translationZh: 唱诗班唱得很悦耳，尤其是没人比得上那个威尔士男孩儿。

meaningZh: 提交；演出；陈述，报告

examples.text: Amy did her presentation on her cat.
examples.translationZh: 艾米做的介绍是关于她的猫的。

examples.text: I was asked to give a short presentation on the aims of the plan.
examples.translationZh: 他们要求我就这计划的目的作一个简短的陈述。

examples.text: We want to make her a presentation to celebrate her jubilee.
examples.translationZh: 我们想送她一件礼物以庆贺她的纪念日。

meaningZh: 要求，请求；需要；[法]召唤

examples.text: Their demand is entirely justified.
examples.translationZh: 他们的要求是完全正当的。

examples.text: The demand for coal begins to slacken off in the spring.
examples.translationZh: 煤的需求在春天开始减少。

examples.text: He had the impertinence to demand a raise.
examples.translationZh: 他竟冒失地要求增加工资。

meaningZh: 商业的；贸易的；营利的

examples.text: Do you fancy having a go at doing a commercial feature film?
examples.translationZh: 对制作商业的影片有没有兴趣?

examples.text: The downtown area is zoned for commercial use.
examples.translationZh: 市中心被划出供商业用。

examples.text: They were much more realistic about its long term commercial prospects.
examples.translationZh: 他们对它的长远商业前景更为现实。

meaningZh: 普通的；通俗的；[数学]公共的

examples.text: Windmills are a common sight in Holland.
examples.translationZh: 风车是荷兰常见的景色。

examples.text: We have common topics to talk about.
examples.translationZh: 我们有共同的话题可谈。

examples.text: Common interests bind us together.
examples.translationZh: 共同的利益使我们结合在一起。

meaningZh: 卓越的；杰出的；优秀的

examples.text: She would have made an excellent teacher.
examples.translationZh: 她本可以成为杰出的教师。

examples.text: As soon as she learns the office routine, she will be an excellent assistant.
examples.translationZh: 她一旦熟悉了办公室的日常事务,就会成为一名优秀的助手。

examples.text: Hawaii is an excellent tourist resort.
examples.translationZh: 夏威夷是极好的旅游胜地。

meaningZh: 观念，概念；观点；思想，设想，想法

examples.text: I can not understand such an abstract concept.
examples.translationZh: 我无法理解如此抽象的观念。

examples.text: He presented a new concept of the origins of the universe.
examples.translationZh: 他提出了一种宇宙起源的新概念。

examples.text: We had no concept that this tiny mistake would ruin the whole plan.
examples.translationZh: 我们完全没有想到这个小小的失误会毁掉整个计划。

meaningZh: 体操，体育；体操运动

examples.text: When she was young she practiced gymnastics.
examples.translationZh: 她年轻时练过体操。

examples.text: The sport of gymnastics is popular in our country.
examples.translationZh: 体操运动在我国很流行。

meaningZh: 区别；荣誉；特质

examples.text: These are the highest distinctions that have ever been given by our government.
examples.translationZh: 这些是我国政府迄今授予的最高荣誉称号。

examples.text: Keller received many awards of great distinction.
examples.translationZh: 凯勒被授予很多殊荣奖。

examples.text: He had the distinction of being the first man to walk on the moon.
examples.translationZh: 他以月球上第一个行走而闻名于世。

meaningZh: 喷嚏；喷嚏声；vi. 打喷嚏

examples.text: A baby's sneeze is not very loud.
examples.translationZh: 婴儿的喷嚏不太响。

examples.text: She let out a loud sneeze.
examples.translationZh: 她打了一个很响的喷嚏。

examples.text: The dust made him sneeze.
examples.translationZh: 灰尘使他打了个喷嚏。

meaningZh: 支票；na. “check”的变体

examples.text: Don't forget to date your cheque.
examples.translationZh: 不要忘记在支票上写上日期。

examples.text: I hope this cheque doesn't bounce.
examples.translationZh: 我希望这张支票别遭退票

examples.text: He drew a cheque to her.
examples.translationZh: 他开了张支票给她。

meaningZh: 操场，尤指提供如秋千等设备的户外场地；游乐场；（某些集体聚会游乐的）园地

examples.text: The students are playing on the playground.
examples.translationZh: 学生们正在操场上玩。

examples.text: The children were taking turns on the slides in the playground.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们在操场上轮流滑滑梯。

examples.text: He sat on the playground listening to the distant croak.
examples.translationZh: 他坐在操场上，聆听远处的蛙鸣。

meaningZh: 损失，减少；丢失，遗失；损耗，亏损

examples.text: The loss of her purse caused her much inconvenience.
examples.translationZh: 丢失钱包给她带来了诸多不便。

examples.text: This wounded soldier was unconscious from his loss of blood.
examples.translationZh: 这名伤员由于失血过多而昏迷不醒。

examples.text: His costly mistake resulted in severe loss.
examples.translationZh: 他的严重的错误导致了重大的损失。

meaningZh: 石头,石块,石子；矿石,石料；宝石

examples.text: The brick house was faced with stone.
examples.translationZh: 这座砖房石料贴面。

examples.text: The inscription on the stone had worn away.
examples.translationZh: 刻在石头上的文字已磨损了。

examples.text: The beetle scurried away when I lifted the stone.
examples.translationZh: 我把石头搬起来时，那只甲虫跑了。

meaningZh: 医生，大夫；博士；神学家

examples.text: He is a Doctor of Philosophy.
examples.translationZh: 他是一位哲学博士。

examples.text: His illness was more serious than the doctor first thought.
examples.translationZh: 他的病较医生原来以为的更严重。

examples.text: How else can the doctor save him?
examples.translationZh: 医院还有别的方法可以救他吗？

meaningZh: 长者；长辈；元老

examples.text: He is the elder twin of the two.
examples.translationZh: 他是两个双胞胎较年长的那个。

examples.text: The elder welder seldom yields his field.
examples.translationZh: 年长的焊接工很少放弃他的场地。

examples.text: He is the elder of the twins.
examples.translationZh: 他是双胞胎中的哥哥。

meaningZh: 反应，作出反应；影响；起反作用

examples.text: Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust.
examples.translationZh: 铁与水和空气起化学反应而生锈。

examples.text: She reacted to the insult by turning her back on him.
examples.translationZh: 她受辱之后就不再理睬他了。

examples.text: How did they react to your suggestion?
examples.translationZh: 他们对你的建议有什么反应？

meaningZh: 庆祝；庆祝会（仪式）；颂扬

examples.text: The hotel had a grand celebration for its opening.
examples.translationZh: 该饭店办了一个盛大的开幕典礼。

examples.text: "(actors, singers, etc.) perform for outside salary income without approval by the unit they belong to"
examples.translationZh: 走穴

examples.text: The celebration will run from next Monday.
examples.translationZh: 庆祝活动从下周一开始。

meaningZh: 久远地；（问到或谈及距离时说）有多远；到很远距离

examples.text: The new music teacher lives far away.
examples.translationZh: 新来的音乐教师住得很远。

examples.text: How far do you make it to the station?
examples.translationZh: 你估计到车站有多远?

examples.text: I was born in a village not far from Beijing.
examples.translationZh: 我出生在离北京不远的村庄里。

meaningZh: 大致的；综合的；总的，全体的

examples.text: The announcement was met with general rejoicing.
examples.translationZh: 该项宣布受到普遍的欢迎。

examples.text: Her predictions are so general that they could apply to anybody.
examples.translationZh: 她的预测很全面,放之四海而皆准。

examples.text: As a general rule, prices follow demands.
examples.translationZh: 一般而言,物价随需求而变化。

meaningZh: 昨天；往昔；过去

examples.text: Yesterday was Friday.
examples.translationZh: 昨天是星期五。

examples.text: I saw him only yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我昨天才见到他。

examples.text: She had an attack of indigestion yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 她昨天消化不良。

meaningZh: 尖的，锐的；敏锐的，敏感的；严重的，剧烈的

examples.text: He suffers from acute depression.
examples.translationZh: 他患有严重的抑郁症。

examples.text: This area has an acute shortage of water.
examples.translationZh: 这个地方缺水严重。

examples.text: She has acute hearing.
examples.translationZh: 她有很敏锐的听力。

meaningZh: 海滩,海滨

examples.text: We are basking on the beach.
examples.translationZh: 我们在海滩上晒太阳。

examples.text: They walked along the beach talking and laughing.
examples.translationZh: 他们说说笑笑，沿着海滩散步。

examples.text: They are vacationing at the beach.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在海滨度假。

meaningZh: 质量，品质；美质，优点；才能，能力，技能，素养

examples.text: He examined the quality of the furniture carefully.
examples.translationZh: 他仔细检查家俱的品质。

examples.text: Her most essential quality is kindness.
examples.translationZh: 她最主要的品质是善良。

examples.text: He shows quality of leadership.
examples.translationZh: 他显示出领导才能。

meaningZh: 行动，活动；功能，作用；手段

examples.text: There is no denying that your action has affected her normal life.
examples.translationZh: 不可否认,你的行为已经影响了她的正常生活。

examples.text: After the security incident, you should create an action report that includes three simple goals.
examples.translationZh: 这次安全事故后,你要撰写一个包括三个简单目标的活动报告。

examples.text: The government finally took some actions because the public had been pressing for inquiry into the question.
examples.translationZh: 由于公众一再坚持调查这一问题,政府终于采取了一些措施。

meaningZh: 祖父或祖母；外祖父或外祖母

examples.text: Worry had greyed grandparent's hair.
examples.translationZh: 祖父愁白了头发

examples.text: I had no grandparent to stand proudly for me.
examples.translationZh: 没有祖父母会为我自豪地站起来。

examples.text: The three children have been sponging on their grandparent for over ten years.
examples.translationZh: 10多年来这3个孩子一直靠他们的姥爷、姥姥养活。

meaningZh: 狭隘的；狭窄的；（种类或数目）有限的

examples.text: The shop sells only a narrow range of goods.
examples.translationZh: 这家商店商品的种类有限。

examples.text: The heavy traffic crawled through the narrow tunnel.
examples.translationZh: 拥挤的车辆慢吞吞地穿过狭窄的隧道。

examples.text: The gate is too narrow for a car.
examples.translationZh: 大门太窄，汽车进不去。

meaningZh: 滥用；恶习；侮辱

examples.text: The government has set up a working party to look into the problem of drug abuse.
examples.translationZh: 政府已成立工作组调查滥用毒品问题。

examples.text: His political reputation was tainted by his abuse of the power.
examples.translationZh: 他因滥用职权而破坏了政治声誉。

examples.text: He greeted me with a stream of abuse.
examples.translationZh: 他见到我就连声辱骂。

meaningZh: 艾滋病，获得性免疫缺乏综合症（Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome）

examples.text: Financial aids generally taper off after the first year of college.
examples.translationZh: 助学金通常在大学一年级之后逐渐减少。

examples.text: There is a TV show about AIDS on right now.
examples.translationZh: 电视正在播放一个关于爱滋病的节目。

examples.text: At present a great deal of research is being carried out to find a cure for AIDS.
examples.translationZh: 目前，为了寻找治疗爱滋病的办法，人们正进行大量的研究工作。

meaningZh: 扩大，放大；扩展，扩充；拉长说，详述

examples.text: I have to enlarge my vocabulary.
examples.translationZh: 我必须扩大自己的词汇量。

examples.text: I planned to enlarge this photograph.
examples.translationZh: 我计划放大这张照片。

examples.text: We must enlarge our views by reading.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须以读书来增长见识。

meaningZh: 希望；想要；祝愿

examples.text: If possible, I wish to work in sales department.
examples.translationZh: 如果可能的话,我希望在销售部工作。

examples.text: I wish you a good journey.
examples.translationZh: 祝你一路平安。

examples.text: Do you wish to say anything?
examples.translationZh: 你想要说什么吗？

meaningZh: 绕道；环形交通枢纽；旋转木马

examples.text: We drove home by a roundabout route.
examples.translationZh: 我们绕远道驾车回家。

examples.text: The taxi didn't go by the direct route, but in a roundabout way.
examples.translationZh: 出租车没有走直路，而是绕道行驶。

examples.text: She suggested it in a very roundabout way.
examples.translationZh: 她很婉转地提出了这个建议。

meaningZh: 欧洲的，欧洲人的；欧盟的；n. 欧洲人

examples.text: Germany is a European country.
examples.translationZh: 德国是一个欧洲国家。

examples.text: The French Revolution was a volcanic upheaval in European history.
examples.translationZh: 法国大革命是欧洲历史上的一次剧变。

examples.text: The meeting once again underlined European reserve.
examples.translationZh: 这次会晤又一次突出表明了欧洲人的守口如瓶。

meaningZh: 商人；批发商；店主

examples.text: The merchant had received a shipment of tea.
examples.translationZh: 这个商人收到了一船茶叶。

examples.text: The merchant decided to use camels to carry his goods across the desert.
examples.translationZh: 商人决定用骆驼载运货物穿过沙漠。

examples.text: The merchant's cash sales each day were $300.
examples.translationZh: 那店主一天有300美元的现金售货收入。

meaningZh: 口；出入口；传闻

examples.text: Her mouth is her best feature.
examples.translationZh: 她的嘴是她容貌上最好看的部分。

examples.text: The dying animal was found foaming at the mouth.
examples.translationZh: 那只将死的动物被发现口吐白沫。

examples.text: Seeing that we are confused about her attitude, she had to give mouth to her doubts.
examples.translationZh: 看到我们对她的态度表示不解,她只得说出心里的疑惑。

meaningZh: 毒药；酒；极糟的食物

examples.text: We detected traces of the poison in her food.
examples.translationZh: 我们在她的食物里发现了微量毒药。

examples.text: He tried to kill himself by taking poison.
examples.translationZh: 他曾试图服毒自杀。

examples.text: Some people say that selfishness is a poison in our society.
examples.translationZh: 有些人说自私是我们社会的一害。

meaningZh: 葡萄；深紫色，葡萄紫

examples.text: The loser's scorn for the award is pure sour grape.
examples.translationZh: 失败者对奖品的轻视纯粹是吃不到葡萄说葡萄酸。

examples.text: Sour grape can never make sweet wine.
examples.translationZh: 酸葡萄酿不出甜酒。

examples.text: The sun shines through the grape-leaves.
examples.translationZh: 太阳从葡萄树叶中穿过。

meaningZh: 大量，大多；块，堆，团；[物理学]质量

examples.text: After harvest we will have a mass of rice.
examples.translationZh: 秋收后，我们将获得大量稻谷。

examples.text: There were masses of dark clouds in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 天上有朵朵乌云。

examples.text: Football stars seem larger-than-life to the mass of fans.
examples.translationZh: 在众多的球迷看来,足球明星是十分杰出的。

meaningZh: 弓形；拱门；拱形物

examples.text: Dip your head under the low arch.
examples.translationZh: 在低矮的门拱下要低头。

examples.text: A pointed arch drawn from two centers within the span.
examples.translationZh: 在跨度内有两个中心点，连接两个中心点的是弧度突出的拱。

examples.text: Have you been to the Triumphal Arch?
examples.translationZh: 你去过凯旋门吗？

meaningZh: 宝贵的，珍贵的；贵重的；矫揉造作的

examples.text: You should make good use of every precious minute to study.
examples.translationZh: 你应很好利用宝贵的每一分钟去学习。

examples.text: Pandas are precious creatures.
examples.translationZh: 熊猫是珍贵的动物。

examples.text: That old book is my most precious possession.
examples.translationZh: 那本旧书是我最珍贵的财产。

meaningZh: 行，排；划船；吵闹

examples.text: Students stand hand in hand in a row.
examples.translationZh: 学生们手牵手站成一排。

examples.text: He glanced towards the row of girls.
examples.translationZh: 他拿眼把那一排女孩子一溜。

examples.text: They asked me to go for a row with them.
examples.translationZh: 他们邀请我和他们一道去划船。

meaningZh: 在…期间；与…同时；虽然

examples.text: I lived in a hostel while I was a student.
examples.translationZh: 我求学期间住在青年招待所里。

examples.text: While Mary was writing a letter, the children were playing outside.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽写信时，孩子们在外面玩耍。

examples.text: In a word, while the prospects are bright, the road has twists and turns.
examples.translationZh: 总之,虽然前途是光明的,但是道路是曲折的。

meaningZh: 房屋；全家人；（从事某种生意的）公司

examples.text: Her house is furnished in excellent taste.
examples.translationZh: 她的房屋布置得非常高雅。

examples.text: They are going to move to a new house next week.
examples.translationZh: 下星期他们将迁入新居。

examples.text: My dream is to have a big house among peach trees.
examples.translationZh: 我的梦想就是在桃林间拥有一座大房子。

meaningZh: 路；通路；途径

examples.text: A fall of rocks blocked the road.
examples.translationZh: 掉落的岩石把路封住了。

examples.text: The road was blocked by a huge rock.
examples.translationZh: 道路被一块大石头堵住了。

examples.text: The rough road made the car vibrate.
examples.translationZh: 崎岖不平的道路使车颠簸得很厉害。

meaningZh: 证明，证实；[法]验证，检定；显示

examples.text: There wasn't enough evidence to prove him guilty.
examples.translationZh: 没有充分的证据证明他有罪。

examples.text: He has proved his courage in the battle.
examples.translationZh: 他已在这场战斗中证明了自己的勇气。

examples.text: The students are asked to prove the purity of copper.
examples.translationZh: 要求学生们检验铜的纯度。

meaningZh: 护照，通行证；手段

examples.text: Show me your passport, please.
examples.translationZh: 请出示护照。

examples.text: My passport has been transacted.
examples.translationZh: 我的护照已经办完了。

examples.text: The police released him but, significantly, they didn't give him back his passport.
examples.translationZh: 警方释放了他，但是没有把护照还给他，这是有特殊用意的。

meaningZh: 辐射；放射物；辐射状

examples.text: Radiation reached unheard-of levels.
examples.translationZh: 辐射作用已达到前所未有的程度。

examples.text: The most terrifying aspect of nuclear bombing is radiation.
examples.translationZh: 核弹轰炸最可怕的一面是辐射。

examples.text: In the accident, the workers received a heavy dose of radiation.
examples.translationZh: 在这次事故中，工人受到大剂量的辐射。

meaningZh: 婴儿室，幼儿园；苗圃；临时托儿所

examples.text: Many children under five go to nursery school.
examples.translationZh: 5岁以下的许多儿童都上幼儿园。

examples.text: She's all for more nursery schools being built.
examples.translationZh: 她坚持主张多建托儿所。

examples.text: She sent her little son to a nursery when she was working.
examples.translationZh: 她工作的时候就把小儿子送到托儿所。

meaningZh: （指成年女子，有些人尤其是长者认为这样说比较礼貌）女士；（不尊重的非正式称呼）女人；（在英国对女贵族或贵族成员的妻子女儿或爵士妻子的称呼）夫人

examples.text: The lady looked at me with a contented smile.
examples.translationZh: 那位夫人带着满意的微笑看着我。

examples.text: The lady assured to him her daughter.
examples.translationZh: 夫人把女儿许配给他。

examples.text: The antique table went to the lady in the pink hat.
examples.translationZh: 这张古董桌子卖给那位戴粉红色帽子的女士了。

meaningZh: 评论；注释；意见

examples.text: The comment is recorded in the event log.
examples.translationZh: 此注释将记录在事件日志中。

examples.text: He made no comments on our proposal.
examples.translationZh: 他对我们的建议没有作评论。

examples.text: Her strange behavior caused a good deal of comment.
examples.translationZh: 她的反常行为引起了不少闲话。

meaningZh: 预报，预测；预示；vi. 预报，预测

examples.text: Share prices plunged as a result of the gloomy economic forecast.
examples.translationZh: 关于经济前景暗淡的预测导致股票价格大跌。

examples.text: The Treasury's forecast assumes that inflation will remain below 3%.
examples.translationZh: 财政部的预测称,通货膨胀率将保持在3%25以下。

examples.text: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

meaningZh: 解决；安排；使定居

examples.text: If you pay for both of us now, we can settle up later.
examples.translationZh: 你要是现在先付清咱们两人的帐，事后咱们俩再细算。

examples.text: An official mission was sent to settle the dispute.
examples.translationZh: 一个官方使团被派去解决争端。

examples.text: The two companies settled out of court.
examples.translationZh: 两家公司在法院外了结了争端。

meaningZh: （用作问候语）嘿，喂；abbr. 夏威夷群岛的书面缩写；（=high intensity）高强度

examples.text: Hi there, buddy!
examples.translationZh: 嘿，老兄！

examples.text: Hi there, Stevens.
examples.translationZh: 你好，史蒂文斯。

examples.text: Hi! Great show, eh?
examples.translationZh: 你好！好节目，是吗？

meaningZh: 邮件，邮政；邮政（制度）；邮务员，邮递员

examples.text: I opened my mail and was surprised to see a broken vase.
examples.translationZh: 我打开了邮件，惊讶地发现了一个打碎的花瓶。

examples.text: Is there another mail in the afternoon?
examples.translationZh: 下午还另有一批邮件吗？

examples.text: Some mail came for you this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天上午有你的邮件。

meaningZh: 帮助，援助；〈古〉出席，出席者；辅助设备

examples.text: We are ready to render them economic assistance.
examples.translationZh: 我们愿意向他们提供经济援助。

examples.text: He gave the assistance to me when I was in trouble.
examples.translationZh: 我有麻烦时,他向我伸出援助之手。

examples.text: You can not rely on his assistance.
examples.translationZh: 你不能指望他能帮助你。

meaningZh: 特别的；详细的；独有的

examples.text: They depend on a particular historical situation.
examples.translationZh: 它们取决于特定的历史境况。

examples.text: I have nothing particular to do this evening.
examples.translationZh: 今晚我没有什么特殊的事要做。

examples.text: Clouds must be given a particular attention.
examples.translationZh: 必须对云给予特别的注意。

meaningZh: 带子；胶带，磁带；卷尺

examples.text: I've got all the Beethoven symphonies on tape.
examples.translationZh: 我有贝多芬交响乐全部的录音带。

examples.text: Cassette tape recorders are gradually out of date now.
examples.translationZh: 现在,盒式磁带录音机渐渐过时了。

examples.text: You'd better put some insulating tape on electric wires.
examples.translationZh: 你最好给电线裹上绝缘胶布。

meaningZh: 悬挂；（被）绞死；贴，装饰

examples.text: You may hang your coat on the hook.
examples.translationZh: 你可以把外套挂在钩子上。

examples.text: I'll hang the pictures as high as I can.
examples.translationZh: 我将尽可能把这些画挂得高。

examples.text: All the shirts hang together in the same wardrobe.
examples.translationZh: 所有的衬衫都挂在同一个衣橱里。

meaningZh: 一匙，一匙的量；“spoon”的派生

examples.text: She put a spoonful of milk in each of the two cup.
examples.translationZh: 她在这两个杯子里各放了一匙牛奶。

examples.text: Please put another spoonful of broth on my plate.
examples.translationZh: 请再舀一匙汤到我的盘子里。

meaningZh: 随意的，任性的，随心所欲的；主观的，武断的；霸道的，专制的，专横的，独断独行的

examples.text: My choice was quite arbitrary.
examples.translationZh: 我的选择相当随意。

examples.text: I'm not used to your arbitrary standards.
examples.translationZh: 我不习惯你们那些随心所欲的标准。

examples.text: Dictators are arbitrary rulers.
examples.translationZh: 独裁者即独断专横的统治者。

meaningZh: 工程师，技师；（轮船的）机师；〈美〉（火车的）司机

examples.text: Hs is a civil engineer.
examples.translationZh: 他是位土木工程师。

examples.text: His dream is to become an engineer.
examples.translationZh: 他的梦想是将来成为一名工程师。

examples.text: He is a locomotive engineer.
examples.translationZh: 他是一名火车司机。

meaningZh: 害怕；可能性；（对神等的）敬畏

examples.text: He is haunted by the fear that the police will find the truth.
examples.translationZh: 他坐立难安,担心警察最终会发现真相。

examples.text: The thought of returning filled him with fear.
examples.translationZh: 一想到还要回去,他心里就害怕。

examples.text: Crusoe stared at the footprint, full of fear.
examples.translationZh: 克鲁索盯着脚印,心里充满了恐惧。

meaningZh: 自行车；脚踏车；v. 骑自行车

examples.text: Can you ride a bicycle?
examples.translationZh: 你会骑自行车吗？

examples.text: He beguiled me into lending him my bicycle.
examples.translationZh: 他骗我把自行车借给了他。

examples.text: Every day he rode his old bicycle to his office.
examples.translationZh: 每天他骑着他那辆旧自行车去上班。

meaningZh: 奶奶，外婆；na. 奶奶，外婆

examples.text: Grandpa and grandma sat in the back of the car.
examples.translationZh: 爷爷和奶奶坐在汽车後排的座位上。

examples.text: Grandma was a good teller of stories.
examples.translationZh: 奶奶很会讲故事。

examples.text: Grandma sealed the jam in the jar.
examples.translationZh: 外婆把果酱密封在罐子里。

meaningZh: 他们；她们；它们

examples.text: Let's go visit them.
examples.translationZh: 让我们去拜访他们吧。

examples.text: A feeling of resentment urged him to abandon them.
examples.translationZh: 一种怨恨的心情促使他离开了她们。

examples.text: Don't bend the wires down, it'll break them.
examples.translationZh: 不要弯折那些线，会弄坏它们的。

meaningZh: 废除，废止；取消，革除；消灭

examples.text: Abraham Lincoln abolished slavery in the United States.
examples.translationZh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯在美国废除了奴隶制。

examples.text: There are many bad customs and laws that ought to be abolished.
examples.translationZh: 有许多不良的习俗和法规应予以废除。

examples.text: They petitioned the government to abolish hanging.
examples.translationZh: 他们向政府请愿，要求废除绞刑。

meaningZh: 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握

examples.text: He shook his fist at me.
examples.translationZh: 他对我挥舞着拳头。

examples.text: I clenched my fist and hit him.
examples.translationZh: 我攥紧拳头向他击去。

examples.text: He was banging on the door with his fist.
examples.translationZh: 他用拳头砸门。

meaningZh: 全部的；一切的；各种的

examples.text: All wood tends to shrink.
examples.translationZh: 所有木头都会缩一些.

examples.text: All my plants have died.
examples.translationZh: 我的花草全死光了。

examples.text: He spent all his time reading.
examples.translationZh: 他把全部时间都花在阅读上。

meaningZh: 收入，进款；进来的动作；进入

examples.text: His income is well below the average.
examples.translationZh: 他的收入大大低于平均水平。

examples.text: My monthly income was just over 200 pounds.
examples.translationZh: 我每月的收入是200多磅。

examples.text: He needs a high income to support such a large family.
examples.translationZh: 他需要有高收入才能供养得起这样一个大家庭。

meaningZh: 最初的；开始的；首字母的

examples.text: This is a letter paper personalized with his initials.
examples.translationZh: 这是一张有他姓名首字母的信纸。

examples.text: After the initial cheers,the noise of the crowd began to die away as the group started playing.
examples.translationZh: 开始的欢呼声结束以后，乐队开始演奏，人们的喧闹声也随之逐渐消失。

examples.text: We are through the initial testing period.
examples.translationZh: 我们通过了最初的考试阶段

meaningZh: 分开，分隔；[数]除法；部门

examples.text: The divisions between the various classes of society are not so sharply marked as they used to be.
examples.translationZh: 现在社会上各阶级的划分不象过去那样明显了。

examples.text: The boy has learnt to do division.
examples.translationZh: 这个小男孩已学会做除法。

examples.text: He works in the foreign division of the company.
examples.translationZh: 他在公司的外事部工作。

meaningZh: 宣布参加竞选；当播音员；vt. 宣布

examples.text: I hope to announce the winner shortly.
examples.translationZh: 我希望马上宣布胜利者的名字。

examples.text: The president will announce a momentous decision.
examples.translationZh: 主席将宣布重要决定。

examples.text: We can go out to people and announce Good News.
examples.translationZh: 我们能够走向人们，宣告天国的好消息。

meaningZh: 照料，照顾；护理；照管，管理

examples.text: Weeds tend to displace other plants.
examples.translationZh: 杂草越来越多，有取代其他植物之势。

examples.text: During the interview, some interviewees tend to exaggerate.
examples.translationZh: 面试时,有些面试者会有夸大的倾向。

examples.text: He's a good salesman, but his offhand manner does tend to put people off.
examples.translationZh: 他是个很好的推销员，可是他那随便的态度容易使人产生反感。

meaningZh: 句子；宣判；vt. 宣判，判决

examples.text: It is a fact that I have written this sentence.
examples.translationZh: 我写了这个句子是事实。

examples.text: The judge will pass sentence tomorrow after looking at the report.
examples.translationZh: 法官看完报告后明天会做出判决。

examples.text: He has been sentenced to pay a fine of 1000 pounds.
examples.translationZh: 他被判罚款1000英镑。

meaningZh: 缺乏，缺少；需要的东西；n. 缺乏，不足，没有

examples.text: Her decision seems to show a lack of political judgement.
examples.translationZh: 她的决定似乎显示出缺乏政治判断力。

examples.text: Lack of sun retards plant growth.
examples.translationZh: 光照不足则植物生长缓慢。

examples.text: In a cold winter, many wild animals can die from lack of food.
examples.translationZh: 在严寒的冬天,很多野生动物可能因缺乏食物而死去。

meaningZh: 光照片；vt. 照X光

examples.text: Do I need X-rays?
examples.translationZh: 我需要拍X光片吗？
examples.author: GlossaMatik

meaningZh: 差别，差异；[数]差数，差额；意见分歧

examples.text: How do you account for the difference between them?
examples.translationZh: 你怎样来解释它们之间的差异呢？

examples.text: Flowers make no difference to this room.
examples.translationZh: 这房间有没有花没什么区别。

examples.text: It won't make much difference whether you go today or tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 你今天或明天去没有多大关系。

meaningZh: 深度；深处，深海；深奥，奥妙

examples.text: The young man dived to a depth of 40 feet.
examples.translationZh: 那个青年人潜到四十尺的深度。

examples.text: Her latest poem has remarkable depth.
examples.translationZh: 她最近的那首诗极有深度。

examples.text: He is admired for the depth of his perception.
examples.translationZh: 他因理解深刻而很受赏识。

meaningZh: 登记，注册；记录；登记簿

examples.text: You must register if you intend to vote.
examples.translationZh: 如果你要投票选举,你就必须登记。

examples.text: He registered the trial proceedings.
examples.translationZh: 法庭速记员记录下了审判进程。

examples.text: You must register as a member first.
examples.translationZh: 你必须先注册成为会员。

meaningZh: 无用的，无效的；无价值的；差劲的

examples.text: It was an intense but useless struggle.
examples.translationZh: 这是一场剧烈而无用的挣扎。

examples.text: Please cancel the words which are useless.
examples.translationZh: 请把无用的词划掉。

examples.text: When the umpire says you are out, it is useless to argue because his decision is irrevocable.
examples.translationZh: 当裁判宣布你出局时，任何辩解都是无效的，因为他的判决不可更改。

meaningZh: 应用，运用；申请；涂

examples.text: We should not only know the theory but also how to apply it to practice.
examples.translationZh: 我们不仅要知道理论，还要知道怎样把理论应用于实践。

examples.text: The plastic coating is easy to be applied on any surface.
examples.translationZh: 塑性涂料容易涂在任何表面上。

examples.text: I am applying for a fellowship.
examples.translationZh: 我在申请研究生奖学金。

meaningZh: 拖拽；吃力地往前拉；拖地而行

examples.text: He dragged the heavy case across the floor.
examples.translationZh: 他在地板上拖着那个沉重的箱子。

examples.text: shrug aside
examples.translationZh: 不予理会

examples.text: She dragged herself out of bed, still half asleep.
examples.translationZh: 她挣扎着起了床,还是睡眼惺忪。

meaningZh: [C]金刚石,钻石；菱形；方块牌

examples.text: She wore a diamond clip on her new dress.
examples.translationZh: 她在新衣服上戴了一枚钻石别针。

examples.text: The diamond ring on her finger glittered in the light.
examples.translationZh: 她手指上的钻石戒指在灯光下闪闪发光。

examples.text: Her bedroom curtains have a diamond pattern.
examples.translationZh: 她卧室的窗帘有菱形的图案。

meaningZh: 考虑；把（某人，某事）看作…，认为（某人，某事）如何；考虑，细想

examples.text: Please take time to consider the problem.
examples.translationZh: 请仔细考虑一下这个问题。

examples.text: They did not consider whether they could afford the time or not.
examples.translationZh: 他们没有考虑是否抽得出时间。

examples.text: When you read, don't just consider what the author thinks, consider what you think.
examples.translationZh: 当你在阅读的时候,不要只是思考作者在想什么,而是要思考你在想什么。

meaningZh: 悲痛；悔恨，惋惜；伤心事

examples.text: He wrung his hands in sorrow.
examples.translationZh: 他悲伤地绞紧双手。

examples.text: He hanged himself in sorrow after his wife died.
examples.translationZh: 妻子死后，他因悲伤而自缢。

examples.text: Life has many joys and sorrows.
examples.translationZh: 人生有许多欢乐和悲伤。

meaningZh: 压（力）；压力；气压（或血压）（的缩略形式）

examples.text: My father suffers from high blood pressure.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲有高血压。

examples.text: The pressure of work was too great for him.
examples.translationZh: 工作的压力使他承受不了。

examples.text: He works well under pressure.
examples.translationZh: 他在有压力的情况下工作很出色。

meaningZh: 镭(88号元素符号Ra)

examples.text: Radium and uranium are radioactive elements.
examples.translationZh: 镭和铀是放射性元素。

examples.text: Madame Curie discovered the element radium.
examples.translationZh: 居里夫人发现了镭元素。

meaningZh: 同意；批准；赞成

examples.text: The proposal was accepted with unanimous approval.
examples.translationZh: 全体一致通过了那项建议。

examples.text: We should submit our plans to the council for approval.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该向理事会提交计划以求批准。

examples.text: Your approval gives me much gratification.
examples.translationZh: 承蒙认可，我非常高兴。

meaningZh: 不中（目标），不对（题），与…无关；（表示排斥）除…之外；（表示位置）在…旁边，，在…一侧，在…附近

examples.text: I set a chair beside him and sat down.
examples.translationZh: 我在他旁边放了一把椅子然后坐下了。

examples.text: The little girl is sitting beside her mother.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩正坐在她妈妈旁边。

examples.text: Our achievements seem small beside his.
examples.translationZh: 与他的成就相比我们的就显得微不足道了。

meaningZh: 腐烂，腐朽；vt.& vi. （使）腐烂，（使）腐朽

examples.text: Foot rot is an avoidable affiction.
examples.translationZh: 烂蹄病是可以避免的。

examples.text: Rot in the tree trunk caused the tree to fall.
examples.translationZh: 树干的腐烂导致树倒了。

examples.text: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.
examples.translationZh: 屋顶的木料已经腐朽并遭虫害。

meaningZh: 太阳，阳光；恒星；中心人物

examples.text: The earth goes round the sun.
examples.translationZh: 地球绕着太阳运行。

examples.text: The sun rises in the east.
examples.translationZh: 太阳从东方升起。

examples.text: They sat in the sun roasting themselves.
examples.translationZh: 他们坐着晒太阳。

meaningZh: 告诉，说；辨别；吩咐

examples.text: It's very kind of you to tell me the truth.
examples.translationZh: 你真好,告诉我这真相。

examples.text: Let me tell you some details about clearance.
examples.translationZh: 让我告诉你一些通关的细节。

examples.text: Tell that joker to stop using my parking space.
examples.translationZh: 叫那个家伙不要占用我的停车场。

meaningZh: 大臣；部长；公使

examples.text: The president gave his minister carte blanche in foreign affairs.
examples.translationZh: 总统把处理外交事务的全权授予他的公使。

examples.text: He was elected Minister of Education.
examples.translationZh: 他被选为教育部长。

examples.text: The minister can only act in this matter with the sanction of Parliament.
examples.translationZh: 部长只有得到国会批准才能就此事采取行动。

meaningZh: 责任；职责；责任感，责任心

examples.text: It's my responsibility to lock the doors.
examples.translationZh: 我负责锁门。

examples.text: You can't retreat from the responsibility in this affair.
examples.translationZh: 你不能回避在这一事件中的责任。

examples.text: The prescription of drugs is a doctor's responsibility.
examples.translationZh: 开药方是医生的职责。

meaningZh: 牺牲者，受害者；自找苦吃的人；受骗者，上当者

examples.text: Think of yourself as a survivor, not a victim.
examples.translationZh: 把自己看作幸运儿,不要看作受害者。

examples.text: The victim was smothered to death.
examples.translationZh: 受害人被窒息致死。

examples.text: She fell an easy victim to his temptation.
examples.translationZh: 她经不起他的诱惑，轻易地被骗了。

meaningZh: 发明；发明物；捏造：内心捏造的东西，特指谎言

examples.text: The invention of the computer marked the beginning of a new era.
examples.translationZh: 计算机的发明标志着一个新时代的开始。

examples.text: Necessity is the mother of invention.
examples.translationZh: 需要是发明之母。

examples.text: This story is apparently a complete invention.
examples.translationZh: 这个故事显然完全是虚构的。

meaningZh: 修理，修补；改正，纠正；加强

examples.text: We need an electrician to mend the iron.
examples.translationZh: 我们要请电工修理熨斗。

examples.text: It won't take long to mend the car.
examples.translationZh: 修理这辆汽车用不了很长时间。

examples.text: He sent for someone to mend the broken window.
examples.translationZh: 他叫人来修补破窗子。

meaningZh: 吸收（液体、气体等）；吸引（注意）；吞并，合并

examples.text: Dry sand absorbs water.
examples.translationZh: 干沙吸收水份。

examples.text: Did you absorb everything the professor said?
examples.translationZh: 教授说的你全部理解了吗?

examples.text: His business absorbs him.
examples.translationZh: 他的业务使他全神贯注。

meaningZh: 思想；想法；关心

examples.text: The old man was lost in thought and did not hear us come in.
examples.translationZh: 这个老人凝神沉思，没有听见我们进来。

examples.text: Art is the mold of feeling as language is the mold of thought.
examples.translationZh: 艺术是感情的模制品,犹如语言是思想的模制品。

examples.text: They stood possessed by the same thought.
examples.translationZh: 他们站在那儿,心里让同样的想法所盘踞。

meaningZh: 长的；长久的；长久地,长期地

examples.text: She was slender and had long dark hair.
examples.translationZh: 她身材苗条，有一头长长的黑发。

examples.text: She bought some roses with long stems.
examples.translationZh: 她买了一些枝干很长的玫瑰花。

examples.text: He delivered a long prose full of platitudes.
examples.translationZh: 他发表了一篇充满陈词滥调的文章。

meaningZh: 提供，给予；提出，提议；出价，开价

examples.text: We offer a free backup service to customers.
examples.translationZh: 对顾客我们提供免费配套服务。

examples.text: Can you offer any evidence in support of what you have said?
examples.translationZh: 你能提出证据来印证你讲的话吗？

examples.text: We offered 100,000 for the warehouse, but another company outbid us.
examples.translationZh: 我们出价1000,000英镑购买这个库房,但另一家公司出价高于我们。

meaningZh: 曲调，曲子；和谐，调谐；语调

examples.text: He played a tune on the violin.
examples.translationZh: 他用小提琴演奏了一首曲子。

examples.text: She was humming a tune to herself.
examples.translationZh: 她自个儿哼著小调。

examples.text: The violin is not quite in tune with the piano.
examples.translationZh: 这小提琴跟钢琴的调子不太和谐。

meaningZh: 强壮的,强有力的；牢固的；坚强的,坚定的

examples.text: A strong light impinged on his eyes.
examples.translationZh: 一道强烈的光刺着他的眼睛。

examples.text: She has a strong desire to become a writer.
examples.translationZh: 她有成为作家的强烈愿望。

examples.text: Such tendentious statements are likely to provoke strong opposition.
examples.translationZh: 这种有倾向性的说法可能招致强烈的反对。

meaningZh: 纸烟，香烟

examples.text: He asked me if I had a cigarette lighter with me.
examples.translationZh: 他问我身上是否带着打火机。

examples.text: A cigarette set the dry grass alight.
examples.translationZh: 香烟把乾草点著了。

examples.text: Don't drop cigarette ash on the carpet.
examples.translationZh: 别把烟灰落在地毯上。

meaningZh: 自豪的，得意的；光荣的，高尚的；傲慢的

examples.text: If your father had still been alive, he would have felt very proud of you.
examples.translationZh: 你父亲如果还健在的话,他会为你骄傲的。

examples.text: It was a proud day for us when we won the trophy.
examples.translationZh: 我们夺得奖杯那一天是值得我们骄傲的日子。

examples.text: They are poor but proud.
examples.translationZh: 他们虽穷但很自重。

meaningZh: 缺点，劣势；退税

examples.text: The great drawback to living near a main road is noise.
examples.translationZh: 住在大街旁最大的缺点是噪音。

examples.text: Everything has its drawbacks.
examples.translationZh: 凡事都有不足之处。

examples.text: Many people are talking about the impact of export drawback system reform on the economy in China these days.
examples.translationZh: 这些天来许多人都在讨论出口退税制度改革对我国经济的影响。

meaningZh: 解释；说明；辩解

examples.text: I made a full and frank explanation to the court.
examples.translationZh: 我对堂上直话直说,从头到尾解释了一番。

examples.text: What did he say in explanation of his stupid behavior?
examples.translationZh: 他说了什么来解释他那愚蠢的行为？

examples.text: There could be some psychological explanation for his bad health.
examples.translationZh: 他的健康不佳可能有心理上的原因。

meaningZh: 温柔的；温暖的；轻微的

examples.text: He has a mild nature.
examples.translationZh: 他的性格温和。

examples.text: He gave a mild answer, in spite of his anger.
examples.translationZh: 尽管他十分恼火,他还是态度温和地回答了。

examples.text: The coastal area has very mild winter, but by contrast the central plains become extremely cold.
examples.translationZh: 靠近海岸的地区有很温和的冬天,相比而方,靠近中央的平原就变得非常寒冷。

meaningZh: 尺；直尺；统治者

examples.text: The ruler is divided into centimetres.
examples.translationZh: 在尺子上分厘米刻度。

examples.text: He reminded me not to forget to bring my ruler.
examples.translationZh: 他提醒我别忘了带尺子。

examples.text: The colonists revolted against their British ruler.
examples.translationZh: 殖民地人民反抗他们的英国统治者。

meaningZh: 温暖，暖和；热情，热心；激动

examples.text: The sun gives (us) warmth and light.
examples.translationZh: 太阳供给我们光和热。

examples.text: She sheds warmth and happiness around her.
examples.translationZh: 她给周围的人带来温暖兴幸福。

examples.text: He was pleased by the warmth of his welcome.
examples.translationZh: 他因受到热烈欢迎而高兴。

meaningZh: 暂时的停顿；犹豫；（诗中）节奏的停顿

examples.text: There will be a brief pause in the program.
examples.translationZh: 这个计划可能需要暂停一下。

examples.text: I made the classic mistake of clapping in a pause in the music!
examples.translationZh: 我在乐曲演奏暂停的间歇鼓起掌来，真是大错特错！

examples.text: There was a pregnant pause before she answered my question.
examples.translationZh: 她耐人寻味地停顿了一下才回答我的问题。

meaningZh: 与…作战；争斗；n. 战争，战役

examples.text: His brave deeds in the battle earned him everlasting glory.
examples.translationZh: 他在那场战斗中的英勇事迹为他赢得了永恒的荣誉。

examples.text: He has proved his wit in the battle.
examples.translationZh: 他已在这场争斗中证明了自己的睿智。

examples.text: They battled with the wind and the waves.
examples.translationZh: 他们与风浪搏斗。

meaningZh: 边疆，边境；边界，边缘；尚待开发的领域

examples.text: We were turned back at the frontier.
examples.translationZh: 我们在边界那儿被赶了回来。

examples.text: The frontier ranges from the northern hills to the southern coast.
examples.translationZh: 边界从北部山地一直延伸到南部海岸。

examples.text: Everything is quiet on the frontier.
examples.translationZh: 边境上一切安静。

meaningZh: 欢乐的，高兴的；令人愉快的

examples.text: His cheerful manner belied his real feelings.
examples.translationZh: 他那快活的样子掩饰了他真实的感情。

examples.text: There is hardly any cheerful news in the papers.
examples.translationZh: 报上没有什么叫人高兴的消息。

examples.text: A cheerful wife is the joy of life.
