examples.translationZh: 快乐的妻子是生活的乐事。

meaningZh: （用以强调）完全的；完成的；达到结尾的

examples.text: We'll certainly set up a complete modern industrial system.
examples.translationZh: 我们一定要建立一个完整的现代化工业体系。

examples.text: When the experiment is complete, include your findings in a report.
examples.translationZh: 试验完成後,请把结果写入报告。

examples.text: This is a complete failure.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个彻底的失败。

meaningZh: 日晷；钟（表）面，标度盘；拨号盘

examples.text: The phone number is on the dial.
examples.translationZh: 号码就在拨号盘上。

examples.text: Please clean the telephone set including the dial.
examples.translationZh: 请将电话机清理一下,包括拨号盘。

examples.text: The dial records very slight variations in pressure.
examples.translationZh: 刻度盘显示出压力有微小变化。

meaningZh: 热狗

examples.text: I bought a hotdog for lunch.
examples.translationZh: 午餐我买了一个热狗。

meaningZh: （级别、地位）较高的；（在质量等方面）较好的；（数量）较多的

examples.text: He always does what his superiors tell him.
examples.translationZh: 他惟上级之命是从。

examples.text: He has no superior as a Shakespearian actor.
examples.translationZh: 他演莎士比亚戏剧无出其右。

examples.text: He smiled a superior smile as he drove past in his expensive new car.
examples.translationZh: 他开着那辆豪华的新车驶过时，傲慢的微微一笑。

meaningZh: 贸易；行业；顾客

examples.text: China does a lot of trade with many countries.
examples.translationZh: 中国和许多国家进行多方面贸易。

examples.text: There has been some shrinkage in our export trade.
examples.translationZh: 我们的出口贸易量已有些减少。

examples.text: He started his daughter up in the trade.
examples.translationZh: 他让女儿从事这一行业。

meaningZh: 基础的，基本的，根本的，重要的，原始的，主要的，十分重大的；[物]基频的，基谐波的；[乐]基音的

examples.text: For something fundamental has changed in Venezuela.
examples.translationZh: 因为在委内瑞拉，有一些基本的东西已经改变了。

examples.text: Trial by the jury is a fundamental right.
examples.translationZh: 有陪审团陪同审判是一项基本的权利。

examples.text: From the outset, it had two fundamental flaws.
examples.translationZh: 从一开始，这一合作就有两个根本的缺陷。

meaningZh: 网；（电视与计算机）网络；网状物

examples.text: The fabrics are merchandised through a network of dealers.
examples.translationZh: 通过经销网点销售纺织品。

examples.text: The Internet is a worldwide computer network.
examples.translationZh: 因特网是一个全球计算机网络系统。

examples.text: She gave me a diagram of railway network.
examples.translationZh: 她给了我一张铁路网图解。

meaningZh: 有系统的，有规则的；有条不紊的；有步骤的

examples.text: He is making a systematic study of the subject.
examples.translationZh: 他在对那一科目作系统的研究。

examples.text: The school offered a systematic course in reading.
examples.translationZh: 学校提供系统的阅读课程。

examples.text: Science means systematic knowledge possessed as a result of practice and study.
examples.translationZh: 科学是由于实践和研究的结果而获得的系统知识。

meaningZh: 水平；平面；飞机

examples.text: The plane flew high above.
examples.translationZh: 飞机高高地在上空飞。

examples.text: The plane circled the airport before landing.
examples.translationZh: 飞机在着陆之前在机场上空盘旋。

examples.text: Keep your work on a high plane.
examples.translationZh: 使你的工作保持在高水平上。

meaningZh: 碰撞；使发出巨响；暴跌

examples.text: He crashed his car into a wall.
examples.translationZh: 他的汽车撞到了墙上。

examples.text: The rocks crashed down onto the car.
examples.translationZh: 岩石轰隆一声砸在汽车上。

examples.text: She was frightened that the plane would crash.
examples.translationZh: 她害怕飞机会坠毁。

meaningZh: 食品杂货店；食品杂货业

examples.text: Her mother began to operate a small grocery.
examples.translationZh: 她母亲开始经营一家小杂货店。

examples.text: She summed up the bills from the grocery with great care.
examples.translationZh: 她非常仔细地合计那些来自食品杂货店的帐单。

examples.text: He's bound up with the grocery trade in some way or another.
examples.translationZh: 他同食品杂货业有着某种密切的关系。

meaningZh: 跟随，接着；vt. 继承；（按时间、顺序等）接着

examples.text: The little boy followed his father out.
examples.translationZh: 小男孩跟随他父亲出去了。

examples.text: They blew up the bridge so that the enemy couldn't follow them.
examples.translationZh: 他们炸毁了桥梁,使敌人无法追赶他们。

examples.text: If you ignore your diet, trouble will follow.
examples.translationZh: 如果你忽视自己的饮食，必然会遇到麻烦

meaningZh: 行动；表现；表演

examples.text: It is an act of kindness to help a blind man across the street.
examples.translationZh: 帮助盲人过街是慈善的行为。

examples.text: This act had to get a strong support from them.
examples.translationZh: 这个行动必须得到他们的大力支持。

examples.text: In 1601, Parliament passed an act, which aimed to provide the poor with more jobs.
examples.translationZh: 1601年,国会通过了一项旨在向贫困群体提供更多工作机会的法案。

meaningZh: 发抖，颤抖；摇动，震动；n. 震动，摇动

examples.text: The ground quaked under his feet.
examples.translationZh: 大地在他的脚下震动。

examples.text: I stood there quaking with fear.
examples.translationZh: 我站在那里，害怕得直发抖。

examples.text: The sound of quake is very terrible.
examples.translationZh: 震动的声音很吓人。

meaningZh: 购买；采购；换得

examples.text: She purchased a number of shares in the company.
examples.translationZh: 她在公司里买了一些股票。

examples.text: Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.
examples.translationZh: 票必须提前两周买。

examples.text: The receipt is your proof of purchase.
examples.translationZh: 这张发票是你购物的凭据.

meaningZh: 埋葬，葬；为…举行葬礼；隐藏，埋藏，遮盖，掩蔽

examples.text: Even if you kill me, even if you bury me, I should rise again.
examples.translationZh: 即使你杀了我

examples.text: The funeral is tomorrow and they will bury the body after the church service.
examples.translationZh: 葬礼明天举行，他们会在教堂仪式后埋葬遗体。

examples.text: He likes to bury himself in the country.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢隐居乡间。

meaningZh: 颜色；肤色；彩色

examples.text: She painted the window sills a bright colour.
examples.translationZh: 她把窗台漆上鲜艳的颜色。

examples.text: His dress is very similar to mine in colour.
examples.translationZh: 他衣服的颜色和我衣服的很相似。

examples.text: That colour doesn't suit your complexion.
examples.translationZh: 那颜色不适合你的肤色。

meaningZh: 出席；致力于，献身于；侍候，照顾

examples.text: I shall be attending the meeting.
examples.translationZh: 我会参加会议。

examples.text: During summer vacations some teachers attend seminars at college.
examples.translationZh: 暑假里,一些教师在学院里参加研究班。

examples.text: You're going out? But who will attend to the baby?
examples.translationZh: 你要出去?那谁来照料这婴儿。

meaningZh: 同伴；男子；（大学的）研究员

examples.text: Jack is a clever fellow indeed.
examples.translationZh: 杰克确实是个聪明的家伙。

examples.text: I can't tolerate that rude fellow.
examples.translationZh: 我不能容忍那个粗鲁的家伙。

examples.text: That foolish fellow is looking for trouble.
examples.translationZh: 那个愚蠢的家伙在自找麻烦。

meaningZh: 运送，运输；流放；使欣喜若狂

examples.text: The goods have been cased up for transport.
examples.translationZh: 货物已装箱待运。

examples.text: London Transport run extra trains during the rush-hour.
examples.translationZh: 伦敦运输公司在交通高峰时 间增开加班列车。

examples.text: Please find alternative means of transport.
examples.translationZh: 请另外找一个运输方法。

meaningZh: 公司，商号；作伴，伴侣，客人；连队，中队

examples.text: I work in a small company.
examples.translationZh: 我在一家小公司工作。

examples.text: The company doubled its size in nine years.
examples.translationZh: 9年来这家公司的规模扩大了一倍。

examples.text: The company has connections with a number of Japanese firms.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司与几家日本商号有业务往来。

meaningZh: 有轨电车轨道；煤车，矿车，缆车；vt. 用电车（等）运

examples.text: A tram was just arriving at the hill foot.
examples.translationZh: 一辆缆车刚到达山脚下。

examples.text: If you go to Melbourne, you can travel by tram.
examples.translationZh: 如果你要去墨尔本，你可以做有轨电车。

examples.text: The tram is being switched on to another track.
examples.translationZh: 电车正被移至另外一条轨道上。

meaningZh: 讲解，解释；vt. 说明…的原因，辩解；vi. 说明，解释，辩解

examples.text: She explained her conduct to her boss.
examples.translationZh: 她向老板说明了自己那种表现的原因。

examples.text: He explained his plan in some detail.
examples.translationZh: 他仔细地说明了自己的计划。

examples.text: The lawyer explained the new law to us.
examples.translationZh: 律师向我们解释了新法律。

meaningZh: 完成；达到（目的）；走完（路程、距离等）

examples.text: I have accomplished a great deal in the last few months.
examples.translationZh: 在过去几个月里，我完成了相当多的工作。

examples.text: The prediction was literally accomplished.
examples.translationZh: 这个预言确实实现了。

examples.text: The role of a judge is to accomplish fairness.
examples.translationZh: 法官的职责是实现公平。

meaningZh: 教师，教员，老师，先生；[航]教练机

examples.text: I asked the teacher for her advice.
examples.translationZh: 我征求这位老师的意见。

examples.text: She is a teacher aged only twenty.
examples.translationZh: 她是一位年仅二十岁的教师。

examples.text: My foreign teacher came from Australia.
examples.translationZh: 我的外籍教师来自澳大利亚。

meaningZh: 好的，上等的；纤细的，精致的；健康的

examples.text: She is a fine singer, as her mother used to.
examples.translationZh: 像她妈妈过去一样,她是个很好的歌手。

examples.text: She has a remarkably fine voice.
examples.translationZh: 她嗓音非常好。

examples.text: We're going to a famous restaurant famous for its fine cuisine.
examples.translationZh: 我们要去一家有名的餐馆,它是以精致的菜肴闻名。

meaningZh: 是；（表示刚想起某事）哦；（表示不相信某人所言）真的吗

examples.text: Yes, monsieur.
examples.translationZh: 是，先生。

examples.text: Yes, you're quite right.
examples.translationZh: 是的，你很对。

examples.text: Yes, I don't see why not.
examples.translationZh: 是的，我看不出有什么不好。

meaningZh: 恢复；重新获得；找回

examples.text: He's now fully recovered from his stroke.
examples.translationZh: 他现已从中风病完全康复了。

examples.text: He is very ill and unlikely to recover.
examples.translationZh: 他病得非常厉害，不大可能恢复健康了。

examples.text: I nearly fell but managed to recover myself.
examples.translationZh: 我差一点倒下,但最后还是站稳了脚根。

meaningZh: 发动机，引擎；工具；火车头

examples.text: What's the cubic capacity of this engine?
examples.translationZh: 这台发动机的立体容积是多少？

examples.text: There must be something wrong with the engine of my car.
examples.translationZh: 我汽车的引擎一定是出故障了。

examples.text: Industrialization is the most important engine of economic growth.
examples.translationZh: 工业化是经济增长最重要的拉动因素。

meaningZh: 利益；维护；支持

examples.text: The agent spoke on behalf of his principal.
examples.translationZh: 代理人代表他的委托人说话。

examples.text: On behalf of my colleagues and myself I thank you.
examples.translationZh: 我代表我的同事和我本人向你表示感谢。

examples.text: He agreed to testify on behalf of the accused man.
examples.translationZh: 他同意为被告作证。

meaningZh: 天（空）；vt. 将…击向空中；将…高挂

examples.text: He stared up at the stars twinkling in the sky above him.
examples.translationZh: 他抬眼凝视着头顶上方星光闪烁的天空。

examples.text: The sky slowly changed from blue to red.
examples.translationZh: 天空慢慢由蓝色变为红色。

examples.text: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 云是天空中的水汽团。

meaningZh: 店主，老板

examples.text: The shopkeeper managed to keep in with his customers.
examples.translationZh: 店主设法做到同顾客搞好关系。

examples.text: She complained loudly to the shopkeeper, who answered her mildly.
examples.translationZh: 她大声对店主抱怨，店主却温和地回答她。

examples.text: I'm sure the shopkeeper gave me short measure when she weighed out the potatoes.
examples.translationZh: 我肯定那店老板给我称土豆时,扣了分量。

meaningZh: 国家的；国有的；国民的

examples.text: These ancient buildings are part of the national heritage.
examples.translationZh: 这些古建是民族遗产的一部分。

examples.text: We must safeguard our national interests.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须保卫国家的利益。

examples.text: National wealth depends to a high degree on a country's educational standard.
examples.translationZh: 国民财富在很大程度上取决于一个国家的教育水准。

meaningZh: 扫描；细看；细查

examples.text: Could you teach me how to scan an image?
examples.translationZh: 你可以教我如何扫描一个影像吗?

examples.text: I scanned the newspaper when I was waiting for the bus.
examples.translationZh: 等公共汽车的时候，我匆匆浏览了一下报纸。

examples.text: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
examples.translationZh: 她审视他的脸,试图探寻他在思考什么。

meaningZh: 微小的；细小的；不结实的

examples.text: He has a slight wheeze in his chest.
examples.translationZh: 他呼吸时胸部发出轻微的响声。

examples.text: Our army suffered a slight reverse.
examples.translationZh: 我们的部队受到轻微的挫败。

examples.text: The salve will heal slight burns.
examples.translationZh: 这药膏能治疗轻微烧伤。

meaningZh: 相识的人，熟人；相识；对…有了解

examples.text: He is not a friend of mine, only an acquaintance.
examples.translationZh: 他不是朋友我的,只是个熟人。

examples.text: I made his acquaintance at a party.
examples.translationZh: 我是在一次聚会上认识他的。

examples.text: Their acquaintance was of long standing.
examples.translationZh: 他们相识多年。

meaningZh: 欲睡的；困乏的；安静的

examples.text: The softness of the breeze made him feel sleepy.
examples.translationZh: 柔和的微风使他昏昏欲睡。

examples.text: I'm too sleepy to watch the end of the show.
examples.translationZh: 我太困倦了，不能把戏看完。

examples.text: I often feel sleepy after supper and then I get my second wind later in the evening.
examples.translationZh: 我吃完晚饭常感到困，一到晚上就又精神了。

meaningZh: 象征；标志；符号

examples.text: The chemical symbol for copper is "Cu".
examples.translationZh: 铜的化学符号是Cu。

examples.text: The dove is the symbol of peace.
examples.translationZh: 鸽子是和平的象征。

examples.text: The river-sea dividing marker must be a symbol which separates the Yalu River from the Yellow Sea.
examples.translationZh: 江海分界碑,这里就是鸭绿江和黄海分界的标志吧。

meaningZh: 管，管状物；电子管；地铁

examples.text: This tube is flexible but tough.
examples.translationZh: 这管子柔软但很坚固。

examples.text: She bought a tube of toothpaste.
examples.translationZh: 她买了一管牙膏。

examples.text: I go to work on the tube.
examples.translationZh: 我经常乘地铁去上班。

meaningZh: 检查，检验；视察；vi. 进行检查

examples.text: Police were called out to keep at the airport, and inspect the arriving planes.
examples.translationZh: 警察们被紧急召集起来去守卫机场，并对到达的飞机进行检查。

examples.text: It was strange that nobody inspected my ticket before I got on the train.
examples.translationZh: 很奇怪，我上火车前，竟然没有人查看我的车票。

examples.text: Customs officers inspect our baggage.
examples.translationZh: 海关人员检查我们的行李。

meaningZh: 陌生的，生疏的；奇怪的，古怪的；疏远的

examples.text: It seemed strange that she would leave so early.
examples.translationZh: 奇怪的是她竟然走的这么早。

examples.text: He had a strange expression on his face.
examples.translationZh: 他脸上呈现出奇怪的表情。

examples.text: What strange clothes you're wearing!
examples.translationZh: 你穿的衣服真特别!

meaningZh: 笔记；便笺；音符

examples.text: Students should take notes during the lectures.
examples.translationZh: 学生们上课应该做笔记。

examples.text: Seeing nobody at home, he decided to leave a note.
examples.translationZh: 看到没人在家,他决定留下一个便条。

examples.text: I'd like to break this 50 dollars note.
examples.translationZh: 我想把这张50美元的纸币换开。

meaningZh: 漏出；透露；（指消息，秘密等）泄密

examples.text: Water had started to leak into the cellar.
examples.translationZh: 水已开始渗入地下室。

examples.text: The kitchen roof is apt to leak when it rains.
examples.translationZh: 厨房的屋顶下雨时容易漏雨。

examples.text: The details were supposed to be secret but somehow leaked out.
examples.translationZh: 这些细节原属秘密，可是不知怎么给泄露出去了。

meaningZh: 在…旁边；表示方式；由于

examples.text: The house by the lake is a restaurant.
examples.translationZh: 湖边的那座房子是家饭店。

examples.text: He entered by the back door.
examples.translationZh: 他从后门进入。

examples.text: The project was viewed favorably by the committee.
examples.translationZh: 那计划受到该委员会的好评。

meaningZh: 保存；保护；避免浪费

examples.text: If I may refer back to the problem we discussed, I think we shall stress on the conservation of our natural resource.
examples.translationZh: 请允许我重提我们刚才讨论过的问题，我想我们应该强调保存我们的自然资源。

examples.text: Conservation methods will also help meet their energy needs.
examples.translationZh: 能量保存方法也会有利于满足其能源需求。

examples.text: Most people have come to accept the need for conservation of natural resources.
examples.translationZh: 现在大多数人已认识到保护自然资源的必要。

meaningZh: 甘蓝（洋白菜、卷心菜）；植物人，常用于英式英语；钱，尤指纸币，常用于美式俚语

examples.text: He is busy pricking out some cabbage seedlings.
examples.translationZh: 他正忙于移植一些卷心菜秧。

examples.text: Cabbage could be eaten raw in salads.
examples.translationZh: 卷心菜可以做成沙拉生吃。

examples.text: I like to cook dishes with cabbage.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢用洋白菜做菜。

meaningZh: 令人尴尬的；难对付的；不方便的

examples.text: It's a little awkward, because he's my friend but I'm still his boss.
examples.translationZh: 他是我朋友,而我又是他老板,这真有点尴尬。

examples.text: He felt awkward and uncomfortable.
examples.translationZh: 他感到尴尬和不舒服。

examples.text: He seemed as awkward and rough as ever.
examples.translationZh: 他跟从前一样拙笨和粗鲁。

meaningZh: 激光[镭射]唱片，光盘

examples.text: The lines AB and CD intersect at E.
examples.translationZh: 直线AB与直线CD相交於E点。

examples.text: The line AB intersects the line CD at E.
examples.translationZh: 直线AB与直线CD相交於E点。

examples.text: AB and CD intersect at (the point) P.
examples.translationZh: AB线和CD线在P点相交。

meaningZh: 动态的；动力的，动力学的；充满活力的，精力充沛的

examples.text: This chapter is on the transformation of heat energy into dynamic energy.
examples.translationZh: 这一章是关于热能转化成动力的。

examples.text: The different varieties of the language are in a dynamic relationship with each other.
examples.translationZh: 这种语言的不同变体间存在着动态的联系。

examples.text: We are looking for dynamic persons to be salesmen.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在寻找充满活力的销售人员。

meaningZh: 年；年纪；一年的期间

examples.text: Winter is the coldest season in a year.
examples.translationZh: 冬季是一年中最冷的季节。

examples.text: The thief was put into prison for one year.
examples.translationZh: 小偷被监禁一年。

examples.text: She was designated sportswoman of the year.
examples.translationZh: 她被指定为本年度的体坛明星。

meaningZh: 陈列，展览；展览品，陈列品；表明

examples.text: There will be an exhibition of the development of automobile industry in our country next week.
examples.translationZh: 下星期将举办一个关于我国汽车工业发展的展览。

examples.text: They came from afar to see the exhibition.
examples.translationZh: 他们从远处赶来参观这个展览会。

examples.text: The quiz was a good opportunity for the exhibition of his knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 这次测验是他显示知识的好机会。

meaningZh: 钱包，钱袋；财力，财源；和包或钱袋相似的东西

examples.text: When did you first miss your purse?
examples.translationZh: 你什么时候发现丢了钱包的?

examples.text: The loss of her purse caused her much inconvenience.
examples.translationZh: 丢失钱包给她带来了诸多不便。

examples.text: This piece of china is beyond my purse.
examples.translationZh: 这件瓷器我买不起。

meaningZh: 女士；小姐；喜欢指使他人的年轻妇女

examples.text: This way please, madam.
examples.translationZh: 这边请，夫人。

examples.text: That poor madam has lost all contact with reality.
examples.translationZh: 那位可怜的夫人脱离了现实生活。

examples.text: Madam Curie is a French professor of physics .
examples.translationZh: 居里夫人是一位法国物理学教授。

meaningZh: 窘境，困境；进退两难

examples.text: In the process of modern urban development, we often find ourselves in a dilemma.
examples.translationZh: 在都市的发展中,我们往往会陷入困境。

examples.text: The bad weather put us in a dilemma——shall we move on or go back?
examples.translationZh: 糟糕的天气使我们进退两难——是继续前进呢,还是打道回府？

meaningZh: 预知，预见；有先见之明

examples.text: Can you foresee what will happen in the future?
examples.translationZh: 你能预见将来会发生什么吗?

examples.text: Nobody could foresee his running away.
examples.translationZh: 没人预见到他的逃跑。

examples.text: Few analysts foresaw that oil prices would rise so steeply.
examples.translationZh: 几乎没有分析师能预见的到石油价格会上升得这么快。

meaningZh: 算术，计算；算法

examples.text: I'm good at history but not so hot at arithmetic.
examples.translationZh: 我的历史成绩不错，但算术不太好。

examples.text: He got the answer by mental arithmetic.
examples.translationZh: 他用心算得出了答案。

examples.text: My job is to instruct you in arithmetic.
examples.translationZh: 我的工作就是指导你学算术。

meaningZh: 出局；在外，在外部；完全，彻底

examples.text: His book came out last month.
examples.translationZh: 他的书上个月出版了。

examples.text: He took out a book from the case.
examples.translationZh: 他从箱子里拿出一本书。

examples.text: Students may not stay out after midnight.
examples.translationZh: 学生午夜后不得在外逗留。

meaningZh: 在…的侧面；在…旁边；与…并排

examples.text: He is the master of the boat moored alongside.
examples.translationZh: 他是那条靠着码头停泊的船的主人。

examples.text: The police car pulled up alongside.
examples.translationZh: 那辆警车在旁边停下。

examples.text: The car drew up alongside the road.
examples.translationZh: 小汽车在路边停下来。

meaningZh: 接待员

examples.text: The receptionist scowled at me.
examples.translationZh: 接待员怒视着我。

examples.text: I will leave a message with the receptionist.
examples.translationZh: 我会给前台小姐留个口信。

meaningZh: 解决；结算；金钱或财产的转让（契约）

examples.text: There is no prospect of a settlement of the dispute.
examples.translationZh: 这场纠纷根本不可能获得解决。

examples.text: Negotiators are looking for a peaceful settlement to the dispute.
examples.translationZh: 谈判双方正寻求和平解决争端的办法。

examples.text: After much discussion the negotiators hammered out a compromise settlement.
examples.translationZh: 双方经多次谈判达成一项折衷的解决办法。

meaningZh: 经过；通过，凭借；取道

examples.text: We went from London to Washington via New York.
examples.translationZh: 我们从伦敦经纽约到华盛顿。

examples.text: This flight is routed to Chicago via New York.
examples.translationZh: 这班机是经纽约飞往芝加哥的。

examples.text: He flew to Europe via the North Pole.
examples.translationZh: 他经由北极飞到欧洲。

meaningZh: 钢琴家；钢琴师；钢琴演奏者

examples.text: It takes years of discipline to become a pianist.
examples.translationZh: 要成为钢琴家需经多年训练。

examples.text: The pianist accompanied her singing.
examples.translationZh: 钢琴家为她的歌唱伴奏。

meaningZh: 污染（作用）；腐败；堕落

examples.text: They devised proposals to deal with air pollution.
examples.translationZh: 他们构想出处理空气污染的方案。

examples.text: Waste water from the factory is the main cause of the pollution of local rivers.
examples.translationZh: 来自那家工厂的污水是当地河流污染的主要原因。

examples.text: Many young people could not resist the spiritual pollution.
examples.translationZh: 很多年轻人不能抵制精神污染。

meaningZh: 沙漠；荒地；应得的赏罚

examples.text: Two thirds of the country is dry or desert.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家有三分之二的地方气候干燥,或者是沙漠。

examples.text: Some of them died of thirst in the desert.
examples.translationZh: 他们中有些人在沙漠中渴死了。

examples.text: Water can transform a desert into a garden.
examples.translationZh: 水能把一片不毛之地变成一座花园。

meaningZh: 自愿的，自发的；志愿的；故意的，有意的

examples.text: He made a voluntary statement to the police.
examples.translationZh: 他自愿为警方作供。

examples.text: Many social services are still provided by voluntary societies in our city.
examples.translationZh: 在我们的城市，许多社会服务仍然是有志愿团体提供的。

examples.text: We rely entirely on voluntary contribution.
examples.translationZh: 我们全靠自愿捐赠。

meaningZh: 教育；教育学；培养

examples.text: Education develops potential abilities.
examples.translationZh: 教育能开发人的潜能。

examples.text: No country can afford to neglect education.
examples.translationZh: 任何国家都不容忽视教育。

examples.text: Our teacher expounded his views on education to me at great length.
examples.translationZh: 我们的老师向我详细讲述了他的教育观点。

meaningZh: （使）加快，（使）增速；加速，催促；促进

examples.text: Our present task is to accelerate economic growth.
examples.translationZh: 加速经济发展是我们当前的任务。

examples.text: The leader is losing ground as the rest of the runners accelerate.
examples.translationZh: 领先者在其余赛跑者加速时就逐渐失去了优势。

examples.text: We will accelerate the reform of the financial system under these circumstances.
examples.translationZh: 在这一背景情况下,我们将加快金融体制改革。

meaningZh: 足够的；适当的，恰当的；差强人意的

examples.text: We had adequate food for a week's journey.
examples.translationZh: 我们有足够的食物可以做一星期的旅行。

examples.text: He sought for an adequate solution to the problem.
examples.translationZh: 他寻求解决这个问题的适当办法。

examples.text: I hope he will be adequate to the job.
examples.translationZh: 我希望他将胜任这一工作。

meaningZh: 它；他；正好是所需的

examples.text: It's Friday.
examples.translationZh: 今天星期五。

examples.text: It irks us to wait for people who are late.
examples.translationZh: 等候迟到的人使我们厌烦。

examples.text: "Where's your car?""It's in the garage."
examples.translationZh: “你的汽车在哪儿呢?”“在车库里。”

meaningZh: 最后的，最终的；决定性的；不可更改的

examples.text: The proposal was presented as final package deal.
examples.translationZh: 那项建议是作为最终的一揽子交易提出来的。

examples.text: We are all satisfied with the final result.
examples.translationZh: 我们都对最终的结果感到满意。

examples.text: This is our final offer.
examples.translationZh: 这是我方的最后报价。

meaningZh: 早; 先; 提早；在初期,在早期；早的,提早的

examples.text: They figured on your arriving early.
examples.translationZh: 他们预料你会早到。

examples.text: The apple trees are fruiting early this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年苹果树很早结果。

examples.text: Could you come back home early this evening?
examples.translationZh: 今天晚上你能早回家吗？

meaningZh: 铁路；铁道；铁路系统

examples.text: The railway lines run parallel to the road.
examples.translationZh: 铁路线和那条道路平行。

examples.text: It takes a lot of labour to build a railway.
examples.translationZh: 修筑一条铁路要花费许多劳动力。

examples.text: The goods were consigned to you by railway.
examples.translationZh: 货物已由铁路托运到你处。

meaningZh: 共和国；共和政体；（成员具有平等权利的）团体

examples.text: He was one of the architects of the republic.
examples.translationZh: 他是这个共和国的缔造者之一。

examples.text: Back to our Republic of Singapore.
examples.translationZh: 回到我们新加坡共和国。

examples.text: In what ways is a republic more desirable than a principality?
examples.translationZh: 共和政体为何比君主政体更令人向往？

meaningZh: 困难的；硬的；有力的

examples.text: The ground is as hard as stone after the long drought.
examples.translationZh: 长期干旱之后,土地硬得就像石头一样。

examples.text: It's very hard to maintain a relationship.
examples.translationZh: 要维持一段关系,是很困难的。

examples.text: It's very hard on parents when their children are rebellious.
examples.translationZh: 对父母来说,孩子叛逆是个很棘手的问题。

meaningZh: 奖金，额外津贴；红利，额外股息；退职金

examples.text: The firm offered her a generous bonus as a sweetener.
examples.translationZh: 公司提出给她一笔可观的花红借以拉拢她。

examples.text: He received a box of cookies as a bonus when he bought coffee at the shop.
examples.translationZh: 他在商店买咖啡时,意外地得到了一盒免费赠送的饼干。

examples.text: The warm weather in such a freezing winter has been a real bonus.
examples.translationZh: 这么寒冷的冬天有这样暖和的天气真是令人喜出望外。

meaningZh: 钥匙；关键,要诀；键

examples.text: He is striking the key of his typewrite.
examples.translationZh: 他敲打着打字机的字键。

examples.text: To exit from this page, press the return key.
examples.translationZh: 退出本页面按返回键。

examples.text: The key here is to set up a responsibility system.
examples.translationZh: 关键是建立责任制。

meaningZh: 拿，取；采取；接受（礼物等）

examples.text: Please take the trash to the garbage can.
examples.translationZh: 请将垃圾拿到垃圾筒去。

examples.text: Take money from the bank when needed.
examples.translationZh: 需要时,把钱从银行里取出来。

examples.text: We are ready to take your order.
examples.translationZh: 我们随时准备执行您的命令。

meaningZh: 小说，虚构的文学作品；虚构的或想像出的事，并非完全真实的事；编造，虚构

examples.text: Real life is sometimes stranger than fiction.
examples.translationZh: 现实生活有时比小说还离奇。

examples.text: I like to read science fiction.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢读科幻小说。

examples.text: It's important to distinguish fact from fiction.
examples.translationZh: 把现实与虚构区分开来是很重要的。

meaningZh: 尽管；虽然；但是

examples.text: Although my uncle is old, he looks very strong and healthy.
examples.translationZh: 我的叔叔虽然老了，但他看上去还是很健壮。

examples.text: Although they can swim, the polar bears are terrestrial animals.
examples.translationZh: 北极熊虽然会游泳，但也是陆栖动物。

examples.text: Although she was poor, she was living in genteel poverty.
examples.translationZh: 尽管她贫穷，但她总想装出上流社会阶层的样子。

meaningZh: 季节，季；时期；活动期，时令

examples.text: Winter is the coldest season in a year.
examples.translationZh: 冬季是一年中最冷的季节。

examples.text: He will captain the basketball team next season.
examples.translationZh: 他将在下个赛季担任该篮球队的队长。

examples.text: Holiday prices are lower out of season.
examples.translationZh: 在度假淡季，度假费用较低。

meaningZh: 训练；培养；（枪炮，摄影机等的）瞄准

examples.text: The champion is in training for his next fight.
examples.translationZh: 这位冠军为了下一场比赛正在进行训练。

examples.text: They finished the preparatory training.
examples.translationZh: 他们完成了预备训练。

examples.text: The army training exercises ended with a mock battle.
examples.translationZh: 军事训练演习以一场模拟战结束。

meaningZh: 不顾后果地；不管怎样，无论如何；不惜费用地

examples.text: He is regardless of the result.
examples.translationZh: 他不顾虑结果。

examples.text: He crushed the bloom with regardless tread.
examples.translationZh: 他毫不在意一脚践踏了鲜花。

examples.text: I protested, but she carried on regardless.
examples.translationZh: 我极力反对，但她置之不理仍一意孤行。

meaningZh: 使惊讶，使大为吃惊

examples.text: I was astonished at the news of his escape.
examples.translationZh: 听到他逃之夭夭的消息，我感到惊讶。

examples.text: She astonished me with her beautiful handwriting.
examples.translationZh: 她以其秀丽的书法而使我惊异。

examples.text: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
examples.translationZh: 重复出现的事物不会使人吃惊。

meaningZh: 活动；活跃，敏捷；活动力

examples.text: We love outdoor activity.
examples.translationZh: 我们热爱户外活动。

examples.text: We plan to expand our business activities in East Africa.
examples.translationZh: 我们打算在东非扩展我们的商业活动。

examples.text: The volcano is in activity.
examples.translationZh: 这火山正活跃著。

meaningZh: 天资，才能；天才，人才；塔兰特，古代的一种计量单位，可用来记重量或作为货币单位

examples.text: He has great talent, but he has lost his faith.
examples.translationZh: 他很有天赋，但是他已经丧失了信心。

examples.text: The mother found that her son had a musical talent.
examples.translationZh: 母亲发现儿子有音乐天赋。

examples.text: Her talents are well known.
examples.translationZh: 人人都知道她很有才干。

meaningZh: 懂，理解；vt. 了解；默认

examples.text: He is trying his best to understand his meaning.
examples.translationZh: 他正在尽力弄明白他的意思。

examples.text: I don't understand what you're talking about.
examples.translationZh: 我不明白你在说什么。

examples.text: If you can't do it, I will understand.
examples.translationZh: 如果你不会做这件事的话，我可以理解。

meaningZh: 小的；难为情的；低级的，卑劣的

examples.text: This coat is too small for me.
examples.translationZh: 这件上衣对我来说太小了。

examples.text: I need to buy a small transistor radio.
examples.translationZh: 我需要买一台小的半导体收音机。

examples.text: The penalty clause was hidden in the small print.
examples.translationZh: 惩罚条款印在不起眼的小号字体部分。

meaningZh: 蚊子

examples.text: The mosquito is the disgusting thing.
examples.translationZh: 蚊子是讨厌的东西。

examples.text: Mosquitoes like to suck the blood of people and animals.
examples.translationZh: 蚊子喜好吸人和动物的血。

examples.text: The mosquito is a transmitter of disease.
examples.translationZh: 蚊子能传播疾病。

meaningZh: 滑，滑脱；犯过失，出错；（时间）不知不觉地过去

examples.text: She slipped on the ice.
examples.translationZh: 她在冰上滑倒了。

examples.text: I was unlucky to slip on a banana skin and fall over.
examples.translationZh: 我真倒霉，踩在香蕉皮上滑倒了。

examples.text: The gear slipped.
examples.translationZh: 齿轮滑脱了

meaningZh: 不锈的；不会脏的；无污点的

examples.text: He wears a stainless white shirt today.
examples.translationZh: 他今天穿着一件洁白无污的衬衫。

examples.text: Half heaven was pure and stainless.
examples.translationZh: 半个天空，纯洁无瑕。

examples.text: This cup is made of stainless steel.
examples.translationZh: 这只杯子是不锈钢做的。

meaningZh: 座右铭；格言；箴言

examples.text: Who is the subscriber of that motto?
examples.translationZh: 谁是那条座右铭的签字者?

examples.text: Humility is the motto in his life.
examples.translationZh: 谦卑是他的人生座右铭.

examples.text: "Proud, not complacent,"the motto has always accompanied me.
examples.translationZh: “自豪，但不自满” 这句箴言总是陪伴我。

meaningZh: 柠檬；柠檬树；柠檬黄

examples.text: I like orange more than lemon.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢桔子更甚于喜欢柠檬。

examples.text: The fish was garnished with slices of lemon.
examples.translationZh: 那盆鱼上配了几片柠檬作为装饰。

examples.text: The Clumber is primarily a white dog with lemon color or orange color markings.
examples.translationZh: 克伦伯猎鹬犬主要颜色是白色，带有柠檬色或橘色斑纹。

meaningZh: 原因；动机；理由

examples.text: Smoking can cause lung cancer.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟可致肺癌。

examples.text: She is always causing trouble for people.
examples.translationZh: 她总是给人添麻烦。

examples.text: Police are investigating the causes of the explosion.
examples.translationZh: 警方正在调查爆炸的原因。

meaningZh: (=amplitude modulation) 调频，调谐；vi. （用于第一人称单数现在时）是；aux. （与v-ing连用构成现在进行时，与v-ed连用构成被动语态）

examples.text: I am a doctor.
examples.translationZh: 我是个医生。

examples.text: I am filled with the desire to go back home.
examples.translationZh: 我心中充满了回家的渴望。

examples.text: I think I am quite a patient person.
examples.translationZh: 我认为我是一个相当有耐心的人。

meaningZh: vt. 放置；vt. 压倒,使躺下,放倒；vt. 使…平息,使…消失

examples.text: You may lay it on the table.
examples.translationZh: 你可以把它放在桌子上。

examples.text: I lay down not so much to sleep as to think.
examples.translationZh: 我躺下来与其说是要睡觉，倒不如说是要思考。

examples.text: I'll lay odds of three to one that he gets the job.
examples.translationZh: 我以三比一的赔率打赌，他能得到那份工作。

meaningZh: 易接近的；可理解的；易相处的

examples.text: Such information is not really accessible.
examples.translationZh: 这种信息不是很容易得到的。

examples.text: A manager should be accessible to his staff.
examples.translationZh: 一个管理人员应该让职员感到平易近人。

examples.text: This database is only accessible by the authorized manager.
examples.translationZh: 只有授权的管理员才可以访问此数据库。

meaningZh: 绝望的；由绝望而引起的；铤而走险的，孤注一掷的

examples.text: The situation is desperate.
examples.translationZh: 情况令人感到绝。

examples.text: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.translationZh: 我一点钱都没有了,简直绝望了。

examples.text: They made a desperate plea for help.
examples.translationZh: 他们不顾一切地恳求帮助。

meaningZh: 宫，宫殿；（主教）邸宅，宏伟大厦；华丽的娱乐场所

examples.text: There are many flocks of tourists in the palace.
examples.translationZh: 宫殿里有好几群游客。

examples.text: Have you been to the Imperial Palace?
examples.translationZh: 你去过故宫吗？

examples.text: The carriage passed through the palace gate.
examples.translationZh: 马车进入了宫殿的大门。

meaningZh: 教；教导，训练；教授

examples.text: I taught her to ride a bicycle.
examples.translationZh: 我教她骑自行车。

examples.text: His parents employed a tutor to teach him Greek.
examples.translationZh: 他父母雇佣了一位家庭教师来教他希腊语。

examples.text: Parents should teach their children table manners.
examples.translationZh: 双亲应该教导他们的小孩餐桌礼仪。

meaningZh: 头痛；令人头痛的事

examples.text: I've got a headache.
examples.translationZh: 我头痛。

examples.text: The aspirins eased my headache.
examples.translationZh: 阿司匹林使我头疼减轻。

examples.text: I've got a splitting headache.
examples.translationZh: 我头疼得要裂开似的。

meaningZh: 保护；保持，保存；腌制食物

examples.text: It is highly important to preserve the environment.
examples.translationZh: 保护自然环境至关重要。

examples.text: It's the duty of the police to preserve the public order.
examples.translationZh: 维护公共秩序是警察的职责。

examples.text: You should preserve your papers for future use.
examples.translationZh: 你应当把你的文件保存起来以备将来之用。

meaningZh: 不常见的，不普通的，难得的，罕有的；异乎寻常的，例外的，奇异的；独特的

examples.text: I look on the matter as most unusual.
examples.translationZh: 我认为这件事极不寻常。

examples.text: Something unusual was about to happen.
examples.translationZh: 某种不寻常的事正要发生。

examples.text: Mr. Heath was a man of unusual character.
examples.translationZh: 希思先生具有独特的个性。

meaningZh: 商议，商量；[医]会诊；咨询

examples.text: I will have to consult the plane time table first.
examples.translationZh: 我得先查阅飞机时刻表。

examples.text: He paused to consult his notes, and then proceeded with his questions.
examples.translationZh: 他停下来看了看笔记，然后继续提问。

examples.text: If you wish good advice, consult an old man.
examples.translationZh: 若要主意好，老人须请教。

meaningZh: 释义 奥得河（中欧）

examples.text: It receives the Vistula and Oder rivers and many other rivers.
examples.translationZh: 波罗的海从四周河流注入大量淡水，最长的河流为维斯杜拉河和奥得河。

meaningZh: 饿，饥饿；欲望；vt.& vi. （使）饥饿

examples.text: He was goaded by hunger into stealing.
examples.translationZh: 他为饥饿所迫而行窃。

examples.text: I had experienced the pangs of hunger.
examples.translationZh: 我曾经历过饥饿的折磨。

examples.text: His hunger for knowledge drove him to the library.
examples.translationZh: 他对求知的强烈渴望驱使他上图书馆。

meaningZh: 不管到什么程度；无论如何；然而

examples.text: She felt ill. She went to work, however, and tried to concentrate.
examples.translationZh: 她病了。然而她照旧去上班，并且尽力集中精神工作。

examples.text: His first response was to say no. Later, however, he changed his mind.
examples.translationZh: 他最初的反应是不同意。可是后来他改变了主意。

examples.text: He will never succeed however hard he tries.
examples.translationZh: 不论他怎样努力,都不会获得成功。

meaningZh: 操作，经营；手术；[数]运算

examples.text: The operation of this machine is simple.
examples.translationZh: 这个机器的操作很简单。

examples.text: I am skillful with computer operation.
examples.translationZh: 我的计算机操作技术很好。

examples.text: We hope we will finalise the operation before the transfer window closes.
examples.translationZh: 我们希望在转会窗口关闭之前完成运转。

meaningZh: 雨伞；〈比喻〉保护物；[军]空中掩护幕

examples.text: The wind blew my umbrella inside out.
examples.translationZh: 风把我的伞吹得翻过去了。

examples.text: You should take an umbrella just as a precaution.
examples.translationZh: 你该带把伞，有备无患。

examples.text: Can you identify your umbrella among this lot?
examples.translationZh: 你能在这些伞中认出你自己的伞吗？

meaningZh: 书；卷；课本

examples.text: That student lost his book yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 那个学生昨天丢了书。

examples.text: Write the essay in your (exercise-)books, not on rough paper.
examples.translationZh: 把文章写在练习簿里，不要写在草稿纸上。

examples.text: I'll book you on a direct flight to London.
examples.translationZh: 我将为你预订直飞伦敦的航班。

meaningZh: 道德的，道义上的；精神上的；无疑的，当然的

examples.text: She regards his moral faults with charity.
examples.translationZh: 她宽恕他的品行不端。

examples.text: We differ about moral standards.
examples.translationZh: 我们对道德标准看法不一致。

examples.text: His behavior transgressed the moral rules of the social conduct.
examples.translationZh: 他的行为违背了社会行为的道德准则。

meaningZh: 助手，助理；[化学]（染色的）助剂；辅助物

examples.text: The Prime Minister came to visit our country in the company of his assistant.
examples.translationZh: 首相在其助手陪同下访问我国。

examples.text: Wang wore two hats as chief of marketing research and assistant head of sales.
examples.translationZh: 王先生身兼两职,是市场调查部主任,也是营销部副主任。

examples.text: She is an assistant teacher in our school.
examples.translationZh: 她是我们学校的助理教员。

meaningZh: 游泳；游动；旋转

examples.text: Let's go swimming.
examples.translationZh: 咱们游泳去。

examples.text: She's teaching the children to swim.
examples.translationZh: 她正在教孩子们游泳。

examples.text: I used to swim all the year round.
examples.translationZh: 过去我一年四季都游泳。

meaningZh: 自由；许可权；放肆，无礼

examples.text: Those prisoners are dreaming of liberty.
examples.translationZh: 这些囚犯们梦想着获得自由。

examples.text: Everybody is at liberty to air his views.
examples.translationZh: 每个人都有发表意见的自由。

examples.text: Women used to have little liberty.
examples.translationZh: 过去妇女没有多少自由。

meaningZh: 早晨；上午；黎明

examples.text: Did you really feel ill this morning?
examples.translationZh: 今天早晨你真的感到身体不适吗？

examples.text: He is loath to get out of bed on cold morning.
examples.translationZh: 在寒冷的早晨他讨厌起床。

examples.text: The people next door play their radio from morning till night.
examples.translationZh: 邻居从早到晚开着收音机。

meaningZh: 出口，通道；退场；退去，退出

examples.text: She made a dart for the exit.
examples.translationZh: 她冲向出口。

examples.text: At the roundabout, take the third exit.
examples.translationZh: 在环状交叉路口，从第三条出路驶出。

examples.text: I was eventually granted an exit visa.
examples.translationZh: 我终于获得了出境签证。

meaningZh: 足球〔美国通常指橄榄球〕；足球运动；屡屡引起争论（或分歧）的问题

examples.text: Football and hockey players wear shoulder pads.
examples.translationZh: 足球和曲棍球球员都戴垫肩。

examples.text: The local schools formed a football league.
examples.translationZh: 当地几所学校组建了足球联合会。

examples.text: He is on the college football team.
examples.translationZh: 他是大学橄榄球队的队员。

meaningZh: 电力；电流，静电；高涨的情绪

examples.text: The electricity failure paralyzed the water supply.
examples.translationZh: 停电使水供应陷于瘫痪。

examples.text: The interruption of electricity made us unable to do anything.
examples.translationZh: 电力的中断让我们什么也不能做。

examples.text: While I was cooking supper the electricity went off.
examples.translationZh: 我正在做晚饭时停电了。

meaningZh: 短暂的；（衣着）短的；简洁的

examples.text: There was a brief pause in the conversation.
examples.translationZh: 对话中有短暂的停顿。

examples.text: We have a tight schedule for your brief visit. I hope you don't mind.
examples.translationZh: 对您短暂的访问,我们为您安排的日程很紧,希望您不介意。

examples.text: In the beginning, the teacher gave us a brief introduction about the subject.
examples.translationZh: 开始时,老师给我们做了关于这门课程的简短介绍。

meaningZh: 乐趣；娱乐活动；嬉戏，嬉闹

examples.text: I'm learning to cook, just for the fun of it.
examples.translationZh: 我正在学做饭，做著玩儿而已。

examples.text: You'll sure to have fun at the party tonight.
examples.translationZh: 你在今晚的晚会上一定会玩得很开心。

examples.text: People make fun of her because she always speaks foolishly.
examples.translationZh: 人们嘲笑她，因为她常说傻话。

meaningZh: 立即，马上；直接地；紧接地

examples.text: He began to look for another position immediately.
examples.translationZh: 他马上开始寻找另一个职位。

examples.text: Jason saw me and got off the horse immediately
examples.translationZh: 杰逊看到我, 立即从马上下来。

examples.text: All those who are immediately involved will be informed of the decision.
examples.translationZh: 这个决定将被通知给所有直接有关的人。

meaningZh: 方法；条理

examples.text: I have a simple and easy method.
examples.translationZh: 我有个简易的方法。

examples.text: New methods of teaching foreign languages are adopted in this institute.
examples.translationZh: 该学院采用新的外语教学法。

examples.text: His book is totally without method.
examples.translationZh: 他写的那本书毫无条理。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. 抢夺; 抢劫; 掠夺

examples.text: Not only do they rob you, they smash everything too.
examples.translationZh: 他们不仅抢夺你的财物，还要把每样东西都捣毁。

examples.text: The robber in arms wanted to rob the bank.
examples.translationZh: 这个持械的强盗想抢劫银行。

examples.text: Ah, I know, it is your desire to rob me of all my gains. I will not disappoint you!
examples.translationZh: 我知道,你想掠夺我的一切获得。我必不使你失望!

meaningZh: 损害，毁坏；n. 损害，损毁；赔偿金

examples.text: The damage to the painting is the work of vandals.
examples.translationZh: 毁坏这幅画的事是恣意破坏公物的人干的。

examples.text: Knowing all this, they made me pay for the damage.
examples.translationZh: 他们尽管了解这一切,还是让我赔偿损失。

examples.text: The flood did a lot of damage to the crops.
examples.translationZh: 洪水毁坏了大量农作物。

meaningZh: （使）联合，合并，统一；并有，兼备；混合，化合

examples.text: They unite to form a new company.
examples.translationZh: 他们联合组成一个新公司。

examples.text: The more of the masses we unite with, the better.
examples.translationZh: 我们联合起来的群众越多，就越有利。

examples.text: Two major telecommunication providers will unite into one.
examples.translationZh: 两大主要的电信提供商会合并成一家。

meaningZh: 取消，注销；抵消，偿还；〈数〉约去

examples.text: The match had to be cancelled due to the bad weather.
examples.translationZh: 比赛因天气不好只得取消。

examples.text: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll have to cancel our holiday plans.
examples.translationZh: 要是情况不妙，我们就只好取消度假计划了。

examples.text: I've lost my crdit card, so I have to go to the bank to cancel it.
examples.translationZh: 我的信用卡弄丢了,我得去银行申请作废。

meaningZh: 附录；阑尾；附加物

examples.text: There is an appendix at the back of the book.
examples.translationZh: 该书末尾处有一附录。

examples.text: This is the appendix to the investigation report.
examples.translationZh: 这是调查报告的附件。

examples.text: The details are clearly set out in an appendix.
examples.translationZh: 详细情况在一个附录里清楚列出。

meaningZh: 仇敌；敌军；危害物

examples.text: The city is held by the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这座城市已被敌人占领。

examples.text: The enemy was forced to retreat.
examples.translationZh: 敌人被迫撤退。

examples.text: This defeat was a powerful blow to the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这次失败是对敌人的有力的打击。

meaningZh: 冒险活动；冒险经历；奇遇

examples.text: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
examples.translationZh: 中文的意思是,对于一个理性极其成熟的人来说,死亡仅仅是下一个伟大冒险。

examples.text: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't persuade his friends to give up the adventure.
examples.translationZh: 无论他怎么努力,都不能说服他的朋友们放弃冒险。

examples.text: He's sailed the seven seas in search of adventure.
examples.translationZh: 他闯荡七大洋去历险。

meaningZh: 保险，保险业；保险费；预防措施

examples.text: I am an insurance broker.
examples.translationZh: 我是一名保险经纪人。

examples.text: He works in an insurance company.
examples.translationZh: 他在一家保险公司上班。

examples.text: I have paid my car insurance.
examples.translationZh: 我已经交了汽车保险费。

meaningZh: 海中软体动物的壳，贝壳

examples.text: She walk along the beach collect seashell.
examples.translationZh: 她沿海滩收集海贝。

examples.text: Small seashells were often used as a primitive kind of money.
examples.translationZh: 小贝壳常被用作简单的货币。

examples.text: This seashell with a radiating shape looks beautiful.
examples.translationZh: 这个放射形的贝壳很好看。

meaningZh: 开始；动身；开动

examples.text: It started to rain.
examples.translationZh: 下起雨来了.

examples.text: I used to start work at 9 o'clock every day.
examples.translationZh: 我过去常在每天9：00开始工作。

examples.text: We are just about to start.
examples.translationZh: 我们正要出发。

meaningZh: “myself”的复数；我们自己；（把）我们自己

examples.text: We have a bathroom to ourselves.
examples.translationZh: 我们自己有一间浴室，不必和人共用。

examples.text: No one can degrade us except ourselves.
examples.translationZh: 除了我们自己，没有人能贬低我们。

meaningZh: [天]行星；[占星]（左右人命运的）星相

examples.text: The Earth is a planet.
examples.translationZh: 地球是一颗行星。

examples.text: Mars is the fourth planet in order from the sun.
examples.translationZh: 火星是太阳系的第四颗行星。

examples.text: They claimed to have discovered a new planet.
examples.translationZh: 他们宣称发现了一颗新的行星。

meaningZh: 提问，询问；小型考试；简单的小测验

examples.text: I hate the quiz someone made.
examples.translationZh: 我讨厌别人搞恶作剧。

examples.text: We will have a quiz tomorrow morning.
examples.translationZh: 我们明天早晨进行一个小测验。

examples.text: He asked us to prepare for a quiz.
examples.translationZh: 他要我们准备好测验。

meaningZh: （人、树木、鸟或动物）成熟的；仔细考虑过的；到期（应该支付）的

examples.text: This is the most mature of his plays.
examples.translationZh: 这是他最成熟的一部剧作。

examples.text: She swept her hair back, so she looks more mature than before.
examples.translationZh: 她把头发往后梳，所以显得比以前成熟。

examples.text: Your fixed account is mature and can be withdrawn any time.
examples.translationZh: 您的定期存款已经到期了，随时可以提取。

meaningZh: 过去的，以前的；结束的；前任的

examples.text: It is past my power.
examples.translationZh: 这是我力所不及的。

examples.text: It was past midnight when we got home.
examples.translationZh: 我们到家时已过半夜.

examples.text: He hurried past me without stopping.
examples.translationZh: 他匆忙从我身边走过，连停都没停。

meaningZh: 介绍；引言，导言；采用，引进

examples.text: There is an introduction about Norway in this magazine.
examples.translationZh: 这本杂志里有一篇关于挪威的介绍文章。

examples.text: He gave us a brief introduction about his company.
examples.translationZh: 他向我们简要地介绍了一下他的公司。

examples.text: The government saw the introduction of new technology as vital.
examples.translationZh: 政府认为引进新技术至关重要。

meaningZh: 小卖部；食堂，小饭馆；水罐

examples.text: He always bring a canteen with him on a hike.
examples.translationZh: 他作徒步旅行时总是带着水壶。

examples.text: This is a much frequented canteen.
examples.translationZh: 这是一家就餐人数很多的食堂。

examples.text: He always bring a canteen with him on a hike.
examples.translationZh: 他作徒步旅行时总是带着水壶。

meaningZh: 大量的，充足的；丰富的，富有的；丰足

examples.text: Indonesia is abundant in petroleum deposits.
examples.translationZh: 印尼的石油蕴藏量丰富。

examples.text: The agricultural commodities are abundant this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年的农产品很丰富。

examples.text: Birds concentrate in places where food is abundant.
examples.translationZh: 鸟聚集在食物丰盛的地方。

meaningZh: 传记；档案；传记体文学

examples.text: He likes to read biographies of great men to promote himself.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢读伟人传记来提高自己。

examples.text: His biography is a saga of scientific research.
examples.translationZh: 他的传记就是一部科研记实。

examples.text: I have read a biography of Abraham Lincoln.
examples.translationZh: 我读过一部亚伯拉罕•林肯的传记。

meaningZh: 数字的；数据的；手指的

examples.text: Most of the computers we are using are digital computers.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在使用的计算机大多数是数字计算机。

examples.text: This is my newly bought digital watch.
examples.translationZh: 这是我新买的数字手表。

examples.text: I just looked at the digital map.
examples.translationZh: 我刚查看完数字地图。

meaningZh: 蒸汽，雾；〈口〉精神，精力；轮船，乘轮船旅行

examples.text: The engines are driven by steam.
examples.translationZh: 这些发动机是由蒸汽驱动的。

examples.text: There was a puff of steam from the engine before it stopped.
examples.translationZh: 机车喷出一股蒸气后就停了下来。

examples.text: Steam has fogged the bathroom mirror.
examples.translationZh: 水蒸气把浴室里的镜子遮住了。

meaningZh: 执行者；演奏者；演员，歌手

examples.text: The performer juggled with knives and swords.
examples.translationZh: 表演者耍弄刀剑。

examples.text: She is an accomplished performer.
examples.translationZh: 她是一个很有造诣的表演者。

examples.text: The performer removes a notepad and pen.
examples.translationZh: 执行者去除笔记薄和笔。

meaningZh: 不抱希望的，绝望的；没有希望的，惨淡的；不可救药的

examples.text: Things are so difficult that it seems hopeless.
examples.translationZh: 事情是这样的困难，宪政是没有希望的了。

examples.text: The doctor said the old man's condition was hopeless.
examples.translationZh: 医生说这位老人的病是没有希望的了。

examples.text: You look on this adventure over here as hopeless.
examples.translationZh: 你对这儿的投机事业认为是绝望的。

meaningZh: 成熟的；醇美可口的；老练的

examples.text: The branches were weighed down with ripe apples.
examples.translationZh: 苹果成熟了把树枝都压弯了。

examples.text: Most tomatoes are red when ripe, but some kinds are yellow.
examples.translationZh: 大多数西红柿成熟时是红色的，但有些品种是黄色的。

examples.text: The ripe apples picked easily.
examples.translationZh: 成熟的苹果易于采摘

meaningZh: 字母表；字母系统；入门，初步

examples.text: C comes after B in the alphabet.
examples.translationZh: 在字母表中C接在B后面。

examples.text: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
examples.translationZh: 英语字母表中有26个字母。

examples.text: The first letter in the English Alphabet is A.
examples.translationZh: 英语字母表中的第一个字母是A。

meaningZh: 秒；瞬间；次货

examples.text: Her beautiful roses won the second prize at the flower show.
examples.translationZh: 她那些美丽的玫瑰在花展上得了二等奖。

examples.text: Our goods are second to none in the world market.
examples.translationZh: 在国际市场上,我们的商品不亚于任何人。

examples.text: The bookcase needs a second coat of paint.
examples.translationZh: 这个书柜需要再刷一层漆。

meaningZh: 什么地方；任何地方；无论何处

examples.text: The city welcomes visitors from anywhere.
examples.translationZh: 这座城市欢迎来自任何地方的来访客人。

examples.text: One day they may be able to go anywhere in space.
examples.translationZh: 会有那么一天，它们也许能够进入太空的任何地方。

meaningZh: 政治家；政客，玩弄权术者；政客，政治贩

examples.text: A politician should be a servant of the people.
examples.translationZh: 政治家应是人民的公仆。

examples.text: That famous politician was murdered last year.
examples.translationZh: 那位著名的政治家去年被谋杀了。

examples.text: A politician needs the common touch.
examples.translationZh: 政治家需要有平易近人的美德。

meaningZh: 足球；〈口〉英式足球

examples.text: People love to play soccer.
examples.translationZh: 人们喜欢踢足球。

examples.text: The boy who is speaking to Helen enjoys playing soccer.
examples.translationZh: 正在跟海伦谈话的那男孩喜爱踢足球。

examples.text: The Government intends to clamp down on soccer hooliganism.
examples.translationZh: 政府拟采取措施严禁在足球比赛中闹事。

meaningZh: (I的所有格)我的（东西）；n. 矿；矿井

examples.text: He is a distant cousin of mine.
examples.translationZh: 他是我的一位远房表亲。

examples.text: The mine was closed owing to exhaustion.
examples.translationZh: 这个煤矿因矿源枯竭而被关闭。

examples.text: The ship's bow was blown off by a mine.
examples.translationZh: 船头给一枚水雷炸掉了。

meaningZh: 某处，在某处；在[到]某处；不知道在[到]什么地方

examples.text: Somewhere somebody sometimes does something good.
examples.translationZh: 在某处某人有时做某些好事。

examples.text: I must have seen you somewhere before.
examples.translationZh: 我以前一定在某处见过你。

examples.text: There is no one but wishes to get somewhere.
examples.translationZh: 没有人不希望将来能有所成就。

meaningZh: 咳嗽；（引擎等）发噗噗声；咳出

examples.text: Cover your mouth when you cough.
examples.translationZh: 咳嗽时要捂上嘴。

examples.text: I cough a great deal last night.
examples.translationZh: 我昨夜咳嗽得很厉害。

examples.text: She cough to give him the hint that he shall go.
examples.translationZh: 她咳了一声，向他暗示他该走了。

meaningZh: 〈古〉方式，方法；本质，天性；同类

examples.text: If you ever see George, give him my kind regards.
examples.translationZh: 如果你见到乔治,请代我向他致以亲切的问候。

examples.text: Taking a blind man across the street is a kind act.
examples.translationZh: 扶盲人过马路是一种善良的行为。

examples.text: She had a very kind mother.
examples.translationZh: 她有一位非常仁慈的母亲。

meaningZh: 池塘；v. 筑成池塘

examples.text: There are some reeds in the pond.
examples.translationZh: 池塘里有些芦苇。

examples.text: The deer lowered its head to drink from the pond.
examples.translationZh: 鹿低下头去喝池塘里的水。

examples.text: The farm has a pond from which the cattle can drink.
examples.translationZh: 农场有一个供牛饮水的池塘。

meaningZh: 消耗，消费；耗尽，毁灭；吃光，喝光

examples.text: His old car consumed much gasoline.
examples.translationZh: 他的旧汽车耗油很多。

examples.text: Each year Americans consume a high percentage of the world's energy.
examples.translationZh: 每年美国人都消耗掉世界能源的很大比例

examples.text: I'm sure that Chinese people consume the largest amount of rice in the world.
examples.translationZh: 我敢肯定,世界上中国人吃掉的大米最多。

meaningZh: 杯子；一杯（的量）；（胸罩的）罩杯

examples.text: This cup is made of stainless steel.
examples.translationZh: 这只杯子是不锈钢做的。

examples.text: Please fill the cup with water.
examples.translationZh: 请把这个杯子装满水。

examples.text: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples.translationZh: 你想喝杯茶吗？

meaningZh: [U]黎明; 拂晓；开端; 萌芽；vi. & link v. 破晓; (天)初亮

examples.text: We set sail at dawn and headed for New York.
examples.translationZh: 我们在黎明起程，直驶纽约。

examples.text: Diana aroused them just before dawn.
examples.translationZh: 戴安娜在黎明前唤醒了他们。

examples.text: I can see the dawn of the better day for humanity.
examples.translationZh: 我已经看到了人类美好日子的曙光。

meaningZh: 严肃的，严重的；认真的，庄重的；重要的

examples.text: Do not treat this serious matter as a joke.
examples.translationZh: 不要把这件严肃的事情当作笑料。

examples.text: A serious look passed over his face.
examples.translationZh: 他脸上显出一副严肃的神色。

examples.text: There was a serious motor smash on the bridge.
examples.translationZh: 桥上发生了严重的汽车相撞事故。

meaningZh: 仅仅，只不过；只是；纯粹

examples.text: They are not merely content to fill the stomach.
examples.translationZh: 他们不仅仅满足于填饱肚子。

examples.text: I accepted this job merely for the high salary.
examples.translationZh: 我仅仅是因为高薪才接受了这份工作。

examples.text: She is merely a child.
examples.translationZh: 她只不过是个孩子。

meaningZh: 富有的；充分的；n. 富人，有钱人，阔人

examples.text: She's an attractive woman, and wealthy to boot.
examples.translationZh: 她是个很有魅力的女人，而且很富有。

examples.text: A wealthy sponsor came to our rescue with a generous donation.
examples.translationZh: 有个富有的赞助人慷慨捐赠来解救我们。

examples.text: He was the son of a wealthy planter.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个富有的种植园主的儿子。

meaningZh: 光滑的；流畅的；柔软的

examples.text: Her skin is as smooth as silk.
examples.translationZh: 她的皮肤像丝绸一样光滑。

examples.text: The birch has smooth bark and slender branches.
examples.translationZh: 桦树有光滑的皮和细长的枝。

examples.text: At 9:50 the plane began a smooth descent through the cloud-smudged sky to Shanghai.
examples.translationZh: 9点50分,飞机在上海上空开始穿过浓云平稳下降。

meaningZh: 时期；（一段）时间；学时

examples.text: He feels completely restored to health after a period of intensive care.
examples.translationZh: 通过一段时间的精心照顾，他感到身体完全康复了。

examples.text: The exercise period was similar to the previous study.
examples.translationZh: 运动周期类似前面的研究。

examples.text: Childhood is a period of rapid growth.
examples.translationZh: 幼年是生长迅速的时期。

meaningZh: 同学，校友

examples.text: He met an old schoolmate at the party.
examples.translationZh: 他在宴会上遇见了一位老同学。

examples.text: I recognise my primiary schoolmate Mary in the photo.
examples.translationZh: 我从照片上认出了我小学时的同学玛丽。

examples.text: Mary's brother is my schoolmate, but two years senior to my grade.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽的哥哥跟我是校友,只是比我高两届。

meaningZh: 目标，目的；球门；终点

examples.text: No. 6 gave a long shot, but missed the goal.
examples.translationZh: 6号来了一个长射，但没有射中球门。

examples.text: He has achieved his goal.
examples.translationZh: 他已经实现了他的目标。

examples.text: If we lose sight of the goal, we cease to be Communists.
examples.translationZh: 如果忘记了这个目标，我们就不再是共产党员了。

meaningZh: 节省；保存；储蓄

examples.text: The doctor managed to save his life.
examples.translationZh: 医生救了他的命。

examples.text: Children should learn to save.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们应学会储蓄。

examples.text: I lent him my bike in order that he could save time.
examples.translationZh: 我把自行车借给他,以便他能节省一些时间。

meaningZh: 魔法；巫术；戏法

examples.text: The fairy's magic changed the two brothers into swans.
examples.translationZh: 仙子用魔法将两兄弟变成了天鹅。

examples.text: Some people still believe in magic.
examples.translationZh: 有些人仍然相信魔法。

examples.text: True magic is a very subtle thing.
examples.translationZh: 真正的魔法是一种非常微妙的事。

meaningZh: 拉；扯；拉过来

examples.text: The tractor pulls well.
examples.translationZh: 这台拖拉机拉力大。

examples.text: Don't pull my hair!
examples.translationZh: 别扯我的头发！

examples.text: Do not pull the chairs about, boys!
examples.translationZh: 不要把椅子拖来拖去，孩子们！

meaningZh: 拥有；掌握，懂得；主宰

examples.text: Different workers possess different skills.
examples.translationZh: 不同的工作者有不同的技能。

examples.text: Rose is a woman who possesses a rare intelligence.
examples.translationZh: 罗丝是一个拥有非凡智慧的女人。

examples.text: The police asked me if I possessed a gun.
examples.translationZh: 警察问我是否有枪。

meaningZh: 小册子，手册

examples.text: I'll send you a brochure.
examples.translationZh: 我给你一份小册子。

examples.text: The computer's features are detailed in our brochure.
examples.translationZh: 该计算机的特点在我们的小册子中有详细介绍。

meaningZh: 旋转；转向；转弯处

examples.text: Unscrew the bonnet by turning counterclockwise.
examples.translationZh: 反时针方向旋转拧松阀盖。

examples.text: They are developing a new turning mechanism for the device.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在研制这一设备的新的旋转装置。

examples.text: Lester hung up his hat and coat, then, turning, he caught his first glimpse.
examples.translationZh: 雷斯脱挂好了帽子大衣，回转身来就瞥见了她的第一眼。

meaningZh: 农场主，农民；承包人

examples.text: The farmer has a shepherd dog.
examples.translationZh: 农夫有一条牧羊犬。

examples.text: The farmer was pleased to see his piles of corns on the cob.
examples.translationZh: 农夫很高兴地看着成堆的玉米。

examples.text: A farmer must plow the land before planting crops.
examples.translationZh: 农民在种庄稼前必须犁地。

meaningZh: 小船，小艇；轮船；vi. 乘船，划船

examples.text: They pushed the boat further into the water.
examples.translationZh: 他们把小船又往水里推了推。

examples.text: Let's go boating on the lake.
examples.translationZh: 我们去湖上划船吧。

examples.text: Are you going to America by boat or by plane?
examples.translationZh: 你到美国是坐船还是坐飞机？

meaningZh: 分配，分派；把…拨给

examples.text: The system was unable to allocate a new data object.
examples.translationZh: 系统无法分派新的数据对象。

examples.text: Allocate rations for a week - long campingtrip.
examples.translationZh: 分配一星期外出野营的定额。

examples.text: You must allocate the money carefully.
examples.translationZh: 你们必须谨慎地分配钱。

meaningZh: 手指；指状物；指针

examples.text: The finger of the clock points to twelve.
examples.translationZh: 钟的指针指向十二点。

examples.text: The pen slips out of my fingers.
examples.translationZh: 钢笔从我指缝中滑下去了。

examples.text: She poked her finger into the hole.
examples.translationZh: 她把手指插入孔中。

meaningZh: （使）落下；投下；（使）降低

examples.text: She dropped to safety from the burning building.
examples.translationZh: 她从失火的建筑物上坠落到安全的地方.

examples.text: He dropped off from his bike.
examples.translationZh: 他从自行车上跌下来。

examples.text: In the winter the temperature often drops below freezing.
examples.translationZh: 冬天的时候,温度往往会降到冰点以下。

meaningZh: 跛的，瘸的；僵痛的；差劲的，无说服力的

examples.text: He gave a lame excuse for being late.
examples.translationZh: 他说了个站不住脚的理由解释他迟到的原因。

examples.text: Mary offered only a lame apology.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽只作了一个站不住脚的辩解。

examples.text: He is lame in one leg and walks with the help of a crutch.
examples.translationZh: 他的一条腿跛了，走路借助于拐杖。

meaningZh: 社会的，社会上的；交际的，社交的；群居的

examples.text: Her research is centred on the social effects of unemployment.
examples.translationZh: 她的研究课题是失业对社会的影响。

examples.text: Many social services are still provided by voluntary societies in our city.
examples.translationZh: 在我们的城市，许多社会服务仍然是有志愿团体提供的。

examples.text: Social divisions in the city are stark.
examples.translationZh: 城市里各社会阶层有明确的分野。

meaningZh: 灯笼；灯塔；灯罩

examples.text: I'm making a paper lantern for my nephew.
examples.translationZh: 我做了个纸灯笼给我的外甥。

examples.text: A little lantern blinked in the darkness.
examples.translationZh: 一盏小灯笼在黑暗中微微闪光。

examples.text: The Chinese palace lanterns are famous for their delicacy.
examples.translationZh: 中国的宫灯以精巧闻名。

meaningZh: 铅笔，彩色铅笔；笔状物；画风，画法

examples.text: He erases pencil marks.
examples.translationZh: 他擦去铅笔的痕迹。

examples.text: My pencil is blunt, could you lend me a knife to sharpen it?
examples.translationZh: 我的铅笔钝了，你能借我把刀子削一削吗？

examples.text: I noted down his telephone number with a pencil near the telephone.
examples.translationZh: 我用电话旁的一根铅笔记下了他的电话号码。

meaningZh: 友情，友谊；友善的关系；友善，好意

examples.text: Take this ring as a pledge of our friendship.
examples.translationZh: 请接受这个戒指作为我们友谊的信物。

examples.text: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
examples.translationZh: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

examples.text: He swore eternal friendship with me.
examples.translationZh: 他发誓和我永远友好。

meaningZh: 首都；资本；资源

examples.text: Beijing is the capital of China.
examples.translationZh: 北京是中国的首都。

examples.text: All the government offices are in the capital.
examples.translationZh: 所有的政府机关都在首都。

examples.text: The main impediment to growth is a lack of capital.
examples.translationZh: 影响发展的主要障碍是缺乏资本。

meaningZh: 数字；算术；人物

examples.text: Our textbook has many figures to help explain the lessons.
examples.translationZh: 我们的教科书有许多图表帮助解释课文。

examples.text: The figure is expressed as a percentage.
examples.translationZh: 那数字是以百分比表示的。

examples.text: He has a more angular figure than his father.
examples.translationZh: 他的体型比他的父亲更显得有棱角。

meaningZh: 一代人；代（约30年），时代；生殖

examples.text: There is a generation gap between my parents and I.
examples.translationZh: 我父母和我之间有代沟。

examples.text: One generation blows bubbles, and the next breaks them.
examples.translationZh: 前一代人制造出来的空洞理论，下一代人把它们打破。

examples.text: Their visionary ideas are often misunderstood by their own generation.
examples.translationZh: 他们有远见的理想往往招致同时代人的误解。

meaningZh: 诚实的；坦诚的；老实的

examples.text: Her action declared her to be an honest woman.
examples.translationZh: 她的行为足以说明她是一个诚实的女人。

examples.text: It was commonly believed that he was an honest man.
examples.translationZh: 一般都认为他是一个诚实的人。

examples.text: The article is an attempt to defame an honest man.
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章旨在诋毁一个正直的人。

meaningZh: 以某种方式，用某种方法；不知怎么地，不知道怎样，不晓得什么缘故；设法，想办法，想个方法

examples.text: We must make up for the lost time somehow.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须以某种方式把损失的时间补上。

examples.text: I wish I can repay you somehow for your kindness.
examples.translationZh: 我希望我能以某种方式报答您的好意。

examples.text: He could have finished it on schedule, but somehow he fell behind.
examples.translationZh: 他原本能按预定进度做完这件事的，但不知怎地却落后了。

meaningZh: 特殊的；专门的；专用的

examples.text: She is a special friend of mine.
examples.translationZh: 她是我一个特别的朋友。

examples.text: We have a special offer for our regular patrons.
examples.translationZh: 我们给予老顾客特别的优惠。

examples.text: If needed, give us your special requirements.
examples.translationZh: 如果需要,告诉我们您的特殊要求。

meaningZh: 堂[表]兄弟姊妹；远亲，同辈

examples.text: I hear from my cousin every two weeks.
examples.translationZh: 我每两星期就会收到我表哥的来信。

examples.text: He is a distant cousin of mine.
examples.translationZh: 他是我的一位远房表亲。

meaningZh: 最高的；至高的，无上的；最重要的

examples.text: The general was girded with the supreme power.
examples.translationZh: 将军被授予最高权力。

examples.text: The safety of the people is the supreme law.
examples.translationZh: 人民的安全是最高的法律。

examples.text: Supreme authority resides in the State.
examples.translationZh: 最高权力属于国家。

meaningZh: 木工，木匠；v. 当木匠；做木工活

examples.text: The carpenter was busy sawing the logs into planks.
examples.translationZh: 这位木匠正忙着把圆木锯成厚板。

examples.text: The carpenter flung aside all his tools in a rage.
examples.translationZh: 木匠怒气冲冲地将工具扔在一边。

examples.text: The carpenter told me how to use a bevel.
examples.translationZh: 木匠告诉我怎样用斜角规。

meaningZh: 风筝；鸢（猛禽）；空头支票

examples.text: The children are flying kites.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们在放风筝。

examples.text: A boy is flying a kite in the piazza.
examples.translationZh: 一个小男孩在阳台上放风筝。

examples.text: I looked up into the sky and saw the kite become smaller and smaller.
examples.translationZh: 我遥望天空，只见风筝越来越小。

meaningZh: 金字塔；角锥状物；vt. 使…成塔尖形

examples.text: Egypt is famous for its grand pyramid.
examples.translationZh: 埃及以巨大的金字塔闻名。

examples.text: Lagrange is the lofty pyramid of mathematical sciences.
examples.translationZh: 拉格朗日是数学科学中高耸的金字塔。

examples.text: A pyramid provides a useful conceptual model for organizing scientific knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 金字塔给科学知识的组织提供了一个有用的概念性模型。

meaningZh: 舌头，喙；语言，方言；演说，鞋舌

examples.text: The tongue is one of the vocals.
examples.translationZh: 舌头是发声器官之一。

examples.text: The dog's tongue was hanging out.
examples.translationZh: 这条狗把舌头伸在外面。

examples.text: English is her mother tongue.
examples.translationZh: 英语是她的母语。

meaningZh: 成果；水果；果实

examples.text: The bough was loaded with fruit.
examples.translationZh: 树枝上果实累累。

examples.text: The flower becomes fruit when it worships.
examples.translationZh: 花崇拜时便成了果实。

examples.text: Their research project haven' t borne fruit.
examples.translationZh: 他们的研究课题还未取得成果。

meaningZh: 单身男子,单身汉；学士; 学士学位

examples.text: You have the alternative of marrying or remaining a bachelor.
examples.translationZh: 你可以结婚也可以仍做单身汉，任你选择。

examples.text: He remained a bachelor all his life.
examples.translationZh: 他终生未娶。

examples.text: Are you a Bachelor of Arts?
examples.translationZh: 你是文学学士吗？

meaningZh: 蛋糕；糕饼；块状物

examples.text: He passed me one fifth of the cake.
examples.translationZh: 他递给我五分之一个蛋糕。

examples.text: I often bake chocolate cake by myself.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢自己培巧克力蛋糕。

meaningZh: 专家；行家；专科医生

examples.text: We profit from the work of the specialist.
examples.translationZh: 我们从专家的工作中得到益处。

examples.text: The provision of specialist teachers is being increased.
examples.translationZh: 配备专业教员的人数有所增加。

examples.text: He is a plastic surgery specialist.
examples.translationZh: 他是个整形外科医生。

meaningZh: 屠夫，屠户；屠杀者，刽子手；残酷的人

examples.text: The butcher chopped off a rib of frozen pork.
examples.translationZh: 屠夫砍下一块冻肉的肋条。

examples.text: Hitler was as a great a butcher as the world has seen.
examples.translationZh: 希特勒是有史以来最大的侩子手。

examples.text: The butcher will dress the chicken for you.
examples.translationZh: 肉商将为你准备加工好的鸡。

meaningZh: 鞋；蹄铁；（汽车轮的）制动器，煞车

examples.text: The shoes are a perfect fit.
examples.translationZh: 这双鞋子穿着非常合脚。

examples.text: My shoe laces have come undone.
examples.translationZh: 我的鞋带松开了。

examples.text: I can feel a nail sticking into my shoe.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得有钉子扎进鞋里。

meaningZh: 镜子，反光镜；真实的写照；反映，借鉴

examples.text: Steam has fogged the bathroom mirror.
examples.translationZh: 水蒸气把浴室里的镜子遮住了。

examples.text: A glance in the mirror reassured him that his tie wasn't crooked.
examples.translationZh: 他照了一下镜子，领带确实没有戴歪。

examples.text: She stared at herself in the mirror.
examples.translationZh: 她凝视着镜中的自己。

meaningZh: 投票，选举；提议；投票表决

examples.text: Give women the vote!
examples.translationZh: 给妇女选举权！

examples.text: I suggested putting the matter to a vote, but the chairman demurred to it.
examples.translationZh: 我建议对此事投票表决，但主席表示反对。

examples.text: A large vote was polled.
examples.translationZh: 投票踊跃。

meaningZh: 盖；帽子；军帽

examples.text: He took off his cap.
examples.translationZh: 他摘掉帽子。

examples.text: It's better to put the cap back on the bottle.
examples.translationZh: 最好把瓶盖盖上。

examples.text: The government should impose an cap across the gas price.
examples.translationZh: 政府应当给燃气价格强制规定上限。

meaningZh: 牙刷

examples.text: My toothbrush is losing its bristles.
examples.translationZh: 我的牙刷掉毛。

examples.text: She squeezes toothpaste onto her toothbrush.
examples.translationZh: 她在牙刷上挤了牙膏。

examples.text: I am aggrieved to find that someone has used my toothbrush.
examples.translationZh: 我发现有人用过我的牙刷，我很不高兴。

meaningZh: 乐观的，乐观主义的

examples.text: The book ended on an optimistic note.
examples.translationZh: 该书的结尾寓意乐观。

examples.text: The stockholders are optimistic about the company's future.
examples.translationZh: 股东对公司的前景很乐观。

examples.text: We are still optimistic, whatever the result (may be).
examples.translationZh: 我们仍然乐观，不论结果如何。

meaningZh: 日期，日子；约会；时代，年代

examples.text: If I pay a fee can I change the date?
examples.translationZh: 如果付费,能够改机票日期吗?

examples.text: What's your card number and expiration date?
examples.translationZh: 你的visa卡号码与有效日期呢?

examples.text: This vase is of an earlier date than that one.
examples.translationZh: 这个花瓶的年代比那个的早.

meaningZh: 毛皮；软毛；毛皮衣服

examples.text: He put on a coat with a fur lining.
examples.translationZh: 他穿上一件有毛皮衬里的外衣。

examples.text: She was wearing a silver fox fur across her shoulders.
examples.translationZh: 她肩上披了一件银狐皮披肩。

examples.text: The dog's fur was matted with blood.
examples.translationZh: 那只狗的毛皮上沾有血迹。

meaningZh: 儿子；孩子；男性后裔

examples.text: His wife born him a son.
examples.translationZh: 他妻子给他生了一个儿子。

examples.text: My little son is fond of playing practical jokes on me.
examples.translationZh: 我的小儿子喜欢对我玩恶作剧。

examples.text: I haven't heard any news from my son lately.
examples.translationZh: 我最近没听到我儿子的任何音讯。

meaningZh: 滑雪；滑雪板；滑水橇

examples.text: They often go skiing in December.
examples.translationZh: 他们经常在十二月份去滑雪。

examples.text: I am learning to ski.
examples.translationZh: 我正在学滑雪。

examples.text: The trail can be skied.
examples.translationZh: 这条小道上可以滑雪。

meaningZh: （人称代词I的宾格）我；n. 自我；自我的一部分

examples.text: Let me see.
examples.translationZh: 让我想一想。

examples.text: They paid me the princely sum of USD5000.
examples.translationZh: 他们慷慨地给我5000美元。

examples.text: Give it to me.
examples.translationZh: 把它给我！

meaningZh: 收据，发票；收入；vt. 开收据

examples.text: May I have a receipt?
examples.translationZh: 我可以要一张收据吗？

examples.text: Please send me a receipt for the money.
examples.translationZh: 请寄给我一张收到此款的收据。

examples.text: We only take goods back if customers can produce the receipt.
examples.translationZh: 顾客如能出示收据，我们才能予以退货。

meaningZh: 也；太；很

examples.text: I will go, provided that you go too.
examples.translationZh: 你也去的话我就去。

examples.text: It's too early for getting up.
examples.translationZh: 现在起床还太早。

examples.text: She broke her leg last week-and on her birthday too!
examples.translationZh: 她上星期把腿摔断了，而且还是在她生日那一天！

meaningZh: 形状；模型；状态

examples.text: This island is triangular in shape.
examples.translationZh: 这个岛的外形呈三角形。

examples.text: I'm having trouble giving shape to my ideas in this essay.
examples.translationZh: 我在这篇文章中表达不清自己的想法。

examples.text: John: Well, I'm a bit out of shape and I was thinking of joining your gym.
examples.translationZh: 嗯,我身材有点走样,正考虑加入你们的健身俱乐部。

meaningZh: 晒黑的，日灼的；(sunburn的过去式和过去分词)

examples.text: The skiing instructor was a tall, sunburnt man.
examples.translationZh: 滑雪教练是一个高高个子晒得黑黑的男子。

examples.text: The colour mantled in her delicate sunburnt cheeks.
examples.translationZh: 她那被太阳晒黑了的娇嫩的双颊泛起了红晕。

examples.text: Don't stay in the sun too long, or you may get sunburnt.
examples.translationZh: 不要在太阳下站得太久，否则你会晒伤的。

meaningZh: 生产；产生；制作

examples.text: This tree produces rubber.
examples.translationZh: 这些树生产橡胶。

examples.text: It is certain that we shall produce this kind of engine.
examples.translationZh: 毫无疑问,我们将生产这种发动机。

examples.text: The plain weave is comparatively inexpensive to produce.
examples.translationZh: 相对来说,平纹组织的生产成本较低。

meaningZh: 任何地方都不，无处；毫无结果；n. 无处

examples.text: Nowhere else will you find such a good book.
examples.translationZh: 你在其他任何地方都找不到这么好的书。

examples.text: The young girl would go nowhere without her chaperon.
examples.translationZh: 这个年轻女孩去任何地方都有监护人跟着。

examples.text: That kind of talk will get you nowhere.
examples.translationZh: 说那种话对你没好处。

meaningZh: 高尚的；雄伟的；贵族的,显贵的

examples.text: These few words fully revealed her noble quality.
examples.translationZh: 这寥寥数语充分显示了她的高贵品质。

examples.text: Jim is descended from a noble family.
examples.translationZh: 吉姆出身于一个贵族家庭。

examples.text: The noble peaks tower into the clouds.
examples.translationZh: 壮丽的山峰高耸入云。

meaningZh: 学说；理论；原理

examples.text: There're many theories about the origin of life.
examples.translationZh: 关于生命起源的学说有很多。

examples.text: In theory, anything could happen.
examples.translationZh: 理论上来说,任何事情都会发生。

examples.text: Not everyone can understand Einstein's Theory of Relativity.
examples.translationZh: 不是每个人都能读懂爱因斯坦的相对论的。

meaningZh: 电子邮件；vt. 给…发电子邮件

examples.text: Please email the documents to me.
examples.translationZh: 请把那些文件以电子邮件形式发给我。

examples.text: Give me a reason why you think that email is a good way for people to communicate.
examples.translationZh: 说一说为什么电子信函是人们通信的好方式。

meaningZh: 地图，天体图；类似地图的事物；〈美俚〉脸，面孔

examples.text: Paste down the map on the board.
examples.translationZh: 把这张地图用浆糊贴在布告板上。

examples.text: I pricked the map with a pin to show our route.
examples.translationZh: 我用大头针在地图上扎孔标出我们的路线。

examples.text: It is hard to map all the regions of big countries.
examples.translationZh: 为幅员辽阔的国家绘制地图，想把每个地区都详细标注是件困难的事。

meaningZh: （两者之中）任何一个；adj. （两者中）任一的；非此即彼的，两者择一的

examples.text: The thief was put in the police car with a policeman on either side of him.
examples.translationZh: 窃贼被送到警车上，身旁各坐着一个警察。

examples.text: You may take either of the roads.
examples.translationZh: 两条路你随便走哪一条。

examples.text: It's not as heavy, either.
examples.translationZh: 这也不那么重。

meaningZh: 花园，菜园；公园；供应点心的露天设施

examples.text: Mary talked with me across the garden fence.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽和我隔着花园篱笆交谈。

examples.text: He dunged his vegetable garden regularly.
examples.translationZh: 他经常给他的菜园施肥。

examples.text: He's been gardening all day.
examples.translationZh: 他在园中干了一整天。

meaningZh: 钱；财富；薪水

examples.text: He robs her of money.
examples.translationZh: 他抢夺她的财产。

examples.text: Time is money.
examples.translationZh: 时间就是金钱。

examples.text: Money doesn't always bring happiness.
examples.translationZh: 金钱并不一定带来快乐。

meaningZh: 喷；喷射；n. 喷雾

examples.text: He sprayed paint on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 他把漆喷在墙上。

examples.text: We should spray some hairspray on your hair.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该喷些发胶在你的头发上。

examples.text: Please spray some water on the flower.
examples.translationZh: 请给花洒些水。

meaningZh: 盯着看；显眼；倒立，直竖起

examples.text: She stared him into silence.
examples.translationZh: 她把他盯得不吭声了。

examples.text: They all stared with astonishment.
examples.translationZh: 他们全都惊讶地瞪着眼。

examples.text: It's impolite to stare at people.
examples.translationZh: 盯着看人是不礼貌的。

meaningZh: 保守的人；（英国）保守党党员，保守党支持者；adj. 保守的

examples.text: He was very conservative in the estimate.
examples.translationZh: 他的这一估计很保守。

examples.text: Old people are usually more conservative than young people.
examples.translationZh: 老年人通常比年轻人保守。

examples.text: The professor's a radical in politics but a conservative dresser.
examples.translationZh: 教授在政治上是激进派,但衣着却很守旧。

meaningZh: 享有，享受；欣赏；喜欢

examples.text: Now that I am free, I can enjoy music for a while.
examples.translationZh: 既然有空，我可以享受一下音乐。

examples.text: They enjoy the fruits of their hard labor.
examples.translationZh: 他们享受自己辛勤努力的成果。

examples.text: How did you enjoy the concert?
examples.translationZh: 你喜欢那场音乐会吗？

meaningZh: 谁的；那个人的，那些人的；他的，他们的

examples.text: No one knows whose dictionary this is.
examples.translationZh: 无人知道这是谁的字典。

examples.text: Whose life have you touched today?
examples.translationZh: 今天你会走进谁的生活？

examples.text: No one knows whose dictionary this is.
examples.translationZh: 无人知道这是谁的字典。

meaningZh: 招待，邀请；请柬，请帖；引诱，吸引，诱惑

examples.text: I appreciate your invitation.
examples.translationZh: 感谢你的邀请。

examples.text: He made a refusal to her invitation.
examples.translationZh: 他拒绝了她的邀请。

examples.text: Nobody in the office had received an invitation to the party.
examples.translationZh: 在办公室里没有人收到邀请函去参加这个宴会。

meaningZh: 不确定的；不稳定的；不明确的

examples.text: Life on earth is short and uncertain.
examples.translationZh: 地面上的生命是短暂而不确定的。

examples.text: I'm uncertain whether to go or not.
examples.translationZh: 我不能肯定去还是不去。

examples.text: It seems uncertain why he lost the election.
examples.translationZh: 他落选的原因似乎并不清楚。

meaningZh: 出版，发行；发表，宣布（结婚等）；公布，颁布

examples.text: Her book was published last year.
examples.translationZh: 她的书去年出版了。

examples.text: He published this book with his pen-name .
examples.translationZh: 他以笔名出版了这本书。

examples.text: Oxford University Press will publish a new magazine.
examples.translationZh: 牛津大学出版社将发行新杂志。

meaningZh: 吸引；诱惑；引起…的好感（或兴趣）

examples.text: The flower show attracted large crowds this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年的花展吸引了大批观众。

examples.text: She gave a quiet cough to attract my attention.
examples.translationZh: 她轻轻地咳了一声好引起我注意。

examples.text: His comments were bound to attract criticism.
examples.translationZh: 他的评论必然会招致批评。

meaningZh: 相当，很；非常；确实如此

examples.text: He was quite young.
examples.translationZh: 他相当年轻。

examples.text: The boy has quite recovered.
examples.translationZh: 这男孩已彻底恢复健康。

examples.text: I don't quite follow you, sir.
examples.translationZh: 先生, 对您的意思我没有完全领会。

meaningZh: (he的宾格)他

examples.text: The accident left him with paralysis of the legs.
examples.translationZh: 事故使他双腿瘫痪。

examples.text: His blindness is a great trial to him.
examples.translationZh: 眼睛瞎对他来说是非常麻烦的事。

meaningZh: 吨；大量，许多

examples.text: The maximum load for this lorry is one ton.
examples.translationZh: 这辆卡车最大载重量是一吨。

examples.text: How many tons does this elephant weigh?
examples.translationZh: 这头大象重多少吨？

meaningZh: 协调；融洽，一致；和谐

examples.text: An enterprise should be full of fairness and harmony.
examples.translationZh: 一个企业内部应该充满公平与和谐。

examples.text: Their life is a natural harmony.
examples.translationZh: 他们的生活是一种自然的和谐。

examples.text: There was not much harmony in international affairs during those years.
examples.translationZh: 那些年国际事态不很协调。

meaningZh: 非凡的；特别的；非常奇特的

examples.text: He has an extraordinary memory.
examples.translationZh: 他有非凡的记忆力。

examples.text: His extraordinary skill was praised by all.
examples.translationZh: 他超凡的技艺博得了广泛的赞誉。

examples.text: I find it very extraordinary.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得这非常离奇。

meaningZh: 进入，入场；入口处，门口；登记，记录

examples.text: He pretended not to observe our entry.
examples.translationZh: 他装作没有看见我们进来。

examples.text: The people without a ticket are denied entry.
examples.translationZh: 没有票的人不许入内。

examples.text: He has applied for an entry visa.
examples.translationZh: 他已申请入境签证。

meaningZh: 包装；把…装箱；向…提出一揽子计划

examples.text: The postman brought me a large package.
examples.translationZh: 邮递员给我送来一个大包裹。

examples.text: He received a compact package.
examples.translationZh: 他收到一个扎得很紧的包裹。

examples.text: The ministers are trying to put together a package that will end the dispute.
examples.translationZh: 大臣们力图搞个一揽子交易结束这场争论。

meaningZh: 一副；一对男女；套在一起的两匹马

examples.text: These two cups will make a pair.
examples.translationZh: 这两个杯子可以配成一对。

examples.text: The newly married couple are really a happy pair.
examples.translationZh: 那对新婚夫妇真是快乐的一对。

examples.text: This pair of shoes is durable.
examples.translationZh: 这双鞋很耐磨。

meaningZh: 记录，记载；档案，履历；唱片

examples.text: As a result of this meeting, he made his first record.
examples.translationZh: 由于这次会议,他制作了他的第一张唱片。

examples.text: He did very well, but failed to break the record.
examples.translationZh: 他做得很出色,但未破纪录。

examples.text: She holds the world record for long distance swimming.
examples.translationZh: 她保持着长距离游泳的世界纪录。

meaningZh: 好的；优秀的；有益的

examples.text: A good video camera will cost you a lot of money.
examples.translationZh: 一台好的摄像机要花掉你很多钱。

examples.text: My one good suit is at the cleaner's.
examples.translationZh: 我那套讲究的衣服还在洗衣店里呢。

examples.text: If you train hard, you'll make a good footballer.
examples.translationZh: 你要刻苦训练就能成为优秀的足球运动员。

meaningZh: 增强；肿胀；膨胀

examples.text: The hills swell gradually up from the plain.
examples.translationZh: 山丘逐渐由平原膨胀起来。

examples.text: Tom had a fall and his under lip began to swell up.
examples.translationZh: 汤姆跌了一跤，下唇开始肿起。

examples.text: The budget deficit could swell further over the next few years.
examples.translationZh: 未来几年内财政赤字可能会有更多增长。

meaningZh: 鼓励，鼓舞；支持；促进

examples.text: Her success encouraged me to try the same thing.
examples.translationZh: 她的成功鼓励我尝试做同样的事。

examples.text: Her parents encouraged her in her studies.
examples.translationZh: 她的父母鼓励她好好学习。

examples.text: He aims to encourage mutual understanding.
examples.translationZh: 他的目的在于增进相互了解。

meaningZh: 手；(钟表等的)指针；人手,员工

examples.text: It was written by hand.
examples.translationZh: 这是手写的。

examples.text: He has a book in one hand, and a pen in the other.
examples.translationZh: 他一手拿书,一手拿笔。

examples.text: Do you want a hand?
examples.translationZh: 你需要帮忙吗？

meaningZh: 财产，财富；富豪（阶级）；丰富，大量

examples.text: Health is better than wealth.
examples.translationZh: 【谚】健康胜于财富。

examples.text: He's always flaunting his wealth.
examples.translationZh: 他总是摆阔。

examples.text: She is responsible for the character part of the hero's devoted mother.
examples.translationZh: 她负责这个主人公的忠诚的母亲的角色部分。

meaningZh: 具体的，有形的，实在的，实际的；固结成的，混凝土制的；图案诗歌的

examples.text: I can't tell you anything concrete.
examples.translationZh: 这具体的我也说不上来。

examples.text: He had nothing concrete to fasten it upon.
examples.translationZh: 他抓不到什么具体的证据。

examples.text: The statue rests on a bed of concrete.
examples.translationZh: 这座雕像立在混凝土的基座上。

meaningZh: 蛇；奸险的人；卑劣的人

examples.text: I have a fear of snakes.
