examples.translationZh: 我害怕蛇。

examples.text: The snake coiled itself around the tree.
examples.translationZh: 蛇盘绕在树上。

examples.text: The girl screamed at the sight of the snake.
examples.translationZh: 那女孩看到蛇就尖叫起来。

meaningZh: 简单的；单纯的；易受骗的

examples.text: In each cave they constructed five simple beds.
examples.translationZh: 他们在每间窑洞里做了5个简单的床。

examples.text: As he had forgot his keys, he got into the house by the simple expedient of climbing through the window.
examples.translationZh: 他由于忘了带钥匙，便以简单的应急办法从窗户爬进屋里。

examples.text: I like my clothes to be simple but elegant.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢朴素但漂亮雅致的衣服。

meaningZh: 茶水；茶；茶树

examples.text: A nice cup of tea will soothe your nerves.
examples.translationZh: 一杯好茶可以使你的心绪平静下来。

examples.text: I'd like to place an order for some tea with you.
examples.translationZh: 我想从贵公司订购一些茶叶。

examples.text: Tea plants grow well on the fertile mountain land.
examples.translationZh: 茶树在这片肥沃的山地上长得很好。

meaningZh: 大衣；外套；保护层，护膜

examples.text: He turned his overcoat collar up.
examples.translationZh: 他把外套的衣领翻了起来。

examples.text: Although I am wearing an overcoat, I am still cold.
examples.translationZh: 虽然我穿了件外套，但还是觉得冷。

examples.text: That overcoat should see me through the winter.
examples.translationZh: 有那件大衣我应该能过冬了。

meaningZh: 醋；乖戾，尖酸刻薄；充沛的精力

examples.text: Vinegar has an acid taste.
examples.translationZh: 醋有酸味。

examples.text: He sprinkled vinegar on his fish and chips.
examples.translationZh: 他把醋洒在鱼和薯条上。

examples.text: His retort was delivered with a strong note of vinegar.
examples.translationZh: 他的反驳带着强烈不满的口气。

meaningZh: 果汁；肉汁；胃液

examples.text: I like to drink coconut juice.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢喝椰子汁。

examples.text: She was drinking juice through a straw.
examples.translationZh: 她正在用吸管喝果汁。

examples.text: Give the bottle a couple of shakes before pouring the juice.
examples.translationZh: 倒果汁前，先把瓶子摇几下。

meaningZh: 事件，事变；小插曲；敌对行动

examples.text: The serious incident along the border increased our fears of the war.
examples.translationZh: 边境上的紧张局势加重了我们对战争的忧虑。

examples.text: She couldn't erase the incident from her memory.
examples.translationZh: 她难以忘记那次事件。

examples.text: The police are connecting this incident with last week's terrorist bombing.
examples.translationZh: 警方认为这次事件和上周的恐怖分子爆炸事件有关。

meaningZh: 肺；呼吸器官；[医]辅助呼吸的装置

examples.text: Smoking can cause lung cancer.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟可致肺癌。

examples.text: A bullet pierced his right lung.
examples.translationZh: 一颗子弹洞穿他的右肺。

examples.text: Smoking is responsible for many cases of lung cancer.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟是许多人患肺癌的致病因素。

meaningZh: 自己；本人；本性

examples.text: He is now out of all conceit with his former self.
examples.translationZh: 他现在全盘否定了他原来的自己。

examples.text: I do not like to go to the movies by my self.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢自己一个人看电影。

examples.text: Suddenly it all falls out of relation to her basic henny self, and she realizes she has lost her life.
examples.translationZh: 瞬间这一切与她如母鸡一样的本性毫无关系，她意识到她已失去了自己的生活。

meaningZh: 大理石；大理石制品；弹子游戏

examples.text: This table is made of marble.
examples.translationZh: 这个桌子是大理石的。

examples.text: Michelangelo carved in marble.
examples.translationZh: 米开朗琪罗在大理石上雕刻。

examples.text: There are many perpendicular marble columns in Greek temples.
examples.translationZh: 希腊庙宇有很多垂直的大理石柱。

meaningZh: 释义 [医][=height equivalent to an effective plate]有效等板高度

examples.text: HEEP is a measure used in chromatography.
examples.translationZh: HEEP 是色谱分析中使用的一种度量。

meaningZh: （报章杂志中的）文章，论文；条款；物品

examples.text: She asked him to contribute a biweekly article on European affairs.
examples.translationZh: 她让他每两周写一篇有关欧洲情况的文章。

examples.text: If you don't return the article to the shop within a week, you forfeit your chance of getting your money back.
examples.translationZh: 如果你不把物品归还商店，你就丧失了取回钱的机会。

examples.text: Article 180 states that one third of the members must be women.
examples.translationZh: 第180条规定,三分之一的成员必须为女性。

meaningZh: 写；写信；写作

examples.text: I've been writing for three hours.
examples.translationZh: 我已经写了三个小时了。

examples.text: Nature inspired him to write such beautiful poems.
examples.translationZh: 自然赋予他灵感,使他写出如此优美的诗句。

examples.text: But there are some parts of the world where even now people cannot write.
examples.translationZh: 但直到现在,世界上有些地方的人们还不会书写。

meaningZh: 获得；购置物；获得物

examples.text: Life is a process about the acquisition of knowledge, wealth and happiness.
examples.translationZh: 生命就是一个获得知识、财富和幸福的过程。

examples.text: My classmates were attracted by the library's most recent acquisitions.
examples.translationZh: 同学们都被图书馆最近新添的书籍吸引了。

meaningZh: 名字；名声；有…名称的

examples.text: The committee's name has been acronymed NACA.
examples.translationZh: 该委员会的名称被缩合成NACA。

examples.text: Rubella is just another name for German measles.
examples.translationZh: 风疹只是德国麻疹的另一个名称。

examples.text: She signed the poem with her real name.
examples.translationZh: 她在诗后署上了自己的真实姓名。

meaningZh: 宽松的上衣；女衬衫；短上衣

examples.text: She wears a white blouse today.
examples.translationZh: 今天她穿了一件白色衬衫。

examples.text: I am interested in your silk blouse.
examples.translationZh: 我对你们的丝绸女衬衫感兴趣。

examples.text: The secretary was wearing a blue chiffon blouse.
examples.translationZh: 这个秘书穿著一件蓝色的雪纺绸衬衫。

meaningZh: 重要的；权威的；有势力的

examples.text: History chronicles important events of the past.
examples.translationZh: 历史记载历代重要的事件。

examples.text: He has made an important contribution to the company's success.
examples.translationZh: 他对公司的成功作出了重要的贡献。

examples.text: It's very important to teach the children about road safety.
examples.translationZh: 把交通安全常识教给孩子们是非常重要的。

meaningZh: 现金；支付金额；vt. 支付现款

examples.text: He paid the cash into his bank account.
examples.translationZh: 他把现金存入银行帐户。

examples.text: I have no cash on me. Can I pay you later?
examples.translationZh: 我没带现金,我能否以后付给你?

examples.text: Sorry, you can't sign the bill here, cash only, please.
examples.translationZh: 对不起,我们这里不可以签单,请付现款吧。

meaningZh: 板；董事会；甲板

examples.text: Will you draw the nails from this board?
examples.translationZh: 请你把钉子从这块木板上拔出来好吗?

examples.text: Paste down the map on the board.
examples.translationZh: 把这张地图用浆糊贴在布告板上。

examples.text: Her election to the board of directors caused great surprise.
examples.translationZh: 她被选进董事会,令人大为吃惊。

meaningZh: 没有人，无人；n. 小人物，无足轻重的人

examples.text: She has almost nobody to take up for her.
examples.translationZh: 她几乎没有人支持。

examples.text: Nobody likes to live in that desert region.
examples.translationZh: 没有人喜欢生活在那个沙漠地区。

meaningZh: 房间；空间；余地

examples.text: I groped for the light switch in the dark room.
examples.translationZh: 我在黑暗的房间里摸索着找电灯开关。

examples.text: He bounced into the room with a springy step.
examples.translationZh: 他以轻快的跑步跳进房间。

examples.text: There is no more room in the computer file.
examples.translationZh: 计算机文件里没有空间了。

meaningZh: 驾驶；开车；驱动

examples.text: He is too little to drive a car.
examples.translationZh: 他太小了,不能开车。

examples.text: Don't drink and drive.
examples.translationZh: 别喝了酒开车。

examples.text: They got a cat to drive out the mice.
examples.translationZh: 他们找到一只猫来驱赶老鼠。

meaningZh: 确信的，深信的；有信心的，沉着的；大胆的，过分自信的

examples.text: For my own part, being nice about appearance keeps me confident.
examples.translationZh: 就我而论，注重仪表使我自信。

examples.text: I'm confident in the path I have chosen.
examples.translationZh: 我对我自己选择的道路有绝对的自信。

examples.text: Your encouragement made me more confident of my future.
examples.translationZh: 你的鼓励使我对我的未来更加有信心。

meaningZh: （男）警察，警员；看守矿井的人；[化] 淀帚

examples.text: The policeman watched his quarry go into a bar.
examples.translationZh: 警察看著他在追捕的人走进一家酒吧。

examples.text: The wounded policeman is now out of danger.
examples.translationZh: 受伤的警察已经脱离危险。

meaningZh: 选举；挑出，挑选；决定

examples.text: They elected him chairman.
examples.translationZh: 他们选他做主席。

examples.text: They organized a poll to elect a president.
examples.translationZh: 他们组织了一次投票选举总统。

examples.text: You can't elect to deal at some other rate.
examples.translationZh: 不能选择其他价格。

meaningZh: 饥饿的；渴望的，渴望得到；（统称）饥民

examples.text: The smell of bread beckoned the hungry boy.
examples.translationZh: 面包香味吸引著那个饥饿的男孩。

examples.text: A lean and hungry cat came to our door.
examples.translationZh: 一只饥饿的瘦猫走到我家门口。

examples.text: Wall Street still wants people who are hungry and pushy.
examples.translationZh: 华尔街需要的是一些渴望的，积极进取的人。

meaningZh: 乳霜；精英；奶油色

examples.text: She ladled cream over her pudding.
examples.translationZh: 她在布丁上浇了一勺奶油。

examples.text: A dish of strawberries and cream is not to be despised.
examples.translationZh: 一盘草莓加乳酪应该算不差了。

examples.text: This cream will soften up your skin.
examples.translationZh: 这种面霜会使你皮肤柔软。

meaningZh: 自由的；免费的；免税的

examples.text: The prisoners wish to be free again.
examples.translationZh: 囚犯们希望重获自由。

examples.text: As a freelancer, he has more free time to himself.
examples.translationZh: 因为是个自由职业者,他有更多属于自己的自由时间。

examples.text: This service is free of charge.
examples.translationZh: 该服务是免费的。

meaningZh: 海；海洋；许多

examples.text: The moonlight shone on the calm sea.
examples.translationZh: 月光映在平静的海面上。

examples.text: The sea covers nearly three-fourths of the world's surface.
examples.translationZh: 海洋几乎占地球表面的四分之三。

examples.text: The sea seemed to melt into the sky at the horizon.
examples.translationZh: 在水平线处，海洋似渐渐没入天际。

meaningZh: 盐；风趣；机智，讽刺

examples.text: Salt water is more buoyant than fresh water.
examples.translationZh: 盐水比淡水浮力大。

examples.text: He had spoiled the soup by putting in too much salt.
examples.translationZh: 他往汤里放盐太多，把汤给糟蹋了。

examples.text: Adventure is the salt of life to some people.
examples.translationZh: 冒险对某些人来说是生活中的刺激。

meaningZh: 黄色的；黄皮肤的；黄种人的

examples.text: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
examples.translationZh: 秋天时叶子变黄。

examples.text: The leaves of the book had yellowed with age.
examples.translationZh: 书页因年久而变黄。

examples.text: She wore on her head a yellow kerchief.
examples.translationZh: 她头上带着一块黄色的头巾。

meaningZh: 薄的；瘦的；稀少的

examples.text: The ice on the pond is too thin for skating.
examples.translationZh: 池塘上的冰面太薄了，不能滑冰。

examples.text: His face is thin and very tanned.
examples.translationZh: 他的面孔瘦削,晒得黑黑的。

examples.text: This string is too thin, I need a thicker piece.
examples.translationZh: 这根绳子太细了,我需要一根粗些的。

meaningZh: 检查，调查；考试；诊察

examples.text: The doctor examined her carefully.
examples.translationZh: 医生仔细检查了她的身体。

examples.text: Examine the account well before you pay it.
examples.translationZh: 在付款以前仔细核对一下帐目。

examples.text: He was unable to examine the issue with detachment.
examples.translationZh: 他不能客观公正地调查这一问题。

meaningZh: 荒谬的；荒唐的；无理性的，杂乱无章的

examples.text: He finally recovered from an absurd infatuation.
examples.translationZh: 他终于从荒唐的迷恋中醒悟过来。

examples.text: What an absurd suggestion!
examples.translationZh: 多荒谬的建议啊！

examples.text: We have no intention of lying down under these absurd allegations.
examples.translationZh: 对这些荒谬的指控我们是不甘受辱的。

meaningZh: （隔离两个表面的）垫；垫子；起保护（或缓冲）作用的事物

examples.text: He covered the cushion with new material.
examples.translationZh: 他给靠垫蒙上了新的料子。

examples.text: She embroidered the cushion with flowers.
examples.translationZh: 她把垫子绣上了花。

examples.text: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
examples.translationZh: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶.

meaningZh: 馅饼，派；爱说话的人；[动]喜鹊

examples.text: That pie tastes good.
examples.translationZh: 那个馅饼味道不错。

examples.text: Help yourself to this apple pie.
examples.translationZh: 请吃点苹果馅饼。

examples.text: Pie and doughnut charts do not have axes.
examples.translationZh: 饼图和圆环图没有轴。

meaningZh: 发生；出现；闪现

examples.text: That plane crash occurred only minutes after take-off.
examples.translationZh: 空难在起飞几分钟后就发生了。

examples.text: Misprints occur on every page.
examples.translationZh: 每页都有印刷错误。

examples.text: A connection error might occur.
examples.translationZh: 可能会出现连接错误。

meaningZh: 有雾的；雾气朦胧的；模糊的

examples.text: He left Beijing on a foggy morning.
examples.translationZh: 他在一个有雾的早上离开北京。

examples.text: But today, this magic hasn't been strong enough to stride over the straits, in the tractive-lost &foggy street, gadding &gadding.
examples.translationZh: 可是今日，这魔力还没有跨越海峡的坚强，在失去了牵引的有雾的街头，游荡游荡。

meaningZh: 嗅觉；气味；臭味

examples.text: The strong smell made me throw up.
examples.translationZh: 这强烈的气味使我呕吐了。

examples.text: The cheese was emitting a strong smell.
examples.translationZh: 干酪散发出强烈的气味。

examples.text: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
examples.translationZh: 狗的嗅觉很灵敏。

meaningZh: 唱，歌唱，吟诵；vi. （鸟）鸣；嗡嗡叫

examples.text: She was singing a lullaby to her child.
examples.translationZh: 她正在给孩子唱摇篮曲。

examples.text: Let's sing a song during the break.
examples.translationZh: 我们趁这空当儿唱支歌。

examples.text: She sang the baby to sleep.
examples.translationZh: 她给孩子唱歌唱到孩子睡着。

meaningZh: 传真；vt. 传真；传真传输

examples.text: We receive a fax of the order this morning.
examples.translationZh: 我们今天上午收到一份传真订单。

examples.text: I was on vacation last week and didn't receive your fax.
examples.translationZh: 上星期我正在度假，没收到你们的传真。

examples.text: After you think it over, please let me know by fax.
examples.translationZh: 你仔细考虑过之后，请用传真相告。

meaningZh: 抓住；逮捕；捉拿

examples.text: Seize the chance, otherwise you'll regret it.
examples.translationZh: 抓住这个机会，否则你会后悔的。

examples.text: Before he could run away, she seized him by the collar.
examples.translationZh: 在他逃跑之前,她抓住了他的衣领。

examples.text: In a climate of political unrest, a dictator can often seize power.
examples.translationZh: 在动荡的政治气候下,独裁者常常能夺取政权。

meaningZh: 老鼠；鼠标；羞怯[胆小]的人

examples.text: The mouse scurried into its hole when the cat appeared.
examples.translationZh: 猫一露面，老鼠急忙钻进自己的洞里。

examples.text: The cat is playing with a live mouse.
examples.translationZh: 猫在戏弄那只活老鼠。

examples.text: He remained a mouse in public affairs.
examples.translationZh: 在公众事务上他依然胆小如鼠。

meaningZh: （表示否定）没有；缺少；（表示运算）减去

examples.text: The temperature is minus twenty degrees.
examples.translationZh: 温度是零下二十度。

examples.text: He seems to have mistaken a plus for a minus.
examples.translationZh: 他似乎把正号误作负号了。

examples.text: A negative value is prefixed by a minus sign.
examples.translationZh: 一个负数将以减号作为前缀。

meaningZh: 悬浮；暂停；悬架

examples.text: I think her suspension from the team was a very harsh punishment.
examples.translationZh: 我认为她被暂停参加队的比赛是很严厉的处罚。

examples.text: The conspicuous suspicious pension is in suspension.
examples.translationZh: 那笔引人注目的可疑养老金被暂停发放。

examples.text: She appealed against her suspension.
examples.translationZh: 她对被停职一事已经上诉。

meaningZh: 银行；（条形的）堆；（河的）岸

examples.text: He has a large deposit in the bank.
examples.translationZh: 他在银行有大笔存款。

examples.text: The town stands on the left bank of the river.
examples.translationZh: 城镇位于河的左岸。

examples.text: They walked along the fields bank，chatting happily.
examples.translationZh: 他们沿着田埂,开心地边走边聊。

meaningZh: 送；使作出（某种反应）；派遣

examples.text: You are now ready to send messages.
examples.translationZh: 现在你可以可以发送消息了。

examples.text: Radio Beijing sends the news all over the world.
examples.translationZh: 北京广播电台向全世界播送新闻。

examples.text: I'll send someone to show you around.
examples.translationZh: 我派人带你到周围转转。

meaningZh: 痛苦；刻苦；令人厌烦的人[事物]

examples.text: His leg was broken and he suffered great pain.
examples.translationZh: 他的腿断了,遭受了巨大痛苦的折磨。

examples.text: He has a pain in the knee.
examples.translationZh: 他膝盖酸痛。

examples.text: He spares no efforts to study English.
examples.translationZh: 他不辞劳苦地学习英语。

meaningZh: 热，热度，高温；热烈，激烈；（身体的）发烧，发热

examples.text: Turn the heat down or your cake will burn.
examples.translationZh: 把热度调低吧,要不蛋糕就要糊了。

examples.text: I can't walk about in this heat.
examples.translationZh: 我不能在这种酷热下走路。

examples.text: Water is changed into steam by heat and into ice by cold.
examples.translationZh: 水加热则成为蒸汽，冷却则成为冰。

meaningZh: 易碎的，脆的；虚弱的

examples.text: Glasses are fragile and must be handled with great care.
examples.translationZh: 玻璃制品易碎，必须小心轻放。

examples.text: This glass plate is very fragile.
examples.translationZh: 这个玻璃盘子很容易碎。

examples.text: The fragile boxes arrived intact.
examples.translationZh: 这些易碎的箱子完整无损地运到了。

meaningZh: 枫树；淡棕色

examples.text: The maple leaf is the emblem of Canada.
examples.translationZh: 枫叶是加拿大的象征。

examples.text: The maple leaves are tinged with autumn red.
examples.translationZh: 枫叶染上了秋天的红色。

examples.text: The garden is flanked to the north with large maple trees.
examples.translationZh: 花园的北侧是一些高大的枫树。

meaningZh: 落下；跌倒；减少

examples.text: The knife fell from his nerveless hand.
examples.translationZh: 那把刀从他无力的手中落下。

examples.text: Apples fall from the tree.
examples.translationZh: 苹果从树上落下。

examples.text: The tree fell with a thunderous crash.
examples.translationZh: 那棵树轰隆一声倒下了。

meaningZh: 工业；产业（经济词汇）；工业界

examples.text: Since the advent of atomic power, there have been great changes in industry.
examples.translationZh: 自从原子动力问世以后，工业发生了巨大的变化。

examples.text: The tourist trade has become a real industry.
examples.translationZh: 旅游业已经成为真正的产业。

examples.text: The information industry is an infant industry in our country.
examples.translationZh: 信息产业在我国是新兴产业。

meaningZh: 二者，两者都；pron. 二者；adv. 二者，二者都

examples.text: Both his eyes are hurt.
examples.translationZh: 他的两眼都受伤了。

examples.text: She kissed him on both cheeks.
examples.translationZh: 她吻了他的双颊。

examples.text: Both are good.
examples.translationZh: 两者都好。

meaningZh: 阻止，扼止；填塞；使窒息

examples.text: She looked like she was going to choke.
examples.translationZh: 她看起来仿佛都要窒息了。

examples.text: She found it hard to choke down her anger.
examples.translationZh: 她感到难以压下心中的怒火。

examples.text: She choked with emotion.
examples.translationZh: 她激动得说不出话来。

meaningZh: 应得某事物；值得做某事；可尊敬的

examples.text: This is a worthy English-Chinese dictionary.
examples.translationZh: 这是一本有价值的英汉词典。

examples.text: This book is worthy of reading.
examples.translationZh: 这本书值得一读。

examples.text: No man thinks more highly than I do of the patriotism, as well as abilities, of the very worthy gentlemen who have just addressed the house.
examples.translationZh: 没有人比我对刚刚向议会全体代表发言的可尊敬的先生们的爱国精神和才干更钦佩了。

meaningZh: （学校等的）宿舍；集体寝室；（在市内工作的人的）郊外住宅区

examples.text: He hangs out in the school dormitory.
examples.translationZh: 他留在学校的宿舍里。

examples.text: Every girl must sign in when she comes back to the dormitory.
examples.translationZh: 每个女生回到宿舍的时候都必须签到。

examples.text: He soon gets accustomed to dormitory life and make two or three friend.
examples.translationZh: 他不久就逐渐习惯了宿舍的生活并交了两三个朋友。

meaningZh: （时间上）遥远的；远离的；远程的

examples.text: The most remote two points in this world are two estranged hearts.
examples.translationZh: 人世间相距最远的两点,是两颗隔膜的心。

examples.text: This is a village remote from the madding crowd.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个远离喧嚣尘世的村庄。

examples.text: Mail comes to this remote village only once a week.
examples.translationZh: 邮车每周只到这个偏僻的村庄一次。

meaningZh: 能够…的；聪明的,能干的

examples.text: We shall be able to deal with all sorts of problem.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该能够应付各种困难。

examples.text: She bet me 20 that I wouldn't be able to give up smoking.
examples.translationZh: 她和我打20英镑的赌，说我戒不了烟。

examples.text: Free will makes us able to choose our way of life.
examples.translationZh: 自由的意志使我们可以选择自己的生活方式。

meaningZh: 拍手，鼓掌；轻轻拍打某人；急速放置

examples.text: She clapped her hands in delight.
examples.translationZh: 她高兴地拍手。

examples.text: If you're happy, clap your hands.
examples.translationZh: 如果感到幸福，你就拍拍手。

examples.text: The gray-beard swept out an arm to clap Shemsen on the shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 灰胡子腾出一只手，拍了拍舍姆森的肩。

meaningZh: 沉默的，无言的；寂静的，无声的；静止的

examples.text: Would you be good enough to keep silent?
examples.translationZh: 请你保持安静好吗？

examples.text: The old house was quite silent.
examples.translationZh: 这所旧房子非常寂静。

examples.text: We sailed into a beautiful and silent bay.
examples.translationZh: 我们驶进一个美丽而安静的海湾。

meaningZh: 一群；包裹；（纸牌的）一副

examples.text: The hare could find no safety, a pack of jackals had it in the wind.
examples.translationZh: 野兔无处逃生,一群豺狗在追踪它。

examples.text: He rounded on journalists, calling them 'a pack of vultures'.
examples.translationZh: 他突然对记者们大发雷霆，称他们是一帮贪婪的家伙。

examples.text: A pack of cards has been spread on the table.
examples.translationZh: 一副牌在桌被传播了。

meaningZh: 她，它

examples.text: She weighs 50 kilograms.
examples.translationZh: 她的体重有50公斤。

examples.text: She can speak Japanese as well as English.
examples.translationZh: 她会说日语和英语。

examples.text: She has served the family faithfully for thirty years.
examples.translationZh: 她为这个家忠心耿耿地操劳了30年。

meaningZh: 蔬菜；植物人；adj. 蔬菜的

examples.text: Is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable?
examples.translationZh: 蕃茄是水果还是蔬菜?

examples.text: We've grown many vegetables in our garden.
examples.translationZh: 我们在花园里种了许多蔬菜。

examples.text: I can recommend the vegetable pie - it's the specialty of the house.
examples.translationZh: 我推荐一道蔬菜馅饼，它是这家餐馆的名菜。

meaningZh: 罐子；（啤酒）杯；缸

examples.text: I can't get the lid off this jar.
examples.translationZh: 我打不开这广口瓶的盖子。

examples.text: The jar contains ten glasses of water.
examples.translationZh: 这只大口瓶能装十杯水。

examples.text: I need a jar to make the krauts.
examples.translationZh: 我需要一个坛子做泡菜。

meaningZh: (she的宾格)她；(she的所有格)她的；她，指某个国家，（一艘）船

examples.text: That's her book.
examples.translationZh: 那是她的书。

examples.text: Give her the book.
examples.translationZh: 把这本书给她。

meaningZh: 虫，昆虫；卑鄙的人；微贱的人，小人

examples.text: The insect bit him and drew blood from his arm.
examples.translationZh: 那只昆虫叮在他的手臂上吸血。

examples.text: A cocoon is a kind of silk covering made by an insect.
examples.translationZh: 蚕茧是由昆虫制造的一种由丝组成的外包层。

examples.text: She stamped on the insect and killed it.
examples.translationZh: 她踩死了一只虫子。

meaningZh: 不公正的，不公平的；违反规则或准则的

examples.text: The detention of the whole class was unfair.
examples.translationZh: 滞留全班学生是不公平的。

examples.text: It's unfair to devalue anyone's work unjustly.
examples.translationZh: 不公正地贬低任何人的工作都是不公平的。

meaningZh: 坟墓；墓穴；墓碑

examples.text: Those dead soldiers were buried in the tombs.
examples.translationZh: 那些死去的战士被埋葬在坟墓里。

examples.text: A tombstone stands in front of her tomb.
examples.translationZh: 她墓前立着一块墓碑。

examples.text: A group of student placed a wreath at the tomb of the national hero.
examples.translationZh: 一群学生在那位民族英雄墓前献上花圈。

meaningZh: 垃圾；脏东西；丢弃的食物

examples.text: Please put the garbage in the dustbin.
examples.translationZh: 请把垃圾放在桶里。

examples.text: She threw the leftovers in the garbage.
examples.translationZh: 她把剩饭倒进垃圾桶。

examples.text: The smell of the garbage overpowered me.
examples.translationZh: 垃圾的臭味使我无法忍受。

meaningZh: 兄弟；同事，同胞；同志

examples.text: John and Peter are brothers.
examples.translationZh: 约翰和彼得是兄弟。

examples.text: The man who captained the home team is my brother.
examples.translationZh: 率领主队的是我的兄弟。

examples.text: Don't be so unkind to your brother.
examples.translationZh: 别对你兄弟这么刻薄。

meaningZh: 伤害，损害；受伤处；伤害的行为

examples.text: She still suffers considerable discomfort from her injury.
examples.translationZh: 她因那次受伤至今仍感不适。

examples.text: He had a spinal injury in that accident.
examples.translationZh: 他在那次事故中脊柱受了伤。

examples.text: The injury to their key player could be a decisive factor in the game.
examples.translationZh: 他们主力队员受伤可能是这场比赛胜负的决定性因素。

meaningZh: 学习，学会；习得；得知

examples.text: Write out this word ten times so that you learn how to spell it.
examples.translationZh: 把这个字抄写十遍就能记住怎麽拼写了。

examples.text: It's more useful to learn modern languages, such as English and German, than Latin.
examples.translationZh: 学习英语和德语等现代语言比学习拉丁语更为有用。

examples.text: I'm trying to learn English.
examples.translationZh: 我正在尽力学英语。

meaningZh: 全国范围的；全国性的；adv. 在全国范围内

examples.text: There was nationwide opposition to the tax hike.
examples.translationZh: 发生了全国性的反对税收增多。

examples.text: We have launched a nationwide forestation campaign.
examples.translationZh: 我们展开了全国性的造林运动。

examples.text: The livestock tax has been rescinded nationwide.
examples.translationZh: 牧业税已经在全国范围内废除。

meaningZh: 雨衣

examples.text: He wasn't wearing his raincoat, he was carrying it over his arm.
examples.translationZh: 他没穿着雨衣而是把它搭在胳膊上。

examples.text: If I'd had the forethought to bring my raincoat, I wouldn't have got wet in the storm.
examples.translationZh: 我当初如果想到要带雨衣，便不会被暴风雨淋湿了。

examples.text: She prepared for all possibilities by taking a sunhat, a raincoat and a woolly scarf.
examples.translationZh: 她带了太阳帽、 雨衣和毛围巾，一切有备无患。

meaningZh: 单词；话语；诺言

examples.text: Could we have a word before you go to the meeting?
examples.translationZh: 你去开会之前，咱们能私下说句话吗？

examples.text: Tell me what happened in your own words.
examples.translationZh: 用你自己的话把发生的事情告诉我。

examples.text: My friend sent word that he was well.
examples.translationZh: 我朋友捎来口信说他很好。

meaningZh: 调制解调器

examples.text: Does your computer have a modem?
examples.translationZh: 你的电脑有调制解调器吗？

examples.text: Please select the modem you want to install.
examples.translationZh: 请选择想要安装的调制解调器。

examples.text: I can't hear if my modem is dialing.
examples.translationZh: 我无法听到调制解调器是否在拨号。

meaningZh: 访问；探望；参观

examples.text: I'm going to visit my aunt for a few days.
examples.translationZh: 我打算去姑妈家住几天。

examples.text: I'll visit him tomorrow if weather permits.
examples.translationZh: 如果天气条件许可,明天我要去拜访他。

examples.text: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will visit the Great Wall.
examples.translationZh: 如果明天不下雨的话,我们将参观长城。

meaningZh: 愉快的，快乐的

examples.text: I do not think that movie is very enjoyable.
examples.translationZh: 我看那部电影并不怎么有趣。

examples.text: In fact, life gets more enjoyable as you age.
examples.translationZh: 事实上，生活随着时间的流逝变得更有趣。

examples.text: We all had an enjoyable evening.
examples.translationZh: 我们全都度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

meaningZh: 每人，人人；大伙儿；各位

examples.text: Everybody should do good self work.
examples.translationZh: 每人必须做好自己的工作。

examples.text: It is difficult to find a time that suits everybody.
examples.translationZh: 很难找到一个对每人都合适的时间。

examples.text: The rascal was hated by everybody in the village.
examples.translationZh: 这坏蛋，村子里人人痛恨。

meaningZh: 十字架；十字形饰物；杂交品种

examples.text: It's very dangerous for children to cross the busy street.
examples.translationZh: 对孩子们来说,穿过车来车往的街道很危险。

examples.text: Meet me at the point where the two paths cross.
examples.translationZh: 我们在那两条路的交叉点见面吧。

examples.text: The experts in the zoo tried to cross a leopard with a lion.
examples.translationZh: 动物园里的专家们试图使豹与狮子杂交。

meaningZh: 财政；金融；财源

examples.text: He is a well-known expert in finance.
examples.translationZh: 他是知名的金融专家。

examples.text: The Chancellor of the Exchequer is the minister in charge of finance in Britain.
examples.translationZh: 英国财政大臣是负责财政的大臣。

examples.text: Unless we can get more finance, we'll have to close the store.
examples.translationZh: 除非我们能得到更多的资金，我们将不得不关闭这家商店。

meaningZh: 精确的，准确的；正确无误的

examples.text: Hearsay definitely can't be regarded as accurate information.
examples.translationZh: 道听途说的决然不能算作很准确的消息。

examples.text: The manager impressed on his office staff the importance of keeping accurate records.
examples.translationZh: 经理让办公室职员认识到做精确记录的重要性。

meaningZh: 使恢复，使振作；使焕然一新，翻新；给（电池）充电

examples.text: A cool drink refreshed me after my long walk.
examples.translationZh: 走了很长的一段路之后，一杯冷饮使我恢复了精神。

examples.text: He has drunk one cup of coffee to refresh oneself.
examples.translationZh: 他喝了一杯咖啡提神。

examples.text: I refreshed myself with a cup of coffee.
examples.translationZh: 我喝了一杯咖啡给自己提提神。

meaningZh: 储备；保护区；保留

examples.text: We reserve the right to lodge a claim for loss.
examples.translationZh: 我们保留要求赔偿损失的权利。

examples.text: I have reserved a table at the restaurant.
examples.translationZh: 我已在饭店预订了一桌菜。

examples.text: The court will reserve judgement.
examples.translationZh: 法庭将延期判决。

meaningZh: 行政官员；公务员；[体]裁判

examples.text: The group have split off from the official union.
examples.translationZh: 这一部分人已从正式的联盟中分裂出来了。

examples.text: I happen to have the official statistics with me.
examples.translationZh: 我碰巧身边有官方的统计数字。

examples.text: They expressed their dissent from official policy.
examples.translationZh: 他们对官方的政策表示出异议。

meaningZh: 正常的；正规的，标准的；[数学]正交的

examples.text: Everything is absolutely normal.
examples.translationZh: 一切完全正常。

examples.text: She refused to conform to the normal social conventions.
examples.translationZh: 她拒绝遵从正常的社会习俗。

examples.text: People who commit crimes like that aren't normal.
examples.translationZh: 犯这种罪的人心理都不正常.

meaningZh: 歧视；辨别，区别；辨别力，识别力

examples.text: He is passionately opposed to racial discrimination.
examples.translationZh: 他极端反对种族歧视。

examples.text: Discrimination against Blacks is still common.
examples.translationZh: 歧视黑人仍是普遍现象。

examples.text: We should not have racial discrimination.
examples.translationZh: 我们不该有种族歧视。

meaningZh: 自由，自主；直率；特权，特许

examples.text: Democracy is a bulwark of freedom.
examples.translationZh: 民主是自由的保障。

examples.text: They bought peace with their freedom.
examples.translationZh: 他们牺牲自由换取和平。

examples.text: By persistence many countries won freedom.
examples.translationZh: 通过坚持不懈的努力, 许多国家赢得了自由。

meaningZh: 家务劳动

examples.text: Housework is usually miscellaneous and toilsome.
examples.translationZh: 家务劳动通常是繁杂的。

examples.text: Her hands were roughened by housework.
examples.translationZh: 她的手由于家务劳动而变得粗糙。

meaningZh: 渔夫，渔民

examples.text: The fisherman transfixed the shark with a harpoon.
examples.translationZh: 渔夫用鱼叉刺住鲨鱼。

examples.text: With dredging , the fisherman tows a chain mesh behind a fishing boat in order to scoop up sea life from the seabed.
examples.translationZh: 利用拖捞网，渔人在渔船后面拖动一串筛网，从而从海床捞起海洋生物。

meaningZh: 循环，周期；自行车；时代，一段时间

examples.text: The seasons of the year make a cycle.
examples.translationZh: 一年四季构成一个循环。

examples.text: The business cycle experienced a sudden down.
examples.translationZh: 商业周期经历了突然的萧条。

examples.text: A cycle of the sun takes a year.
examples.translationZh: 太阳循环周期需要一年。

meaningZh: 块；街区；大楼，大厦

examples.text: Walk two blocks down the street and go past the city hall.
examples.translationZh: 顺这条街走两个街区，过市政厅。

examples.text: The doctors succeeded in confining the contagious disease within the block.
examples.translationZh: 医生们成功地将这个传染病控制在这一街区的范围内。

examples.text: The floor was made of wooden blocks.
examples.translationZh: 地板是用木块拼成的。

meaningZh: 承认；鸣谢；对…打招呼

examples.text: We acknowledged the need for reform.
examples.translationZh: 我们承认改革的需要。

examples.text: Please acknowledge this cheque as soon as you receive it.
examples.translationZh: 收到该支票后,请立即告知。

examples.text: We hope you can acknowledge your mistake in public.
examples.translationZh: 希望你当众认错。

meaningZh: 支撑；携带；输送

examples.text: She came in carrying an important-looking piece of paper.
examples.translationZh: 她进来时,拿着一份看来很重要的文件。

examples.text: This is a dangerous area, so don't carry too much cash on you.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区很危险，所以你身上不要带太多现金。

examples.text: Pipes carry oil across the desert to the east.
examples.translationZh: 输油管把石油经过沙漠运送到东部。

meaningZh: 埋，葬

examples.text: They interred their dear comrade in the arms.
examples.translationZh: 他们埋葬了他们亲爱的战友。

examples.text: The man who died in that accident has been interred.
examples.translationZh: 在那次事故中死的那个人已经被埋葬了。

meaningZh: 离开，远离；在远处；消失

examples.text: He lives 3 miles away from here.
examples.translationZh: 他住在距离这里三英里的地方。

examples.text: I hope to get away early in the morning.
examples.translationZh: 我希望一早就动身离开。

examples.text: He lives in retirement, away from everyone.
examples.translationZh: 他远离大家隐居着。

meaningZh: 教科书；课本；教材

examples.text: Each student was issued with a textbook.
examples.translationZh: 每个学生发了一本课本。

examples.text: This textbook has twenty lessons.
examples.translationZh: 这课本有二十课。

examples.text: There is a glossary at the end of the textbook.
examples.translationZh: 这本教科书后面有词汇表。

meaningZh: 病毒；病毒性疾病；毒素，毒害

examples.text: Scientists have isolated the virus causing the epidemic.
examples.translationZh: 科学家们已分离出引起这种流行病的病毒。

examples.text: We should be watchful of computer viruses.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该警惕计算机病毒。

examples.text: HBV is a virus that causes inflammation of the liver.
examples.translationZh: HBV是一种会引起肝脏发炎的病毒。

meaningZh: 损害；使受伤；使伤心

examples.text: The rumors hurt his reputation badly.
examples.translationZh: 流言语大大地损害了他的名誉。

examples.text: She hurt my feelings.
examples.translationZh: 她伤害了我的感情。

examples.text: I do not want to hurt anybody and be hurted by anybody.
examples.translationZh: 我不想伤害任何人,也不想让任何人所伤害。

meaningZh: 金属丝；电线；电报

examples.text: The fabric was displayed on a wired stand.
examples.translationZh: 那种织物陈列在金属制的架子上。

examples.text: The rope was not strong enough, so we used wire.
examples.translationZh: 这根绳子不够结实，所以我们用金属线。

examples.text: The hot wire is caused by overload.
examples.translationZh: 电线发热是由于过载造成的。

meaningZh: 警察部门；警方；警察

examples.text: The police have caught the murderer.
examples.translationZh: 警察已经抓获杀人凶手。

examples.text: His strange behavior made the police suspicious.
examples.translationZh: 他不寻常的举止引起了警察的怀疑。

examples.text: It's the duty of the police to preserve the public order.
examples.translationZh: 维护公共秩序是警察的职责。

meaningZh: 橡胶；橡皮；决胜局

examples.text: Oil and grease will rot the rubber of your tyres.
examples.translationZh: 油污能腐蚀轮胎橡胶。

examples.text: My classmate borrowed my rubber and forgot to return it.
examples.translationZh: 我的同学借了我的橡皮忘了还。

examples.text: She used a rubber band to tie her hair.
examples.translationZh: 她用一根橡皮筋扎头发。

meaningZh: 美洲；美国；[电影]亚美利加

examples.text: Are you going to America by boat or by plane?
examples.translationZh: 你到美国是坐船还是坐飞机？

examples.text: It's time for us to say "No"to America.
examples.translationZh: 是我们对美国说不的时候了。

examples.text: One of his forefathers was an early settler in America.
examples.translationZh: 他的祖先之一是美洲的早期移民。

meaningZh: 使…变大；扩张；详述

examples.text: Metals expand when they are heated.
examples.translationZh: 金属遇热则膨胀。

examples.text: Would you expand upon the matter a little further?
examples.translationZh: 请你再进一步谈谈这件事好吗?

examples.text: They conferred on the best way to expand business.
examples.translationZh: 他们商议扩展业务的最好方法。

meaningZh: 分开；（使）分离；区分

examples.text: Can these two definitions be conflated, or must they be kept separate?
examples.translationZh: 这两个定义可以合成一个呢，还是必须分开?

examples.text: I advocate separate classes for students to learn Chinese in different ways.
examples.translationZh: 我建议我们分班授课，让不同的学生以不同的方式学习华文。

examples.text: We don't have a separate dining room—the living area is all one.
examples.translationZh: 我们没有单独的饭厅——活动空间都在一处。

meaningZh: 提高（土地、地产）的价值；利用（机会）；改善，改良

examples.text: Your work will get by, but try to improve it.
examples.translationZh: 你的工作勉强通过了,但要设法改善它。

examples.text: He offered a suggestion to improve the plan.
examples.translationZh: 他提出一个建议,以改进那项计划。

examples.text: I want to improve my English.
examples.translationZh: 我想提高我的英语水平。

meaningZh: 臂；武器；[复数]战事

examples.text: You should wind a cloth round the wounded arm.
examples.translationZh: 你应该把一块布缠在受伤的和臂上。

examples.text: The archer holds the bow in his bow arm.
examples.translationZh: 运动员用执弓臂握住弓。

examples.text: His left arm was hurt in an accident.
examples.translationZh: 他的左胳膊在一次事故中受伤了。

meaningZh: 出生；分娩；起源

examples.text: Gestation extends from fertilization to birth.
examples.translationZh: 妊娠期系指从配种到分娩之间的时间。

examples.text: Many of the women died in child birth in the past.
examples.translationZh: 在过去，许多妇女死于分娩。

examples.text: My daughter's birth was ecstatic.
examples.translationZh: 我女儿的出生令人欣喜。

meaningZh: 危险的

examples.text: It is dangerous to walk on thin ice in a lake.
examples.translationZh: 在湖中薄冰上行走是很危险的。

examples.text: Dangerous driving should be severely punished.
examples.translationZh: 危险驾驶应受严惩。

examples.text: It is dangerous for you to stay here.
examples.translationZh: 你呆在这儿不安全。

meaningZh: 外面的，外部的；远离内部（中心）的；[哲]客观外界的，物质的

examples.text: This is compensated for an outer impressiveness.
examples.translationZh: 这一点由外部的感人情景得到了补偿。

examples.text: Outer enclosure shall not crack to the extent that the cells or any protective devices are exposed.
examples.translationZh: 外部的粘着处不能裂开至裸露出电池或保护装置。

examples.text: But you can use a swab or cloth to clean the outer part of the ear.
examples.translationZh: 但是你可以用棉签或者布把你耳朵外面的部分擦干净。

meaningZh: 经营者；操作员；电话接线员

examples.text: I am a computer operator.
examples.translationZh: 我是一名计算机操作人员。

examples.text: Is this man a teaccher or an operator?
examples.translationZh: 这个男人是老师还是名操作员?

examples.text: The lathe is being adjusted by the operator.
examples.translationZh: 这台车床正由技工在调准。

meaningZh: 科学；技术，知识；学科

examples.text: She dedicated her life to science.
examples.translationZh: 她毕生致力于科学。

examples.text: Apparently impossible feats are now accomplished by science.
examples.translationZh: 许多看起来不可能的伟大业绩现在已经由科学实现了。

examples.text: He started to study ecology and decided to devote his whole life to the science.
examples.translationZh: 他开始研究生态学,并决心将他的一生献身于这门学科。

meaningZh: 阿姨；姨母，姑妈；舅妈

examples.text: She has no relations besides an aged aunt.
examples.translationZh: 她除了有一个年老的伯母以外，再没有亲戚了。

examples.text: My aunt gave me one of her brooches as a keepsake.
examples.translationZh: 我姑母把她的一支胸针送给我作记念。

examples.text: I'm duty bound to visit my old aunt.
examples.translationZh: 我有义务去探望年老的姑妈。

meaningZh: 化学的；用化学方法制造的，化学作用的；n. 化学药品，化学制品

examples.text: The government has banned the use of chemical weapons.
examples.translationZh: 政府已经禁止使用化学武器。

examples.text: A reactor is a container for chemical reaction.
examples.translationZh: 反应器是进行化学反应的容器。

examples.text: We are doing a chemical experiment.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在做化学实验。

meaningZh: 天主教的；统括一切的；包罗万象的

examples.text: Anselm's theology is not Catholic faith.
examples.translationZh: 安塞姆的神学并不是天主教的信念。

examples.text: The atom bomb is of catholic concern.
examples.translationZh: 原子弹受到普遍的关注。

examples.text: As a young person he had more catholic tastes than he does now.
examples.translationZh: 他在年轻时兴趣比现在广泛得多。

meaningZh: 老板，上司；领袖，首领；[机]轴套，套筒

examples.text: My boss is a football fan.
examples.translationZh: 我的上司是一位足球迷。

examples.text: He was fired by his boss.
examples.translationZh: 他被他的老板解雇了。

examples.text: He is my sometime boss.
examples.translationZh: 他是我从前的上司。

meaningZh: 艺术家；画家；能手

examples.text: She is a consummate artist.
examples.translationZh: 她是个技艺高超的艺术家。

examples.text: He is a notable artist.
examples.translationZh: 他是一位著名的艺术家。

examples.text: His dream of becoming an artist has been fulfilled.
examples.translationZh: 他成为一个艺术家的梦想实现了。

meaningZh: 原始的；发展水平低的；落后的

examples.text: Primitive peoples deified the sun.
examples.translationZh: 原始部落将太阳奉为神。

examples.text: The constitution of a primitive society is not necessarily simple.
examples.translationZh: 原始社会的结构并不一定就是简单的。

examples.text: They built a primitive shelter out of the tree trunks
examples.translationZh: 他们用一些树干建造了一个简陋的棚子。

meaningZh: 反驳，驳斥；否认；与…矛盾，与…抵触

examples.text: He did not contradict his attorney's comment.
examples.translationZh: 他没有反驳律师的意见。

examples.text: She doesn't like to contradict her husband in public.
examples.translationZh: 她不愿在众人面前反驳她丈夫。

examples.text: Don't contradict your father.
examples.translationZh: 别和你父亲犟嘴。

meaningZh: 失败，不及格；缺乏，不足；破产，倒闭

examples.text: I shall have another chance in the event of failure.
examples.translationZh: 如果失败，我还有另一个机会。

examples.text: The play was a dead failure.
examples.translationZh: 这场戏完全失败了。

examples.text: I was a failure in my own eyes.
examples.translationZh: 在我眼里,我是个失败者。

meaningZh: 失望的；沮丧的，失意的；v. 使（人）失望( disappoint的过去式和过去分词)

examples.text: I'm afraid you're very disappointed with me.
examples.translationZh: 恐怕你对我是非常失望的。

examples.text: A disappointed look came into his face.
examples.translationZh: 他脸上浮现出一种失望的神情。

meaningZh: 法；法学；规律

examples.text: The law forbids stealing.
examples.translationZh: 法律禁止盗窃。

examples.text: Those who break the law are subjected to justice.
examples.translationZh: 违法者要受到法律制裁。

examples.text: The new law has received the royal assent.
examples.translationZh: 新的法规已得到国王的批准。

meaningZh: 解雇，把…免职；遣散，解散（队伍等）；驳回，拒绝受理

examples.text: If you are late again, you will be dismissed.
examples.translationZh: 如果你再迟到，你将被解雇。

examples.text: Let us dismiss and return in an hour.
examples.translationZh: 让我们先解散,一个钟头后再回来。

examples.text: We should dismiss all thought of revenge.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该屏除一切报复的念头。

meaningZh: 台风

examples.text: The typhoon is gathering strength.
examples.translationZh: 台风的风力正逐渐增强。

examples.text: The typhoon hit the coastal area.
examples.translationZh: 台风侵袭沿海地区。

examples.text: The navy rescued forty people in the typhoon.
examples.translationZh: 海军在台风天时救了四十个人。

meaningZh: 千克；公斤

examples.text: One thousand grams are equal to one kilogram.
examples.translationZh: 一千克等於一公斤。

examples.text: One kilogram of butter was a lot!
examples.translationZh: 一千克黄油非常多！

examples.text: One thousand grams are equal to one kilogram.
examples.translationZh: 一千克等於一公斤。

meaningZh: 清楚的，明白的；清晰的，明亮的；清澈的

examples.text: I made it clear to him that I rejected his proposal.
examples.translationZh: 我清楚地告诉他，我拒绝了他的建议。

examples.text: You are a boss, as is clear from your manner.
examples.translationZh: 你是一个老板,从你的举止就能很清楚地看出来。

examples.text: There is a clear division of labor in ants.
examples.translationZh: 蚂蚁间有明确的分工。

meaningZh: 光束,光线；射线；一线

examples.text: My eyes are blind by the direct ray of light.
examples.translationZh: 在光线的直射下，我看不清楚东西。

examples.text: He focused the sun's ray on a piece of paper with a burning-glass.
examples.translationZh: 他用一面凸透镜把阳光在纸上聚成焦点。

examples.text: X ray is increasingly used in industry as well.
examples.translationZh: 在工业中X射线也得到了广泛应用。

meaningZh: 明信片

examples.text: He sent me a postcard from the United Nations.
examples.translationZh: 他从联合国给我寄来一张明信片。

examples.text: Excuse me, how much is a postcard to France?
examples.translationZh: 打扰一下，寄往法国的明信片多少钱一张？

meaningZh: 把…（系统地）分类；整理；改编（剧本等）

examples.text: You must arrange these books in alphabetical order.
examples.translationZh: 你要把这些书按字母顺序排好。

examples.text: I have arranged one of my staff to meet you at the airport.
examples.translationZh: 我已经安排好一个职员到飞机场接你。

examples.text: If you can arrange the tourist destinations for me, I will be very grateful.
examples.translationZh: 如果你能为我计划一下,我将不胜感激。

meaningZh: 航行；起航；驾驶帆船

examples.text: This ship sails for New York on Monday.
examples.translationZh: 这船将于星期一开往纽约。

examples.text: The ship was given the all-clear to sail again.
examples.translationZh: 这艘船得到恢复航行的许可。

examples.text: Can you sail a boat?
examples.translationZh: 你会驾驶船只吗？

meaningZh: 自己，自身；亲自，自行；其

examples.text: One can congratulate oneself on one's victories.
examples.translationZh: 一个人也可以自己庆祝自己的胜利。

examples.text: One should be strict with oneself.
examples.translationZh: 一个人应对自己要求严格。

examples.text: How should my friend safeguard the rights and interests of oneself?
examples.translationZh: 我的朋友该如何维护自身的权益呢?

meaningZh: 剪刀；两腿前后错跃；v. 剪开( scissor的第三人称单数)

examples.text: Leonardo Da Vinci invented the scissors.
examples.translationZh: 达芬奇发明了剪刀。

examples.text: We bought some new scissors yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我们昨天买了一些新剪刀。

examples.text: Blunt scissors don't cut cleanly.
examples.translationZh: 钝剪刀剪不齐。

meaningZh: 敏感的；感觉的；[仪]灵敏的

examples.text: She's got very sensitive hearing, skin, etc.
examples.translationZh: 她的听觉、 触觉等很灵敏。

examples.text: Don't be so sensitive and I was not criticizing you.
examples.translationZh: 别那么敏感,我不是在批评你。

examples.text: What food and fruit are sensitive?
examples.translationZh: 哪些食物和水果是感光的？

meaningZh: 沉默，无言，无表示，无声，沉静，肃静，寂静，缄默；无音信，失去联系，忘却，湮没，无表示，无音讯；[乐]停止

examples.text: We interpreted his silence as a refusal.
examples.translationZh: 我们认为他的沉默是拒绝的表示。

examples.text: His forceful arguments reduced his opponents to silence.
examples.translationZh: 他那有力的论点驳得对手哑口无言。

examples.text: There was nothing but silence in the room.
examples.translationZh: 这间屋内声息全无，一片寂静。

meaningZh: 烦扰，打扰；使…不安，使…恼怒；使迷惑

examples.text: I've no time to bother with such things.
examples.translationZh: 我没时间为这种事烦恼。

examples.text: Don't write anything that will bother the censor.
examples.translationZh: 你可别写什么给检查员找麻烦的话。

examples.text: It bothers me that he can be so insensitive.
examples.translationZh: 他这样麻木不仁，我心里很不痛快。

meaningZh: 北方的，北部的；来自北方的；北风

examples.text: That's a large city in northern Greece.
examples.translationZh: 那是希腊北部的一个大城市。

examples.text: The people of northern Canada are called Inuit.
examples.translationZh: 加拿大北部的人称为因纽特人。

examples.text: The United Kingdom consists of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
examples.translationZh: 联合王国由大不列颠和北爱尔兰组成。

meaningZh: 标题；头衔；[体]冠军

examples.text: What's the title of her new book?
examples.translationZh: 她的新书书名是什么？

examples.text: The title just won't come to mind.
examples.translationZh: 那个标题就是想不起来。

examples.text: If you lose, you're given a really humiliating title.
examples.translationZh: 如果你输了,你会被标上一个很丢脸的称号。

meaningZh: 渴望的；热切的，热情洋溢的；热心的

examples.text: He is eager for you to meet his friends.
examples.translationZh: 他热切希望你见见他的朋友。

examples.text: Eager fans mobbed the popular singer.
examples.translationZh: 热切的歌迷们团团围住住这位流行歌手

examples.text: The boys listened to my story with eager attention.
examples.translationZh: 男孩们以热切的心情非常注意地倾听我的故事。

meaningZh: 结果；成果；出路

examples.text: What was the outcome of your meeting?
examples.translationZh: 你们会晤的结果如何?

examples.text: The outcome of the election is a foregone conclusion.
examples.translationZh: 选举结果已在预料之中。

examples.text: The outcome of the game is beyond his fondest hopes.
examples.translationZh: 比赛结果使他大喜过望。

meaningZh: 她的；属于她的

examples.text: Your appearance is identical to hers.
examples.translationZh: 你的相貌和她的一模一样。

examples.text: This book is hers.
examples.translationZh: 这本书是她的。

meaningZh: 身材高的，高大的；（数量）大的；（俚）过分的，夸张的

examples.text: The boy is 150 centimetres tall.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩身高150厘米。

examples.text: She's tall for her age.
examples.translationZh: 从她的年龄来看，她个子算是高的。

examples.text: The tall hedge breaks the force of the wind .
examples.translationZh: 高的树篱能减弱风力。

meaningZh: 给予帮助的，有益的；愿意帮忙的

examples.text: You are very helpful.
examples.translationZh: 您真帮了我的大忙。

examples.text: These things are helpful for my life.
examples.translationZh: 而且对我的生活是有帮助的。

examples.text: These tactics are unlikely to be helpful to you.
examples.translationZh: 这种方法对你未必有用。

meaningZh: [动]鲸，鲸鱼；巨大的事物；v. 捕鲸

examples.text: We may live to see the extinction of the whale.
examples.translationZh: 人类或许能亲眼见到鲸的灭绝。

examples.text: The whale thrashed the water with its tail.
examples.translationZh: 那条鲸鱼不住地用尾巴击水。

examples.text: The blue whale is the world's largest living animal.
examples.translationZh: 蓝鲸是当今最大的动物。

meaningZh: 学生；[解]瞳孔；未成年人

examples.text: The headmaster has made a decision of suspension of a pupil from school.
examples.translationZh: 校长已经做出对一名学生停学处分的决定。

examples.text: A teacher can't give individual attention to each pupil if his class is large.
examples.translationZh: 如果班上的人数多，老师就不能给予个别辅导了。

examples.text: The painting is the work of a pupil of Rembrandt.
examples.translationZh: 这幅画是伦勃朗的一位弟子的作品。

meaningZh: 刚才；仅仅，只是；正好

examples.text: This is the thing you just left.
examples.translationZh: 这是您刚才忘在这里的东西。

examples.text: I am just teasing you; you need not be nervous.
examples.translationZh: 我仅仅是在跟你闹着玩,你不要紧张。

examples.text: I'm sorry, but I am just on my way out.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉,我正好要出门。

meaningZh: 祈祷，祷告；请求，恳求；央求

examples.text: She prays to god to keep her son from harm.
examples.translationZh: 她祈祷上帝保佑儿子平安。

examples.text: They went to the mosque to pray.
examples.translationZh: 他们去清真寺做祷告。

examples.text: I earnestly pray for your pardon.
examples.translationZh: 我恳切地请求你原谅。

meaningZh: 制服；军服；通讯中用以代表字母 u 的词

examples.text: He looks very manly in his uniform.
examples.translationZh: 他穿着制服十分精神。

examples.text: The students are wearing school uniforms.
examples.translationZh: 学生们穿着校服。

examples.text: The rows of houses were uniform in appearance.
examples.translationZh: 这一排排的房屋外表都是一样的。

meaningZh: 面，边；方面；侧面

examples.text: My house is the ninth on the right side.
examples.translationZh: 我的房子是右边第九幢。

examples.text: The park is just on the left side of this street.
examples.translationZh: 公园就在马路的左侧。

examples.text: We planted tulips along the side of the lawn.
examples.translationZh: 我们沿草坪的边缘种上了郁金香

meaningZh: 袋，囊，枕套；钱包，手提皮包，财富；〈英俚〉大量，很多

examples.text: He lost his travelling bag when he crossed the desert.
examples.translationZh: 他在穿越沙漠的时候丢失了他的旅行袋。

examples.text: The boxer's fist thumped into the punching bag.
examples.translationZh: 拳师猛击吊袋。

examples.text: He put his bag on the luggage rack.
examples.translationZh: 他把包放在行李架上。

meaningZh: 清静的；僻静的；不起眼的

examples.text: When you are in a library, you must be quiet.
examples.translationZh: 当你在图书馆时,你必须保持安静。

examples.text: Please keep quiet while others are studying.
examples.translationZh: 在别人学习的时候,请保持安静。

examples.text: His health has turned all the better for him after a quiet holiday abroad.
examples.translationZh: 在国外度过一个宁静的假期，他的健康状况有所好转。

meaningZh: 仓库，货栈；批发商店；福利库

examples.text: They stored their goods in a warehouse.
examples.translationZh: 他们把货物储存在一个仓库里。

examples.text: They operate three factories and a huge warehouse.
examples.translationZh: 他们经营三家工厂和一个大仓库。

examples.text: If necessary, please warehouse the goods.
examples.translationZh: 如有必要，请将该货存入仓库。

meaningZh: 取笑，戏弄；挑逗；强要

examples.text: He is a terrible tease.
examples.translationZh: 他特别爱戏弄人。

examples.text: It's too bad of you to tease the child like that.
examples.translationZh: 你那样逗弄小孩真不好。

examples.text: You must never tease a child because he stutters .
examples.translationZh: 你切不可因为一个孩子口吃而去取笑他。

meaningZh: 奖学金；学术；学识

examples.text: The scholarship includes an allowance of 80 dollars for books.
examples.translationZh: 奖学金包括八十美元的书籍费津贴。

examples.text: He won a scholarship to Cambridge.
examples.translationZh: 他获得一份到剑桥大学读书的奖学金。

examples.text: She has been awarded a scholarship to study at Harvard.
examples.translationZh: 她获得了去哈佛大学读书的奖学金。

meaningZh: 茶壶

examples.text: This teapot doesn't pour well.
examples.translationZh: 这个茶壶不好倒。

examples.text: This teapot's got a broken spout.
examples.translationZh: 这茶壶的壶嘴坏了。

meaningZh: 休息厅；客厅；（机场等的）等候室

examples.text: We watched television in the hotel lounge.
examples.translationZh: 我们在旅馆休息室里看电视。

examples.text: Please move forward to the passenger lounge .
examples.translationZh: 请向前走到旅客休息室。

examples.text: She is waiting for me in the departure lounge.
examples.translationZh: 她在候机室等我。

meaningZh: 立刻，马上；简单地，扼要地；唐突地，简慢地

examples.text: Know that these aches and pains are just blockages and that they will be moved shortly.
examples.translationZh: 了解这些伤痛不过只是沮滞并且将立刻被移除。

examples.text: And it's hardly a coincidence that shortly after Usmanov hires a big shot PR firm these kinds of pieces begin to appear in the papers.
examples.translationZh: 当乌斯马诺夫刚刚雇用了强悍的公关公司后，这类东西就立刻出现在报纸上，很难让人信服这只是一种巧合。

examples.text: I hope to announce the winner shortly.
examples.translationZh: 我希望马上宣布胜利者的名字。

meaningZh: 双的；两倍的；两面派的

examples.text: The date had a double significance.
examples.translationZh: 那个日子有双重意义。

examples.text: This machine serves a double purpose.
examples.translationZh: 这部机器有双重用途。

examples.text: The egg has a double yolk.
examples.translationZh: 这只蛋双黄。

meaningZh: 夜；晚上；（举行盛事的）夜晚

examples.text: Night began to fall.
examples.translationZh: 夜幕降临。

examples.text: We can see the stars at night.
examples.translationZh: 夜晚我们可以看见星群。

examples.text: With the setting of the sun, night comes silently.
examples.translationZh: 随着太阳的落下，夜晚悄悄地来到。

meaningZh: 自然的；物质的；天生的

examples.text: It is natural that he should fall in love with such a beautiful girl.
examples.translationZh: 他爱上那位美丽的姑娘是很自然的事。

examples.text: I prefer to see animals living in their natural state.
examples.translationZh: 我宁愿看处于野生状态的动物。

examples.text: Leave her alone. She's natural crier.
examples.translationZh: 别理她,她是个天生爱哭的人。

meaningZh: 植物学的

examples.text: My botanical interest is largely confined to the reproductive processes in vascular plants.
examples.translationZh: 我对植物学的兴趣主要限于维管植物的生殖过程。

examples.text: De Bary abandoned a career in medicine in Frankfurt to devote the rest of his life to his botanical studies, becoming professor of botany at a number of German universities.
examples.translationZh: 它放弃了在法兰克福医学的研究转向植物学的研究，后来成为好几所德国大学的植物学教授。

examples.text: My botanical interest is largely confined to the reproductive processes in vascular plants.
examples.translationZh: 我对植物学的兴趣主要限于维管植物的生殖过程。

meaningZh: 豆,豆科植物

examples.text: Cocoa bean is used to make some kinds of drink.
examples.translationZh: 可可豆用于制作一些饮料。

examples.text: A bean grows rapidly.
examples.translationZh: 豆类植物生长很快。

examples.text: The bean plant is cultivated for animal fodder.
examples.translationZh: 种植豆科植物可以用来当动物饲料。

meaningZh: 任意的；随机的；胡乱的

examples.text: Men are exposed to more acts of random physical violence.
examples.translationZh: 男人受到更多的任意的身体强烈活动。

examples.text: Most people know that the outcome of a coin toss is random.
examples.translationZh: 大部分人都知道掷硬币的结果是随机的。

examples.text: The computer will generate apparently random numbers.
examples.translationZh: 电脑似乎将随机产生号码。

meaningZh: 收益，得益；利润；红利

examples.text: There is very little profit in selling newspapers at present.
examples.translationZh: 现在卖报纸利润很少。

examples.text: I want to know the net profit.
examples.translationZh: 我想知道净收益。

examples.text: It is well known that fake and inferior commodities do harm to the profit of consumers.
examples.translationZh: 众所周知,假冒伪劣商品损害了消费者的利益。

meaningZh: 男人；人类；男子汉

examples.text: She married a man who put her on a pedestal.
examples.translationZh: 她嫁给了一个对她十分崇拜的男人。

examples.text: All men are born equal.
examples.translationZh: 人生而平等。

examples.text: He played the man in the time of great trouble.
examples.translationZh: 他在极为困难的时候显示出男子汉的气概。

meaningZh: 传统的；口传的；惯例的

examples.text: The traditional breakfast in this area includes bacon and eggs.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区传统的早饭包括火腿和鸡蛋。

examples.text: It's a garden in the traditional victorian style.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个传统的维多利亚风格的花园。

meaningZh: 评价；求…的值（或数）；对…评价

examples.text: Let's evaluate the evidence.
examples.translationZh: 让我们评定一下此证据的价值。

examples.text: The school has only been open for six months, so it's too early to evaluate its success.
examples.translationZh: 这所学校开办还不过六个月，所以要对它的成绩作出评价为时尚早。

examples.text: Enterprise should acquaint with its storage status, that's the reason why it needs to evaluate the storage material.
examples.translationZh: 企业应对自身库存状况有清楚的了解,这就需要对各个物资做出评价。

meaningZh: 烹调；编造；篡改

examples.text: The cook went to see the cake left in the oven.
examples.translationZh: 炊事员去照看炉子里的蛋糕了。

examples.text: They engaged a cook for the summer.
examples.translationZh: 那个夏天他们雇了一个厨子。

examples.text: He was a cook before his demobilization.
examples.translationZh: 他复员以前是一名炊事员。

meaningZh: 麻雀；〈美〉个子小的人

examples.text: A sparrow is very alert in its movement.
examples.translationZh: 麻雀的动作很敏捷。

meaningZh: 指已提到的人（物）；指说话人与听者已知的人（物）；用于独一无二的事物前

examples.text: I reached the gate that opened towards the lake.
examples.translationZh: 我走到临湖而开的那扇门前。

examples.text: Is it necessary for me to attend the meeting?
examples.translationZh: 我真的必须参加这个会议吗？

examples.text: The electrical installations are very old.
examples.translationZh: 这些装置那么残旧。

meaningZh: 弹药库；杂志；弹仓

examples.text: This magazine has a large circulation.
examples.translationZh: 这本杂志发行量很大。

examples.text: I was reading a magazine when the phone rang.
examples.translationZh: 电话铃响时我正在看一本杂志。

examples.text: This magazine comes out quarterly.
examples.translationZh: 这种杂志一年发行四期。

meaningZh: 科技（总称）；工业技术；工艺学

examples.text: The government saw the introduction of new technology as vital.
examples.translationZh: 政府认为引进新技术至关重要。

examples.text: Britain is behind Japan in developing modern technologies.
examples.translationZh: 在发展现代技术方面英国落后于日本。

examples.text: He majors in engine technology in this college.
examples.translationZh: 他在这所学院主修发动机工艺。

meaningZh: 勇敢的；需要勇气的；华丽的

examples.text: I think you are very brave.
examples.translationZh: 我认为你非常勇敢。

examples.text: The soldier's brave deeds brought him honor and glory.
examples.translationZh: 士兵的勇敢事迹为他带来了荣耀和赞美。

examples.text: Let us remember the brave who died for the peace of the world.
examples.translationZh: 让我们永远怀念为世界和平献身的勇士们。

meaningZh: 很可能变化的；常变化的；易变的

examples.text: The weather in Xi'an is always changeable.
examples.translationZh: 西安的天气很易变的。

examples.text: In the subjects having known the risk factors, more than half of patients still did not adopt any actions on the changeable life styles.
examples.translationZh: 在了解危险因素的同时仍有半数以上患者在可改变的生活方式上未采取行为。

meaningZh: 桩；一堆；绒头

examples.text: We put the books in piles on the floor.
examples.translationZh: 我们把书在地板上堆起来。

examples.text: I have a huge pile of letters to deal with.
examples.translationZh: 我有一大堆信件要处理。

examples.text: The thick pile of a luxurious bath towel touches soft.
examples.translationZh: 这块华丽浴巾的厚绒面摸起来很柔软。

meaningZh: 冰箱；冷藏库；制冰机，冷冻机

examples.text: Milk will keep for several days in a refrigerator.
examples.translationZh: 牛奶在冰箱里可以保存几天。

examples.text: Perishable food should be stored in a refrigerator.
examples.translationZh: 易腐的食物应储存在冰箱里。

meaningZh: 要求；需要；所请求的事物

examples.text: I will oblige any sincere request.
examples.translationZh: 我会答应任何诚意的请求。

examples.text: His answer to my request was a negative.
examples.translationZh: 我的请求遭到了他的拒绝。

examples.text: Your request will be dealt with in due course.
examples.translationZh: 你的要求将在适当时机予以处理。

meaningZh: 颈，脖子；衣领；海峡

examples.text: The giraffe is characterized by its very long neck.
examples.translationZh: 长颈鹿以其长颈为特徵.

examples.text: The neck of my guitar is broken.
examples.translationZh: 我吉他的琴颈坏了。

examples.text: The doctor operated the patient on the neck.
examples.translationZh: 医生给病人的颈部动手术。

meaningZh: 坚固的，坚牢的；坚定的，坚决的；严格的

examples.text: He has established his own firm.
examples.translationZh: 他已建立起自己的公司。

examples.text: He resigned his directorship and left the firm.
examples.translationZh: 他放弃了董事职务, 离开了公司。

examples.text: The businessment started out as an errand boy at the age of 14 in a firm.
examples.translationZh: 这位大企业家从14岁时起就在一家商行里当听差。

meaningZh: 参加某事；分享某事；vt. 得到或接受某部分东西

examples.text: Everyone in the class is expected to participate in the discussion.
examples.translationZh: 希望全班同学参加讨论。

examples.text: In the ancient Greek Olympics, only men were allowed to participate in it.
examples.translationZh: 在古希腊奥运会中,只允许男人参加比赛。

examples.text: I don't want to participate in the English party.
examples.translationZh: 我不想参加英语晚会。

meaningZh: 穿着，戴着；面露；留着（胡须等）

examples.text: The inscription on the stone had worn away.
examples.translationZh: 刻在石头上的文字已磨损了。

examples.text: Machines soon wear out under rough usage.
examples.translationZh: 机器如果使用不仔细, 很快就会磨损。

examples.text: It was a freak of mine to wear pink pajamas.
examples.translationZh: 穿上粉红色睡衣是我一时的奇想。

meaningZh: 根，根源；原因，本质；祖先

examples.text: Ann caught her foot on a tree root and stumbled.
examples.translationZh: 安的一只脚被树根绊了一下跌倒了。

examples.text: The dog is snuffling around the root of a tree.
examples.translationZh: 那条狗在树根处嗅来嗅去。

examples.text: Unhappiness is the root cause of his illness.
examples.translationZh: 不开心是他生病的根源。

meaningZh: 锚；锚状物；靠山

examples.text: The ship dragged its anchor during the night.
examples.translationZh: 夜里,船把锚拖动了。

examples.text: Hope is his only anchor.
examples.translationZh: 希望是他唯一的依靠。

examples.text: He was then doing the anchor.
examples.translationZh: 他当时正主持新闻广播节目。

meaningZh: 一次，一趟；一倍；曾经

examples.text: Once or twice she looked over her shoulder at me.
examples.translationZh: 有一两次她回头看看我。

examples.text: She had not once spoken to him all the evening.
examples.translationZh: 整整一晚上,她都没有跟他讲过一次话。

examples.text: I see them about once a fortnight.
examples.translationZh: 我大约两星期见他们一次。

meaningZh: 怀孕的；孕育着…的；富于想象的

examples.text: How long has she been pregnant?
examples.translationZh: 她怀孕多久了？

examples.text: She got pregnant and was turned out of the house by her parents.
examples.translationZh: 她怀孕了，父母把她赶出了家门。

examples.text: Women who do not ovulate regularly have difficulty in becoming pregnant.
examples.translationZh: 妇女排卵期不正常就不易受孕。

meaningZh: 毛毯，毯子；毯状物；厚的覆盖层

examples.text: He threw a blanket over the injured man.
examples.translationZh: 他急忙给受伤的人披上条毯子。

examples.text: They cuddled up (together) under the blanket.
examples.translationZh: 他们盖著毯子(在一起)搂著。

examples.text: The nurse carried in a baby wrapped (up) in a warm blanket.
examples.translationZh: 保母抱著个孩子进来，孩子身上裹著暖暖的毯子。

meaningZh: 相对的；对面的；对立的

examples.text: She hurried away in the opposite direction.
examples.translationZh: 她朝着相反的方向匆匆离去了。

examples.text: The fireplace flamed the opposite wall.
examples.translationZh: 炉火照亮了对面的墙壁。

examples.text: Our points of view are at opposite poles.
examples.translationZh: 我们的观点截然相反。

meaningZh: 圣诞节

examples.text: We usually sing carols at Christmas.
examples.translationZh: 圣诞节时，我们一般会唱颂歌。

examples.text: Christmas is a time of mirth, especially for children.
examples.translationZh: 圣诞节是个快乐的日子，尤其是对孩子们。

examples.text: They decorated the Christmas tree with tinsel.
examples.translationZh: 他们用亮金属片装饰圣诞树。

meaningZh: 公民；国民；市民

examples.text: He is a Dane inasmuch as he was born in Denmark, but he became a British citizen at the age of 30.
examples.translationZh: 他按其出生在丹麦来说是丹麦人，但他在30岁时成了英国公民。

examples.text: She is a lawful citizen.
examples.translationZh: 她是个守法的公民。

examples.text: This accusation of bribery is a vile smear on an honorable citizen.
examples.translationZh: 这项有关贿赂的指控是对一个正直公民的无耻诽谤。

meaningZh: 使闪光，使闪烁；拍出，发出（电报等）；〈口〉炫耀

examples.text: Lighthouse and beacons flash at night.
examples.translationZh: 晚上灯塔与信号灯闪着光。

examples.text: A driver is not supposed to flash his lights at the coming vehicles.
examples.translationZh: 司机不该朝着迎面开来的车辆闪灯。

examples.text: Her eyes flashed with anger.
examples.translationZh: 她眼中冒出了怒火。

meaningZh: 摘要，概要；总结，一览；adj. 概括的，总结的

examples.text: Please write me a summary of this report.
examples.translationZh: 请替我写一份这份报告的摘要。

examples.text: Your summary will need fleshing out before you present it.
examples.translationZh: 你的总结需要增加一些具体材料再交出。

examples.text: I went through by a summary method.
examples.translationZh: 我成功运用了一个简易的方法。

meaningZh: 深的；深远的，深奥；重大的，深刻的

examples.text: There is a deep divide between the two factions.
examples.translationZh: 这两派之间有很深的分歧。

examples.text: The deer escaped to the deep forest.
examples.translationZh: 那鹿逃入了丛林深处。

examples.text: His personality left a deep impression on us.
examples.translationZh: 他的人品给我们留下了深刻的印象。

meaningZh: 由；（表示根据）依照；（表示比率）（尤指数量，价格，时间）每

examples.text: These apples cost five yuan per kilogram.
examples.translationZh: 这些苹果每公斤五元。

examples.text: We were bowling along (the motorway) at seventy miles per hour.
examples.translationZh: 我们以每小时七十英里的速度(在高速公路上)飞驰。

examples.text: The vessel tax of anchorage is 5,000 dollars per year.
examples.translationZh: 这艘船的停泊税一年是五千美元。

meaningZh: 银；银币; 银餐具

examples.text: He had some silver in his pocket.
examples.translationZh: 他口袋里有些银币。

examples.text: Acid had pitted the surface of the silver.
examples.translationZh: 酸把银器的表面腐蚀了。

examples.text: His black hair was threaded with silver.
examples.translationZh: 他的黑发中夹杂着银发。

meaningZh: 物主，所有人

examples.text: The property revert to its original owner in1998.
examples.translationZh: 财产于1998年将归还原所有人。

examples.text: She is not the true owner of this house.
examples.translationZh: 她不是这所房子的真正所有人。

examples.text: The stolen property must be restored to its owner.
examples.translationZh: 赃物必须物归原主。

meaningZh: 年龄；时代；老年

examples.text: What is your age?
examples.translationZh: 你多大年纪？

examples.text: The child is at an impressionable age.
examples.translationZh: 这孩子正处于易受影响的年龄。

examples.text: We are living in the age of technology.
examples.translationZh: 我们生活在工业技术时代。

meaningZh: 网；网状织物；球网

examples.text: This area has not been covered by the communication net.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区还不在通讯网的覆盖之内。

examples.text: My mother bought a lot of net curtains.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈买了很多网眼帘布。

examples.text: The net weight of this jar of coffee is 180 grams.
examples.translationZh: 这瓶咖啡净重180克。

meaningZh: 夫人，太太（对无特殊头衔的已婚妇女的称呼）

examples.text: Mrs Brown is known as a social climber.
examples.translationZh: 布朗太太是有名的趋炎附势的人。

examples.text: Mrs Fiedler makes a little money go a long way.
examples.translationZh: 菲德勒太太经常以很少的钱办很多的事。

meaningZh: 凶猛的，残忍的；猛烈的；狂热的

examples.text: What he said met with fierce opposition.
examples.translationZh: 他的话语遭到激烈反对。

examples.text: Because there is so much unemployment, the competition for jobs is fierce.
examples.translationZh: 因为失业严重，求职的竞争十分激烈。

examples.text: The postman was bitten by a fierce dog.
examples.translationZh: 那个邮递员被一只恶狗咬了。

meaningZh: 省份；大行政区；范围

examples.text: British Columbia is a province of Canada.
examples.translationZh: 不列颠哥伦比亚是加拿大的一个省。

examples.text: Hangzhou is the capital city of Zhejiang Province.
examples.translationZh: 杭州是浙江的省会城市。

meaningZh: 声明；（思想、观点、文章主题等的）表现；（文字）陈述

examples.text: She refused to make a statement to the police lest she （should） incriminate herself.
examples.translationZh: 她拒绝向警方作陈述以免受连累。

examples.text: Her views were fully elaborated in a written statement.
examples.translationZh: 她的观点在一篇书面声明中得到了充分的阐述。

meaningZh: 真实的；实际的；现行的

examples.text: The actual cause of the quake itself is the rupturing or breaking of rocks at or below the earth's surface.
examples.translationZh: 地震本身的真正原因是地球表面的或地底下的岩石断裂或破裂。

examples.text: We call the baby Doc. His actual name is Daniel.
examples.translationZh: 我们把这个婴儿叫做多克,他的实际名字是丹尼尔。

examples.text: I need the actual figures, not an estimate.
examples.translationZh: 我需要确实的数字，不要估计的。

meaningZh: 束，串，捆；一串，一群；一帮，一伙

examples.text: I bought a bunch of grapes.
examples.translationZh: 我买了一串葡萄。

examples.text: He gave a bunch of flowers to his girlfriend.
examples.translationZh: 他送给女友一束花。

examples.text: He goes round with a bunch of thugs.
examples.translationZh: 他经常和一帮流氓厮混。

meaningZh: 紧密的；亲密的；亲近的

examples.text: If you close your eyes, you can't see anything.
examples.translationZh: 如果你闭上眼睛，就什么也看不见了。

examples.text: The road was closed to traffic for two days.
examples.translationZh: 这条路已经封路两天了。

examples.text: The hospital closed at the end of last year.
examples.translationZh: 这所医院去年年底关闭。

meaningZh: 容易的；舒适的；宽裕的

examples.text: It's not easy to rid oneself of a habit.
examples.translationZh: 要改掉一个习惯是不容易的。

examples.text: Her movements were easy and graceful.
examples.translationZh: 她的动作轻松而优雅。

examples.text: It was not easy for me to get the rusty nail out.
examples.translationZh: 我好不容易才拔出这颗生锈的钉子。

meaningZh: 也许；可能；大概

examples.text: Maybe these nutrients are helpful to your health.
examples.translationZh: 或许这些营养品对你的健康有帮助。

examples.text: Maybe it will work.
examples.translationZh: 也许这个办法会有效。

examples.text: Maybe some other time.
examples.translationZh: 也许下一次吧。

meaningZh: 商标,牌子；烙印；vt. 打烙印于,以烙铁打

examples.text: As an author who was in a period when the new and the old interlaced, Cervantes had a brand of two ages inevitably.
examples.translationZh: 作为新旧两个时代交替期的作家,塞万提斯身上不可避免地带有两个时代的烙印。

examples.text: You may personalize the design to match your company's existing brand identity and design specifications.
examples.translationZh: 您也可以进行个性化设计,使其符合公司的现有商标与设计规范。

examples.text: The advertising manager may set as a goal for advertising an increase of 15 percent in consumer brand awareness in the next six months.
examples.translationZh: 广告经理确定的目标为:在今后的6个月里，通过广告，提高消费者商标知晓率的15%25。

meaningZh: 美丽的，美好的；极好的

examples.text: She is, as it were, the most beautiful girl I've ever seen.
examples.translationZh: 她可说是我见过的最漂亮的姑娘。

examples.text: Looking at a beautiful painting always gives one satisfaction.
examples.translationZh: 观赏一幅美丽的图画使人心满意足。

examples.text: Many beautiful fish are fast disappearing because of the severe pollution.
examples.translationZh: 因为污染严重，许多美丽的鱼类正在面临绝种。

meaningZh: 贡献，捐赠，捐助；捐赠，捐助物；投稿，来稿

examples.text: Don't undervalue Jim's contribution to the research.
examples.translationZh: 不要低估了吉姆在研究工作中的贡献。

examples.text: He has made an important contribution to the company's success.
examples.translationZh: 他对公司的成功作出了重要的贡献。

examples.text: All contribution, however small, will be greatly appreciated.
examples.translationZh: 所有捐款，无论数目多么少，我们都深表感谢。

meaningZh: 乘客，旅客；行人，过路人；碍手碍脚的人

examples.text: The mysterious woman passenger vanished.
examples.translationZh: 这位神秘的女乘客突然不见了。

examples.text: The passenger berthed beside me.
examples.translationZh: 这名乘客的铺位在我的旁边。

examples.text: The allowance per passenger is 25 kg.
examples.translationZh: 每个旅客的行李重量限25公斤。

meaningZh: 矛盾的；反驳的；抗辩的

examples.text: I was bewildered by the contradictory statements.
examples.translationZh: 我被互相矛盾的陈述搞得莫衷一是。

examples.text: People found this sort of contradictory reality hard to accept.
examples.translationZh: 人们都觉得这矛盾的现实难以接受。

examples.text: His remark was contradictory to the truth.
examples.translationZh: 他的叙述与事实矛盾。

meaningZh: 黄油；黄油状的食品；奉承话

examples.text: My mother asked me to cream the butter and sugar together.
examples.translationZh: 妈妈让我把黄油和糖搅成奶油状。

examples.text: She cooks omelets in butter as they do in France.
examples.translationZh: 她用奶油做法国式的蛋卷。

examples.text: She filmed a slice of bread with butter.
examples.translationZh: 她涂一层薄薄的奶油在一片面包上。

meaningZh: 悲哀的；糟糕的；可悲的

examples.text: Her eyes moisten as she listen to the sad story.
examples.translationZh: 听著这悲伤的故事,她的眼睛湿润了。

examples.text: My heart broke at the sad news.
examples.translationZh: 知道这悲伤的消息时

examples.text: Here we had, not long ago, a very sad funeral in this church.
examples.translationZh: 不久以前,这教会举行了一次悲哀的丧礼。

meaningZh: 聪明的；敏捷的；漂亮的

examples.text: I'm a smart girl that speaks with a smart accent.
examples.translationZh: 我是个机灵的姑娘，说话带有时髦的腔调。

examples.text: A few months ago they opened a new shop catering exclusively to the smart set.
examples.translationZh: 几个月前他们新开了一家商店，专门向最时髦的人士出售物品。

examples.text: He really cuts a dash in his smart new uniform.
examples.translationZh: 他穿著漂亮的新制服真是神气十足。

meaningZh: 精确（性），准确（性）

examples.text: He's a man of accuracy and strict method.
examples.translationZh: 他是个精细而严谨的人。

examples.text: Accuracy is more important than speed in his new job.
examples.translationZh: 对他的新工作，准确比速度更重要。

examples.text: I can predict something with great accuracy.
examples.translationZh: 我能很准确地预测某事。

meaningZh: 现实，现实性；真实情况，实际情形；实体，实在

examples.text: He describes the scene with startling reality.
examples.translationZh: 他对那景象的描述逼真得令人惊讶。

examples.text: I try to convince him of the reality of the danger.
examples.translationZh: 我试图使他相信危险的确存在。

examples.text: His plans were transformed overnight into reality.
examples.translationZh: 他的计划迅速变为现实。

meaningZh: 私有的，私人的；秘密的；内心的

examples.text: The president is paying a private visit to Europe.
examples.translationZh: 总统正在欧洲进行私人访问。

examples.text: We each have our private views about it.
examples.translationZh: 我们每个人对这件事都有自己的看法。

examples.text: The public is fascinated by the private lives of public figures.
examples.translationZh: 公众对社会名流的私生活具有浓厚的兴趣。

meaningZh: 计算；估计；打算，计划

examples.text: I will calculate your bill for you.
examples.translationZh: 我帮您计算账单。

examples.text: Can you calculate the content of the tube?
examples.translationZh: 你能计算出试管的容量吗?

examples.text: Scientists have calculated that the world's population will double by the end of the century.
examples.translationZh: 科学家已推算出世界人口在本世纪末将要增加一倍。

meaningZh: 成功；继承；vt. 继承，继任，继位

examples.text: If you work hard you will succeed.
examples.translationZh: 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。

examples.text: We succeeded in repairing the engine.
examples.translationZh: 我们成功地修好了发动机。

examples.text: When the duke dies, his eldest son will succeed to the title.
examples.translationZh: 公爵去世之后，他的长子将继承他的爵位。

meaningZh: 桥；桥牌；鼻梁

examples.text: The bridge is not strong enough to allow the passage of vehicles.
examples.translationZh: 这座桥不够牢固，车辆不能通行。

examples.text: I think I'm lost; I can't find the bridge.
examples.translationZh: 我想我是迷路了，我找不到那座桥了。

examples.text: They are a link to the past and a bridge to the future.
examples.translationZh: 它们是联系过去的纽带，又是通向未来的桥梁。

meaningZh: （织物、毛皮等的）手感；手柄；举动

examples.text: I was impressed by her handling of the affair.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得她对此事的处理很了不起。

examples.text: The speaker was roughly handled by the mob.
examples.translationZh: 演说者受到暴民的粗暴对待。

examples.text: He's not a very good teacher---he doesn't know how to handle children.
examples.translationZh: 他不是一个好的老师---他不懂得如何对待孩子。

meaningZh: 精神的；心灵的；高尚的，崇高的

examples.text: Many young people could not resist the spiritual pollution.
examples.translationZh: 很多年轻人不能抵制精神污染。

examples.text: I care more about the spiritual life than the substantial life.
examples.translationZh: 和物质生活相比，我更注重精神生活。

examples.text: The monks were arraigned for not teaching things spiritual.
examples.translationZh: 修道士们因不讲授有关心灵的道理而受到指责。

meaningZh: （画等的）背景；底色；背景资料

examples.text: He has a strong political background.
examples.translationZh: 他有强大的政治背景。

examples.text: It is wrong to differentiate between people according to their family background.
examples.translationZh: 根据出身不同而区别待人是不对的。

examples.text: With my working-class background I feel like a fish out of water among these high-society people.
examples.translationZh: 我出身于工人阶级,在上流社会中感到很不自在。

meaningZh: 有争议的，引起争议的，被争论的；好争论的

examples.text: We tried to stay away from controversial topics at the dinner party.
examples.translationZh: 晚宴上我们尽力避免一些有争议的话题。

examples.text: This is a controversial question.
examples.translationZh: 这是个引起争论的问题。

meaningZh: 聪明的，有智慧的；博学的，博识的；明白的

examples.text: Learned men are not necessarily wise.
examples.translationZh: 博学者未必都是聪明的。

examples.text: To a wise person, time is like a diamond.
examples.translationZh: 时间对一个有智慧的人而言，就如钻石般珍贵。

examples.text: A wise general can gain the upper hand in any battle.
examples.translationZh: 一位有智慧的将军在任何战争中都能占上风。

meaningZh: 阵雨；淋浴；淋浴器

examples.text: She is taking a shower.
examples.translationZh: 她正在洗淋浴。

examples.text: Scattered showers are expected this afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 预料今天下午有零星阵雨。

examples.text: The weatherman predict shower this afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 气象预告员说,今天下午有阵雨。

meaningZh: 超级市场；自动售货商店

examples.text: A variety of food is sold at a supermarket.
examples.translationZh: 超级市场各式各样的食物均有出售。

examples.text: The supermarket is just in the corner of the street.
examples.translationZh: 超市就在街角。

examples.text: Another supermarket opened last week.
examples.translationZh: 上星期又有一家超级市场开张了。

meaningZh: 词典，字典；[自]代码字典

examples.text: That is not, properly speaking, a dictionary but a grammar book.
examples.translationZh: 严格地说，那不是一本字典，而是一本语法书。

examples.text: He is, as it were, a walking dictionary.
examples.translationZh: 他可说是个活字典。

examples.text: That dictionary belongs to me.
examples.translationZh: 那本字典是属于我的。

meaningZh: 突破；穿透；重要技术成就

examples.text: It is a major technological breakthrough.
examples.translationZh: 这是一次重要的技术突破。

examples.text: He finally has a breakthrough in his creation.
examples.translationZh: 他终于在创作上有了突破。

examples.text: The scientists strive for a breakthrough in cancer research.
examples.translationZh: 科学家们力争在癌症研究方面有个突破。

meaningZh: 不同的，多种多样的；变化多的；形形色色的

examples.text: They are the people from diverse cultures.
examples.translationZh: 他们是些有着不同文化背景的人。

examples.text: Since then，she has played a diverse range of roles.
examples.translationZh: 从那时起,她出演了各种不同的角色。

examples.text: Her interests are very diverse.
examples.translationZh: 她的兴趣非常广泛。

meaningZh: 线条；排；行列

examples.text: One line cuts another at right angles.
examples.translationZh: 一条线与另一条线成直角相交。

examples.text: The ball went over the line.
examples.translationZh: 球越线出界了。

examples.text: The line of the two countries is too vague.
examples.translationZh: 这两个国家的界线太模糊了。

meaningZh: 拳击；装箱；做箱（或盒）的材料

examples.text: I enjoyed all the sports with the exception of boxing.
examples.translationZh: 除了拳击，我喜欢所有的运动。

examples.text: He was done out of the right of boxing.
examples.translationZh: 他被取消了拳击比赛资格。

meaningZh: 进步；前进；[生物学]进化

examples.text: The student is showing rapid progress in his studies.
examples.translationZh: 这个学生学习上进步很快。

examples.text: Physics has made enormous progress in this century.
examples.translationZh: 本世纪物理学的发展突飞猛进。

examples.text: They made slow progress towards the mountaintop.
examples.translationZh: 他们向山顶缓慢地前进。

meaningZh: 狗；蹩脚货；丑女人

examples.text: The dog kept a vigilant guard over the house.
examples.translationZh: 这只狗警惕地守护着这所房屋。

examples.text: He is really a lucky dog.
examples.translationZh: 他真是个幸运的家伙。

examples.text: You stole my watch, you dog.
examples.translationZh: 你偷了我的手表，你这个卑鄙小人

meaningZh: 地方的；当地的，本地的；局部的

examples.text: This is a local problem, not a nation-wide one.
examples.translationZh: 这是地方性的问题，而非全国性的问题。

examples.text: I suggest that he put an advertisement in the local paper.
examples.translationZh: 我建议他在当地的报纸上登条广告。

examples.text: He provided local delicacies for his guests' meal.
examples.translationZh: 他用当地的美味佳肴来招待客人。

meaningZh: 日记，日志；日记簿

examples.text: His father ordered that he (should) keep a diary in English.
examples.translationZh: 他的父亲规定他要用英文写日记。

examples.text: I keep a diary every day.
examples.translationZh: 我每天记日记。

examples.text: There is no further reference to him in her diary.
examples.translationZh: 她的日记中没有进一步提到他。

meaningZh: 野兽；人面兽心的人；讨厌的人（或事物）

examples.text: The lion is called the king of beasts.
examples.translationZh: 狮子号称百兽之王。

examples.text: The hunters blocked up the hole of the beast.
examples.translationZh: 猎人堵住了兽穴。

examples.text: He put the beast out and headed home.
examples.translationZh: 他把这只畜牲丢下，掉头就回家。

meaningZh: 内疚的；有罪的

examples.text: The court found him guilty.
examples.translationZh: 法官判他有罪。

examples.text: The man was proved guilty of murder.
examples.translationZh: 这个男子被证实犯了杀人罪。

examples.text: A man is accounted innocent until he is proven guilty.
examples.translationZh: 一个人未被证明有罪前，被视为是清白的。

meaningZh: 比赛；游戏；戏剧

examples.text: Once he is free, he will play computer games.
examples.translationZh: 只要他有空,他就玩电脑游戏。

examples.text: The boy rushed his homework through and went out to play.
examples.translationZh: 那男孩急急忙忙把作业做好,出外玩去了。

examples.text: On Saturday France plays Rugby against Wales.
examples.translationZh: 星期六，法国队和威尔士队比赛橄榄球。

meaningZh: 晚饭，晚餐；夜点心；晚餐会

examples.text: He had some rice for supper.
examples.translationZh: 晚饭时他吃了一些米饭。

examples.text: I came here immediately after having my supper.
examples.translationZh: 我一吃完晚饭就来这里了。

examples.text: Have you had your supper?
examples.translationZh: 你吃过晚饭了吗？

meaningZh: 关闭；合上；打烊

examples.text: Please shut the door behind you.
examples.translationZh: 请关上你身后的门。

examples.text: The office will shut down for christmas.
examples.translationZh: 圣诞节办公室将关闭。

examples.text: He decided to shut down the shop.
examples.translationZh: 他决定关闭这家商店。

meaningZh: 寓所，住房；房间；公寓楼

examples.text: I have an apartment in downtown Manhattan.
examples.translationZh: 我在曼哈顿中心区有一套住房。

examples.text: We are fascinated by the delicate interior design of the apartment.
examples.translationZh: 我们被这所公寓的精致的室内装潢设计吸引。

meaningZh: 加，增加，附加；[数]加法；增加的人或事物

examples.text: In addition to a diet, she pursues various exercises on TV.
examples.translationZh: 节食以外她还随电视做体操。

examples.text: In addition to an album, I gave him a pen and a pencil.
examples.translationZh: 除了一本照相簿外，我还给了他一支钢笔和一支铅笔。

examples.text: They eat a great deal of fruit in addition.
examples.translationZh: 他们还吃大量的水果。

meaningZh: （由底片印出的）照片；印刷字体；印痕

examples.text: How many copies shall we print from the negative?
examples.translationZh: 用这张底片我们要印多少张相片?

examples.text: His second book is already in print.
examples.translationZh: 他的第二本书已出版。

examples.text: He founded his own press to print them.
examples.translationZh: 他自己成立印刷厂出版这些书。

meaningZh: 旅行，观光；巡回演出；任职期

examples.text: They're going on a world tour.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在环球旅行。

examples.text: We are going on a tour of the city this afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 我们今天下午要到城里去观光。

examples.text: He went on a speaking tour of the United States.
examples.translationZh: 他去美国作巡回演讲。

meaningZh: 炸弹；彻底的失败；[橄榄球] 长传

examples.text: The bomb exploded in a twinkling.
examples.translationZh: 炸弹一会儿就爆炸了。

examples.text: The terrorists planted a bomb in the post office.
examples.translationZh: 恐怖分子在邮局安放了一枚炸弹。
