examples.text: The city was bombed by the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这座城市被敌人炸毁了。

meaningZh: 健康状况；卫生；保健

examples.text: Smoking is harmful to your health.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。

examples.text: Fresh air and exercise are good for the health.
examples.translationZh: 新鲜空气和运动有益于健康。

examples.text: It is generally believed that health is above wealth.
examples.translationZh: 一般人都相信健康重于财富。

meaningZh: 外貌，外观；出现，露面；[哲]现象

examples.text: The journal makes its appearance once two months.
examples.translationZh: 这本刊物两个月出版一次。

examples.text: The appearance of Internet marked the beginning of the age of information.
examples.translationZh: 因特网的出现标志着信息时代的开始。

examples.text: I don't want to go to the party but I'd better put in an appearance, I suppose.
examples.translationZh: 我不想参加那个聚会，可是我最好还是要露一下面。

meaningZh: 职业，工作；占有，占领；（土地、房屋、建筑等的）使用

examples.text: I haven't entered your name and occupation yet.
examples.translationZh: 我尚未记下你的名字和职业。

examples.text: Please state your name, age and occupation.
examples.translationZh: 请说明姓名、年龄和职业。

examples.text: He is a merchant in occupation.
examples.translationZh: 他的职业是经商。

meaningZh: 道路；方法；方向

examples.text: I am on my way to the grocery store.
examples.translationZh: 我正在去杂货店的路上。

examples.text: We lost the way in the dark.
examples.translationZh: 我们在黑夜中迷路了。

examples.text: He asked me the way to London.
examples.translationZh: 他问我去伦敦的路。

meaningZh: 装备，配备；使具备，使有准备

examples.text: They can't afford to equip their army.
examples.translationZh: 他们无力装备自己的军队。

examples.text: We must equip the army for the modern war.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须装备军队打现代化战争。

examples.text: He is equipped with much experience in teaching.
examples.translationZh: 他具有丰富的教学经验。

meaningZh: 健身房；体育馆；室内健身操

examples.text: The basketball players are working out at the gym.
examples.translationZh: 篮球运动员们正在体育馆进行训练。

examples.text: We go to play badminton in the nearest gym every Sunday.
examples.translationZh: 每个星期天我们都去最近的体育馆打羽毛球。

examples.text: He often went to the gym to harden his muscles.
examples.translationZh: 他过去常到健身房锻炼肌肉。

meaningZh: 朋友，友人；资助者；助手

examples.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.translationZh: 患难之交才是真朋友。

examples.text: My friend invited me to dine out.
examples.translationZh: 我的朋友邀请我出去吃饭。

examples.text: I made friends with Bill in high school.
examples.translationZh: 我和比尔在高中就成为朋友。

meaningZh: 平行的；相同的，类似的；[电]并联的

examples.text: In the parallel world, there might be an answer for everything.
examples.translationZh: 在平行世界里,似乎有一切的答案。

examples.text: Parallel processing is the most important peculiarity in this design.
examples.translationZh: 其中,并行化的设计理念是该设计的最大特点。

examples.text: The railway lines run parallel to the road.
examples.translationZh: 铁路线和那条道路平行。

meaningZh: 电话；听筒；（发声或使用声音的）工具

examples.text: What's your phone number?
examples.translationZh: 你的电话号码是多少？

examples.text: I nearly smashed the phone in fury.
examples.translationZh: 盛怒之下，我差点把电话机砸碎。

examples.text: She picked up the phone but didn't speak.
examples.translationZh: 她拿起话筒,但并没有说话。

meaningZh: 咬；叮；n. 咬

examples.text: Their dog bit a hole in my trousers.
examples.translationZh: 他们的狗把我的裤子咬了个窟窿。

examples.text: They are badly bitten by mosquitoes.
examples.translationZh: 他们被蚊子叮得很厉害。

examples.text: He was taken to the hospital to be treated for snake bite.
examples.translationZh: 他因遭蛇咬而被送到医院治疗。

meaningZh: 基础；主要成分；基准，基本原则

examples.text: His research formed the basis of his new book.
examples.translationZh: 他的研究成果是他这本新书的基础。

examples.text: We drew this conclusion on the basis of experiments.
examples.translationZh: 我们是在试验的基础上得出这个结论的。

examples.text: What basis do you have for saying that?
examples.translationZh: 你那样说有什么根据啊?

meaningZh: 理发师；理发店(= barber's shop)；vt. 为…理发剃须

examples.text: The barber thinned out my thick hair.
examples.translationZh: 理发师把我浓密的头发削薄了一些。

examples.text: The barber cut his hair very short.
examples.translationZh: 理发师把他的头发剪得很短。

examples.text: His father apprenticed him to a barber.
examples.translationZh: 他父亲送他去当理发师的徒弟。

meaningZh: （总称）牛，牲口；畜生；无价值的人

examples.text: There is much forage for the cattle.
examples.translationZh: 那儿有很多喂牛的饲料。

examples.text: There are many herds of cattle in the meadow.
examples.translationZh: 牧场上有许多牛群。

examples.text: Clover can be grown as food for cattle.
examples.translationZh: 苜蓿可以用作牛饲料。

meaningZh: [计算机]主机；主人，东道主；节目主持人

examples.text: At the end of the party, we thanked our host and went back home.
examples.translationZh: 宴会结束时,我们谢了主人后便回家去了。

examples.text: He was the host for a TV talk show.
examples.translationZh: 他是一名电视脱口秀的主持人。

examples.text: Which country will be the host country for the next Olympic Games?
examples.translationZh: 哪个国家将是下届奥运会的主办国？

meaningZh: 圆形的；弧形的；丰满的，肥胖的

examples.text: He put the apples on a round plate.
examples.translationZh: 他把苹果放在一个圆盘子里。

examples.text: The earth is round because of gravity.
examples.translationZh: 地球是由于重力而成为球形的。

examples.text: Eustacia slowly drew up her sleeve and disclosed her round white arm.
examples.translationZh: 游苔莎慢慢地把衣袖卷起，把她那只圆润丰满的白胳膊露出来了。

meaningZh: 空白的；空的，无信息的，未填写的；茫然的

examples.text: Give me a blank sheet of paper, please.
examples.translationZh: 请给我一张空白的纸。

examples.text: Many blank spaces are still left in the suburbs.
examples.translationZh: 郊区仍留有许多空地。

examples.text: Her explanations were met with blank incomprehension.
examples.translationZh: 大家对她的解释茫然不解。

meaningZh: 瓶子；一瓶（的量）；（婴儿）奶瓶

examples.text: Why don't we crack open a bottle of champagne to celebrate?
examples.translationZh: 我们何不开瓶香槟酒庆祝一下呢？

examples.text: Try not to bottle up your emotions.
examples.translationZh: 尽量不要压抑自己的情感。

examples.text: Tell us what's worrying you; don't bottle it up!
examples.translationZh: 把心中的烦恼告诉我们,不要把它闷在心里！

meaningZh: 发展，进化；被发展的状态；新生事物，新产品

examples.text: The economic sanctions could not prevent the development of that country.
examples.translationZh: 经济制裁不能阻碍那个国家的发展。

examples.text: The main impediment to development is the country's large population.
examples.translationZh: 发展的主要障碍是这个国家人口太多。

examples.text: The firm pumped money into the development of the new product.
examples.translationZh: 这家企业投入大量资金以开发这种新产品。

meaningZh: 女性的；雌性的；能结果实的

examples.text: The male and female genders are equal.
examples.translationZh: 男性和女性是平等的。

examples.text: All the female workers in this factory got a present on March 8th.
examples.translationZh: 这家工厂的所有女职工在三八节都得到了一份礼物。

examples.text: The male sperm fertilizes the female egg.
examples.translationZh: 雄性的精子使雌性的卵子受精。

meaningZh: 钉子；指甲，趾甲；钉状物

examples.text: He hit the nail into the wall with a hammer.
examples.translationZh: 他用一把锤子把钉子打进墙里去。

examples.text: I found a nail sticking in the tyre.
examples.translationZh: 我发现轮胎上扎着一根钉子。

examples.text: You can try this nail polish on your nails.
examples.translationZh: 您可以在指甲上试试这种指甲油。

meaningZh: 精神，心灵；情绪；勇气

examples.text: He is endued with a spirit of public service.
examples.translationZh: 他富有为公众服务的精神。

examples.text: We need a spirit of enterprise if we are to overcome our difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 如果我们要克服困难，我们就要有进取精神。

examples.text: Now the rat of Panic was gnawing at Byron's spirit.
examples.translationZh: 如今恐慌正象耗子一样在啃啮拜伦的心灵。

meaningZh: 寻找，探寻；追求，谋求；往或朝…而去

examples.text: Tortured by fear, he decided to seek the aid of a psychiatrist.
examples.translationZh: 他终日恐惧不安,决定寻求心理医生的帮助。

examples.text: Many single people are seeking that special someone.
examples.translationZh: 许多单身人士都在追求他们的唯一。

examples.text: Some nations will seek the change of their energy supply sources to reduce emissions, or for other reasons.
examples.translationZh: 为了减少碳排量,或是出于其他原因,一些国家试图改变他们的能源供应来源。

meaningZh: 渐变；渐渐变为（与into连用）；渐渐消逝（与away连用）

examples.text: He is a graduate in medicine.
examples.translationZh: 他是医科毕业生。

examples.text: He is a graduate of Tokyo University.
examples.translationZh: 他是东京大学的毕业生。

examples.text: They graduate 30,000 engineers every year.
examples.translationZh: 每年有3万名工程师从学校毕业。

meaningZh: 不同，相异；不同意，意见相左；争吵

examples.text: They differ widely in their opinions.
examples.translationZh: 他们的意见分歧很大。

examples.text: Our ideologies differ.
examples.translationZh: 我们的思想不同。

examples.text: They differ in size but not in kind.
examples.translationZh: 这些东西的区别只是大小不同而实质一样。

meaningZh: 信，信任；信念，意见；信条

examples.text: It bolstered my belief.
examples.translationZh: 这增强了我的信念。

examples.text: He acted in accordance with his beliefs.
examples.translationZh: 他按照自己的信念行事。

examples.text: His belief of communism is immovable.
examples.translationZh: 他坚定不移地信仰共产主义。

meaningZh: 劝告，忠告；（商业）通知；建议

examples.text: Tell me the reason (why) he refused to listen to my advice.
examples.translationZh: 告诉我为何他拒绝听从我的劝告。

examples.text: He disregarded his doctor's advice.
examples.translationZh: 他无视医生的劝告。

examples.text: I set a high value on his advice.
examples.translationZh: 我认为他的忠告很有价值。

meaningZh: 拼写；导致，意味着；组成（一个词）的字母是…

examples.text: I don't know how to spell your name.
examples.translationZh: 我不会拼写你的名字。

examples.text: Can you spell the word"metropolis"?
examples.translationZh: 你会拼写“metropolis”这个词吗?

examples.text: Her writing is neat, but she can't spell.
examples.translationZh: 她的书写很工整，但是她不会拼写。

meaningZh: [医]药方，处方；处方药；训令，指示

examples.text: The doctor is writing a prescription.
examples.translationZh: 医生正在开处方。

examples.text: The doctor dispensed a prescription to his patient.
examples.translationZh: 医生开处方给病人配药。

examples.text: The prescription of drugs is a doctor's responsibility.
examples.translationZh: 开药方是医生的职责。

meaningZh: 衣服；服装；[航]帆装

examples.text: He discarded his winter clothing.
examples.translationZh: 他把冬天穿的衣服都丢弃了。

examples.text: This clothing sells well to the teenage market.
examples.translationZh: 这种衣服在青少年中间很畅销。

examples.text: Children depend on their parents for food and clothing.
examples.translationZh: 小孩依赖他们的父母供给衣食。

meaningZh: 洗手间；坐便器；梳洗

examples.text: Where is the ladies' toilet?
examples.translationZh: 女厕所在那里？

examples.text: Every flat has its own bathroom and toilet.
examples.translationZh: 每套公寓都带有洗澡间和盥洗室。

examples.text: I must buy some toilet requisites.
examples.translationZh: 我必须买些卫生间必需品。

meaningZh: 偷；悄悄地做，悄悄地走；潜行

examples.text: He was sent into prison for stealing.
examples.translationZh: 他由于偷窃被送入监狱。

examples.text: He stole a glance at the pretty girl across the table.
examples.translationZh: 他偷偷地看了一眼桌子对面那个漂亮的女孩。

examples.text: Despite fine acting by several well-known stars, it was a young newcomer who stole the show.
examples.translationZh: 尽管几位名角演出都很出色,却未曾想竟让一名新秀抢尽风头。

meaningZh: 形状，形式；外形；方式

examples.text: Playing basketball is one form of physical exercise.
examples.translationZh: 打篮球是体育活动的一种形式。

examples.text: The form of a building grows out of its use.
examples.translationZh: 建筑物的形式取决于建筑物的用途。

examples.text: It has the irregular form of an ink blot.
examples.translationZh: 它具有不规则的水渍形状。

meaningZh: 安全的；保险的，肯定的；无损的

examples.text: There is no safe landing on that coast.
examples.translationZh: 那一带海岸没有安全的登陆处。

examples.text: It is not safe to drive like that, you must slow down.
examples.translationZh: 那样开车是不安全的,你必须减速。

examples.text: The rescuers brought the climbers back safe and sound.
examples.translationZh: 救援人员把登山的人都安然无恙地救了回来。

meaningZh: 使锐利；使敏捷；加重

examples.text: My pencil is blunt, could you lend me a knife to sharpen it?
examples.translationZh: 我的铅笔钝了，你能借我把刀子削一削吗？

examples.text: Generations of urban living sharpened their wits.
examples.translationZh: 世代居住在城市里使他们磨练了才智。

examples.text: Strikes will sharpen the country's dilemma.
examples.translationZh: 罢工将加剧这个国家的困境。

meaningZh: 化学；物质的化学组成（或性质），化学作用（现象）；（常指有强烈性吸引力的）两人间的关系

examples.text: I prefer chemistry to physics.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢化学甚于物理。

examples.text: We have three periods of chemistry a week.
examples.translationZh: 我们一星期三节化学课。

examples.text: No one can cope with him in Chemistry.
examples.translationZh: 在化学方面，谁也比不上他。

meaningZh: 发生；碰巧；出现

examples.text: The accident happened at six o'clock.
examples.translationZh: 事故发生在六点钟。

examples.text: It is impossible to anticipate when it will happen.
examples.translationZh: 不可能预料这事何时发生。

examples.text: I happened to see her yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我昨天碰巧见到她。

meaningZh: 猫；猫科动物；狠毒的女人

examples.text: A cat mews.
examples.translationZh: 猫喵喵叫。

examples.text: The cat lapped up the milk.
examples.translationZh: 猫舔食牛奶。

examples.text: The cat is playing with a live mouse.
examples.translationZh: 猫在戏弄那只活老鼠。

meaningZh: 跳，反弹；急促地动；拒付，退票

examples.text: The ball hit the wall and bounced off it.
examples.translationZh: 球打在墙上又反弹回来。

examples.text: She's had many misfortunes in her life but she always bounces back.
examples.translationZh: 她一生中经历过许多挫折，然而总是能重新振作起来。

examples.text: He is young enough to bounce back from this disappointment.
examples.translationZh: 他很年轻，能够从这次挫折中恢复过来。

meaningZh: 明确的，清楚的；直言的；详述的

examples.text: They gave explicit reasons for leaving.
examples.translationZh: 他们明确地说出了离开的原因。

examples.text: A man can try his best to perfect and improve himself only if he has strong desires and explicit goal.
examples.translationZh: 只有怀着强烈的欲望,有着明确的目标,一个人才能竭尽全力去完善自我,提升自我。

examples.text: He has an explicit understanding of this.
examples.translationZh: 他对这个了解得很清晰。

meaningZh: 频繁的，时常发生的，常见的；（脉搏等）急促的，快的；vt. 常到，光顾，常与…交往

examples.text: My girlfriend writes frequent letters to me.
examples.translationZh: 我的女朋友频繁地给我写信。

examples.text: Traffic accidents are alarmingly frequent of late.
examples.translationZh: 近来交通事故频繁得吓人。

examples.text: He is a frequent visitor to our house.
examples.translationZh: 他是我们家的常客。

meaningZh: 一步；长度单位；步幅，步调

examples.text: She works so fast that I can't keep pace with her.
examples.translationZh: 她工作得很快，我跟不上她的速度。

examples.text: When John found he was going to be late, he stepped up his pace.
examples.translationZh: 约翰发现要迟到了, 就加大步伐。

examples.text: They pace in sleek chivalric certainty.
examples.translationZh: 自信的步态骑士般孔武而自如。

meaningZh: 化学家；药剂师；药商

examples.text: Do you want anything from the chemist?
examples.translationZh: 你想向化学家要些什么吗？

examples.text: The famous chemist won the Nobel Prize.
examples.translationZh: 那个著名的化学家赢得了诺贝尔奖。

examples.text: The chemist is preparing a medicine.
examples.translationZh: 药剂师正在配药。

meaningZh: 新闻工作者，新闻记者；记日志者

examples.text: This journalist's works are popular among young people.
examples.translationZh: 这位新闻记者的著作很受年轻人的欢迎。

examples.text: The journalist was probing into several financial scandals.
examples.translationZh: 那记者正在调查几起财务丑闻。

examples.text: He is not so much a journalist as a writer.
examples.translationZh: 与其说他是个新闻工作者, 不如说他是个作家。

meaningZh: 年少的,较年幼的；资历较浅的,地位较低的；年少者

examples.text: I started the job as a junior secretary.
examples.translationZh: 刚开始这份工作时，我是初级秘书。

examples.text: The president was so young that he was junior to some of his employees.
examples.translationZh: 总裁的年龄甚至是比他的一些雇员还小。

examples.text: He likes to lord it over the junior staff.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢对下级职员逞威风。

meaningZh: 理论的；推想的，假设的；空论的

examples.text: These findings have both theoretical and practical applications.
examples.translationZh: 这些发现具有理论和实际的应用。

examples.text: Theoretical study must be closely integrated with practice.
examples.translationZh: 理论学习要紧密结合实际。

examples.text: It's a theoretical possibility, but I don't suppose it will happen.
examples.translationZh: 这是一种理论上的可能性，但我认为这种情况不会发生。

meaningZh: 立刻，马上；一会儿，不久；快

examples.text: I'll be back soon.
examples.translationZh: 我马上回来。

examples.text: She will be here sooner than you expect.
examples.translationZh: 她很快就到，比你预料的要早。

examples.text: He left as soon as he heard the news.
examples.translationZh: 他一听到这事儿就走了。

meaningZh: 信息，数据；通知；消息

examples.text: They were unable to provide much information.
examples.translationZh: 他们不能提供很多信息。

examples.text: We are able to get the information we need from the Internet.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以从网上得到我们需要的信息。

examples.text: The police haven't got enough information to catch the criminal.
examples.translationZh: 警方还未得到可捉拿这个罪犯的足够情报。

meaningZh: 脉搏；[无线电]（电磁波等）脉动；活力

examples.text: His pulse is not very regular.
examples.translationZh: 他的脉搏不很规则。

examples.text: The excitement quickened my pulse.
examples.translationZh: 激动使我的心跳加快。

examples.text: I could feel a fluttering pulse.
examples.translationZh: 我感到脉搏跳动。

meaningZh: 兼职的；部分时间的；adv. 兼职地

examples.text: In American, seven out of ten mothers have paid jobs, either full time or part time. These include more than half of women with babies or young children.
examples.translationZh: 在美国，有十分之七的妈妈有全职或兼职的带薪工作，其中超过一半妇女有婴儿或很小的小孩。

examples.text: But he said the part-time soldiers, who will serve about three weeks at a time, will not be directly involved in detaining people trying to cross the border illegally.
examples.translationZh: 但他说，兼职的士兵将会连续工作三周，但是不会直接牵涉到阻止那些尝试非法进入边境的人们。

meaningZh: 提出；介绍；引进

examples.text: She introduced me to her friend.
examples.translationZh: 她把我介绍给她的朋友。

examples.text: Excuse me, may I take the opportunity to introduce myself as an interpreter?
examples.translationZh: 作为译员,我可以冒昧自我介绍一下吗?

examples.text: Introduce new ideas into a business.
examples.translationZh: 引进新观念于一事业。

meaningZh: 部分；零件；参加

examples.text: This piece of glass seems to be part of a lamp.
examples.translationZh: 这片玻璃似乎是一盏灯的一部分。

examples.text: This is one of the nicest parts of San Francisco.
examples.translationZh: 这是旧金山最好的地方之一。

examples.text: He liked the feeling of being part of the team.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢成为这个队伍的一部分。

meaningZh: 裁判员；证明人；公断人

examples.text: The referee whistled and the game began.
examples.translationZh: 裁判哨子一响，比赛开始了。

examples.text: Does the referee have the power to send him off the field?
examples.translationZh: 裁判员有权勒令他退场吗?

examples.text: He was booked by the referee for foul play.
examples.translationZh: 他因为动作犯规而被裁判记下姓名。

meaningZh: 笑，笑声；〈古〉好笑的事；〈美俚〉力量悬殊得可笑的体育比赛

examples.text: We couldn't withhold our laughter.
examples.translationZh: 我们忍不住大笑起来。

examples.text: He gave me a fright by bursting into a sudden laughter.
examples.translationZh: 他突然大笑起来，吓了我一跳。

examples.text: Her funny costume caused much mirthful laughter among the guests.
examples.translationZh: 她那滑稽的服装引得客人哄堂大笑。

meaningZh: 占领；使用，住在…；使从事，使忙碌

examples.text: Is that seat occupied?
examples.translationZh: 那个座位有人吗？

examples.text: Reading occupies most of my free time.
examples.translationZh: 阅读占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

examples.text: We occupy the farm and raise a lot of poultry.
examples.translationZh: 我们拥有这个农场并养着许多家禽。

meaningZh: 不能的，不会的；无能力的，不熟练的；不能胜任的

examples.text: He is an able person, nothing is unable to him.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个能人，对他没有不能的事。

examples.text: Despite our great advances in microbiology, we are still unable to differentiate these organisms that cause the different infections.
examples.translationZh: 不管我们的在微生物学的大进展，我们仍然是不能的区分引起不同的感染的这些有机体。

meaningZh: 强调；重音；压力

examples.text: Stress can be extremely damaging to your health.
examples.translationZh: 压力对你的健康会是非常有害的。

examples.text: The stress on setting an example is particularly necessary at present.
examples.translationZh: 现在，强调以身作则这个问题很必要。

examples.text: Which syllable does the stress of this word fall on?
examples.translationZh: 这个单词的重音是在哪个音节上?

meaningZh: 令人钦佩的；极好的，绝妙的；值得赞扬的

examples.text: His bravery is admirable.
examples.translationZh: 他的勇气令人钦佩。

examples.text: She showed admirable self-control.
examples.translationZh: 她表现出令人钦佩的自我控制。

examples.text: This essay is admirable in all respects.
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章在各方面都很值得欣赏。

meaningZh: 不利，劣势，短处；损失

examples.text: The situation put us at a serious disadvantage.
examples.translationZh: 形势使我们处于非常不利的地位。

examples.text: If you don't speak good English, you'll be at a big disadvantage when you try to get a job.
examples.translationZh: 你要是英语讲得不好，找工作时就会处于非常不利的地位。

examples.text: The system puts the firm at a disadvantage because of its overmuch manpower.
examples.translationZh: 由于过剩的人力，这一体制使公司处境不利。

meaningZh: 瞄准；对准；踢向

examples.text: What is your aim in life?
examples.translationZh: 你的生活目标是什么？

examples.text: The aim of the policy is the preservation of peace.
examples.translationZh: 这一政策旨在维护和平。

examples.text: Take careful aim at the target before firing.
examples.translationZh: 开火之前仔细瞄准目标。

meaningZh: 报纸，报；旧报纸；新闻纸

examples.text: He unfurled the newspaper and began to read.
examples.translationZh: 他展开报纸开始阅读。

examples.text: I learned this news from the newspaper.
examples.translationZh: 我从报纸上得知这个消息。

examples.text: Only when he read the newspaper did he know the story.
examples.translationZh: 他看了报纸后才知道那则报导。

meaningZh: 羽毛球；羽毛球运动

examples.text: I like to play badminton in my spare time.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢在闲暇时打羽毛球。

examples.text: He went to the badminton club at times during his school days.
examples.translationZh: 他上学时有时到羽毛球俱乐部去。

examples.text: He's in his element when playing badminton.
examples.translationZh: 他打起羽毛球来真是得心应手。

meaningZh: 使摆脱，解除，免除

examples.text: We will be glad to get rid of him.
examples.translationZh: 摆脱他，我们将很高兴。

examples.text: You must rid yourself of this melancholy mood.
examples.translationZh: 你一定要摆脱这种忧愁情绪。

examples.text: We must try every way to rid ourselves of these debts.
examples.translationZh: 我们要想尽一切办法来摆脱这些债务。

meaningZh: 叫喊，大声叫；叫喊着说；n. 叫喊，大声叫

examples.text: Don't yell at me!
examples.translationZh: 别对我大喊大叫！

examples.text: You don't have to yell; I can hear you.
examples.translationZh: 你用不著喊，我听得见。

examples.text: She yelled out at her mischievous child.
examples.translationZh: 她对她淘气的孩子大喊大叫。

meaningZh: 面粉；vt. 撒上粉

examples.text: Bread is chiefly made of flour.
examples.translationZh: 面包主要是由面粉做成的。

examples.text: He used a miller to mill the grain into flour.
examples.translationZh: 他用碾磨机把谷物磨成面粉。

examples.text: In the flour mill, wheat grains are powdered.
examples.translationZh: 麦粒在磨坊被磨成粉末。

meaningZh: 保持；保留；遵守

examples.text: He would keep in touch with us wherever he was.
examples.translationZh: 他无论在什么地方,总是与我们保持联系。

examples.text: Here's a five-pound note-- you can keep the change.
examples.translationZh: 这是五镑的钞票－－零钱不用找了。

examples.text: Progress is slow but we keep battling on.
examples.translationZh: 进展虽慢

meaningZh: 感觉，知觉，情绪；感情；气氛

examples.text: I have a feeling that we are being followed.
examples.translationZh: 我有种感觉我们正被人跟踪。

examples.text: The feeling deepened with the passing of the years.
examples.translationZh: 这种感觉一年一年地加深了。

examples.text: He had no movement or feeling below his navel.
examples.translationZh: 肚脐以下没有知觉，也不能活动。

meaningZh: 嫉妒，妒忌；羡慕；vi. 感到妒忌

examples.text: They envy him his good fortune.
examples.translationZh: 他们羡慕他的好运气。

examples.text: I envy her ability to dance in front of a crowd.
examples.translationZh: 她在众人面前所展现的的舞技令我羡慕不已。

examples.text: Don't envy anyone who lives better than you.
examples.translationZh: 不要妒忌比你日子过得好的任何人。

meaningZh: 雨；（热带地区的）雨季，雨天；雨点般降落的东西

examples.text: There will be rain in all parts of the country.
examples.translationZh: 全国各地将有雨。

examples.text: The boys went for a walk despite of the rain.
examples.translationZh: 尽管下雨，孩子们还是去散步。

examples.text: The rain beat against the windows.
examples.translationZh: 雨水拍打在窗户上。

meaningZh: 通知；使活跃，使充满；预示

examples.text: If you see something suspicious, inform the police at once.
examples.translationZh: 你要是看到什么可疑的东西就马上通知警察。

examples.text: I wasn't informed of the decision until it was too late.
examples.translationZh: 等到我得知这项决定时,已经太迟了。

examples.text: The UN Associations work to inform the public about the role the UN plays in global affairs.
examples.translationZh: 联合国协会致力于使公众了解联合国在全球事务中发挥的作用。

meaningZh: 入口，出口；接近，进入；增长

examples.text: This is the only means of access to the building.
examples.translationZh: 这是进入这栋楼的唯一入口。

examples.text: The avalanche cut off the access to the mountain village.
examples.translationZh: 雪崩切断了进入山村的通道。

examples.text: The only access to that building is along the track.
examples.translationZh: 到那座大楼的唯一通道就是沿这条小路走。

meaningZh: 个人计算机；巡逻车(Patrol Car)

examples.text: Maintenance of PC is in my element.
examples.translationZh: 我对电脑的维修保养很在行。

meaningZh: 使惊恐，惊吓；使害怕，使恐惧；把…吓跑

examples.text: You scare them to death with your mouth.
examples.translationZh: 你一开口就能把人吓死。

examples.text: We'll scare her out of telling the police.
examples.translationZh: 我们要把她吓得不敢报警。

examples.text: His threats scared them out of carrying out the plan.
examples.translationZh: 他的威胁迫使他们不敢实行该计划。

meaningZh: 地震；大变动；动乱

examples.text: The earthquake rocked the houses.
examples.translationZh: 地震震动房屋。

examples.text: There has been a dreadful earthquake in Iran.
examples.translationZh: 伊朗发生了一次可怕的地震。

meaningZh: 射手，击球；开枪，发射；企图

examples.text: He gave me a second shot of penicillin.
examples.translationZh: 他又给我打了一针青霉素。

examples.text: Eight-year-old Griffin Stevens made the shot of a lifetime this past weekend.
examples.translationZh: 8岁的格里芬史蒂文斯在本周末创造了一次一生难忘的投篮。

examples.text: In this case, the ever-changing waves are part of our shot.
examples.translationZh: 在本例中,不断变化的波浪也是我们拍摄的一部分内容。

meaningZh: 十年，十年间；十个一组；十年期

examples.text: Prices have risen steadily during the past decade.
examples.translationZh: 在过去十年里，物价一直在上涨。

examples.text: Several decades have elapsed since I graduated from the college.
examples.translationZh: 我大学毕业已数十年了。

examples.text: I believed that this struggle is going to go on and it might well be decided in the next decade.
examples.translationZh: 我相信这一对抗还将会持续下去，并可能在下一个十年中得出结果。

meaningZh: 直的；连续的；直率的

examples.text: Light travels in straight lines.
examples.translationZh: 光是沿直线传播。

examples.text: I want a straight answer to the question.
examples.translationZh: 我想提问和回答都要直截了当。

examples.text: John Wayne was a blunt talker and straight shooter.
examples.translationZh: 约翰·韦恩是一个直言不讳、一针见血的人。

meaningZh: 级别最高的；总的；主要的

examples.text: In USA, NewYork City is the chief seat of commerce.
examples.translationZh: 在美国,纽约是主要的商业中心。

examples.text: What are the chief exports of your country?
examples.translationZh: 你们国家有哪些主要的出口物品？

examples.text: Slow speed is the chief drawback of sea shipment.
examples.translationZh: 海运最大的缺点是速度慢。

meaningZh: 标准，规格；旗，军旗；度量衡标准

examples.text: There is no absolute standard for beauty.
examples.translationZh: 美是没有绝对的标准的。

examples.text: More than 300 watches are not up to standard.
examples.translationZh: 有300多块手表不合质量标准。

examples.text: The government has an official standard for the purity of silver.
examples.translationZh: 政府对于银的纯度定有官方的规格。

meaningZh: 背诵；叙述；列举

examples.text: Can you recite the Ten Commandants?
examples.translationZh: 你能背诵十诫吗？

examples.text: I like to recite his poetical works.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢背诵他的诗。

examples.text: She can recite the whole poem from memory.
examples.translationZh: 她能背诵全诗。

meaningZh: 设备，装备；器材，配件；（工作必需的）知识，素养

examples.text: The government has an interest in importing scientific equipment.
examples.translationZh: 政府对引进科学设备非常感兴趣。

examples.text: We should make a better use of the existing equipment.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该更好地利用现有设备。

examples.text: The equipment must be bought from a supplier approved by the company.
examples.translationZh: 设备必须从公司认可的供应商那里购买。

meaningZh: 属于；是…的成员；应被放在

examples.text: The daffodil belongs to the genus Narcissus.
examples.translationZh: 黄水仙是水仙属植物。

examples.text: Those documents belong with the sale report.
examples.translationZh: 那些文件归入销售报告。

examples.text: These boots belong in the closet.
examples.translationZh: 这些靴子应搁在壁橱里。

meaningZh: 地下室；[建]基底，底部

examples.text: Dam Monitoring Dam monitoring at a mountain water reservoir during the basement stablization.
examples.translationZh: 大坝监测水库大坝监测在根基稳定期间。

examples.text: The dampness in the basement damaged his books.
examples.translationZh: 地下室的潮湿将他的书损坏了。

meaningZh: 天空；气氛；空运

examples.text: The fresh air in the morning made him feel glad.
examples.translationZh: 早晨的新鲜空气使他觉得愉快。

examples.text: There is a bird flying through the air.
examples.translationZh: 一只小鸟从天空飞过。

examples.text: The archers sent their shafts through the air.
examples.translationZh: 弓箭手向空中射出利箭。

meaningZh: 要求；需要；想要

examples.text: The director required that we should work all night.
examples.translationZh: 主任要求我们通宵工作。

examples.text: We must not propagate one method and require all localities to adopt it.
examples.translationZh: 我们在宣传上不要只讲一种办法，要求各地都照着去做。

examples.text: Please call if you require assistance.
examples.translationZh: 如果需要帮忙，请打电话。

meaningZh: 注意，注意力；照料，关怀；殷勤

examples.text: She soon becomes the centre of attention.
examples.translationZh: 她很快成为大家注意的人物。

examples.text: You should focus your attention on your work.
examples.translationZh: 你应该把注意力放到工作上。

examples.text: She gave her aging parents much attention.
examples.translationZh: 她悉心照料年迈的双亲。

meaningZh: 可移动的；行动自如的；易变的

examples.text: Additionally, consumers continue to embrace mobile personal devices.
examples.translationZh: 此外,消费者接受移动个人设备的热情依然不减。

examples.text: He had a mobile, expressive, animated face.
examples.translationZh: 他有一张多变的，富于表情的，生动活泼的脸。

examples.text: He has a broken leg and isn't very mobile.
examples.translationZh: 他的腿摔伤了,活动不便。

meaningZh: 侵略的，侵犯的，攻势的；（美）有进取心的，积极行动的；有进取心的，有闯劲的

examples.text: He has an aggressive manner.
examples.translationZh: 他的态度咄咄逼人。

examples.text: His style of argument in meetings is not so much aggressive as pertinacious.
examples.translationZh: 他在会议上的辩论态度并非锋芒逼人而是坚持己见。

examples.text: Red fire ants are very aggressive and readily attack anything that disturb them.
examples.translationZh: 红火蚁攻击性强,容易攻击任何干扰它们的生物。

meaningZh: 惊恐；警报；闹铃

examples.text: The proceedings were interrupted by the fire alarm.
examples.translationZh: 会议的进程被火灾警报打断了。

examples.text: The instant they heard the alarm, they fell in for action.
examples.translationZh: 他们一听到警报，就立即集合准备战斗。

examples.text: The smoke triggered off the alarm.
examples.translationZh: 这些烟把警报器触响了。

meaningZh: 总计的（金额等）；全部的；完全的

examples.text: The total cost will be 126 dollars.
examples.translationZh: 总的费用要126美元。

examples.text: You can choose four out of the total number.
examples.translationZh: 你可以从全部数目中选出四个。

examples.text: A dingle monthly total is posted to Accounts Receivable and Fees Earned in the general ledger.
examples.translationZh: 全体的小峡谷月刊被寄到帐户应收帐款和费用在一般的分类帐中赚。

meaningZh: 心，精神，心力，知，智力，智慧；心胸，头脑，人；愿望，目的，意向，意志，决心，见解，意见

examples.text: He is ninety years old,but his mind is sharp.
examples.translationZh: 他虽然90岁了,但头脑还很灵活。

examples.text: Her death had an unbalancing effect on Joe's mind.
examples.translationZh: 她一死,乔在精神上打击很大。

examples.text: I tried to fix the date in my mind.
examples.translationZh: 我试着把那个日期牢记在心。

meaningZh: 下巴；颌；唠叨

examples.text: A strong square jaw is a sign of firm character.
examples.translationZh: 强健的方颚是性格坚定的象征。

examples.text: He fell from a ladder, and broke his jaw bone.
examples.translationZh: 他从梯子上掉了下来，摔伤了颌骨。

examples.text: Give him a sock on the jaw!
examples.translationZh: 给他下巴上来一拳！

meaningZh: 伙伴；同伙；同伴

examples.text: He has a competent partner who always organizes everything well for him.
examples.translationZh: 他有个很能干的伙伴,总是替他把一切弄得井井有条。

examples.text: Will you be my partner in the next dance?
examples.translationZh: 下一支曲子时可否请你跟我一起跳舞?

examples.text: I am so lucky to have a partner like you to enjoy the beauty of life together.
examples.translationZh: 我真幸运,能拥有你这样的伴侣陪我一起享受生命中的美好。

meaningZh: （外）孙女

examples.text: His granddaughter is very pretty.
examples.translationZh: 他的孙女很漂亮。

examples.text: The couple has one daughter and one granddaughter.
examples.translationZh: 这对夫妇有一个女儿和一个外孙女。

meaningZh: 尊重；尊敬；关心

examples.text: All students should respect their teachers.
examples.translationZh: 凡是学生就应当尊敬老师。

examples.text: I respected their moral standards.
examples.translationZh: 我尊重他们的道德标准。

examples.text: I respect him as a writer and as a man.
examples.translationZh: 我尊重他这位作家，也尊重他这个人。

meaningZh: 聘用；录用；雇用

examples.text: We don't want to hire inexperienced worker.
examples.translationZh: 我们不想聘用没有经验的工人。

examples.text: We hired an advertising company for help to sell our product.
examples.translationZh: 我们雇用了一家广告公司来推销我们的产品。

examples.text: Lawyers are men who hire out their words and anger.
examples.translationZh: 律师,是把自己的言辞与愤怒出租于人的人。

meaningZh: 生物，动物；人；创造物

examples.text: This creature lives in the depth of the ocean.
examples.translationZh: 这种生物生活在海洋深处。

examples.text: We can't see microscopic creature with naked eyes.
examples.translationZh: 我们不能用肉眼看到微生物。

examples.text: Pandas are precious creatures.
examples.translationZh: 熊猫是珍贵的动物。

meaningZh: 药物；药剂；麻醉药

examples.text: They were arrested for drug offences.
examples.translationZh: 他们因贩卖毒品罪而被逮捕。

examples.text: The man formed a habit of taking harmful drugs.
examples.translationZh: 这人养成了服用有害麻醉品的习惯。

examples.text: We are testing the efficacy of a new drug.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在测试新药的功效。

meaningZh: （表示位置）在…的后面；支持；（表示顺序）在身后

examples.text: Who is the girl standing behind Richard?
examples.translationZh: 站在理查德后面的那个姑娘是谁？

examples.text: The train was 10 minutes behind time.
examples.translationZh: 火车晚到了十分钟。

examples.text: Britain is behind Japan in developing modern technologies.
examples.translationZh: 在发展现代技术方面英国落后于日本。

meaningZh: 月，月份；一个月的时间

examples.text: He shut himself away for a month to catch up on his academic work.
examples.translationZh: 他与世隔绝一个月，力图把功课赶上去。

examples.text: He's asking 80 a month rent for that flat.
examples.translationZh: 那套房间月租他要80英镑。

examples.text: July is the hottest month in a year in my hometown.
examples.translationZh: 在我的家乡，七月是一年里最热的一月。

meaningZh: 推销员；售货员，店员

examples.text: At first John served as a salesman.
examples.translationZh: 起初约翰是一个销售人员。

examples.text: The salesman's manner was abrupt to the point of rudeness.
examples.translationZh: 这销售人员的态度唐突到粗鲁的程度。

examples.text: The salesman cheated me into buying a fake.
examples.translationZh: 那个推销员骗我买了假货。

meaningZh: 每年的；一年的；[植物]一年生的

examples.text: The firm has an annual turnover of $75 million.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司的年营业额为7500万美元。

examples.text: Now, again, his annual trip to Paris begins.
examples.translationZh: 现在,他一年一度的巴黎之行又开始了。

examples.text: The kind of plant is a hardy annual.
examples.translationZh: 这种植物是耐寒的一年生植物。

meaningZh: 退休金，养老金；膳宿费；生活津贴

examples.text: He's got nothing beyond his state pension.
examples.translationZh: 除了国家发的养老金，他一无所有。

examples.text: He went to the post office to draw his pension.
examples.translationZh: 他到邮局去取退休金了。

examples.text: He had stayed at the pension for a fortnight.
examples.translationZh: 他已在那个小旅馆待了两个星期。

meaningZh: 耳朵；听觉，听力；耳状物

examples.text: She plays the piano entirely by ear.
examples.translationZh: 他演奏钢琴完全凭听觉记忆,不用乐谱。

examples.text: If this news ever reaches her ears, she'll be furious.
examples.translationZh: 这个消息万一传到她的耳朵里，她一定得大发雷霆。

examples.text: He gave the boy's ear a painful tweak.
examples.translationZh: 他用力拧了一下那男孩的耳朵。

meaningZh: 动物，兽，牲畜；家畜，牲口；畜生（一般的人）

examples.text: The jackal is a wild animal in Africa and Asia.
examples.translationZh: 豺狼是产于亚非的一种野生动物。

examples.text: This small animal has a pair of brown eyes.
examples.translationZh: 这只小动物有一双棕色的眼睛。

examples.text: A pig is a domestic animal.
examples.translationZh: 猪是一种家畜。

meaningZh: 罗盘；指南针；圆规

examples.text: Now we begin to draw a circle with compasses.
examples.translationZh: 现在我们开始用圆规画一个圆。

examples.text: I need a compass to draw a circle.
examples.translationZh: 我需要一支圆规画圆。

examples.text: A compass needle points to the north.
examples.translationZh: 罗盘的指针永远指向北方。

meaningZh: 潜在的，有可能的；[语法学]可能语气的，表示可能性的；有能力的

examples.text: These potential effects must be studied carefully.
examples.translationZh: 这些潜在的影响必须仔细地加以研究。

examples.text: Aha! Now that 's something that has potential .
examples.translationZh: 啊！ 现在这好像是很有可能的。

examples.text: She has acting potential, but she needs training.
examples.translationZh: 她有表演潜力，但需要训练。

meaningZh: 翼状的；翼形

examples.text: The insect has alary muscles near its wings.
examples.translationZh: 这种昆虫的翅膀附近有翼肌。

meaningZh: 别的；其他的；（两个中的）另一个

examples.text: They discussed the weather and other topics.
examples.translationZh: 他们讨论了气候和其他的话题。

examples.text: He overtook the other runners on the last lap.
examples.translationZh: 他在最后一圈时超过了其他的赛跑选手。

examples.text: Problems always lead to other problems.
examples.translationZh: 有些问题总是连带着另外的问题。

meaningZh: 收到；接到；接纳

examples.text: Neither John nor I am to receive the award.
examples.translationZh: 约翰和我谁都不会接到奖赏。

examples.text: I was on vacation last week and didn't receive your fax.
examples.translationZh: 上星期我正在度假，没收到你们的传真。

examples.text: He was received as an honoured visitor.
examples.translationZh: 他以贵宾的身分受到款待。

meaningZh: 什么时候；（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时；其时

examples.text: When did that happen?
examples.translationZh: 那件事是什么时候发生的？

examples.text: They stood respectfully when he entered the room.
examples.translationZh: 当他走进房间时，他们都恭恭敬敬地站着。

examples.text: Iron will melt when it is made very hot.
examples.translationZh: 当铁烧得很热时就会熔化的。

meaningZh: 倒回（影片、录音带等）；重绕；n. 重绕

examples.text: Don't forget to rewind that videotape before you return it.
examples.translationZh: 在你归还那卷录影带前，别忘了倒带。

examples.text: I stopped the tape and pressed rewind button.
examples.translationZh: 我停止了磁带播放，按下了倒回键。

meaningZh: 村民；乡村，村庄；群落

examples.text: This village is as beautiful as the fairyland.
examples.translationZh: 这个小村庄美如仙境。

examples.text: There are two main nationalities in our village.
examples.translationZh: 我们村子有两大民族。

meaningZh: 当代的，现代的；同时代的，同属一个时期的；n. 同代人

examples.text: Marlowe was contemporary with Shakespeare.
examples.translationZh: 马洛与莎士比亚是同时代的。

examples.text: He had devoted his whole life to the study of contemporary art.
examples.translationZh: 他把他的一生都献给了当代艺术研究。

examples.text: Thackeray is a contemporary of Dickens.
examples.translationZh: 萨克莱跟狄更斯是同时期的人。

meaningZh: 天文学者，天文学家

examples.text: He wished to be an astronomer when he was a child.
examples.translationZh: 他还是孩子的时候就梦想成为天文学家。

examples.text: But one astronomer has just done precisely that.
examples.translationZh: 但是一位天文学家却恰恰做到了这一点。

meaningZh: 变为，成为；变得；变成

examples.text: Vast areas of land have become desert.
examples.translationZh: 广大的地区均已变成沙漠。

examples.text: You may also find that reading has become more fun than work!
examples.translationZh: 你或许也会发现阅读已经变成是有趣的事，而不是工作。

examples.text: The entrepreneur has become a news figure.
examples.translationZh: 这位企业家变成了新闻人物。

meaningZh: 摇动，摇摆；饶舌；（时势等）推移，变迁

examples.text: Dogs wag their tails when they are pleased.
examples.translationZh: 狗一高兴就摇尾巴。

examples.text: The dog's tail wagged.
examples.translationZh: 那只狗的尾巴摇摆着。

examples.text: They often persuaded me to wag school.
examples.translationZh: 他们常劝我逃学。

meaningZh: 应该（指道义上有责任）；应当（显示所采取行动正确或明智）；可能会

examples.text: I don't think you ought to.
examples.translationZh: 我看你不应该。

examples.text: You ought to be more careful, you know.
examples.translationZh: 你应该小心一点，知道吗？

examples.text: The information ought to be made more accessible.
examples.translationZh: 资料应该明白易懂。

meaningZh: 本国的；土著的；天生的

examples.text: He's emigrated to the USA and gone completely native.
examples.translationZh: 他已移居美国，完全成了美国人。

examples.text: My native language is Chinese.
examples.translationZh: 我的母语是汉语。

examples.text: You can tell from his blue eyes that he isn't native to China.
examples.translationZh: 你可以从他的蓝眼睛看出他不是中国本土的人。

meaningZh: 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许

examples.text: Perhaps this book will prove to be of some use to you in your studies.
examples.translationZh: 也许这本书会对你的研究有用处。

examples.text: As she's been ill perhaps she'll need some help.
examples.translationZh: 她由于生病可能需要些帮助。

examples.text: Perhaps you left your e-dictionary in the dorm.
examples.translationZh: 可能你将电子词典忘在宿舍里了。

meaningZh: 测量，测度；措施；程度

examples.text: The government has taken measures to restrain inflation.
examples.translationZh: 政府已采取措施控制通货膨胀。

examples.text: The standard kilogram is maintained as a measure of mass.
examples.translationZh: 标准的千克是测量质量的量度

examples.text: I want the suit made to his own measure.
examples.translationZh: 我想要这套西装照他自己的尺寸做。

meaningZh: 懒惰的；没精打采的；慢吞吞的

examples.text: Her lazy husband is a millstone round her neck.
examples.translationZh: 她的懒丈夫成了她的一个包袱。

examples.text: He is so lazy; he could do with a good kick up the rear.
examples.translationZh: 他这个人太懒惰，真想在他屁股上踢一脚。

examples.text: The lazy girl is dreaming of marrying a millionaire and therefore won't do any work.
examples.translationZh: 这个懒惰的女孩正梦想着嫁给一个有钱人，从此不再工作。

meaningZh: 平房；单层小屋，多于一层的小屋

examples.text: She lives in the bungalow besides the oak tree.
examples.translationZh: 她住在橡树边的平房里。

examples.text: In the preserved old urban bungalow area, clean energy will be used for heating.
examples.translationZh: 市区平房保留区采暖设施改用清洁能源。

examples.text: His gaze goes back to the bungalow.
examples.translationZh: 他再次盯住了那间小屋。

meaningZh: 鼓励；支持（的事物）；激励

examples.text: Her encouragement gave me a great sense of uplift.
examples.translationZh: 她鼓励我激发了我的上进心。

examples.text: The teacher's words were a great encouragement to him.
examples.translationZh: 教师的话对他是极大的鼓舞。

examples.text: They attribute their success to their teacher's encouragement.
examples.translationZh: 他们把成功归因于老师的鼓励。

meaningZh: （表示属性）与…不同；不像；adj. 不同的

examples.text: The two sisters are unlike in disposition.
examples.translationZh: 那两姊妹性情不一样。

examples.text: His new novel is unlike all his previous ones.
examples.translationZh: 他新出的这部小说与他以前的不同。

examples.text: Unlike a loan, a grant does not have to be repaid.
examples.translationZh: 不像贷款，补助金不需要还款。

meaningZh: 开除；去除；脱掉，拿下

examples.text: He removed the mud from his shoes.
examples.translationZh: 他去掉鞋上的泥。

examples.text: How can we remove the husk of the grains?
examples.translationZh: 我们怎样去掉谷物的外皮？

examples.text: Come and remove your wet coat.
examples.translationZh: 过来把你的湿上衣脱掉。

meaningZh: 皇帝，君主

examples.text: The emperor was actually a political eunuch.
examples.translationZh: 那个皇帝实际上没有政治实权。

examples.text: The emperor conferred a title on the brave soldier.
examples.translationZh: 皇上授予这勇敢的士兵一头衔。

examples.text: He knelt in front of the emperor with a look of entreaty.
examples.translationZh: 他面带恳求的神态跪在皇帝面前。

meaningZh: 收集，采集；征收；收藏品

examples.text: The collection of these stamps took ten years.
examples.translationZh: 收集这些邮票花了十年时间。

examples.text: There are two collections a day from this letter box.
examples.translationZh: 这个邮箱每天开两次。

examples.text: Is the collection going to be divided up or sold as a whole?
examples.translationZh: 这批收藏品是零卖还是一起卖?

meaningZh: 钢琴；囚犯工作席；轻奏乐段

examples.text: He is a wizard at playing the piano.
examples.translationZh: 他是个钢琴奇才。

examples.text: She is learning to play the piano.
examples.translationZh: 她在学弹钢琴。

meaningZh: 普通的；平常的；一般的

examples.text: I just want an ordinary car without the frills.
examples.translationZh: 我只要一辆没有多余装饰的普通汽车。

examples.text: Now electrical appliances have entered into ordinary families.
examples.translationZh: 现在家用电器已经步入普通家庭。

examples.text: It was an ordinary lunch of soup and a sandwich.
examples.translationZh: 那是一顿平淡的午餐:一份汤,一份三明治。

meaningZh: 牙膏

examples.text: Put the cap back on the toothpaste.
examples.translationZh: 把盖子重新拧在牙膏管上。

examples.text: I must buy a tube of toothpaste.
examples.translationZh: 我必须买一支牙膏。

meaningZh: 滑板

examples.text: With a skateboard, you can skate on the street.
examples.translationZh: 有了溜冰板,你可以在大街上滑冰了。

examples.text: Skateboards are the latest craze.
examples.translationZh: 滑板运动是目前最时兴的玩意儿。

examples.text: You will know when you try to skateboard once, I promise that you won't regard.
examples.translationZh: 踏上滑板你便知道，我保证你不会后悔。

meaningZh: 城堡,堡垒

examples.text: A spirit haunts the castle.
examples.translationZh: 幽灵常出没于古堡。

examples.text: The mist eddied round the old castle.
examples.translationZh: 薄雾在那座古老的城堡的周围打转转。

examples.text: The castle has fallen into decay in the last100 years.
examples.translationZh: 这座古堡在近100年里渐渐荒废了。

meaningZh: 健忘的；好忘事的；疏忽的

examples.text: Grandfather is forgetful and often repeats himself when he tells a story.
examples.translationZh: 爷爷记忆不好，他讲故事的时候老爱重复。

examples.text: My old uncle has become rather forgetful.
examples.translationZh: 我的老叔父已经有点健忘了。

examples.text: She is forgetful of her object.
examples.translationZh: 她忘却了自己的目标。

meaningZh: 祝贺，恭喜；贺词

examples.text: May we proffer you our congratulations?
examples.translationZh: 请让我们向你表示祝贺。

examples.text: Please give him my congratulations when you see him.
examples.translationZh: 请见到他时转达我的祝贺。

examples.text: I sent her a gift as a token of my congratulation.
examples.translationZh: 我给她寄去一件礼物表示祝贺。

meaningZh: 运货汽车，机动卡车

examples.text: Bind down the ropes around the load on the lorry.
examples.translationZh: 把绕在卡车上货物外面的绳子扎紧。

examples.text: A heavy lorry floundered about in deep snow.
examples.translationZh: 一辆重型卡车在厚厚的积雪中艰难地行进。

meaningZh: 如果，倘若；即使；〈口〉是否

examples.text: Do you know if he's married?
examples.translationZh: 他结婚没结婚，你知道吗？

examples.text: I can give you a round neckline if you prefer.
examples.translationZh: 如果您喜欢我可以给您开个圆领口。

examples.text: If he wins and it's a big if he'll be the first Englishman to win for twenty years.
examples.translationZh: 假使他赢了－－是否能赢还是一大疑问－－他将是二十年来第一个获胜的英国人。

meaningZh: 灯；发热灯，照射灯

examples.text: The lamp hung over the table.
examples.translationZh: 那盏灯悬挂在桌子上方。

examples.text: The lamp was set on my desk for me to study at night.
examples.translationZh: 台灯放在我的书桌上,好让我晚上可以学习。

examples.text: In our village, electric light has taken the place of oil lamp.
examples.translationZh: 在我们村庄,电灯已经取代了油灯。

meaningZh: 出现，显现；出庭，出场；演出

examples.text: A ship appeared on the horizon.
examples.translationZh: 船出现在水平线上。

examples.text: His book appears on the market.
examples.translationZh: 他的书出版了。

examples.text: An article about him appeared in the paper.
examples.translationZh: 一篇有关他的文章在报上发表。

meaningZh: 图表；图解；示意图

examples.text: She gave me a diagram of railway network.
examples.translationZh: 她给了我一张铁路网图解。

examples.text: The diagram had been copied with great precision.
examples.translationZh: 该图表的复印件很精确。

examples.text: He pointed at the diagram to illustrate his point.
examples.translationZh: 他指着图表来说明他的论点。

meaningZh: 粉笔，白垩；用粉笔画的记号；〈英〉（比赛）得分纪录，记入借方的款项

examples.text: The teacher wrote on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
examples.translationZh: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写字。

examples.text: The teacher's chalk grated on the blackboard.
examples.translationZh: 老师的粉笔在黑板上发出刺耳的摩擦声。

examples.text: My father said cement couldn't be made from chalk.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲说水泥不能用白垩来制作。

meaningZh: 打翻，弄翻；打乱，打搅；vt. 打乱，搅乱

examples.text: I'm always upset when I don't get any mail.
examples.translationZh: 我接不到任何邮件时总是心烦意乱。

examples.text: There is no reason to get so upset.
examples.translationZh: 完全没有理由如此心烦意乱。

examples.text: Try not to get too upset about it.
examples.translationZh: 尽量不要过于为此烦恼。

meaningZh: 在一定程度上；部分地；不完全地

examples.text: You have introduced a partly random component.
examples.translationZh: 你介绍了一个在一定程度上属于偶然的成分。

examples.text: The transformation is partly due to demographics.
examples.translationZh: 这一变化一定程度上是源于人口的变化。

examples.text: Their energy is partly dissipated.
examples.translationZh: 它们的能量被部分地消耗掉。

meaningZh: （口）渴；渴感；长期的干渴

examples.text: On these dry days, you soon thirst for a cool drink.
examples.translationZh: 在那些干旱的日子里，你不久就会渴望喝点清凉的东西。

examples.text: These young children thirst for knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 这些孩子们都渴求知识。

examples.text: The cold water appeased his thirst.
examples.translationZh: 凉水缓解了他的口渴。

meaningZh: 踢；n. （毒品或酒精的）效力；精力

examples.text: That horse kicked me.
examples.translationZh: 那匹马踢了我。

examples.text: It's not fair to kick another player in football.
examples.translationZh: 足球比赛中不允许踢另一位球员。

examples.text: The rifle kicked my shoulder when I fired it.
examples.translationZh: 我开了一枪后，步枪反弹到我肩上

meaningZh: 呜咽；发呜咽声；vt. 哭诉，呜咽着说

examples.text: Then the man began to sob and walked away.
examples.translationZh: 那个人开始抽泣,然后走开了。

examples.text: Some children often sob themselves to sleep.
examples.translationZh: 有些孩子常哭泣着睡着了。

examples.text: The hard sob of anger barred her voice.
examples.translationZh: 愤怒所产生的痛苦呜咽阻滞着她的语音。

meaningZh: （电子）计算机，电脑

examples.text: I'm getting a new computer for birthday present.
examples.translationZh: 我得到一台电脑作生日礼物。

examples.text: This computer company was established last year.
examples.translationZh: 这家电脑公司是去年成立的。

examples.text: In addition to giving a general introduction to computer, the course also provides practical experience.
examples.translationZh: 课程除了一般介绍电脑知识外，还提供实际操作的机会。

meaningZh: 全世界的；adv. 遍及全球地

examples.text: The story has attracted worldwide attention.
examples.translationZh: 这件事已经引起了全世界的关注。

examples.text: Gasoline now has an almost worldwide use.
examples.translationZh: 汽油在全世界范围内被广泛使用。

examples.text: Our hotel have a worldwide reputation for good service.
examples.translationZh: 我们出色的饭店服务享誉世界。

meaningZh: （使）成熟；（使）熟

examples.text: The sun ripens the corn.
examples.translationZh: 阳光使农作物成熟。

examples.text: Time had ripened his life and mellowed its fruits.
examples.translationZh: 时间使他的生命成熟，结出硕果。

examples.text: We are waiting for the first crops to ripen.
examples.translationZh: 我们正等待着第一次农作物的成熟。

meaningZh: 破旧的，衣衫褴褛的；卑鄙的；悭吝的

examples.text: He owns nothing beyond the shabby house.
examples.translationZh: 除了那个破旧的房子,他一无所有。

examples.text: His shabby appearance creates a bad impression.
examples.translationZh: 他那寒酸的样子给人留下不好的印象。

examples.text: She is none the less beautiful for her shabby clothing.
examples.translationZh: 即使她衣衫褴褛，却仍然美丽。

meaningZh: 火车；行列；一系列相关的事情

examples.text: The 6:30 train for Berlin has been canceled.
examples.translationZh: 6点30分开往柏林的列车已经取消。

examples.text: I lost my train by three minutes.
examples.translationZh: 我迟了3分钟，没赶上火车。

examples.text: I saw a camel train.
examples.translationZh: 我看到了一队的骆驼。

meaningZh: （表示位置）在；在（某时间或时刻）；以，达

examples.text: I'm sorry to obtrude on you at such a time.
examples.translationZh: 我很抱歉在这个时候打扰你。

examples.text: She had her hair styled at the beauty parlor.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发是在美容院做的。

examples.text: Snipers shot at the invaders from the roof tops.
examples.translationZh: 狙击手从房顶上向侵略者射击。

meaningZh: 储蓄，存款；保证金；沉淀物

examples.text: She deposited a pile of books on my desk.
examples.translationZh: 她把一摞书放在我的书桌上。

examples.text: Coarse crumb rubber is apt to deposit in asphalt.
examples.translationZh: 粗的橡胶颗粒容易在沥青中沉淀。

examples.text: The Nile floods the fields and deposits mud on them.
examples.translationZh: 尼罗河泛滥，在田野上淤积一层泥。

meaningZh: 他，它；一个人；n. 雄性动物

examples.text: He is a teacher.
examples.translationZh: 他是教师。

examples.text: It was not until he came that I left.
examples.translationZh: 直到他来我才离开。

examples.text: He beat the other runners by a margin of ten seconds.
examples.translationZh: 他比其他运动员早10秒钟到达终点。

meaningZh: 快的，急速的；聪明的，凌厉的；灵活的

examples.text: Everyone is trying to get rich quick nowadays.
examples.translationZh: 现在每个人都想要尽快发财致富。

examples.text: He gave a quick answer to the teacher's question.
examples.translationZh: 他对老师的提问作出了迅速的回答。

examples.text: They are pressing us to make a quick decision.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在敦促我们迅速作出决定。

meaningZh: 愚蠢的；鲁莽的；荒谬的，可笑的

examples.text: They all jeer at the foolish speaker.
examples.translationZh: 他们都嘲笑那个愚蠢的演说者。

examples.text: It's foolish to idle away one's precious time.
examples.translationZh: 把大好时光浪费掉是愚蠢的。

examples.text: He could not account for his foolish mistake.
examples.translationZh: 他无法解释他所犯的荒谬的错误。

meaningZh: 跳；跳过；快速移动

examples.text: If a horse refuses a jump,penalty points are added to the score.
examples.translationZh: 如果马拒绝跳跃，是要扣分的。

examples.text: The athlete made a superb jump.
examples.translationZh: 运动运做了一个出色的跳跃。

examples.text: The loud bang made me jump.
examples.translationZh: 砰的一声巨响吓了我一跳。

meaningZh: 周年纪念日；adj. 周年的；周年纪念的

examples.text: He gave me a necklace as an anniversary gift.
examples.translationZh: 他给我一条项链作为周年纪念礼物。

examples.text: They held a dinner to celebrate his anniversary.
examples.translationZh: 为了庆祝他的周年纪念他们举办了一个宴会。

examples.text: How did you celebrate your wedding anniversary?
examples.translationZh: 你是怎样庆祝结婚周年纪念日的？

meaningZh: 草，草本植物；药草，香草；牧草

examples.text: He alighted on a rare medical herb.
examples.translationZh: 他偶然找到了一种稀有的草药。

examples.text: I had to take the herb tea although it's bitter.
examples.translationZh: 虽然汤药很苦，我还是不得不喝了。

examples.text: The essence drawn out from this medicinal herb is good for high blood pressure.
examples.translationZh: 从这种药草提炼出来的精华对治疗高血压有效。

meaningZh: 全部地；完全地；总共

examples.text: He bought altogether 500 hectares of land.
examples.translationZh: 他总共买了五百公顷土地。

examples.text: There are ten people altogether.
examples.translationZh: 这里总共有十个人。

examples.text: I am altogether on your side in this matter.
examples.translationZh: 在这个问题上我完全支持你。

meaningZh: 多样；种类；杂耍

examples.text: The hotel offers its guests a wide variety of amusements.
examples.translationZh: 这个旅馆为住客提供了各种各样的娱乐活动。

examples.text: The shop sells a great variety of porcelain wares.
examples.translationZh: 这家店铺出售品种繁多的瓷器。

examples.text: We all need variety in our diet.
examples.translationZh: 我们都需要饮食多样化.

meaningZh: 离婚；分离；vt. 与…离婚

examples.text: They demanded the divorce of the subsidiary from the parent firm.
examples.translationZh: 他们要求子公司与母公司分离。

examples.text: Boredom is not a ground for divorce.
examples.translationZh: 日久生厌不能成为离婚的理由。

examples.text: She has filed a petition for divorce.
examples.translationZh: 她已向法院申请离婚。

meaningZh: 打断（别人的话等）；阻止；截断

examples.text: It's not polite to interrupt a speaker.
examples.translationZh: 打断人的谈话是不礼貌的。

examples.text: The sudden noise from the next room interrupted my train of thinking.
examples.translationZh: 从隔壁房间突然传来的吵闹声打断了我的思路。

examples.text: I must go on, so please don't interrupt me.
examples.translationZh: 我必须做下去,请不要打扰我。

meaningZh: 禁止，下令禁止；剥夺权利；[古]诅咒

examples.text: The government has banned the use of chemical weapons.
examples.translationZh: 政府已经禁止使用化学武器。

examples.text: She was banned from athletics for two years after failing a drug test.
examples.translationZh: 她在药检中被查出服用禁用药物而被禁赛两年。

examples.text: A ban on the importation of drugs has been issued recently.
examples.translationZh: 最近已经发布了禁止进口毒品的法令。

meaningZh: 检查，核对；制止，抑制；在…上打勾

examples.text: Do look out for spelling mistakes when you check your homework.
examples.translationZh: 你检查作业时要当心拼写错误。

examples.text: We had to check this tendency for administrative reasons.
examples.translationZh: 由于市政管理的原因，我们不得不阻止这种趋势。

examples.text: Please check the date.
examples.translationZh: 请核实一下日期。

meaningZh: 喝（酒）；饮；喝酒

examples.text: It is harmful to your health to drink too much.
examples.translationZh: 过量喝酒对你的身体有害。

examples.text: It's not good to drink on an empty stomach.
examples.translationZh: 空腹喝酒不好。

examples.text: Let us drink to the health of our father.
examples.translationZh: 让我们举杯为父亲祝福。

meaningZh: 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；[数]式，符号

examples.text: He always shows a doleful expression.
examples.translationZh: 他总是露出忧郁的表情。

examples.text: She gave expression to her sadness.
examples.translationZh: 她流露出了悲伤之情。

examples.text: The scenery was beautiful beyond expression.
examples.translationZh: 那风景美丽得无法形容。

meaningZh: 人造的；人工的；虚假的，非原产地的

examples.text: This orange drink contains no artificial flavourings.
examples.translationZh: 这种橙汁饮品不含人工调味料。

examples.text: This dress is made of artificial fibers.
examples.translationZh: 这件衣服是人造纤维的。

examples.text: She welcomed us with an artificial smile on her face.
examples.translationZh: 她脸上挂着虚委的笑容来迎接我们。

meaningZh: 偏爱；优先权；偏爱的事物

examples.text: She has a preference for blue.
examples.translationZh: 她特别喜欢蓝色。

examples.text: It's entirely a matter of preference.
examples.translationZh: 这完全是个见仁见智的问题。

examples.text: A polar bear has a preference for cold weather.
examples.translationZh: 北极熊喜欢寒冷的天气。

meaningZh: 使困窘；使混乱；使困惑

examples.text: They asked so many questions that they confused me.
examples.translationZh: 他们问了许许多多问题，把我弄糊涂了。

examples.text: Your explanation does not so much enlighten us as confuse us.
examples.translationZh: 你的解释没有起到启发作用,反而把我们弄糊涂了。

examples.text: Her unexpected arrival confused all our plans.
examples.translationZh: 她突然来到把我们所有的计划全打乱了.

meaningZh: 奥林匹斯山的，奥林匹亚的；奥林匹克的；n. 奥林匹克运动会比赛项目

examples.text: The Olympic winner received a gold medal as an award.
examples.translationZh: 奥林匹克的优胜者获得一枚金质奖章作为奖赏。

examples.text: Hotel accommodation was scarce during the Olympic Games.
examples.translationZh: 奥运会期间，旅馆房间很难找。

examples.text: Which country will be the host country for the next Olympic Games?
examples.translationZh: 哪个国家将是下届奥运会的主办国？

meaningZh: 但是；而是；除了

examples.text: Our world is but a small part of the cosmos.
examples.translationZh: 我们的世界仅仅是宇宙的一小部分而已。

examples.text: He's still but a child.
examples.translationZh: 他仅仅是个小孩子。

examples.text: I want to say nothing but sorry.
examples.translationZh: 我只想说对不起。

meaningZh: 跳；跳绳；悄悄溜走

examples.text: Lambs skipped in the field.
examples.translationZh: 小羊在田野里跳跃。

examples.text: Let' s skip over this page and come to page 55.
examples.translationZh: 咱们越过这一页，看第五十五页。

examples.text: I read the whole book without skipping(a page).
examples.translationZh: 我一页不漏地读完了整本书。

meaningZh: （究竟）在哪儿；conj. 无论什么地方；各处，处处

examples.text: I can fall asleep wherever and in any position.
examples.translationZh: 我可以在任何地方任何位置睡着。

examples.text: Remember you are a Chinese wherever you go.
examples.translationZh: 不论你到哪里,记住你是中国人。

examples.text: We'll go wherever you like.
examples.translationZh: 你爱去哪儿我们就去哪儿。

meaningZh: 有利的，有益的；[法]可享受利益的

examples.text: It's a beneficial result to us.
examples.translationZh: 对我们来说那是有利的结果。

examples.text: Word of mouth advertising is the most beneficial.
examples.translationZh: 口碑广告是最有利的。

examples.text: Calcium is beneficial to our bones.
examples.translationZh: 钙对我们的骨骼有益。

meaningZh: 女发言人；女代言人

examples.text: The White House spokeswoman is in for a tough time.
examples.translationZh: 白宫女发言人目前的日子很不好过。

examples.text: Rio spokeswoman Amanda Buckley also declined to comment.
examples.translationZh: 里约的女发言人阿曼达巴克利也拒绝对此发表评论。

meaningZh: 击败，战胜；挫败；[法]宣告无效，作废

examples.text: He was depressed by his defeat.
examples.translationZh: 失败让他沮丧。

examples.text: This defeat was a powerful blow to the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这次失败是对敌人的有力的打击。

examples.text: The news of army's defeat cast a gloom over the town.
examples.translationZh: 军队败北的消息给小城蒙上了一层忧郁。

meaningZh: 黑暗；阴郁；模糊

examples.text: She strained her eyes in the darkness.
examples.translationZh: 她在黑暗中睁大眼睛看。

meaningZh: 对…有害的；能造成损害的；不利

examples.text: The instrument sheds harmful radiations.
examples.translationZh: 这仪器散发有害的辐射物。

examples.text: Freezing winter is harmful to orange trees.
examples.translationZh: 冰冻天气对桔子树是有害的。

meaningZh: 典型的；特有的或特别的；代表性的

examples.text: Since I'm here, I'd like to try a typical dish of this country.
examples.translationZh: 既然来了，我想吃这个国家特有的食物。

examples.text: If they reappear, they manifest themselves in certain typical ways.
examples.translationZh: 一旦它们重复出现就会以特有的方法表现出来。

examples.text: This is a typical bourgeois neighborhood.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个典型的中产阶级地区。

meaningZh: 口头的，口述的；口服的；属于或关于嘴的

examples.text: The old man told us a story passed on by oral tradition.
examples.translationZh: 老人给我们讲述了一个口头流传的故事。

examples.text: We hurried an oral agreement before signing a formal contract.
examples.translationZh: 在签正式合同之前，我们先草签了一份口头协议。

examples.text: He gave us an oral report after inspecting the factory.
examples.translationZh: 视察了那家工厂后,他给我们作了口头汇报。

meaningZh: 东北，东北方向；东北部；adj. 在东北的

examples.text: At this point the road turns northeast.
examples.translationZh: 路在这里转向东北。

examples.text: The Northeast is the granary of the country.
examples.translationZh: 东北是祖国的粮仓。

examples.text: It is a strategic pass to the northeast.
examples.translationZh: 这里是通往东北的要隘。

meaningZh: 快速的；[摄]感光快的；险峻的

examples.text: Cats have rapid reflexes.
examples.translationZh: 猫的反应很敏捷.

examples.text: The pound's rapid appreciation is creating problems for exporters.
examples.translationZh: 英镑急速升值给出口商造成困难。

examples.text: The rapid spread of the disease is alarming the medical authorities.
examples.translationZh: 这种疾病的迅速蔓延使医疗当局感到忧虑不安。

meaningZh: 肥的；胖的；厚的

examples.text: If you don't get more exercise, you'll get fat.
examples.translationZh: 如果你不多作运动，就会发胖。

examples.text: The tight jumper only accentuated his fat stomach.
examples.translationZh: 那件紧身套头毛衣反更突出了他那肥胖的肚子。

examples.text: I was so tightly wedged between two fat women that it was difficult for me to get up and leave the bus.
examples.translationZh: 我被两个肥胖的女人紧紧地挤在中间，以致于要站起来下公共汽车都很难。

meaningZh: 将，将要；愿意；会，打算

examples.text: The president proclaimed that a new currency would be issued.
examples.translationZh: 总统宣布将发行新货币。

examples.text: He would have lost his position if you hadn't backed him up.
examples.translationZh: 假如你当初没有支持他,他可能已经失去职位了。

examples.text: It would take about 30 minutes.
examples.translationZh: 大概要开30分钟。

meaningZh: 评定；估价；对（财产、收入等）进行估价（作为征税根据）

examples.text: He can quickly assess a person's character.
examples.translationZh: 他能很快地评定出某人的品质。

examples.text: How do you assess your students?
examples.translationZh: 你如何评估学生们？

examples.text: We will assess the damages caused by the flood.
examples.translationZh: 我们将对洪灾造成的损失进行评估。

meaningZh: 不可能的，做不到的；难以忍受的；不会有的，不能相信的

examples.text: It's impossible to tell who will win the next election.
examples.translationZh: 下届选举谁能获胜无法预知。

examples.text: It's impossible for us to finish the work in one day.
examples.translationZh: 我们在一天之内完成这份工作是不可能的。

meaningZh: 灰尘；（建筑物内、家具或地板等上的）灰尘；遗骸，尸体，人体，人

examples.text: The mirror is covered with a film of dust.
examples.translationZh: 镜子蒙上了一层灰尘。

examples.text: A thick layer of dust lay on the furniture.
examples.translationZh: 家具上覆盖着一层厚厚的灰尘。

examples.text: The truck left clouds of dust in its wake.
examples.translationZh: 车后扬起了一阵尘土。

meaningZh: （鸟）窝；温床；（套叠在一起的）一套物件

examples.text: The blackbird's nest contained four eggs.
examples.translationZh: 黑鹂巢里有四个蛋。

examples.text: The male hunts for food while his mate guards the nest.
examples.translationZh: 雌性动物守巢时，雄性动物猎食。

examples.text: The bird is building a nest of straw and twigs.
examples.translationZh: 这只鸟在用稻草和小树枝筑巢。

meaningZh: 永久（性）的，永恒的，不变的，耐久的，持久的，经久的；稳定的；常务的，常设的

examples.text: The incident left permanent traces on his mind.
examples.translationZh: 那件事在他头脑里留下了永久的印象。

examples.text: I am looking for a permanent position.
examples.translationZh: 我在找一个永久性的职业。

examples.text: These factors usually have a longer and more permanent impact on share prices.
examples.translationZh: 这项因素通常会对股价产生更加长远和持久的影响。

meaningZh: 固体的；实心的；结实的，可靠的

examples.text: Ice is water in solid state.
examples.translationZh: 冰是水的固体状态。

examples.text: In fact, it was originally a solid rock.
examples.translationZh: 其实,这本来是实心的岩石。

examples.text: All these have laid a solid political foundation for consolidated national unity.
examples.translationZh: 所有这些为巩固国家统一奠定了坚实的政治基础。

meaningZh: 伟大的，杰出的；优异的，显著的；很多的

examples.text: What a great idea!
examples.translationZh: 好主意！

examples.text: This cake tastes great.
examples.translationZh: 这块蛋糕吃起来很不错。

examples.text: We had a great day.
examples.translationZh: 我们度过了美好的一天。

meaningZh: 贫穷的，贫乏的；令人怜悯的，可怜的；匮乏的

examples.text: The poor horse looked all skin and bone.
examples.translationZh: 这匹马骨瘦如柴,看起来很可怜。

examples.text: He was too poor to buy a new coat.
examples.translationZh: 他穷得无法买新衣。

examples.text: Sparkling white wine is the poor man's champagne.
examples.translationZh: 白葡萄汽酒算是廉价的香槟。

meaningZh: （用于问句）为什么；为何；（反问，表示不必）何必

examples.text: The reasons why he did it are obscure.
examples.translationZh: 他做那事的理由还不清楚。

examples.text: That is why I am not in favour of the plan.
examples.translationZh: 那是我不赞成这个计划的理由。

examples.text: He expounded the reasons why he did it.
examples.translationZh: 他阐述了他做这件事的理由。

meaningZh: 面具；假面具；用作掩饰的事物

examples.text: They did so under the mask of charity.
examples.translationZh: 他们是打着慈善的幌子这么做的。

examples.text: He longed to throw off the mask of respectability.
examples.translationZh: 他渴望丢掉那副道貌岸然的伪装。

examples.text: Her sociable manner is really a mask for a very shy nature.
examples.translationZh: 她那好交际的作风，实际上是她腼腆天性的伪装。

meaningZh: 怀疑的；怀疑论者的

examples.text: He listened to me with a sceptical expression.
examples.translationZh: 他听我讲话的时候带着怀疑的表情。

examples.text: A small smile came over Winifred's face, subtle and sceptical.
examples.translationZh: 威妮弗莱德的脸上露出了一丝神秘，怀疑的微笑。

meaningZh: 导体；售票员；（乐队）指挥

examples.text: The conductor punched his bus ticket.
examples.translationZh: 售票员用剪票夹在他的汽车票上打孔。

examples.text: She knows why the metal is the good conductor.
examples.translationZh: 她知道金属为什么是好的导体。

examples.text: Rubber is not a conductor, and neither is plastics.
examples.translationZh: 橡胶不是导体，塑料也不是导体。

meaningZh: 灌木（丛）；[机械学]（金属）衬套；[电学]（绝缘）套管

examples.text: He scrabbled about in the bush for the ball.
examples.translationZh: 他在灌木丛中爬着到处找球。

examples.text: The rabbit started from the bush.
examples.translationZh: 野兔从灌木丛中突然窜了出来。

examples.text: There is some ice in the bush.
examples.translationZh: 树丛里有些冰。

meaningZh: 严峻的；严厉的；剧烈的

examples.text: The premier came under severe criticism.
examples.translationZh: 这位总理遭到严厉的抨击。

examples.text: He's suffering from severe mental disorder.
examples.translationZh: 他患有严重的精神病。

examples.text: A severe storm turned the small village down to ground.
examples.translationZh: 一场剧烈的风暴把小村夷为平地。

meaningZh: 喜爱，慈爱；情感或感情；意向

examples.text: He's so susceptible that she easily gained his affection.
examples.translationZh: 他易受感情影响，所以她很轻易就得到了他的爱。

examples.text: You appear to me to allow nothing for the influence of friendship and affection.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得你未免否定了友谊和感情对于一个人的影响。

examples.text: Don't squander your affection on him, he'll never love you.
examples.translationZh: 不要把感情浪费在他身上，他是永远不会爱你的。

meaningZh: 任命，委派；约定，指定；装设，布置

examples.text: The company decided to appoint a new treasurer.
examples.translationZh: 公司决定任命一位新司库。

examples.text: They appointed him chairman.
examples.translationZh: 他们任命他为主席。

examples.text: As a top manager, he should appoint none but people on their merit.
examples.translationZh: 作为一位总经理，他应该任人为贤。

meaningZh: 目的，目标；目的地，终点；[罕用语]预定，指定

examples.text: We eventually arrived at our destination.
examples.translationZh: 我们终于到达了目的地。

examples.text: The parcel was sent to the wrong destination.
examples.translationZh: 包裹送错了地方。

examples.text: The coach followed a rather devious course to its destination.
examples.translationZh: 长途汽车要绕很多弯路才到达目的地。

meaningZh: 各种各样的；多方面的；许多的

examples.text: There are various ways of solving the problem.
examples.translationZh: 有各种各样解决问题的方法。

examples.text: He decided to leave school for various reasons .
examples.translationZh: 由于各种各样的原因,他决定离开学校。

examples.text: Their hobbies are many and various.
examples.translationZh: 他们的业余爱好五花八门。

meaningZh: 马铃薯， 土豆，洋芋；土豆块茎

examples.text: The potato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
examples.translationZh: 马铃薯是一种蔬菜，不是一种水果。

examples.text: This salad is made of apple, pear, potato and celery.
examples.translationZh: 这份色拉是由苹果、梨、土豆和芹菜做成的。

examples.text: I like to cook dishes with potatoes.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢用马铃薯炒菜。

meaningZh: 庭院，院子；天井

examples.text: The courtyard was shaded by high trees.
examples.translationZh: 庭院荫庇在大树下。

examples.text: Rise at dawn and sweep the courtyard.
examples.translationZh: 黎明即起，洒扫庭除。

examples.text: The hotel is built round a courtyard, with fountain and palm tree.
examples.translationZh: 这家饭店围绕一庭院而建，辅以泉水和棕榈树。

meaningZh: 复习；回顾；（报刊的）评论

examples.text: Before the examination we have a review of the term's work.
examples.translationZh: 考试之前，我们复习一学期的功课。

examples.text: A succinct review of this problem with an excellent bibliography has recently appeared.
examples.translationZh: 关于这个问题的一个简明的复习和一份极好的文献目录最近已发表。

examples.text: Perhaps we need a quick review of what we've gone through so far.
examples.translationZh: 或许我们应很快地回顾一下我们前一段时间的工作。

meaningZh: 装饰，装潢；装饰品；装饰图案，装饰风格

examples.text: Such decoration was a typical feature of the baroque period.
examples.translationZh: 这种装饰是巴罗克时期的特征。

examples.text: A lot of money has been allotted to the decoration.
examples.translationZh: 装饰花了很多钱。

examples.text: She put some decorations on the Christmas tree.
examples.translationZh: 她在圣诞树上放了一些装饰品。

meaningZh: 电路，线路；巡回；唤醒，环形道

examples.text: For many years he was top banana on the circuit.
examples.translationZh: 几年来,他是巡回剧团里的主角。

examples.text: The commanding officer made a circuit of the camp.
examples.translationZh: 指挥官在营地巡视一周。

examples.text: Complete minor repairs to circuit wiring.
examples.translationZh: 完成线路小修。

meaningZh: 乒乓球；台球

examples.text: I played ping pong so much, I even played it in my sleep.
examples.translationZh: 我那么爱打乒乓乒乓球世界排名，甚至在睡梦中都会打。

examples.text: An exhibition match of Ping Pong will take place next week.
examples.translationZh: 下星期将举行一次乒乓表演赛。

examples.text: We play ping pong after school from Monday to Friday.
examples.translationZh: 我们星期一到星期五放学后在学校打桌球。

meaningZh: 肉；肉体；果肉

examples.text: The knife cut the flesh of his arm.
examples.translationZh: 小刀把他胳膊上的肉割破了。

examples.text: The pain was almost more than flesh could take.
examples.translationZh: 疼痛几乎使肉体受不了。

examples.text: We are made from flesh and soul.
examples.translationZh: 我们是肉体与灵魂结合的产物。

meaningZh: 网球（运动）

examples.text: Do you play tennis?
examples.translationZh: 你打网球吗？

examples.text: I'm just a rabbit at tennis.
examples.translationZh: 我网球打得很差劲。

examples.text: I won the tennis tournament.
examples.translationZh: 我赢了那场网球比赛。

meaningZh: 疲倦的；困倦的；对…不耐烦的

examples.text: I am not in the least tired.
examples.translationZh: 我一点也不疲倦。

examples.text: If you watch too much TV, you'll feel tired.
examples.translationZh: 如果你看电视太多,你就会感到疲劳。

examples.text: We reached our destination, tired and hungry.
examples.translationZh: 到达目的地时,我们又累又饿。

meaningZh: 父亲（或母亲）；先辈；根源，起源

examples.text: My parents have gone to Hangzhou for holiday.
examples.translationZh: 我父母已经去杭州度假了。

examples.text: Being a parent can be hard work.
examples.translationZh: 当父母可是件辛苦的事。

examples.text: Ignorance is the parent of many evils.
examples.translationZh: 无知是许多罪恶的根源。

meaningZh: 承诺，许诺；委任，委托；致力，献身

examples.text: If you are serious about our relationship, you should make a commitment.
examples.translationZh: 如果你对我们的关系很认真，你就应该给个承诺。

examples.text: He made a commitment to pay the rent on time.
examples.translationZh: 他保证按时付房租。

examples.text: It saddens me to recall that I assured him that I had no expectations of a long-term commitment.
examples.translationZh: 现在回想起来，我为我一开始就向他保证说我也不期望一段长期的关系而伤感。

meaningZh: 信任；料想；笃信宗教

examples.text: We believe in his ability.
examples.translationZh: 我们相信他的才干。

examples.text: Some people believe in God and others don't.
examples.translationZh: 有人相信上帝; 有人则不相信。

examples.text: Some people believe poverty engenders crime.
examples.translationZh: 有人认为贫困生罪恶。

meaningZh: 尊严；高尚；自豪

examples.text: He would do nothing beneath his dignity.
examples.translationZh: 他决不愿意干任何有损自身尊严的事。

examples.text: The real dignity of a man lies in what he is, not in what he has.
examples.translationZh: 一个人的真正尊严在于他的品格，而非他的财富。

examples.text: A man's dignity depends not upon his wealth but upon his character.
examples.translationZh: 人高尚与否不取决於他的财富,而取决於他的品格。

meaningZh: 天；天堂；上帝

examples.text: A lark is singing in the heaven.
examples.translationZh: 云雀在天空中歌唱。

examples.text: Twinkling stars are garnishry of heaven.
examples.translationZh: 闪烁的星星是天空的装饰品。

examples.text: If there's a heaven on earth, this is it!
examples.translationZh: 人间若有天堂，非此莫属！

meaningZh: 上面的，高架的；头顶上的；（费用等）经常的，管理的

examples.text: Their office is in central Beijing, so their overhead is very high.
examples.translationZh: 他们的办事处设在北京市中心，所以他们的日常开支很大。

examples.text: The overhead costs are ridiculously expensive.
examples.translationZh: 日常开支太高了。

examples.text: This button turns on your overhead light.
examples.translationZh: 这个按钮用来开亮您头顶上方的灯。

meaningZh: 到达，走到；够…，抓…；完成

examples.text: We had twenty miles to cover to reach the nearest railway station.
examples.translationZh: 我们得走20英里的路才能到达最近的火车站。

examples.text: He reached into his pocket to get his car keys.
examples.translationZh: 他把手伸进口袋里拿车钥匙。

examples.text: Hopefully, they will reach an agreement after the talk.
examples.translationZh: 会谈之后,他们有望达成协议。

meaningZh: 练习；运动，训练；运用

examples.text: Exercise is good for your heart and lungs.
examples.translationZh: 对您的心脏和肺,运动也是有益的。

examples.text: I suggest you go on a diet and take more exercise.
examples.translationZh: 我建议你节食,多做运动。

examples.text: Next I'd like you to do the exercises on page 10.
examples.translationZh: 下面我让你做第10页上的练习。

meaningZh: 牙；齿；齿状部份

examples.text: This tooth is sensitive to cold.
examples.translationZh: 这颗牙对冷过敏。

examples.text: I was fitted an artificial tooth by the dentist.
examples.translationZh: 牙医给我镶了颗假牙。

examples.text: We should brush our teeth at least twice a day.
examples.translationZh: 我们每天应该至少刷两次牙。

meaningZh: [C] 春,春天；弹簧,发条；泉,源泉

examples.text: Spring is here.
examples.translationZh: 春天来了。

examples.text: It can be quite windy there, especially in spring.
examples.translationZh: 那里有时容易刮风,特别在春季。

examples.text: When the box was opened, the spring jumped out.
examples.translationZh: 盒子一打开，弹簧就绷出来了。

meaningZh: 睡，睡觉；vi. 睡，睡觉；睡眠状态

examples.text: I didn't sleep well last night.
examples.translationZh: 昨晚我睡不安稳。

examples.text: He have to sleep by day and work by night.
examples.translationZh: 他只好白天睡觉，晚上工作。

examples.text: He'd been sleeping rough for a week, in ditches and haystacks.
examples.translationZh: 他在沟里和草堆里露宿了一个星期。

meaningZh: 简化；使单纯；使简易

examples.text: That will simplify my task.
examples.translationZh: 那可简化了我的工作。

examples.text: She simplified the instructions so that the children could understand them.
examples.translationZh: 她简化了指令以便于儿童理解。

examples.text: The whole process has now been greatly simplified.
examples.translationZh: 整个程序被极大地简化了。

meaningZh: 最大值的，最大量的；n. 最大的量、体积、强度等

examples.text: This hall holds a maximum of seventy people.
examples.translationZh: 这厅最多容纳七十人。

examples.text: The child turned the volume up to the maximum.
examples.translationZh: 小孩把音量转到了最大。

examples.text: It is the maximum the insurance company will pay.
examples.translationZh: 这是保险公司所能付给的最大金额。

meaningZh: 音乐会；一致，和谐；vt. 通过双方协议来计划或安排

examples.text: The concert will be given on Saturday.
examples.translationZh: 音乐会将于星期六举行。

examples.text: It is good to go to a concert for a change.
examples.translationZh: 到音乐会去换换环境比较好。

examples.text: The newspaper gave much publicity to the concert.
examples.translationZh: 报纸对这次音乐会进行了充分报道。

meaningZh: 台，看台；立场；停止

examples.text: I don't think the chair is firm enough to stand on.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得这椅子不够稳固,不能站人。

examples.text: I twisted my ankle, and I couldn't stand up.
examples.translationZh: 我的脚踝扭伤,简直无法站起来。

examples.text: She is funny, but I can't stand her.
examples.translationZh: 她滑稽,但我无法忍受她。

meaningZh: 蝴蝶；蝶泳；轻浮的人

examples.text: A butterfly must not be confused with a moth.
examples.translationZh: 不得将蝴蝶和飞蛾混同起来。

examples.text: A caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly.
examples.translationZh: 毛虫是蝴蝶的幼体。

examples.text: A butterfly is flying up and down among the flowers.
examples.translationZh: 有一只蝴蝶正在花丛里忽上忽下地飞着。

meaningZh: 相隔，相距；分散地，分开地；成部分，成碎片

examples.text: The two villages are three miles apart.
examples.translationZh: 这两个村子相距三英里。

examples.text: He took the watch apart to repair it.
examples.translationZh: 他把手表拆开来修理。

examples.text: She lives apart from her family.
examples.translationZh: 她跟家人分开住。

meaningZh: 温度；体温；气温

examples.text: The temperature has stayed hot this week.
examples.translationZh: 本周气温一直都很热。

examples.text: The temperature soared to 43 degrees centigrade on July 25.
examples.translationZh: 7月25日,气温猛升到4摄氏度。

examples.text: After the storm there will be a sharp drop in temperature.
examples.translationZh: 风暴过后,气温会骤降。

meaningZh: [航海] 宽叶短桨；桨状物；搅拌金矿的铁器，类似铁铲的工具

examples.text: The butter churn has two paddles to whip the cream.
examples.translationZh: 奶油制造机有两根搅棍搅打奶油。

examples.text: He dipped his paddle without a splash.
examples.translationZh: 他把他的短桨浸没有飞溅声。

examples.text: Each man has a paddle for an hour and then a rest.
examples.translationZh: 每个人划一个小时,然后休息一下。

meaningZh: 实践的，实际的；可实现的，实用的；注重实际的

examples.text: A practical person does not spend his money and time foolishly.
examples.translationZh: 一个有头脑的人是不胡乱花钱和虚度光阴的。

examples.text: It's an interesting idea, but there are many practical difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个很有意思的想法,然而却存在着许多实际困难。

examples.text: Most importantly, we should develop our own practical ability.
examples.translationZh: 最重要的是,我们应该提高自身的实践能力。

meaningZh: 释义 允许，任由；让，随；假设

examples.text: I won't let him get away with that excuse.
examples.translationZh: 我不会让他用那种借口蒙混过去。

examples.text: I don't agree with all you say, but I'll let it go at that.
examples.translationZh: 我并不完全同意你说的话，但我不再多说了。

examples.text: No visitors are let into the committee meetings.
examples.translationZh: 委员会会议不允许任何访问者闯入。

meaningZh: 胶囊；航天舱；（植物的）荚

examples.text: The capsule is filled with small soluble cases.
examples.translationZh: 胶囊里充满了可溶的小颗粒。

examples.text: This capsule is to be taken every four hours.
examples.translationZh: 这种胶囊每隔四小时服一次。

examples.text: This capsule is used for animals.
examples.translationZh: 这个太空舱是用来装载动物的。

meaningZh: （通常因道义上的原因而）谴责；宣判；宣布…不能使用

examples.text: We must not condemn her on pure supposition.
examples.translationZh: 我们不能单凭猜测就谴责她。

examples.text: We condemn all sorts of slanders.
examples.translationZh: 我们谴责一切诽谤中伤的言论。

examples.text: Most people are willing to condemn violence.
examples.translationZh: 大部分的人极力谴责暴力。

meaningZh: 粉，粉末；粉状物质；vt. 在…搽粉

examples.text: Borax is a kind of white powder.
examples.translationZh: 硼砂是一种白色粉末。

examples.text: There's too much powder on your nose.
examples.translationZh: 你鼻子上的粉擦得太多了。

examples.text: I know the smell of powder.
examples.translationZh: 我上过战场。

meaningZh: 王国；界；领域

examples.text: The ruler of a kingdom is designated a king.
examples.translationZh: 王国的统治者称作国王。

examples.text: The Calcite Mineral Kingdom addresses you today.
examples.translationZh: 今天是方解石王国向你们问候。

examples.text: This is the fight of the kingdom of the mind.
examples.translationZh: 这是思想领域的斗争。

meaningZh: 抵抗，抗拒；忍耐；反对，抵制

examples.text: Many young people could not resist the spiritual pollution.
examples.translationZh: 很多年轻人不能抵制精神污染。

examples.text: They are determined to resist invasion.
examples.translationZh: 他们决定抵抗入侵。

examples.text: The nobility usually resist social changes.
examples.translationZh: 贵族通常反对社会变革。

meaningZh: 保龄球运动；滚木球戏；v. 打保龄球(bowl的现在分词)

examples.text: Prinne was tired after bowling for half an hour.
examples.translationZh: 普林玩了半个钟头保龄球戏后觉得累了。

examples.text: Jerry and Marcy are bowling on bowling night.
examples.translationZh: 杰瑞和玛西在保龄球之夜打保龄球。

meaningZh: 电影；电影院；电影业

examples.text: The movie was over shortly before six.
examples.translationZh: 电影在六点钟不到就结束了。

examples.text: The movie has been hyped up far beyond its worth.
examples.translationZh: 这部影片被吹得离了谱了。

examples.text: His last movie was a real turkey.
examples.translationZh: 他最後的那部影片一塌糊涂。

meaningZh: 在下面，到下面；prep. （表示位置）在…下面；（表示状态）在…掩饰之下

examples.text: His income is well below the average.
examples.translationZh: 他的收入大大低于平均水平。

examples.text: The class has dropped below ten students this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年这个班的学生降到了10人以下。

examples.text: Please do not write below this line.
examples.translationZh: 请不要写到这条线下面。

meaningZh: 国王的,女王的,王室的

examples.text: Two men carried the standard in the royal parade.
examples.translationZh: 在盛大的游行队伍中, 两个男子打着旗子。

examples.text: The royal wedding was an occasion of great festivity.
examples.translationZh: 皇室婚礼是喜庆的盛事。

examples.text: Britain has always had a large navy, called the Royal Navy.
examples.translationZh: 英国一直有一支强大的海军，称为皇家海军。

meaningZh: 女售货员，女店员

examples.text: The saleswoman set aside the coat for the fat lady.
examples.translationZh: 女售货员给这位胖女士留下了一件外套。

examples.text: The man became embroiled this time with a saleswoman.
examples.translationZh: 这回那男子跟一名女售货员好上了。

examples.text: The saleswoman inveigled the poor girl into buying four hats.
examples.translationZh: 女店员诱骗那女孩买了四顶帽子。

meaningZh: 动荡，不安定；骚乱；风潮

examples.text: There's (a feeling of) unrest in the air.
examples.translationZh: 四处充满了不安(的感觉)。

examples.text: The unrest erupted into revolution.
examples.translationZh: 动乱爆发为革命。

examples.text: People are predicting civil unrest in the area.
