examples.translationZh: 人们预言该地区将发生动乱。

meaningZh: 罕见的，特殊的；半熟的；半生的

examples.text: It is rare to find such a genius nowadays.
examples.translationZh: 这样的天才现在很少见。

examples.text: It was in the days when motorcars were rare.
examples.translationZh: 那是在汽车还罕见的时代。

examples.text: He's devoted his whole life to the protection of the rare animals.
examples.translationZh: 他终生献身于珍稀动物的保护。

meaningZh: 聋的；不愿听的

examples.text: He is deaf in one ear.
examples.translationZh: 他有一只耳朵是聋的。

examples.text: He's a deaf mute and cannot tell anyone secret.
examples.translationZh: 他是个聋哑人，不会把他们的秘密告诉任何人。

examples.text: He is always deaf to his teacher's advice.
examples.translationZh: 他总是对他老师的忠告充耳不闻。

meaningZh: 缺席，缺勤；缺乏，缺少，无；心不在焉，不注意

examples.text: His long absence raised fears about his safety.
examples.translationZh: 他长期不在引起了大家对他的安全的担心。

examples.text: What was the real reason for your absence?
examples.translationZh: 你缺席的真正原因是什么？

examples.text: We are in the absence of experience.
examples.translationZh: 我们缺乏经验。

meaningZh: 生物学；生物

examples.text: He specializes biology.
examples.translationZh: 他主修生物学。

examples.text: We have a biology lesson tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我们有堂生物学课。

examples.text: He is an environmentalist with a passion of the biology and geography of the region.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个环保人士，对这个地区的生物和地理很有热情。

meaningZh: 罢（工、课等）；撞；攻击

examples.text: The dockers are coming out on strike for higher wages.
examples.translationZh: 码头工人将举行罢工要求增加工资。

examples.text: The coalminers have been out on strike for several weeks now.
examples.translationZh: 煤矿工人已罢工了几个星期。

examples.text: The strike has delivered a heavy blow to the management.
examples.translationZh: 这场罢工给资方以一个沉重打击。

meaningZh: 大小，尺寸；规模；胶料，浆糊

examples.text: The size of the apples varied.
examples.translationZh: 那些苹果大小不同。

examples.text: The company doubled its size in nine years.
examples.translationZh: 9年来这家公司的规模扩大了一倍。

examples.text: What size of collar is this shirt?
examples.translationZh: 这衬衣领子的尺寸是多少？

meaningZh: 非洲的；非洲人的；（非洲）黑人的

examples.text: Some African cultures consider twins blessed.
examples.translationZh: 一些非洲的文化认为双胞胎可以企福。

examples.text: We referred to Sana'a as an African city.
examples.translationZh: 我们曾报道萨那为非洲的一座城市。

examples.text: Most African people are black people.
examples.translationZh: 大多数非洲人是黑人。

meaningZh: 响亮的，大声的，高声的；响亮的，洪亮的，高亢的；高声的，激烈的

examples.text: I gave a loud yawn, but he just kept on talking.
examples.translationZh: 我大声打了个呵欠，可他还是不停地讲下去。

examples.text: He cleared his nose with a loud sniff.
examples.translationZh: 他大声吸气清了清鼻子。

examples.text: All of this loud music is driving me up the wall.
examples.translationZh: 这吵闹的音乐快令我发疯了。

meaningZh: 原则，原理；准则，道义；道德标准

examples.text: A bicycle and a motorcycle are built on the same principle.
examples.translationZh: 自行车和摩托车是根据同样的原理制造的。

examples.text: Archimedes ,a great physicist ,discovered the principle of floating bodies .
examples.translationZh: 阿基米德，一位伟大的物理学家，发现了浮体原理。

examples.text: We adhere to the principle that everyone should be treated fairly.
examples.translationZh: 我们坚持人人都应该被平等对待这一原则。

meaningZh: 筷子；筷子( chopstick的名词复数 )

examples.text: She is still awkward with chopsticks.
examples.translationZh: 她用筷子还不熟练。

examples.text: I have trouble using chopsticks correctly.
examples.translationZh: 我很难正确地使用筷子。

meaningZh: 北方；北部；（美国南北战争时与南方作战的）北部各州

examples.text: Such fish is rarely met with in the north country.
examples.translationZh: 这种鱼在北方难得看到。

examples.text: North America has the world's best climate for wild grapes.
examples.translationZh: 北美的气候是世界上最适合野生葡萄生长的。

examples.text: The river turns north at this point.
examples.translationZh: 这条河从这里转向北方。

meaningZh: 用过的；习惯于；二手的

examples.text: He makes sweaters from used plastic bottles.
examples.translationZh: 他利用使用过的塑料瓶罐来制造毛衣。

examples.text: I want to buy a used car at a cheap price.
examples.translationZh: 我要以低廉价买一辆被使用过的车。

examples.text: To save money, I purchased a used car instead of a new one.
examples.translationZh: 为了省钱，我没买新车，而是买了辆二手的。

meaningZh: （车辆等的）停放；停车场所，停车位；v. 停车(park的ing形式)

examples.text: No parking on the pavement.
examples.translationZh: 人行道/路面上不许停车。

examples.text: There is no parking around here.
examples.translationZh: 这周围不准停车。

examples.text: We encouraged the Smiths before leaving the parking lot.
examples.translationZh: 在离开停车场之前，我们鼓励了史密斯一家。

meaningZh: 称…的重量；权衡，考虑；用手掂估

examples.text: He weighed the ideas in his mind.
examples.translationZh: 他在脑中权衡着这些想法。

examples.text: It's been weighing on my mind for days whether to tell her or not.
examples.translationZh: 我这几天心烦意乱，不知道应该不应告诉她。

examples.text: The branches of the trees were weighed down by snow.
examples.translationZh: 树枝被雪压弯了。

meaningZh: 粗心的；无忧无虑的；漫不经心的，不介意的

examples.text: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
examples.translationZh: 你没锁门，太粗心了。

examples.text: The careless waiter dropped the dish onto the ground.
examples.translationZh: 那个粗心的侍者把盘子摔到了地上。

examples.text: The accident was due to his careless driving.
examples.translationZh: 事故起因于他驾驶疏忽。

meaningZh: 欢迎；乐于接受；adj. 受欢迎的

examples.text: I don't welcome intrusions into my privacy.
examples.translationZh: 我不希望有人干扰我的私生活。

examples.text: When I came into the office, the principal rose to welcome me.
examples.translationZh: 当我走进办公室时,校长起身欢迎我。

examples.text: You are always welcome to our house.
examples.translationZh: 欢迎你随时到我们家。

meaningZh: 十几岁的青少年；十三岁到十九岁的少年

examples.text: He is a lanky teenager.
examples.translationZh: 他是个瘦削的少年。

examples.text: It is not easy to educate teenagers.
examples.translationZh: 教育青少年不是件容易的事。

examples.text: That teenager singer is really dynamite!
examples.translationZh: 那个少年歌手真是轰动一时！

meaningZh: 代替，顶替；反而；反倒

examples.text: I gave him advice instead of money.
examples.translationZh: 我给了他忠告，而不是钱。

examples.text: I made this cake specially, with brown sugar instead of white.
examples.translationZh: 我特别地以红糖代替白糖做了这个蛋糕。

examples.text: We shouldn't look down upon them, instead we should try to help them and take more care of them.
examples.translationZh: 我们不仅不该歧视他们,反而更要多帮助、照顾他们。

meaningZh: 科学的；有系统的；应用科学的

examples.text: We all support his scientific research.
examples.translationZh: 我们都支持他的科学研究。

examples.text: He took a very scientific approach to management.
examples.translationZh: 他采取了一种非常科学的管理方法。

examples.text: He is engaged in scientific pursuit.
examples.translationZh: 他从事科学研究。

meaningZh: 衣服，衣物；寝具；v. 穿（衣）( clothe的第三人称单数)

examples.text: She has good taste in clothes.
examples.translationZh: 她对服装有很好的审美眼光。

examples.text: It might be appropriate to wear traditional clothes on special occasions.
examples.translationZh: 在某些特定的场合,我们适合穿传统服装。

examples.text: I washed many clothes with my washer last night.
examples.translationZh: 我昨晚用洗衣机洗了很多衣服。

meaningZh: 练习；实习；积极从事

examples.text: I need to practise my Italian before my business trip.
examples.translationZh: 我出差之前需要先练习一下意大利语。

examples.text: I strive to practise these two virtues in my life.
examples.translationZh: 我在生活中努力实践这两种美德。

examples.text: For the present, we have to practise the supply system of distribution.
examples.translationZh: 现在我们也只能实行供给制。

meaningZh: 商品，货物；动产；本领

examples.text: The goods were consigned to you by railway.
examples.translationZh: 货物已由铁路托运到你处。

examples.text: Please honor our arrangement by exchanging the damaged goods.
examples.translationZh: 请遵守我们的协议，给我们调换损坏的货物。

examples.text: Can the goods be refunded at your counter?
examples.translationZh: 你们柜台的商品可以退吗？

meaningZh: 知道；了解；认识

examples.text: What do you know about us?
examples.translationZh: 你对我们有什么了解?

examples.text: I didn't know the truth until she told me what happened.
examples.translationZh: 直到她告诉我发生的事,我才了解真相。

examples.text: I know what happened.
examples.translationZh: 我知道发生了什么事。

meaningZh: 拼写；拼法；v. 拼写( spell的现在分词)

examples.text: Don't make a mistake in your spelling.
examples.translationZh: 不要在拼法上出错。

examples.text: English spelling has little rhyme or reason.
examples.translationZh: 英文的拼法没什么规律。

examples.text: He is certainly improving in his spelling.
examples.translationZh: 他的拼写大有改进。

meaningZh: 盘；餐具；一盘食物

examples.text: The careless waiter dropped the dish onto the ground.
examples.translationZh: 那个粗心的侍者把盘子摔到了地上。

examples.text: That dish is too shallow to serve soup in.
examples.translationZh: 那只盘子太浅了，不能盛汤。

examples.text: This glass dish is very fragile.
examples.translationZh: 这玻璃碟子十分易碎。

meaningZh: 波浪，波动；挥手；涌现的人（或事物）

examples.text: The boat was smashed by a huge wave.
examples.translationZh: 小船被一个巨浪掀翻胃。

examples.text: She has a natural wave in her hair.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发自然卷曲。

examples.text: A compression wave in decelerating flow steepens.
examples.translationZh: 压缩波在减速流中变陡。

meaningZh: 钱包，皮夹子

examples.text: She placed the receipt in her wallet.
examples.translationZh: 她把收条放到皮夹子里了。

examples.text: I lost my wallet yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我昨天丢了钱包。

examples.text: My wallet has disappeared from the table.
examples.translationZh: 我放在桌子上的钱包不见了。

meaningZh: 基本的；[化学]碱性的；[地质学]基性的

examples.text: The family is the basic unit of society.
examples.translationZh: 家庭是社会的基本单位。

examples.text: The right to work is a basic right of the citizens.
examples.translationZh: 劳动权是公民的一项基本权利。

examples.text: Food, clothing and shelter are all basic necessities of life.
examples.translationZh: 衣、 食、 住所是生活的基本必需品。

meaningZh: 涉及，关系到；使关心，使担忧；参与

examples.text: Hardly a whisper of concern has been voiced.
examples.translationZh: 没有人表示过一点点的关心。

examples.text: Provision of shelter was their main concern for the disaster victims.
examples.translationZh: 为灾民提供避难处是他们最关切的事。

examples.text: I am not insensible of your concern.
examples.translationZh: 我不是没察觉到你的忧虑。

meaningZh: 胶合；紧附于；n. 胶水

examples.text: This extra strong glue should do the job nicely.
examples.translationZh: 这种超强度胶应该管用。

examples.text: This glue doesn't stick very well.
examples.translationZh: 这种胶水粘不住。

examples.text: The poster wouldn't stick even though I drenched it with glue.
examples.translationZh: 我涂了大量胶水，可那张海报就是贴不住。

meaningZh: 百分度的；摄氏的；摄氏温度计的

examples.text: This thermometer is calibrated by centigrade.
examples.translationZh: 这种温度计是用摄氏百分度标定的。

examples.text: It is therefore usually expressed in percentage terms rather than in engineering units such as degrees centigrade.
examples.translationZh: 因此它往往用一个百分比来表示而不是机械单位如百分度表示。

meaningZh: 无尽的，无边的；没完没了的；永久的

examples.text: Endless desires eventually led him astray.
examples.translationZh: 无止境的欲望最终将他引入了歧途。

examples.text: I can't endure your endless complaints anymore.
examples.translationZh: 我再也不能忍受你无止境的抱怨了。

examples.text: I am too busy to listen to her endless grievance.
examples.translationZh: 我太忙了，没空听她那没完没了的牢骚。

meaningZh: （人或其举止）优美的；漂亮的；简炼的

examples.text: He strolled about, looking very debonair in his elegant new suit.
examples.translationZh: 他穿了一身讲究的新衣服逛来逛去，显得颇为惬意。

examples.text: He proudly promenaded his elegant companion in the park.
examples.translationZh: 他得意地领著他那标致的伴侣遛公园。

examples.text: We all wonder how you always look so young and beautiful and elegant!
examples.translationZh: 我们都很想知道,为什么你总是那么优雅年轻。

meaningZh: 饼干；小甜点；吸引人的年轻妇女

examples.text: This cookie is neither sweet nor soft.
examples.translationZh: 这块饼干既不甜也不软。

examples.text: The child reached for another cookie.
examples.translationZh: 小孩伸手拿取另一片饼干。

examples.text: We had cookies and coffee.
examples.translationZh: 我们吃了甜饼和咖啡。

meaningZh: 帮助；有助于， 有利于；vt. 治疗

examples.text: Your advice helped me a lot.
examples.translationZh: 你的意见对我大有帮助。

examples.text: I'll do everything possible to help you.
examples.translationZh: 我会尽一切可能帮助你。

examples.text: Trade helps industry to develop.
examples.translationZh: 贸易促进工业发展。

meaningZh: 代数学，代数

examples.text: The boy can't figure out the algebra problems.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩做不出这道代数题。

examples.text: It's easy to learn algebra.
examples.translationZh: 学习代数很容易。

examples.text: We've learned algebra in middle school.
examples.translationZh: 我在中学就学过代数学。

meaningZh: 长袜；似长袜之物

examples.text: I ripped my stocking on a nail.
examples.translationZh: 一个钉子挂破了我的袜子。

examples.text: The thief masked his face with a stocking.
examples.translationZh: 那贼套上长筒袜遮住脸。

examples.text: The boy is one meter tall in his stocking feet.
examples.translationZh: 这个小男孩不穿鞋的身高是一米。

meaningZh: 阴影；影子；鬼，幽灵

examples.text: The tree cast its shadow on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 树影映在墙上。

examples.text: His shadow followed him along the road.
examples.translationZh: 他的影子一路上跟着他。

examples.text: The scandal cast a shadow on his career.
examples.translationZh: 这件丑闻给他的事业投上了一层阴影。

meaningZh: 扭成一束；搓，捻；绕，卷

examples.text: She twisted the long scarf round her head.
examples.translationZh: 她把那条长围巾围在头上。

examples.text: Selecting the suitable twist factor in order to meet the needs of flax knitting yarn, it is the key to increase high_grade and productivity of flax knitting products.
examples.translationZh: 选择合理的捻系数以满足针织用纱的要求是提高亚麻针织产品档次和生产效率的关键。

examples.text: We twisted the bed sheets into a rope and escaped by climbing down it.
examples.translationZh: 我们把床单搓成绳子，援绳下坠逃跑了。

meaningZh: 磁带录像；录像磁带；录像机，电视

examples.text: The cinema has largely yielded to the home video.
examples.translationZh: 电影业在很大程度上已让位给家庭录像电影。

examples.text: They showed a video of "Gone with the Wind".
examples.translationZh: 他们放了录像片《乱世佳人》。

examples.text: Could you video the documentary for me?
examples.translationZh: 帮我录一下这个纪录片好吗？

meaningZh: 羊肉；绵羊

examples.text: Fish doesn't go well with mutton.
examples.translationZh: 鱼和羊肉在一起不好吃。

examples.text: People like to have mutton in the winter.
examples.translationZh: 冬天人们喜欢吃羊肉。

meaningZh: 破碎的，打碎的；（腿，臂等）已骨折的；（线条）虚线的，断续的

examples.text: He likes to tinker at broken gadgets.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢摸弄坏掉的小器具。

examples.text: Can you glue the broken vase together?
examples.translationZh: 你能把破碎的花瓶黏合起来吗?

examples.text: The broken windows have been boarded up.
examples.translationZh: 破碎的窗户已被木板封住。

meaningZh: 从不，从来没有；一点也不，决不；不会…吧，没有

examples.text: I will never forget your kindness.
examples.translationZh: 我永远忘不了你的好意。

examples.text: In these altitudes snow never melts.
examples.translationZh: 在这样的高度，雪永不融化。

examples.text: His love for science will never die.
examples.translationZh: 他对科学的热爱永不会消退。

meaningZh: 选择；挑选；选拔

examples.text: Please select a channel to begin with from left.
examples.translationZh: 请从左边选择一个频道。

examples.text: She lets her son select his own Christmas present.
examples.translationZh: 她让儿子自己选择圣诞礼物。

examples.text: They select him to their leader.
examples.translationZh: 他们选择他为他们的领导人。

meaningZh: 斑马；adj. 有斑纹的

examples.text: Seemingly everyone likes the zebra.
examples.translationZh: 似乎每个人都喜欢斑马。

examples.text: The neck of the zebra was nipped by a lion.
examples.translationZh: 狮子咬断了那头斑马的脖子。

examples.text: There was only one big road to cross, but it had a zebra crossing.
examples.translationZh: 只有一条大路要过，但它有斑马线。

meaningZh: 逃走，逃掉；消失；vt. 逃离，逃避

examples.text: He tried to flee from the police in a stolen car.
examples.translationZh: 他企图驾驶一辆偷来的车从警察局逃走。

examples.text: The frightened people fled from the fire.
examples.translationZh: 人们惊恐万状地逃离了火灾现场。

examples.text: The mists was fleeing before the rising sun.
examples.translationZh: 太阳慢慢升起，薄雾渐渐消失。

meaningZh: 语言，语言文字；表达能力；言语，语风，文风，文体

examples.text: Chinese is my native language.
examples.translationZh: 汉语是我的母语。

examples.text: What languages can you speak?
examples.translationZh: 你会说什么语言？

examples.text: A dictionary is an invaluable aid in learning a new language.
examples.translationZh: 在学习一种新语言时,辞典是非常有用的工具。

meaningZh: 文明，文化；开化，教化；修养

examples.text: Chinese civilization is one of the oldest in the world.
examples.translationZh: 中国文化是世界上最古老的文化之一。

examples.text: The civilization of mankind has taken thousands of years.
examples.translationZh: 人类经数千年才文明开化。

examples.text: In some ways, civilization does not seem to have progressed much in the last century.
examples.translationZh: 在某些方面，上个世纪文明似乎进展不大。

meaningZh: 干杯；烤面包；接受敬酒的人

examples.text: She put a dab of butter on the toast.
examples.translationZh: 她在吐司上抹了一点黄油。

examples.text: Two toast bread and a cup of coffee.
examples.translationZh: 两个吐司面包，一杯咖啡。

examples.text: We breakfasted on toast and coffee.
examples.translationZh: 我们用的早餐是烤面包片和咖啡。

meaningZh: 不同的；各式各样的；个别的

examples.text: The two doctors made different diagnosis of my disease.
examples.translationZh: 两位医生对我的病作出了不同的诊断。

examples.text: He's a different man from what he was 10 years ago.
examples.translationZh: 他和十年前不一样。

examples.text: You can't imagine how different it is from the John Grier Home.
examples.translationZh: 你很难想象这里与约翰·格利尔孤儿院有多大的区别。

meaningZh: 认出，识别出某人[某事物]；承认…有效[属实]；认可

examples.text: We recognise the imperative need for this development.
examples.translationZh: 我们承认这是必要的为了这个发展。

examples.text: Once that is done, it would be easier to recognise an independent Kosovo.
examples.translationZh: 只要这样，就更容易承认一个独立的科索沃。

examples.text: As an engineer, he can recognise a kludge when he sees one.
examples.translationZh: 作为一名工程师，他一眼就能识别出那些尚不成熟的技术。

meaningZh: 枪；发令枪声；受雇杀人的枪手

examples.text: The gun has a carry of 400 yards.
examples.translationZh: 这枪的射程为四百码。

examples.text: He was clubbed to death with a butt of a gun.
examples.translationZh: 他是被人用枪托殴打致死的。

examples.text: It's illegal to carry guns in our country.
examples.translationZh: 在我们国家，携带枪支是违法的。

meaningZh: 祖先，祖宗；被继承人；原型

examples.text: During the festival the investor investigated his ancestor.
examples.translationZh: 节日期间投资者调查了他的祖宗。

examples.text: They said their ancestor was a famous hunter and a crack hunter.
examples.translationZh: 他们说他们的祖宗是个有名的猎人，也是个神枪手。

examples.text: People who share an ancestor are called relatives.
examples.translationZh: 有同一个祖先的叫做亲戚。

meaningZh: 高兴的，乐意的；令人高兴的，使人愉快的；（风光）明媚的，（景色）美丽的

examples.text: I'm glad to hear he's feeling better.
examples.translationZh: 听说他身体好些了，我很高兴。

examples.text: I am glad we have come together at last.
examples.translationZh: 很高兴我们终于取得了一致。

examples.text: I'd be glad to lend you the money.
examples.translationZh: 我很乐意借给你钱。

meaningZh: 表演；演技；表现

examples.text: His performance gripped the audience.
examples.translationZh: 他的表演深深地吸引住观众。

examples.text: Proposal is easier than performance.
examples.translationZh: 建议容易实行难。

examples.text: His good performance in school does great credit to his mother.
examples.translationZh: 他在学校的优良表现为他母亲带来极大的荣誉。

meaningZh: 哀痛；服丧；咕哝

examples.text: People wore crapes to mourn our leader.
examples.translationZh: 人们戴着黑纱哀悼我们的领导。

examples.text: We mourn for our fallen soldiers.
examples.translationZh: 我们哀悼阵亡的兵士。

examples.text: The old woman still mourns for her son.
examples.translationZh: 这位老太太还在为儿子的死伤心。

meaningZh: 存在；生存；生活

examples.text: Most scientists believe that water doesn't exist on the surface of the moon.
examples.translationZh: 多数科学家认为,月球表面不存在水。

examples.text: That department has ceased to exist.
examples.translationZh: 那部门已不复存在。

examples.text: Man cannot exist without air.
examples.translationZh: 没有空气人就不能生存。

meaningZh: 流汗，渗出；发酵；做苦工

examples.text: He is covered with sweat.
examples.translationZh: 他浑身是汗。

examples.text: Camel, soaked with sweat, makes a hand expression for "shush"secretly.
examples.translationZh: 满身大汗的卡梅尔悄悄地做出一个“嘘”的手势。

examples.text: She stood up to wipe the sweat off her face.
examples.translationZh: 她站起来擦擦脸上的汗珠。

meaningZh: 事例,实例；实情,情况；病例,病症,患者

examples.text: Talk of wasting money, my buying this car is a case in point.
examples.translationZh: 谈到浪费钱财,我买这台车就是个恰当的例子。

examples.text: In your case, we are prepared to be lenient.
examples.translationZh: 根据你的情况，我们拟予从宽处理

examples.text: But that is not always the case, sometimes the table can turn.
examples.translationZh: 但事情并不一定都是这样,有时情况会发生改变。

meaningZh: 无力，无能；残疾；[法]无能力，无资格

examples.text: She learned to triumph over her disability.
examples.translationZh: 她学会了战胜她自身的不足。

examples.text: His disability caused this thing to fail.
examples.translationZh: 他的无能导致了这件事失败。

examples.text: The accident caused a temporary disability.
examples.translationZh: 事故造成了短暂的机体无能。

meaningZh: 脚后跟，踵；（鞋、袜等的后跟）；（四足动物的）后脚

examples.text: His heel is raw because his shoe does not fit well.
examples.translationZh: 因鞋子不合适，他的脚后跟擦破皮了。

examples.text: I have a blister on my heel because my shoes are too tight.
examples.translationZh: 鞋子太紧了，我脚后跟起了个泡。

examples.text: He was about to crush the plant with his heel, when a new thought made him stop.
examples.translationZh: 他正想要用脚后跟践碎那株小草,而一个新的的念头使他停下来了。

meaningZh: 碗；一碗东西；碗状物

examples.text: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
examples.translationZh: 我每天早晨吃一碗麦片粥。

examples.text: His grandfather gave her an earthenware bowl.
examples.translationZh: 他的祖父给了她一个陶碗。

examples.text: Hollywood Bowl, the huge outdoor amphitheater, is very attractive.
examples.translationZh: 好莱坞圆形的露天剧场非常壮观。

meaningZh: 间隔；幕间休息；（数学）区间

examples.text: He comes back to see us at regular intervals.
examples.translationZh: 他每隔一段时间就回来看看我们。

examples.text: The proper intervals should be maintained between vehicles.
examples.translationZh: 车辆之间应保持适当的间距。

examples.text: The performance runs 2 hours 30 minutes including an interval.
examples.translationZh: 整个演出2小时30分,包括中间休息。

meaningZh: 处理者，经理，管理人；干事，理事；〈美〉（政党等的）领袖

examples.text: The manager let us cut the cackle.
examples.translationZh: 经理让我们不要闲谈。

examples.text: I want to speak to the sales manager.
examples.translationZh: 我想找营业部经理。

examples.text: He is the manager of the warehouse.
examples.translationZh: 他是这个仓库的管理者。

meaningZh: 栅栏，篱笆；围墙；防护物

examples.text: He tried to see over the fence but it was too high.
examples.translationZh: 他试图从栅栏上面看过去，但它太高了。

examples.text: He hired a workman to repair the fence.
examples.translationZh: 他雇用了一个工人修理围墙。

examples.text: That fence is the limit of the schoolyard.
examples.translationZh: 那堵围墙是校园的界限。

meaningZh: （木制）长凳，工作台；法官，法官席；（英国议会的）议员席

examples.text: This bench is made of elm.
examples.translationZh: 这条长凳是榆木制的。

examples.text: An old man sat on the park bench and fed the pigeon.
examples.translationZh: 一位老人坐在公园的长凳上喂鸽子。

examples.text: A young woman, of sullen aspect, was sitting alone on the bench.
examples.translationZh: 一个面色忧郁的年轻女人独自坐在长凳上。

meaningZh: 提升；增加；养育

examples.text: The percentage of the pay raise equals the increase in prices.
examples.translationZh: 薪水的提高比率和物价的上升一致。

examples.text: He got a raise in monthly wages.
examples.translationZh: 他的月薪增加了。

examples.text: The first thing that we did when we conquered the town was to haul down the enemy's flag and raise our own.
examples.translationZh: 我们占领这座城市以后以后所做的第一件事就是降下城里敌人的旗帜，升起我们自己的旗帜。

meaningZh: 减少，减小；减少量；vi.&vt. 减少，减小

examples.text: They are making further efforts to decrease military spending.
examples.translationZh: 他们正在做进一步的努力来减少军费开支。

examples.text: His interest in this subject gradually decreases.
examples.translationZh: 他对这门学科的兴趣逐渐减退。

examples.text: The government projected a tax decrease.
examples.translationZh: 政府计划降低税收。

meaningZh: 运动；活动；动作，举动

examples.text: If you did so, you would lose the movement of the knee.
examples.translationZh: 如果你这样做,你的膝关节就不能活动了。

examples.text: Loose clothing gives you greater freedom of movement.
examples.translationZh: 衣服宽松，可以活动自如。

examples.text: The Trade Union Movement works to obtain higher wages and better conditions.
examples.translationZh: 工会运动旨在争取更高的工资和更好的工作条件。

meaningZh: [U]页; 张；〈文〉重要事件；vt. 标记…的页数,翻页

examples.text: There are several faults in the page of figures.
examples.translationZh: 那一页的数字中有几个差错。

examples.text: Open your German readers at page 28.
examples.translationZh: 把德语课本翻到第28页。

examples.text: The page number is shown at the foot of the page.
examples.translationZh: 在页脚处可以看到页码。

meaningZh: 分；划分；分离

examples.text: White lines divide the playing area into sections.
examples.translationZh: 这些白线把赛区分成各个部分。

examples.text: I hope this disagreement will not divide us.
examples.translationZh: 我希望我们不会因这分歧而对立起来。

examples.text: Divide the cake into equal parts.
examples.translationZh: 把蛋糕分成等份。

meaningZh: 在这里；这时；在这一点上

examples.text: It is neither hot nor cold in winter here.
examples.translationZh: 这里冬天既不热也不冷。

examples.text: He has lived here for the last few years.
examples.translationZh: 过去的几年他一直住在这里。

examples.text: Here he stopped reading and looked up.
examples.translationZh: 这时他停止看书,抬头看了看。

meaningZh: 焦虑的；紧张不安的；神经质的

examples.text: The doctors shall operate on his central nervous system.
examples.translationZh: 医生们将要对他的中枢神经系统动手术。

examples.text: He is suffering from nervous tension.
examples.translationZh: 他正受神经紧张之苦。

examples.text: They can also help come calm and control nervous horses and got cheap guard sheep and gots goats on farms.
examples.translationZh: 它们也可以使紧张焦虑的马平静下来，它们同样可以保卫绵羊和山羊。

meaningZh: 意欲，计划；为特殊目的而设计；为特定用途而打算

examples.text: I haven't been to the exhibition, neither do I intend to go.
examples.translationZh: 我还没有看展览会,我也不想去。

examples.text: My husband trusts me and I don't intend to break that trust
examples.translationZh: 我的丈夫信任我,所以我不想失去这种信任

examples.text: I've chosen the main actors and we intend to put it on next January.
examples.translationZh: 我已经选好了主要演员,打算明年一月上演这出戏。

meaningZh: 建筑物；建造；解释

examples.text: China is striding ahead in her economic construction.
examples.translationZh: 中国正在经济建设方面大步前进。

examples.text: It is an object of simple construction.
examples.translationZh: 它是一个简单结构的物体。

examples.text: The cathedral is a fantastic modern construction.
examples.translationZh: 那个教堂是奇特的现代建筑。

meaningZh: 试图，努力；实验；审判

examples.text: This idea seems good but you need to try it out.
examples.translationZh: 这个想法似乎不错,但是需要试验一下。

examples.text: I think I'll try my luck at roulette.
examples.translationZh: 我想玩玩轮盘赌碰碰运气。

examples.text: He is trying his best to understand his meaning.
examples.translationZh: 他正在尽力弄明白他的意思。

meaningZh: 同时，其间；n. 其时，其间

examples.text: Father was cutting the grass, and meanwhile mother was planting roses.
examples.translationZh: 父亲在剪草,母亲在种玫瑰。

examples.text: Meanwhile, my debts were mounting up.
examples.translationZh: 同时，我的债务还在不断增加。

examples.text: Meanwhile they set aside part of their funds for the motorized boats.
examples.translationZh: 与此同时,他们拨出一部分资金购买机动帆船。

meaningZh: 树；木料；树状图

examples.text: We plant trees and flowers in spring.
examples.translationZh: 我们在春天种花种树。

examples.text: In the storm I took shelter under the tree.
examples.translationZh: 暴风雨时，我正在树下躲避。

examples.text: She sat very still under the tree.
examples.translationZh: 她在树底下静静地坐着。

meaningZh: 由于；适当的；预定

examples.text: When it comes to giving due respect to the old people, she feels a bit uneasy.
examples.translationZh: 说到给老人应有的尊敬,她有些不自在。

examples.text: The BBC must ensure that due impartiality is preserved in its news programmes.
examples.translationZh: 英国广播公司必须确保新闻节目保持应有的公正。

examples.text: If you're going to the library, would you mind returning this book for me? It's due today.
examples.translationZh: 如果你要去图书馆的话,是否介意替我还一下这本书呢?它今天到期。

meaningZh: 足够的；充足的，丰富的；宽敞的，广大的

examples.text: He has got ample stage experience, and won't get stage fright.
examples.translationZh: 他有丰富的舞台经验，不会怵场的。

examples.text: The region developed by leaps and bounds because of its ample mineral resources.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区由于有丰富的矿藏,所以发展得很快。

examples.text: The house has an ample parlor.
examples.translationZh: 这座房子有宽敞的客厅。

meaningZh: 来；开始；出现

examples.text: The train slowly came to the station.
examples.translationZh: 火车缓缓地进站。

examples.text: He will come on time even though it rains.
examples.translationZh: 即使下雨，他还是会准时来的。

examples.text: They came to a river.
examples.translationZh: 他们来到河边。

meaningZh: 手势，姿势；举止，动作；〔古语〕仪态

examples.text: Japanese don't use as much gesture as Europeans.
examples.translationZh: 日本人使用手势没有欧美人那样多。

examples.text: The children were diverted with his funny gesture.
examples.translationZh: 他那滑稽的手势使孩子们很开心。

examples.text: He put his arm round her in a protective gesture.
examples.translationZh: 他用一只手臂围住她做出保护的姿势。

meaningZh: 创办，成立，建立；v. 发现（ find的过去式）；找到

examples.text: This business company was founded in 1724.
examples.translationZh: 这家商业公司建立于1724年。

examples.text: A good relationship has to be founded on trust.
examples.translationZh: 基于信任建立良好的关系。

examples.text: They founded a college.
examples.translationZh: 他们创办了一所大学。

meaningZh: 风景，景色；舞台布景；风景画

examples.text: The scenery is beautiful beyond description.
examples.translationZh: 那里的风光美得难以描述。

examples.text: We admired the splendor of the mountain scenery.
examples.translationZh: 我们赞赏着壮丽的山景。

examples.text: He asked us to lash the scenery up with rope.
examples.translationZh: 他要我们用绳子把舞台背景绑起来。

meaningZh: 走；步行；散步

examples.text: I missed the bus and had to walk home.
examples.translationZh: 我没赶上公共汽车，只好走回家。

examples.text: The car's kaput we'll have to walk.
examples.translationZh: 汽车坏了--我们只好步行。

examples.text: I will walk you home.
examples.translationZh: 我陪你走回家。

meaningZh: 餐，饭；进餐（时间）；〈英〉一次挤奶量

examples.text: My mother usually cooks a hot meal in the evening.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈通常在晚上煮一顿热饭。

examples.text: This is the best meal I had ever eaten.
examples.translationZh: 这是我所吃过的最好的一餐。

examples.text: That restaurant provided us with a good meal.
examples.translationZh: 饭店给我们提供了美味的膳食。

meaningZh: （在）今天；现在；现今

examples.text: Today is my birthday.
examples.translationZh: 今天是我的生日。

examples.text: Today is Thursday.
examples.translationZh: 今天是星期四。

examples.text: The fashions of today change very quickly.
examples.translationZh: 现今的时装式样变换很快。

meaningZh: 门，户；出入口；一家[户]

examples.text: He chiseled a hole in the door to fit a new lock.
examples.translationZh: 他在门上凿了个孔，以便装一把新锁。

examples.text: Somebody opened the door and the candle blew out.
examples.translationZh: 有人打开了门，蜡烛随之被吹灭了。

examples.text: He sprang up and rushed to the door.
examples.translationZh: 他跳起身，跑到门口。

meaningZh: 全体船员；全体乘务员；一群，一帮

examples.text: The ship set sail after all the crew came on board.
examples.translationZh: 全体船员上船后，船就开了。

examples.text: The crew abandoned the sinking ship.
examples.translationZh: 全体船员离开了正在下沉的船。

examples.text: The plane crashed, killing all its passengers and crew.
examples.translationZh: 飞机失事了，所有乘客和机组人员都遇难了。

meaningZh: 神圣的；值得尊敬的，值得推崇的；圣洁的，圣徒般的

examples.text: To the children, their father's study was the holy of holies.
examples.translationZh: 在这些孩子的眼里，父亲的书房是最神圣的地方。

examples.text: Jerusalem was regarded as the holy place by the Christians.
examples.translationZh: 耶路撒冷被基督徒们认为是圣地。

examples.text: They led a holy life.
examples.translationZh: 他们过着圣洁的生活。

meaningZh: 争论，争吵；论据；[数]幅角

examples.text: She handled a difficult argument skilfully.
examples.translationZh: 她巧妙地应付了一场艰难的辩论。

examples.text: This argument, however, does not hold water.
examples.translationZh: 但是,这种观点是站不住脚的。

examples.text: This point is vital to my argument.
examples.translationZh: 这一点对我的论据极为重要。

meaningZh: 英亩；土地，耕地；[口]大量

examples.text: The shepherd has penned up the sheep in the four acre field.
examples.translationZh: 牧羊人把羊群围在那块四英亩的土地上。

examples.text: The house has half an acre of lawn.
examples.translationZh: 这座房子有半英亩草坪。

examples.text: We own 100 acres of farmland.
examples.translationZh: 我们拥有一百英亩农田。

meaningZh: 发热，发烧；热病；一时的狂热

examples.text: Football fever gripped the town when the local team reached the cup final.
examples.translationZh: 在当地的足球队打进了优胜杯的决赛圈后，全市掀起一阵足球热。

examples.text: War fever was rising all over the Middle East.
examples.translationZh: 战争狂热正在整个中东地区升温。

examples.text: Her fever lasted five days without intermission.
examples.translationZh: 她连续五天一直发烧。

meaningZh: 这样；很；（表示程度）这么

examples.text: He felt pity for a man suffering so much.
examples.translationZh: 他对那个受过那么多痛苦的人感到同情。

examples.text: How could you be so stupid as to believe him?
examples.translationZh: 你怎么这么笨竟相信他的话？

examples.text: Stand with your arms out, so.
examples.translationZh: 两臂伸开站著，就这样。

meaningZh: 科学家；科学工作者

examples.text: The young girl aspired to be a scientist.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩立志要做一名科学家。

examples.text: When will scientist conquer cancer?
examples.translationZh: 科学家什么时候才能征服癌症呢？

examples.text: The scientist needs some delicate instruments.
examples.translationZh: 这位科学家需要一些精密的仪器。

meaningZh: 每个；每；所有可能的

examples.text: Every citizen should be obedient to the law.
examples.translationZh: 每个公民都应当是遵守法律的。

examples.text: He received the fixed dole every month.
examples.translationZh: 他每个月都能领到固定的救济金。

examples.text: I have had to work for every single penny I earned.
examples.translationZh: 我挣的每一便士都是辛苦工作得来的。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. 读; 看懂,理解；vt. 显示; 标明

examples.text: Only a few of the children there can read.
examples.translationZh: 那里只有几个小孩识字。

examples.text: Read the text slowly and deliberately.
examples.translationZh: 缓慢,有意的读全文。

examples.text: Every man is a volume if you know how to read him.
examples.translationZh: 每一个人都是一卷书,只要你懂得如何阅读它。

meaningZh: 承认；同意；承兑

examples.text: We gave him a present,but he did not accept it.
examples.translationZh: 我们给他一件礼物,但他不肯接受。

examples.text: She is too independent to accept charity.
examples.translationZh: 她很强调自力更生,不肯接受赈济。

examples.text: she accepted the judge's decision.
examples.translationZh: 她同意了法官的判决。

meaningZh: 哪一个；哪一些；哪个

examples.text: Which book have you read?
examples.translationZh: 哪一本书你读过了？

examples.text: Here are the designs. Which ones do you prefer?
examples.translationZh: 这就是那些图样。你喜欢哪一些?

examples.text: It's hard to say which is better.
examples.translationZh: 很难说哪一个好些。

meaningZh: 表示可能；表示许可；表示询问情况

examples.text: That might be in your favor.
examples.translationZh: 那可能对你有利。

examples.text: You might do me a favor?
examples.translationZh: 你或许能帮我—个忙吧?

examples.text: If someone had been with him, he might not have been drowned.
examples.translationZh: 如果有人在他旁边，或许他就不会溺死。

meaningZh: 口头讲的；口头的；口语的

examples.text: She has a good command of spoken English.
examples.translationZh: 她的英语口语很熟练。

examples.text: Fluency in spoken English is a major requirement.
examples.translationZh: 主要条件为英语口语流利。

meaningZh: 独立，自主；足够维持闭居生活的收入；独立心

examples.text: The country attained its independence in 1972.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家在1972年获得了独立。

examples.text: The government adopted an uncompromising posture on the issue of independence.
examples.translationZh: 政府在独立的问题上采取了毫不妥协的态度。

examples.text: I tried to preserve my independence.
examples.translationZh: 我试图保持自己的独立性。

meaningZh: 饭店；餐馆；饭馆

examples.text: This restaurant gets three stars in the guidebook.
examples.translationZh: 这家餐馆在旅游指南中标有三颗星。

examples.text: There are many streamers in front of the restaurant.
examples.translationZh: 饭店门前有许多长条旗。

examples.text: I had my breakfast in the small restaurant.
examples.translationZh: 我在一家小饭馆里吃了早饭。

meaningZh: 延迟，拖延；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间

examples.text: It was impossible to delay her at such a crisis.
examples.translationZh: 在这样一个紧要关头来耽搁她是不可能的。

examples.text: We decided to delay our wedding until next year.
examples.translationZh: 我们决定把婚礼推迟到明年。

examples.text: Our plane was delayed by fog.
examples.translationZh: 我们的飞机因大雾而误点了。

meaningZh: 视力；看见；视野

examples.text: I'm having laser treatment to improve my sight.
examples.translationZh: 我正在接受激光治疗来提高我的视力。

examples.text: The captain ordered us to shoot any strangers on sight.
examples.translationZh: 船长命令我们凡是看见的陌生人都要将其枪毙。

examples.text: The train is still in sight.
examples.translationZh: 火车仍在视线内。

meaningZh: 极好的；很大的；怪诞的

examples.text: We watched a fantastic play yesterday evening.
examples.translationZh: 昨天晚上我们看了一场非常精彩的演出。

examples.text: I have a fantastic amount of work to do.
examples.translationZh: 我有大量的工作要做。

examples.text: My daughter likes to describe her fantastic dreams to me.
examples.translationZh: 我女儿喜欢给我讲她那些奇怪的梦。

meaningZh: 打折扣，减价出售；减息贷款；削价出售，打折

examples.text: These goods will be sold at a discount.
examples.translationZh: 这些货物将减价出售。

examples.text: We give 10 percent discount for cash.
examples.translationZh: 现金付款，我们九折优惠。

examples.text: The discount rate is set by the Fed.
examples.translationZh: 贴现率是由联储决定的。

meaningZh: 统治；管理；治理

examples.text: Education makes a people easy to lead, but difficult to drive: easy to govern but impossible to slave.
examples.translationZh: 教育让一个民族容易被领导，却很难被驱使；容易被统治，却很难被奴役。

examples.text: You must not be governed by the opinions of others.
examples.translationZh: 你决不要受别人意见的支配。

examples.text: Such laws also govern the chances of commodity production and exchange.
examples.translationZh: 这种规律也支配着商品生产和商品交换的偶然性：

meaningZh: 金银财宝；宝藏；珍宝

examples.text: A nation's treasure is in its scholars.
examples.translationZh: 学者是国家的财富。

examples.text: This museum has many art treasures.
examples.translationZh: 这家博物馆收藏了许多艺术珍品。

examples.text: They went to the cave in quest of hidden treasure.
examples.translationZh: 他们到山洞去寻找宝藏。

meaningZh: (he的所有格)他的；(he的物主代词)他的东西；det. 属于他的，用于名词前

examples.text: Next Tuesday is his birthday.
examples.translationZh: 下周二是他的生日。

examples.text: He claims it was his idea.
examples.translationZh: 他声称这是他的主意。

examples.text: His brother is my classmate.
examples.translationZh: 他哥哥是我的同学。

meaningZh: [数]长方形，矩形

examples.text: Rectangle is coming into fashion.
examples.translationZh: 长方形开始流行了。

examples.text: He folded his newspaper into a neat rectangle.
examples.translationZh: 他将报纸折成一个整整齐齐的长方形。

examples.text: A rectangle has four right angles.
examples.translationZh: 一个矩形有四个直角。

meaningZh: 安全；保证，担保；保护，防护

examples.text: I'll undertake for your security.
examples.translationZh: 我将保证你的安全。

examples.text: The visitors were secarched for security reasons.
examples.translationZh: 为了安全起见,来宾受到了检查。

examples.text: Our own actions are our security.
examples.translationZh: 我们的行为是自己的保证。

meaningZh: 发明，创造；虚构

examples.text: Can you tell me who invented the telephone?
examples.translationZh: 你能告诉我是谁发明了电话？

examples.text: He always strives to invent something new.
examples.translationZh: 他一直努力要发明新东西。

examples.text: The fact was that China was the first country to invent paper.
examples.translationZh: 事实是中国是发明纸的第一个国家。

meaningZh: 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的

examples.text: I think international calls are very expensive.
examples.translationZh: 我认为国际电话费用很高。

examples.text: The country violated the international agreement.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家违反了国际协议。

examples.text: The drug problem is international.
examples.translationZh: 毒品问题是世界性的。

examples.translationZh: 比赛时所有的朋友都为我喝彩。

meaningZh: 提倡；拥护；鼓吹

examples.text: Many educators advocate a liberal education.
examples.translationZh: 很多教育家提倡通才教育。

examples.text: We don't advocate learning by rote.
examples.translationZh: 死记硬背的学习方法，我们是不提倡的。

examples.text: Many people advocate building more hospitals.
examples.translationZh: 许多人主张增设医院。

meaningZh: 地毯，桌毯；毛毯，绒毯；地毯状覆盖物

examples.text: This carpet is of Russian style.
examples.translationZh: 这块地毯是俄国风格的。

examples.text: Our living room is covered with a carpet.
examples.translationZh: 我们的起居室里铺了地毯。

examples.text: A carpet of leaves covered the ground.
examples.translationZh: 一层厚厚的落叶覆盖在地上。

meaningZh: 证词；证据；迹象

examples.text: There wasn't enough evidence to prove his guilt.
examples.translationZh: 没有充分的证据能证明他有罪。

examples.text: Evidence weighted against the defendant.
examples.translationZh: 证词很不利于被告。

examples.text: It is a statement in conflict with other evidence.
examples.translationZh: 这一陈述与其他证词不一致。

meaningZh: 付款；偿还；补偿

examples.text: I'd like to pay with my credit card.
examples.translationZh: 我想用信用卡支付。

examples.text: My firm pays well.
examples.translationZh: 我公司工酬优厚。

examples.text: Let me pay for dinner.
examples.translationZh: 晚饭让我来付。

meaningZh: 更新，使现代化；校正，修正；n. 现代化

examples.text: The data should be updated once a week.
examples.translationZh: 这些数据应该每星期更新一次。

examples.text: The feedback from the computer enables us to update the program.
examples.translationZh: 计算机的反馈能使我们更新程序。

examples.text: I would advise you to update the software.
examples.translationZh: 我建议你把这个软件升级。

meaningZh: 楼梯；（楼梯的）一级

examples.text: The child was sitting on the bottom stair.
examples.translationZh: 那孩子正坐在楼梯最下面的一级上。

examples.text: Clutch stair armrest, move carefully step by step.
examples.translationZh: 抓紧楼梯扶手，一步步谨慎地移动。

meaningZh: 酸味的；尖刻的；酸的

examples.text: Acids react with bases to form salts.
examples.translationZh: 酸与碱反应生成盐。

examples.text: The acid burnt a hole in the carpet.
examples.translationZh: 酸把地毯烧了个洞。

examples.text: The acid has burnt a hole in my jacket.
examples.translationZh: 这种酸把我的上衣烧了一个窟窿。

meaningZh: (用于表示简单将来式) 将,要,会；愿意,准备；(用于表示推测,与must类似)大概,可能

examples.text: A country must have the will to repel any invader.
examples.translationZh: 一个国家得有决心击退任何入侵者。

examples.text: Free will makes us able to choose our way of life.
examples.translationZh: 自由的意志使我们可以选择自己的生活方式。

examples.text: The rich man left his son nothing in the will.
examples.translationZh: 那位富翁在遗嘱中什么都没给他儿子留下。

meaningZh: 获得，得到；流行；买到，达到（目的）

examples.text: He failed to obtain a scholarship.
examples.translationZh: 他没有获得奖学金。

examples.text: At last, their company obtained the mining concession.
examples.translationZh: 他们的公司最终获得了采矿权。

examples.text: Those who were penitent obtained absolution.
examples.translationZh: 悔过者获得了赦免。

meaningZh: 子夜，午夜；漆黑；一段黑暗阴暗的时间

examples.text: The mail was sorted and pouched by midnight.
examples.translationZh: 邮件在午夜前分拣装包。

examples.text: We finally got some shut-eye after midnight.
examples.translationZh: 午夜过後我们总算睡了一会儿。

meaningZh: 链子，链条；连锁，连续；拘束

examples.text: Though you seek in garments the freedom of privacy you may find in them a harness and a chain.
examples.translationZh: 你们想借着衣服得到隐私的自由,反而却因此为之羁绊和束缚。

examples.text: She wore a silver chain around her neck.
examples.translationZh: 她脖子上戴着一条银项链。

examples.text: He detached a link from a chain.
examples.translationZh: 他从链子上拆下一个链环。

meaningZh: 包含，容纳；克制，遏制；牵制

examples.text: The atlas contains forty maps.
examples.translationZh: 这个地图集有四十幅地图。

examples.text: Does each cup contain the same amount of milk?
examples.translationZh: 每个杯子里的牛奶都一样多吗?

examples.text: This book contains all the information you need.
examples.translationZh: 这本书包含你所需的一切资料。

meaningZh: 手套；棒球手套；拳击手套

examples.text: It's getting cool and I have to take out my woolen gloves.
examples.translationZh: 天气变冷了，我不得不把毛线手套拿出来了。

examples.text: The finger of my glove has a hole.
examples.translationZh: 我手套的指头处有个洞。

examples.text: I rarely lose a left-hand glove.
examples.translationZh: 我很少脱下左手手套。

meaningZh: 地面，土地；基础；范围

examples.text: You shouldn't sit on the ground when it's wet.
examples.translationZh: 地面潮湿时就不应该坐在地上。

examples.text: The expedition covered a lot of ground.
examples.translationZh: 探险队到过很多地方。

examples.text: Boredom is not a ground for divorce.
examples.translationZh: 日久生厌不能成为离婚的理由。

meaningZh: 旅游，观光；旅游业

examples.text: Tourism was then still in its infant stage.
examples.translationZh: 旅游业当时还处在初创阶段。

examples.text: We should work on improving our tourism industry.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该努力改进我们的旅游业。

examples.text: The island has been ruined by tourism.
examples.translationZh: 该岛毁在旅游业上了。

meaningZh: 的复数；adj. 那些的，那；n. 那，那个( that的名词复数)

examples.text: Successful are those who are willing to take pains.
examples.translationZh: 成功的人都是那些肯努力的人。

examples.text: The oranges in the box are better than those on the shelf.
examples.translationZh: 箱子的橙子比橱上的那些好。

examples.text: Let's forget about those worries.
examples.translationZh: 咱们忘掉那些烦恼的事吧。

meaningZh: 极端的，过激的；极限的，非常的；末端的

examples.text: Extreme cold can wake a hibernating animal.
examples.translationZh: 极度的寒冷能使正在冬眠的动物苏醒。

examples.text: The extreme heat sapped his strength and health.
examples.translationZh: 极度的暑热逐渐损耗他的体力兴健康。

examples.text: Extreme poverty had reduced them to a state of apathy.
examples.translationZh: 极端的贫困使他们万念俱灰。

meaningZh: （使）结婚；娶；嫁

examples.text: He will marry the girl first or last.
examples.translationZh: 他迟早会娶那姑娘的。

examples.text: My hope is that I can marry her.
examples.translationZh: 我的希望是能娶她。

examples.text: Much as I like her, I will not marry her.
examples.translationZh: 我虽然很喜欢她，却不打算娶她。

meaningZh: 勇气；胆量；魄力

examples.text: He showed remarkable courage when he faced the danger.
examples.translationZh: 他在面对危险的时候表现出非凡的勇气。

examples.text: I don't think I have the courage to tell him the bad news.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得我没有勇气告诉他这个坏消息。

examples.text: Do you have the courage to go bungee jumping?
examples.translationZh: 你有胆量玩蹦极跳吗?

meaningZh: 陡峭的，险峻的；过分的，夸张的；极高的

examples.text: This hill is too steep to ride up on a bicycle.
examples.translationZh: 这山太陡了，骑自行车可上不去。

examples.text: The last part of the ascent is very steep.
examples.translationZh: 最后一段上坡路很陡。

examples.text: The bus toiled up the steep hill.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车艰难地爬上陡峭的山岗。

meaningZh: 状态；环境；健康状况

examples.text: Conditions in poor quarters were horrible.
examples.translationZh: 城里穷人居住区条件十分糟糕。

examples.text: I had halfway decided to accept their conditions at that time.
examples.translationZh: 当时我已差不多决定要接受他们的条件了。

examples.text: The terrorists will only release their hostage on certain condition.
examples.translationZh: 恐怖分子只有在某些条件下才释放人质。

meaningZh: 发誓；咒骂；n. 发誓，宣誓

examples.text: Shut up! How dare you swear at me like that!
examples.translationZh: 住嘴，你竟敢那样咒骂我!

examples.text: You have no right to swear at me like that!
examples.translationZh: 你无权那样咒骂我！

examples.text: I swear by Almighty God that I will tell the truth.
examples.translationZh: 我对万能的上帝发誓我要说真话。

meaningZh: 美味的，可口的；高雅的，有品味的；有趣的

examples.text: These pancakes made by my mother are really tasty.
examples.translationZh: 我妈妈做的这些煎饼非常好吃。

examples.text: He larded the duck with pig fat to make it tasty.
examples.translationZh: 他给鸭肉加了点猪油使它美味可口。

examples.text: Dried cuttlefish is a tasty snack.
examples.translationZh: 鱿鱼丝是很好吃的点心。

meaningZh: 堕落的，道德败坏的；贪污的，腐败的；腐烂的

examples.text: She wrote a book declaiming against our corrupt society.
examples.translationZh: 她写了一本书抨击我们这腐败的社会。

examples.text: The corrupt judge dismissed the case without a hearing.
examples.translationZh: 腐败的法官没有听审就驳回了这个案子。

examples.text: The official led a corrupt life.
examples.translationZh: 这个官员过着堕落的生活。

meaningZh: 髭；小胡子；触须

examples.text: His lips are roofed by a moustache.
examples.translationZh: 他的嘴唇被小胡子遮盖住了。

examples.text: He had a small black moustache which was neatly trimmed.
examples.translationZh: 他留着一小撮修剪整齐的黑色小胡子。

examples.text: His grey hair and moustache were neatly trimmed.
examples.translationZh: 他灰白的头发和八字须修剪得很整洁。

meaningZh: 灰浆桶

examples.text: The worker carried bricks in a hod.
examples.translationZh: 工人用灰浆桶搬砖。

meaningZh: 流；垂；流出

examples.text: The government is trying to stop the increasing flow of refugees entering the country.
examples.translationZh: 政府正在设法阻止越来越多的难民流入本国。

examples.text: The flow of melted snow cascaded down the mountainside and into the river.
examples.translationZh: 溶化的雪水如瀑布般沿着山崖边泻入河里。

examples.text: I saw the ebb and flow of the sea.
examples.translationZh: 我目睹了海潮的涨落。

meaningZh: 很少的；很少；（与复数名词和复数动词连用）有些

examples.text: We saw few students there.
examples.translationZh: 我们在那儿几乎没看见学生。

examples.text: The sunny intervals we were promised have been few and far between.
examples.translationZh: 我们原可望能有几阵晴天，结果却很稀少。

examples.text: Very few girls went to school then.
examples.translationZh: 那时几乎没有女孩子去上学。

meaningZh: 习惯的；通常的；独有的

examples.text: He was accustomed to command, not to entreat.
examples.translationZh: 他习惯于发号施令，而不是恳求他人。

examples.text: You will soon get accustomed to the climate here.
examples.translationZh: 你会很快习惯这里的气候的。

examples.text: I might have been incredulous had I not been accustomed to such responses.
examples.translationZh: 若非我已经习惯了这样的回答，我可能不敢轻易相信。

meaningZh: 印象，感觉；影响，效果；盖印，印记

examples.text: Her gentleness has given me a deep impression.
examples.translationZh: 她的亲切给我留下了很深的印象。

examples.text: I am surprised you've got an unfavorable impression of him.
examples.translationZh: 我很惊讶你对他印象不佳。

examples.text: I had the impression that your boy hates school.
examples.translationZh: 我感觉你的孩子不喜欢去上学。

meaningZh: 农业；农耕；农业生产

examples.text: I know nothing about agriculture.
examples.translationZh: 我对农业一窍不通。

examples.text: Modern agriculture is spoiling our beautiful countryside.
examples.translationZh: 现代农业正在破坏我们美丽的农村。

examples.text: Agriculture in this country has developed greatly after liberation.
examples.translationZh: 解放后这个国家的农业得到了巨大的发展。

meaningZh: 必要的；强制的；必然的

examples.text: She will make necessary arrangements.
examples.translationZh: 她会作好必要的准备。

examples.text: If necessary, please warehouse the goods.
examples.translationZh: 如有必要，请将该货存入仓库。

examples.text: The necessary outcome of a war is a fall in production.
examples.translationZh: 战争带来的必然结果就是生产力下降。

meaningZh: 工厂，制造厂；代理店

examples.text: I got a job in a textile factory.
examples.translationZh: 我在一家纺织厂找到一份工作。

examples.text: The company wished to locate its new factory beside the river.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司希望把新工厂建在河边。

examples.text: The car factory is situated on the edge of the town.
examples.translationZh: 这座汽车制造厂坐落在该城的边上。

meaningZh: 军队；陆军；团体

examples.text: The battlefield is full of the army.
examples.translationZh: 军队布满了战场。

examples.text: He joined the army a year ago.
examples.translationZh: 一年以前，他参军了。

examples.text: The head of state was deposed by the army.
examples.translationZh: 国家元首被军队废黜了。

meaningZh: 拉紧的；肌肉绷紧的；神经紧张的

examples.text: Try to act naturally, even if you're tense.
examples.translationZh: 即使紧张也不要做作。

examples.text: It is difficult to be natural when one is tense.
examples.translationZh: 人在紧张的时候很难泰然自若。

examples.text: She was gently massaging the tense muscles of his neck.
examples.translationZh: 她温柔地按摩着他脖子上绷紧的肌肉。

meaningZh: 速度；比率；等级

examples.text: House price is rising at a higher rate than inflation.
examples.translationZh: 房价比通货膨胀上涨的比率高。

examples.text: The birth rate is the number of births compared to the number of the people.
examples.translationZh: 出生率是出生数与人口数的比率。

examples.text: Prices keep rising at a dizzy rate.
examples.translationZh: 物价以极快的速度不断上涨。

meaningZh: 辩护；防御；防御工事

examples.text: Humour is a more effective defence than violence.
examples.translationZh: 幽默是比暴力更有效的防御武器。

examples.text: They planned the defence of the town.
examples.translationZh: 他们订出了该城的防御计划。

examples.text: They took up arms in defence of their country.
examples.translationZh: 他们拿起武器保卫祖国。

meaningZh: （反身代词）他自己；（用以加强语气）他亲自，他本人

examples.text: He is smart and can take care of himself.
examples.translationZh: 他很精明可以照顾他自己。

examples.text: His new house was built by himself, brick by brick.
examples.translationZh: 他的新房子是他自己一块砖一块砖砌起来的。

meaningZh: 统计，统计学，统计法，统计资料；统计数字；“statistic”的复数

examples.text: He is a professor of statistics.
examples.translationZh: 他教授统计学。

examples.text: There is a compulsory course in statistics.
examples.translationZh: 有一门统计学的必修课。

examples.text: Get me a printout of the statistics.
examples.translationZh: 给我一份打印出的统计资料。

meaningZh: 卫星；人造卫星；卫星国

examples.text: Troop movements can be observed from space by a satellite.
examples.translationZh: 藉助卫星可观察到部队的调动。

examples.text: The equipment picked up the signal from the satellite.
examples.translationZh: 这设备收到了卫星发出的信号。

examples.text: The bbc is hooked up with Australian television by satellite.
examples.translationZh: 英国广播公司通过卫星与澳大利亚电视实行联播。

meaningZh: 食品商；杂货商

examples.text: She is a Chinese grocer's daughter.
examples.translationZh: 她是个华裔食品杂货商的女儿。

examples.text: The grocer sparred with her outside his store.
examples.translationZh: 杂货商在店外和她吵起来了。

examples.text: There's a grocer's at the corner of the street.
examples.translationZh: 在街道的转弯处有一个食品杂货店。

meaningZh: 猪肉；〈美俚〉支持政党上台所分到的好处，政治分肥；〈古〉猪

examples.text: The little girl only eats lean pork.
examples.translationZh: 这个小女孩只吃瘦肉。

examples.text: In some religions pork is considered impure.
examples.translationZh: 某些宗教认为猪肉是亵渎的。

meaningZh: 受苦，遭难；苦楚，苦难；令人痛苦的事

examples.text: He watched her suffering with clinical detachment.
examples.translationZh: 他冷漠地看著她遭受的痛苦。

examples.text: Her words mitigated my suffering.
examples.translationZh: 她的话减轻了我的痛苦。

examples.text: She bore her sufferings bravely.
examples.translationZh: 她勇敢地承受艰难困苦。

meaningZh: 使相信，说服，使承认；使明白；使确信

examples.text: I try to convince him of the reality of the danger.
examples.translationZh: 我试图使他相信危险的确存在。

examples.text: It took many hours to convince me of his guilt.
examples.translationZh: 研究了许多个小时我才相信他有罪。

examples.text: He convinced me of his sincerity.
examples.translationZh: 他使我确信他的真诚。

meaningZh: 进口，进口商品；输入；重要性

examples.text: The government has imposed strict controls over the import of luxury goods.
examples.translationZh: 政府对奢侈品的进口采取了严格的管制。

examples.text: You should grasp the import of your mother's remarks.
examples.translationZh: 你应该领会到你妈妈说话的含义。

examples.text: The miscellaneous expenses of import are so much!
examples.translationZh: 进口货物的杂费太多了！

meaningZh: 卖，售；使好卖；使接受，使赞成

examples.text: Her name will help to sell the film.
examples.translationZh: 有她的名字，这部影片就卖座。

examples.text: The group's record has sold millions.
examples.translationZh: 他们的唱片已经售出了千千万万张了。

examples.text: I'd like to buy your house if you are willing to sell it.
examples.translationZh: 如果你愿意卖的话，我想买你的房子。

meaningZh: 是（be的三单形式；n. 存在

examples.text: Spain is our favorite holiday spot.
examples.translationZh: 西班牙是我们喜欢的度假地点。

examples.text: The boy is 150 centimeters tall.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩有150厘米高。

examples.text: There is no doubt about it.
examples.translationZh: 那是毫无疑问的。

meaningZh: 阶段；舞台；戏剧

examples.text: She stood alone on the enormous stage.
examples.translationZh: 她孤零零地站在巨大的舞台上。

examples.text: He quitted the stage of politics.
examples.translationZh: 他退出了政治舞台。

examples.text: Novels are often adapted for the stage.
examples.translationZh: 小说常常改编为戏剧。

meaningZh: 信任；信托；照管

examples.text: A good marriage is based on trust.
examples.translationZh: 美满的婚姻是建立在互相信任的基础上的。

examples.text: In his will he created trusts for his children.
examples.translationZh: 他在遗嘱里为子女安排好了信托财产。

examples.text: You must trust in your own judgement.
examples.translationZh: 你得相信自己的判断力.

meaningZh: 遥远的；冷漠的，冷淡的；远离的，远隔的

examples.text: His stepson is still very distant towards him.
examples.translationZh: 他的继子对他仍然很疏远。

examples.text: Her manner was cold and distant.
examples.translationZh: 她的态度冷漠而疏远。

examples.text: It snows all the year round in that distant little village.
examples.translationZh: 在那个遥远的小村落里整年下雪。

meaningZh: 祖国，家乡；（南非种族隔离制度下的）黑人住宅区

examples.text: They yearned to go back to their homeland.
examples.translationZh: 他们念念不忘要回到祖国。

examples.text: The overseas are very glad to set foot on their homeland.
examples.translationZh: 华侨们非常高兴地踏上祖国的土地。

examples.text: He came to miss his homeland when he settled down abroad.
examples.translationZh: 当他在国外安定下来时，他开始想念祖国了。

meaningZh: 酿酒厂，啤酒厂

examples.text: Workers at the Tsingtao Brewery bottle beer for export.
examples.translationZh: 青岛啤酒厂的工人为出口的啤酒装瓶。

examples.text: He worked in a brewery, loading the bottles into wooden crates.
examples.translationZh: 他在一个啤酒厂工作，把瓶子装进木箱里。

examples.text: I work in a brewery but strangely enough I never drink beer.
examples.translationZh: 我在酿酒厂工作，但是奇怪的是我从不喝啤酒。

meaningZh: 强大的；权力大的；（药）有效地

examples.text: This defeat was a powerful blow to the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这次失败是对敌人的有力的打击。

examples.text: The elephant grinds its food with its powerful molars.
examples.translationZh: 象用其强有力的臼齿嚼碎食物。

examples.text: Russia used to be a very powerful country.
examples.translationZh: 俄国曾是一个非常强大的国家。

meaningZh: 卡片；纸牌；明信片

examples.text: They play cards every Friday.
examples.translationZh: 他们每个星期五玩纸牌。

examples.text: No one understood how I did the card trick.
examples.translationZh: 谁也没有看出来我是怎样玩纸牌戏法的。

examples.text: I have received eleven Christmas cards by now.
examples.translationZh: 到现在为止，我已经收到了十一张圣诞卡片。

meaningZh: 模式；花样，样品；图案

examples.text: The two buildings are modeled after the same pattern.
examples.translationZh: 这两座建筑是按照同一模式建造的。

examples.text: Training and education follow different patterns in different regions.
examples.translationZh: 培训和教育在不同的地区遵循不同的模式。

examples.text: This cloth has a pattern of blue and white squares.
examples.translationZh: 这种布有蓝白格子的图案。

meaningZh: 毕业；毕业典礼；刻度，分度

examples.text: I saw little or nothing of him after graduation.
examples.translationZh: 毕业后我几乎没有看见过他。

examples.text: After graduation, he lives on his own.
examples.translationZh: 毕业后他就独立生活了。

examples.text: He worked as a magistrate after graduation.
examples.translationZh: 他毕业后任地方行政长官。

meaningZh: （同班）同学；级友

examples.text: He is my classmate of junior middle school.
examples.translationZh: 他是我初中时的同班同学。

examples.text: He helped a classmate who was behind with his homework.
examples.translationZh: 他帮助一位没有按时完成作业的同班同学。

meaningZh: 面部的；面部用的；表面的

examples.text: She is having a facial massage.
examples.translationZh: 她正做脸部按摩。

examples.text: The cream dissolves facial hair.
examples.translationZh: 这种化妆品能清除脸上的汗毛。

examples.text: She wiped off the sweat from her face with a piece of facial tissue.
examples.translationZh: 她用一张面巾纸擦掉脸上的汗水。

meaningZh: 指甲

examples.text: He tapped Nim's memo with a fingernail.
examples.translationZh: 他用指甲轻轻地弹了弹尼姆的备忘录。

examples.text: He clipped off the few hairs of his spare beard with a fingernail clipper.
examples.translationZh: 他用一把指甲剪剪去几根胡须。

meaningZh: 分类，归类；把…列为密件

examples.text: The books in the library are classified by subject.
examples.translationZh: 图书馆的书是按科目分类的。

examples.text: We can classify these subjects under three headings.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以将这些题目加以分类成三个主题。

examples.text: Would you classify her novels as serious literature or other?
examples.translationZh: 你认为她的小说属于文学类，还是其它类?

meaningZh: 旅馆，宾馆，酒店，饭店；vt. 使…在饭店下榻；vi. 进行旅馆式办公

examples.text: This is the identical hotel we stayed at last year.
examples.translationZh: 这就是我们去年住过的旅馆。

examples.text: The front of the postcard shows a picture of our hotel.
examples.translationZh: 明信片正面是我们旅馆的图片。

examples.text: We stayed at a small hotel.
examples.translationZh: 我们住在一家小旅馆里。

meaningZh: 军队；一群；[军]骑兵连

examples.text: There is a troop of monkeys in the woods.
examples.translationZh: 林子中有一群猴子。

examples.text: The enemy made a thrust against our troop.
examples.translationZh: 敌人向我军发动了袭击。

examples.text: The troop made good their retreat from the occupied city.
examples.translationZh: 部队从沦陷的城市安全撤出。

meaningZh: 有礼貌的；有教养的，文雅的；上流社会的

examples.text: It is not polite of you to cut the speaker short.
examples.translationZh: 你打断发言者的话,真不礼貌。

examples.text: This boy is polite to everyone.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩对所有人都很礼貌。

examples.text: You may be busy, but you should be polite at least.
examples.translationZh: 你可能很忙,但无论如何你应客气点。

meaningZh: 想要；希望；打算

examples.text: I want large ones, not small ones.
examples.translationZh: 我要大的, 不要小的。

examples.text: He wants me to go with him.
examples.translationZh: 他希望我同他一起去。

examples.text: What they talked about is what we want to know.
examples.translationZh: 他们谈论什么是我们所想要知道的事。

meaningZh: （尤指向慈善机构）捐赠；献（血）；捐（血）

examples.text: I can donate one hundred dollars at best.
examples.translationZh: 我充其量只能捐助100美元。

examples.text: We donate to the school endowment fund every year.
examples.translationZh: 我们每年向学校的捐赠基金捐款。

examples.text: The government calls on the youth to donate their blood voluntarily.
examples.translationZh: 政府号召青年义务献血。

meaningZh: （坚定地向某地）前进；行军，进军；游行示威

examples.text: Not a single man fell out in the long march.
examples.translationZh: 在长途行军中没有一个人掉队。

examples.text: The army was now on the march to Shanghai.
examples.translationZh: 部队当时正向上海进军。

examples.text: Science is on the march.
examples.translationZh: 科学正在进步中。

meaningZh: 清晰的；精确的；正规的

examples.text: With the new technique, measurement was claimed to be much more precise.
examples.translationZh: 有了这种技术,人们断言测量的结果会精确得多。

examples.text: At the precise moment that I put my foot on the step, the bus started.
examples.translationZh: 恰恰就在我登上公共汽车踏板的时候，车子开动了。

examples.text: I am not clear about the precise bearing of the word in this passage.
examples.translationZh: 我说不准这个字在这段文章里的确切意义是什么。

meaningZh: 积极的；确实的，肯定的；[数]正的

examples.text: He has a positive attitude towards life.
examples.translationZh: 他对生活持有积极的态度。

examples.text: We regret out inability to let you know anything positive concerning the above firm.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉，我方无法让您了解上述公司任何肯定的资料。

examples.text: We still don't have a positive answer as to how he died.
examples.translationZh: 他究竟是如何死的，我们还未得出明确的答案。

meaningZh: 客人；旅客；特邀嘉宾

examples.text: They are coming to the party as my guests.
examples.translationZh: 他们作为我的客人出席晚会。

examples.text: These Indian guest are familiar with this book.
examples.translationZh: 这些印度客人对这本书很熟悉。

examples.text: She deleted our names from the guest list.
examples.translationZh: 她把我们的名字从宾客名单中删去了。

meaningZh: 传说，传言；（尤指充满惊险的）故事；坏话，谣言

examples.text: Their love story sounds like a fairy tale.
examples.translationZh: 他们的爱情故事听起来像童话。

examples.text: This is a tale that wring the heart.
examples.translationZh: 这是个令人心痛的故事。

examples.text: We listened to their tales about life in the Sahara Desert.
examples.translationZh: 我们听他们讲述撒哈拉沙漠的生活经历。

meaningZh: 媒体；[解剖学]血管中层；[语音学] 浊塞音

examples.text: Tim appeared unabashed by all the media attention.
examples.translationZh: 蒂姆成了传播媒介的焦点，却也满不在乎。

examples.text: The media have a lot of power today.
examples.translationZh: 现在大众传播媒介有很大的力量。

examples.text: The actress revels in all the attention she gets from the media.
examples.translationZh: 这位女演员陶醉于传媒对她的吹捧。

meaningZh: 女警察；女警官

examples.text: He is asking a policewoman for help.
examples.translationZh: 他正在向一个女警察求助。

meaningZh: 陆地；国家；地产

examples.text: We are glad to be on land again.
examples.translationZh: 我们很高兴又踏上陆地了。

examples.text: The river passes through our land.
examples.translationZh: 这条河流经我们的国土

examples.text: The land is laid down with red or white clover.
examples.translationZh: 这块土地种上了红花和白花苜蓿。

meaningZh: 专利；专利品；专利权

examples.text: The patent runs out in three years time.
examples.translationZh: 这项专利期限为3年。

examples.text: He got a patent for this invention.
examples.translationZh: 他获得了这项发明的专利权。

examples.text: The government patented the device to its inventor.
examples.translationZh: 政府给予发明者专利权。

meaningZh: 准备好的，现成的；即时的，敏捷的；情愿的

examples.text: The troops were ready for anything.
examples.translationZh: 部队已做好了一切准备。

examples.text: The letter is ready for the post.
examples.translationZh: 信已准备好，可以寄出了。

examples.text: I have no ready answer to the question.
examples.translationZh: 我没有现成的答案。

meaningZh: 地点，场所；斑点，污点；[股票]现货

examples.text: This is the spot where the two trucks collided.
examples.translationZh: 这儿就是两辆卡车相撞的地点。

examples.text: That was the common spot for settling affairs of honour.
examples.translationZh: 那是他们通常决斗的场所。

examples.text: She found a spot as a secretary.
examples.translationZh: 她找到一个秘书的职位。

meaningZh: 物体；目标；宾语

examples.text: Various objects were on the table.
examples.translationZh: 桌子上摆着各种各样的物体。

examples.text: His one object in life is to earn as much money as possible.
examples.translationZh: 一生中的他的一个目标将挣得尽可能多的钱。

examples.text: This church is the main object of his interest.
examples.translationZh: 他最感兴趣的是这座教堂。

meaningZh: 墙,壁,围墙；vt. 筑墙围住,用墙隔开

examples.text: The picture on the wall is crooked.
examples.translationZh: 挂在墙壁上的画是歪的。

examples.text: The castle walls are very thick.
examples.translationZh: 城堡的墙很厚。

examples.text: I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled.
examples.translationZh: 我必撤去篱笆，使它被吞灭，拆毁墙垣，使它被践踏。

meaningZh: 烧烤；vt. 拷问，盘问；n. 烤架

examples.text: We have to clean the grill before we start a fire.
examples.translationZh: 在生火前我们必须把烤架清理干净。

examples.text: Put the hamburgers on the grill.
examples.translationZh: 把汉堡牛排放到烤架上。

examples.text: There is no grill in Room Service.
examples.translationZh: 客房服务部不卖烧烤的食品。

meaningZh: 奶；乳液；母乳

examples.text: A baby vomits milk from repletion.
examples.translationZh: 婴儿吃饱会吐奶。

examples.text: She dribbled some milk onto the cereal.
examples.translationZh: 她把一些奶滴在燕麦片上。

examples.text: The cat lapped up the milk.
examples.translationZh: 猫舔食牛奶。

meaningZh: 收集；聚集，搜集；收紧，收缩

examples.text: Clouds gather before a thunderstorm.
examples.translationZh: 在风暴来临之前云层聚集。

examples.text: People began to gather outside the palace.
examples.translationZh: 人们开始聚集在宫殿前。

examples.text: We'll gather at the school gate at eight tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 我们明天八点在校门口集合。

meaningZh: 矿物；矿石；矿物质

examples.text: Coal is a mineral.
examples.translationZh: 煤是一种矿物。

examples.text: We are digging for mineral deposits.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在掘地探矿。

examples.text: This shop sells mineral water.
examples.translationZh: 这家商店卖矿泉水。

meaningZh: 恶劣的；肮脏的；卑劣的

examples.text: The clothes on the floor are dirty.
examples.translationZh: 地板上的那些衣物是脏的.

examples.text: The tourist complained that the room was too dirty.
examples.translationZh: 游客抱怨说房间太脏了。

examples.text: The dirty pub is a beastly place.
examples.translationZh: 那个肮脏的小酒馆是一个叫人恶心的地方。

meaningZh: 到…之上；对…了解；[数]映射到…上

examples.text: He grafted the branch onto the apple tree.
examples.translationZh: 他将这根树枝嫁接到了苹果树上。

examples.text: Historically, wafers were waxed onto a metal plate.
examples.translationZh: 过去片子是用石蜡固定到金属板上。

meaningZh: （容量单位）升

examples.text: The capacity of this bottle is one litre.
examples.translationZh: 这个瓶子的容量是1公升。

examples.text: A litre of gas has less mass than a litre of water.
examples.translationZh: 一公升的气体质量少于一公升的水。

meaningZh: 改变，变更；交换，替换；兑换

examples.text: His perception of the change came in a flash.
examples.translationZh: 他在一瞬间察觉到了这一变化。

examples.text: The change in the weather has mucked up our sports timetable.
examples.translationZh: 天气的变化打乱了我们运动比赛的日程。

examples.text: This is a tremendous change unparalleled in the history of China and of the world.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个绝大的变化，这是自有世界历史和中国历史以来无可比拟的大变化。

meaningZh: 幸存，活下来；vt. 比…活得长，经历…之后还存在；幸存

examples.text: She was the only one to survive the crash.
examples.translationZh: 她是这次飞机失事的唯一幸存者。

examples.text: These birds are able to survive the perils of the Arctic winter.
examples.translationZh: 这些鸟能在北极寒冷的冬天里生存。

examples.text: I don't know how I ever survived high school.
examples.translationZh: 我都不知道我是怎样熬过高中那段岁月的。

meaningZh: 椅子；大学教授职位；主持会议的主席（的席位或职位）

examples.text: Her hands rested on the arms of her chair.
examples.translationZh: 她的双手搁在椅子的扶手上。

examples.text: He sat in a chair near the door.
examples.translationZh: 他坐在靠门的一把椅子上。

examples.text: Mr Smith will take the chair at the next meeting.
examples.translationZh: 下次会议将由史密斯先生主持。

meaningZh: 电影院；电影艺术；电影业

examples.text: They streamed out of the cinema.
examples.translationZh: 他们涌出电影院。

examples.text: There is a telephone booth near the cinema.
examples.translationZh: 电影院附近有一个电话亭。

examples.text: He has an urge to become a cinema star.
examples.translationZh: 他渴望当一名电影明星。

meaningZh: 耐性,忍耐力,耐心；坚忍,坚持,毅力

examples.text: Her endless patience made her the best nurse in the hospital.
examples.translationZh: 无限的耐心使她成为这个医院最好的护士。

examples.text: His patience was worn out by all these troubles.
examples.translationZh: 这么多麻烦使他都没有耐心了。

examples.text: She owes her success to hard work and patience.
examples.translationZh: 她的成功是努力工作和耐心的结果。

meaningZh: 旅行，旅程行期；历程，过程；vi. 旅行，出游

examples.text: It was a long journey, but we eventually arrived.
examples.translationZh: 旅程很长，但我们最后还是到达了。

examples.text: He told a very descriptive account of his journey.
examples.translationZh: 他对旅行作了十分生动的叙述。

examples.text: He is going to make a long journey.
examples.translationZh: 他要作一次长途旅行。

meaningZh: 浴室；盥洗室；（带抽水马桶的）厕所

examples.text: He weighed himself on the bathroom scales.
examples.translationZh: 他在浴室的磅秤上称体重。

examples.text: Steam has fogged the bathroom mirror.
examples.translationZh: 水蒸气把浴室里的镜子遮住了。

examples.text: There are two bathrooms in my house.
examples.translationZh: 我们家有两个浴室。

meaningZh: 仁慈的，宽恕的，温和的，（情形）良好的，顺利的，（处罚）宽大的

examples.text: Be merciful to those who show mercy.
examples.translationZh: 对仁慈的人讲仁慈。

examples.text: The merciful king saved the young officers from death.
examples.translationZh: 仁慈的国王把年青的军官从死神手中救了出来。

examples.text: She was merciful to the prisoners.
examples.translationZh: 她对犯人很仁慈。

meaningZh: 总之；无论如何；不管怎样

examples.text: Anyhow,Spring will return to us.
examples.translationZh: 春，无论如何也会回到人间。

examples.text: Anyhow I must finish this job today.
examples.translationZh: 无论如何，我今天要完成这件事。

examples.text: Anyhow, don't worry yourself now about it.
examples.translationZh: 不管怎样，现在不要为这事烦恼了。

meaningZh: 停止；中断；逗留

examples.text: The train stopped at the station.
examples.translationZh: 火车在车站上停了下来。

examples.text: His heart has stopped.
examples.translationZh: 他的心脏停止了跳动。

examples.text: They would stop the rich from robbing the poor.
examples.translationZh: 他们要制止富人掠夺穷人。

meaningZh: 孙子，外孙

examples.text: The old lady placed great trust in her grandson.
examples.translationZh: 那位老太太对她孙子非常信任。

examples.text: The old man goes to see his grandson twice a week.
examples.translationZh: 这位老人每星期去看他的孙子两次。

examples.text: The old woman led her grandson by the arm.
examples.translationZh: 那老婆婆牵着外孙的手。

meaningZh: 鼓舞；激励；赋予灵感

examples.text: We're trying to inspire him with confidence.
examples.translationZh: 我们在努力鼓舞他的自信心。

examples.text: The sight inspired him with nostalgia.
examples.translationZh: 这景象激起了他的怀旧之情。

examples.text: The failure inspired him to greater efforts.
examples.translationZh: 失败激发他作更大的努力。

meaningZh: 盘子，盆子；金属板；均匀厚度的片状硬物体

examples.text: Just a paper? It's a small plate of dish.
examples.translationZh: 不就是一篇论文吗,小菜一碟。

examples.text: The doctor inserted a steel plate into his damaged leg.
examples.translationZh: 医生在他受伤的腿中植入了一块钢板。

examples.text: This is apparently related to the tectonic setting of Shandong,namely, the continental margin where the Pacific Plate collided against the Eurasian Plate.
examples.translationZh: 之所以如此,显然与山东所处的大地构造位置,即太平洋板块与欧亚板块相互碰撞的陆缘地带密切相关。

meaningZh: 口授，听写；听写测验；命令

examples.text: The teacher gave the pupils dictation.
examples.translationZh: 教师让学生听写。

examples.text: We have a dictation every English class.
examples.translationZh: 每次上英语课我们都进行听写测验。

examples.text: I hated it if I ever had to take dictation from him.
examples.translationZh: 如果我总是不得不作他的口授记录员，我会感到讨厌的。

meaningZh: 酸乳酪，酸奶；酸牛奶

examples.text: I like drinking creamy yoghurt in summer.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢在夏天喝些酸奶。

examples.text: Drink yoghurt to have curative effect to the cold?
examples.translationZh: 喝酸奶对感冒有疗效吗？

examples.text: This yoghurt contains no artificial flavouring or colouring.
examples.translationZh: 这种酸乳酪不含人造香料或著色剂。

meaningZh: 立方体的；n. [数]三次曲线（方程式，多项式，函数）

examples.text: This box is a cubic object.
examples.translationZh: 这个盒子是个立方体。

examples.text: The volume of this container is 20 cubic meters.
examples.translationZh: 这个集装箱的体积是20立方米。

examples.text: What's the cubic capacity of this engine?
examples.translationZh: 这台发动机的立体容积是多少？

meaningZh: 意外事件；事故；机遇，偶然

examples.text: His left knee was hurt in a traffic accident.
examples.translationZh: 他的左膝在一次交通事故中受伤了。

examples.text: Happily, the accident was prevented.
examples.translationZh: 很幸运，事故得以避免了。

examples.text: The other day I came across an interesting accident.
examples.translationZh: 几天前,我碰到一件意外事情。

meaningZh: 保护，保卫；贸易保护；备款以支付

examples.text: He raised his arm to protect his child from hurt.
examples.translationZh: 他伸出手去，保护他的孩子免受伤害。

examples.text: These gallant soldiers will protect our country.
examples.translationZh: 这些勇敢的士兵会保卫我们的国家的。

examples.text: These rare tigers are protected by special laws.
examples.translationZh: 这些珍贵的老虎受到专门法律的保护。

meaningZh: 揭露，揭发；使暴露；使遭受

examples.text: The reporter was killed because he tried to expose a plot.
examples.translationZh: 这名记者因为试图揭露一个阴谋而被杀害。

examples.text: I hate the paparazzi.They always expose the people's privacy.
examples.translationZh: 我讨厌狗仔队,他们老曝光别人的隐私。

examples.text: We should not expose our children to horrors.
examples.translationZh: 我们不应该让孩子看恐怖片。

meaningZh: 竹子；竹竿；竹木家具

examples.text: He did athletic stunts on bamboo ladders.
examples.translationZh: 他在竹梯上表演了体育绝技。

examples.text: The piece of bamboo makes a musical sound.
examples.translationZh: 这块竹片能发出悦耳的声音。

examples.text: This armchair is made of bamboo.
examples.translationZh: 这个扶手椅是用竹子做成的。

meaningZh: （出版物的）版式；[自]（数据安排的）形式；电视节目的总安排（或计划）

examples.text: The book has been styled in a modern format.
examples.translationZh: 该书已按照现代版式制作。

examples.text: It's the same book,but a new format.
examples.translationZh: 还是那本书

examples.text: The format of the meeting was such that every one could ask a question.
examples.translationZh: 会议安排好可让每个人都能提一个问题。

meaningZh: 香肠，腊肠；〈口〉德国人

examples.text: She loves sausage and mash.
examples.translationZh: 她喜欢香肠和土豆泥。

examples.text: Many people don't like blood sausage.
examples.translationZh: 很多人不喜欢黑香肠。

examples.text: The sausage began to spit in the pan.
examples.translationZh: 锅里香肠开始滋滋作响。

meaningZh: 好像，仿佛；似乎；装作

examples.text: He seems to know everything.
examples.translationZh: 他似乎什么都懂。

examples.text: The children seem unaffected emotionally by their parent's divorce.
examples.translationZh: 孩子在情绪上似乎未受到父母离婚的影响。

examples.text: Well, funny things seem to be happening.
examples.translationZh: 哦,似乎有些怪事正在不断发生。

meaningZh: 皮，皮革；皮革制品；vt. 用皮革包盖

examples.text: This wallet feels to me like leather.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得这钱包像是皮的。

examples.text: Leather can deteriorate in damp conditions.
examples.translationZh: 皮革受潮可变质。

examples.text: Plastic is sometimes used instead of leather.
examples.translationZh: 塑胶有时可以替代皮革。

meaningZh: 竞争；比赛；竞争者

examples.text: Everyone in modern society faces keen competitions.
examples.translationZh: 现代社会的每个人都面临着激烈的竞争。

examples.text: To our satisfaction, he had got the first prize in the diving competition.
examples.translationZh: 我们满意的是,他在跳水比赛中获得了一等奖。

meaningZh: 电的，带电的；发电的，导电的；令人激动的

examples.text: They still live in the houses without electric lights.
examples.translationZh: 他们仍然住在没有电灯的房子里。

examples.text: The solar cell can convert the energy of sunlight into electric energy.
examples.translationZh: 太阳能电池能把阳光的能量转化为电能。

examples.text: He uses an electric razor for shaving.
examples.translationZh: 他用一把电动刮脸刀刮脸。

meaningZh: 邮政编码

examples.text: You need to give me your address and postcode so that I can write to you.
examples.translationZh: 请把您的地址和邮政编码给我，这样我可以给你写信。

meaningZh: （两者）都不的；pron. 两者都不；adv. 两个都不

examples.text: Neither of my parents enjoys music.
examples.translationZh: 我父母都不喜欢音乐。

examples.text: Neither of the statements is true.
examples.translationZh: 两种说法都不正确。

examples.text: He tasted both cakes and said that neither was delicious.
examples.translationZh: 他两块蛋糕都尝了尝,觉得都不好吃。

meaningZh: 画家，着色者；油漆匠；（系船的）缆绳

examples.text: He is an amateur painter.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个业余画家。

examples.text: The painter stretched the canvas on a frame.
examples.translationZh: 画家把油画布紧绷在画框上。

examples.text: He was an unknown painter one year ago.
examples.translationZh: 一年前，他还是一个不为人知的画家。

meaningZh: 教训，训诫；功课；课程，一堂课

examples.text: Such a lesson should be treasured in our memories.
examples.translationZh: 这样的宝贵教训应该铭记在心。

examples.text: That accident taught them a lesson.
examples.translationZh: 那次事故给了他们一个教训。

examples.text: I missed a lesson yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 昨天我误了一节课。

meaningZh: 倾听；留心听；听信

examples.text: She is listening to the radio.
examples.translationZh: 她在听收音机。

examples.text: It is boring to listen to the same story.
examples.translationZh: 听相同的故事是令人厌烦的。

examples.text: He should listen to his intimate feelings.
examples.translationZh: 人应当倾听自己的内心感觉。

meaningZh: 块，片，段；部分，部件；文章，音乐作品

examples.text: The book is a fine piece of scholarship.
examples.translationZh: 这部书是一件优秀的学术成果。

examples.text: This is an elegant piece of writing.
examples.translationZh: 这篇东西写得很优美。

examples.text: Would you please give me a piece of paper?
examples.translationZh: 能给我一张纸吗？

meaningZh: 邮费，邮资

examples.text: It costs a pound, plus ten pence for postage.
examples.translationZh: 这东西值一镑，另加邮费十便士。

examples.text: What is the postage for an air letter?
examples.translationZh: 寄一封航空信的邮费要多少？

meaningZh: （烧水用的）壶；小汽锅

examples.text: The kettle is boiling.
examples.translationZh: 壶里的水开了。

examples.text: The switch on the kettle won't stay down.
examples.translationZh: 这个水壶上的开关按下时卡不住了。

examples.text: This kettle whistles when it boils.
examples.translationZh: 这水壶在水开时会哔哔作响。

meaningZh: 常规；例行程序；生活乏味

examples.text: We must introduce some system into our office routine.
examples.translationZh: 我们须在我们日常公务中建立一些制度。

examples.text: They did it as a matter of routine.
examples.translationZh: 他们那样做只是例行公事。

examples.text: This type of work rapidly becomes routine.
examples.translationZh: 这种工作很快就变得乏味无聊。

meaningZh: 海报，招贴，公告；招贴画；张贴者

examples.text: The lettering on the poster is very eye-catching.
examples.translationZh: 海报上的字体非常醒目。

examples.text: The poster only stayed up a few hours before it was stolen.
examples.translationZh: 那张海报贴上去没几个小时就让人给偷走了。

examples.text: He put up a poster advertising the circus.
examples.translationZh: 他贴了一张宣传马戏团的海报。

meaningZh: 贡献出；捐赠（款项）；投稿（给杂志等）

examples.text: It was generous of her to contribute such a large sum.
examples.translationZh: 她很大方，捐助了这么大笔钱。

examples.text: She asked him to contribute a biweekly article on European affairs.
examples.translationZh: 她让他每两周写一篇有关欧洲情况的文章。

examples.text: Don't contribute after the closing date.
examples.translationZh: 请在截止日期前投稿。

meaningZh: 有时，间或；时而

examples.text: Old people are sometimes forgetful.
examples.translationZh: 老人有时爱忘事。

examples.text: Sometimes the patient cried for the pain.
examples.translationZh: 有时这个病人疼得哭起来。

examples.text: Love is sometimes put in range with a career.
examples.translationZh: 人们往往认为爱情和事业是并驾齐驱的。

meaningZh: 污染；玷污，亵渎；破坏（品性），使堕落

examples.text: Our store never sells books which pollute the mind.
examples.translationZh: 我们书店从不出售污染心灵的书籍。

examples.text: We should not pollute our rivers with waste.
examples.translationZh: 我们不应让废弃物污染我们的河川。

meaningZh: 密封；印章；海豹

examples.text: The seal on this bottle is broken.
examples.translationZh: 这个瓶上的密封纸破开了。

examples.text: This document carries the royal seal.
examples.translationZh: 这份文件上盖有王室印章。

examples.text: The first time I saw a seal was in an aquarium.
examples.translationZh: 我第一次看见海豹是在水族馆里。

meaningZh: 自然；天性；天理

examples.text: In fact, nature is much better at recycling than we humans are.
examples.translationZh: 事实上,自然界在再循环方面比人类做得更好。

examples.text: To a great extent, that is the nature of my own work.
examples.translationZh: 在很大程度上,这就是我工作的性质。

examples.text: The goal of life is living in agreement with nature.
examples.translationZh: 人生的终极目标是和自然和谐相处。

meaningZh: 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻

examples.text: She has the ability to keep calm in an emergency.
examples.translationZh: 她有处变不惊的本事。

examples.text: We took the emergency in our stride.
examples.translationZh: 我们泰然地处理了紧急情况。

examples.text: Ring the bell in an emergency.
examples.translationZh: 情况紧急时请按铃。

meaningZh: 真诚地；诚恳地；谆

examples.text: She praised him sincerely for his victory.
examples.translationZh: 她真诚地表扬了他的胜利。

examples.text: I sincerely hope you'll come with us.
examples.translationZh: 我真诚希望你和我们一起去。

examples.text: Do you sincerely want to succeed?
examples.translationZh: 你真的想要成功吗?

meaningZh: 地位；情形，状态；身份

examples.text: Women's social status has changed much over the years.
examples.translationZh: 这些年来妇女的社会地位有了很大改变。

examples.text: I'll keep you posted on the status.
examples.translationZh: 我会随时告诉你进展的情形。

examples.text: We ask the bank to report on his financial status.
examples.translationZh: 我们请银行报告他的财政状况。

meaningZh: 指责，责怪；归咎于；n. 责备

examples.text: The driver was not to blame for the accident.
examples.translationZh: 这次事故怪不着司机。

examples.text: The bank manager was really to blame, though he tried to pin it on a clerk.
examples.translationZh: 真正受责备的应该是银行经理，可是他却想把责任推到一个职员身上。

examples.text: She blamed him for the failure of their marriage.
examples.translationZh: 她把婚姻的触礁归咎於他。

meaningZh: 乐意的，愿意的；自愿的，心甘情愿的；v. will的现在分词

examples.text: Are you willing to help?
examples.translationZh: 你愿意帮忙吗？

examples.text: I don't know whether he is willing to come.
examples.translationZh: 我不知道他是否愿意来。

examples.text: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.
examples.translationZh: 心有余而力不足。

meaningZh: 插座；灯座；窝，穴

examples.text: There is an electric socket in the wall.
examples.translationZh: 墙上有个电源插座。

examples.text: This type of bulb screws into the socket.
examples.translationZh: 这种灯是拧到灯座上的。

examples.text: Never poke a finger or scissors into an electric socket.
