examples.translationZh: 千万不要把手指或剪刀插进电源插座。

meaningZh: 点头；打瞌睡；上下摆动

examples.text: She nodded when she passed me in the street.
examples.translationZh: 她在街上走过我身旁时向我点了点头。

examples.text: He nodded in agreement with me.
examples.translationZh: 他点头表示同意我的意见。

examples.text: The student began to nod off during math class.
examples.translationZh: 那学生上数学课的时候开始打盹。

meaningZh: 锦标赛，联赛；中世纪的骑士比武；锦标赛

examples.text: Winning the tournament gratified the golf champion.
examples.translationZh: 那位高尔夫球世界冠军为赢得锦标赛而感到高兴。

examples.text: His victory in the tournament earned him $50000.
examples.translationZh: 他在这次锦标赛中获胜，挣得了5万元。

examples.text: I won the tennis tournament.
examples.translationZh: 我赢了那场网球比赛。

meaningZh: 百万富翁；大富翁；大财主

examples.text: He spends as if he were a millionaire.
examples.translationZh: 他用起钱来像个百万富翁似的。

examples.text: Now a millionaire, he typifies the self-made man.
examples.translationZh: 他成了百万富翁，可以说是白手起家的典型。

examples.text: He is not poor, on the contrary, he is a millionaire.
examples.translationZh: 他不穷，相反，他是个百万富翁。

meaningZh: 笨拙的；复杂难懂的；得罪人的

examples.text: The clumsy boy bumped into the table.
examples.translationZh: 笨拙的男孩撞到桌子上。

examples.text: My clumsy answer hurt her feelings.
examples.translationZh: 我笨拙的回答伤了她的感情。

examples.text: He chided his son for being clumsy.
examples.translationZh: 他斥责儿子笨手笨脚。

meaningZh: 联盟；社团；（运动）联合会、联赛

examples.text: They are not in the same league.
examples.translationZh: 他们的水平有高低。

examples.text: Our club is a member of the Football League.
examples.translationZh: 我们的俱乐部是足球联合会的一员。

examples.text: Most of us in our class are League members.
examples.translationZh: 我们班上大多数是团员。

meaningZh: 意气相投，同感；同情，同情心；慰问

examples.text: I felt much sympathy for the blind.
examples.translationZh: 我对盲人深感同情。

examples.text: I have great sympathy for people in affliction.
examples.translationZh: 我对那些受苦受难的人们充满同情。

examples.text: The story stirred her sympathy.
examples.translationZh: 这故事激起了她的同情心。

meaningZh: 游戏，运动；比赛，竞赛；诡计

examples.text: All the children partook in the game.
examples.translationZh: 所有孩子都参加了游戏。

examples.text: I found a computer game to divert the children.
examples.translationZh: 我发现了一种供孩子娱乐的电脑游戏。

examples.text: He is my main rival in the game.
examples.translationZh: 他是我运动会上的主要对手。

meaningZh: 最小的；最少的（ little的最高级）；最不重要的，地位最低的

examples.text: The least noise would startle the timid child.
examples.translationZh: 最小的响声也会吓着这个胆小的孩子的。

examples.text: The greatest talkers are always the least doers.
examples.translationZh: 大言不惭的总是做得最少的人。

examples.text: She came when we least expected her.
examples.translationZh: 她在我们最意料不到的时候来了。

meaningZh: 错误，过失，误解；差错，口误，笔误；失策，失误

examples.text: His costly mistake resulted in severe loss.
examples.translationZh: 他的严重的错误导致了重大的损失。

examples.text: You've made several grammatical mistakes in the composition.
examples.translationZh: 你的作文中犯了几处语法错误。

examples.text: Tom must have taken your dictionary by mistake.
examples.translationZh: 汤姆一定是弄错了才拿了你的字典。

meaningZh: 说话者；演讲者，发言人；讲某种语言的人

examples.text: The speaker was boring everybody.
examples.translationZh: 说话者令每个人生厌。

examples.text: These gestures are extremely important as they virtually negate what the speaker says.
examples.translationZh: 这些肢体动作极其重要，因为它们几乎否定掉说话者所说的话。

examples.text: The speaker sawed the air as he cried loudly.
examples.translationZh: 发言者一边挥舞手臂一边大声叫喊。

meaningZh: 火腿；（旧时的）小镇，村庄；大腿后部

examples.text: This ham has too much fat on it.
examples.translationZh: 这火腿肥肉太多。

examples.text: He tucked into the ham hungrily.
examples.translationZh: 他狼吞虎咽地大吃火腿。

examples.text: He made a ham sandwich.
examples.translationZh: 他做了一个火腿三明治。

meaningZh: 妻子，太太；夫人，老婆；已婚妇女

examples.text: He kissed his wife and children good-bye.
examples.translationZh: 他吻别他的妻子和孩子。

examples.text: The cruel man abandoned his wife and child.
examples.translationZh: 那个狠心的男人抛弃了他的妻儿。

examples.text: She tried to be an affectionate wife.
examples.translationZh: 她试图做个温柔体贴的妻子。

meaningZh: 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的

examples.text: It is obvious that she is very clever.
examples.translationZh: 很明显，她挺聪明。

examples.text: The embassy is an obvious target for terrorist attacks.
examples.translationZh: 大使馆是恐怖分子攻击的明显目标。

examples.text: The merits of the scheme are quite obvious.
examples.translationZh: 该计画的可取之处是相当明显的。

meaningZh: [计]（软件的）套件；（房间，器具等）一套，一副；[乐]组曲

examples.text: The suite is for the honeymoon couple.
examples.translationZh: 这套房是为新婚夫妇设的。

examples.text: He brought a three-piece suite for his new house.
examples.translationZh: 他为新房子买了三件一套的家具。

examples.text: He left the hotel with his suites yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 他昨天带着一群随员离开了那家酒店。

meaningZh: [化]二氧化物

examples.text: The carbon14 atoms oxidize to carbon dioxide which gets blown about and mixed up with lower atmosphere.
examples.translationZh: 碳14原子氧化生成二氧化碳，向四周散去并与低空的大气混合。

examples.text: Soft drinks contain carbon dioxide.
examples.translationZh: 软饮料中含有二氧化碳。

examples.text: Plants can absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 植物可以吸收二氧化碳释放氧气。

meaningZh: 适用，应用，运用；申请，请求，申请表格；勤勉，用功

examples.text: The application of new scientific discoveries to industrial production methods usually increases efficiency.
examples.translationZh: 把新的科学发现运用到工业生产上,通常可以提高效率。

examples.text: I didn't receive an acknowledgement of my application.
examples.translationZh: 对我的申请,我还没有收到复信告知收悉。

examples.text: The manager received twenty applications for the post.
examples.translationZh: 经理收到了二十份求职申请书。

meaningZh: 离开海岸的；近海的；海外的，国外的

examples.text: Meizhou Island is an offshore island.
examples.translationZh: 湄洲岛地处海陆边际。

examples.text: The water quality of the offshore marine areas tended to improve.
examples.translationZh: 近岸海域海水水质呈改善趋势。

examples.text: The bluefin are fattened offshore in sea cages before being shot and butchered for the sushi and steak markets in Japan, America, and Europe.
examples.translationZh: 在屠宰并卖到日本、美国和欧洲的寿司或者烤鱼片市场之前，这些金枪鱼被关在离岸的笼子中养肥。

meaningZh: 亲自地；就个人而言；个别地

examples.text: Personally, I like blue best.
examples.translationZh: 我个人最喜欢蓝色。

examples.text: She saw to the comforts of her guests personally.
examples.translationZh: 她亲自照顾客人。

examples.text: I really need to talk to him personally.
examples.translationZh: 我真的需要亲自跟他说。

meaningZh: 哀号，吼叫；vi. 嚎叫，咆哮；哀嚎

examples.text: The howl seemed to freeze the world with fear.
examples.translationZh: 那嚎叫声好像要令整个世界毛骨悚然。

examples.text: You can grip the club when you hear the wolf howl.
examples.translationZh: 听见狼嚎你可以握紧棍子。

examples.text: A sudden howl pierced the silence.
examples.translationZh: 突然一声嗥叫划破了寂静。

meaningZh: 棕色的,褐色的

examples.text: He had brown skin.
examples.translationZh: 他的皮肤是棕色的

examples.text: He bought a pair of dark brown shoes.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一双深褐色的皮鞋。

examples.text: Brown doesn't suit you.
examples.translationZh: 你不适合穿褐色衣服。

meaningZh: 生日；诞辰；成立纪念日

examples.text: I received a set of gardening tools on my birthday.
examples.translationZh: 生日那天，我收到一套园艺工具。

examples.text: He gave her an expensive fur for her birthday.
examples.translationZh: 他送给她一件昂贵的毛皮衣服作为生日礼物。

examples.text: Tom's birthday is this week.
examples.translationZh: 汤姆的生日就在这个星期。

meaningZh: 水池；石油层；（液体等的）一滩

examples.text: A fringe of trees stood round the pool.
examples.translationZh: 池塘四周耸立着一圈树木。

examples.text: They stripped off and jumped into the pool.
examples.translationZh: 他们脱掉衣服，跳进了池子。

examples.text: There is a swimming pool in the park.
examples.translationZh: 公园里有一个游泳池。

meaningZh: 吸引；[物]引力；魅力

examples.text: She felt an immediate attraction to him.
examples.translationZh: 她对他一见锺情。

examples.text: The attraction of the moon for the earth causes the tides.
examples.translationZh: 月球对地球的吸引力造成潮汐。

examples.text: She felt a strong attraction to him.
examples.translationZh: 她感到他对她有强烈的吸引力。

meaningZh: 母亲，妈妈；女修道院院长；大娘

examples.text: I wonder when mother will ring?
examples.translationZh: 我不知道母亲什么时候会打电话来？

examples.text: It happened that my mother was out that day.
examples.translationZh: 我母亲恰巧那天出去了。

examples.text: He disobeyed his mother and went to the party.
examples.translationZh: 他不听母亲的劝告，参加了那次聚会。

meaningZh: 三角形；三人一组；三角铁

examples.text: He outlined the triangle in red.
examples.translationZh: 他用红笔画出三角形。

examples.text: The angles of a triangle total 180.
examples.translationZh: 三角形的三角之和等于180°。

examples.text: The place is a cobbled triangle.
examples.translationZh: 这个地方是一块铺石子的三角地。

meaningZh: 审判，评判；断定；vt. 估计

examples.text: He is an impartial judge.
examples.translationZh: 他是一位公正的法官。

examples.text: At the end of the trial, the judge summed up.
examples.translationZh: 审讯结束后,法官作了总结。

examples.text: The judges' decision is final.
examples.translationZh: 裁判的决定为最终决定。

meaningZh: 无论如何；而且；尽管

examples.text: Anyway she said what was in her mind.
examples.translationZh: 不管怎样，她说了心里话。。

examples.text: He reflected that the quality of the instruments was good anyway.
examples.translationZh: 他寻思，不管怎样，这些乐器的质量还是不错的。

examples.text: I don't think they need help, but I think I should offer anyway.
examples.translationZh: 我认为他们无须帮助，不过我想我应有所表示。

meaningZh: 可能的；可接受的；合理的，可以允许的

examples.text: I'll do everything possible to help you.
examples.translationZh: 我会尽一切可能帮助你。

examples.text: It isn't remotely possible that you will be chosen to go.
examples.translationZh: 挑选你去的可能性并非很小。

examples.text: You'd better rest as much as possible.
examples.translationZh: 你要尽可能多休息。

meaningZh: 破坏，毁灭；使破产；使没落，使堕落

examples.text: He ruined his prospects by carelessness.
examples.translationZh: 他因疏忽大意而断送了前途。

examples.text: The politics of the company will ruin their image.
examples.translationZh: 公司的策略会毁掉他们的形象。

examples.text: His enemies maliciously conspired to ruin him.
examples.translationZh: 他的敌人恶毒地密谋搞垮他。

meaningZh: 士兵；军人；战士

examples.text: The soldier received a serious wound on the chest.
examples.translationZh: 这名士兵胸部受了重伤。

examples.text: The trade of the soldier is war.
examples.translationZh: 士兵的职业是打仗。

examples.text: I believe he is meant to be a soldier.
examples.translationZh: 我相信他天生是要当军人的。

meaningZh: 推荐；劝告；使显得吸引人

examples.text: Can you recommend me some new books on this subject?
examples.translationZh: 你能推荐一些有关这个学科的新书给我吗?

examples.text: I should recommend it as a useful reference book.
examples.translationZh: 我愿意推荐它作为一本有用的参考书。

examples.text: I recommend you to buy this dictionary and that tape.
examples.translationZh: 我建议你买这本字典和那盒磁带。

meaningZh: 牺牲；献祭，供奉；牺牲行为

examples.text: He gave his life as a sacrifice for his country.
examples.translationZh: 他为国牺牲了。

examples.text: She made a big sacrifice for her position today.
examples.translationZh: 她为今天的职位付出了很大的代价。

examples.text: They offered a sacrifice to propitiate the god.
examples.translationZh: 他们供奉祭品以慰诸神。

meaningZh: 烹饪，烹调法；菜肴

examples.text: Chinese cuisine is very different from European.
examples.translationZh: 中国烹饪与欧洲烹饪有很大区别。

examples.text: I studied Greek cuisine for one year.
examples.translationZh: 我学了一年的希腊菜烹饪法。

examples.text: After that, they might end their day dining in a restaurant that serves Chinese cuisine.
examples.translationZh: 然后他俩可能会去一家中国餐馆吃晚饭，以此来结束一天的活动。

meaningZh: 音乐家

examples.text: That musician is very famous.
examples.translationZh: 那位音乐家非常有名。

examples.text: He's not in the first grade as a musician.
examples.translationZh: 他不是第一流的音乐家。

examples.text: The musician made the legend into a beautiful ballad.
examples.translationZh: 这位音乐家把传说编成了一首美丽的民谣。

meaningZh: 交换；交换物，被掉换者；vi. 交换（工作）

examples.text: He offerd to swap his camera for hers.
examples.translationZh: 他表示要与她交换相机。

examples.text: He swap his old car for a new motorcycle.
examples.translationZh: 他用旧车换了一辆新摩托车。

examples.text: They swapped stories about their army days.
examples.translationZh: 他们互相讲述了他们在军队中的经历。

meaningZh: 低的，矮小的；楼下的，低洼的；沮丧的

examples.text: The price they quoted was very low.
examples.translationZh: 他们报的价很低。

examples.text: Shadows are longer when the sun is low in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 太阳很低时，物体的影子就很长。

examples.text: We must reorder these items because stock gets low.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须再订购这些物品,因为库存越来越少了。

meaningZh: 忙碌的；占线；繁华的

examples.text: He is busy with some important work.
examples.translationZh: 他正忙于处理一些重要的事情。

examples.text: He was busy getting ready for his journey.
examples.translationZh: 他正忙于准备旅行。

examples.text: The shop looked out into a busy street.
examples.translationZh: 这商店濒临近一条繁忙的街道。

meaningZh: 灌溉；水利；[医]冲洗

examples.text: Water is channelled through a series of irrigation canals.
examples.translationZh: 把水引入一系列灌溉渠中。

examples.text: We used the money to set up an irrigation project.
examples.translationZh: 我们把钱用在兴建灌溉工程上了。

examples.text: Irrigation is needed to make crops grow in dry regions.
examples.translationZh: 干旱地区需要灌溉才能使作物生长。

meaningZh: 河流，小河，川，溪；潮流，趋势，倾向；（事件等的）连续，（财富等的）滚滚而来

examples.text: On either bank of the stream stand rows of willow trees.
examples.translationZh: 小河两岸柳树成行。

examples.text: Sand and leaves trapped the water in the stream.
examples.translationZh: 沙子和树叶堵住了小河的水流。

examples.text: Visitors to the exhibition came in an endless stream.
examples.translationZh: 参观展览会的人络绎不绝。

meaningZh: 甜的；愉快的，快乐的；温柔的，亲切的

examples.text: Do you like sweet or dry sherry?
examples.translationZh: 你喜欢甜的还是不甜的雪利酒?

examples.text: The dish tastes a bit sweet.
examples.translationZh: 这菜有点儿甜味。

examples.text: Don't the roses smell sweet!
examples.translationZh: 这玫瑰花真香!

meaningZh: 草，青草；草地，草坪；告密者

examples.text: The grass was wet with dew.
examples.translationZh: 草被露水打湿了。

examples.text: Father was cutting the grass, and meanwhile mother was planting roses.
examples.translationZh: 父亲在剪草,母亲在种玫瑰。

examples.text: We play football on the grass.
examples.translationZh: 我们在草地上踢足球。

meaningZh: 获胜的人；胜券在握；制胜的一记入球

examples.text: The winner beamed with satisfaction.
examples.translationZh: 获胜者满意地笑了。

examples.text: The winner was presented with a trophy.
examples.translationZh: 获胜者得到了奖品。

examples.text: Who's the winner of the tennis match?
examples.translationZh: 这次网球赛的优胜者是谁？

meaningZh: 必须做的，强制性的；义务的；必修的

examples.text: Attendance at evening prayers is not compulsory.
examples.translationZh: 参加晚祷并非硬性规定。

examples.text: I think it is compulsory.
examples.translationZh: 我认为这是非做不可的。

examples.text: The car insurance is compulsory.
examples.translationZh: 这项汽车保险是强制性的。

meaningZh: 末期的；晚期的；定期的

examples.text: That terminal is live.
examples.translationZh: 那个接头有电。

examples.text: A record message is played when the airport bus approaches the terminal.
examples.translationZh: 当机场班车接近终点时，播放了注意事项录音。

examples.text: I'll keep with you to the bus terminal.
examples.translationZh: 我陪你到公共汽车终点站。

meaningZh: （使）弯曲，屈身；拉弯；使成形，强行

examples.text: The branches bent in the wind.
examples.translationZh: 树枝被风吹弯了。

examples.text: The branch bent but didn't break when the boy climbed along it.
examples.translationZh: 那男孩爬上树枝时，树枝弯曲了，但是没有折断。

examples.text: They refused to bend to the hijackers' demands.
examples.translationZh: 他们拒绝屈从于劫机者的要求。

meaningZh: 社会主义

examples.text: From then on we proceeded to build socialism.
examples.translationZh: 从那时起,我们开始建设社会主义。

examples.text: Who is the founder of the scientific socialism?
examples.translationZh: 谁是科学社会主义的奠基人？

meaningZh: 燃料；（为身体提供能量的）食物；（维持、增加感情的）刺激物

examples.text: Coal is used as fuel.
examples.translationZh: 煤用作燃料。

examples.text: We aim for a 10% saving in fuel.
examples.translationZh: 我们的目标是节省10%的燃料。

examples.text: His indifference was a fuel to her hatred.
examples.translationZh: 他无动于衷使她心中的怨恨火上加油。

meaningZh: 北极的；极冷的；严寒的

examples.text: The polar bear's habitat is the icy waters of the Arctic.
examples.translationZh: 北极熊的栖息地是冰冷的北极海域。

examples.text: I guess there are much less people in the Arctic regions than here.
examples.translationZh: 我想北极地区的人要比这里的少得多。

examples.text: We can't stand this arctic weather.
examples.translationZh: 我们受不了这种严寒的天气。

meaningZh: 帮助；助手；外援

examples.text: The regime has been propped up by foreign aid.
examples.translationZh: 该政权是靠外国援助维持着的。

examples.text: Filled with fears all day long, he decided to seek the aid of a psychiatrist.
examples.translationZh: 他终日恐惧不安,决定寻求心理医生的帮助。

examples.text: In his father's presidential race in 1988, George W. Bush became his father's aid.
examples.translationZh: 1988年在他父亲竞选总统时,小布什成为父亲的助手。

meaningZh: （表示程度）超过；（表示等级）在…之上；（表示位置）在…正上方

examples.text: The glider was soaring above the valley.
examples.translationZh: 那架滑翔机在山谷上空滑翔。

examples.text: Applicants must be above the age of 18.
examples.translationZh: 申请者的年龄必须超过18岁。

examples.text: The temperature has been above the average recently.
examples.translationZh: 近来的气温一直比平均温度高。

meaningZh: 发现；找到；查明

examples.text: We have found oil under the North Sea.
examples.translationZh: 我们在北海发现了石油。

examples.text: I think I'm lost; I can't find the bridge.
examples.translationZh: 我想我是迷路了，我找不到那座桥了。

examples.text: He tried to find in the list his own name.
examples.translationZh: 他试图在名单上找到自己的名字。

meaningZh: 高度，海拔；高地；身高

examples.text: They looked down from a giddy height.
examples.translationZh: 他们从令人眩晕的高度往下看。

examples.text: His height makes him stand out in the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 他身材高大，因此在人群中很突出。

examples.text: The climber fell from a great height.
examples.translationZh: 攀登者从极高的地方坠落下来。

meaningZh: 含盐的；咸的；辛辣的

examples.text: We have a bowl of very salty pea and ham soup.
examples.translationZh: 我们喝了一碗非常咸的豌豆火腿汤。

examples.text: I like frenchfries because they are salty.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢薯条因为它们是咸的。

meaningZh: 习惯，惯例；海关，关税；经常光顾

examples.text: The custom has now become a rule.
examples.translationZh: 那种习惯现已变为成规。

examples.text: It is my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 早餐前出去散散步是我的习惯。

examples.text: Custom rules the law.
examples.translationZh: [谚]风俗左右法律。

meaningZh: 失去；错过；遗失

examples.text: I lost my wallet yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我昨天丢了钱包。

examples.text: It's only the second time the team has lost a match this season.
examples.translationZh: 那仅仅是本赛季该队的第二次失利而已。

examples.text: The game will lose its relish when you grow old.
examples.translationZh: 你年纪大了以后,就会发现这种游戏的趣味大打折扣了。

meaningZh: 便宜的，廉价的；劣质的，低劣的；小气的，可鄙的

examples.text: Her shoes look cheap.
examples.translationZh: 她的那双鞋看上去很便宜。

examples.text: I am going to buy something cheap.
examples.translationZh: 我要买些便宜的东西。

examples.text: A flood of cheap imports has come into the shops.
examples.translationZh: 大量廉价进口商品涌入商店。

meaningZh: 得到；抓住；说服

examples.text: The problem is when to get the money we need.
examples.translationZh: 问题是什么时候能得到我们所需要的钱。

examples.text: If Peter had applied for the post, he would probably get it now.
examples.translationZh: 要是彼得申请了那职位,他很可能现在就得到了。

examples.text: She soon got the children ready for school.
examples.translationZh: 她很快帮孩子做好上学的准备。

meaningZh: 便士；(美国、加拿大的)一分钱；少量的钱

examples.text: I only have a few pennies with me.
examples.translationZh: 我身上只有几个便士。

examples.text: He said that he wouldn't lend me a penny.
examples.translationZh: 他说过他一便士都不愿借给我。

examples.text: He felt in his pocket for a penny.
examples.translationZh: 他在口袋里摸索着找一个便士。

meaningZh: （尤指作为一种职业的）教育工作者，教员，教师；教育学家，教育家；教学管理者

examples.text: That educator published many articles in these magazines.
examples.translationZh: 那位教育工作者在这些杂志上发表了许多文章。

meaningZh: 欢迎，迎接；致敬，致意；打招呼

examples.text: I greet you in the name of the President.
examples.translationZh: 我代表总统前来迎接您。

examples.text: He greeted her with a loving hug.
examples.translationZh: 他以一个深情的拥抱来迎接她。

examples.text: They greet each other with a hug and say Merry Christmas!
examples.translationZh: 他们互相拥抱,互相问候圣诞快乐!

meaningZh: 研究，追究；探讨，探测；调查

examples.text: We all support his scientific research.
examples.translationZh: 我们都支持他的科学研究。

examples.text: Research indicates that men find it easier to give up smoking than women.
examples.translationZh: 研究表明，男人比女人更容易戒烟。

examples.text: My research is just bouncing along at present.
examples.translationZh: 目前我的调查进展得很顺利。

meaningZh: 卷笔刀；磨床；磨器

examples.text: Nobody else has a pencil sharpener.
examples.translationZh: 再没有谁有卷笔刀了。

examples.text: The boy is sharpening his pencils with a sharpener.
examples.translationZh: 那男孩正在用卷笔刀削铅笔。

meaningZh: 一天,一日；[U]日间,白天；工作日

examples.text: Owls sleep by day and work at night.
examples.translationZh: 猫头鹰白天睡觉晚上工作。

examples.text: There will be occasional showers during the day.
examples.translationZh: 白天将偶有阵雨。

examples.text: He is seldom at home during the day.
examples.translationZh: 他白天很少在家。

meaningZh: 说服；劝说；使相信

examples.text: How can I persuade you of my sincerity?
examples.translationZh: 我如何能够让你相信我的诚意？

examples.text: We are persuaded of the justice of her case.
examples.translationZh: 我们确信对她案件的审理是公正的。

examples.text: I am not fully persuaded by the evidence.
examples.translationZh: 这证据不足以使我充分信服。

meaningZh: 禁止，阻止，防止；不准许

examples.text: Smoking is prohibited here.
examples.translationZh: 这里禁止吸烟。

examples.text: We should prohibit the sale of pornographic literature.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该禁止出售淫秽文学。

examples.text: Some areas prohibit dogs or require them to be on a leash at all times.
examples.translationZh: 一些区域禁止狗或者要求一直拴住它们。

meaningZh: 减少；缩小；使还原

examples.text: The new government's prime task is to reduce the level of inflation.
examples.translationZh: 新政府的主要任务是减低通货膨胀的水平。

examples.text: We need to reduce our dependence on oil as a source of energy.
examples.translationZh: 在能源方面,我们需减少对石油的依赖。

examples.text: We must gradually reduce the wage gap.
examples.translationZh: 我们要逐步缩小工资差距。

meaningZh: 编辑，编者；校订者；[计]编辑软件，编辑程序

examples.text: The editor hacked the story to bits.
examples.translationZh: 编辑把那篇小说改得面目全非。

examples.text: The editor struck out the whole paragraph.
examples.translationZh: 编辑把整段全删掉了。

examples.text: He is an associate editor of the newspaper.
examples.translationZh: 他是报纸的副主编。

meaningZh: 搏斗；奋斗；努力

examples.text: He struggled to control his temper.
examples.translationZh: 他努力控制住自己的脾气。

examples.text: They should therefore unite to struggle together.
examples.translationZh: 因此,他们要联合起来,共同努力奋斗。

examples.text: Let's join hands and struggle together.
examples.translationZh: 咱们携起手来共同斗争。

meaningZh: 讨论，谈论；详述，论述

examples.text: In their discussion, I was in favor of Mr. Li.
examples.translationZh: 在他们的争论中，我支持李先生。

examples.text: I was not privy to the discussion, so I cannot tell you what was decided.
examples.translationZh: 我并不了解讨论的情况，所以无法告诉你做了什么决定。

examples.text: The whole discussion pivots on this one point.
examples.translationZh: 整个讨论内容均以此为中心。

meaningZh: 进入；开始；参加

examples.text: Please do not enter before knocking on the door.
examples.translationZh: 进来前请先敲门。

examples.text: He has no choice but enter that college.
examples.translationZh: 他不得不进入那所大学读书。

examples.text: He showed me how to enter data into the computer.
examples.translationZh: 他告诉我如何将数据输入电脑。

meaningZh: 负担，包袱；责任，义务；载货量

examples.text: The burden on his back seemed to be crushing him to the earth.
examples.translationZh: 他背上的重负似乎要把他压倒在地。

examples.text: People on high incomes face a huge tax burden.
examples.translationZh: 高收入的人面临着沉重的纳税负担。

examples.text: The burden of organizing the campaign fell to me.
examples.translationZh: 组织这次活动的责任落到了我头上。

meaningZh: 橄榄球运动；拉格比市（英格兰中部的城市）；英式橄榄球

examples.text: Rugby is another popular winter sport.
examples.translationZh: 橄榄球是另一项流行的冬季运动。

examples.text: On Saturdy France plays Rugby against Wales.
examples.translationZh: 星期六,法国队和威尔士队比赛橄榄球。

meaningZh: 午餐；vt.& vi. 吃午餐；供给午餐

examples.text: We had a wonderful lunch.
examples.translationZh: 我们吃了顿很不错的午餐。

examples.text: Let's get together for lunch.
examples.translationZh: 让我们一起吃顿午餐吧。

examples.text: I can lunch off the bread left over from yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 午餐我可以吃昨天剩下的面包。

meaningZh: 推测；猜测，臆测；猜中

examples.text: I don't really know, I'm just guessing.
examples.translationZh: 我真的不知道, 我仅仅是猜想。

examples.text: We could only guess at her motives.
examples.translationZh: 我们只能猜测她的动机

examples.text: She guessed the right answer at once.
examples.translationZh: 她立刻猜出了正确的答案。

meaningZh: 自动的；不假思索的，无意识的；必然发生的

examples.text: This heating system has an automatic temperature control.
examples.translationZh: 这个暖气系统有自动化的温度调节系统。

examples.text: We get an automatic increase in pay every year.
examples.translationZh: 我们的薪金每年会自动增长。

examples.text: For most of us breathing is automatic.
examples.translationZh: 我们大多数人的呼吸都是无意识的。

meaningZh: 我；个人；利己主义者

examples.text: I don't like bananas.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢香蕉。

examples.text: I didn't hurt you, did I?
examples.translationZh: 我没有伤害你,是吧？

examples.text: It is I who will suffer.
examples.translationZh: 我将是那个要受苦的人。

meaningZh: 代理；机构；力量

examples.text: I hope we can see eye to eye about the other terms of the agency then.
examples.translationZh: 我希望到那时候我们能在代理协议的其他条款上能取得一致意见。

examples.text: I got this job through an employment agency.
examples.translationZh: 我通过职业介绍所找到了这份工作。

examples.text: They resigned their child to an adoption agency.
examples.translationZh: 他们把自己的孩子交给了一家收养机构。

meaningZh: 预言，预测；预示，预告；vi. 预言，预示：预言某事，预言

examples.text: It is virtually impossible to predict the future accurately.
examples.translationZh: 精确预言未来的事实际上是办不到的。

examples.text: The economists predicted an increase in the rate of inflation.
examples.translationZh: 经济学家预言通货膨胀率将会增长。

examples.text: The earthquake had been predicted several months before.
examples.translationZh: 这次地震早在几个月以前就发布了预报。

meaningZh: 物主身份；所有权；所有制

examples.text: She disclaimed ownership of the vehicle.
examples.translationZh: 她放弃了这辆车的所有权。

examples.text: The ownership of the house is still unknown.
examples.translationZh: 这栋房子的所有权至今无人知道。

examples.text: The ownership of the land is disputed.
examples.translationZh: 那土地的所有权有争议。

meaningZh: 修改；改[纠]正；惩罚

examples.text: I'm speaking under correction.
examples.translationZh: 我说的不一定正确。

examples.text: The correction of all my mistakes took nearly an hour.
examples.translationZh: 我用了近一个小时才改完我的全部错误。

examples.text: I believe these figures are the most recent available but I am open to correction.
examples.translationZh: 我认为这些数据是最近才得到的，但我乐于接受改正。

meaningZh: 破布；碎布；破旧衣服

examples.text: She twisted a rag round my hand.
examples.translationZh: 她用一块破布包住我的手。

examples.text: He plugged the hole in the pipe with an old rag.
examples.translationZh: 他用一块旧破布把管子上的那个洞塞住了。

examples.text: He wrapped a clean rag around his ankle.
examples.translationZh: 他把一小块乾净的布缠住脚腕。

meaningZh: 破坏，摧毁；消灭，歼灭（敌人）；杀死

examples.text: If the tree falls that way, it will destroy the house.
examples.translationZh: 这棵树向那边倒下就会把那所房子压坏。

examples.text: We want to nurture the new project, not destroy it.
examples.translationZh: 我们要支持这个新工程，不要破坏它。

examples.text: The new law operates to destroy our advantages.
examples.translationZh: 这项新法律损害我们的利益。

meaningZh: 院子；码（等于3英尺或36英寸或0。9144米）；场地

examples.text: I was out in the back yard splitting logs.
examples.translationZh: 我那时正在后院劈柴。

examples.text: We planted some elms in the yard.
examples.translationZh: 我们在院子里种了一些榆树。

examples.text: Her carriage was the most beautiful one in the yard.
examples.translationZh: 她的马车是院子里最漂亮的。

meaningZh: 绘画；拖，拉；招致

examples.text: The horses draw the wagon.
examples.translationZh: 马拖货车。

examples.text: Our car broke down and we had to draw it to a garage.
examples.translationZh: 我们的车坏了, 不得不把它拖到修车厂去。

examples.text: The season was drawing to its dusty end.
examples.translationZh: 喧嚣纷扰的社交季节逐渐接近尾声。

meaningZh: 煤；煤块；煤堆

examples.text: He put a shovel of coal on to the fire.
examples.translationZh: 他往火炉里加了一铲煤。

examples.text: The country is rich in oil and coal.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家石油和煤的资源丰富。

examples.text: Coal can be converted to gas.
examples.translationZh: 煤可以转化成煤气。

meaningZh: 两次；两倍；两遍

examples.text: I am more than twice as old as he.
examples.translationZh: 我的年龄是他的两倍还不止。

examples.text: The length of the table is twice its breadth.
examples.translationZh: 桌子的长度是它的宽度的两倍。

examples.text: I've seen this film twice.
examples.translationZh: 这部影片我已经看过两次了。

meaningZh: 环境，周围的事物；adj. 周围的，附近的；v. 包围( surround的现在分词 )

examples.text: The surrounding land is low and marshy.
examples.translationZh: 周围的地低洼而多沼泽。

examples.text: Gradually the surrounding farmland turned residential.
examples.translationZh: 周围的农田渐渐变成了住宅区。

examples.text: The surrounding villages have been absorbed into the growing city.
examples.translationZh: 周围的村庄已经并入了那不断扩展的城市。

meaningZh: 建立；制定；开始

examples.text: New methods of teaching foreign languages are adopted in this institute.
examples.translationZh: 该学院采用新的外语教学法。

examples.text: Integrity and professionalism are the two main corporate values of the Institute.
examples.translationZh: 诚信和专业精神是学会的两个主要机构价值观。

examples.text: The UK's Securities & Investment Institute provides education and qualifications for many of these staff.
examples.translationZh: 英国证券与投资协会为许多这样的员工提供培训和资格证书。

meaningZh: 应受；应得；值得

examples.text: He has done nothing to deserve death.
examples.translationZh: 他没做过该受死刑的事。

examples.text: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
examples.translationZh: 你帮了这么大的忙，理应受到奖励。

examples.text: These proposals deserve careful study.
examples.translationZh: 这些建议值得认真研究。

meaningZh: 洞，孔；洞穴，穴；缺陷

examples.text: There is a hole in my sock.
examples.translationZh: 我的袜子上有个洞。

examples.text: The dog skins through the small hole in the wall.
examples.translationZh: 那条狗勉强钻过小小的墙洞。

examples.text: He chiseled a hole in the door to fit a new lock.
examples.translationZh: 他在门上凿了个孔，以便装一把新锁。

meaningZh: 使延期，延缓；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面

examples.text: The weather being bad, we had to postpone our trip.
examples.translationZh: 因为天气不好,我们不得不延期出行。

examples.text: She did not postpone her departure.
examples.translationZh: 她不再延迟她的行期。

examples.text: Can we postpone the meeting till tomorrow?
examples.translationZh: 我们可以把会议延到明天吗?

meaningZh: 等候；等待；（尤指长期地）希望

examples.text: She has impatience to wait for the bus.
examples.translationZh: 她没有耐心等公共汽车到来。

examples.text: He kept us waiting for ages while he packed his luggage.
examples.translationZh: 他收拾行李，让我们等了好半天。

examples.text: You will just have to wait your turn.
examples.translationZh: 你得等到轮到你才行。

meaningZh: [乐]主题；主旋律；题目，话题

examples.text: Peace was the dominant theme of the conference.
examples.translationZh: 和平是大会的首要议题。

examples.text: What is the essential theme of the play?
examples.translationZh: 这剧本的主题是什麽?

examples.text: The theme for tonight's talk is education.
examples.translationZh: 今天谈话的题目是教育。

meaningZh: 智力；聪颖；情报

examples.text: She's the equal of her brother as far as intelligence is concerned.
examples.translationZh: 论智力，她和她哥哥不相上下。

examples.text: His intelligence is rather limited.
examples.translationZh: 他的智力相当有限。

examples.text: She's not lacking in intelligence.
examples.translationZh: 她并不缺乏学识。

meaningZh: 发出滴答声；n. 滴答声

examples.text: The clock went ticktock all night.
examples.translationZh: 时钟整夜滴答作响。

meaningZh: 公鸡；[美]狂妄自负的人，好斗者

examples.text: The rooster clawed a hole in the earth.
examples.translationZh: 那只公鸡在地上扒出个洞来。

examples.text: The rooster disappeared under the car.
examples.translationZh: 公鸡消失在车子底下。

examples.text: Don't talk with him; he is a rooster.
examples.translationZh: 别理他，他太狂妄自负了。

meaningZh: 到达，抵达；出现，登场；新生婴儿

examples.text: I am impatient for his arrival.
examples.translationZh: 我渴盼着他的到来。

examples.text: The secretary informed me of his arrival.
examples.translationZh: 秘书通知我他来了。

examples.text: Since her arrival at the company, she has re-organized several departments.
examples.translationZh: 自从她到这个公司,她已经重组了几个部门了。

meaningZh: 妥协；（名誉等的）损害；妥协（或折中）方案

examples.text: He did it without compromise of his dignity.
examples.translationZh: 他做这事而不损及他的尊严。

examples.text: The agreement is a compromise, not a sell-out.
examples.translationZh: 这个协议是双方妥协的产物而不是一方让步。

examples.text: After some discussion we arrive at a compromise.
examples.translationZh: 经过一番讨论之后，我们达成一项折衷方案。

meaningZh: 宽的；普遍的；广阔的

examples.text: He is a man of wide interests.
examples.translationZh: 他兴趣广泛。

examples.text: The paper has a wide readership.
examples.translationZh: 该报拥有广泛的读者。

examples.text: Computers have been brought into wide use.
examples.translationZh: 计算机已得到广泛使用。

meaningZh: （一件）工作；职责；职业

examples.text: I do get a job in a travel agency.
examples.translationZh: 我真的在旅行社找了份工作。

examples.text: He lost his job during the great depression.
examples.translationZh: 他在大萧条时期失业了。

examples.text: His present job seemed to be a blind alley.
examples.translationZh: 他现在的职业看来没什么前途。

meaningZh: 货车；（铁路的）无盖货车；（行李）搬运车

examples.text: The truck was heavily loaded.
examples.translationZh: 这辆卡车装载很重。

examples.text: They transported the goods by truck.
examples.translationZh: 他们用卡车运货。

examples.text: Move cylinders using a suitable hand truck or cart.
examples.translationZh: 用合适的手推车或移动钢瓶。

meaningZh: 位；地方；职位

examples.text: We must find a place for this new picture.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须找一个地方放这张新照片。

examples.text: Put everything away in its correct place.
examples.translationZh: 把东西放到该放的地方去。

examples.text: Social science affirms that a woman's place in society marks the level of civilization.
examples.translationZh: 社会科学认为,妇女在社会里的地位标志着文明的水平。

meaningZh: 鹅；鹅肉；雌鹅

examples.text: The goose hissed at me angrily.
examples.translationZh: 那鹅愤怒地向我发出嘶嘶声。

examples.text: There is some goose left in the bowl.
examples.translationZh: 碗里还剩有点鹅肉。

examples.text: They often have goose at Christmastime.
examples.translationZh: 他们在圣诞节时常常吃鹅肉。

meaningZh: 淹没；下落；退去

examples.text: Wood does not sink in water, it floats.
examples.translationZh: 木头在水中不沉，而是漂在水面。

examples.text: The boat will sink unless we bail out.
examples.translationZh: 我们要不把积水清除掉，船就要沉了。

examples.text: The ship was sunk by an enemy torpedo.
examples.translationZh: 这艘船被敌人的鱼雷击沉了。

meaningZh: 粗绳；绳索；一串

examples.text: The rope was not strong enough, so we used wire.
examples.translationZh: 这根绳子不够结实，所以我们用金属线。

examples.text: They tied their prisoner up with a piece of rope.
examples.translationZh: 他们用绳索把犯人捆起来。

examples.text: I bought a beautiful rope of pearls.
examples.translationZh: 我买了一串很好看的珠子。

meaningZh: 稳定的，不变的；镇定的，沉着的；坚定的

examples.text: The old man is not steady on his legs.
examples.translationZh: 这位老人站不稳。

examples.text: The agreement ensured a steady supply of oil.
examples.translationZh: 该协定保证了石油的稳定供给。

examples.text: Don't tell your secret to him before you get a steady relationship.
examples.translationZh: 在未跟他的感情稳定下来之前,不要把自己的秘密说给他听。

meaningZh: 抽象的，理论上的；难解的；抽象派的

examples.text: We may talk of beautiful things, but beauty itself is abstract.
examples.translationZh: 我们尽可谈论美的事物，然而美本身却是抽象的。

examples.text: He has some abstract notion of wanting to change the world.
examples.translationZh: 他有一种要改造世界的空想。

examples.text: Abstract paintings did not appeal to him.
examples.translationZh: 抽象派绘画引不起他的兴趣。

meaningZh: 蓝色的,蔚蓝的；沮丧的,忧郁的；[C]蓝色,蔚蓝; 青色

examples.text: She wore a dark blue coat.
examples.translationZh: 她穿着一件深蓝色的上衣。

examples.text: The pots are made with blue enamel.
examples.translationZh: 这些锅上有蓝色的搪瓷。

examples.text: Someone has flown off with my blue bag.
examples.translationZh: 有人把我那蓝色的包偷拿走了。

meaningZh: 调解，调整；调节器；调解，调停

examples.text: I've made a few minor adjustments to the seating plan.
examples.translationZh: 我对座次表作了小小的调整。

examples.text: The company made an adjustment in my salary.
examples.translationZh: 公司对我的薪金作了调整。

examples.text: The adjustment of the interest rate will moderate.
examples.translationZh: 利率的调整将会放缓。

meaningZh: 严格的；僵硬的；（规则、方法等）死板的

examples.text: The tent has a rigid support.
examples.translationZh: 帐篷有一个坚硬的支柱。

examples.text: He is a man of very rigid principles.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个原则性很强的人。

examples.text: He's very rigid in his ideas.
examples.translationZh: 他的想法非常固执。

meaningZh: 汤，羹；浓雾；硝化甘油炸药

examples.text: I made some gravy soup for my husband.
examples.translationZh: 我给我丈夫做了一些肉汤。

examples.text: He had spoiled the soup by putting in too much salt.
examples.translationZh: 他往汤里放盐太多，把汤给糟蹋了。

examples.text: This soup is a spicy variation on a traditional favourite.
examples.translationZh: 这种汤是在一种受欢迎的传统汤羹中加了香料。

meaningZh: 常常；经常；时常

examples.text: I often take my children to play in the park.
examples.translationZh: 我经常带我的孩子们去公园玩。

examples.text: My brother often scolds me without reason.
examples.translationZh: 我哥哥经常无故责备我。

examples.text: Judy goes to the movies as often as Sara does.
examples.translationZh: 朱迪像莎拉一样时常去看电影。

meaningZh: 最，最多（大）；much的最高级；非常，很

examples.text: This is the area that attracts the most attention.
examples.translationZh: 这是最受关注的地区。

examples.text: Studying on our own brings the most knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 自己钻研可带来最多的知识。

examples.text: Who do you think will get (the) most votes?
examples.translationZh: 你认为谁会得到最多的选票?

meaningZh: 相等的，平等的；平稳的；势均力敌的

examples.text: Women demand equal pay for equal work.
examples.translationZh: 妇女要求同工同酬。

examples.text: All countries, big and small, should be equal.
examples.translationZh: 国家不论大小, 一律平等。

examples.text: Nobody can equal him in intelligence.
examples.translationZh: 没有人在智力方面能比得上他。

meaningZh: 原子核的，原子能的；[细胞]细胞核的

examples.text: Nuclear binding energies are strikingly high.
examples.translationZh: 原子核的结合能是极大的。

examples.text: The college students are active to crusade against the nuclear weapons.
examples.translationZh: 大学生们积极投入开展反对核武器的运 动。

examples.text: They decided to establish a nuclear power station.
examples.translationZh: 他们决定修建一所核电站。

meaningZh: 诞生地，出生地

examples.text: He has a sentimental attachment to his birthplace.
examples.translationZh: 他对他的出生地有眷恋之情。

examples.text: The house is wrongly reputed to have been the poet's birthplace.
examples.translationZh: 这所房子被误以为是诗人的出生地。

examples.text: Ronda is the birthplace of modern bullfighting.
examples.translationZh: 朗达是现代西班牙斗牛场的发源地。

meaningZh: 铝；adj. 铝的

examples.text: I hardly ever know that aluminium alloy could be as strong as steel.
examples.translationZh: 我几乎从来不知道铝合金竟会和钢强度一样大。

examples.text: Aluminium was slowly wedging its way in the metal market.
examples.translationZh: 当时铝正在慢慢地挤入金属市场。

examples.text: By mixing aluminium with other metals, scientists have been able to produce a variety of alloys, some of which have the strength of steel but weigh only one third as much.
examples.translationZh: 把铝和其他金属混合，科学家们能够制造出各种合金，其中一些具有钢一样的强度，但其重量只是钢的三分之一。

meaningZh: 小提琴；小提琴手

examples.text: He plays the violin for the fun of it.
examples.translationZh: 她拉小提琴只是为了好玩。

examples.text: The audience lapped up the violin solo.
examples.translationZh: 观众对小提琴独奏反应热烈。

examples.text: The violin is not quite in tune with the piano.
examples.translationZh: 这小提琴跟钢琴的调子不太和谐。

meaningZh: 包围，围绕；n. （物品的）边；外围物

examples.text: The house was surrounded by high walls.
examples.translationZh: 房子的四周有高墙。

examples.text: They have surrounded the town with troops.
examples.translationZh: 他们出动军队包围了该城。

examples.text: Trees surround the pond.
examples.translationZh: 树木围绕着池塘。

meaningZh: 光荣，荣誉；壮观，壮丽；（对上帝的）赞颂

examples.text: No road of flowers lead to glory.
examples.translationZh: 没有一条通往光荣的道路是铺满鲜花的。

examples.text: His brave deeds in the battle earned him everlasting glory.
examples.translationZh: 他在那场战斗中的英勇事迹为他赢得了永恒的荣誉。

examples.text: They are driven by a craving for personal glory.
examples.translationZh: 对个人荣誉的渴望驱动着他们。

meaningZh: 要求；必要条件；必需品，需要量

examples.text: Candidates who fail to meet these requirements will not be admitted to the University.
examples.translationZh: 不符合这些要求的考生不能上这所大学。

examples.text: Our immediate requirement is extra staff.
examples.translationZh: 我们亟需增加工作人员。

examples.text: The refugees' main requirements are food and shelter.
examples.translationZh: 难民的主要必需品是食物和住所。

meaningZh: 运动员；体育家；强壮的人

examples.text: The athlete is suffering from muscular strain.
examples.translationZh: 这名运动员正受肌肉劳损之苦。

examples.text: She will make a very good athlete.
examples.translationZh: 她将来会成为一名很好的运动员。

examples.text: The athlete has an electrifying burst of speed.
examples.translationZh: 这名运动员具有惊人的爆发速度。

meaningZh: 自然（界）的；身体的；物质的

examples.text: It's a physical impossibility to be in two places at one time.
examples.translationZh: 同时在两地是自然规律上不可能的事。

examples.text: Physical disability causes mental anguish.
examples.translationZh: 生理伤残会引起心理苦闷。

examples.text: Staying up late makes him at his worst in terms of physical situation.
examples.translationZh: 熬夜使得他的体力状况处于低潮。

meaningZh: 宽恕；原谅；赦免

examples.text: I do beg your pardon.
examples.translationZh: 一定请您原谅。

examples.text: She supplicated for pardon.
examples.translationZh: 她恳求原谅。

examples.text: They all sued out a pardon for an offender.
examples.translationZh: 他们请求法院赦免一名罪犯。

meaningZh: 究竟什么时候；不论何时；conj. 无论什么时候

examples.text: It's not urgent we can do it next week or whenever.
examples.translationZh: 不是急事--我们可以下星期做或其他时候做。

examples.text: I'd like to see you whenever it's convenient.
examples.translationZh: 在你方便的时候我想来看看你。

examples.text: She gets in a fret whenever we're late.
examples.translationZh: 只要我们一迟到,她就焦虑不安。

meaningZh: 秘密，机密；秘诀；奥秘

examples.text: Our plan must remain a secret.
examples.translationZh: 我们的计划必须保密。

examples.text: His secret died with him, for he never told anyone.
examples.translationZh: 他的秘密至死也不为人知，因为他从未告诉过别人。

examples.text: What new secrets of the universe will the new telescope reveal?
examples.translationZh: 新的望远镜将会给我们展示宇宙的哪些新奥秘呢？

meaningZh: 纸；被单；一张（通常指标准尺寸的纸）

examples.text: We change the sheet every week.
examples.translationZh: 我们每个星期换一次床单。

examples.text: The doctor wanted us to use the sheet for a shroud.
examples.translationZh: 医生想让我们用床单当裹尸布。

examples.text: He put a fresh sheet in the typewriter.
examples.translationZh: 他把一张纸放进了打字机中。

meaningZh: 面包；食物；营养，营养物

examples.text: They had nothing to eat but stale bread.
examples.translationZh: 除了陈面包外，他们没有别的东西可吃。

examples.text: I had a frugal meal of bread and cheese last night.
examples.translationZh: 我昨晚吃了只有面包和奶酪的便餐。

examples.text: Bread the pork chops before frying them.
examples.translationZh: 炸猪排前先在上面撒一点面包碎屑。

meaningZh: 信息；消息；要旨

examples.text: There is an important message for you from your brother.
examples.translationZh: 你哥哥有个重要的消息要告诉你。

examples.text: The message in the newspaper is unabridged.
examples.translationZh: 报纸上的那则消息是没有经过删节的。

examples.text: Did you deliver my message to my father?
examples.translationZh: 你把我的信息传给我父亲了吗?

meaningZh: 相遇；相识；开会

examples.text: I chanced to meet an old friend in the park today.
examples.translationZh: 今天我在公园碰巧遇见一位老朋友。

examples.text: She is the girl whom you meet at the airport.
examples.translationZh: 她就是你在机场遇见的那个女孩。

examples.text: Ensure that your request be the fastest meet.
examples.translationZh: 保证你的要求得到最快的满足。

meaningZh: 林荫路；大街；途径，手段

examples.text: He stands on the corner of a wide avenue.
examples.translationZh: 他站在宽阔的林荫道的角落里。

examples.text: I meet him by chance on Fifth Avenue.
examples.translationZh: 我偶然在第大街上遇到他。

examples.text: The avenue was crowded with people.
examples.translationZh: 大街上挤满了人。

meaningZh: 打扰，妨碍；使骚动；使不安，使烦恼

examples.text: They took the phone off the hook so no calls would disturb them.
examples.translationZh: 他们摘下电话听筒，以免电话打扰他们。

examples.text: I am sorry to disturb you.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉我妨碍到你了。

examples.text: Ministers declared themselves profoundly disturbed by the violence.
examples.translationZh: 大臣们自称因为暴力而感到深刻的不安。

meaningZh: 会计人员，会计师

examples.text: He was deep in conversation with his accountant.
examples.translationZh: 他与会计深入交谈。

examples.text: The accountant described his work to the sales staff.
examples.translationZh: 那个会计向营业部的职员介绍了自己的工作情况。

examples.text: The company accountant queried my travel expenses.
examples.translationZh: 公司的会计对我的旅行开支提出疑问。

meaningZh: 允许；承认；给予

examples.text: You are not allowed to smoke here.
examples.translationZh: 这里不许吸烟。

examples.text: How much holiday are you allowed?
examples.translationZh: 你有多少天假?

examples.text: I should allow an hour to get to London.
examples.translationZh: 到伦敦去我得留出一小时来。

meaningZh: 收缩，皱缩；（使）缩水；退缩，畏缩

examples.text: Will this woolen sweater shrink when washed?
examples.translationZh: 这件羊毛衫洗后会缩水吗？

examples.text: The company's profit margins shrank from 32.5% to 17%.
examples.translationZh: 该公司的边际利润率从32.5%降到了17%。

examples.text: We will never shrink from difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 我们在困难面前决不退缩。

meaningZh: 认捐，捐赠；签署，题词，署名；认购

examples.text: I subscribe to"Reader's Digest"magazine.
examples.translationZh: 我订了《读者文摘》杂志。

examples.text: They refused to subscribe to the agreement.
examples.translationZh: 他们拒绝在协议上签字。

examples.text: Do you subscribe to her pessimistic view of the state of the economy?
examples.translationZh: 你是否同意她对经济状况所持的悲观看法？

meaningZh: 症状；征兆

examples.text: Cigarettes can aggravate the symptoms of a cold.
examples.translationZh: 抽烟会加重感冒症状。

examples.text: The doctor made his diagnosis after studying the patient's symptoms.
examples.translationZh: 医生研究病人的症状后, 作出诊断。

examples.text: Fever is a symptom of many illnesses.
examples.translationZh: 发烧是许多疾病的症兆。

meaningZh: （表示方向）进入…中；（表示所属）输入；（表示状态）进入…状态

examples.text: An idea popped into his mind like a flash.
examples.translationZh: 他头脑里突然闪过一个念头。

examples.text: Nothing will induce me to jump into the icy water.
examples.translationZh: 我怎么也不会想跳进这冰冷的水里。

examples.text: The thief broke into the house during the night.
examples.translationZh: 小偷在夜间破门进入住宅。

meaningZh: 生物化学；生物化学成份

examples.text: Her research is breaking new ground in biochemistry.
examples.translationZh: 她的研究正在开辟生物化学的新开地。

examples.text: I am going to start my doctorate in biochemistry next year.
examples.translationZh: 我准备明年开始攻读生物化学博士学位。

meaningZh: 乞讨；恳求（原谅）；回避（问题）

examples.text: She begs them not to punish her son severely.
examples.translationZh: 她恳求他们不要给他儿子太重的处罚。

examples.text: The boys hailed passing cars to beg a ride.
examples.translationZh: 这些男孩向过往的汽车呼叫恳求乘车。

examples.text: He knew he had hurt her and begged her to forgive him.
examples.translationZh: 他自知伤了她的心而央求她原谅。

meaningZh: 毛巾，手巾；纸巾；vt. 用毛巾擦

examples.text: I dry my hands and face with the towel.
examples.translationZh: 我用毛巾擦干了双手和面部。

examples.text: She mops her tears with a towel.
examples.translationZh: 她用毛巾擦眼泪。

examples.text: We installed a stainless steel towel rail on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 我们在墙上装了一个不锈钢的挂毛巾的横杆。

meaningZh: （中小学的）男生；学童

examples.text: He is a nine-year-old schoolboy.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个九岁的男学生。

examples.text: The ratio of schoolboys to schoolgirls is 2 to 1.
examples.translationZh: 男学生和女学生的比例是2比1。

examples.text: The schoolboy made a face at his teacher's back.
examples.translationZh: 那个男生对着教师的背后做个鬼脸。

meaningZh: 美好；美人；完美

examples.text: Beauty's tears are lovelier than her smile.
examples.translationZh: 美人的泪水比微笑更可爱。

examples.text: His wife is an unmatched beauty.
examples.translationZh: 他妻子是一个倾国倾城的美人。

examples.text: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
examples.translationZh: 语言难以描述那景色之美丽。

meaningZh: （表示时间）从…；（表示原因）因为；（表示来源）来自…

examples.text: He descended from a good family.
examples.translationZh: 他出自名门。

examples.text: From what author does this quotation come?
examples.translationZh: 这一引文出自哪位作者?

examples.text: Bitter words from you will only wound her.
examples.translationZh: 出自你口中的尖刻话只会伤害她而已。

meaningZh: 杂草；大麻；废物

examples.text: The garden is choked with weeds.
examples.translationZh: 花园杂草丛生。

examples.text: She knelt down to pull a weed from the flower bed.
examples.translationZh: 她跪下来拔除花圃上的杂草。

examples.text: There are so many weeds in his field!
examples.translationZh: 他的田里有那么多野草！

meaningZh: 解释者；口译译员；[军事]判读员

examples.text: She earned her living as an interpreter.
examples.translationZh: 她靠当译员谋生。

examples.text: She is determined to be an interpreter.
examples.translationZh: 她决心要当一名口译者。

examples.text: She was famous as an interpreter of Shakespearean roles.
examples.translationZh: 她因演绎莎士比亚戏剧角色而出名。

meaningZh: 黑（色）的；黑色人种的；黑暗的

examples.text: Do you have a black jacket?
examples.translationZh: 你有一件黑夹克吗？

examples.text: How do you like coffee, black or white ?
examples.translationZh: 你喜欢什么样的咖啡?不加牛奶的还是加牛奶的?

examples.text: His hands were black from working on the car all afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 他的双手因为整个下午都在修车而变得脏黑黑的。

meaningZh: 惭愧的，羞耻的，害臊的；难为情

examples.text: He is ashamed for his former dishonorable action.
examples.translationZh: 他对他以前不光彩的行为感到羞愧。

examples.text: He was ashamed that he had lied.
examples.translationZh: 他很惭愧他说了谎。

examples.text: As for you, you should feel ashamed.
examples.translationZh: 至于你，你应该感到惭愧。

meaningZh: 抓住；了解；急忙抓住

examples.text: She has a good grasp of the English language.
examples.translationZh: 她精通英语。

examples.text: She has a comprehensive grasp of the subject.
examples.translationZh: 她已全面掌握了这一学科。

examples.text: I kept her hands in my grasp.
examples.translationZh: 我紧握着她的手。

meaningZh: 恶心的；晕船；不舒服的

examples.text: He fell sick with malaria on a trip to Africa.
examples.translationZh: 他在去非洲时患了疟疾。

examples.text: He put a maid in to look after his sick wife.
examples.translationZh: 他雇了1名女仆来照顾她的病妻。

examples.text: You'll be sick if you eat any more of that candy.
examples.translationZh: 如果你再吃那种糖果,就会感到恶心的。

meaningZh: 火，燃烧物；火灾；射击，发射

examples.text: The fire flared up as I put more firewood on it.
examples.translationZh: 我加上了几块木柴, 火顿时旺起来。

examples.text: The house is on fire!
examples.translationZh: 房子着火了！

examples.text: A cigarette thrown into the woods in dry weather may start a fire.
examples.translationZh: 在天气干燥时把点燃的香烟扔进树林可能会引起火灾。

meaningZh: 比（用于比较级）；宁愿…而不愿；除…以外

examples.text: She was older than I was.
examples.translationZh: 她年纪比我大。

examples.text: I was inspired to work harder than ever before.
examples.translationZh: 我受激励比以往任何时候都更加努力地工作。

examples.text: This street is four times shorter than that one.
examples.translationZh: 这条街道比那条短四倍。

meaningZh: 少年，少女；adj. 青春期的；青少年的

examples.text: It is not unusual for grown adults to act in an adolescent way.
examples.translationZh: 成人表现出青春期的样子很正常。

examples.text: She says that risk-taking is normal adolescent behaviour.
examples.translationZh: 她说冒险是青春期的正常表现。

examples.text: I still remember my adolescent life.
examples.translationZh: 我仍然记得我青少年时期的生活。

meaningZh: 向外的；外面的；公开的

examples.text: A detonation projects an instantaneous pulse of pressure outward in all directions.
examples.translationZh: 爆炸的瞬间会朝各个方向发出向外的压力波。

examples.text: Frost consists of tiny crystals of ice which grow outward from a solid surface.
examples.translationZh: 霜是由冰的微晶组成，它生长在固体表面的外部。

examples.text: The Sun's outermost layer begins about 10,000 miles above the visible surface and goes outward for millions of miles.
examples.translationZh: 太阳的最外层从其可见表面的约一万英里处开始，向外延伸数百万英里。

meaningZh: 喀哒声；爪，掣子；[计]（鼠标）点击

examples.text: Marsha heard the lock click softly.
examples.translationZh: 玛莎听到锁轻轻地发出咔嗒一声。

examples.text: Click on their names to find out more about them.
examples.translationZh: 点击它们的名称以获取更多信息。

examples.text: You can click here to download the file now.
examples.translationZh: 你可以点击这里立刻下载文件。

meaningZh: 透明的；清澈的；易识破的

examples.text: Plain glass is transparent.
examples.translationZh: 普通的白玻璃是透明的。

examples.text: The insect's wings are almost transparent.
examples.translationZh: 这昆虫的翅膀几乎是透明的。

examples.text: It was transparent that her pride was hurt.
examples.translationZh: 很显然，她的自尊心受到了伤害。

meaningZh: 可爱的；令人愉快的；亲切友好的

examples.text: The girl's rosy cheeks made her look very lovely.
examples.translationZh: 那女孩玫瑰色的脸颊使她显得非常可爱。

examples.text: The squirrel is a lovely small animal.
examples.translationZh: 松鼠是一种可爱的小动物。

examples.text: Collecting buttons is a lovely way to pass time.
examples.translationZh: 收集钮扣是一种令人愉快的消遣方法。

meaningZh: 被动的；消极的；不抵抗的

examples.text: He played a passive role in the marriage.
examples.translationZh: 他在婚姻中扮演了一个被动的角色。

examples.text: You are passive when you allow things to happen, but do nothing.
examples.translationZh: 当你让这些事发生,而不做任何事来阻止它,你是消极的。

examples.text: Good is the passive that obeys reason.
examples.translationZh: 善是服从理智的被动性。

meaningZh: 粉红色的；淡红色的；略带左翼政治观点的

examples.text: She carried a spray of pink roses.
examples.translationZh: 她拿著一簇粉红色的玫瑰花。

examples.text: Write your name and address on this pink slip.
examples.translationZh: 在这张粉红色纸条上写下你的姓名和地址。

examples.text: The sunset has tinted the sky with pink.
examples.translationZh: 落日把天空染成了粉红色。

meaningZh: 金属；金属元素；成色

examples.text: Copper and gold are both metals.
examples.translationZh: 铜和金都是金属。

examples.text: Wood floats on the water but metal sinks.
examples.translationZh: 木头漂在水面上,而金属却下沉。

examples.text: They cut holes on the sheet of metal with a punch press.
examples.translationZh: 他们用冲床在金属板上打孔。

meaningZh: 易看见的，可看见的；显然的，明明白白的；貌似的，表面的

examples.text: It was apparent to all that he was guilty.
examples.translationZh: 众所周知，他是有罪的。

examples.text: Japan's apparent lack of capitalist endeavour also has much to do with the lack of a mature financing market.
examples.translationZh: 显而易见,日本缺少资本家的创业精神,而这与日本没有一个成熟的融资市场也有很大关系。

examples.text: She had many good qualities despite her apparent rudeness.
examples.translationZh: 她粗鲁是粗鲁，但还有许多优秀品质。

meaningZh: 战斗；斗争；打架

examples.text: After spiritual purification, he meets the demon in a thrilling fight.
examples.translationZh: 在精神净化后,他遇见邪魔并展开激烈的战斗。

examples.text: Armed with raincoat and flashlight, he joined in the fight against the flood.
examples.translationZh: 他穿上雨衣,带上手电,加入了抗洪的战斗。

examples.text: Did you hear that there was a fight down in the local on Wednesday?
examples.translationZh: 你听说了吗?上星期三在附近的酒馆里有人打架。

meaningZh: 剃须，剃毛；vt. 剃，削去；修剪

examples.text: I lathered my face and started to shave.
examples.translationZh: 我往脸上涂了皂沫，然后开始刮胡子。

examples.text: He shaved his head bald.
examples.translationZh: 他剃了个光头。

examples.text: He asked me to shave the lawn.
examples.translationZh: 他叫我修剪草坪。

meaningZh: 准备；预备（饭菜）；配备

examples.text: Early experiments with military rockets prepared the ground for space travel.
examples.translationZh: 早年对军用火箭进行的实验为发展航天技术奠定了基础。

examples.text: He is preparing his speech for the meeting tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 他正准备明天集会的演说。

examples.text: Prepare to alight,for we are almost there.
examples.translationZh: 我们马上就要到了

meaningZh: 漫画；讽刺画；动画片

examples.text: The kids glued their eyes to the TV set, watching a cartoon.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们目不转睛地盯着电视机看卡通片。

examples.text: The man looks like a cartoon character with a plaster on his temple.
examples.translationZh: 那人太阳穴上贴了一块膏药，看上去像个卡通人物。

examples.text: This movie theater often shows the latest cartoon films.
examples.translationZh: 这家电影院经常放映一些最新的卡通电影.

meaningZh: 上瘾的；沉迷于某种嗜好的；vt. 使…上瘾(addict的过去分词)

examples.text: He's finally off (ie is no longer addicted to) drugs.
examples.translationZh: 他终於戒了毒了。

examples.text: He's hooked on (ie addicted to) speed.
examples.translationZh: 他使用安非他明已成瘾。

examples.text: Smokers who inhale are likely to become addicted to nicotine.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟的人容易对尼古丁上瘾。

meaningZh: 海峡；（常用pl.）窘迫，困境；危难

examples.text: We will transit the strait at night.
examples.translationZh: 我们将在夜间通过那个海峡。

examples.text: We passed through the Strait of Magellan.
examples.translationZh: 我们穿过了麦哲伦海峡。

examples.text: I hear you are in poor financial straits.
examples.translationZh: 我听说你处于经济困难之中。

meaningZh: 食物，食品；粮食；养料

examples.text: What's your favorite food?
examples.translationZh: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

examples.text: I prefer vegetarian food.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢吃素食。

examples.text: The scarcity of food forced prices up.
examples.translationZh: 食物短缺促使物价上涨。

meaningZh: 嗓音；（动词的）语态；呼声，发言权

examples.text: His voice shook with fear.
examples.translationZh: 他害怕得声音发抖。

examples.text: The little girl spoke in a high childish voice.
examples.translationZh: 小女孩说话时声音尖尖的，带着童音。

examples.text: We could hear the children's voices in the garden.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以听到花园里孩子们的声音。

meaningZh: 半圆形，半圆形的周长，半圆形的东西

examples.text: An angle in a semicircle is a right angle.
examples.translationZh: 半圆所对的圆周角是直角。

examples.text: We sat in a semicircle round the fire.
examples.translationZh: 我们坐在炉火前，围成一个半圆形。

examples.text: We sat in a semicircle facing the teacher.
examples.translationZh: 我们面对着老师坐成半圆形。

meaningZh: 安全的；牢固的；有把握的

examples.text: If you are not sure it is secure, do not debug it.
examples.translationZh: 如果您不能确定它是安全的,请不要调试它。

examples.text: His place in history is now secure.
examples.translationZh: 他在历史上的地位现在已经稳固了。

examples.text: A climber needs secure footholds.
examples.translationZh: 攀登的人脚踩的地方要很牢固。

meaningZh: 售货棚，摊位；公用电话亭；隔开的小间

examples.text: Would you please watch over my booth?
examples.translationZh: 请您照料一下我的摊位好吗?

examples.text: I'll give him a call from the phone booth on the corner.
examples.translationZh: 我到街角的电话亭给他打个电话。

examples.text: It happened that there was a telephone booth nearby.
examples.translationZh: 碰巧在附近有个公用电话亭。

meaningZh: 你自己；（用以加强语气）亲自；你的正常或健康的情况

examples.text: Forget yourself and think of someone else for a change.
examples.translationZh: 别光想著你自己，你也为别人想一次。

examples.text: Please make yourself at home.
examples.translationZh: 请别客气。

examples.text: You've only yourself to blame.
examples.translationZh: 你只能怪你自己。

meaningZh: 意图，目的；意向；意义，意旨

examples.text: I held back not knowing his real intention.
examples.translationZh: 我有点犹豫不定,不知道他的真正意图是什么。

examples.text: What do you think was the author's intention in this passage?
examples.translationZh: 你认为作者写这一段的用意是什麽?

examples.text: Acquaint him with your intention.
examples.translationZh: 让他知道你的意向。

meaningZh: 女儿；产物，后代；（某地的）妇女

examples.text: Jill is my eldest daughter.
examples.translationZh: 吉尔是我的长女。

examples.text: The death of their daughter was a cruel blow.
examples.translationZh: 女儿的死对他们是一个残酷的打击。

examples.text: She spoke as a true daughter of the city.
examples.translationZh: 她讲起话来真像来自这个城市的。

meaningZh: 授课；教诲；传授的或获得的知识，课程

examples.text: The robot follows the instructions given by the computer.
examples.translationZh: 机器人听从计算机给出的指令。

examples.text: Under no circumstances should we neglect the quality of instruction at vocational secondary schools.
examples.translationZh: 任何时候都不要忽略职业中学的教学质量问题。

examples.text: We can derive pleasure, experience, and instruction from good books.
examples.translationZh: 好书能给我们乐趣,经验和教诲。

meaningZh: 百分比，百分数；百分之一；adj. 百分之…的，每一百中有…的

examples.text: The number of queues repaired out of the percent detected.
examples.translationZh: 修复的队列数目超过检测到的百分比。

examples.text: Twenty percent of the products are exported.
examples.translationZh: 百分之二十的产品外销。

examples.text: The company's market share is 48 percent in the marketplace.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司的市场占有率是百分之四十八。

meaningZh: 钩，铁钩；弯曲部分，有钩部分；圈套，陷阱

examples.text: Please hang your coat on the hook.
examples.translationZh: 请把你的外衣挂在钩上。

examples.text: They took the phone off the hook so no calls would disturb them.
examples.translationZh: 他们摘下电话听筒，以免电话打扰他们。

examples.text: He smote his match to the ground with a left hook.
examples.translationZh: 他以一记左钩拳把对手击倒在地。

meaningZh: 信任,信仰,信心；宗教信仰

examples.text: Christians profess their faith when they say the Creed.
examples.translationZh: 基督教徒在念信经时就表明了他们的宗教信仰。

examples.text: Missionaries went far afield to propagate their faith.
examples.translationZh: 传教士到远方去传播其信仰。

examples.text: The disaster caused him to waver in his faith.
examples.translationZh: 这件灾难使他对信仰发生了动摇。

meaningZh: 图表；航海图；排行榜

examples.text: Can you read the weather chart?
examples.translationZh: 你能看懂气象图吗？

examples.text: They laid out the chart of their destiny to come.
examples.translationZh: 他们展开了他们未来命运的蓝图。

examples.text: Joyride topped the US chart in spring 1991.
examples.translationZh: 专辑《逍遥游》于1991年春荣登美国排行榜榜首。

meaningZh: 清洁的；整齐的；新的

examples.text: You must keep your clothes clean.
examples.translationZh: 你必须保持衣着整洁。

examples.text: I'll let you use my bike on condition that you keep it clean.
examples.translationZh: 如果你能保持车子干净,我就让你用我的自行车。

examples.text: Mickey is a clean mouse right from the beginning.
examples.translationZh: 米老鼠从一开始就是一只纯洁的老鼠。

meaningZh: 呼吸；活着，生存；小憩一会儿，歇歇气

examples.text: Fish cannot breathe out of water.
examples.translationZh: 鱼离开水就不能呼吸。

examples.text: It is difficult to breathe at these altitudes.
examples.translationZh: 在这些高的地方很难呼吸。

examples.text: We breathe through the nasal passage.
examples.translationZh: 我们通过鼻腔呼吸。

meaningZh: 关系；联系；关联

examples.text: Relation between the two countries has reached a crisis point.
examples.translationZh: 两国关系已达到出现危机的地步。

examples.text: We try to maintain good relation with our customer.
examples.translationZh: 我们努力与客户保持良好的关系。

examples.text: We wish to establish relation with you.
examples.translationZh: 我们希望与你们建立贸易关系。

meaningZh: 洗，清洗；浸湿；冲刷，冲击

examples.text: This dress material shrinks in the wash.
examples.translationZh: 这种衣料一洗要缩水。

examples.text: We'll toss a coin to see who does the wash.
examples.translationZh: 我们将掷币决定谁来洗衣服。

examples.text: She has a large wash this week.
examples.translationZh: 这星期她有大量衣服要洗。

meaningZh: 烟草，烟叶；烟草制品；卷烟

examples.text: A high amount of money is spent on tobacco every year.
examples.translationZh: 每年都要花费大量金钱在烟草上。

examples.text: It's forbidden to sell tobacco to children under 16.
examples.translationZh: 禁止向16岁以下的儿童出售烟草。

examples.text: His breath reeked of tobacco.
examples.translationZh: 他口中带有烟草的臭味。

meaningZh: 会议；聚会；汇合点

examples.text: The meeting will deal with these problems.
examples.translationZh: 本次会议将就这些问题作出处理。

examples.text: Our meeting in Beijing was later than I expected.
examples.translationZh: 我们在北京的会面比我们预想的要晚。

examples.text: Police were called in to break up the meeting.
examples.translationZh: 出动了警察将集会驱散。

meaningZh: 加仑（容量单位）

examples.text: There are eight pints in a gallon.
examples.translationZh: 一加仑有八品脱。

examples.text: This type of car can run 25 miles a gallon.
examples.translationZh: 这种汽车每加仑油料能行驶二十五英里。

meaningZh: 判断，鉴定，评价，判断；审判，裁判，判决；看法，意见

examples.text: Her decision seems to show a lack of political judgement.
examples.translationZh: 她的决定似乎显示出缺乏政治判断力。

examples.text: Politicians should not engage in business affairs that might affect their political judgement.
examples.translationZh: 政治家不应该参与那些可能会影响其政治判断力的商业事务。

examples.text: My judgement was frequently faulty, but my loyalty to the nation could not be questioned.
examples.translationZh: 我的判断经常出错，但是我对祖国的忠诚是无可置疑的。

meaningZh: 医生，内科医生；医学博士；（精神创伤的）医治者，抚慰者

examples.text: He was attended by his personal physician.
examples.translationZh: 他的私人医生护理他。

examples.text: He prefers to be a surgeon rather than a physician.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢当外科医生而不愿作内科医生。

examples.text: The physician put him on a special diet.
examples.translationZh: 内科医生给他吃特定的食物。

meaningZh: 尊敬；荣幸；正义感

examples.text: He has the best claim to the honour.
examples.translationZh: 他最有资格获得这荣誉。

examples.text: His action profaned the honour of his country.
examples.translationZh: 他的行为玷污了国家的荣誉。

examples.text: I also have the desire to take the light-welterweight title, and it's a big honour to be in another fight which the fans want to see.
examples.translationZh: 我要拿下超轻量级头衔，拳迷喜欢这样的比赛，我深感荣幸。

meaningZh: 侄子，外甥

examples.text: My little nephew is very naughty.
examples.translationZh: 我的外甥特别调皮。

examples.text: He decided to take his nephew abroad.
examples.translationZh: 他决定把他的外甥带出国。

examples.text: To my surprise, I found my nephew dressed in a girl's skirt.
examples.translationZh: 令我惊奇的是，我侄子穿着女孩的裙子。

meaningZh: 匙，调羹；一匙的量；匙状物，匙桨

examples.text: The spoon has been rusty from disuse.
examples.translationZh: 汤匙因弃置不用而生锈了。

examples.text: His soup spoon dropped onto the ground.
examples.translationZh: 他的汤勺掉到了地上。

examples.text: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
examples.translationZh: 她生来富贵。

meaningZh: 需要；必须；aux. 必须

examples.text: You look tired. You need a good rest.
examples.translationZh: 你看来累了。你需要好好休息一下。

examples.text: If I need you to come and help, I'll call you.
examples.translationZh: 如果我需要你来帮忙,我会打电话的。

examples.text: If the ground is too dry, then you need to water it.
examples.translationZh: 如果地面太干燥,那么你就需要给它浇浇水。

meaningZh: 鉴定，识别；验明；身份证明

examples.text: A line of people is formed for identification.
examples.translationZh: 人们排成一行等待确认身份。

examples.text: He gave a positive identification of the killer.
examples.translationZh: 他明确的认出了凶手。

examples.text: Jewellery identification is a hard job.
examples.translationZh: 珠宝鉴定不是一件容易的工作。

meaningZh: 公共汽车，巴士，客机；（口）汽车，机器脚踏车，飞机；[计]（电脑的）总线

examples.text: The busman stopped the bus.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车司机停下了车。

examples.text: The bus driver asked the passengers to buy tickets.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车司机要求乘客买票。

examples.text: Nor can you always use bus interrupts.
examples.translationZh: 你也不可能总是用总线中断。

meaningZh: 分析，分解；梗概，要略；[数]解析

examples.text: His analysis of the problem showed great perception.
examples.translationZh: 他对该问题的分析显示出敏锐的洞察力。

examples.text: We agreed with his acute analysis of the political situation.
examples.translationZh: 我们都同意他对政治形势的深刻分析。

examples.text: Close analysis of sales figures showed clear regional variations.
examples.translationZh: 对销售额的仔细分析显示出明显的地区差别。

meaningZh: 点；要点；得分

examples.text: I have tried to get my point across.
examples.translationZh: 我已尽力让我的观点清晰明了。

examples.text: OK, you've made your point!
examples.translationZh: 好了，你已经把话说清楚了。

examples.text: I don't see the point of her last remark.
examples.translationZh: 我不明白她最后那句话的意思。

meaningZh: 无聊的，无趣的，烦人的；v. 令人厌烦( bore的过去式和过去分词 )；挖

examples.text: Some people use their teisure for such activities because they are lonely or bored.
examples.translationZh: 有些人因为寂寞或无聊,才利用闲暇时间从事这些活动。

examples.text: He is a bored student.
examples.translationZh: 他是一位感到厌烦的学生。

examples.text: I'm rather bored by the rumor.
examples.translationZh: 这谣传我真听厌烦了。

meaningZh: 羞愧；羞辱；可耻的人

examples.text: He had no sense of shame and never felt guilty.
examples.translationZh: 他毫无羞耻之心，而且从不觉得内疚。

examples.text: He saved the child at the risk of his own life and put all those who looked on to shame.
examples.translationZh: 他冒着生命危险救了那个孩子,使所有旁观者都相形见绌。

examples.text: Your bad behavior brings shame on the whole school.
examples.translationZh: 你的恶劣行径给整个学校带来耻辱。

meaningZh: 讨厌的人或事；有害动植物；瘟疫

examples.text: Stores of grain are frequently attacked by pests.
examples.translationZh: 储存的谷物经常受到害虫的破坏。

examples.text: It won't be long before we can be rid of the pest altogether.
examples.translationZh: 不要太久，我们就能把这种害虫消除干净。

examples.text: That child is being a real pest.
examples.translationZh: 那个孩子真讨厌。

meaningZh: 跳舞；舞会；舞蹈艺术

examples.text: The girls are making up for the dance.
examples.translationZh: 女孩子们为了参加舞会正在化装。

examples.text: We have fixed up a date for the dance.
examples.translationZh: 我们己经定好了舞会的日期。

examples.text: May I ask you for a dance, Lily?
examples.translationZh: 莉莉,我可以请你跳舞吗?

meaningZh: 理由；原因；理性

examples.text: That is the reason why I don't like it.
examples.translationZh: 那就是我不喜欢它的原因。

examples.text: He is able to explain the reason because he was present at that time.
examples.translationZh: 他当时在场,所以他能解释原因。

examples.text: We have reason to believe that he was murdered.
examples.translationZh: 我们有理由相信他是被谋杀的。

meaningZh: 苦的；尖锐的；严寒的

examples.text: The medicine has a bitter taste.
examples.translationZh: 这药有苦味。

examples.text: The defeat was a bitter pill to swallow.
examples.translationZh: 那次失败是一次难以吞咽的苦果。

examples.text: She wept bitter tears over the loss of her lover.
examples.translationZh: 她为失去了她的情人而流下痛苦的眼泪。

meaningZh: 钟,铃,电铃；钟声,铃声；钟状物

examples.text: The church bell tolled the hour.
examples.translationZh: 教堂的鸣钟报时。

examples.text: I was roused by the sound of the bell this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天早晨，我被铃声唤醒。

examples.text: I was too preoccupied to hear the bell.
examples.translationZh: 当时我出神地想着心事，没有听见门铃响。

meaningZh: 几个的；专有的；各自的

examples.text: I bought several books yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 我昨天买了好几本书。

examples.text: My husband has several shirts of different colors.
examples.translationZh: 我丈夫有好几件颜色不同的衬衫。

examples.text: The regime has been propped up by several monopoly capitalists.
examples.translationZh: 那个政权一直是受到若干垄断资本家的支持而维持着的。

meaningZh: 专心于；注意；集中

examples.text: I can't concentrate on my work when I'm tired.
examples.translationZh: 我累了就无法集中精力工作。

examples.text: The confusing matters make him unable to concentrate on his study.
examples.translationZh: 那么多烦心事使他无法专心学习。

examples.text: The crowds concentrated round the palace.
examples.translationZh: 人群汇集在宫殿的四周。

meaningZh: 打字机

examples.text: The computer is more expensive than the typewriter.
examples.translationZh: 这部电脑比这部打字机更贵。

examples.text: The typewriter is at your service.
examples.translationZh: 这台打字机随便你使用。

meaningZh: 假定，假设；承担；想当然

examples.text: The project was predicated on the assumption that the economy was expanding.
examples.translationZh: 这一计划是以经济发展的设想为依据的。

examples.text: The theory is based on a series of wrong assumptions.
examples.translationZh: 这一理论是以一系列错误的设想为依据的。

examples.text: His assumption of power was welcomed by everyone.
examples.translationZh: 他的当权为大家所欢迎。

meaningZh: 苍白的；无力的；暗淡的

examples.text: She was pale with fear.
examples.translationZh: 她吓得脸色发白。

examples.text: His pale face has shown his bad health.
examples.translationZh: 他面色苍白，说明他身体不好。

examples.text: The pale eyes seemed to glare past her, the eyebrows frowned, the long jaw hardened.
examples.translationZh: 那双灰白的眼睛仿佛看穿了她的身子，眉头皱着，长下巴发僵。

meaningZh: 和平的；爱好和平的；安静的

examples.text: Hopes of a peaceful settlement are now fading.
examples.translationZh: 和平解决的希望正在消失。

examples.text: China is a peaceful country.
examples.translationZh: 中国是一个爱好和平的国家。

examples.text: The world today is far from peaceful.
examples.translationZh: 今天的世界还很不安宁。

meaningZh: 爆[突]发，发怒；激增，迅速扩大；vt. （使）爆炸

examples.text: The bomb was timed to explode during the rush-hour.
examples.translationZh: 炸弹选在人最多时爆炸。

examples.text: When the boiler exploded many people were injured.
examples.translationZh: 因锅炉爆炸，许多人受了伤。

examples.text: The firework exploded in his hand.
examples.translationZh: 那个爆竹在他手里响了。

meaningZh: 敢；敢做；激（某人做某事）

examples.text: The gymnast dared a breathtakingly difficult move.
examples.translationZh: 这位体操选手敢于做惊险的高难度动作

examples.text: He dared me to jump over the river.
examples.translationZh: 他激我跳过河。

examples.text: He dared his grandfather's displeasure when he left the family business.
examples.translationZh: 他不顾祖父的不悦，放下了家族的生意。

meaningZh: 钟，时钟；计时器；秒表

examples.text: The clock shows half past two.
examples.translationZh: 时钟的针指著两点半。

examples.text: This clock has outlasted several owners.
examples.translationZh: 这座时钟的寿命比它的几个主人的寿命都长。

examples.text: The silence was succeeded by the striking of a clock.
examples.translationZh: 时钟鸣响声打破了寂静。

meaningZh: 居住区；周边地区；大约

examples.text: Our neighbourhood police are very friendly.
examples.translationZh: 我们邻近的警察非常友善。

examples.text: The whole neighbourhood was reduced to ashes.
examples.translationZh: 整个邻近一带被化为灰烬。

examples.text: Contribute to physical and mental health, family harmony, neighbourhood relations, learning and career progress, social harmony and stability.
examples.translationZh: 有助于身心健康，家庭和睦，邻里关系，学习及事业进步，社会的和谐稳定。

meaningZh: 暴风雨，暴风雪；[军]猛攻，冲击；骚乱

examples.text: In the storm I took shelter under the tree.
examples.translationZh: 暴风雨时，我正在树下躲避。

examples.text: A storm arose during the night.
examples.translationZh: 夜间起风暴了。

examples.text: The clouds threatened a big storm.
examples.translationZh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

meaningZh: 想；思索；以为

examples.text: I think you are very brave.
examples.translationZh: 我认为你非常勇敢。

examples.text: Women used to think they were on the shelf at 30.
examples.translationZh: 过去女人一到30岁就认为是过了结婚年龄。

examples.text: If you want to make money you've got to think money.
examples.translationZh: 你要是想赚钱，脑子里就得想著钱。

meaningZh: 剧场；戏剧界；戏剧效果

examples.text: David's house is quite close to the Global Theater.
examples.translationZh: 大卫的家离环球剧院很近。

examples.text: I ran to the theater all along and was out of breath.
examples.translationZh: 我一路跑到剧院上气不接下气。

examples.text: The movie theater is dark on Mondays.
examples.translationZh: 电影院每逢星期一公休

meaningZh: 不；否；一点也没有

examples.text: The sick man is no better.
examples.translationZh: 那病人一点也没有好转。

examples.text: You are very selfish sometimes.---No,I'm not.
examples.translationZh: 你有时很自私的。--不,我不自私。

examples.text: He has no money.
examples.translationZh: 他没有钱。

meaningZh: 每；各自的；pron. 每个

examples.text: We each have our private views about it.
examples.translationZh: 我们每个人对这件事都有自己的看法。

examples.text: I asked all the children and each told a different story.
examples.translationZh: 我问过所有的孩子，每个人的说法都不一样。

examples.text: Each of them had his little local personal history.
examples.translationZh: 他们每一个人都有过一段默默无闻的个人历史。

meaningZh: 宠物；宠儿；受宠的人

examples.text: My daughter keeps a rabbit as pet.
examples.translationZh: 我的女儿养了一只兔子当做宠物。

examples.text: She is the teacher's pet.
examples.translationZh: 她是老师的宠儿。

examples.text: The little girl cuddled her pet cat.
examples.translationZh: 这个小女孩搂抱着她的宠物猫。

meaningZh: 亚洲人；adj. 亚洲的，亚洲人的

examples.text: How many Asian countries have taken part in the sport meeting?
examples.translationZh: 有多少亚洲国家参加这次运动会？

examples.text: Before entering a house in some Asian countries, it is good manners to take off your shoes.
examples.translationZh: 在某些亚洲的国家，进屋子之前脱下鞋子才是有礼貌的。

examples.text: I've been invited to an Asian wedding. What happens on such occasions?
examples.translationZh: 我应邀参加亚洲人的婚礼。这种婚礼是如何举行的?

meaningZh: 叶子；页；叶状的结构

examples.text: I saw him take a leaf out of the book.
examples.translationZh: 我看见他从书上撕下一页。

examples.text: The falling leaf spiralled to the ground.
examples.translationZh: 落叶盘旋著飘到了地上。

examples.text: Not a leaf nor an insect stirred.
examples.translationZh: 不单是树叶，连个虫子都不动。

meaningZh: 维持生命所必需的；至关重要的；生死攸关的

examples.text: The government saw the introduction of new technology as vital.
examples.translationZh: 政府认为引进新技术至关重要。

examples.text: She's a very vital sort of person.
examples.translationZh: 她是个精力旺盛的人。

examples.text: Confronted with such a vital problem of life and death, he looked as cool as a cucumber.
examples.translationZh: 面对着这样重大的生死问题,他的神态却异常冷静。

meaningZh: 在外面；向外面；在户外

examples.text: The house is painted green outside.
examples.translationZh: 那房子外面漆的绿色。

examples.text: The outside of it looks all right.
examples.translationZh: 它的外观还可以。

examples.text: He has a rough outside but a good heart.
examples.translationZh: 他外表粗鲁，但心地善良。

meaningZh: 坏的，不好的；严重的；不舒服的

examples.text: Smoking is bad for health.
examples.translationZh: 吸烟对身体有害。

examples.text: In the recession, our firm went through a bad time.
examples.translationZh: 我们公司在经济衰退时期历尽艰辛。

examples.text: He's gone to bad since he made friends with those people.
examples.translationZh: 他结交那些人后就开始堕落了。

meaningZh: 蜡，蜡状物；耳垢，耳屎；（鞋匠用的）擦线蜡

examples.text: Blobs of wax covered the candlestick.
examples.translationZh: 烛台上全是一团团的蜡。

examples.text: He is modeling a unicorn in wax .
examples.translationZh: 他在用蜡制作独角兽。

examples.text: They bought wax and honey up by the great.
examples.translationZh: 他们大量购进蜜蜡和蜂蜜。

meaningZh: 慢跑；轻推，轻撞；蹒跚行进

examples.text: He goes jogging every night.
examples.translationZh: 他每晚慢跑。

examples.text: You jogged my elbow and spoiled what I was drawing.
examples.translationZh: 你撞到了我的手肘，弄坏了我正在画的图画。

examples.text: The wagon jogged along on the rough road.
examples.translationZh: 马车沿着崎岖不平的道路颠簸前行。

meaningZh: 表现；举止端正；自然反应

examples.text: How is your new car behaving?
examples.translationZh: 你的新车性能如何？

examples.text: I'll trust you to behave responsibly while I'm out.
examples.translationZh: 我相信你在我外出期间会认真办事的。

examples.text: If you behave like that, you'll get yourself disliked.
examples.translationZh: 如果你的行为那样，你会让人厌恶的。

meaningZh: 上帝，造物主；被极度崇敬的人[物]；男神

examples.text: Poseidon was the Greek god of the sea.
examples.translationZh: 波赛冬是希腊海神。

examples.text: The Greeks dedicated a shrine to the god.
examples.translationZh: 希腊人把一座庙奉献给神。

examples.text: He's one of the gods of the fashion world.
examples.translationZh: 他是时尚界的偶像之一。

meaningZh: 尺寸；[复]面积，范围；[物]量纲

examples.text: Height is an external dimension.
examples.translationZh: 高是外部尺寸。

examples.text: When a dimension's origin is in doubt use the datums specified.
examples.translationZh: 当不能确定尺寸原点时，使用规定的基准。

examples.text: The fifth dimension creates everything that is on earth.
examples.translationZh: 第五次元创造了地球上所有的东西。

meaningZh: 家庭教师；导师；（大专院校的）助教

examples.text: His parents employed a tutor to teach him Greek.
examples.translationZh: 他父母雇佣了一位家庭教师来教他希腊语。

examples.text: My tutor is an accomplished scholar.
examples.translationZh: 我的导师是一位学识渊博的学者。

examples.text: Most parents have no time to tutor their children.
examples.translationZh: 大部分家长没有时间辅导孩子。

meaningZh: 热水瓶，保温瓶。来自于德国品牌膳魔师保温瓶商标“Thermos”

examples.text: We chipped in a few yuan to buy a thermos bottle.
examples.translationZh: 我们捐出几块钱来买一只热水瓶。

examples.text: She poured hot water from the thermos.
examples.translationZh: 她从热水瓶倒出热水。

meaningZh: 迅速的,速度快的；敏捷的,反应快的

examples.text: His landing is both swift and sure.
examples.translationZh: 他的落地既快又稳。

examples.text: He made a remarkably swift recovery.
examples.translationZh: 他康复得相当快。

examples.text: They've been very swift to deny these rumors.
examples.translationZh: 他们在辟谣方面反应迅速。

meaningZh: 表面；外观，外表；地面。水面

examples.text: The scheme seems on the surface to be quite practical.
examples.translationZh: 这方案表面上看来似乎很实际。

examples.text: A wave broke across the surface of the pool.
examples.translationZh: 一个波浪从池水表面掠过。

examples.text: Beneath that apparently calm surface is a man of fierce temper.
examples.translationZh: 文静的外表掩盖着的是一个火暴脾气的人。

meaningZh: 费用；花费的钱；消耗

examples.text: It's too much of an expense for me to own a car.
examples.translationZh: 对我来说，拥有一辆汽车的花费太大。

examples.text: Societies should try to save every plant and animal species, regardless of the expense to humans in effort, time, and financial well-being.
examples.translationZh: 社会应尽力挽救每一动植物物种,不管花费多少人力、时间和财力。

examples.text: Don't involve yourself in unnecessary expense.
examples.translationZh: 勿做不必要的花费。

meaningZh: 极小的，微小的；n. 小孩子；[医]癣

examples.text: A tiny fishing boat was drifting slowly along.
examples.translationZh: 一只小小的渔船在缓缓地漂去。

examples.text: We're struggling along on a tiny income.
examples.translationZh: 我们依靠极少的收入过活。

examples.text: She has a tiny mole on her cheek.
examples.translationZh: 她面颊上有一颗小痣。

meaningZh: 孪生儿之一，双胞胎之一；两个相像的人或物之一；孪晶

examples.text: I always confounded him with his twin brother.
examples.translationZh: 我总分不清他和他的孪生兄弟。

examples.text: They are motivated by the twin goads of punishment and reward.
examples.translationZh: 他们受赏与罚的双重因素所激励。

examples.text: I can't tell one twin from the other.
examples.translationZh: 我分不出双胞胎中谁是谁。

meaningZh: 英雄，勇士；男主角；（古代神话中的）神人，半神的勇士

examples.text: The hero smote the giant with his sword.
examples.translationZh: 英雄用剑猛劈巨人。

examples.text: He is the hero of an old legend.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个古老传说中的英雄。

examples.text: They say the hero is played by Tom Cruise.
examples.translationZh: 据说男主角是汤姆·克鲁斯。

meaningZh: 摩天大楼，超高层大楼；特别高的东西

examples.text: A new skyscraper has been put up downtown.
examples.translationZh: 市中心又建起了一座摩天大厦。

examples.text: The skyscraper towers into the sky.
examples.translationZh: 该摩天大楼高耸入云。

meaningZh: 无辜的，无罪的；清白的；天真无邪的

examples.text: A man is accounted innocent until he is proven guilty.
examples.translationZh: 一个人未被证明有罪前，被视为是清白的。

examples.text: He was charged with murder but found innocent later.
examples.translationZh: 他被控杀人，但后来发现他是无罪的。

examples.text: It was an innocent deception, meant as a joke.
examples.translationZh: 那是个无伤大雅的骗术，开个玩笑而已。

meaningZh: 线；线索；线状物

examples.text: How many spools of thread did you use?
examples.translationZh: 你用了几轴线?

examples.text: The thread seems to match the cloth.
examples.translationZh: 这线和这布似乎很相称。

examples.text: I need one more spool of thread before finishing the embroidery.
examples.translationZh: 再来一轴线我就可以完成这幅刺绣了。

meaningZh: 爆裂，炸破；使爆炸；充满，塞满

examples.text: There was a burst of laughter in the next room.
examples.translationZh: 隔壁房间里突然爆发出一阵笑声。

examples.text: The pipe burst and a spout of water shoot out.
examples.translationZh: 水管破裂了，一股水喷了出来。

examples.text: Prices went up and up in recent years, before the housing bubble burst.
examples.translationZh: 最近几年价格持续上涨，直到房价泡沫的破裂。

meaningZh: 队，组；团队；工作组

examples.text: John is the spark plug on his rowing team.
examples.translationZh: 约翰是划船队的中坚分子。

examples.text: A cricket team is comprised of eleven players.
examples.translationZh: 一个板球队由11名队员组成。

examples.text: A team of nurses assisted the doctor in performing the operation.
examples.translationZh: 一组护士协助医生施行手术。

meaningZh: 志愿者，志愿兵；[军]义勇军；[植]自生植物
