examples.text: He enlisted as a volunteer in the army.
examples.translationZh: 他以志愿兵从军。

examples.text: He works as a volunteer at off time.
examples.translationZh: 在业余时间

examples.text: He volunteered a statement to the police.
examples.translationZh: 他自动向警方供出情况。

meaningZh: 电子的；电子操纵的；用电子设备生产的

examples.text: This dictionary is available in electronic version.
examples.translationZh: 这部词典有电子版。

examples.text: I like to read books on electronic music.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢读一些关于电子音乐的书。

examples.text: Helen became an electronic engineer.
examples.translationZh: 海伦成了一名电子工程师。

meaningZh: 小旅馆，客栈；小饭店，小酒馆；vi. 住旅馆

examples.text: There was an air of romance about the old inn.
examples.translationZh: 这家老客栈颇有些浪漫气氛。

examples.text: I intend to strike my staff at that small inn.
examples.translationZh: 我打算在那家客栈暂住下来。

examples.text: The traveller decided to lie at an inn that night.
examples.translationZh: 旅行者决定那天晚上在一个小旅店过夜。

meaningZh: 使用；使用权；功能

examples.text: The present phone boxes will go out of use next year.
examples.translationZh: 现有的公共电话亭明年就不再使用了。

examples.text: He exemplified the use of the word.
examples.translationZh: 他举例证明那个词的用法。

examples.text: This use is less common in British English.
examples.translationZh: 这种用法在英式英语中不多见。

meaningZh: 起源，根源；出身；[数]原点，起点

examples.text: The social unrest has its origins in economic problems.
examples.translationZh: 社会动荡是经济问题引起的。

examples.text: This is the true story of the weeds: the origin of the species.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个关于野草的真实故事:关于他们的物种起源。

examples.text: He is a Dane by origin.
examples.translationZh: 他原籍丹麦。

meaningZh: 单位，单元；装置；个体

examples.text: This textbook has twenty units.
examples.translationZh: 这本课本有二十单元。

examples.text: There's a rumour floating around of a new job in the unit.
examples.translationZh: 这个部门盛传有个新工作要聘人。

examples.text: The family is the smallest social unit.
examples.translationZh: 家庭是社会最小的单位。

meaningZh: 岸；滨；国家（尤指濒海国家）

examples.text: The breakers came tumbling onto the shore.
examples.translationZh: 浪涛滚滚而来拍打著岸边。

examples.text: They anchored their ship off the shore.
examples.translationZh: 他们在滨外抛锚泊船。

meaningZh: 逮捕，拘捕；止住，阻止，抑制；吸引（注意）

examples.text: The police arrested the thief.
examples.translationZh: 警察逮捕了小偷。

examples.text: You shouldn't arrest him without warrant.
examples.translationZh: 你不能毫无根据地逮捕他。

examples.text: The constable stop the car and arrest the driver.
examples.translationZh: 警官使车停住并将司机扣留。

meaningZh: 四十；四十几；adj. 四十的

examples.text: They managed to squash forty people into the bus.
examples.translationZh: 那辆公共汽车好不容易塞进了四十个人。

examples.text: He reigned over the country for forty years.
examples.translationZh: 他统治了这个国家四十年。

meaningZh: 反对，抗争；使相对；使对照

examples.text: It was courageous of him to oppose his chief.
examples.translationZh: 他敢反对他的上司，真是勇敢。

examples.text: The rabbles met on the square to oppose their new mayor.
examples.translationZh: 平民们在广场上集会反对他们的新市长。

examples.text: They opposed the government's new policies.
examples.translationZh: 他们反对政府的新政策。

meaningZh: 圆；圆状物；一圈

examples.text: The dancers were standing in a circle around the fire.
examples.translationZh: 舞者们围着篝火站成一圈。

examples.text: A square has four sides but a circle has no sides.
examples.translationZh: 正方形有四条边，而圆形没有边。

examples.text: He has a large circle of friends.
examples.translationZh: 他有一大群朋友。

meaningZh: 巧合；一致；同时存在

examples.text: What a coincidence!
examples.translationZh: 真是太巧了！

examples.text: That was a really creepy coincidence.
examples.translationZh: 那样的巧合实在太离奇了。

examples.text: That's the most incredible coincidence I've ever heard of!
examples.translationZh: 那是我听说过的最难以置信的巧合！

meaningZh: 欧洲；欧盟；（除英国以外的）全欧洲

examples.text: Africa is exporting beef to Europe.
examples.translationZh: 非洲向欧洲出口牛肉。

examples.text: Greece is located in the south of Europe.
examples.translationZh: 希腊位于欧洲南部。

examples.text: Ceding sovereignty to Europe is a political hot potato in Britain.
examples.translationZh: 对英国政坛来说，放弃欧盟主权可谓是一块烫手的热山芋。

meaningZh: 不愿意的，不情愿的；勉强的；厌恶的

examples.text: I am unwilling to set a precedent.
examples.translationZh: 我不想开先例。

examples.text: Nothing is easy to the unwilling.
examples.translationZh: 人不情愿事事难。

examples.text: He is unwilling to accept advice.
examples.translationZh: 他不愿意接受忠告。

meaningZh: 决定；果断；决议

examples.text: I don't think his decision is wise in reality.
examples.translationZh: 实际上,我觉得他的决定并不明智。

examples.text: We can' t reach a decision without our chairman.
examples.translationZh: 主席不在场

examples.text: All is dependent on your decision.
examples.translationZh: 一切看你的决心而定。

meaningZh: 事件；（讨论、考虑等的）问题；重要性

examples.text: I don't talk with my boss about my private matters.
examples.translationZh: 我不和我的老板谈私事。

examples.text: She reluctantly agreed to let the matter drop.
examples.translationZh: 她勉强同意这事到此为止。

examples.text: He reconsidered his decision for the new development of the matter.
examples.translationZh: 他根据事态的发展重新考虑自已的决定.

meaningZh: 竞赛；竞争；比得上

examples.text: Companies must be able to compete in the marketplace.
examples.translationZh: 公司一定要在市场中有竞争力。

examples.text: Several companies are competing for the contract.
examples.translationZh: 几家公司正为争取一项合同而互相竞争。

examples.text: We can compete with the best teams.
examples.translationZh: 我们能与最好的队竞争。

meaningZh: 广播；播放；使广为人知

examples.text: The chairman's speech will be broadcast nationwide.
examples.translationZh: 主席的讲话将向全国广播。

examples.text: She broadcasts on current affairs.
examples.translationZh: 她发表时事广播演说。

examples.text: The BBC broadcasts all over the world.
examples.translationZh: 英国广播公司向全世界播送节目。

meaningZh: 道歉认错，愧悔；正式辩解，正式辩护；解释

examples.text: I demand an apology.
examples.translationZh: 我要求道歉。

examples.text: Please accept my apology.
examples.translationZh: 请接受我的道歉。

examples.text: He made a contrite apology.
examples.translationZh: 他深表懊悔地致歉。

meaningZh: 船长，机长；领袖，首领；上尉

examples.text: And they'll find that their bold captain is nowhere to be found
examples.translationZh: 但他们再也找不到他们豪勇的首领了。

examples.text: The captain led our team to victory.
examples.translationZh: 队长带领我们队取得了胜利。

examples.text: The football captain was the mogul of the school.
examples.translationZh: 那足球队长是该校的大人物。

meaningZh: 搬运人；运输公司；搬运器

examples.text: The missile was launched from the aircraft carrier.
examples.translationZh: 导弹是从航空母舰上发射的。

examples.text: The carrier is armed with nuclear weapons.
examples.translationZh: 那艘航空母舰有核武器。

examples.text: Airplanes were launched from the aircraft carrier.
examples.translationZh: 飞机从航空母舰上起飞了。

meaningZh: 焦虑，忧虑；切望，渴望；令人焦虑的事

examples.text: It proved difficult to disguise his anxiety.
examples.translationZh: 他的焦虑难以掩饰。

examples.text: They show great anxiety concerning their retirement allowance.
examples.translationZh: 他们对自己的养老金问题显得十分焦虑。

examples.text: This has caused us much anxiety.
examples.translationZh: 这事使我们极为担心。

meaningZh: 其中的哪一个；n. 可能的选择

examples.text: I'm uncertain whether to go or not.
examples.translationZh: 我不能肯定去还是不去。

examples.text: His nationality isn't relevant to whether he's a good teacher.
examples.translationZh: 他的国籍与他是否是位好老师无关。

examples.text: Little does he care whether we live or die.
examples.translationZh: 他一点也不管我们是死是活。

meaningZh: 纳税人，纳税的机构；所收租金只够支付地产税的建筑物

examples.text: They mayor may have bolted with taxpayer's money.
examples.translationZh: 市长可能卷着纳税人的钱逃跑了。

examples.text: If the government goes on exacting so much from the taxpayer, it will not last long.
examples.translationZh: 如果该政府继续如此征税的话，它将不会持续多久。

meaningZh: 环境，外界；周围，围绕；工作平台

examples.text: She is not used to the new environment.
examples.translationZh: 她对新环境不习惯。

examples.text: We are required by environment protecting department to use anthracite.
examples.translationZh: 环保部门要求我们使用无烟煤。

examples.text: At one time, children didn't have to learn any more than how to cope with their physical environment.
examples.translationZh: 曾经有一段时间,儿童除了学习适应外界环境以外,什么都不学。

meaningZh: 注视，注意；看守，监视；守候（机会等）

examples.text: I seldom play chess, but I like to watch.
examples.translationZh: 我很少下棋，但是喜欢看。

examples.text: Watch what I do and how I do it.
examples.translationZh: 注意看我的动作和方法。

examples.text: I was assigned to watch the road.
examples.translationZh: 我被派去护路。

meaningZh: 山羊；色鬼；替罪羊

examples.text: Can you distinguish goat from sheep?
examples.translationZh: 你能把山羊和绵羊区分开吗？

examples.text: We saw the tiger pouncing on the goat.
examples.translationZh: 我们看见老虎向那只山羊扑过去。

examples.text: The regimental mascot is a goat.
examples.translationZh: 这个团的吉祥物是山羊。

meaningZh: 公民的，市民的；文明的，有礼貌的；民用的，国民间的

examples.text: The law shall strictly protect civil rights.
examples.translationZh: 法律应严格保护公民的权利。

examples.text: The presence of the army should act as a check on civil unrest.
examples.translationZh: 军队的存在应能制止民间的动乱。

examples.text: The boy was so cold and even didn't return a civil greeting.
examples.translationZh: 那个男孩是那么的冷淡,他甚至都没有回敬一个礼貌的问候。

meaningZh: 咽喉；颈前部；[植物学]管颈

examples.text: I have a sore throat today.
examples.translationZh: 我今天嗓子疼。

examples.text: I have to clear my throat before I begin my speech.
examples.translationZh: 在开始演讲之前,我得先清清嗓子。

examples.text: I've got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
examples.translationZh: 有根鱼骨头卡在我的喉咙里。

meaningZh: 准许进入；承认；坦白

examples.text: He is a coward by his own admission.
examples.translationZh: 他自己承认是个胆小鬼。

examples.text: He was, on his own admission, impulsive by nature.
examples.translationZh: 他承认自己生性易于感情冲动。

examples.text: Do they charge for admission?
examples.translationZh: 入场要收费吗?

meaningZh: 数学；〈诗〉同“ripen”；算学

examples.text: Mathematics is her favorite subject.
examples.translationZh: 数学是她喜欢的科目。

examples.text: He has a great faculty for mathematics.
examples.translationZh: 他具有很强的学数学的才能。

meaningZh: （使）充满，（使）装满；vt. 满足；配药

examples.text: Please fill the cup with water.
examples.translationZh: 请把这个杯子装满水。

examples.text: Smoke filled the room.
examples.translationZh: 屋里尽是烟。

examples.text: Life just gives you time and space, it's up to you to fill it.
examples.translationZh: 生活只给我们时间和空间,我们自己决定如何去填充它。

meaningZh: 改革，改良，改造；改正；vt.& vi. 改善

examples.text: Our reform made an inexorable march of progress.
examples.translationZh: 我们的改革取得了势不可挡的进展。

examples.text: Many reforms must be made to the education system.
examples.translationZh: 教育体制要作许多改革。

examples.text: The reform and open policy has Brought us Chinese people a rich and colourful life.
examples.translationZh: 改革开放的政策给我们中国人民带来了富裕和多彩的生活。

meaningZh: 公众的，公共的；公开的；政府的

examples.text: Changing public perception may take some time.
examples.translationZh: 改变公众的看法需要一些时间。

examples.text: The pension fund owns shares in several major public companies.
examples.translationZh: 该养老基金在几家主要出售股份给公众的公司中均有股份。

examples.text: The government decided to promote public welfare.
examples.translationZh: 政府决定发展公共福利。

meaningZh: 弓；鞠躬；船头

examples.text: At that time, people hunt with bows and arrows.
examples.translationZh: 在那时,人们以弓﹑ 箭行猎。

examples.text: He moved aside for her with a polite bow.
examples.translationZh: 他礼貌地鞠躬，退避一旁让她过去。

examples.text: She has a dress decorated with bows.
examples.translationZh: 她有一条饰有蝴蝶结的连衣裙。

meaningZh: （表示运算）加；（表示包容）外加；[口语]和

examples.text: Two plus five is seven.
examples.translationZh: 二加五等于七。

examples.text: The bill was 10, plus 1 for postage.
examples.translationZh: 帐款是10英镑，再加上1英镑邮费。

examples.text: We've got to fit five people plus all their luggage in the car.
examples.translationZh: 我们得在汽车里挤下五个人和全部行李。

meaningZh: 拖拉机；牵引器

examples.text: The tractor pulls well.
examples.translationZh: 这台拖拉机拉力大。

examples.text: The tractor had been damaged by rough usage.
examples.translationZh: 这辆拖拉机因使用不经心而损坏了。

examples.text: A tractor towed the car to the repair factory.
examples.translationZh: 一辆牵引车将汽车拖去修理厂。

meaningZh: 躺；坐落在；处于…状态

examples.text: If you feel unwell, go and lie down.
examples.translationZh: 如果你感到不舒服，就去躺下。

examples.text: My home town lies low in a hidden valley.
examples.translationZh: 我的家乡位于一个隐蔽的山谷里。

examples.text: The fundamental way out lies in reform and openness.
examples.translationZh: 根本出路在于改革开放。

meaningZh: 较大的,主要的；少校；专业; 主修科目

examples.text: The city holds the major portion of the population in the country.
examples.translationZh: 那个城市聚集了全国大部分人口。

examples.text: Popular education is one of our major objectives.
examples.translationZh: 民众教育是我们的主要目标之一。

examples.text: This quartet represents a major new trend in modern music.
examples.translationZh: 这首四重奏的曲子反映了现代音乐中一种主要的新趋向。

meaningZh: 一些；某个；大约

examples.text: She won a competition in some newspaper or other.
examples.translationZh: 她参加某报纸举办的比赛获胜。

examples.text: If you save some money each week, we can go on holiday.
examples.translationZh: 要是你每星期能存点儿钱，咱们就可以外出度假了。

examples.text: There is some ice in the bush.
examples.translationZh: 树丛里有些冰。

meaningZh: 衣服；装饰；连衣裙

examples.text: She wears a beautiful evening dress.
examples.translationZh: 她穿着一件漂亮的晚礼服。

examples.text: She wore a diamond clip on her new dress.
examples.translationZh: 她在新衣服上戴了一枚钻石别针。

examples.text: They tried to dress him up as a"national hero".
examples.translationZh: 他们想把他打扮成一个“民族英雄”。

meaningZh: 祖国；母国

examples.text: We are loyal to our motherland.
examples.translationZh: 我们忠于祖国。

examples.text: He expressed earnest love to his motherland.
examples.translationZh: 他抒发了对祖国的挚爱之情。

meaningZh: 溜冰，滑冰；n. 溜冰鞋

examples.text: In winter, many people skate on the lake.
examples.translationZh: 冬天时，许多人在湖上溜冰。

examples.text: The ice is too thin to skate on.
examples.translationZh: 冰太薄,不能在上面溜冰。

examples.text: The Dutch often skate along the canals in winter.
examples.translationZh: 冬天荷兰人经常沿着运河滑冰。

meaningZh: 悲哀，忧伤，忧愁，悲哀；令人悲哀或忧伤的事物；愁眉苦脸，心境恶劣，心情恶劣

examples.text: His sudden death was occasion for much sadness.
examples.translationZh: 他的突然死亡是很多的悲哀场合。

examples.text: Try to pin down the exact quality of its sadness.
examples.translationZh: 努力弄清楚它的确切的悲哀特点。

meaningZh: 信；证书，许可证；字母，文字

examples.text: She balled the letter into a wad.
examples.translationZh: 她将信揉成一团。

examples.text: I acknowledged her letter at once.
examples.translationZh: 我马上告知收到了她的信。

examples.text: The kids are learning to trace the letter.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们学描字母。

meaningZh: 脚；底部；英尺(=12 英寸或 30。48 厘米)

examples.text: I apologized to her for stepping on her foot.
examples.translationZh: 我因踩了她一脚向她道歉。

examples.text: I hurt my foot while playing football.
examples.translationZh: 在踢足球时,我的脚受伤了。

examples.text: They sank the post two feet deep in the ground.
examples.translationZh: 他们把这根柱子在地下埋了两英尺深。

meaningZh: 模糊的；（思想上）不清楚的；（表达或感知）含糊的

examples.text: At the back of his mind was the vague idea that he had met her before.
examples.translationZh: 他隐隐约约地觉得以前曾经见过她。

examples.text: She is so vague that I can never understand what she is trying to say.
examples.translationZh: 她说话含含糊糊，我怎么也听不明白她想说些什么。

examples.text: His vague ideas crystallized into a definite plan.
examples.translationZh: 他那些模糊的想法变成了一个明确的计划。

meaningZh: 运河，沟渠；管道；气管

examples.text: The canal is now open to shipping.
examples.translationZh: 该运河现已通航。

examples.text: They dragged the canal for the missing child.
examples.translationZh: 他们用拖网沿运河打捞失踪孩子的尸体。

examples.text: The canal is navigable all the year.
examples.translationZh: 这条运河全年可通航。

meaningZh: 将（程序，资料等）从大计算机系统输入小计算机系统，下载

examples.text: Wait until it's finished downloading.
examples.translationZh: 等到下载完毕。

examples.text: You can download this software for free.
examples.translationZh: 你可以免费下载该软件。

examples.text: The download failed.
examples.translationZh: 下载失败了。

meaningZh: 计量器；计量仪；v. 用仪表测量

examples.text: It is a mere 100 meter from my house to the theater.
examples.translationZh: 从我家到剧场只有一百公尺。

examples.text: One hundred centimeters make one meter.
examples.translationZh: 一百公分等于一公尺。

examples.text: One yard is nearly a meter in length.
examples.translationZh: 一码约等于一公尺长。

meaningZh: 职责，责任；义务；职责或工作

examples.text: I feel it my duty to speak frankly to you.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得我有义务要坦白地对你说。

examples.text: She was ashamed to admit that she hadn't done her duty.
examples.translationZh: 她羞愧地承认她没有尽到自己的义务。

examples.text: He is on night duty three days a week.
examples.translationZh: 他一个星期要上三天夜班。

meaningZh: 有规律的；规则，整齐的；不变的

examples.text: He made a regular visit to his parents.
examples.translationZh: 他定期看望父母亲。

examples.text: We will remain in regular contact with them.
examples.translationZh: 我们将和他们保持经常的联系。

examples.text: Please act according to the regular procedure.
examples.translationZh: 请按照正规的程序行事。

meaningZh: 治疗，疗法；处理；待遇，对待

examples.text: I tried every treatment the doctor suggested.
examples.translationZh: 我试遍了医生建议的每一种疗法。

examples.text: The treatment arrested the growth of the disease.
examples.translationZh: 治疗抑制了病情的发展。

examples.text: Unfortunately, they face unfair treatment and discrimination in that country.
examples.translationZh: 不幸的是,他们在那个国家遭到了不公平对待和歧视。

meaningZh: 浸；（把烛芯浸在融蜡里）制造（蜡烛）；把（汽车前灯）的远光调为近光

examples.text: The boat dipped into the waves.
examples.translationZh: 小船沉没在波涛之中。

examples.text: He dipped his pen in the ink.
examples.translationZh: 他拿钢笔蘸墨水。

examples.text: The children like to dip their bread into the milk.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们喜欢把面包蘸牛奶吃。

meaningZh: 抽屉；开票人，出票人；起草者

examples.text: He found the money secreted in a drawer.
examples.translationZh: 他找到了藏在抽屉里的钱。

examples.text: There is a pair of scissors in the bottom drawer.
examples.translationZh: 最底下的抽屉里有把剪刀。

examples.text: The drawer will write the check.
examples.translationZh: 出票人将填写支票。

meaningZh: 有关的，中肯的；相关联的；确切的

examples.text: A paper relevant to this research was published by him.
examples.translationZh: 与本研究相关的一篇论文是他发表的。

examples.text: Have you heard of the relevant report?
examples.translationZh: 你听说过相关的报道吗?

examples.text: My next conclusion is more relevant.
examples.translationZh: 我的另一个结论更切题。

meaningZh: 不同意；不一致；不适合

examples.text: I disagree with you on this point.
examples.translationZh: 我不同意你的意见。

examples.text: Initially, I disagreed with his proposal, but later I changed my mind.
examples.translationZh: 起初我不同意他的提议,不过后来我改了主意。

examples.text: In some countries, people who disagree with the government are classed as criminals.
examples.translationZh: 在某些国家，凡是同政府持有不同意见的人都被视为罪犯。

meaningZh: 国家；民族；国民

examples.text: I was told that Spain is a romantic nation.
examples.translationZh: 有人告诉我说，西班牙是个浪漫的国家。

examples.text: The nation levied all able-bodied man for the war.
examples.translationZh: 国家征召所有壮丁参战。

examples.text: My judgement was frequently faulty, but my loyalty to the nation could not be questioned.
examples.translationZh: 我的判断经常出错，但是我对祖国的忠诚是无可置疑的。

meaningZh: 拓荒者；开发者；先驱者

examples.text: He was a pioneer in the use of X-rays.
examples.translationZh: 他是最早使用X光的人。

examples.text: I see everybody as a pioneer out there.
examples.translationZh: 我认为每个人在那里都是先锋。

examples.text: She was descended from a pioneer family.
examples.translationZh: 她来自一个早期的开拓者家庭

meaningZh: 一点，一块；少量，少许；一会儿，一转眼

examples.text: He only put a bit on his plate to make fashion.
examples.translationZh: 他只是拨了一点食物到盘子里做做样子。

examples.text: He assembled the model aircraft bit by bit.
examples.translationZh: 他一块一块地装配飞机模型。

examples.text: Let the broth simmer down a bit more.
examples.translationZh: 让肉汤炖得再久一些吧。

meaningZh: 隐藏；躲避，隐匿，躲藏；遮蔽，覆盖

examples.text: I hid the broken plate behind the table.
examples.translationZh: 我把打碎的盘子藏在餐桌后面了。

examples.text: I hide the message in a cleave in the rock.
examples.translationZh: 我把情报藏在石块的裂缝里。

examples.text: She tried to hide her feelings.
examples.translationZh: 她设法不表露自己的感情。

meaningZh: 领袖，领导者；负责人；指挥者

examples.text: We are disciples of the artistic leader.
examples.translationZh: 我们是那位艺术领袖的追随者。

examples.text: People came to the memorial to revere the memory of the great leader.
examples.translationZh: 人们来到纪念馆崇敬地纪念这位伟大的领袖。

examples.text: He's a follower, not a leader.
examples.translationZh: 他是追随者，不是领导者。

meaningZh: 薄纸，棉纸；[生]组织；一套

examples.text: She gave us a box of tissues.
examples.translationZh: 她递给我们一盒纸巾。

examples.text: She wiped off the sweat from her face with a piece of facial tissue.
examples.translationZh: 她用一张面巾纸擦掉脸上的汗水。

examples.text: On her head was a tiny cap of silver tissue.
examples.translationZh: 她头上戴着一顶银丝小帽。

meaningZh: 提供饮食及服务；vt. 满足需要，适合；投合，迎合

examples.text: Our hotel also caters for weddings and parties.
examples.translationZh: 本饭店也承办婚礼、宴会。

examples.text: These hotels cater especially to foreign tourists.
examples.translationZh: 这些旅馆专门为外国游客提供服务。

examples.text: They only publish novels which cater to the mass market.
examples.translationZh: 他们只出版迎合大众市场的小说。

meaningZh: 野生的鸟兽等；adj. 野生生物的

examples.text: This area was once a wildlife reserve.
examples.translationZh: 该地区曾是一个野生动物保护区。

examples.text: Hunters are barred from wildlife sanctuaries.
examples.translationZh: 野生动物保护区内禁止狩猎。

meaningZh: 裙子；边缘；（连衣裙、外衣等的）下摆

examples.text: How many skirts do you have?
examples.translationZh: 你有多少条裙子？

examples.text: She tore her skirt on the nail.
examples.translationZh: 钉子勾破了她的裙子。

examples.text: Her skirt has very exquisite lace.
examples.translationZh: 她的裙子有非常精致的花边。

meaningZh: 小偷，盗贼；（使蜡外流的）蜡烛心结的烛花

examples.text: His enemies labelled him a thief.
examples.translationZh: 他的敌人称他为贼。

examples.text: The thief was confined in a prison.
examples.translationZh: 窃贼被关押在监狱里。

examples.text: The police set a trap to catch the thief.
examples.translationZh: 警察设下了捉拿窃贼的圈套。

meaningZh: （缩）上午，午前

examples.text: He set off at 4 a.m.
examples.translationZh: 他早上4点出发了。
examples.author: fucongcong

meaningZh: 好；很；好意地

examples.text: She speaks English very well.
examples.translationZh: 她英语讲得很好。

examples.text: I can't sleep well because the tap is dripping.
examples.translationZh: 龙头漏水,吵得我睡不好觉。

examples.text: It was well worth waiting for.
examples.translationZh: 这件事倒是很值得等待。

meaningZh: 生动的；（记忆、描述等）清晰的；（人的想像）丰富的

examples.text: This place conjures up vivid memories.
examples.translationZh: 这个地方使人回忆起许多生动的往事。

examples.text: My daughter is a child with vivid imagination.
examples.translationZh: 我女儿是一个想象力活跃的孩子。

examples.text: This girl gave a vivid description of the event.
examples.translationZh: 那女孩对这件事作了一番生动的描述。

meaningZh: 欣赏；鉴赏；感谢

examples.text: She shows little appreciation of good music.
examples.translationZh: 她对于好音乐几乎没有欣赏能力。

examples.text: An appreciation of art will enrich your life.
examples.translationZh: 艺术欣赏将会丰富你的生活

examples.text: She grinned her appreciation of my help.
examples.translationZh: 她露齿一笑表示感激我的帮助。

meaningZh: 大字标题；新闻提要；头条新闻

examples.text: A newspaper headline caught his attention.
examples.translationZh: 报纸的大标题引起他的注意。

examples.text: A headline on the front page draws attention to the fuller story inside.
examples.translationZh: 扉页上的大字标题为的是吸引你注意里面的详细内容。

examples.text: A bold black headline screamed out from the front page.
examples.translationZh: 在头版上出现了一条令人触目惊心的粗黑体大字标题。

meaningZh: 宣布；声明，声称；申报

examples.text: I now declare this meeting open.
examples.translationZh: 我现在宣布会议开幕。

examples.text: Britain declared war on Germany in 1914.
examples.translationZh: 英国在1914年向德国宣战。

examples.text: The customs asked me if I had anything to declare.
examples.translationZh: 海关人员问我是否有要报税的东西。

meaningZh: 敏锐的；锋利的；狡猾的，聪明的

examples.text: Cats have sharp claws.
examples.translationZh: 猫有锋利的爪子。

examples.text: There is a sharp drop in the prices.
examples.translationZh: 价格出现暴跌。

examples.text: It was very sharp of you to have noticed that.
examples.translationZh: 你注意到了这一点是够机灵的。

meaningZh: 障碍；屏障；栅栏

examples.text: The ice skater rammed into the barrier.
examples.translationZh: 溜冰者撞到护栏上了。

examples.text: Heavy duties on imports and exports are a barrier to international trade.
examples.translationZh: 进出口的高关税是国际贸易的障碍。

examples.text: The Sahara Desert is a natural barrier between north and central Africa.
examples.translationZh: 撒哈拉沙漠是北非与中非之间的天然屏障。

meaningZh: 紧接在后的；次于的；贴近的

examples.text: If I miss this train I'll catch the next one.
examples.translationZh: 如果我错过了这班火车，就赶乘下一班。

examples.text: Let's pass on to the next item on the agenda.
examples.translationZh: 咱们进行议事日程的下一个项目吧。

examples.text: The next best thing would be to tell him the truth.
examples.translationZh: 其次，最好的办法就是把真相告诉他们。

meaningZh: 高声；大声

examples.text: She sobbed aloud, not caring to restrain her grief.
examples.translationZh: 她大声地啜泣，不打算遏止悲哀。

examples.text: He groaned aloud as he started to drag himself to his feet.
examples.translationZh: 他一面拖着身体站起来，一面大声地哼哼。

meaningZh: 松鼠，松鼠科动物；松鼠毛皮；vt. 储藏

examples.text: The squirrel is a lovely small animal.
examples.translationZh: 松鼠是一种可爱的小动物。

examples.text: The squirrel ran up a tree and got out of my reach.
examples.translationZh: 松鼠跑到树上去了，我逮不着。

examples.text: The squirrel hoards up nuts for the winter.
examples.translationZh: 松鼠储藏坚果以防冬天。

meaningZh: 衣服；服装；v. 给…穿衣服

examples.text: This garment should be washed carefully.
examples.translationZh: 这件衣服应该小心地洗涤。

examples.text: The garment fits her perfectly.
examples.translationZh: 这件衣服她穿上很合适。

examples.text: In spring nature wears a new garment.
examples.translationZh: 春天

meaningZh: 文学；文学作品；文献

examples.text: She is fond of polite literature.
examples.translationZh: 她喜爱风雅文学。

examples.text: He destroyed feudal ideas in literature.
examples.translationZh: 他摧毁了文学中的封建思想。

examples.text: The principal literature comes from zoology.
examples.translationZh: 主要文献都来自动物学。

meaningZh: 主题；话题，论题；标题，细目

examples.text: Lack of space forbids further treatment of the topic here.
examples.translationZh: 因篇幅所限，此处不便对本题作进一步阐述。

examples.text: This essay is so short that it can only scratch the surface of the topic.
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章很短，只能对这一问题作肤浅的探讨。

examples.text: The essay isn't even remotely relevant to the topic.
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章毫不切题。

meaningZh: 盖子；限制；[口]果盖

examples.text: He slammed the lid down.
examples.translationZh: 他砰的一声盖上了盖子。

examples.text: She gave the lid a few gentle taps to loosen it.
examples.translationZh: 她把盖子轻拍了几下使它松动。

examples.text: The lid of this jam pot won't unscrew.
examples.translationZh: 这果酱罐的盖子拧不开。

meaningZh: 烟雾；烟尘；烟雾污染

examples.text: Black smog reduced visibility to about fifty yards.
examples.translationZh: 黑色的烟雾使能见度降到大约五十码左右。

examples.text: The smog persisted throughout the day.
examples.translationZh: 烟雾终日不散。

meaningZh: 用拖把拖；擦拭；vi. 用拖把拖

examples.text: Here is a dish mop.
examples.translationZh: 这儿是洗碗刷。

examples.text: I used a mop to sop up the spilled water.
examples.translationZh: 我用拖把把泼出的水擦干。

examples.text: She had a mop of black hair.
examples.translationZh: 她一头蓬乱的黑发。

meaningZh: 注意，观察；话语；评论，谈论

examples.text: They made rude remarks about her appearance.
examples.translationZh: 他们对她的外表横加粗暴的评论。

examples.text: The teacher asked the students to make a remark on this page.
examples.translationZh: 老师要求学生在这页备注。

examples.text: Ellen later regretted her remarks about his private affairs.
examples.translationZh: 后来,艾伦后悔的发现没有好好注意他的私事。

meaningZh: 类型；铅字；（印刷或打印的）文字

examples.text: I'm unfamiliar with this type of computer.
examples.translationZh: 我不熟悉这种类型的计算机。

examples.text: There are two types of rocks in this area.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区有两种类型的岩石。

examples.text: I don't think she's the artistic type.
examples.translationZh: 我认为她不属艺术家那类的人。

meaningZh: 方式，方法，做法；态度，样子，举止；礼貌，规矩

examples.text: He is easy in conversation and graceful in manner.
examples.translationZh: 他谈吐从容,举止优雅。

examples.text: There is a noticeable coolness in his manner.
examples.translationZh: 在他的举止中表现出一种明显的冷淡。

examples.text: It is bad manners to interrupt.
examples.translationZh: 打断别人说话是不礼貌的。

meaningZh: 天花板；最高限度；云幕高度

examples.text: He cracked his nut on the ceiling.
examples.translationZh: 他的头让天花板碰破了。

examples.text: The low ceiling of the room gave me a feeling of oppression.
examples.translationZh: 低矮的屋顶给我一种压抑的感觉。

examples.text: It took more or less a whole day to paint the ceiling.
examples.translationZh: 粉刷天花板用了将近一整天的时间。

meaningZh: 申请人，求职人；请求者

examples.text: He gave every new applicant the once-over.
examples.translationZh: 他匆匆地看一下每一个新来的申请人。

examples.text: As the wage of the job was low, there were few applicants for it.
examples.translationZh: 因为工资低,没有什么人申请这份工作。

examples.text: The enterprise is an applicant of this credit.
examples.translationZh: 这家企业是信用证的申请者。

meaningZh: （表示时间）自始至终；在…期间；遍及…地域

examples.text: The disease spread throughout the country.
examples.translationZh: 这种疾病蔓延全国。

examples.text: She remained cheerful throughout the trip.
examples.translationZh: 旅行中她始终兴致勃勃。

examples.text: It snowed throughout the night.
examples.translationZh: 雪整整下了一夜。

meaningZh: 主题，话题；学科，科目；[哲]主观

examples.text: She dare not mention the subject again.
examples.translationZh: 她不敢重提那个话题。

examples.text: Mathematics is her favorite subject.
examples.translationZh: 数学是她喜欢的科目。

examples.text: He is said to be writing a paper on this subject.
examples.translationZh: 据说他正在写一篇关于这个主题的论文。

meaningZh: 票，入场券；标签；传票，交通违规的通知单

examples.text: Have you got your train ticket?
examples.translationZh: 你拿到火车票了吗？

examples.text: No one is allowed to get his ticket out of turn.
examples.translationZh: 任何人都不准不按次序买票。

examples.text: The money is raised by the sale of raffle ticket.
examples.translationZh: 这笔款是通过出售购物彩券筹集的。

meaningZh: 下雪的；被雪覆盖的；雪白的，洁白无瑕的

examples.text: I can't remember when we had such a snowy day.
examples.translationZh: 我记不得何时我们曾有过这样多雪的日子了。

examples.text: It's cold and snowy in December.
examples.translationZh: 十二月是寒冷多雪的。

examples.text: A snowy morning is a theatre of memory.
examples.translationZh: 下雪的早晨令人浮想联翩。

meaningZh: 关系；联系；浪漫关系

examples.text: Part of my job is to maintain good relationship with our suppliers.
examples.translationZh: 我的部分工作是同我们的供应商保持良好的关系。

examples.text: We have a working relationship.
examples.translationZh: 我们是工作上的关系。

examples.text: I'm not going to give my son the job just because of our relationship.
examples.translationZh: 我不打算把这个职位给我的儿子,正因为我们有这层亲属关系。

meaningZh: 错误，过失；[法]误审，违法；[数]误差

examples.text: He overlooked a spelling error on the first page.
examples.translationZh: 他没有看出第一页中有个拼写错误。

examples.text: An alert listener will have noticed the error.
examples.translationZh: 耳朵尖的人能听出这个错。

examples.text: Every man is liable to error.
examples.translationZh: 人人都可能犯错误。

meaningZh: 遮盖；掩蔽；涉及

examples.text: The front cover of the novel has been torn off.
examples.translationZh: 这本小说的封面已被撕掉。

examples.text: I can't make the cover of the tin fit on.
examples.translationZh: 我无法把这罐头的盖子盖上。

examples.text: The car should be housed with a cover for a longer time's parking.
examples.translationZh: 长时间的存放汽车，应给汽车罩上套子。

meaningZh: 纯的；单纯的；纯真的

examples.text: Water can be made pure by distilling it.
examples.translationZh: 水可以通过蒸馏而提纯。

examples.text: They are all made of one-hundred percent pure silk.
examples.translationZh: 它们都是用100%的纯丝绸做成的。

examples.text: Life is a sweet thing for one who has a pure conscience.
examples.translationZh: 对于善良纯洁的人来说,生活是一件美好的事情。

meaningZh: 行为；行动；契约

examples.text: His deed claims our respect.
examples.translationZh: 他的行为值得我们尊敬。

examples.text: His deed revealed him to be a kind man.
examples.translationZh: 他的行为显示他是个好心的人。

examples.text: We must take the consequences of our own deed.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须承担自己行为的后果。

meaningZh: 鸡；鸡肉；胆小鬼

examples.text: He has a chicken farm.
examples.translationZh: 他有一个养鸡场。

examples.text: He is mending the wire mesh in front of the chicken coop.
examples.translationZh: 他正在鸡笼前面修理铁丝网。

examples.text: This soup tastes of chicken.
examples.translationZh: 这汤里有鸡肉的味道。

meaningZh: 事情，事件；事务；个人的事，私事

examples.text: Their love affair is an open secret.
examples.translationZh: 他们的风流韵事是公开的秘密。

examples.text: The party was a dull affair.
examples.translationZh: 这次聚会单调乏味。

examples.text: The minister is busy with important affairs of state.
examples.translationZh: 部长忙于重要国务。

meaningZh: 平原；平地；[纺织业]平针

examples.text: It was plain to everyone that she was not happy.
examples.translationZh: 她并不幸福,这是明摆着的事实。

examples.text: The restaurant serves plain home-made meals.
examples.translationZh: 那个餐馆供应简单的家常菜。

examples.text: She was admired for her plain speaking.
examples.translationZh: 她说话坦白,这一点令人钦佩。

meaningZh: 快乐的,欢快的; 轻松的,愉快的；轻率的,不假思索的; 放荡的；同性恋的

examples.text: They object to the movie's depiction of gay people.
examples.translationZh: 他们反对这部影片对同性恋者的刻画。

examples.text: She gave a gay laugh.
examples.translationZh: 她发出了快活的笑声。

examples.text: The package was tied with gay ribbons.
examples.translationZh: 包裹用色彩鲜艳的丝带捆扎好。

meaningZh: 向（某人）道贺；祝贺；（为成就或成功）感到高兴

examples.text: Let me congratulate you.
examples.translationZh: 请允许我向您表示祝贺。

examples.text: May I congratulate you?
examples.translationZh: 请允许我向您表示祝贺。

examples.text: I congratulate you on your great discovery.
examples.translationZh: 我祝贺你的伟大发现。

meaningZh: 菜单；菜，菜肴

examples.text: We only have an a la carte menu.
examples.translationZh: 我们只有分类菜单。

examples.text: He called the waiter to bring the menu.
examples.translationZh: 他叫侍者拿菜单来。

examples.text: I haven't decided on the menu yet, let alone bought the food.
examples.translationZh: 我还没决定吃什么菜呢，更不必说买好了。

meaningZh: 辞职；放弃；屈从

examples.text: Have you heard of her intention to resign?
examples.translationZh: 你听到她打算辞职的传闻了吗？

examples.text: He decided to resign his claim to the copyright.
examples.translationZh: 他决定放弃对版权的要求。

examples.text: He has resigned himself to the fact that he will lose the job.
examples.translationZh: 他已经接受他将要失去这份工作的现实。

meaningZh: 醉的；陶醉的；沉醉

examples.text: He was obviously drunk.
examples.translationZh: 他显然是醉了。

examples.text: The drunk man lost his pouch in the bar.
examples.translationZh: 那个喝醉了的人在酒吧里丢失了钱袋。

examples.text: Men were drunk now with a kind of fury of contest.
examples.translationZh: 现在人们在一种斗争的狂热中陶醉了。

meaningZh: 麻木的，失去感觉的；无动于衷的，没感情的；vt. 使麻木，使麻痹

examples.text: My fingers were so numb that I could hardly write.
examples.translationZh: 我的手指都麻木了几乎不能写字。

examples.text: I've just been to the dentist and my face is still numb.
examples.translationZh: 我刚刚去看了牙医，脸上现在还没知觉呢。

examples.text: The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
examples.translationZh: 麻醉药使他的整张脸失去了知觉。

meaningZh: 地址；通信处；演说

examples.text: Please write your home address on the registration form.
examples.translationZh: 请在这张登记表上写下你的家庭住址。

examples.text: I'll log in to the internet to know about you. I know your address.
examples.translationZh: 我还是上因特网去看吧，我知道你们的网址。

examples.text: Can you tell me your E-mail address?
examples.translationZh: 能告诉我你的电子邮箱地址吗?

meaningZh: （使）循环；（使）流通；（使）流传

examples.text: Please open a window to allow the air to circulate.
examples.translationZh: 打开窗子让空气流通。

examples.text: Foreign money is not allowed to circulate in China.
examples.translationZh: 外币不允许在中国流通。

examples.text: Money shall circulate freely within the common market.
examples.translationZh: 货币应在共同市场内自由流通。

meaningZh: 焦炭，焦煤；vt.& vi. 转化或者被转化为焦炭

examples.text: Coke consists mainly of carbon.
examples.translationZh: 焦炭的主要成分是碳。

examples.text: Without coke iron cannot be smelted.
examples.translationZh: 没有焦炭就不能炼铁。

meaningZh: 令人讨厌的；令人烦恼的；引起麻烦的

examples.text: You must learn to rid yourself of such troublesome thoughts.
examples.translationZh: 你必须学会使自己摆脱如此令人烦恼的想法。

examples.text: She has left, for instance, some troublesome bits of scaffolding, like the vermiform appendix, behind.
examples.translationZh: 比如，它遗留下了令人烦恼的残留物，如隐藏的阑尾。

examples.text: This species is a troublesome weed.
examples.translationZh: 本种是一根令人讨厌的杂草。

meaningZh: 罪行，犯罪；罪恶；v. 指控犯罪

examples.text: He was acquitted of the crime.
examples.translationZh: 他被宣告无罪。

examples.text: His addiction to drugs propelled him towards a life of crime.
examples.translationZh: 他吸毒成瘾使他走上了犯罪的道路。

examples.text: The government is alarmed by the dramatic increase in violent crime.
examples.translationZh: 政府对暴力犯罪案件的急剧增加感到担心。

meaningZh: 灰；灰烬,废墟；骨灰

examples.text: She dusted some ash from her sleeve.
examples.translationZh: 她撢去袖子上的灰末。

examples.text: Wood ash should be forked or dug into the soil.
examples.translationZh: 木灰应被耙入或插进土壤里。

examples.text: I wish he would refrain from scattering his ash all over the carpet.
examples.translationZh: 我希望他不要将烟灰往地毯上乱弹。

meaningZh: （物体的）飞行；航班；飞翔

examples.text: She photographed the birds in flight.
examples.translationZh: 她拍摄鸟儿飞行的照片。

examples.text: I'll book a direct flight to London for you.
examples.translationZh: 我将为你预订直飞伦敦的航班。

meaningZh: 赞扬，称赞；崇拜；赞词

examples.text: The teacher praised her for her courage.
examples.translationZh: 老师赞扬了她的勇气。

examples.text: The guests praised the meal.
examples.translationZh: 客人们称赞这顿饭做得好.

examples.text: He deserves all the praise and worship.
examples.translationZh: 他值得我们一切的赞美和崇拜。

meaningZh: 听力，听觉；审问；听力所及的距离，听得见的范围

examples.text: He has a good faculty of hearing.
examples.translationZh: 他的听力生来就好。

examples.text: His hearing was impaired after the explosion.
examples.translationZh: 爆炸后他的听力受到了损害。

examples.text: Loud noise would impair your hearing.
examples.translationZh: 大的噪音会损害你的听觉。

meaningZh: 有毒的；有害的；恶意的

examples.text: Some mushrooms are poisonous.
examples.translationZh: 有些蘑菇有毒。

examples.text: Some snakes have poisonous fangs.
examples.translationZh: 有些蛇长有毒牙。

examples.text: She gave him a poisonous look.
examples.translationZh: 她恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

meaningZh: 将（某物）切开（或分割）；vt. 削减；剪切

examples.text: This knife is not sharp enough to cut the steak.
examples.translationZh: 这把刀子不够利,无法切牛排。

examples.text: Don't cut your finger on the broken glass.
examples.translationZh: 别让碎玻璃割伤你的手。

examples.text: Face round, please, so that I can cut your hair at the back.
examples.translationZh: 转一下头, 好让我可以剪你后面的头发。

meaningZh: 使人发笑；逗乐；使消遣

examples.text: I amuse myself by reading on weekends.
examples.translationZh: 周末我读书消遣。

examples.text: It is not always easy to amuse oneself on holiday.
examples.translationZh: 让自己在假期里自娱并不总是容易的。

examples.text: The boys amuse themselves by drawing caricatures of their teacher.
examples.translationZh: 男孩子们以画老师的漫画取乐。

meaningZh: 皮，皮肤；（蔬菜，水果等）外皮；毛皮

examples.text: He had brown skin.
examples.translationZh: 他的皮肤是棕色的

examples.text: When he fell he just broke the skin.
examples.translationZh: 当他跌倒时，他只擦破皮肤。

examples.text: She peeled off the skin of a banana for the child.
examples.translationZh: 她替孩子剥掉香蕉皮。

meaningZh: 心理学；心理特点；心理状态

examples.text: I can't understand that man's psychology.
examples.translationZh: 我无法理解那个人的心理。

examples.text: She had no personal life and no private psychology.
examples.translationZh: 她没有个人的生活和隐秘的心理活动。

examples.text: Many people failed in the psychology test.
examples.translationZh: 很多人在心理测试环节被淘汰。

meaningZh: 足够地，充足地；十分地；adj. 充足的

examples.text: I haven't enough time for reading.
examples.translationZh: 我没有足够的时间读书。

examples.text: He has enough money (=money enough) to buy a car.
examples.translationZh: 他有足够的钱买一辆汽车。

examples.text: John's old enough to take care of himself.
examples.translationZh: 约翰长大了,能照顾自己了。

meaningZh: 感谢的，感激的；欣慰的

examples.text: Oh, we have a lot to be thankful for.
examples.translationZh: 啊，我们有很多需要感谢的事情。

examples.text: Seeds of discouragement will not grow in the thankful heart.
examples.translationZh: 气馁的种子在感激的心中不会生长。

examples.text: So I am ready to accompany you with a thankful heart.
examples.translationZh: 我带着一颗感激的心准备随你去。

meaningZh: 书法，手书；笔迹，字迹；v. 亲手写(handwrite的ing形式)

examples.text: The handwriting on both cheques is identical.
examples.translationZh: 两张支票上的笔迹完全相同。

examples.text: It's always a problem deciphering his handwriting.
examples.translationZh: 辨认他的笔迹有困难。

examples.text: My handwriting cannot compete with his.
examples.translationZh: 我的书法不及他。

meaningZh: 头盔；钢盔；盔形物，盔状物

examples.text: The sword bit the knight's helmet.
examples.translationZh: 剑刺穿了武士的头盔。

examples.text: A miner's lamp is fixed onto his helmet.
examples.translationZh: 矿灯固定在矿工的头盔上。

examples.text: The safety helmet is held on by an elastic strap.
examples.translationZh: 安全帽用一根松紧带系住。

meaningZh: 正餐，主餐；宴会；晚餐

examples.text: It's time for dinner.
examples.translationZh: 该吃晚饭了。

examples.text: It is now his turn to set me up to a nice dinner.
examples.translationZh: 现在轮到他请我吃一顿丰盛的晚餐了。

examples.text: We invite her to have Thanksgiving dinner with us.
examples.translationZh: 我们邀请她和我们一起吃感恩节晚餐。

meaningZh: 囚犯；犯人；俘虏

examples.text: The prisoner made a plea for mercy.
examples.translationZh: 囚犯恳求宽恕。

meaningZh: 可变的电容二极管

examples.text: This VCD can be returned for repair under warranty.
examples.translationZh: VCD在保修期间可以退回维修。

meaningZh: 侦探的；适于探测的；用于探测的

examples.text: The detective laid great stress on details.
examples.translationZh: 侦探特别强调细节。

examples.text: The detective was trying to ascertain exactly who was at the party.
examples.translationZh: 这个侦探试图查明都有谁参加了聚会。

examples.text: The detective thought the stick was relative to the murder case.
examples.translationZh: 侦探认为这根木棒和谋杀案有牵连。

meaningZh: 货币；通用，流通，流传，传播；市价，行情

examples.text: The president proclaimed that a new currency would be issued.
examples.translationZh: 总统宣布将发行新货币。

examples.text: Our currency will not be depreciated.
examples.translationZh: 我们的货币不会贬值。

examples.text: There are currency restrictions on the sums allowed for foreign travel.
examples.translationZh: 到国外旅行允许携带的款额有所限制。

meaningZh: 疯狂的；猛烈的；着迷的

examples.text: She was almost mad with grief when her son died.
examples.translationZh: 她的儿子死去时，她悲伤得几乎疯了。

examples.text: They are mad about football.
examples.translationZh: 他们对足球很狂热。

examples.text: It was a mad idea to climb the mountain in this bad weather.
examples.translationZh: 在这种坏天气去爬山真是愚蠢。

meaningZh: 早餐，早饭；早餐食物；vi. 吃早餐

examples.text: We were having breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 我们正在吃早餐。

examples.text: He seldom eats breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 他很少吃早餐。

examples.text: She juiced an orange for her breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 她用一只橙子榨汁作早餐饮料。

meaningZh: 怒目而视；vi. 发强光；n. 强光

examples.text: I like turning a corner from the shade of a house into the full torrid glare of an open space.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢将来自房子的色度的一个角落变成开着空间的完整晒焦的闪耀光。

examples.text: These sunglasses are designed to reduce glare.
examples.translationZh: 这些太阳镜是为减少刺眼的强光而设计的。

examples.text: The glare of the oncoming headlights temporarily blinded me.
examples.translationZh: 迎面车灯刺眼的光照得我瞬间什么也看不见。

meaningZh: 方法（ mean的名词复数）；手段；收入

examples.text: Are there any means of getting there?
examples.translationZh: 有什么方法可以到那里吗？

examples.text: We express our thought by means of words.
examples.translationZh: 我们用词句来表达思想。

examples.text: He explored ways and means of solving the question.
examples.translationZh: 他寻找解决问题的方法。

meaningZh: 中部，中间；腰部；中央

examples.text: There are 300 students or so in this middle school.
examples.translationZh: 这所中学大约有300个学生。

examples.text: He was not much above the middle height.
examples.translationZh: 他不过中等身材。

examples.text: He made a bid for middle class support.
examples.translationZh: 他努力试图得到中产阶级的支持。

meaningZh: 赠品，礼物；天赋；赠送

examples.text: He gave me a necklace as an anniversary gift.
examples.translationZh: 他给我一条项链作为周年纪念礼物。

examples.text: At that price it's an absolute gift!
examples.translationZh: 那个价钱，纯粹是白给。

examples.text: He has a gift for music.
examples.translationZh: 他有音乐天赋。

meaningZh: 显示屏，屏幕；[计]显示器；监测仪

examples.text: Police officers have been closely monitoring the organization's activities.
examples.translationZh: 警方密切地监视着该组织的活动。

examples.text: He will monitor and review the company's rules and regulations.
examples.translationZh: 他将监督并审查该公司的规章制度。

examples.text: This instrument monitors the patient's heartbeats.
examples.translationZh: 这台仪器监听病人的心跳。

meaningZh: 摄影师；摄影家；照相师

examples.text: The photographer retouched her picture.
examples.translationZh: 摄影师对她的照片作了修整。

meaningZh: 命令，指挥；司令部，指挥部；[计算机]指令

examples.text: He growled a command to her to stop.
examples.translationZh: 他咆哮着命令她停下来。

examples.text: The company commander roared his command.
examples.translationZh: 连长高声发布命令。

examples.text: He has a hundred men under his command.
examples.translationZh: 他指挥一百个人。

meaningZh: 议事日程；待议诸事项一览表；日常工作事项

examples.text: This agenda will form the basis of our next meeting.
examples.translationZh: 本议程将成为下次会议的中心议题。

examples.text: Let's go on to the next item on the agenda.
examples.translationZh: 我们讨论议程表上的下一项吧。

examples.text: Let's thrash the matter over before putting it on the agenda.
examples.translationZh: 我们先把这件事仔细研究一下，再把它列入议事日程。

meaningZh: 被子，棉被；被状物；v. 缝（被）

examples.text: He bought a heavy quilt for the winter.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一床厚被子过冬。

examples.text: He wake to find that his quilt have slip off the bed.
examples.translationZh: 他醒来发现被子从床上滑下来了。

examples.text: If you air your quilt on such a wet day, it'll soak up the moisture.
examples.translationZh: 如果在这么潮湿的天晒被子，被子就会把湿气都吸去。

meaningZh: 湖

examples.text: He fell into the lake.
examples.translationZh: 他掉进了湖里。

examples.text: The garden reaches the lake.
examples.translationZh: 花园一直延伸到湖边。

examples.text: We crossed the lake in a canoe.
examples.translationZh: 我们乘独木舟过河。

meaningZh: 快的；走得快；感光快的

examples.text: I like fast music.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢节奏快的音乐。

examples.text: The star was whipped into a fast car and driven off.
examples.translationZh: 那个明星迅速上了一辆汽车疾驶而去。

examples.text: The post is fast in the ground.
examples.translationZh: 那柱子牢牢地埋在地里.

meaningZh: 稳定的；沉稳[持重]的；[物理学]稳定平衡的

examples.text: Markets are flourishing and prices are stable.
examples.translationZh: 市场繁荣, 物价稳定。

examples.text: In order that our country could flourish and achieve its own goals, a stable environment within the country is definitely not dispensable.
examples.translationZh: 国家要发展，要实现自己的目标，这是必不可少的条件，就是要国内有安定的环境。

examples.text: The Sunnis hold a majority in four provinces and any government will have to respect them if they wish to administer a stable state.
examples.translationZh: 逊尼派在四个省份里都是多数群体，而任何政府只要想管理一个安定的国家，就不得不对他们予以尊重。

meaningZh: 额；前部

examples.text: She lightly touched his forehead.
examples.translationZh: 她轻轻地摸了摸他的前额。

examples.text: The horse has a splash of white on its forehead.
examples.translationZh: 这匹马的前额上有一块白斑。

examples.text: The forehead is small and narrow, assumes the triangle slightly, the top of the head front part is smooth, on behind skin scale fine grain shape.
examples.translationZh: 头部窄小，略呈三角形，头顶前部平滑，头后部皮肤上秤细粒颗状。

meaningZh: 津贴，补贴，零用钱；限额；折扣

examples.text: I didn't receive any allowance from my father.
examples.translationZh: 我没有收到父亲给的零用钱。

examples.text: I have to work to earn my allowance.
examples.translationZh: 我非得工作挣零用钱。

examples.text: She receives a monthly allowance of $500.
examples.translationZh: 她每月收到500美元的津贴。

meaningZh: 请；vt.& vi. 使高兴；使满意

examples.text: Please come with me.
examples.translationZh: 请跟我来。

examples.text: Please call if you require assistance.
examples.translationZh: 如果需要帮忙，请打电话。

examples.text: Please fill in the arrival card.
examples.translationZh: 请填写这张入境卡。

meaningZh: 飞机

examples.text: The boom of the airplane was damaged.
examples.translationZh: 飞机的尾桁受到损害。

examples.text: An airplane engine is a complex mechanism.
examples.translationZh: 飞机引擎是种复杂的机械装置。

meaningZh: 直升机，直升飞机；vt. 用直升飞机载送；vi. 乘直升飞机

examples.text: The criminal escaped by a helicopter.
examples.translationZh: 罪犯乘直升机逃走了。

examples.text: The shipwrecked sailors were rescued by helicopter.
examples.translationZh: 遭遇海难的水手已经被直升机救起。

examples.text: We shuttled the passengers to the city center by helicopter.
examples.translationZh: 我们来来回回地用直升机把旅客运送到市中心。

meaningZh: 温和的；文雅的；高尚的

examples.text: We've never met such gentle people.
examples.translationZh: 我们从来没有遇到这样温和的人。

examples.text: My mother is a kind and gentle woman.
examples.translationZh: 我的母亲是一位心地善良、性情温和的妇女。

examples.text: The gentle music can relax him.
examples.translationZh: 轻柔的音乐能使他放松。

meaningZh: 表明，标示，指示；象征，暗示，预示；[医]显示需要做…的治疗

examples.text: This is used to indicate the temperature of the enclosure.
examples.translationZh: 这个用来指示壳体的温度。

examples.text: Sword indicates the bearer to a just and generous pursuit of honor and virtue in warlike deeds.
examples.translationZh: 长剑象征剑的佩有者在格斗中具备公正、宽恕的美德。

examples.text: My car's gas gauge indicated that there was little gas left.
examples.translationZh: 我车上的汽油表显示剩下的油不多了。

meaningZh: 教授；（大学的）讲师，教员；自称者，宣称者

examples.text: Our professor is a man of profound learning.
examples.translationZh: 我们的教授是一个学识渊博的人。

examples.text: The professor invited his students to his home for conversation.
examples.translationZh: 教授邀请学生们到自己家里会晤。

examples.text: Professor Green, lately of Princeton, is now head of the department at California.
examples.translationZh: 格林教授不久前在普林斯顿任教，现在是加州大学的系主任。

meaningZh: 账单；广告,招贴,节目单；议案

examples.text: A 10% service charge is added on to the bill.
examples.translationZh: 帐单上包括了百分之十的服务费。

examples.text: I have a 5-dollar bill.
examples.translationZh: 我有一张5美元的钞票。

examples.text: A bill came along with the package.
examples.translationZh: 清单与包裹一并到达。

meaningZh: 控制；管理；限制

examples.text: Don't worry, we have everything under control.
examples.translationZh: 别担心,一切都在我们掌控之中。

examples.text: Inflation has got out of control.
examples.translationZh: 通货膨胀失去了控制。

examples.text: The government has imposed strict controls over the import of luxury goods.
examples.translationZh: 政府对奢侈品的进口采取了严格的管制。

meaningZh: 地区；教区；〈美〉（各州众议员）选举区

examples.text: This district used to grow cotton on a large scale.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区过去大量种棉花。

examples.text: We wish to be your agent in our district if the commission rate is favorable.
examples.translationZh: 如佣金率优惠,我们愿意做你方在我们地区的代理。

examples.text: He was elected the district attorney.
examples.translationZh: 他被选为地方检察官。

meaningZh: 牙科医生

examples.text: The dentist told the boy not to eat too many sweets.
examples.translationZh: 牙医告诫这男孩不要吃太多糖果。

examples.text: I have an appointment with my dentist this afternoon.
examples.translationZh: 我已约好今天下午去看牙医。

examples.text: The dentist took out his bad tooth yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 昨天医生拔掉了他的一颗坏牙。

meaningZh: 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的

examples.text: She is vain and foolish, and yet people like her.
examples.translationZh: 她自负而愚蠢，然而人们喜欢她。

examples.text: She is vain of her voice.
examples.translationZh: 她自以为她的声音了不起。

examples.text: They endeavoured to make her happy but in vain.
examples.translationZh: 他们尽量使她快乐，却徒劳无功。

meaningZh: 面条；傻子， 笨蛋；vi. （乐师）弹拨乐器，（即兴）演奏

examples.text: The noodle is in the shape of a waistbelt.
examples.translationZh: 面条像腰带。

examples.text: Please put more minced meat into my noodle soup.
examples.translationZh: 请给我的面条里多加些肉末。

meaningZh: 结局；结束；终结

examples.text: The story is flawed by a weak ending.
examples.translationZh: 这个故事因结尾写得马虎而显得逊色了。

examples.text: Write your own ending dear reader.
examples.translationZh: 亲爱的读者，您自己来作一个结尾吧。

examples.text: The writer contrived a happy ending.
examples.translationZh: 作者安排了一个大团圆的结局。

meaningZh: 行李；皮箱

examples.text: All the luggage has been strapped up.
examples.translationZh: 所有行李都已捆扎好。

examples.text: He put his bag on the luggage rack.
examples.translationZh: 他把包放在行李架上。

examples.text: The porter was weighed down by all the luggage.
examples.translationZh: 搬运工扛着这些行李压得直不起腰来。

meaningZh: 成功，成就；好成绩，好结果；成功的人（或物）

examples.text: She is responsible for the character part of the hero's devoted mother.
examples.translationZh: 她负责这个主人公的忠诚的母亲的角色部分。

examples.text: The school has only been open for six months, so it's hard to evaluate its success.
examples.translationZh: 该学校仅开办了六个月, 现在还很难估计它的成就。

examples.text: I am very heartened by her success in the election.
examples.translationZh: 她在竞选中获胜令我大受鼓舞。

meaningZh: 微波；微波炉；vt. 用微波炉加热（或烹饪）

examples.text: The samples were digested using a microwave oven.
examples.translationZh: 用微波消解样品。

examples.text: A land line can be wire or fiber optics or microwave.
examples.translationZh: 陆上线路可以是金属或光纤电缆或者微波线路。

examples.text: We cooked the fish in the microwave oven.
examples.translationZh: 我们在微波炉中煮鱼。

meaningZh: 帐篷；帐篷状物；塞子

examples.text: They set up a tent near the seashore.
examples.translationZh: 他们在海滨附近搭起了一个帐篷。

examples.text: The wind caused the tent to collapse.
examples.translationZh: 风把帐篷吹塌了。

examples.text: Please slacken the tent rope before it rains.
examples.translationZh: 下雨前，请将帐篷的绳索放松。

meaningZh: 在内，在里面；在屋内；在心中，心里是

examples.text: I'll be coming within an hour.
examples.translationZh: 一小时之内我就会到。

examples.text: No fishing is allowed within a twenty mile limit.
examples.translationZh: 二十英里范围内不准垂钓。

examples.text: This is a task well within your ability.
examples.translationZh: 这完全是你力所能及的工作。

meaningZh: 纪念碑，纪念物；纪念仪式；adj. 纪念的

examples.text: This memorial commemorates those who died in the war.
examples.translationZh: 这座纪念碑是纪念战争中牺牲者的。

examples.text: The site of the memorial is granted in perpetuity to Canada.
examples.translationZh: 纪念馆址已选定在加拿大作为永久的纪念。

examples.text: People came to the memorial to revere the memory of the great leader.
examples.translationZh: 人们来到纪念馆崇敬地纪念这位伟大的领袖。

meaningZh: 鹿

examples.text: The deer darted away at the sight of a lion.
examples.translationZh: 鹿一见狮子就飞奔而逃。

examples.text: There were deer in abundance in these forests.
examples.translationZh: 这些森林中有许多鹿。

meaningZh: 聊天；闲谈；参加网络闲聊

examples.text: He came round last week and we chatted for a while.
examples.translationZh: 上星期他顺道来访,我们闲谈了一会。

examples.text: He likes to chat with his e-pals on the Internet.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢上网与网友聊天。

examples.text: Ask him to stop by for a chat.
examples.translationZh: 请他来坐坐，聊聊天。

meaningZh: 重音；口音；腔调

examples.text: The accent falls on the third syllable.
examples.translationZh: 重音落在第三个音节上。

examples.text: She spoke with an Irish accent.
examples.translationZh: 她说话带有爱尔兰口音。

examples.text: He flattered himself that he spoke French with a perfect accent.
examples.translationZh: 他自以为他说法语的腔调很完美。

meaningZh: 这样的；如此的；这么大的

examples.text: He said he hadn't got time or made some such excuse.
examples.translationZh: 他说他没有时间, 或是找诸如此类的借口。

examples.text: Such a disaster as her car being stolen had never happened before.
examples.translationZh: 有的祸事，像她的汽车被盗之类，以前从未发生过。

examples.text: He had never before gazed on such splendour.
examples.translationZh: 他生平从未见过如此壮观的场面。

meaningZh: 发音；读法；发音方法

examples.text: His pronunciation is simply terrible.
examples.translationZh: 他的发音太糟了。

examples.text: Your faults of pronunciation can be remedied.
examples.translationZh: 你的发音毛病是可以纠正的。

examples.text: He learns pronunciation by imitating the teacher.
examples.translationZh: 他是向老师模仿来学习发音的。

meaningZh: 得分；分数；总谱

examples.text: Hughes scored two goals before half-time.
examples.translationZh: 休斯在上半场进了两个球.

examples.text: The army continued to score successes in the south.
examples.translationZh: 军队在南方不断取得胜利。

examples.text: They scored the floor-boards by pushing furniture about.
examples.translationZh: 他们推动家具

meaningZh: 碑，匾；药片；便笺簿

examples.text: Fill a glass with water and dissolve this tablet in it.
examples.translationZh: 倒杯水把药片放进去溶解了。

examples.text: The doctor told him to take two tablets of aspirin before every meal.
examples.translationZh: 医生告诉他每天饭前吃两片阿斯匹林。

examples.text: On the tablet are the Roman numerals for July 4, 1776.
examples.translationZh: 匾上的罗马数字写着1776年七月四日。

meaningZh: 女演员；女表演者

examples.text: The actress received numerous floral tributes.
examples.translationZh: 那位女演员接受了许多献花。

examples.text: Her success as an actress was now assured.
examples.translationZh: 她当演员很成功，已毋庸置疑了。

examples.text: She has romantic notions about becoming a famous actress.
examples.translationZh: 她心里充满幻想，总希望有一天会成为著名演员。

meaningZh: 原谅；为…申辩；免除，宽免

examples.text: Excuse me, but I must say you are completely wrong.
examples.translationZh: 对不起，但是我必须说你完全错了。

examples.text: I hope you will excuse me if I have to leave early.
examples.translationZh: 如果我必须早些离开,希望你能原谅我。

examples.text: He told a real whopper to excuse his lateness.
examples.translationZh: 他撒了个大谎为自己的迟到辩解。

meaningZh: 份额；许多；命运

examples.text: It takes a lot of labor to build a railway.
examples.translationZh: 修筑一条铁路要花费许多劳动力。

examples.text: She had a lot of problems to contend with.
examples.translationZh: 她有许多问题要解决。

examples.text: The flood did a lot of damage to the crops.
examples.translationZh: 洪水毁坏了大量农作物。

meaningZh: 梨（树）；梨树

examples.text: This pear is rotten at the core.
examples.translationZh: 这个梨子的果心腐烂了。

examples.text: Would you like a pear?
examples.translationZh: 想吃梨吗？

examples.text: This salad is made of apple, pear, potato and celery.
examples.translationZh: 这份色拉是由苹果、梨、土豆和芹菜做成的。

meaningZh: 战争；战争期间；斗争

examples.text: The hope of a short war went glimmering.
examples.translationZh: 战争无望在短期内结束。

examples.text: A series of provocations led up to the border war.
examples.translationZh: 一系列的挑衅事件导致了边境战争的发生。

examples.text: The army was disbanded when the war came to an end.
examples.translationZh: 战争结束时，军队即被解散。

meaningZh: 分布广的；普遍的；广泛应用

examples.text: The high cost prohibits the widespread use of the drug.
examples.translationZh: 该药因价格昂贵而影响其被广泛应用。

examples.text: Widespread flooding is affecting large areas of Devon.
examples.translationZh: 洪水泛滥，淹没了德文郡的广大地区。

examples.text: The Government acted quickly to relieve the widespread distress caused by the earthquake.
examples.translationZh: 地震造成大范围的灾难,政府迅速采取行动赈济灾民。

meaningZh: 鸟，禽；少女，姑娘，人，家伙，东西；飞机，火箭，导弹

examples.text: That bird tried to peck me.
examples.translationZh: 那只鸟想啄我。

examples.text: The penguin is a flightless bird.
examples.translationZh: 企鹅是一种不会飞的鸟。

examples.text: Better be a bird in the wood than one in the cage.
examples.translationZh: 宁为林中鸟,不作笼中禽。

meaningZh: 困难的；难做的；难解的

examples.text: The quest for gold was difficult.
examples.translationZh: 寻找金矿是很困难的。

examples.text: The child is going through a difficult phase.
examples.translationZh: 那孩子正经历困难的阶段。

examples.text: She handled a difficult argument skilfully.
examples.translationZh: 她巧妙地应付了一场艰难的辩论。

meaningZh: 现在；其时；立刻

examples.text: It is now possible to put a man on the moon.
examples.translationZh: 目前已能将人送到月球上。

examples.text: He is writing a letter now.
examples.translationZh: 他现在正在写信。

examples.text: Now you see I am telling you the truth.
examples.translationZh: 现在你明白我对你讲的是真话了。

meaningZh: 技术（性）的，工艺的，学术（上）的，专门（技术）的，艺术的；[法]根据法律的，法律上的；[商]人造的，用工业方法制造的，由市场内部因素（如投机等）引起的

examples.text: On technical matters, I defer to the experts.
examples.translationZh: 在技术问题上，我遵从专家的意见。

examples.text: The flight was delayed owing to technical reasons.
examples.translationZh: 这次飞行由于技术的原因而被推迟。

examples.text: This book is too technical for me.
examples.translationZh: 对我来说，这本书太专业了。

meaningZh: 频道，波道；渠道；途径

examples.text: This channel comes on the air every morning at 7 am.
examples.translationZh: 这个频道每天早晨7点钟开始播放。

examples.text: The ship went through the English Channel fast.
examples.translationZh: 那条船很快的通过了英吉利海峡。

examples.text: She was seeking a channel for her creative energies.
examples.translationZh: 她正在为她创造性的能量寻找方法。

meaningZh: 试探性的；试验的；尝试性的

examples.text: He still held a tentative relationship with Mary.
examples.translationZh: 他还和玛丽保持着若即若离的关系。

examples.text: Could we make a tentative appointment for Friday?
examples.translationZh: 我们能暂时先约在星期五吗?

examples.text: We've drawn up a tentative program for the next two weeks.
examples.translationZh: 我们制定了一个之后两个星期的试探性计划。

meaningZh: 辩护；保卫；（足球、曲棍球等）防守

examples.text: Some players are better at defending.
examples.translationZh: 有些运动员较擅长打防卫。

examples.text: The union said that they would take action to defend their member's jobs.
examples.translationZh: 工会说他们将采取行动维护会员的工作权益。

examples.text: He was afraid of being attacked by Liu Bei and Sun Quan, so he sent a troop to defend Jingzhou.
examples.translationZh: 他害怕刘备和孙权继续向他进攻,派人在荆州防守。

meaningZh: 连接；联结；加入

examples.text: The island is joined to the mainland by a bridge.
examples.translationZh: 岛上有座桥与大陆相连。

examples.text: The two estates join at the foot of the hill.
examples.translationZh: 这两处房地产在山脚下相毗连。

examples.text: If you join the club, you must abide by its rules.
examples.translationZh: 你参加这个俱乐部就得遵守其规章。

meaningZh: 黑板

examples.text: Who's rubbed my figures off the blackboard?
examples.translationZh: 谁把我写在黑板上的数字擦掉了?

examples.text: The blackboard is in the front of the classroom.
examples.translationZh: 黑板在教室的前面。

examples.text: Please raise your head and look at the blackboard.
examples.translationZh: 请抬起头来，看黑板。

meaningZh: 持续；逗留；维持原状

examples.text: He is to continue as manager.
examples.translationZh: 他要继续当经理。

examples.text: They continued down until they came to some pockets of natural gas.
examples.translationZh: 他们继续往下钻，终於找到了一些天然气的气阱。

examples.text: She continued as mayor for a second term.
examples.translationZh: 她连任了一期市长

meaningZh: 地带；区域，范围；地区，时区

examples.text: They are pulling their troops out of the battle zone.
examples.translationZh: 他们正把部队调离战区。

examples.text: They have declared their country a, nuclear-free zone.
examples.translationZh: 他们宣布本国为无核区。

examples.text: Most of China is in the temperate zone.
examples.translationZh: 中国的大部分地区在温带。

meaningZh: 南极的

examples.text: Oh, I have got another cable to send to Antarctic.
examples.translationZh: 哦，我还要发一份去南极的电报。

examples.text: Antarctic exploration begins with Ptolemy.
examples.translationZh: 南极的探险是由普特利姆首先进行的。

examples.text: Antarctic Peninsula has the most moderate climate.
examples.translationZh: 南极洲半岛气候最温和。

meaningZh: 男性的；雄性的；有力的

examples.text: The male voice is deeper than the female.
examples.translationZh: 男性的嗓音比女性的低沉。

examples.text: We need some male subjects for a psychology experiment.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要几个男子作心理学实验对象。

examples.text: In early days only male athletes were allowed to take part in the Olympic Games.
examples.translationZh: 在奥林匹克运动会早期，只有男性运动员才能参加比赛。

meaningZh: 穿过；横穿，横过；与…交叉

examples.text: Can you swim across the river?
examples.translationZh: 你能游到河的对岸吗？

examples.text: The drunk man staggered across the room.
examples.translationZh: 那个醉汉摇摇晃晃地穿过房间。

examples.text: Edgar looked in anger across at Miriam.
examples.translationZh: 埃德加气鼓鼓地看着对面的米丽安。

meaningZh: 拍摄；射击；发芽

examples.text: This is just a toy gun; it doesn't shoot.
examples.translationZh: 这只是玩具枪, 不能发射子弹。

examples.text: He shot the bird with his gun.
examples.translationZh: 他用枪打鸟。

examples.text: The sports car shot past us.
examples.translationZh: 赛车从我们前面飞驰而过。

meaningZh: 喂养；满足（欲望等）；向…提供

examples.text: Will you feed my cat for me?
examples.translationZh: 请帮我喂我的猫好吗？

examples.text: What do you feed the poultry on?
examples.translationZh: 你们用什么饲料喂养家禽?

examples.text: They feed on plankton, the sea's drifting life.
examples.translationZh: 它们吃以浮游生物为生。

meaningZh: 宽阔的；广泛的；概括的

examples.text: The broad steps in front of the mansion made it look very dignified.
examples.translationZh: 宽阔的台阶使大厦的正面显得很气派。

examples.text: The picture is small but it shows broad vistas.
examples.translationZh: 画幅虽然不大,所表现的天地却十分广阔。

examples.text: The Minister gave a broad hint that she intends to raise taxes.
examples.translationZh: 首相明白地暗示她打算提高税额.

meaningZh: 没有人，没有一人；没有一个；没有一部分，没有一点

examples.text: None could produce a simple, tidy answer.
examples.translationZh: 没有人能提出一个简单而又令人满意的答案。

examples.text: None of us like to go skate in winter.
examples.translationZh: 我们之中没有人愿意在冬天去滑冰。

examples.text: None of them dares even mutter dissent.
examples.translationZh: 没有人敢说半个不字。

meaningZh: 面容；表面；脸

examples.text: A cut diamond has many faces.
examples.translationZh: 经切割的钻石有很多晶面。

examples.text: They disappeared from the face of the earth.
examples.translationZh: 他们从地面上消失了。

examples.text: The clowns pulled funny faces.
examples.translationZh: 小丑扮出了可笑的鬼脸。

meaningZh: 早已，已经；先前

examples.text: I've already paid my membership dues.
examples.translationZh: 我已经交了我的会员费。

examples.text: The new rules have already come into play.
examples.translationZh: 新规则已经开始生效。

examples.text: You had already gone when I arrived there.
examples.translationZh: 当我到达时，你已经走了。

meaningZh: 和，跟；随着；关于

examples.text: They muffled up her head with a blanket.
examples.translationZh: 他们用毯子蒙住了她的头。

examples.text: The risk of severe illnesses increases with age.
examples.translationZh: 患重病的风险随着年龄的增加而增加。

examples.text: The week cost us over 500 but that was with skiing lessons.
examples.translationZh: 这一周花了500多英镑，但其中包括滑雪课的学费。

meaningZh: 利益，好处；救济金，津贴；义演，义卖

examples.text: It was for the benefit of your company that we did that.
examples.translationZh: 我们这样做都是为了你们公司的利益。

examples.text: Applications for unemployment benefits dropped last month.
examples.translationZh: 上个月申请失业津贴的人数下降了。

examples.text: A benefit performance will be held tonight.
examples.translationZh: 今晚有义演。

meaningZh: 海岸；滑坡；vi. （汽车或自行车）（尤指不用动力向山坡下）滑行

examples.text: Spray slaps the coast ceaselessly.
examples.translationZh: 海浪不停地拍打着海岸。

examples.text: Fishing boats were anchored all along the coast.
examples.translationZh: 渔船沿着岸抛锚停泊。

examples.text: He is going to live by the coast for the sake of his health.
examples.translationZh: 他为了自己的健康，打算到海滨地区去居住。

meaningZh: 国际互联网，因特网

examples.text: Internet plays a very important role in modern life.
examples.translationZh: 互联网在现代生活中发挥非常重要的作用。

examples.text: My brother doesn't know much about the Internet.
examples.translationZh: 我哥哥对因特网所知不多。

examples.text: The Internet has great attraction for young people.
examples.translationZh: 因特网对年轻人有很大的吸引力。

meaningZh: 工人，员工；劳动者；[虫]工蜂，工蚁

examples.text: The worker's overalls were badly burned by acid.
examples.translationZh: 这位工人的工作装被酸腐蚀得很厉害。

examples.text: The boss dispenses the sick worker from his duties.
examples.translationZh: 老板准许生病的工人不上班。

examples.text: She has been held up as a model worker.
examples.translationZh: 她被推举为模范工作者。

meaningZh: 醒，醒来；苏醒，复活；警觉

examples.text: I usually wake up early.
examples.translationZh: 我通常醒得很早。

examples.text: She spends all her waking hours worrying about her job.
examples.translationZh: 她只要醒著就一直为工作发愁。

examples.text: The incident woke memories of his past sufferings.
examples.translationZh: 这件事唤起了他对过去苦难经历的回忆。

meaningZh: 有耐性的；能容忍的；n. 患者

examples.text: You'll have to be patient with my mother she's going rather deaf.
examples.translationZh: 你对我母亲得有耐心，她的耳朵越来越背了。

examples.text: He is a patient man, but not even he could sit down under that kind of provocation.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个能忍耐的人，但就连他也没法忍受那种挑衅了。

examples.text: To have access to the good things of the world, one has to be patient and wait.
examples.translationZh: 对于世间美好的东西,忍耐与等待是不可缺少的。

meaningZh: 手稿，原稿

examples.text: The article, coming out anonymously, is fathered upon Ms Harper.
examples.translationZh: 匿名发表的那篇文章被认为是哈珀女士所写。

examples.text: Since the [welfare] checks stopped, Ms. Robinson has been evicted from an apartment, found a boy-friend and fallen out with him, and wound up in a shelter for the homeless.
examples.translationZh: 自从[社会福利]支票停止以后，鲁宾逊小姐从公寓被迫迁出来，找到一个男友，跟他闹翻了，最后到了无家可归者的收容所里。

examples.text: Ms X has been named for the directorship/named as the new director.
examples.translationZh: 某女士已被提名任董事职务[任命为新董事]。

meaningZh: 旅行，航海，航空；远行；旅程

examples.text: This is the virgin voyage of the ship.
examples.translationZh: 这是这艘船的处女航。

examples.text: The ship hit heavy fog on its voyage.
examples.translationZh: 船在航行时碰上了大雾。

examples.text: She went on a long sea voyage.
examples.translationZh: 她乘船在海上长途旅行。

meaningZh: 大街，街道

examples.text: I met him in the street.
examples.translationZh: 我在街上遇到他。

examples.text: He stood in a strange street.
examples.translationZh: 他站在一条陌生的街道上。

examples.text: This street is four times shorter than that one.
examples.translationZh: 这条街道比那条短四倍。

meaningZh: （使）下决心，（使）做出决定；vt. 决定，确定；判定，判决

examples.text: Chance will determine the outcome.
examples.translationZh: 机缘将决定结果

examples.text: I must now determine whether to meet him or not.
examples.translationZh: 我现在必须决定是否要见他。

examples.text: I am determined to find out the rights and wrongs of this matter.
examples.translationZh: 我决心查明这件事的真相。

meaningZh: 中心；（市镇的）中心区；中心点

examples.text: That new shopping centre is a real eyesore.
examples.translationZh: 那个新的购物中心真是难看极了。

examples.text: The new library was built in the centre of the campus.
examples.translationZh: 新图书馆建在校园的中心。

examples.text: Children like to be the centre of attention.
examples.translationZh: 儿童喜欢引人注意.

meaningZh: 瞬间，顷刻；此刻；当月

examples.text: I shall be back in an instant.
examples.translationZh: 我马上就回来。

examples.text: Just for an instant I thought he was going to refuse.
examples.translationZh: 我脑中有一闪念，以为他要拒绝了。

examples.text: I recognized her the instant I saw her.
examples.translationZh: 我一眼就认出是她。

meaningZh: 必须；必然要；（做出逻辑推断）

examples.text: Something must be done about it.
examples.translationZh: 必须得想个办法。

examples.text: In England traffic must keep to the left.
examples.translationZh: 在英国，车辆必须靠左行驶。

examples.text: We must make allowance for his youth.
examples.translationZh: 我们应当考虑到他还年轻。

meaningZh: 鹦鹉；应声虫，学舌者；机械模仿别人的人

examples.text: The boy had a parrot on his right shoulder.
examples.translationZh: 男孩把一只鹦鹉放在右肩上。

examples.text: He talks like a parrot and just repeats what he heard.
examples.translationZh: 他只是鹦鹉学舌，拾人牙慧罢了。

examples.text: My little brother is also my parrot, always doing everything I do.
examples.translationZh: 我的小弟弟也是我的模仿者，我做什么他也做什么。

meaningZh: 照片，相片；vt.& vi. 为…拍照；拍照，摄影

examples.text: I planned to enlarge this photograph.
examples.translationZh: 我计划放大这张照片。

examples.text: This photograph flatters you.
examples.translationZh: 这照片比你本人漂亮。

examples.text: I always photograph badly.
examples.translationZh: 我照相总是照不好。

meaningZh: 围栏；轨道，钢轨；扶手

examples.text: A towel hung from the rail.
examples.translationZh: 栏杆上搭著条毛巾。

examples.text: We installed a stainless steel towel rail on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 我们在墙上装了一个不锈钢的挂毛巾的横杆。

examples.text: Nobody believes that he can jump over that rail.
examples.translationZh: 没人相信他能越过那个栏杆。

meaningZh: 粗糙的，崎岖不平的；粗鲁的；狂暴的，汹涌的

examples.text: The rough road made the car vibrate.
examples.translationZh: 崎岖不平的道路使车颠簸得很厉害。

examples.text: You'd better give us a rough idea of your price.
examples.translationZh: 您最好给我们一个粗略的价格。

examples.text: It is only a rough guide to ideal weight.
examples.translationZh: 这只是一个实现理想体重的粗略的办法。

meaningZh: 标题，说明文字，字幕；字幕；第三档

examples.text: There is a caption under the picture.
examples.translationZh: 图片下边附有说明。

examples.text: The Vatican said it wanted the caption removed.
examples.translationZh: 梵蒂冈说，它希望撤掉这段文字。

meaningZh: 开关；转换，转换器；软鞭子

examples.text: How do I switch to the next major release branch?
examples.translationZh: 如何转换为下个主要发布版本分支？

examples.text: The current will switch over after I push this button.
examples.translationZh: 我按下这个按钮之后，电流会被转换。

examples.text: I wish to turn on the light, where is the switch?
examples.translationZh: 我想要开亮那一支电灯,请问开关在哪儿?

meaningZh: 参考；参考书；提及，涉及

examples.text: This book is for reference only.
examples.translationZh: 这本书仅供参考。

examples.text: This frame of reference will be determined by the limitations on the rational man's knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 这个参照系统决定于理性人知识的限制。

examples.text: Full reference citations are available on the readings page.
examples.translationZh: 全部参考资料的出处可以在阅读资料那页找到。

meaningZh: 女服务员；女侍者；vi. 做女服务员

examples.text: The waitress received a handsome tip.
examples.translationZh: 女侍者收到了数量可观的小费。

examples.text: A waitress came in, carrying tea on a tray.
examples.translationZh: 一名女侍者走进来，手端放着茶的托盘。

examples.text: A waitress put a glass of water in front of him.
examples.translationZh: 一名女服务员迎上来在他面前放了一杯水。

meaningZh: 新闻；消息；（可当作新闻内容的）人

examples.text: Have you read the news about the election?
examples.translationZh: 你看了关于选举的新闻了吗？

examples.text: She tapped out a news story on the typewriter.
examples.translationZh: 她用打字机打出一篇新闻报道。

examples.text: I heard it on the 7 o'clock news.
examples.translationZh: 我在七点钟的新闻报道中听到了这则消息。

meaningZh: 超过；越过；那一边

examples.text: The level of inflation has gone beyond 8%.
examples.translationZh: 通货膨胀率已经超过了8%。

examples.text: Such philosophical subtleties are beyond my reach.
examples.translationZh: 这种深奥的哲理我可无法理解。

examples.text: The scenery there was beautiful beyond expression.
examples.translationZh: 那儿的风景美丽得无法形容。

meaningZh: 焦急的；渴望的；令人焦虑的

examples.text: The whole country was anxious for peace.
examples.translationZh: 全国上下都渴望和平。

examples.text: I am anxious to compare my fancy with reality.
examples.translationZh: 我焦切地把我的想象同现实作一番比较。

examples.text: Small businesses are anxious to experiment with computers.
examples.translationZh: 小型企业都急于试用计算机。

meaningZh: 彩虹；adj. 五彩缤纷的；彩虹状的

examples.text: Do you see rainbow?
examples.translationZh: 你看到彩虹了吗？

examples.text: A rainbow is usually seen after a heavy rain.
examples.translationZh: 大雨之后常有彩虹。

examples.text: Now we can bask in the rainbow of the memories that we'll nurture in the years ahead.
examples.translationZh: 在未来岁月里，让我们在记忆的长虹里永远珍藏对他的怀念。

meaningZh: 橡皮擦，板擦

examples.text: The eraser is in the pencil-box.
examples.translationZh: 橡皮擦在文具盒里面。

examples.text: Life is to paint without an eraser.
examples.translationZh: 生命是绘一幅画，手中却无橡皮擦。

meaningZh: 运气好的，侥幸的；兆头好的，吉祥的；〈俚〉难得

examples.text: You lucky blighter!
examples.translationZh: 你这幸运的家伙！

examples.text: He is really a lucky dog.
examples.translationZh: 他真是个幸运的家伙。

examples.text: You are lucky to be alive after being in that accident.
examples.translationZh: 你真幸运，经过那场车祸还能生还。

meaningZh: 蔬菜水果商，菜贩

examples.text: The greengrocer unloaded the potatoes from the van.
examples.translationZh: 蔬菜水果商把土豆从车上卸下来。

examples.text: His father intended to set him up as a greengrocer.
examples.translationZh: 他的父亲打算让他做个蔬菜水果商。

examples.text: We are at the greengrocer's now.
examples.translationZh: 我们现在到菜店了。

meaningZh: 星；星状物；星级

examples.text: A lonely star shone out against the black sky.
examples.translationZh: 一颗孤星在黑色的夜空中闪闪发亮。

examples.text: This star is not visible to the naked eye.
examples.translationZh: 这颗星肉眼看不见。

examples.text: The opera star wanted in her later years.
examples.translationZh: 那位歌剧明星晚年生活困苦。

meaningZh: 剑，刀；武力，战争；兵权，权力

examples.text: He drove at her with his sword.
examples.translationZh: 他用剑猛攻击她。

examples.text: He is slashing wildly at his opponent with a sword.
examples.translationZh: 他正用剑疯狂地朝对手乱砍。

examples.text: The officer belted his sword on.
examples.translationZh: 军官用皮带扣住佩刀。

meaningZh: 发展；生长；形成

examples.text: Modern music was first developed in Italy.
examples.translationZh: 现代音乐最初是在意大利发展起来的。

examples.text: China can't develop in isolation from the rest of the world.
examples.translationZh: 中国的发展离不开世界。

examples.text: Plants develop from seeds, but many animals developed from eggs.
examples.translationZh: 植物由种子发育而成,而许多动物由卵子发育而来。

meaningZh: 娱乐；游戏；文娱活动

examples.text: I find amusement in collecting stamps.
examples.translationZh: 我发现了集邮的乐趣。

examples.text: He is responsible for the amusement activity.
examples.translationZh: 他负责娱乐活动。

examples.text: His chief amusement is reading novels.
examples.translationZh: 他的主要消遣是看小说。

meaningZh: 数字；数量；号码

examples.text: He picked a winning number on the first draw.
examples.translationZh: 他第一次便抽到一个中奖号码。

examples.text: I slipped up and gave you the wrong phone number.
examples.translationZh: 我粗心大意给错了你电话号码。

examples.text: The number of fish in coastal waters has decreased.
examples.translationZh: 沿海鱼的数量已减少了。

meaningZh: 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的

examples.text: Listen to the Sound From Underground.
examples.translationZh: 听听地下的声音。

examples.text: Underground water that is held in the soil and in pervious rocks.
examples.translationZh: 土壤和能渗透的岩石中含有的地下的水。

examples.text: He is well known for his reports on underground crime and gangs.
examples.translationZh: 他因为关于报道秘密的犯罪和帮派而出名。

meaningZh: （尤指外语）流利，流畅

examples.text: He speaks English and French with equal fluency.
examples.translationZh: 他说英语和法语同样流利。

examples.text: Fluency in spoken English is a major requirement.
examples.translationZh: 主要条件为英语口语流利。

examples.text: He speaks English with great fluency.
examples.translationZh: 他的英语说得非常流畅。

meaningZh: 部分；节；部件

examples.text: White lines divide the playing area into sections.
examples.translationZh: 这些白线把赛区分成各个部分。

examples.text: I hope someone competent will join our section.
examples.translationZh: 我希望有能力的人加入本部门。

examples.text: The report has a section on accidents at work.
examples.translationZh: 报告中有一段谈到工作中的事故问题。

meaningZh: 平常的；平均的；典型的

examples.text: The average of 4,6 and 8 is 6.
examples.translationZh: 4,6, 8的平均数是6。

examples.text: Temperatures are below average for the time of year.
examples.translationZh: 温度低于此时的年平均温度。

examples.text: The average age of the boys in this class is fifteen.
examples.translationZh: 本班男生的平均年龄是十五岁。

meaningZh: vt. & vi. 连接,联系；环;联系,纽带

examples.text: Television stations around the world are linked by satellite.
examples.translationZh: 全世界的电视台通过卫星联系一起。

examples.text: The road links all the new towns.
examples.translationZh: 这条路把所有的新城镇都连接起来了。

examples.text: He detached a link from a chain.
examples.translationZh: 他从链子上拆下一个链环。

meaningZh: 外科医生；[军]军医

examples.text: The surgeon has performed the operation.
examples.translationZh: 外科医生做了手术。

examples.text: The surgeon operated on her for appendicitis.
examples.translationZh: 外科医生为她做阑尾切除手术。

examples.text: The surgeon asked him if he felt nervous.
examples.translationZh: 外科医生问他是否感到紧张。

meaningZh: 革命；彻底改变；旋转

examples.text: Most countries have had revolutions aganist the government.
examples.translationZh: 大多数国家发生过反对政府的革命。

examples.text: The industrial revolution had taken place in England first.
examples.translationZh: 工业革命首先在英国发生。

examples.text: Those people go around preaching revolution.
examples.translationZh: 那些人到处宣扬革命。

meaningZh: 修订，修改；修订本；校对

examples.text: A revision of that dictionary has been published.
examples.translationZh: 那本词典的修订本已经出版。

examples.text: The catalogue is under revision.
examples.translationZh: 目录正在修订之中。

examples.text: She matured her novel by constant revision.
examples.translationZh: 她不断修改自己的小说以使其趋于完善。

meaningZh: 协力；配合；联合作业

examples.text: They showed ever exceptionally good teamwork.
examples.translationZh: 他们配合得非常之好。

examples.text: Only teamwork will enable us to get the job done on time.
examples.translationZh: 只有团结一致,我们才能按时完成这项工作。

examples.text: In football teamwork is even more important than individual skill.
examples.translationZh: 在橄榄球比赛中，全队的配合比个人技术甚至更加重要。

meaningZh: [U]苹果

examples.text: My uncle has an apple orchard.
examples.translationZh: 我叔叔拥有一个苹果园。

examples.text: The apple trees are blossoming.
examples.translationZh: 苹果树正在开花。

examples.text: He regard his new bike as the apple of his eye.
examples.translationZh: 他把他的新自行车视为珍宝。

meaningZh: 车站；所，局；身份

examples.text: Don't forget to drop by at the gas station.
examples.translationZh: 别忘了到煤气站去看看。

examples.text: He was walking up and down the station platform.
examples.translationZh: 他在火车站的月台上走来走去。

examples.text: Can you tell me the way to the railway station?
examples.translationZh: 你能告诉我往火车站的路怎么走吗？

meaningZh: 有天赋的；有才华的

examples.text: He is gifted for art.
examples.translationZh: 他有艺术天赋。

examples.text: Man is the only creature that is gifted with speech.
examples.translationZh: 人类是唯一被赋予语言能力的动物。

examples.text: Martin Gatt is a gifted bassoonist.
examples.translationZh: 马丁盖特是个有才华的巴人松管演奏者。

meaningZh: 死亡，熄灭；凋零，枯萎；渴望，盼望

examples.text: Nowadays many people die of cancer.
examples.translationZh: 现在有很多人死于癌症。

examples.text: Many people die from famine in Africa.
examples.translationZh: 在非洲许多人死于饥荒。

examples.text: My grandfather died at the age of 86.
examples.translationZh: 我爷爷在86岁时去世了。

meaningZh: 产量；输出；作品

examples.text: Output has tripled.
examples.translationZh: 产量已增加到三倍。

examples.text: This country ranks last in industrial output.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家的工业生产排名最後。

examples.text: The average output of the factory is 20 cars a day.
examples.translationZh: 该工厂的平均产量是每天20辆汽车。

meaningZh: 红色的；（脸）涨红的；烧红的

examples.text: I received a bunch of red roses on my birthday.
examples.translationZh: 生日那天，我收到一束红玫瑰。

examples.text: The dying fire was throwing out a dull red light.
examples.translationZh: 将要熄灭的火发出暗红色的光。

examples.text: Red squirrels are now very rare in Britain.
examples.translationZh: 红色的松鼠在英国已十分罕见了。

meaningZh: 自治的；有自主权的；[生，植]自发的

examples.text: Each of the U.S. states has an autonomous government.
examples.translationZh: 美国的每个州都有一个自治政府。

examples.text: The former Soviet Union is formed of several autonomous republic.
examples.translationZh: 前苏联是由数个自治共和国组成的。

meaningZh: 猪；猪肉；令人不快（或讨厌）的人

examples.text: A pig is a domestic animal.
examples.translationZh: 猪是一种家畜。

examples.text: The farmer keeps hundreds of pigs on his farm.
examples.translationZh: 那个农场主在他的农场里养了几百头猪。

examples.text: The snout of the pig you drew on the picture is too long.
