examples.translationZh: 这幅画上你画的猪鼻子太长了。

meaningZh: 替换；代替；把…放回原位

examples.text: Nothing can replace a mother's love.
examples.translationZh: 什么都无法取代母爱。

examples.text: We've replaced the old adding machine with a computer.
examples.translationZh: 我们用电脑取代了老式的加法计算器。

examples.text: The coach decided to replace player No. 8 with No. 3.
examples.translationZh: 教练决定让3号替换8号。

meaningZh: 主管，主任；董事，理事；负责人，监督者

examples.text: The board nominated him as the new director.
examples.translationZh: 董事会指定他为新董事。

examples.text: Her career culminated in her appointment as director.
examples.translationZh: 她一生事业的顶峰是当上董事。

examples.text: I wouldn't advise you to go against the director.
examples.translationZh: 我反对你和经理对着干。

meaningZh: 古代的，已往的；古老的，过时的；年老的

examples.text: This is an ancient parable.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个古老的寓言。

examples.text: It's an ancient tale which appears in various guises in several languages.
examples.translationZh: 那是一个以几种语言叙述的古老的故事。

examples.text: Soldiers in ancient time used escutcheon to fight.
examples.translationZh: 古代的士兵用饰有花纹的盾作战。

meaningZh: 演说，演讲，发言；说话，谈话，说话能力或方式；（乐器的）音，音色

examples.text: The mayor made a speech at the opening.
examples.translationZh: 市长在开幕式上发表了演说。

examples.text: The speaker will soon wind up his speech.
examples.translationZh: 演说者就要结束他的讲话了。

examples.text: I had to give a speech to the press club.
examples.translationZh: 我得向记者俱乐部发表演说。

meaningZh: 挑选，挑拣；挖，采，摘，剔，扒；挑剔

examples.text: That sentimental girl likes to pick up the fallen petals on the ground in autumn.
examples.translationZh: 那个多愁善感的女孩喜欢在秋天里拾起地上的落英。

examples.text: He picked the watch up from the carpet.
examples.translationZh: 他从地毯上把表捡起来。

examples.text: We had to find a flat in a hurry--there was no time to pick and choose.
examples.translationZh: 我们只好匆忙找套房子--没有时间挑选了.

meaningZh: 明亮的；美好的；闪耀的

examples.text: He has got brilliant achievements in the field of physics.
examples.translationZh: 他在物理学方面已经取得了卓越的成就。

examples.text: The brilliant sun lit up their rooms.
examples.translationZh: 灿烂的阳光照亮了他们的屋子。

examples.text: Memory is like a living book whose brilliant fragments worth reading a hundred times in my life.
examples.translationZh: 回忆就像是一本生动的书,生活中那些精彩的片段令我百读不厌。

meaningZh: 结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合

examples.text: The news of their marriage knocked me for a loop.
examples.translationZh: 他们结婚的消息使我大吃一惊。

examples.text: It was a pleasant surprise to learn of her marriage.
examples.translationZh: 得知她结婚是件令人惊喜的事。

examples.text: Marriage is an institution in most societies.
examples.translationZh: 婚姻是大多数社会早已确立的制度。

meaningZh: [机]动力，功率；力量；政权，权力

examples.text: A man should rely upon his own power.
examples.translationZh: 人类应该依靠自身的力量。

examples.text: Such things aren't within the compass of my power.
examples.translationZh: 这些事不在我力可能及的范围之内。

examples.text: I intend to release my karma to give power away.
examples.translationZh: 我意愿释放我送给别人力量的业力。

meaningZh: 拉链；精力，活力；尖啸声

examples.text: She caught her hair in the zip of the dress.
examples.translationZh: 她的头发被裙子的拉链钩住了。

examples.text: The zip sticked because it was caught by a thread.
examples.translationZh: 拉链被线卡住了, 拉不动。

examples.text: We need to put some zip into this presentation.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要为这次演出注人一些活力。

meaningZh: 球，球状物；地球，世界；天体

examples.text: Magellan was the first person to circumnavigate the globe.
examples.translationZh: 麦哲伦是第一个环球航行的人。

examples.text: This plant can grow in many parts of the globe.
examples.translationZh: 这种植物能在地球上许多地方生长。

examples.text: A terrestrial globe is one that represents the earth.
examples.translationZh: 地球仪是表现地球的器具。

meaningZh: 提到；针对；关系到

examples.text: We referred the proposal to the board of directors.
examples.translationZh: 我们把这一建议提交董事会处理。

examples.text: You should refer this matter to the head office for a decision.
examples.translationZh: 你应当把这事提交总部去决定。

examples.text: He referred all his troubles to bad luck.
examples.translationZh: 他将他的一切麻烦都归因于运气不好。

meaningZh: 泥，泥淖；没价值的东西，污物；咖啡

examples.text: My car's stuck in the mud, and it won't budge.
examples.translationZh: 我的车陷入泥中，一动也不动。

examples.text: He removed the mud from his shoes.
examples.translationZh: 他去掉鞋上的泥。

examples.text: As the bus passed, it spattered mud on my clothes.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车开过时溅了我一身泥。

meaningZh: 影响；效果；印象

examples.text: The aspirins soon took effect.
examples.translationZh: 服下的阿司匹林药片很快见效了。

examples.text: The advertising campaign didn't have much effect on sales.
examples.translationZh: 这些广告攻势对销售额并没有起到多大作用。

examples.text: What is certain is that every effect must have a cause.
examples.translationZh: 每一个结果都有一个原因，这是确定无疑的

meaningZh: 马甲；防护衣；内衣

examples.text: One button on the vest is loose.
examples.translationZh: 背心上的一粒鈕扣松了。

examples.text: Jimmy is wearing a vest under a coat.
examples.translationZh: 吉米在外套里面穿着一件背心。

examples.text: Then I became aware of his hand drifting lower and suddenly I was wide awake as he stroked my neck and started sliding his hand down my vest top.
examples.translationZh: 接着我意识到他的手向下滑去，当他抚摸着我的脖子并开始将手滑向我的内衣时，我猛地清醒起来。

meaningZh: 领导；引导；指挥

examples.text: She led the way downstairs for us.
examples.translationZh: 她引着我们下楼。

examples.text: Our football team leads them by two goals.
examples.translationZh: 我们的足球队比他们领先两分。

examples.text: It's up to you to lead us through the difficulties.
examples.translationZh: 就靠你来带领我们度过难关了。

meaningZh: 区分，辨别，分清；辨别是非；vt. 区分，辨别，分清

examples.text: Speeches distinguish human beings from animals.
examples.translationZh: 人类和动物的区别在于人会说话。

examples.text: It's important to distinguish fact from fiction.
examples.translationZh: 把现实与虚构区分开来是很重要的。

examples.text: The twins were so much alike that it was impossible to distinguish one from the other.
examples.translationZh: 这对孪生子像得使人无法分辨。

meaningZh: 租金；地租；（意见等的）分裂，分歧

examples.text: The rent is due at the end of each quarter.
examples.translationZh: 缴纳租金以每季度末为期限。

examples.text: They let the house to me at a rent of 100 dollars a month.
examples.translationZh: 他们把房子租给我，每月租金一百美元。

examples.text: I rent a room from her.
examples.translationZh: 我向她租了一个房间。

meaningZh: 杀死…；vt. 使停止[结束，失败]；破坏，减弱，抵消

examples.text: His wife was killed in a car accident.
examples.translationZh: 他的妻子在车祸中丧生。

examples.text: They fumigated the room to kill the vermin.
examples.translationZh: 他们用烟熏房间以杀死害虫。

examples.text: The noise killed the music.
examples.translationZh: 噪音淹没了音乐。

meaningZh: 购买，购得；n. 交易，买卖；便宜货

examples.text: Money can't buy happiness.
examples.translationZh: 金钱买不来幸福。

examples.text: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.translationZh: 我请他喝酒以酬谢他的帮助。

examples.text: I'd like to buy a strong household bleach.
examples.translationZh: 我想买强力家用漂白剂。

meaningZh: 伤痕；精神上的创伤；有损外观的地方

examples.text: He has a scar running across his left cheek.
examples.translationZh: 他左脸上有一道很长的疤痕。

examples.text: The scar flawed her beauty.
examples.translationZh: 这伤疤损害了她的美貌。

examples.text: The cut in her hand has healed completely, without leaving a scar.
examples.translationZh: 她手上的刀伤完全愈合了,没有留下一点伤痕。

meaningZh: 壮观的，豪华的；极好的或令人满意的；闪亮的

examples.text: Playing tabletennis is a splendid sport.
examples.translationZh: 打乒乓球是极好的运动。

examples.text: My kid sister has a splendid memory.
examples.translationZh: 我小妹记忆力极好。

examples.text: We won another splendid victory.
examples.translationZh: 我们又赢得了辉煌的胜利。

meaningZh: 观察；研究；vt. 遵守

examples.text: We have to observe carefully what's going on there.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须仔细观察那里的动静。

examples.text: He made a telescope through which he could observe the stars.
examples.translationZh: 他做了个望远镜,用其观察星座。

examples.text: All citizens should observe traffic rules.
examples.translationZh: 每位公民都应该遵守交通规则。

meaningZh: 死亡；（某种）死法，死亡方式；病危

examples.text: The seedling was frozen to death.
examples.translationZh: 幼苗被冻死了。

examples.text: The farm came to him on his father's death.
examples.translationZh: 他父亲死时把农场留给他了。

examples.text: The film ends with the death of the heroine.
examples.translationZh: 这部电影以女主角的死告终。

meaningZh: 法律的；合法的；法定的

examples.text: When his father died, his uncle became his legal custodian.
examples.translationZh: 他父亲死后,他叔叔成了他的法定监护人。

examples.text: She started out on her legal career in 1963.
examples.translationZh: 她于1963年干起了法律这一行。

examples.text: We will introduce legal safeguards against fraud.
examples.translationZh: 我们要采取法律保护措施，制止诈骗活动。

meaningZh: 角；[比喻]（考虑、问题的）角度；观点

examples.text: The rising sun is especially beautiful to look at from this angle.
examples.translationZh: 旭日从这个角度看起来特别美。

examples.text: Try looking at the affair from a different angle.
examples.translationZh: 试从不同的角度来看这件事。

examples.text: The two roads lie at an angle of about 45 degrees.
examples.translationZh: 这两条路交叉成45度角。

meaningZh: 同盟，联盟；协会，工会；联合，团结

examples.text: They had a sound basis of union.
examples.translationZh: 他们的结合有着坚实的基础。

examples.text: He was elected the leader of the union.
examples.translationZh: 他被选为工会的领导人。

examples.text: He has changed his stance on monetary union.
examples.translationZh: 他已经改变了对货币联盟的态度。

meaningZh: 阳光，日光；晴朗，晴天；太阳晒着的地方

examples.text: Dewdrops shine brightly in the sunshine.
examples.translationZh: 露珠在阳光下闪闪发光。

examples.text: I saw her basking in the sunshine.
examples.translationZh: 我看到她在阳光下晒太阳。

examples.text: The water soon evaporated in the sunshine.
examples.translationZh: 水在阳光下不久就蒸发了。

meaningZh: 作文，作曲；创作；构图，布置

examples.text: We examined the rock to find out its composition.
examples.translationZh: 我们检验了这一石块,想弄清它的构成成分。

examples.text: He played many of his compositions for me.
examples.translationZh: 他为我演奏了他的许多乐曲。

examples.text: `Swan Lake' is one of Tchaikovsky's best-known compositions.
examples.translationZh: 《天鹅湖》是柴可夫斯基最著名的作品之一。

meaningZh: 话；说话；谚语，格言

examples.text: As the saying goes the early bird catches the worm.
examples.translationZh: 谚语说，早起的鸟有食吃。

examples.text: We attributed this saying to Shakespeare.
examples.translationZh: 我们认为这句谚语出自莎士比亚之手。

examples.text: An old trader's saying warns to be wary of smiling Squibs.
examples.translationZh: 老生意人有句俗话，提醒你要当心满面堆笑的斯奎布人。

meaningZh: 假定，认为；承担；装出

examples.text: Let's assume it to be true.
examples.translationZh: 让我们假定这是真的。

examples.text: We assume his guilt.
examples.translationZh: 我们假定他是有罪的。

examples.text: They assumed their operational positions.
examples.translationZh: 他们设想了自己在实施中的作用。

meaningZh: 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属

examples.text: My feelings are in unison with yours.
examples.translationZh: 我的感情与你的感情是一致的。

examples.text: His problem is similar to yours.
examples.translationZh: 他的问题和你的相似。

examples.text: We must fit our plan in with yours.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须使我们的计划与你们的协调一致。

meaningZh: 回答，答复；反应；报复（行动）

examples.text: What a sage reply you gave!
examples.translationZh: 多聪明的回答啊！

examples.text: He gave me no chance to reply to his question.
examples.translationZh: 他没有给我回答他问题的机会。

examples.text: I'm rather hazy about how to reply.
examples.translationZh: 我不清楚如何回答。

meaningZh: 充满活力的；活泼的；充满趣味的

examples.text: He is an outgoing and lively person.
examples.translationZh: 他是个性格开朗而又活泼的人。

examples.text: She's a lively child and popular with everyone.
examples.translationZh: 她是个活泼的孩子，大家都喜欢她。

examples.text: Life on campus is friendly, safe and very lively.
examples.translationZh: 校园生活是友好的，安全的和十分活跃的。

meaningZh: 适应，改编

examples.text: Therefore, adaption and co-existence is one of culture implications in Li River.
examples.translationZh: 因此，适应和共存是漓江流域的文化底蕴之一。

examples.text: The novel lends itself to adaption as a film.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说适合改编为电影。

meaningZh: 塑料制品；〈口〉（使用）信用卡；整形

examples.text: Plastic is sometimes used instead of leather.
examples.translationZh: 塑胶有时可以替代皮革。

examples.text: Many items in daily use are made out of plastic.
examples.translationZh: 有很多日常生活用品是塑料制的。

examples.text: Consumers want to buy goods on the Internet using plastic.
examples.translationZh: 顾客想要在网上通过信用卡购物。

meaningZh: 野生的；野蛮的；狂热的

examples.text: In nature, all animals are wild and free.
examples.translationZh: 在自然界，一切动物都是野生的，自由自在的。

examples.text: North America has the world's best climate for wild grapes.
examples.translationZh: 北美的气候是世界上最适合野生葡萄生长的。

examples.text: I was living like a wild child.
examples.translationZh: 我的行为像个野蛮的孩子。

meaningZh: 失明的；盲目的，轻率的；供盲人用的

examples.text: Love is blind and sometimes deaf.
examples.translationZh: 爱情是盲目的,有时甚至是聋的。

examples.text: She wants it so much that she became so stupid and blind.
examples.translationZh: 她那么渴望,以致到了又笨又盲目的地步。

examples.text: There's none so blind as those who won't see.
examples.translationZh: 瞎子不算瞎,有眼不看才是瞎。

meaningZh: 贴上，系；附上；vt. （有时不受欢迎或未受邀请而）参加

examples.text: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
examples.translationZh: 我附上笔记一份供你参考。

examples.text: In confirmation hereof we attach a bank statement.
examples.translationZh: 为作这方面的确认我们附上银行结单。

examples.text: Please attach these labels to your hand luggages.
examples.translationZh: 请把这些标签系在您的手提行李上。

meaningZh: 轨道；势力范围；眼眶

examples.text: Hou Kou district fell into Japanese orbit before the outbreak of the second sino-Japan war.
examples.translationZh: 虹口区在抗日战争爆发前就已落入日本人手中。

examples.text: In the right orbit, an external ethmoidectomy was done, while in the left, a transnasal endoscopic approach was used to remove the inferomedial wall.
examples.translationZh: 两边皆以外侧眼眶切开术行外侧眼窝减压术合并内侧及部分眼窝底减压术。

examples.text: Conclusions For patients undergoing enophthalmos caused by a crepitant frature in orbit, it is the best way to perform an operation as early as possible.
examples.translationZh: 结论对于眼眶爆裂性骨折引起的眼球内陷可考虑早期手术，其效果优于晚期手术者。

meaningZh: 脑；智慧；聪明的人

examples.text: The drug may cause permanent brain damage.
examples.translationZh: 这种药可能会引起永久性的脑部伤害。

examples.text: His brain seems to be functioning normally.
examples.translationZh: 他的大脑看起来功能正常。

examples.text: His brain was clouded by vapours and dreams.
examples.translationZh: 他的脑子里充满空想和梦幻。

meaningZh: 四分之一；一刻钟；地区

examples.text: Only a quarter of the earth is land.
examples.translationZh: 仅仅地球的四分之一是陆地。

examples.text: It's a quarter past ten.
examples.translationZh: 现在是十点一刻。

examples.text: The flight was put off about a quarter, because of ground fog.
examples.translationZh: 由于地面有雾，这次班机推迟1 刻钟。

meaningZh: 特权；（因财富和社会地位而仅有部分人享有的）权益；免责特权

examples.text: I had the privilege of meeting the queen.
examples.translationZh: 我有会见王后的特权。

examples.text: It is a great privilege to know you.
examples.translationZh: 认识你是一件难得的事。

examples.text: It was a privilege to work with him.
examples.translationZh: 和他在一起工作是一项殊荣。

meaningZh: （使）摇摆；（使）摇荡；n. 摇摆，摆动

examples.text: The swing of the ship made many people seasick.
examples.translationZh: 船的摇摆使许多人晕船。

examples.text: The willow branches swing in the breeze.
examples.translationZh: 柳枝迎风摇摆。

examples.text: I used to swing, but then age and good taste overtook me.
examples.translationZh: 我原来喜欢赶时髦，后来随着年龄的增长和审美观的改变便不再那样了。

meaningZh: 不好的；恶意的；有病的

examples.text: There's one bad apple for every three good ones.
examples.translationZh: 每四个苹果里就有一个坏的。

examples.text: He was ill, but made out to be all right.
examples.translationZh: 他病了，但却装着没有病的样子。

examples.text: These nouns refer to the feeling or expression of deep-seated ill will.
examples.translationZh: 这些名词指根深蒂固的恶意的感情或表述。

meaningZh: （改变…以）适应，调整，校正；调准（望远镜等），对准，校正，校准（机械等）；核算（盈亏）

examples.text: Could you teach me how to adjust the iris of the camera?
examples.translationZh: 你能教我怎么调照相机的光圈吗？

examples.text: This kind of desk can be adjusted to the height you need.
examples.translationZh: 这种书桌的高低可以按照你的需要调节。

examples.text: He can't adjust himself to the whirl of modern life in this big city.
examples.translationZh: 他无法适应这个大都市的现代生活的忙碌。

meaningZh: 欺骗，诈骗；误导，愚弄；躲避，逃脱

examples.text: We were on our honor not to cheat the customers.
examples.translationZh: 我们以名誉担保不欺骗顾客。

examples.text: It is contemptible to cheat friends.
examples.translationZh: 欺骗朋友是卑劣的。

examples.text: They cheat the old woman of her house and money.
examples.translationZh: 他们骗取了老妇人的房屋和钱财。

meaningZh: 删除

examples.text: Delete his name from the list.
examples.translationZh: 把他的名字从名单上删去。

examples.text: The attack is to wipe out data, to delete flies, or to format the hard disk.
examples.translationZh: 常见的攻击方式是消除数据、删除文件或者格式化硬盘。

examples.text: Please delete my name from your list.
examples.translationZh: 请把我的名字从你的名单上删除。

meaningZh: 翻译；解释；转化

examples.text: I need to translate it into English.
examples.translationZh: 我必须把它译成英语。

examples.text: Be you plan to translate the novel?
examples.translationZh: 你计划翻译这部小说吗？

examples.text: I translate his silence as a protest.
examples.translationZh: 我把他的沉默解释为抗议。

meaningZh: 球；棒球（投手投出的）坏球；拇指球

examples.text: The cat made little rushes to and fro after the ball.
examples.translationZh: 猫追着球跑过来跑过去。

examples.text: She rolled the socks into a ball.
examples.translationZh: 她把袜子卷成一团。

examples.text: I cut up the meat for cooking meat balls.
examples.translationZh: 我把肉剁碎后做肉丸子。

meaningZh: 语法；语法书；（学术的）基本原理

examples.text: That is not, properly speaking, a dictionary but a grammar book.
examples.translationZh: 严格地说，那不是一本字典，而是一本语法书。

examples.text: I know nothing about Latin grammar.
examples.translationZh: 我一点都不懂拉丁语法。

examples.text: Why care for grammar as long as we are good?
examples.translationZh: 只要我们没有错，为什么要关心文法?

meaningZh: 诊所，门诊部；特殊病例分析；临床讲授

examples.text: His clinic is near the newly-built railway station.
examples.translationZh: 他的诊所在新建的火车站附近。

examples.text: He is being treated at a private clinic.
examples.translationZh: 他正在私人诊所接受治疗。

examples.text: He will be tested for HIV at the hospital clinic.
examples.translationZh: 他将在医院门诊部接受艾滋病检查。

meaningZh: 固定；准备；修理

examples.text: He fixed a shelf to the wall.
examples.translationZh: 他把架子装在墙上。

examples.text: My watch has stopped it needs fixing.
examples.translationZh: 我的表停了,需要修理了。

examples.text: Have you fixed on a date for the wedding?
examples.translationZh: 你们选定结婚日期了吗?

meaningZh: 盒；箱状物；包厢

examples.text: He has eaten a whole box of chocolates.
examples.translationZh: 他吃了一整盒巧克力。

examples.text: It's quite an effort to lift this heavy box.
examples.translationZh: 抬起这只沉重的箱子要花费相当大的力气。

examples.text: They have reserved a box for us in the theatre.
examples.translationZh: 他们在剧院为我们预订了一个包厢。

meaningZh: 漫步，漫游；vi. 游荡，漫游，闲逛，慢走，漫步；离开原路，离群，失散

examples.text: He likes to wander over the countryside.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢在乡间漫步。

examples.text: The river wanders through some beautiful country.
examples.translationZh: 这条河蜿蜒曲折地流经一些风景秀丽的乡村。

examples.text: I like to wander in the park after dinner.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢晚饭后在公园里闲逛。

meaningZh: 人群；群众；一群

examples.text: We had to push our way through the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 我们得从人群中挤过去。

examples.text: From across the fields came cheers of the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 从田野的那一边传来群众的欢呼声。

examples.text: A large crowd was waiting at the bus stop.
examples.translationZh: 一大群人在公共汽车站等候。

meaningZh: 证明书；文凭，结业证书；vt. 发给证明书

examples.text: The driver's certificate was suspended by the police.
examples.translationZh: 这个司机的驾驶执照被警察吊销了。

examples.text: He was afforded a certificate upon completion of his course of study.
examples.translationZh: 他结业时被授予证书。

examples.text: This is an accredited course and participants will receive 4.5 college credits and a world recognized Certificate of Nutrition upon completion.
examples.translationZh: 本课程设学分制，完成课程的直销商可获国际认可大学学分，结业时将获颁发盖有美国大溪谷州立大学盖印的营养证书。

meaningZh: （表示牵涉）经过；（表示位置）处在…中；（表示范围）在…之内

examples.text: I live among the mountains.
examples.translationZh: 我住在群山之中。

examples.text: He climbed up the tree and hid among the branches.
examples.translationZh: 他爬上树去,藏在树枝里。

examples.text: New York is among the largest cities in the world.
examples.translationZh: 纽约是世界上最大的几座城市之一。

meaningZh: （使）破；打破（纪录）；（常指好天气）突变

examples.text: If you discover a fire, break the glass to sound the fire alarm.
examples.translationZh: 如果你发现了火灾,打碎玻璃去弄响火警铃报警。

examples.text: To frighten the dog, he broke a twig from the tree.
examples.translationZh: 为了吓唬那只狗,他从树上折了一根小树枝。

examples.text: What shocked the workers was that the boss had broken his promise.
examples.translationZh: 工人们感到震惊的是,老板竟然违背了诺言。

meaningZh: 表示…的意思；意思是；打算

examples.text: What does this word mean?
examples.translationZh: 这个单词是什么意思？

examples.text: I mean that's his own decision to resign or not.
examples.translationZh: 我的意思是说辞不辞职是他自己的决定。

examples.text: I mean to call on you tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 我打算明天看望你。

meaningZh: 上端；头脑；头部

examples.text: Please raise your head and look at the blackboard.
examples.translationZh: 请抬起头来，看黑板。

examples.text: The stone caught him on the side of the head.
examples.translationZh: 那块石头击中他头部的侧面。

examples.text: He had no head for business.
examples.translationZh: 他毫无商业头脑。

meaningZh: 使迷惑，使难解；vt.& vi. 为难，伤脑筋；n. 智力测验，智力玩具

examples.text: Will you help me to solve this puzzle?
examples.translationZh: 你能帮助我解决这个难题吗?

examples.text: He sat frowning over a crossword puzzle.
examples.translationZh: 他坐着皱着眉头在思考纵横字谜。

examples.text: Her decision was a puzzle to him.
examples.translationZh: 她的决定对他来说是个谜。

meaningZh: 单一的；（打斗、比赛等）一对一的；惟一的

examples.text: The letter was written on a single sheet of paper.
examples.translationZh: 这封信只用一张纸写成。

examples.text: I'd like to have a single room, preferably, facing south.
examples.translationZh: 我想要一个套间,最好是朝南的。

examples.text: Every single child will receive a gift.
examples.translationZh: 每一个孩子都会收到一份礼物

meaningZh: 王朝；朝代

examples.text: How many dynasties are there in China's history?
examples.translationZh: 中国历史上有多少个朝代？

examples.text: The Qing Dynasty ended in 1911.
examples.translationZh: 清朝结束于1911年。

examples.text: The Tang Dynasty is a period remarkable for its liberality.
examples.translationZh: 唐朝是一段以开明著称的时期。

meaningZh: 母鸡；雌禽；女人

examples.text: The hen sits for most of the day.
examples.translationZh: 这只母鸡整天大部分时间都在抱窝。

examples.text: The hen laid a large brown egg.
examples.translationZh: 这只母鸡下了一个大红皮蛋。

examples.text: The hen tucked her head under her wing.
examples.translationZh: 那母鸡把头缩在翅膀下。

meaningZh: 兴趣，爱好；利害关系，利益；利息

examples.text: He showed not a spark of interest in the plan.
examples.translationZh: 他对这个计划一点不感兴趣。

examples.text: His two great interests in life are music and painting.
examples.translationZh: 音乐和绘画是他生活中的两大嗜好。

examples.text: Do you pay interest on that account?
examples.translationZh: 那种存款付给利息吗?

meaningZh: 烙饼，薄煎饼；粉饼；[航]平降，平坠

examples.text: I would like to put some raisins and strawberries on the pancake.
examples.translationZh: 我想在薄煎饼上放些葡萄乾和草莓。

examples.text: Please wrap the Beijing Roast duck in the pancake with the spring onion and the sweet bean sauce.
examples.translationZh: 请将北京烤鸭同葱和甜面酱一起包在薄煎饼里。

meaningZh: 项链

examples.text: I value this necklace at $5,000.
examples.translationZh: 我估计这条项链值五千美元。

examples.text: The girl is wearing a bead necklace.
examples.translationZh: 女孩戴了一条珠子项链。

meaningZh: 麻烦；烦恼；故障

examples.text: I find getting up early a great trouble.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得早起床可不容易。

examples.text: I'm sorry to have to put you to so much trouble.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉，给您添了这麽多麻烦。

examples.text: Don't mention my name or you'll get me into trouble.
examples.translationZh: 别提我的名字，免得给我惹麻烦。

meaningZh: 怜悯；同情；可惜的事

examples.text: The old lady often takes pity on small animals.
examples.translationZh: 那位老太太常常怜悯小动物。

examples.text: He remained unmoved by her entreaties for pity.
examples.translationZh: 他未因她恳求怜悯而动心。

examples.text: We took pity on the homeless girl and took her into our house.
examples.translationZh: 我们同情这个无家可归的女孩，让她住进了我们的屋子里。

meaningZh: 香水；香料；香味，香气

examples.text: The room reeked of cheap perfume.
examples.translationZh: 房间里弥漫著劣质香水的呛鼻气味。

examples.text: The smell of her perfume lingered in the empty house.
examples.translationZh: 空屋里仍然飘溢著她的香水味。

examples.text: A mist of perfume hung in the air.
examples.translationZh: 空气中飘溢著香水的雾气。

meaningZh: 西鲱，美洲西鲱

examples.text: We have filet of sole, flounder and baked shad.
examples.translationZh: 我们有上等螺沙鱼排、比目鱼，还有烤鲱鱼。

meaningZh: 末尾；最后；上个

examples.text: The hot weather lasted until September.
examples.translationZh: 炎热的天气持续到九月。

examples.text: The wind is changing round, so the storm won't last long.
examples.translationZh: 风正在转向,因此暴风雨不会持续太长的时间。

examples.text: Economically, one tin of oil will last at least three months.
examples.translationZh: 如果节省地用的,这罐油就会维持至少三个月。

meaningZh: 虔诚的；笃信宗教的；宗教的

examples.text: The religious affairs have been reestablished.
examples.translationZh: 宗教事务已经恢复。

examples.text: He was troubled by religious doubt.
examples.translationZh: 他因对宗教的疑惧而十分烦恼。

examples.text: Secular music refers to music which is not religious.
examples.translationZh: 世俗音乐是指非宗教的音乐。

meaningZh: 某人，有人；n. 大人物，重要的人物

examples.text: Somewhere somebody sometimes does something good.
examples.translationZh: 在某处某人有时做某些好事。

examples.text: Since somebody let the gardener go.
examples.translationZh: 某人让园丁卷铺盖了。

examples.text: Somebody has poked a hole in the paper screen.
examples.translationZh: 有人在那个纸屏风上戳了个洞。

meaningZh: 间谍；密探；vt. 看见

examples.text: The spy was expelled from the realm.
examples.translationZh: 这名间谍被驱逐出境。

examples.text: This evidence reinforces my view that he is a spy.
examples.translationZh: 这个证据证实了我认为他是间谍的这一看法。

examples.text: The scout was sent to spy out the land.
examples.translationZh: 侦探被派出去秘密侦察高地去了。

meaningZh: 反射（光、热、声或影像）；考虑；vt. 反射，反照

examples.text: Her sad looks reflected the thought passing through her mind.
examples.translationZh: 她忧戚的面容反映出她内心的思想。

examples.text: The results reflect the greatest credit upon all concerned.
examples.translationZh: 这些成绩带给所有有关人员最大的荣誉。

examples.text: The sunlight was reflected in the water.
examples.translationZh: 日光由水面反射出来。

meaningZh: 符合，一致；相应；通信

examples.text: Your account and hers correspond.
examples.translationZh: 你的说法跟她的说法一致。

examples.text: Your account of events corresponds with hers.
examples.translationZh: 你说的情况跟她说的相符。

examples.text: The American Congress corresponds to the British Parliament.
examples.translationZh: 美国的国会相当于英国的议会。

meaningZh: 有毛病的，失常的；错误的，不正确的；不好的，不公正的

examples.text: I am afraid you've made a wrong decision.
examples.translationZh: 恐怕你做了一个错误的决定。

examples.text: I'm not going to bow down to such wrong opinions.
examples.translationZh: 我不打算听从这种错误的意见。

examples.text: There is something wrong with the car.
examples.translationZh: 这车有点毛病。

meaningZh: 百分比，百分率；比例，部分；[数]百分法

examples.text: The percentage at grade E and above for day school candidates in the HKCEE was 67.5 compared with 65.6 in 1998.
examples.translationZh: 中学会考日校考生报考的科目成绩达E级或以上的有67.

examples.text: What percentage of the earth is covered by oceans?
examples.translationZh: 地球上百分之多少被海水覆盖着？

examples.text: Whisky contains a large percentage of alcohol.
examples.translationZh: 威士忌所含酒精的百分比很高。

meaningZh: 非洲；adj. 非洲的

examples.text: Africa is full of adventurers.
examples.translationZh: 在非洲有很多冒险家。

examples.text: Peoples in Africa are living in penury.
examples.translationZh: 非洲的人民过着贫穷的生活。

examples.text: Africa is exporting beef to Europe.
examples.translationZh: 非洲向欧洲出口牛肉。

meaningZh: 接受者，收款员；接收器；无线电接收机

examples.text: Please put the receiver back after calling.
examples.translationZh: 打完电话后，请把听筒放回原位。

examples.text: He jammed the receiver down on the cradle.
examples.translationZh: 他把听筒猛力往支架上放下。

examples.text: The television receiver is an electronic device.
examples.translationZh: 电视接收器是一种电子装置。

meaningZh: 安慰；舒适；使人舒服的事物

examples.text: The dress is carefully styled for maximum comfort.
examples.translationZh: 这服装精心设计，力求达到最大限度的舒适。

examples.text: First, you need to get out of your comfort zone.
examples.translationZh: 首先,你要离开你的习惯,离开你的舒适地带。

examples.text: Humanization design is to upgrade the comfort of operation.
examples.translationZh: 人性化设计,更提升了操作舒适性。

meaningZh: 内心的，精神的，思想的，心理的；智慧的，智[脑]力的；〈口〉精神病的，意志薄弱的，愚笨的

examples.text: It's clear that mental activity does not stop when we're asleep.
examples.translationZh: 很显然,我们熟睡的时候,思想活动仍然不会停下来。

examples.text: We should pay more attention to our mental health.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该更注重心理健康。

examples.text: I think such mental disorders are hereditary.
examples.translationZh: 我认为这种精神失调是遗传的。

meaningZh: 铁锹，铲子；纸牌中的)黑桃；vt. 铲

examples.text: She got a spade and laid to with the others.
examples.translationZh: 她拿了把铲子和大家一起大干起来。

examples.text: My father used a special spade for digging turf.
examples.translationZh: 我父亲用一把特别的铲子挖草皮。

examples.text: He was digging potatoes with a spade.
examples.translationZh: 他正在用铁锹挖马铃薯。

meaningZh: 硬币；金属钱币；[建筑]拐角，墙角石

examples.text: He put a coin into the insertion slot.
examples.translationZh: 他往投币孔投入一枚硬币。

examples.text: He paid me in coin.
examples.translationZh: 他付给我的都是硬币。

examples.text: Father dug up an old coin in the garden.
examples.translationZh: 父亲在花园里掘出一枚古钱币。

meaningZh: 手提箱；衣箱

examples.text: My wife compacted my clothes in a suitcase.
examples.translationZh: 妻子把我的衣服紧塞在手提箱里。

examples.text: We've got a spare suitcase but it's not very get-at-able.
examples.translationZh: 我们有个多余的手提箱，但是不太容易拿出来。

examples.text: He stuffed the suitcase with his clothes.
examples.translationZh: 他把衣服塞满手提箱。

meaningZh: 笑；发笑；嘲笑

examples.text: He could tell she was in a bad mood, and tried to laugh her out of it.
examples.translationZh: 他看出她心情不好，想逗她笑好让她不再想烦恼的事。

examples.text: It is natural to laugh when you are happy.
examples.translationZh: 高兴时笑是正常的。

examples.text: You have to laugh and find humor every day.
examples.translationZh: 每天都要笑，每天都要找到幽默。

meaningZh: 早午餐

examples.text: Brunch is a cross between breakfast and lunch.
examples.translationZh: 早午餐是介于早餐兴午餐的中间餐。

examples.text: They eat much the same thing for brunch every day.
examples.translationZh: 每天早午餐他们总是吃同样的东西。

meaningZh: 番茄，西红柿；[俚语] 美女

examples.text: Would you like some tomato paste?
examples.translationZh: 你要西红柿酱吗？

examples.text: His shirt was stained with tomato juice.
examples.translationZh: 我的衬衣被西红柿汁污染了。

examples.text: Most tomatoes are red when ripe, but some kinds are yellow.
examples.translationZh: 大多数西红柿成熟时是红色的，但有些品种是黄色的。

meaningZh: 不善地；坏地；不完美地

examples.text: He was illy prepared for the difficult task.
examples.translationZh: 他对这项艰巨任务准备得很不充分。

meaningZh: 商人；实业家

examples.text: The businessman is a proverb for meanness.
examples.translationZh: 那个商人因行为卑鄙而恶名远扬。

examples.text: That businessman flies great distances every month.
examples.translationZh: 那个商人每月都乘飞机来回很远的地方。

meaningZh: 厨师，大师傅

examples.text: The chef is not interested in Greek food.
examples.translationZh: 厨师对希腊饭不感兴趣。

examples.text: The chef sprinkle poppy seed on the cake.
examples.translationZh: 厨师往蛋糕上撒罂粟籽。

examples.text: I commended the chef on the excellent meal. I later wrote to commend him to his employer, the restaurant owner.
examples.translationZh: 我称赞厨师做的菜味道好。随后我给雇用他的餐馆老板写了封信表扬他。

meaningZh: 偷盗，偷窃；被盗，失窃；盗窃之物，赃物

examples.text: Avarice drove him into theft.
examples.translationZh: 贪婪驱使他偷窃。

examples.text: The building has been insured against fire and theft.
examples.translationZh: 这座大楼保了火险和失窃险。

examples.text: The prosecutor brought an accusation of theft against him.
examples.translationZh: 检察官指控他偷窃。

meaningZh: 木,木材,木料,木头,木柴；树林,林地

examples.text: Our wood supply proved insufficient.
examples.translationZh: 我们的木材供应证明是不够的。

examples.text: We can use plastics in place of wood or metal.
examples.translationZh: 我们可用塑料来代替木材或金属。

examples.text: The man cleft a block of wood in two with an ax.
examples.translationZh: 那人用斧头把一块木头劈成两半。

meaningZh: 对于；向；为了

examples.text: He ran for dear life toward his house.
examples.translationZh: 他拼命地向他的房子跑去。

examples.text: The bus follows the road toward Beijing.
examples.translationZh: 那公共汽车是顺着朝北京去的道路行驶。

examples.text: I have shown enough forbearance toward him.
examples.translationZh: 我已经对他很有耐心了。

meaningZh: 盒式录音带；摄影胶卷暗匣，弹夹；珠宝箱，宝匣

examples.text: Cassette tape recorders are gradually out of date now.
examples.translationZh: 现在,盒式磁带录音机渐渐过时了。

examples.text: He bought a new cassette recorder.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一台新的盒式录音机。

examples.text: There is a little window in the cassette case so that you can see the tape.
examples.translationZh: 盒式音像带上有个小窗，能看见里面的磁带。

meaningZh: 千克；公斤（等于kilogram）

examples.text: The tomatoes cost two yuan a kilo.
examples.translationZh: 蕃茄二元一公斤。

examples.text: I'd like one kilo of apples, please.
examples.translationZh: 给我称一公斤苹果。

meaningZh: 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的

examples.text: Internet makes it convenient for us to get in touch with each other.
examples.translationZh: 互联网使得我们相互联系便利了。

examples.text: Please come whenever it is convenient to you.
examples.translationZh: 方便的时候,请随时来。

meaningZh: 雷电交加的暴风雨；大雷雨

examples.text: They say we're in for a thunderstorm.
examples.translationZh: 他们说要有一场雷暴雨。

examples.text: Fortunately the thunderstorm kept off until we were safely indoors.
examples.translationZh: 幸好我们已经安全地回到家里雷暴雨才来到。

examples.text: He was born during a thunderstorm.
examples.translationZh: 他是在大雷雨中出生的。

meaningZh: 棋，国际象棋

examples.text: My win at chess raised my spirits a little.
examples.translationZh: 我赢了这盘国际象棋才打起了一点精神。

examples.text: I'm not very fond of playing chess.
examples.translationZh: 我不太喜欢下棋。

examples.text: It was the first time I'd won since I'd learnt to play chess.
examples.translationZh: 自从我学会下国际象棋以来，这是我第一次赢。

meaningZh: 价值，价格；意义，涵义；重要性

examples.text: This book will be of great value to him in his study.
examples.translationZh: 这本书将对他的研究有很大价值。

examples.text: The fall in the dollar's value worldwide sent tremors through the Wall Street.
examples.translationZh: 全球性的美元价格下跌震动了整个华尔街。

examples.text: No one knows the value of health until he loses it.
examples.translationZh: 直到失去了健康，人们方知健康的重要性。

meaningZh: 看，瞧；vi. 注意；面向

examples.text: He looked at the baby with a smile.
examples.translationZh: 他笑着看着这个婴儿。

examples.text: They looked forward very much to seeing him again.
examples.translationZh: 他们非常盼望再次见到他。

examples.text: He turned on the torch to look for his keys.
examples.translationZh: 他打开了手电筒，寻找钥匙。

meaningZh: 接待；欢迎；招待会

examples.text: The bridal suite was prepared for the reception of the honeymooners.
examples.translationZh: 新婚套间已准备好以接待度蜜月的人。

examples.text: The play got a favourable reception from the critics.
examples.translationZh: 该剧获评论界好评。

examples.text: Wait for me at reception.
examples.translationZh: 在接待处等我吧。

meaningZh: 负荷；负担；装载

examples.text: A plane can carry only so much load after all.
examples.translationZh: 一架飞机终归只能承载那么多的负荷。

examples.text: The load is too heavy and the supports buckle .
examples.translationZh: 负荷过重，支柱坍下来。

examples.text: She will not shove the heavy load onto others.
examples.translationZh: 她不愿意把重担推给别人。

meaningZh: 不舒服的；令人不舒服的；不自在的

examples.text: But women alway wear uncomfortable shoes.
examples.translationZh: 可是女人们总是穿不舒服的鞋子。

examples.text: I have an uncomfortable feeling deep in my throat.
examples.translationZh: 喉咙底部有不舒服的感觉。

examples.text: I'm uncomfortable being introduced to a new person.
examples.translationZh: 你会觉得给别人介绍你才去的时候有不自在的感觉吗？

meaningZh: 主意，想法；[哲]理念，观念；[乐]乐句

examples.text: It's my idea to hold the party outside the house.
examples.translationZh: 在户外聚会是我的主意。

examples.text: It would be a good idea to go swimming in the pond.
examples.translationZh: 到池塘里去游泳倒是个好主意。

examples.text: I have no idea what I plan to be when I grow up.
examples.translationZh: 我不知道长大以后要干什么。

meaningZh: 看见；领会，理解；查看

examples.text: If you shut your eyes you can't see.
examples.translationZh: 要是把眼睛闭上就什么也看不见了。

examples.text: When the sun goes down, we can see the stars.
examples.translationZh: 当太阳落下,我们能看见星星。

examples.text: It is getting dark and I cannot see to read.
examples.translationZh: 天渐渐黑了,我看不见字,无法再阅读了。

meaningZh: 嘈杂的；喧闹的；充满噪音的

examples.text: I prefer the quiet countryside to the noisy cities.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢安静的乡村胜过喧闹的城市。

examples.text: He was notorious for his noisy parties in the town.
examples.translationZh: 因为他搞了多次喧闹的晚会，所以他在镇上声名狼藉。

examples.text: I have got accustomed to noisy sound.
examples.translationZh: 我已习惯于嘈杂声音。

meaningZh: 复活节

examples.text: Christmas and Easter are Christian festivals.
examples.translationZh: 圣诞节和复活节是基督教的节日。

examples.text: Easter comes early this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年复活节来得早。

examples.text: At Easter, attendances at church rose.
examples.translationZh: 复活节期间，到教堂做礼拜的人多了。

meaningZh: （一）打，十二个；adj. 一打的

examples.text: How much are those apples a dozen?
examples.translationZh: 那些苹果一打多少钱？

examples.text: He gave me a dozen of roses for my birthday.
examples.translationZh: 他在我生日那天送我了一打玫瑰。

examples.text: I had bred a dozen of chickens.
examples.translationZh: 我饲养了12只小鸡。

meaningZh: 不可相信的；站不住脚的；（由于太好或太糟而）令人难以置信的

examples.text: They work with an unbelievable speed.
examples.translationZh: 他们以令人难以置信的速度工作。

examples.text: His ecstasy to the pop music is unbelievable.
examples.translationZh: 他对流行音乐的入迷是令人难以置信的。

meaningZh: 执行；履行；表演

examples.text: Every manager must perform some duties of a ceremonial nature.
examples.translationZh: 每个管理者必须执行一些礼仪性的任务。

examples.text: Student teams perform a comprehensive analysis and valuation of a business, as outlined in the syllabus.
examples.translationZh: 如同课程大纲所提及，每一组学生都要对一个企业执行广泛的分析与评价。

examples.text: They always perform their duties faithfully.
examples.translationZh: 他们总是忠实地履行自己的职责。

meaningZh: 复述，背诵；重复；vi. 重做

examples.text: A repeat of a television program is boring.
examples.translationZh: 电视节目的重播是很乏味的。

examples.text: Malcolm is forced to repeat crimes on himself.
examples.translationZh: 马尔康不得不反复声言自己有罪。

examples.text: Repeat this process repetitively, each time going farther and farther from the dog.
examples.translationZh: 反复这一过程，逐渐地加大你与狗之间的距离。

meaningZh: 使激动；使陶醉；使颤动、战栗或振动

examples.text: It gave me a real thrill to see her again after so many years.
examples.translationZh: 那么多年后与她重逢,我非常激动。

examples.text: With a thrill I realized that I had won.
examples.translationZh: 我意识到自己获得了胜利

examples.text: It was a real thrill to meet the Queen.
examples.translationZh: 能见到女王的确是令人兴奋的事。

meaningZh: 适当的；恰当的；合适的

examples.text: You will be informed of the details at the appropriate time.
examples.translationZh: 在适当的时候将把详情告诉你。

examples.text: It is not easy to choose clothes which are appropriate to your beautiful figure.
examples.translationZh: 选择与你漂亮的体型相称的服装是不容易的。

examples.text: She again entreated his forgiveness for so selfishly appropriating the cottage
examples.translationZh: 她为自己这么自私地占用了这座农舍而再次恳求他的原谅。

meaningZh: 衣领；领子；（狗等的）项圈

examples.text: He grabbed my collar and pulled me towards him.
examples.translationZh: 他抓住我的领子把我拉倒他面前。

examples.text: He turned up his coat collar against the chill wind.
examples.translationZh: 他竖起大衣领抵御寒风。

examples.text: Where are the dog's collar and lead?
examples.translationZh: 狗的颈圈和皮带哪去了？

meaningZh: 柜台；对立面；计数器

examples.text: He placed the money on the counter.
examples.translationZh: 他把钱放在柜台上。

examples.text: Shoppers got into a scrum round the bargain counter.
examples.translationZh: 顾客在廉价品柜台周围你争我夺。

examples.text: The circuit is a conventional ring counter.
examples.translationZh: 此线路是一个普通的环形计数器。

meaningZh: 艰难；困苦；艰难情况

examples.text: We are ready to face any hardship.
examples.translationZh: 我们准备好了面对任何艰难。

examples.text: He will not shrink from any hardship.
examples.translationZh: 他不会因任何艰难而畏缩。

examples.text: A strong man will bear hardship without complaining.
examples.translationZh: 一个坚强的人会忍受困苦而不抱怨。

meaningZh: 现在，当今；n. 当今，现在

examples.text: Nowadays we rely increasingly on computers for help/to help us.
examples.translationZh: 现今人们越来越依赖计算机协助工作。

examples.text: Nowadays people travel in cars rather than carriages.
examples.translationZh: 现今人们旅行都坐汽车，而不使用马车。

examples.text: Portable telephones are very popular nowadays.
examples.translationZh: 现今，移动电话非常普及。

meaningZh: 绘画；油画；上色，着色

examples.text: The painting took his fancy, so he bought it.
examples.translationZh: 这幅画被他看中了,所以他就把它买了下来。

examples.text: Looking at a beautiful painting always gives one satisfaction.
examples.translationZh: 观赏一幅美丽的图画使人心满意足。

examples.text: There are three paintings on the wall.
examples.translationZh: 墙上有三幅画。

meaningZh: 岛，岛屿；vt. 使孤立

examples.text: This island is accessible only by boat.
examples.translationZh: 这个小岛只能坐小船去。

examples.text: This island is no longer a dependency of the USA.
examples.translationZh: 这个小岛不再是美国的属地。

examples.text: Cocos are everywhere in Hainan Island.
examples.translationZh: 海南岛上到处都是椰子树。

meaningZh: 丈夫；〈英〉管家；〈古〉节俭的管理人

examples.text: My husband is a stamp collector.
examples.translationZh: 我丈夫是个集邮者。

examples.text: Mary accused her husband of snore too loudly.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽指责她丈夫打呼噜太响。

meaningZh: 保证，担保；保证人，保证书；抵押品

examples.text: A diploma is no guarantee of efficiency.
examples.translationZh: 持有文凭不能保证工作效率一定高。

examples.text: I guarantee that this will not happen again.
examples.translationZh: 我保证此类事情不会再发生。

examples.text: We guarantee the fastness of these dyes.
examples.translationZh: 我们担保这些染料不褪色。

meaningZh: 人，人类；adj. 人的；有人性的

examples.text: The accident was caused by human error.
examples.translationZh: 这宗事故是人为过失造成的。

examples.text: It is beyond the confines of human knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 这超出了人类的知识范围。

examples.text: Her novel shows her keen insight into human character.
examples.translationZh: 她的小说显示出她对人性的敏锐洞察力。

meaningZh: （用以询问某人或某事物的词）什么，多少；…的事物；adj. …的（事物或人）

examples.text: What are you having for dinner?
examples.translationZh: 你晚饭吃什么?

examples.text: She is not what she was a few years ago.
examples.translationZh: 她已经不是几年前的她了。

examples.text: What color is your dress?
examples.translationZh: 你的衣服是什么颜色？

meaningZh: 过路人；经过者

examples.text: The purse was picked up by a passer.
examples.translationZh: 钱包被一个过路人捡到了。

examples.text: Somebody passing by asked me the way to the post office.
examples.translationZh: 一个过路人问我去邮局怎么走。

meaningZh: 进攻；（球队的）前锋；进攻方法

examples.text: Others assume it's a victimless offense.
examples.translationZh: 也有些人认为这是无害过错。

examples.text: That dirty old house is an offense to the eye.
examples.translationZh: 那幢肮脏的旧房子令人看了很不舒服。

examples.text: No offense, sir, but we're searching every vehicle.
examples.translationZh: 恕我冒犯,但我们在搜查每一辆车。

meaningZh: 放射性的

examples.text: Radioactive ray is material thing.
examples.translationZh: 放射线是实际的物质。

examples.text: Radium and uranium are radioactive elements.
examples.translationZh: 镭和铀是放射性元素。

examples.text: Radioactive waste must be stored on land.
examples.translationZh: 有放射性的废物都必须存放在陆地上。

meaningZh: 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的；不堪入目

examples.text: That's disgusting.
examples.translationZh: 真讨厌。

examples.text: His speech was long, tedious and disgusting.
examples.translationZh: 他的讲话冗长，叫人反感。

examples.text: His deceit is disgusting; he took everybody in!
examples.translationZh: 他的欺诈手段令人憎恶，弄得人人上当！

meaningZh: 父亲；祖先；（尤指天主教和东正教的）神父

examples.text: My father and mother went for a walk.
examples.translationZh: 爸爸妈妈去散步了。

examples.text: He modeled himself on his father.
examples.translationZh: 他把他的父亲作为自己的楷模。

examples.text: Father Donovan dropped his eyes.
examples.translationZh: 多诺万神父垂下了眼神。

meaningZh: 邮件；邮政；柱，桩，杆

examples.text: He has no qualifications for the post.
examples.translationZh: 他没有资格担任该职位。

examples.text: Your duties include checking and dispatching the posts.
examples.translationZh: 你的职责是检查和发送邮件。

examples.text: He struggled to run towards the winning post.
examples.translationZh: 他拼命地向获胜标冲去。

meaningZh: 某人，有人；n. 某个人

examples.text: The camera filmed someone leaping into the house.
examples.translationZh: 照相机拍到了某人突然跳入那房子的画面。

examples.text: Someone tried to poison our dog.
examples.translationZh: 有人想毒杀我们的狗。

examples.text: I seem to hear someone knocking at the door.
examples.translationZh: 我好像听到有人在敲门。

meaningZh: 微妙的；熟练的；纤弱的

examples.text: The international situation is very delicate at present.
examples.translationZh: 目前的国际形势极其微妙。

examples.text: He persecuted me with various delicate questions.
examples.translationZh: 他用种种微妙的问题把我难倒了。

examples.text: She wears a dress with delicate lace.
examples.translationZh: 她穿了一件带有精致花边的裙子。

meaningZh: 水坝，堰；水库；（牙科用的）橡皮障

examples.text: The dam was not strong enough to hold back the flood waters.
examples.translationZh: 水坝不太坚固，挡不住洪水。

examples.text: The village was swept away when the dam burst.
examples.translationZh: 村庄在水坝决堤时被冲走了。

examples.text: The water deepened after the dam was built.
examples.translationZh: 堤坝建成后水已加深。

meaningZh: 排球（运动）

examples.text: Volleyball is a team game.
examples.translationZh: 排球是一项要求全队默契配合的运动。

examples.text: We are going to play neither basketball nor volleyball.
examples.translationZh: 我们既不将打篮球也不将打排球。

examples.text: Their team really whipped ours at volleyball.
examples.translationZh: 他们的排球队彻底击败了我们队。

meaningZh: 热心的；热情的；热烈的

examples.text: He is enthusiastic about helping others.
examples.translationZh: 他热心助人。

examples.text: He doesn't know much about this subject, but he's very enthusiastic.
examples.translationZh: 他对这事所知不多,但他非常热心。

examples.text: The audience were enthusiastic on the opening night of the play.
examples.translationZh: 那出戏首次公演之夜观众非常热情。

meaningZh: 也不；也不是；和 neither 或 not 连用

examples.text: It is neither hot nor cold in winter here.
examples.translationZh: 这里冬天既不热也不冷。

examples.text: He's neither an electrician nor a mechanic.
examples.translationZh: 他既不是电工也不是技工。

examples.text: Neither he nor I have free time.
examples.translationZh: 他没有闲功夫，我也没有闲功夫。

meaningZh: 技能，技巧；熟练，巧妙；才能，本领

examples.text: The crisis put his courage and skill to the test.
examples.translationZh: 这次危难是对他的勇气和技能的考验。

examples.text: She dealt with the problem with consummate skill.
examples.translationZh: 她以巧妙的手腕处理了这个问题。

examples.text: Resources management is an important business skill.
examples.translationZh: 资源管理是一项重要的经营技能。

meaningZh: 价格，价钱；代价；价值

examples.text: I wonder why the company keeps its price so low.
examples.translationZh: 我奇怪那个公司为什么把他们的价格压得那么低。

examples.text: No price is too high for winning their support.
examples.translationZh: 为了获得他们的支持，任何代价均在所不惜。

examples.text: It will be cheap at the price if this tour can keep the whole family happy.
examples.translationZh: 只要这次旅游能让全家人开心,再贵也值得了。

meaningZh: 官僚的，官僚主义的，官僚作风的

examples.text: We pardon bureaucratic officials and endure bad deeds of security staff.
examples.translationZh: 我们原谅官僚的习性，容忍治安人员的恶行恶状。

examples.text: In this manner the reformists who have outlived their own day work for the fascists along bureaucratic lines.
examples.translationZh: 这样，这班早该死去的改良主义者们就沿着官僚的路线为法西斯服务了。

meaningZh: 存在，实在；生活，生活方式；实体，存在物

examples.text: The newspaper ceased to appear after an existence of three months.
examples.translationZh: 该报发行3 个月后停刊了。

examples.text: According to some philosopher, everything in existence is reasonable.
examples.translationZh: 某位哲学家认为，存在的事物都是合理的。

examples.text: The family lived a precarious existence.
examples.translationZh: 这家人过着朝不保夕的生活。

meaningZh: 赞赏；称赞；欣赏

examples.text: You may not like him, but you have got to admire his persistence.
examples.translationZh: 你可以不喜欢他，但你不得不佩服他那种坚韧不拔的精神。

examples.text: We admire him for his righteousness.
examples.translationZh: 我们钦佩他的正直。

examples.text: You had better admire others more than criticize if you want to be popular.
examples.translationZh: 如果你想要更受人欢迎,尽量多赞美、少批评。

meaningZh: 潜水；跳水；急剧下降

examples.text: Our dive is a part of this expedition.
examples.translationZh: 我们这次潜水活动就是属于这个远航的一部分。

examples.text: What a beautiful dive!
examples.translationZh: 多么优美的跳水！

examples.text: He dived from the bridge and rescued the drowning child.
examples.translationZh: 他从桥上跳入水中，救起溺水的孩子。

meaningZh: 葡萄酒；果酒；紫红色，深红色

examples.text: He likes to drink red wine at supper.
examples.translationZh: 他喜欢在晚饭时喝红葡萄酒。

examples.text: The wine is left to mature in oak barrels.
examples.translationZh: 葡萄酒在橡木桶中陈酿。

examples.text: He drank the wine slowly, savoring every drop.
examples.translationZh: 他慢慢地喝着酒，细细品尝着每滴酒的滋味。

meaningZh: 颜料，涂料；绘画作品；胭脂等化妆品

examples.text: I personally think we should paint the wall yellow.
examples.translationZh: 我个人认为墙壁应该粉刷成黄色。

examples.text: They painted a coat of paint to prevent the oxidation of the ship by seawater.
examples.translationZh: 他们刷了一层油漆以防止船只被海水氧化。

examples.text: She learns to paint in the fashion of Picasso.
examples.translationZh: 她学着以毕加索的手法(绘画风格)绘画。

meaningZh: 一瞥；闪微光；掠过，擦过

examples.text: She glanced round the room before she left.
examples.translationZh: 她略微环视了一下房间才离开。

examples.text: I'm just going to glance over these documents, then we can go.
examples.translationZh: 我再看一下这些文件，然后我们就可以走了。

examples.text: On the bus I always manage to glance at the headline in the newspaper.
examples.translationZh: 在公共汽车上我总能设法匆匆看一眼报纸大标题。

meaningZh: 滑落；下跌；打滑

examples.text: If you pull this lever, the roof will slide back.
examples.translationZh: 拉一下这根杆,顶就往后滑动。

examples.text: The book slid off my knee.
examples.translationZh: 书从我膝上滑落。

examples.text: House values may begin to slide.
examples.translationZh: 房价可能开始逐渐下降了。

meaningZh: 治愈；矫正；解决

examples.text: There is no effective cure for colds except rest.
examples.translationZh: 除了多休息,没有有效的方法可以治疗感冒。

examples.text: There is still no cure for the common cold.
examples.translationZh: 目前仍没有治愈感冒的良药。

examples.text: The doctor claimed to have discovered a cure for the disease.
examples.translationZh: 这个医生声称找到治愈那个疾病的疗法。

meaningZh: 阳光

examples.text: We can see the dust particles floating in the sunlight clearly.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以很清楚地看到阳光下的灰尘颗粒。

examples.text: He squinted in the bright sunlight.
examples.translationZh: 他在很亮的阳光下眯起了眼睛。

examples.text: The sunlight was reflected in the water.
examples.translationZh: 日光由水面反射出来。

meaningZh: 共产主义者，共产主义的支持者；共产党党员；巴黎公社社员

examples.text: The Communist form of government had not mellowed.
examples.translationZh: 共产主义的政府形式还没有成熟。

examples.text: She's a member of the Communist Party.
examples.translationZh: 她是共产党员。

examples.text: Every true Communist must fight to root out this evil.
examples.translationZh: 每一个忠诚的共产主义者，必须为消灭这种恶劣的现象而斗争。

meaningZh: 会议；讨论；（正式）讨论会

examples.text: He is in conference.
examples.translationZh: 他正在开会。

examples.text: An international conference will be held in Beijing next month.
examples.translationZh: 一个国际性的会议下月将在北京举行。

examples.text: There will be a banquet following the conference.
examples.translationZh: 会议过后将有一个宴会。

meaningZh: 漂亮的；机灵的，聪明的；adv. 相当，颇

examples.text: I am pretty sure that he'll say yes.
examples.translationZh: 他会同意的,我对此相当有把握。

examples.text: After six months, I could speak Chinese pretty well.
examples.translationZh: 6个月之后,我就能讲相当好的汉语了。

examples.text: Rachel is a very pretty woman, just like her mother.
examples.translationZh: 瑞秋是一位很漂亮的女性,就像她的母亲一样。

meaningZh: 打扰；干扰；使烦恼

examples.text: We can annoy the enemy by raids.
examples.translationZh: 我们可用袭击骚扰敌人。

examples.text: Some peoples' daily mission is to annoy you!
examples.translationZh: 一些人的日常使命就是骚扰你！

meaningZh: 南方；南部；美国南方各州

examples.text: He suggested that we should make for the south.
examples.translationZh: 他建议我们往南走。

examples.text: They lived in a room facing the south.
examples.translationZh: 他们住在一间面南的房间里。

examples.text: A humid wind blew from the south.
examples.translationZh: 湿润的风从南方吹来。

meaningZh: 问题；疑问；怀疑

examples.text: He gave me no chance to reply to his question.
examples.translationZh: 他没有给我回答他问题的机会。

examples.text: That is a great international question of the day.
examples.translationZh: 那是当代的一个重大国际问题。

examples.text: Make a mark where you have a question.
examples.translationZh: 在有疑问的地方做个记号。

meaningZh: 新鲜的；淡水的；新的

examples.text: Some tribes migrate with their cattle in search of fresh grass.
examples.translationZh: 有些部落为了寻找新鲜的牧草而带着他们的牲畜迁移。

examples.text: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
examples.translationZh: 打开窗户，让新鲜的空气进来。

examples.text: When fresh supplies come into the market, we can revert to your enquiry.
examples.translationZh: 等新货上市时，我们才能回头考虑你们的询盘。

meaningZh: 能力；技能；相当的资产

examples.text: Competence is prerequisite to promotion.
examples.translationZh: 能力是升职的先决条件。

examples.text: I doubt his competence to do the work.
examples.translationZh: 我怀疑他是否有能力做那件工作。

examples.text: No one doubts her competence as a teacher.
examples.translationZh: 谁也不怀疑她能胜任教师工作。

meaningZh: 上诉；[体育]诉请；呼吁

examples.text: Their appeal for help went unheeded.
examples.translationZh: 他们求助的呼吁未受到注意。

examples.text: He made one last appeal to his father to forgive him.
examples.translationZh: 他最後一次恳求父亲宽恕他。

examples.text: His appeal to a higher court was set aside.
examples.translationZh: 他的上诉被驳回。

meaningZh: 在旁边，在一边，到旁边，到一边；撇开（…暂且不谈），留存；[戏]独（白），旁（白）

examples.text: This is surely an author's aside.
examples.translationZh: 这当然是作者的旁白。

examples.text: He spoke in an aside of his family.
examples.translationZh: 他离开本题谈起他的家庭。

examples.text: She has cast her old friends aside.
examples.translationZh: 她把老朋友都撇在一边。

meaningZh: 依靠，倚赖，仗恃；信任，信赖

examples.text: They have to rely on the river for their water.
examples.translationZh: 他们用水只好依靠这条河。

examples.text: A man should rely upon his own power.
examples.translationZh: 人类应该依靠自身的力量。

examples.text: You can't rely on his assistance.
examples.translationZh: 你不能指望他能帮助你。

meaningZh: 前面；正面；身体前部

examples.text: The front of the postcard shows a picture of our hotel.
examples.translationZh: 明信片正面是我们旅馆的图片。

examples.text: Put the statue so that the front faces the light.
examples.translationZh: 把雕像摆好，让正面向著光。

examples.text: The front of the building was covered with ivy.
examples.translationZh: 建筑物的前面爬满了常春藤。

meaningZh: 学习，研究；课题；书房

examples.text: This reference book is very useful to our study.
examples.translationZh: 这本参考书对我们的研究很有用。

examples.text: He persisted in the study of law.
examples.translationZh: 他坚持学习法律。

examples.text: His years of study were useful in his job.
examples.translationZh: 他多年的学习有助于他的工作。

meaningZh: 休息；剩余部分；支持物

examples.text: We'll eat some of the bread and keep the rest for breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 我们将吃一点面包，剩下的留到早饭时吃。

examples.text: You look tired. You need a good rest.
examples.translationZh: 你看来累了。你需要好好休息一下。

examples.text: A rest shall be placed at the end of a row of books to keep them upright.
examples.translationZh: 一排书的末端应放个支撑物以使书本保持直立。

meaningZh: 英俊的，健美的；美观的；大方的

examples.text: The waitress received a handsome tip.
examples.translationZh: 女侍者收到了数量可观的小费。

examples.text: The deal netted him a handsome profit.
examples.translationZh: 这笔交易让他捞到了可观的利润。

examples.text: He is a reporter on the news,and draws a handsome screw.
examples.translationZh: 他是新闻记者，领取可观的薪水。

meaningZh: 男孩，少年；儿子；小伙子，家伙

examples.text: That boy is about ten years old.
examples.translationZh: 那个男孩大约有十岁。

examples.text: The stone just missed the boy.
examples.translationZh: 那块石头差点儿砸到那个男孩。

examples.text: Don't cry, you are a big boy now.
examples.translationZh: 别哭，你现在已经是大男孩了。

meaningZh: （数字）0；零度；adj. 全无的，没有的

examples.text: Make sure you are not dividing by zero.
examples.translationZh: 确保不会除零。

examples.text: It was five below zero last night.
examples.translationZh: 昨夜温度是零下五度。

examples.text: The temperature will be above zero.
examples.translationZh: 气温将在零度以上。

meaningZh: （表示恐惧、惊讶、疑虑等）噢；啊；哎呀

examples.text: Oh, Xiao Fang, I didn't hear you come in.
examples.translationZh: 哦，小方，你进来我都没听见。

examples.text: Oh, she really is getting above herself!
examples.translationZh: 哦，她确实变得越来越自高自大了。

meaningZh: 又一个；再一个；另一的

examples.text: It is just as well that you took another road.
examples.translationZh: 还好你们走了另一条路。

examples.text: She has been transferred to another department.
examples.translationZh: 她已被调往另一个部门。

examples.text: Will you like another cup of tea?
examples.translationZh: 你要再来一杯茶吗？

meaningZh: 外国人；外人，陌生人；外来物，进口货物

examples.text: She wedded a foreigner.
examples.translationZh: 她嫁给了一个外国人。

examples.text: The foreigner knew the local custom very well.
examples.translationZh: 这位外国人对当地的风俗非常熟悉。

examples.text: His accent argues him to be a foreigner.
examples.translationZh: 他的腔调表明他是个外国人。

meaningZh: 湾，海湾；犬吠声；月桂树

examples.text: Sunlight shimmers on the waters of the bay.
examples.translationZh: 阳光在海湾的水面上闪烁。

examples.text: We can see a magical view over the calm water of the bay from our window.
examples.translationZh: 从我们的窗户里可以看到海湾里平静海水的迷人景色。

examples.text: In the milk was a bay leaf, a few slices of onion.
examples.translationZh: 牛奶中也有一片月桂树叶和几片洋葱。

meaningZh: 观光，游览

examples.text: I spent most of my time in sightseeing.
examples.translationZh: 我大部分时间都用在观光游览上了。

examples.text: We spent the remainder of the day sightseeing.
examples.translationZh: 这天剩下的时间我们到各处观光。

examples.text: They embarked on an orgy of sightseeing.
examples.translationZh: 他们开始尽情地观光游览。

meaningZh: 台；站台；平台

examples.text: Any train from this platform stops at Gatwick.
examples.translationZh: 从这一月台开出的火车都在盖特威克停。

examples.text: He was walking up and down the station platform.
examples.translationZh: 他在火车站的月台上走来走去。

examples.text: Jane walked boldly up to the platform without faltering.
examples.translationZh: 简沉著大胆地走上讲台。

meaningZh: 人名地址录，（电话）号码簿；（计算机文件或程序的）目录；adj. 指导的，指挥的

examples.text: He thumbed through the directory to look for her number.
examples.translationZh: 他翻阅电话号码簿找寻她的号码。

examples.text: He found their address in the telephone directory.
examples.translationZh: 他在电话薄里找到了他们的住址。

examples.text: And here is our service directory.
examples.translationZh: 这是服务指南。

meaningZh: 某物，某事；重要的事物[人]，有一定意义的事物；n. （表示不确切的描述或数量）大致，左右

examples.text: I think I dropped something.
examples.translationZh: 我想我掉了东西。

examples.text: I'll try and rustle you up something to eat.
examples.translationZh: 我设法给你弄点吃的。

examples.text: I can predict something with great accuracy.
examples.translationZh: 我能很准确地预测某事。

meaningZh: 短促的敲打（声）；爆震声；敲击声

examples.text: Someone is knocking at the door.
examples.translationZh: 有人在敲门。

examples.text: One may knock to signal one's presence to others.
examples.translationZh: 可以用敲击发出的声音向别人表明自己的存在。

examples.text: He knocked a big hole in the wall.
examples.translationZh: 他把墙撞出了一个大洞。

meaningZh: 胸部，胸腔；箱子；金库

examples.text: The soldier received a serious wound on the chest.
examples.translationZh: 这名士兵胸部受了重伤。

examples.text: The bullet hit him in the chest.
examples.translationZh: 子弹击中了他的胸膛。

examples.text: Chest pains may be symptomatic of heart disease.
examples.translationZh: 胸痛可能是心脏病的症状。

meaningZh: 电视，电视机；电视节目；电视业

examples.text: He turned up the volume on the television.
examples.translationZh: 他把电视机的音量调大了。

examples.text: His first film was shown on television this weekend.
examples.translationZh: 他的第一部电影本周末在电视上播放。

examples.text: The television audience aggregated 30 millions.
examples.translationZh: 电视观众合计达3000万人。

meaningZh: 行为；举止；（人、动植物、化学药品等的）表现方式

examples.text: Such behaviour is beneath contempt.
examples.translationZh: 这种行为令人不齿。

examples.text: What comments have you about my son's behaviour?
examples.translationZh: 你对我儿子的行为有什么意见？

examples.text: I could not endure the insolence of his behaviour.
examples.translationZh: 我不能再忍受他那傲慢无礼的行为了。

meaningZh: 速度；快速；昌盛

examples.text: The police are advising motorists to reduce speed because of the fog.
examples.translationZh: 由于有雾，警察告诫驾车者减慢速度。

examples.text: This plane can reach speeds in excess of 1000 kilometers an hour.
examples.translationZh: 这架飞机可以达到每小时一千公里以上的速度。

examples.text: She finished typewriting the letter at speed.
examples.translationZh: 她迅速打好那封信。

meaningZh: 使结冰，使冻僵；冷藏；吓呆

examples.text: Water freezes at the temperature of 0 degrees Celsius.
examples.translationZh: 水在摄氏零度结冰。

examples.text: We ate some of the fruits and froze the rest.
examples.translationZh: 我们吃了一些水果，把剩下的冷藏起来。

examples.text: They freeze this theory to death.
examples.translationZh: 他们把这个理论僵化了。

meaningZh: 架子，搁板；棚；沙洲，暗礁

examples.text: He poised the glass on the shelf.
examples.translationZh: 他把玻璃杯稳稳地放在架子上。

examples.text: There were a lot of books on the shelves along the walls.
examples.translationZh: 靠墙的书架上有许多书。

examples.text: Please lift the box down from the shelf for me.
examples.translationZh: 请帮我把这只箱子从搁板上抬下来。

meaningZh: 缝，做针线活；缝纫；装钉（书籍）

examples.text: The skirt is finished I'm now going to sew a pocket on.
examples.translationZh: 裙子做好了--我现在再缝上个口袋。

examples.text: I'll just sew up that tear, and the coat will be as good as new.
examples.translationZh: 我把大衣的破处缝好，就会完好如新了。

examples.text: Sew that part all along.
examples.translationZh: 把那部分从头到尾缝合起来。

meaningZh: 疯狂的；不理智的；离奇的

examples.text: Are you crazy?
examples.translationZh: 你疯了吗？

examples.text: It drives me crazy.
examples.translationZh: 它使我快要发疯了。

examples.text: The mother of the kidnapped child was crazy with worry.
examples.translationZh: 那个被绑架的孩子的母亲担心得几乎发狂了。

meaningZh: 羊毛；羊毛制品；（幼虫的）毛

examples.text: These goats are specially bred for their wool.
examples.translationZh: 这些山羊是专为剪取羊毛而饲养的。

examples.text: He found a job of shearing wool from sheep.
examples.translationZh: 他找到一份剪羊毛的工作。

examples.text: She asked me to wind the wool for her.
examples.translationZh: 她叫我帮她绕毛线。

meaningZh: 杰出的；显著的；凸出的

examples.text: He was an outstanding student.
examples.translationZh: 他是个优秀的学生。

examples.text: Given the chance, John might have become an outstanding painter.
examples.translationZh: 如果有机会,约翰也许已成为一位杰出的画家了。

examples.text: Two things are outstanding in the creation of the English system of canals.
examples.translationZh: 在创建英国运河体系的过程中,有两件事是非常突出的。

meaningZh: 种子；子孙；起源

examples.text: The farmers were scattering seed on the fields.
examples.translationZh: 农夫把种子撒在田里。

examples.text: Part of every crop is saved for seed.
examples.translationZh: 每一种庄稼都留一部分作种子。

examples.text: Most plants propagate by seed.
examples.translationZh: 大多数植物靠种子繁殖。

meaningZh: 洋葱（头）

examples.text: I don't like the flavor of onion.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢洋葱的味道。

examples.text: This soup tastes strongly of onion.
examples.translationZh: 这汤洋葱味太浓。

examples.text: We had steak and fried onion for dinner.
examples.translationZh: 我们晚餐吃牛排和炒洋葱。

meaningZh: 油田

examples.text: Design factors of oilfield heaters.
examples.translationZh: 油田加热炉设计要素及技术发展。

examples.text: Karamay Oilfield is located in the western basin.
examples.translationZh: 克拉玛依油田位于盆地西部。

meaningZh: 严寒的，冰冻的；极冷的；使人打冷颤的

examples.text: Freezing weather will break up the soil.
examples.translationZh: 冰冻的天气使土地龟裂。

examples.text: Leave a basin of water outside in freezing weather.
examples.translationZh: 在冰冻的天气里，放一盆水在室外。

examples.text: Freezing winter is harmful to orange trees.
examples.translationZh: 冰冻天气对桔子树是有害的。

meaningZh: 品脱；一品脱的量器或容器；一品脱容器的东西

examples.text: Draw off another pint of beer, please.
examples.translationZh: 请再量出一品脱啤酒。

examples.text: I bought a pint of milk in the store.
examples.translationZh: 我在这家商店里买了一品脱牛奶。

meaningZh: 场面，现场；（戏剧的）一场；景色，风景

examples.text: The terrible scene was engraved on his memory.
examples.translationZh: 那可怕的情景铭记在他的记忆里。

examples.text: The first scene of the play is the king's palace.
examples.translationZh: 剧中的第一个场景是王宫。

examples.text: A new chapter in a novel is something like a new scene in a play.
examples.translationZh: 一部小说中新的一章,就象一出戏中新的一场。

meaningZh: 不适宜的，不适当的；体格不佳的，不健康的；vt. 使不相宜，使不合格

examples.text: The water is unfit for drinking.
examples.translationZh: 这水不宜饮用。

examples.text: This house is unfit for human habitation.
examples.translationZh: 这所房子不适合人居住。

examples.text: She was unfit for such a senior position.
examples.translationZh: 她不能胜任这样的高级职位。

meaningZh: （表示方向）向；（表示对象）对；（表示位置）在…上

examples.text: The book is on the table.
examples.translationZh: 书在桌子上。

examples.text: The spider is walking on the ceiling.
examples.translationZh: 蜘蛛在天花板上爬行。

examples.text: I bought it on credit.
examples.translationZh: 这东西我是赊购来的。

meaningZh: 笼子；牢房；升降车

examples.text: The old man wants to buy a cage for birds.
examples.translationZh: 老人想买一个鸟笼。

examples.text: Is it cruel to confine a bird in a cage?
examples.translationZh: 把鸟关在笼子里残忍不残忍?

examples.text: The hamster had got through the wire at the front of its cage.
examples.translationZh: 仓鼠从其笼子前部的栅栏处钻出去了。

meaningZh: 反对；对…不利；紧靠

examples.text: There are 26 votes for him and 8 against him.
examples.translationZh: 有26票赞成他，8票反对他。

examples.text: We sailed against the wind.
examples.translationZh: 我们逆风航行。

examples.text: It's against your promise to go on smoking.
examples.translationZh: 继续抽烟,这违背了你的诺言。

meaningZh: 预算；预算案；预算拨款

examples.text: Congress has approved the new educational budget.
examples.translationZh: 国会通过了新的教育预算。

examples.text: Our budget needs drastic revision.
examples.translationZh: 我们的预算需作重大修改。

examples.text: The government has budgeted 10000000 pounds for education spending.
examples.translationZh: 政府将10000000英镑编入教育预算。

meaningZh: 给予；赠送；作出

examples.text: Would you please give me a piece of paper?
examples.translationZh: 能给我一张纸吗？

examples.text: He give me a box in which to keep the toy.
examples.translationZh: 他给了我一个装着玩具的盒子。

examples.text: He gives generously to the poor.
examples.translationZh: 他慷慨地施舍给穷人。

meaningZh: 小山，山冈；斜坡；v. 把…堆成小山

examples.text: Trees crowned the hill.
examples.translationZh: 树木覆盖着小山。

examples.text: We found the animal on a scrub hill.
examples.translationZh: 我们在一个灌木丛生的丘陵上找到这动物。

examples.text: The hill was buried under 11 inches of snow.
examples.translationZh: 这丘陵上覆盖着11英寸厚的大雪。

meaningZh: 黏土; 泥土

examples.text: Clay is a plastic substance.
examples.translationZh: 黏土是可塑物质。

examples.text: Clay soil retains water.
examples.translationZh: 黏土能保持水分。

examples.text: Bricks and dishes are made from various kinds of clay.
examples.translationZh: 砖和盘子由各种粘土制成。

meaningZh: 雷声；隆隆的响声；vi. 打雷

examples.text: Thunder always comes after lightning.
examples.translationZh: 雷经常出现在闪电之后。

examples.text: The thunder rumbled in the distance.
examples.translationZh: 远处雷声隆隆。

examples.text: We could hear the thunder of distant guns.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以听到远处炮声隆隆。

meaningZh: 主观的；个人的；内省的

examples.text: His arguments were never subjective.
examples.translationZh: 他的论点从来不是主观的。

examples.text: He took a subjective view of the problem.
examples.translationZh: 他用主观的方法看问题。

examples.text: Grading of oral tests is quite subjective.
examples.translationZh: 口语考试的打分是相当主观的。

meaningZh: 获得；赢得；增加

examples.text: No pain, no gain.
examples.translationZh: 不劳则无获。

examples.text: He has no aspiration for fame or gain.
examples.translationZh: 他不图名利。

examples.text: It is not for the love of gain that he does so.
examples.translationZh: 他这样做并非为了得什么好处。

meaningZh: 交谈，会话；交往，交际；会谈

examples.text: I listened to their conversation.
examples.translationZh: 我倾听他们的谈话。

examples.text: Did you have a conversation with him?
examples.translationZh: 你和他谈过话了吗？

examples.text: The band drowned our conversation.
examples.translationZh: 乐队的演奏声把我们谈话的声音淹没了。

meaningZh: （如用铲、锨或推土机等）挖掘；探究，发掘；刺，戳

examples.text: Ten soldiers were told off to dig ditches.
examples.translationZh: 十名战士被分派去挖沟。

examples.text: He was buried by an avalanche and had to be dug out.
examples.translationZh: 他遇雪崩被埋住了，得把他挖出来。

examples.text: An old Greek statue was dug up here last month.
examples.translationZh: 上个月在这儿挖出了一尊古希腊雕像。

meaningZh: 职业，专业；同行；宣称

examples.text: He is a doctor by profession.
examples.translationZh: 他的职业是医生。

examples.text: Nursing is a vocation as well as a profession.
examples.translationZh: 护理工作既是职业又是救死扶伤的责任。

examples.text: I don't believe her profession of friendship for us.
examples.translationZh: 我不相信她声称同我们友好。

meaningZh: 管子；烟斗；管乐器

examples.text: Water is spouting out of the pipe.
examples.translationZh: 水正从管子里喷出来。

examples.text: The workers are laying pipes under the road.
examples.translationZh: 工人们正在道路下面铺设管道。

examples.text: The plumber went down to the cellar to fix the leaky pipe.
examples.translationZh: 管道工到地下室去修漏水的管子。

meaningZh: 轮子；旋转；Wheels 汽车

examples.text: They found her slumped over the steering wheel.
examples.translationZh: 他们发现她倒伏在方向盘上。

examples.text: Nobody can roll back the wheel of history.
examples.translationZh: 没有人能够倒转历史的车轮。

examples.text: The wheel sheared off and fell to the ground.
examples.translationZh: 车轮突然脱落到地上。

meaningZh: 奶牛，乳牛；母兽；雌（象，鲸等）

examples.text: The cow has produced a calf.
examples.translationZh: 这母牛生了一头小牛。

examples.text: Do you know how to milk a cow?
examples.translationZh: 你知道怎么挤牛奶吗？

examples.text: I'm sure it was deliberately done to cow us.
examples.translationZh: 我确信,这一事件经过精心策划,目的是恐吓我们。

meaningZh: 普遍的，一般的；通用的，万能的；全世界的

examples.text: These phenomena is very universal.
examples.translationZh: 这些现象己经非常普遍了。

examples.text: Overpopulation is a universal problem.
examples.translationZh: 人口过多是全球性的问题。

examples.text: Music has been called the universal language.
examples.translationZh: 人们称音乐为世界的语言。

meaningZh: 牙痛，牙疼

examples.text: Ice water aggravated my toothache.
examples.translationZh: 冰水使我的牙痛加重了。

examples.text: The old man had to endure a toothache.
examples.translationZh: 这位老人不得不忍受牙痛。

meaningZh: 开幕，开始；空缺的职位；[商]开盘，交易开始时间

examples.text: He scraped through the narrow opening.
examples.translationZh: 他勉强钻过狭窄的开口处。

examples.text: He put a gate across the opening in the fence.
examples.translationZh: 他在围墙的开口处安了一个门。

examples.text: The book's opening is dull, but the last chapters are interesting.
examples.translationZh: 那本书的开始部分枯燥乏味,但最后几章很有意思。

meaningZh: 替代的；备选的；其他的

examples.text: We have the alternative plans of having a picnic or taking a boat trip.
examples.translationZh: 我们在去野餐或者去乘船旅游两个计划中只能选一。

examples.text: They are provided with the choice of two alternative flights.
examples.translationZh: 有两个航班可供他们选择。

examples.text: I'd like to get some alternative music CDs for my niece.
examples.translationZh: 我想买一些非主流的音乐唱片给我侄女。

meaningZh: 味道；滋味；味觉

examples.text: I've got a cold and so I have lost my sense of taste.
examples.translationZh: 我伤风了,尝不出味道。

examples.text: The medicine has a bitter taste.
examples.translationZh: 这药有苦味。

examples.text: She likes her first taste of life in a big city.
examples.translationZh: 她喜欢她对大城市生活的初次体验。

meaningZh: （加入组织或做某事付的）费；专业服务费，业务报酬；小费，赏钱

examples.text: She charged only a nominal fee for her work.
examples.translationZh: 她为所做的工作只收取象征性的费用。

examples.text: The doctor's fee was higher than we expected.
examples.translationZh: 这位医生的收费比我们预料的高。

examples.text: Tickets are issued only against payment of the full fee.
examples.translationZh: 只有付讫全费才可将票发出。

meaningZh: 大陆；本土；adj. 大陆的

examples.text: The programs will be beamed to Mainland China.
examples.translationZh: 这些节目将对中国大陆播放。

examples.text: The island is joined to the mainland by a bridge.
examples.translationZh: 岛上有座桥与大陆相连。

examples.text: Bombay is linked to the mainland by a causeway.
examples.translationZh: 孟买和印度本土是由一条堤道相连的。

meaningZh: 多云的；阴天的；朦胧的

examples.text: Tonight will be cloudy.
examples.translationZh: 今天夜间多云。

examples.text: In that cloudy sky only one lone star can be seen.
examples.translationZh: 在那多云的天上，只能看到孤零零的一颗星星。

examples.text: It's cloudy today.
examples.translationZh: 今天阴天。

meaningZh: 小的；琐碎的；娇小的

examples.text: We have a little bull session after work.
examples.translationZh: 下班后，我们要开一个小的讨论会。

examples.text: This little bed will do for our youngest daughter.
examples.translationZh: 这张小床我们最小的女儿睡能行。

examples.text: She is too little to ride a bicycle.
examples.translationZh: 她太小了，不能骑脚踏车。

meaningZh: 马；骑马的军人，骑兵；有脚的架

examples.text: The horse jumped the fence.
examples.translationZh: 那匹马跃过了栅栏。

examples.text: He withdrew his horse from the race.
examples.translationZh: 他让他的马退出了比赛。

examples.text: She sat her horse well.
examples.translationZh: 她善於骑马。

meaningZh: 贪吃的；贪心的；贪婪的

examples.text: He is a greedy capitalist.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个贪婪的资本家。

examples.text: He looked at the shop window with greedy eyes.
examples.translationZh: 他用贪婪的眼光看着商店的橱窗。

meaningZh: 高兴的；自鸣得意；（用于初次见面握手时）很高兴认识您

examples.text: He was pleased with their warm welcome.
examples.translationZh: 他们的热烈欢迎使他很高兴。

examples.text: I am very pleased to hear the news.
examples.translationZh: 我很高兴听到这个消息。

meaningZh: 低声说；私语；密谈，密谋坏事

examples.text: There is no word, no whisper, no cry.
examples.translationZh: 这里没有消息，没有低语，没有呼唤。

examples.text: She said it in a whisper, so I didn't hear.
examples.translationZh: 她是悄声说的，所以我没有听见。

examples.text: I heard the whisper of wind in the pines.
examples.translationZh: 我听见风吹过松林间飒飒作响。

meaningZh: 军官，警官；高级职员；公务员

examples.text: That officer must be removed.
examples.translationZh: 那位官员必须免职。

examples.text: He doubts if the officer is anybody.
examples.translationZh: 他怀疑这官员是个要人。

examples.text: The immigration officer stamped my passport.
examples.translationZh: 移民官员在我的护照上盖了戳。

meaningZh: 茶杯托，茶碟；（放花盆的）垫盘（等）；浅碟形盆地

examples.text: He is drinking with a cup and saucer.
examples.translationZh: 他正在用带茶托的茶杯喝茶。

examples.text: First, Linc pushed over a chair and jolted a knickknack table off its accustomed site hard enough so that a cup and saucer fell to the rug.
examples.translationZh: 第一，林克推翻了一个椅子，把一个放小摆设的小桌子用力的推离了原来的位置，使上面的一个杯子和茶托掉到了地毯上。

examples.text: The cat has upset its saucer of milk.
examples.translationZh: 那只猫打翻了它的牛奶碟子。

meaningZh: （女用）手提包；旅行包

examples.text: She was carrying a buffalo hide handbag.
examples.translationZh: 她拎著一个牛皮手提包。

examples.text: Do you mind if I open your handbag and check?
examples.translationZh: 我打开你的手提包检查一下行吗？

meaningZh: 非常；差不多；很多地

examples.text: The President's speech provoked much discussion.
examples.translationZh: 总统的演说引发了许多议论。

examples.text: All the furniture in the room had much carving.
examples.translationZh: 房间里所有的家具上都有许多雕刻。

examples.text: My plans are still very much in embryo.
examples.translationZh: 我的计划在很大程度上仍在酝酿中。

meaningZh: 假期，休假；[古] 空出，撤出，辞去；vi. 度假

examples.text: I was on vacation last week and didn't receive your fax.
examples.translationZh: 上星期我正在度假，没收到你们的传真。

examples.text: I was too busy to spare time for a vacation.
examples.translationZh: 我太忙抽不出休假的时间。

examples.text: Immediate vacation of the house is essential.
examples.translationZh: 立即腾出这所房子是当务之急.

meaningZh: 可怕的；危害极大的；很糟的

examples.text: The earthquake was a terrible catastrophe.
examples.translationZh: 这次地震是个可怕的灾难。

examples.text: If they had any respect for human life they wouldn't do such terrible things.
examples.translationZh: 他们如果还顾及人的生命就不会做出这样可怕的事来。

examples.text: The government didn't allow reporting the terrible accident.
examples.translationZh: 政府不允许报道那起严重事故。

meaningZh: 承担，从事；保证；同意，答应

examples.text: We could undertake the work for the time being.
examples.translationZh: 我们可暂时承担这项工作。

examples.text: We shall undertake the construction of this bridge.
examples.translationZh: 我们将负责这座桥的修建工程。

examples.text: Whatever I may undertake in the coming years, I don't need your help.
examples.translationZh: 未来无论我从事什么,我都不需要你的帮助。

meaningZh: 井；煤矿；麻子

examples.text: The children were playing in the sand pit.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们在沙坑中玩耍。

examples.text: They dug a pit to bury the rubbish.
examples.translationZh: 他们挖了一个坑把垃圾埋掉。

examples.text: I've got quite used to working in the pit.
examples.translationZh: 在矿井工作我已经很习惯了。

meaningZh: 用户，使用者；吸毒成瘾者

examples.text: It allows the user to enter data on a keyboard.
examples.translationZh: 字处理软件允许用户在键盘上输入数据。

examples.text: Yes , I am an existing MERP user.
examples.translationZh: 是，我是现代教育资源库的用户。

examples.text: The user interacts with the computer.
examples.translationZh: 使用者同计算机对话。

meaningZh: 很，非常；恰好是，正是；十足的

examples.text: She likes Beethoven very much.
examples.translationZh: 她很喜欢贝多芬的作品。

examples.text: It is very unwise for the girl to marry him.
examples.translationZh: 这女孩嫁给他是很不明智的。

examples.text: London is a very cosmopolitan city.
examples.translationZh: 伦敦完全是个国际大城市。

meaningZh: 下降；（力量、健康、品格、权力、价值等的）衰退；下倾

examples.text: I wish prices would decline.
examples.translationZh: 但愿物价下降。

examples.text: The price of 14 inches TV set declined from 400 to 320 yuan each.
examples.translationZh: 14英寸的电视机每台从400元降到320元。

examples.text: He spent his declining years in the country.
examples.translationZh: 他在乡间度过晚年。

meaningZh: 商店；贮存物；仓库

examples.text: The fire was so damaging that the store had to close its doors.
examples.translationZh: 火灾造成的损失太严重， 这个商店不得不停业。

examples.text: He always keeps several cases of wine in store.
examples.translationZh: 他总是备有几箱酒。

examples.text: She has acquired such a vast store of knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 她的知识面非常广。

meaningZh: 获得，取得；学到

examples.text: We should try to acquire good habits.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该努力养成良好的习惯。

examples.text: He will acquire the right to permanent residency here.
examples.translationZh: 他将获得这里的永久居留权。

examples.text: We hope to acquire the knowledge in the happiness.
examples.translationZh: 我们希望在快乐中获得知识。

meaningZh: 观众；读者；接见

examples.text: The audience was no less than five thousand.
examples.translationZh: 听众有五千人之多。

examples.text: Someone in the audience began to laugh.
examples.translationZh: 观众中有人开始笑起来。

examples.text: The concert drew a large audience.
examples.translationZh: 音乐会吸引了大量的观众。

meaningZh: 对话；（文学、戏剧、电影等中的）对话；对白

examples.text: The novel contains more narrative than dialogue.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说里的叙述比对话多。

examples.text: The writer is not very good at writing dialogues.
examples.translationZh: 这个作家不太擅长写对白。

examples.text: At last there can be a reasonable dialogue between our two governments.
examples.translationZh: 我们两国最后终于能理智地进行对话了。

meaningZh: 立刻，马上；向右，右边；恰当地

examples.text: In general, I think we're on the right track.
examples.translationZh: 总的看来,我想我们走的路子是正确的。

examples.text: After some introspection, I think you are right.
examples.translationZh: 经过了自省后,我认为你是对的。

examples.text: The bus station is on the right side.
examples.translationZh: 公共汽车站在右边。

meaningZh: 一周一次的[地]，每周的；周刊的；n. 周刊，周报

examples.text: We should work out what our weekly costs are.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该算出我们每周的花费。

examples.text: The child has a weekly allowance of five dollars.
examples.translationZh: 这孩子每星期有五元零用钱。

examples.text: I'll have to discontinue these weekly visits.
examples.translationZh: 我每周一次的访问得停止了。

meaningZh: 成分；零件；[数]要素

examples.text: The factory supplies components for the car industry.
examples.translationZh: 该工厂向汽车业供应零部件。

examples.text: Each of the components is useful in its degree.
examples.translationZh: 每一个元件都各有程度不同的用处。

examples.text: The militia is a component of the state's armed forces.
examples.translationZh: 民兵是国家武装力量的组成部分。

meaningZh: 目击者，见证人；[法]证人；证据

examples.text: The witness was telling about the whole accident.
examples.translationZh: 目击者正在讲述整个事故的过程。

examples.text: The lawyer examined the witness.
examples.translationZh: 律师讯问了证人。

examples.text: A material witness failed to appear in court.
examples.translationZh: 一名重要的证人没有出庭。

meaningZh: 损害，毁坏；伤害（名誉、自尊等）；（尤指事故中）伤害

examples.text: Don't injure yourself with that tool.
examples.translationZh: 不要让那工具伤害到你。

examples.text: He that spare the bad injure the good.
examples.translationZh: 饶恕了恶人，伤害了好人。

examples.text: It would naturally injure him in her estimation.
examples.translationZh: 那自然也会损害到她对他的评价。

meaningZh: 光；发光体；电灯

examples.text: I try to see but I'm blinded by the white light.
examples.translationZh: 我试着去看，但是有道白光让我什么都看不到。

examples.text: I can't read while you are standing in my light.
examples.translationZh: 你挡住了我的光线，我没法看书。

examples.text: He turned off the light before going out.
examples.translationZh: 他出门前把灯关掉。

meaningZh: 人，人类；居民；人民

examples.text: Were there many people at the meeting?
examples.translationZh: 集会有很多人吗？

examples.text: People become uninhibited when they drink.
examples.translationZh: 人一喝酒就会变得肆无忌惮。

examples.text: I think it my duty to serve the people.
examples.translationZh: 我认为为人民服务是我的责任。

meaningZh: 主要的，最重要的；全力的；n. 最主要的部分，重点

examples.text: The teacher asked me to note down the main points of the speech.
examples.translationZh: 老师要求我把演说的要点记下来。

examples.text: The speech was most disappointing,it skirted round all the main questions.
examples.translationZh: 这篇演讲非常令人失望,它回避了所有主要的问题。

examples.text: By defeating their main competitor this firm has cornered the wheat market.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司击败了主要的竞争对手而垄断了整个小麦市场。

meaningZh: 运动场；体育场；[医]（疾病的第…）期

examples.text: The crowds drifted away from the stadium.
examples.translationZh: 人群慢慢从体育场散去。

examples.text: Keep on past the church; the stadium is about half a mile further on.
examples.translationZh: 一直向前走过了教堂，约莫半英里就是体育场。

examples.text: We will go to the stadium to watch a football match.
examples.translationZh: 我们将去体育场观看足球比赛。

meaningZh: 大气，空气；大气层；风格，基调

examples.text: The burning of fossil fuels results in the pollution of the atmosphere.
examples.translationZh: 矿物燃料的燃烧导致了大气污染。

examples.text: The atmosphere of the city is very much polluted.
