examples.translationZh: 那个城市的空气受到严重污染。

examples.text: The atmosphere is very stuffy here and can we open a window?
examples.translationZh: 这里的空气很闷,咱们能打开一扇窗吗？

meaningZh: 孵化；孵出，破壳而出；vt. 秘密策划，（尤指）密谋

examples.text: The hatch date for tit eggs appears to be determined about a month earlier, when the eggs are laid.
examples.translationZh: 白颊山雀孵化的时间，似乎在孵化前一个月，也就是下蛋时便已决定。

examples.text: Both men quickly disappeared down the hatch.
examples.translationZh: 两个人很快从舱口下去不见了。

examples.text: We heard the noise of a hatch being closed.
examples.translationZh: 我们听到关舱口的声音。

meaningZh: 果酱；拥挤，挤满；困境

examples.text: He spread some apple jam on the bread.
examples.translationZh: 他在面包上涂上苹果酱。

examples.text: I reached across the table for the jam.
examples.translationZh: 我伸手到桌子那端去拿果酱。

examples.text: Traffic jams in the town happen everyday.
examples.translationZh: 城里的交通天天堵塞。

meaningZh: 垂直的，竖立的；[解]头顶的；顶点的

examples.text: The northern face of the mountain is almost vertical.
examples.translationZh: 这座山向北的一面几乎是垂直的。

examples.text: The vertical line meets the horizontal one here.
examples.translationZh: 垂直线与水平线在此相交。

examples.text: Wire saws can cut in any orientation, vertical or horizontal.
examples.translationZh: 钢丝锯能够切割任何方向,纵向或横向。

meaningZh: （从事运动或天气炎热时穿的）短裤；男人的短内裤；电影短片

examples.text: Shorts that ride up can be very uncomfortable.
examples.translationZh: 短裤向上绷紧会使人感到很不舒服。

examples.text: Men and women wear shorts in hot weather.
examples.translationZh: 在天热时男人和妇女穿短裤。

meaningZh: 和平；和睦；治安

examples.text: The situation poses a grave threat to world peace.
examples.translationZh: 这局势对世界和平构成了严重的威胁。

examples.text: The dove is the emblem of peace.
examples.translationZh: 鸽子是和平的象徵。

examples.text: There is an atmosphere of peace and calm in the country.
examples.translationZh: 在乡间有一种和平宁静的气氛。

meaningZh: 家；家庭；家庭生活

examples.text: She lives a long way from home.
examples.translationZh: 她远远地离开故乡在外地生活。

examples.text: My home isn't very big, but very comfortable.
examples.translationZh: 我家不很大，但很舒适。

examples.text: He is planning to establish a home.
examples.translationZh: 他正计划建立家庭。

meaningZh: vt. 培养,促进；vt. & vi. 收养,养育

examples.text: People who cannot have a baby of their own sometimes foster (a child).
examples.translationZh: 不能生育的人有时领养别人的(孩子).

examples.text: It is very important to foster an interest.
examples.translationZh: 培养一种兴趣是十分重要的。

examples.text: The mother tried to foster her son's interest in music.
examples.translationZh: 母亲设法培养儿子对音乐的兴趣。

meaningZh: 自尊；骄傲；自满

examples.text: My teaching is my pride and joy.
examples.translationZh: 我的教学工作是我的快乐和骄傲。

examples.text: Pride was his downfall.
examples.translationZh: 骄傲是他垮台的原因。

examples.text: She takes great pride in her children's success.
examples.translationZh: 她为自己的孩子取得的成绩感到无比骄傲。

meaningZh: 到…为止；在…以前；conj. 到…为止，在…以前

examples.text: The heat did not relax until midnight.
examples.translationZh: 直到半夜，炎热才缓解。

examples.text: We did not notice this matter until yesterday.
examples.translationZh: 直到昨天我们才注意到这件事。

examples.text: She can't leave until Friday.
examples.translationZh: 在星期五之前她不能离开。

meaningZh: 机会,运气,转机；前途,命运；大笔的钱,巨款

examples.text: Everyone is the architect of his own fortune.
examples.translationZh: 每个人都是自己命运的创造者。

examples.text: An ill marriage is a spring of ill fortune.
examples.translationZh: 不良的婚姻是恶运的来源。

examples.text: He dreamed of making a fortune.
examples.translationZh: 他梦想发大财。

meaningZh: 恐怖；恐怖的缘由；恐怖行为

examples.text: Her face worked as she stared at him in terror.
examples.translationZh: 她惊恐地注视着他，脸也吓得抽动起来。

examples.text: She let out a scream of terror.
examples.translationZh: 她发出恐怖的叫喊。

examples.text: His terror is so great that he can do nothing.
examples.translationZh: 他惊骇万分以致什么事都不能做。

meaningZh: 同样地，一样地；例如；prep. 作为，以…的身份

examples.text: The ground was as white as snow with petals that had drifted down from the apple trees.
examples.translationZh: 满地是苹果树上飘落下来的花瓣，地上一片雪白。

examples.text: Many things pollute water, such as tires, trash, and plastic bags.
examples.translationZh: 很多东西使水污染，例如轮胎、垃圾和塑胶袋。

examples.text: This cathedral was regarded as a miracle in architectural history.
examples.translationZh: 这座大教堂被认为是建筑史上的奇迹。

meaningZh: 暴力引起的；剧烈的，（风，爆炸等）猛烈的，狂暴的；感情强烈的

examples.text: The soldiers launched into a violent attack.
examples.translationZh: 士兵们展开猛烈的攻击。

examples.text: The violent blow sent him down on his knees.
examples.translationZh: 那猛烈的一击使他跪倒在地。

examples.text: She was in violent temper.
examples.translationZh: 她暴跳如雷。

meaningZh: 再一次；再说；此外

examples.text: Try again.
examples.translationZh: 再试试。

examples.text: Say that again, please.
examples.translationZh: 请再说一遍。

examples.text: I am longing to see my friend Jack again.
examples.translationZh: 我渴望再见到我的朋友杰克。

meaningZh: 营救，救援，使免遭损失；[法律] 非法劫回；n. 营救，救援

examples.text: He dived from the bridge to rescue the drowning child.
examples.translationZh: 他从桥上跳入水中去抢救那溺水儿童。

examples.text: Had Jim not dived in to rescue him, the boy would have drowned.
examples.translationZh: 如果不是吉姆跳下水去救，那小孩早就淹死了。

examples.text: The government has rescued the firm from bankruptcy by giving them a grant.
examples.translationZh: 政府拨款给这家公司使其免于破产。

meaningZh: 传统；惯例；[宗]经外传说

examples.text: We shall carry forward the revolutionary tradition.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该发扬革命传统。

examples.text: In many countries young people still keep up the tradition that women will get married in a long white dress.
examples.translationZh: 许多国家里，年轻人仍保持着妇女结婚时穿白色长礼服的传统。

examples.text: They still follow the tradition of their fathers.
examples.translationZh: 他们仍然继承著他们祖先的传统。

meaningZh: 热的；辣的；激动的

examples.text: A bowl of hot chicken soup is good for you.
examples.translationZh: 喝一碗热鸡汤对你有好处。

examples.text: The hot weather has soured the milk.
examples.translationZh: 炎热的天气使牛奶变酸了。

examples.text: This dish is a bit hot.
examples.translationZh: 这道菜有些辣。

meaningZh: 菠萝；凤梨；〈俚〉手榴弹

examples.text: Cut some pineapple for your sister.
examples.translationZh: 给你姐姐切几片菠萝吧。

examples.text: Tom likes to eat pineapple very much.
examples.translationZh: 汤姆非常喜欢吃菠萝。

examples.text: I bought some tinned pineapples to visit her.
examples.translationZh: 我买了一些菠萝罐头去看她。

meaningZh: 稻草；麦秆；吸管

examples.text: The bird is building a nest of straw and twigs.
examples.translationZh: 这只鸟在用稻草和小树枝筑巢。

examples.text: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
examples.translationZh: [谚]人快淹死时，稻草也要抓。

examples.text: She was drinking juice through a straw.
examples.translationZh: 她正在用吸管喝果汁。

meaningZh: 大蒜；蒜头

examples.text: His breath smelt of garlic.
examples.translationZh: 他呼出的气中有蒜味。

examples.text: This dish needs a touch more garlic.
examples.translationZh: 这菜里要再加点儿蒜。

examples.text: Can you taste the garlic in this stew?
examples.translationZh: 你尝得出炖肉里有大蒜味儿吗?

meaningZh: 枕头；垫子；花边垫子

examples.text: He bought a foam pillow.
examples.translationZh: 他买了一个海绵枕头。

examples.text: My daughter asked me to buy her a pillow stuffed with feathers.
examples.translationZh: 我女儿请求我给她买一个羽绒枕头。

examples.text: I want to consult with my pillow before I take a decision.
examples.translationZh: 在我做出决定前，我要好好考虑一下。

meaningZh: 发抖；焦虑；颤动

examples.text: His remarks struck a tremble into her heart.
examples.translationZh: 他的话令她感到不寒而栗。

examples.text: There was a tremble in her voice.
examples.translationZh: 她声音颤抖。

examples.text: The dog was all of a tremble with cold.
examples.translationZh: 这条狗冻得全身发抖。

meaningZh: 海草；海藻

examples.text: , yes.
examples.translationZh: 所以

meaningZh: 认为；注视；涉及

examples.text: The artist was highly regarded.
examples.translationZh: 这位艺术家非常受尊敬。

examples.text: I regard reading as a form of recreation.
examples.translationZh: 我把看书当作一种消遣的形式。

examples.text: He regards the bad weather as a prognostic of failure.
examples.translationZh: 他将坏天气视为失败的预兆。

meaningZh: （使）燃烧；vt.& vi. 使用某物为燃料；烧毁

examples.text: Half the candle had burnt away.
examples.translationZh: 蜡烛已烧去一半。

examples.text: It's better to burn out than to fade away!
examples.translationZh: 与其慢慢凋谢,不如灿烂燃烧!

examples.text: Paper burns easily.
examples.translationZh: 纸容易着火。

meaningZh: 幽默的；滑稽的；风趣的

examples.text: I have plenty of humorous tales.
examples.translationZh: 我有许多幽默的故事。

examples.text: Indeed he has a solemn face, but he is very humorous at heart.
examples.translationZh: 他的确有一副严肃的脸孔，但内心却是很富幽默感。

examples.text: She writes humorous songs when she is in the right vein.
examples.translationZh: 她在心情不好的时候写诙谐的歌曲。

meaningZh: 灰色的；灰白的；vt. 使变成灰色

examples.text: Have you any grey pullovers in stock?
examples.translationZh: 你们有灰色套头毛衣的现货吗？

examples.text: Today, the canopy of the heavens is grey.
examples.translationZh: 今天的天幕是灰色的。

examples.text: The most popular color this autumn is grey.
examples.translationZh: 今年最流行灰色。

meaningZh: [化]氧，氧气

examples.text: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 水含有氢和氧。

examples.text: Hydrogen and oxygen are gases.
examples.translationZh: 氢和氧是气体。

examples.text: Plants can absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 植物可以吸收二氧化碳释放氧气。

meaningZh: 版本；译文，译本；说法

examples.text: The new version of this dictionary is not in use yet.
examples.translationZh: 这本字典的新版本还未通行。

examples.text: The two newspapers gave different versions of what happened.
examples.translationZh: 两家报纸对发生的事说法不一。

examples.text: The book was translated into many versions and sold all over the world.
examples.translationZh: 这本书被翻译成多种译文并行销全球。

meaningZh: 强壮的；结实的；勇敢的

examples.text: Hope is a slender reed for a stout man to lean on.
examples.translationZh: 希望是壮汉依靠的一根纤细的芦苇。

examples.text: The stout old man waddled across the road.
examples.translationZh: 那粗壮的老人摇摇摆摆地穿过大路。

examples.text: He became stout as he grew older.
examples.translationZh: 随着年龄的增长，他发胖了。

meaningZh: 稻；稻米， 大米；vt. 筛选

examples.text: Rice is our essential foodstuff in life.
examples.translationZh: 大米是我们生活的基本食物。

examples.text: His plate was piled high with rice.
examples.translationZh: 他的盘子里盛满了米饭。

examples.text: He had some rice for supper.
examples.translationZh: 晚饭时他吃了一些米饭。

meaningZh: 呼吸；一口气；呼吸力

examples.text: He caught his breath in surprise.
examples.translationZh: 他惊奇得屏住了呼吸。

examples.text: His chest heaves with every breath.
examples.translationZh: 他的胸部随着呼吸而起伏。

examples.text: It took us a few minutes to get our breath back after the race.
examples.translationZh: 赛跑后我们用了好几分钟才恢复了正常呼吸。

meaningZh: 吮吸；吸入；卷进入

examples.text: Don't suck your thumb; it's so dirty.
examples.translationZh: 别舔手指头，太脏了。

examples.text: They suck soda water through straws.
examples.translationZh: 他们用吸管喝汽水。

examples.text: Plants suck water from the ground.
examples.translationZh: 植物从地中吸收水分。

meaningZh: 谁；什么人；关系代词，有先行词

examples.text: People who cannot speak can talk by using signs.
examples.translationZh: 不会说话的人可以用手势沟通。

examples.text: Who do you think you are?
examples.translationZh: 你以为你是谁？

examples.text: She looked wretched and forlorn, despairing of the arrival of a friend who had promised to meet her.
examples.translationZh: 她看上去又可怜又孤独，对于答应来看她的朋友的到来已不抱希望。

meaningZh: 尤其地；主要地，格外地；显著地

examples.text: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
examples.translationZh: 他们的主要出口货物是纺织品，特别是丝绸和棉布。

examples.text: The rising sun is especially beautiful to look at from this angle.
examples.translationZh: 旭日从这个角度看起来特别美。

examples.text: I love the country, especially in spring.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢这乡村，尤其是在春天。

meaningZh: 泥土；土地，国土；滋生地，温床

examples.text: It's rich there because of the fertility of soil.
examples.translationZh: 因为土地肥沃，那儿很富裕。

examples.text: Fertile soil yields good crops.
examples.translationZh: 肥沃的土地能种出好庄稼。

examples.text: This kind of soil contains much alkali.
examples.translationZh: 这种土壤含碱丰富。

meaningZh: 触摸；使某物与…轻轻接触；吃或喝，尝

examples.text: Don't touch the paint until it's dry.
examples.translationZh: 油漆未干,切勿触摸。

examples.text: His sad story touched our hearts.
examples.translationZh: 他的悲惨的故事深深打动了我们的心。

examples.text: I'm not going to touch a thing tonight.
examples.translationZh: 今天晚上,我什么也不打算吃了。

meaningZh: 态度；看法；姿势

examples.text: We must maintain a firm attitude.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须采取坚定的态度。

examples.text: She shows a very positive attitude to her work.
examples.translationZh: 她工作态度非常积极。

examples.text: He has a mellow attitude to life.
examples.translationZh: 他对生活有种成熟的看法。

meaningZh: 特别受喜爱的；n. 特别喜爱的人（或物）

examples.text: It used to be my favourite restaurant but the standard of cooking has fallen off recently.
examples.translationZh: 那是我以前最喜欢的饭馆，但近来烹饪水平已大不如前了。

examples.text: Who is your favourite writer?
examples.translationZh: 谁是你最喜欢的作家？

examples.text: History is my favourite subject at school.
examples.translationZh: 历史是我在学校中最喜爱的学科。

meaningZh: 智慧，明智；常识，好的判断力；知识，学问

examples.text: She had acquired much wisdom during her long life.
examples.translationZh: 她经年累月造就了很高的智慧。

examples.text: He attributes his wisdom to his teachers.
examples.translationZh: 他认为他的智慧来自于老师。

examples.text: We grow in wisdom as we grow older.
examples.translationZh: 我们随着年龄增长而更加明智。

meaningZh: 昂贵的，花钱多的；豪华的

examples.text: The dress is too expensive for me to buy.
examples.translationZh: 那衣服太昂贵，我买不起。

examples.text: A cheaper camera is not always inferior to a more expensive one.
examples.translationZh: 廉价照相机的质量并总不比昂贵的差。

examples.text: This set of crystal wine cups is very expensive.
examples.translationZh: 这套水晶玻璃酒杯非常昂贵。

meaningZh: 航空邮件；vt. 航空邮寄；投

examples.text: Please send this letter by airmail.
examples.translationZh: 请用航空邮件寄送此信。

examples.text: Airmail is quicker than sea mail.
examples.translationZh: 航空邮递比海上邮递快。

examples.text: I would like to send this letter by airmail.
examples.translationZh: 这封信我想寄航空。

meaningZh: 浪费，白费，挥霍钱财；废料，废品，废物；荒地，荒芜

examples.text: The city waste is disposed of in the sea.
examples.translationZh: 城市垃圾倒在海里处理掉。

examples.text: The safe disposal of nuclear waste is a major problem.
examples.translationZh: 安全处置核废料是个大问题。

examples.text: It's only a waste of time to speak to her.
examples.translationZh: 和她说话纯粹是浪费时间。

meaningZh: 医学的；医药的；医疗的

examples.text: This is the best medical team in the country.
examples.translationZh: 这是该国最好的医疗队伍。

examples.text: Great advances have been made in medical science.
examples.translationZh: 医疗科学取得巨大的进展。

examples.text: He is engaged in medical research.
examples.translationZh: 他从事于医学的研究。

meaningZh: 离开；放弃，抛弃；停止，中断

examples.text: You must quit smoking. Most important of all, you should start taking exercise.
examples.translationZh: 你必须戒烟，更重要的是，你该开始运动。

examples.text: They have to quit China in a few days.
examples.translationZh: 他们必须在几天之内离开中国。

examples.text: The guard did not quit his post all night long.
examples.translationZh: 那个哨兵整夜都没有离开他的哨位。

meaningZh: 渐进的，渐（升）降的；倾斜度小的；逐次的，逐渐的

examples.text: This leads to gradual memory exhaustion.
examples.translationZh: 这将导致存储空间逐渐的耗尽。

examples.text: There has been a gradual increase in the number of people owning cars.
examples.translationZh: 拥有汽车的人数一直在逐渐上升。

examples.text: I advocate a policy of gradual reform.
examples.translationZh: 我拥护逐步改革的政策。

meaningZh: 金，黄金；金色；金币

examples.text: This gold frame sets off your painting well.
examples.translationZh: 这金色的框架把你的画衬托。

examples.text: The gold watchband is thin but heavy.
examples.translationZh: 这条金色的表带薄薄的，但是很重。

examples.text: The Olympic winner received a gold medal as an award.
examples.translationZh: 奥林匹克的优胜者获得一枚金质奖章作为奖赏。

meaningZh: 仁慈，善行；友好的行为

examples.text: Her motherly kindness attaches us all to her.
examples.translationZh: 她像母亲一般仁慈，我们大家都很依恋她。

examples.text: Love is patience, and contains kindness.
examples.translationZh: 爱情是耐性,而且包含仁慈。

examples.text: Your kindness quite overwhelmed me.
examples.translationZh: 你的好意使我感激难言。

meaningZh: 接见；采访；面试

examples.text: How was your interview with Michigan?
examples.translationZh: 你跟密歇根大学的人面谈得如何?

examples.text: He mentioned that problem at our interviews.
examples.translationZh: 他在我们会谈时提到了那个问题。

examples.text: I think I fared quite well in the interview.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得我这次面试考得不错。

meaningZh: 欢呼；使高兴；为…喝彩

examples.text: The audience greet his speech with loud cheer.
examples.translationZh: 听众对他的演讲报以高声欢呼。

examples.text: The audience gave a great cheer when he scored.
examples.translationZh: 当他得分的时候，观众们爆发出热烈的欢呼。

examples.text: The doctor spoke words of cheer to the sick child.
examples.translationZh: 医生向病童说了一些鼓励的话。

meaningZh: 调查表；调查问卷

examples.text: We gave them some questionnaires for collecting data.
examples.translationZh: 为了收集数据我们发给他们一些调查表。

examples.text: Please fill up the blanks in the questionnaire.
examples.translationZh: 请把调查表填写一下。

examples.text: Please complete and return the enclosed questionnaire.
examples.translationZh: 所附问卷请填妥交回。

meaningZh: 害羞的；怕羞的；害怕（做）

examples.text: He was too shy to talk to anyone at the party.
examples.translationZh: 在晚会上他很腼腆，没有和任何人讲话。

examples.text: He only saw her sweet, shy face.
examples.translationZh: 他只注意到她的甜甜的、腼腆的脸。

examples.text: We must not fight shy of hard work.
examples.translationZh: 我们不应回避艰苦的工作。

meaningZh: 不见，消失；不复存在，灭绝

examples.text: The sun disappeared behind a cloud.
examples.translationZh: 太阳消失在一片云后面。

examples.text: Many beautiful fish are fast disappearing because of the severe pollution.
examples.translationZh: 因为污染严重，许多美丽的鱼类正在面临绝种。

examples.text: My wallet has disappeared from the table.
examples.translationZh: 我放在桌子上的钱包不见了。

meaningZh: “can”的过去式；能够，打算；用于假设语气的条件句

examples.text: We could relax the procedure slightly in your case.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以根据你的情况通融一些。

examples.text: Could this verb be used in progressive form?
examples.translationZh: 这个动词可以用进行式吗？

examples.text: I can't sing now, but I could when I was young.
examples.translationZh: 现在我不会唱歌了，但我年轻的时候会。

meaningZh: 合理的，公道的；明白道理的；适当的

examples.text: The management took all reasonable safety precautions.
examples.translationZh: 管理部门采取了一切合理的安全措施。

examples.text: All you need is reasonable doubt.
examples.translationZh: 你所需要的是合理怀疑。

examples.text: You are fortunate to have such a reasonable father.
examples.translationZh: 你有这样一位通情达理的父亲，真是幸运。

meaningZh: 背，背部；背面，反面；后面，后部

examples.text: Three people can sit in the back of this car.
examples.translationZh: 这车的后座可坐3个人。

examples.text: It encouraged him to talk because his back had stiffened in the night and it hurt truly now.
examples.translationZh: 他靠说话来鼓劲,因为他的背脊在夜里变得僵直,眼下真痛得厉害。

examples.text: You'll make your back ache if you carry those heavy buckets.
examples.translationZh: 如果你背那些沉重的桶，你的背会痛的。

meaningZh: 修理；纠正；恢复

examples.text: She turned the chair on its side to repair it.
examples.translationZh: 她把椅子翻转过来修理。

examples.text: I'll have my watch repaired; it doesn't work.
examples.translationZh: 我得修修表，它不走了。

examples.text: The overcoat is so old, it won't repair.
examples.translationZh: 这件大衣太旧了，不能修补了。

meaningZh: 否则；另外；别的方式

examples.text: Seize the chance, otherwise you'll regret it.
examples.translationZh: 抓住这个机会，否则你会后悔的。

examples.text: He should have been working, but he was otherwise engaged.
examples.translationZh: 他应该在工作,可他却干别的事。

examples.text: She is not very clever, but otherwise she's a nice girl.
examples.translationZh: 她并不聪明，但在其他方面，她倒是个好姑娘。

meaningZh: 驾驶员，司机；驱动器，驱动程序；驱逐者，驱赶者

examples.text: The driver slacked up on the gas pedal.
examples.translationZh: 驾驶员松开油门减速。

examples.text: A good driver keeps his eye on the road.
examples.translationZh: 好的驾驶员会注意看路。

examples.text: I'm a hopeless driver, but the examiner let me through.
examples.translationZh: 我开车的技术糟透了，但考官让我及格了。

meaningZh: 警卫；狱吏，看守；护卫队

examples.text: He keeps a dog to guard the house.
examples.translationZh: 他养一条狗看家。

examples.text: The dog guarded the house against strangers.
examples.translationZh: 狗守卫着房屋，不让陌生人进去。

examples.text: Ten soldiers were detailed to guard the bridge.
examples.translationZh: 十名战士被派去保卫那座桥梁。

meaningZh: 戒指,指环；环状物,圆圈；团伙,帮派

examples.text: She wears a wedding ring to show that she's married.
examples.translationZh: 她戴着结婚戒指，表示她已结婚。

examples.text: Roger made the rope fast to the metal ring.
examples.translationZh: 罗杰把绳子牢牢地拴在金属环上。

examples.text: Adenine has a purine ring structure.
examples.translationZh: 腺嘌呤具有嘌呤环的结构。

meaningZh: 的过去分词；支撑，支持；亲自携带，运输

examples.text: The youngest is a born rider of the rails.
examples.translationZh: 小儿子是天生的流浪儿。

examples.text: Meg was born into a large family.
examples.translationZh: 梅格出生在一个大家庭。

examples.text: I've never heard such nonsense in all my born days!
examples.translationZh: 我一生中从未听到过这种胡言乱语。

meaningZh: 争吵，口角；反目；抱怨…的原因（理由）

examples.text: He seemed determined to pick a quarrel with us.
examples.translationZh: 他似乎存心要找我们吵架。

examples.text: They were reconciled after a quarrel.
examples.translationZh: 他们吵架之后又重归于好。

examples.text: Their small argument boiled over into a serious quarrel.
examples.translationZh: 他们的小争论终于酿成了一场激烈的争吵。

meaningZh: 在上面，在高处；起床，起来；向上

examples.text: Put the packet up on the top shelf.
examples.translationZh: 把这个包放到架子顶格上去。

examples.text: I got up early this morning.
examples.translationZh: 今天早晨我起床很早。

examples.text: The import of cotton goods went up sharply in 1981.
examples.translationZh: 一九八一年棉织品的进口量急遽上升。

meaningZh: 奖赏；战利品；值得努力争取的东西

examples.text: The boys competed with each other for the prize.
examples.translationZh: 那些男孩子为赢得奖品而互相竞争。

examples.text: First prize in the raffle is a holiday for two in Paris.
examples.translationZh: 抽奖销售的头奖是两个人到巴黎度假旅游。

examples.text: The champion team will win the cup and prize.
examples.translationZh: 比赛的冠军将获得奖杯和奖金。

meaningZh: 值得的；有…的价值；等值的

examples.text: The thieves stole 1 million pounds' worth of jewellery.
examples.translationZh: 窃贼偷走了价值100万英磅的珠宝。

examples.text: Just 44 years old, his net worth tops $20 billion.
examples.translationZh: 年仅44岁，他的财富纯价值已高达200亿美元。

examples.text: The movie was definitely worth seeing.
examples.translationZh: 那部电影真的很值得看。

meaningZh: 重力；万有引力，地心引力；重要性，严重性

examples.text: He discoursed impressively on Newton's theory of gravity.
examples.translationZh: 他讲述了牛顿的引力定律，给人以深刻的印象。

examples.text: The stone rolled down the hill by gravity.
examples.translationZh: 石头在重力作用下向山下滚去。

examples.text: The force of gravity pulls things towards the earth's centre.
examples.translationZh: 地心吸力把物体吸向地心。

meaningZh: 结果；（尤指足球比赛的）胜利；[体]比分

examples.text: These problems are the result of years of bad management.
examples.translationZh: 这些问题是由于多年管理不善而造成的。

examples.text: The presumable result is an election defeat.
examples.translationZh: 推测结果是竞选可能会失败。

examples.text: She looked with pride at the result of her work.
examples.translationZh: 她自豪地看着自己的工作成果.

meaningZh: 但是；还；已经

examples.text: He hasn't done much yet.
examples.translationZh: 他做的还不很多。

examples.text: "It's time to go.""I'm not ready yet."
examples.translationZh: 出路

examples.text: Have you composed your masterpiece yet? Have we seen it?
examples.translationZh: 对你来说,你是否已经完成了你的杰作了呢?我们什么时候能见到它?

meaningZh: 腰带；区域；传送带

examples.text: He has a brown belt in karate.
examples.translationZh: 他有一条空手道的棕腰带。（他是空手道茶带）

examples.text: A belt of trees grew between the two fields.
examples.translationZh: 两块田之间有一条树木带。

examples.text: As Indonesia lies in the volcanic belt, earthquakes can occur.
examples.translationZh: 由于印尼位于火山地带,因此有发生地震的可能。

meaningZh: 宇航员；太空人；航天员

examples.text: The astronaut can send out a robot which will work on the unknown planet, collecting rocks and minerals, putting up a permanent observation station or traveling far and wide.
examples.translationZh: 宇航员可以派出机器人在这颗陌生的行星上工作，收集岩石和矿物; 建立永久性观察站，或向四面八方走动。

examples.text: My son's dream is to be an astronaut.
examples.translationZh: 我儿子的理想是当宇航员。

examples.text: A rocket manned by trained astronauts will launch soon.
examples.translationZh: 载有受过训练的宇航员的火箭马上就要发射了。

meaningZh: 用钱，花钱；vt. 花费；消耗

examples.text: The average spend on higher education was 55 pounds per head.
examples.translationZh: 用于高等教育的平均支出是每人55英镑。

examples.text: The new law will put a lid on government spend.
examples.translationZh: 新法律将限制政府开支。

examples.text: The time I spend in commuting every day adds up to three hours.
examples.translationZh: 我每天上下班乘车花费的时间加起来有3个小时。

meaningZh: 今晚，今夜；adv. 在今晚

examples.text: The band is really in the groove tonight.
examples.translationZh: 乐队今晚演奏得精彩极了。

examples.text: We have a leg of mutton for dinner tonight.
examples.translationZh: 我们今晚有只羊腿作晚餐。

examples.text: The theme for tonight's talk is education.
examples.translationZh: 今天谈话的题目是教育。

meaningZh: 裤子

examples.text: Flared trousers are out this year.
examples.translationZh: 今年喇叭裤不时兴了。

examples.text: The boy's trousers need a patch on the knee.
examples.translationZh: 这孩子的裤子膝盖上需要打个补丁。

examples.text: He tucked his shirt into his trousers.
examples.translationZh: 他把衬衫下摆塞入裤中。

meaningZh: 内容；（书等的）目录；满足

examples.text: Teaching content should be concise.
examples.translationZh: 教学内容要少而精。

examples.text: The book is rich in content and succinct in style.
examples.translationZh: 这本书内容丰富，文字简练。

examples.text: Define content sections of status reports.
examples.translationZh: 定义状态报告的目录部分。

meaningZh: 嗡嗡作响；急速上升；n. 嗡嗡声

examples.text: Overnight trading caused share prices to zoom up.
examples.translationZh: 一夜的交投使股票价格直线上升。

examples.text: We heard a jet plane zooming overhead.
examples.translationZh: 我们听见喷射机在头上嗡嗡作响。

examples.text: If you zoom out at this point, we shall get a view of the whole square.
examples.translationZh: 如果你在此地把镜头推远，我们将看到整个广场。

meaningZh: 账，账目；存款；记述，报告

examples.text: She squared her account at the store.
examples.translationZh: 她在商店里结清帐目。

examples.text: We have accounts with most of our suppliers.
examples.translationZh: 我们与大多数供应商都是实行赊购制。

examples.text: The agency has lost several of its most important accounts.
examples.translationZh: 这家代理机构失去了几家最重要的老客户。

meaningZh: 吉普车

examples.text: An old jeep is putter along the road.
examples.translationZh: 一辆旧吉普车沿路迤逦而来。

examples.text: They rode up the hill in a jeep.
examples.translationZh: 他们坐了一辆吉普车往山上开去。

meaningZh: 祝福；保佑；赞美

examples.text: God bless you!
examples.translationZh: 愿上帝保佑你！

examples.text: May the gods bless this grateful heart!
examples.translationZh: 愿神祗保佑这深明大义的孩子。

examples.text: May Lord bless all of us who are in misfortune!
examples.translationZh: 愿天主保佑我们这些苦难的人吧！

meaningZh: 大陆，陆地；欧洲大陆；北美洲大陆

examples.text: The discovery of the new continent is usually referred to Columbus.
examples.translationZh: 人们通常认为新大陆是哥伦布发现的。

examples.text: There are seven continents in the world.
examples.translationZh: 世界上有七大洲。

examples.text: Asia is the largest continent on Earth.
examples.translationZh: 亚洲是地球上最大的洲。

meaningZh: 政治的；政党的；对政治有兴趣的

examples.text: He has some pretty strange political ideas.
examples.translationZh: 他有一些很奇怪的政治信念。

examples.text: She entered the political arena after her husband's death.
examples.translationZh: 她丈夫死后，她进入了政界。

examples.text: The British political system has evolved over several centuries.
examples.translationZh: 英国的政治制度是经过几个世纪逐步发展而成的。

meaningZh: 使气馁；使沮丧；阻碍

examples.text: Inflation discourages saving.
examples.translationZh: 通货膨胀阻碍储蓄的积累。

examples.text: A new law has been brought in to discourage racial prejudice.
examples.translationZh: 一项反对种族歧视的新法律已被提出。

examples.text: Try to discourage such familiarities from your subordinates.
examples.translationZh: 不要让属下对你这样不拘礼仪。

meaningZh: 抽水机；打气筒；泵

examples.text: The heart has acted as a strong pump.
examples.translationZh: 心脏充当了一部强有力的泵。

examples.text: At the farm there was an old-fashioned pump for drawing water from a well.
examples.translationZh: 那个农场有一台老式的用来从井里抽水的抽水机。

examples.text: Can you lend me your bicycle pump?
examples.translationZh: 能把你的打气筒借给我吗？

meaningZh: 商店；工厂；办事处

examples.text: The local dress shop is having a sale.
examples.translationZh: 附近的时装店正在大拍卖。

examples.text: The dresses in the shop are priced high.
examples.translationZh: 这家商店的衣服定价很高。

examples.text: That shop has a large connection.
examples.translationZh: 那商店有一大批顾客。

meaningZh: 医学；药物；有功效的东西，良药

examples.text: I have a stomachache. May I have some medicine?
examples.translationZh: 我胃痛,能给我开点药吗?

examples.text: The best medicine for you now would be a good holiday.
examples.translationZh: 目前对你来说,一个愉快的假期就是一剂良药。

examples.text: There have been great progresses in medicine in the past decade.
examples.translationZh: 在过去十年里,医学取得了巨大的进步。

meaningZh: 亚洲

examples.text: He kept a journal of his wanderings across Asia.
examples.translationZh: 他记自己漫游亚洲的日记。

examples.text: The company has begun to scale down its operations in Asia.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司已开始减少在亚洲的业务。

examples.text: China is a developing country in Asia.
examples.translationZh: 中国是亚洲的发展中国家。

meaningZh: 参谋；全体职员；管理人员

examples.text: I find the hotel staff particularly courteous.
examples.translationZh: 我发现饭店员工特别谦恭有礼。

meaningZh: 公路；公用通道；干线

examples.text: A four-lane highway connects the two cities.
examples.translationZh: 一条四车道的公路连接这两个城市。

examples.text: This narrow highway should be broadened.
examples.translationZh: 这条狭窄的公路应该加宽。

meaningZh: 碰撞；冲突；（意见，看法）的抵触

examples.text: The car was completely wrecked by the force of the collision.
examples.translationZh: 这辆汽车受到很大的撞击力而完全损坏。

examples.text: The liner is reported to have been in collision with an oil tanker.
examples.translationZh: 据报道，这艘客轮与一艘油轮相撞。

examples.text: The Government and the unions are on a collision course.
examples.translationZh: 政府和工会必将发生冲突。

meaningZh: 傍晚；黄昏；晚会

examples.text: Could you come back home early this evening?
examples.translationZh: 今天晚上你能早回家吗？

examples.text: I had a severe headache that evening.
examples.translationZh: 那天晚上我头特别疼。

examples.text: In the evening we went to see a film.
examples.translationZh: 晚上我们去看了一场电影。

meaningZh: 中央的，中心的；重要的，核心的；n. 电话总局

examples.text: My house is very central.
examples.translationZh: 我的家非常靠近市中心。

examples.text: What's the central thought of this article?
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章的中心思想是什么？

examples.text: She stays in a small hotel near central park.
examples.translationZh: 她住在中央公园附近的一家小旅馆。

meaningZh: 愚蠢的；迟钝的；乏味的

examples.text: What a stupid idiot!
examples.translationZh: 真是个愚蠢的白痴！

examples.text: I think he was born stupid.
examples.translationZh: 我认为他生来就愚笨。

examples.text: The woman is proverbially stupid.
examples.translationZh: 这个女人是出名的愚蠢。

meaningZh: (it的反身形式)；它自己，它本身；自身，本身

examples.text: The cat is washing itself.
examples.translationZh: 猫正在给自己洗脸。

examples.text: The government made itself unpopular.
examples.translationZh: 这届政府使得自己失去人心。

examples.text: The house itself is not particularly to my mind, but I like its environment.
examples.translationZh: 这房子本身并不特别合我的心意，但我喜欢它周围的环境。

meaningZh: 奴隶；完全受控制的人；从动装置

examples.text: This slave dreamed of becoming a freeman.
examples.translationZh: 这个奴隶梦想着成为一个自由人。

examples.text: The boy was caught and sold to be a galley slave.
examples.translationZh: 这个男孩被抓住，并被卖到战舰上做奴隶。

examples.text: He is a slave to drink.
examples.translationZh: 他是个酒鬼。

meaningZh: 芳香的，香的；愉快的；喷香

examples.text: The aspic is one kind of strongly fragrant purple blue color floret.
examples.translationZh: 薰衣草是一种馥郁的紫蓝色的小花。

examples.text: Fragrant fruit juice is the best drink to entertain guests in the four seasons.
examples.translationZh: 香气馥郁的果露饮料是四季酬宾美物。

meaningZh: 材料，原料；素材；布，织物

examples.text: The colour in this silk material will not fade.
examples.translationZh: 这种绸布料子不会褪色。

examples.text: The workshop has shut down for lack of raw material.
examples.translationZh: 由于缺乏原料，这个车间已停工了。

examples.text: She's collecting materials for her latest novel.
examples.translationZh: 她在为其最新的小说收集素材。

meaningZh: 业余爱好者；外行，生手；adj. 业余的，非职业的

examples.text: An amateur shouldn't play roulette for high stakes.
examples.translationZh: 外行不该下大赌注赌轮盘赌。

examples.text: You're a professional, but I am an amateur.
examples.translationZh: 你是专业的,而我是业余的。

examples.text: Don't let yourself be beaten by an amateur.
examples.translationZh: 不要让自己给一个业余运动员打败了。

meaningZh: 睡着的；休眠的；麻木的

examples.text: The lion lay asleep in its den.
examples.translationZh: 狮子躺在洞里睡觉。

examples.text: He soon fell asleep with weariness.
examples.translationZh: 他疲倦地很快就睡着了。

examples.text: Some people grind their teeth while they are asleep.
examples.translationZh: 有些人睡觉时磨牙齿。

meaningZh: 呼唤，喊叫；召唤，叫来，召集；下令，命令

examples.text: The shouting boy did not hear his mother call him.
examples.translationZh: 大声叫嚷的孩子听不到妈妈的叫唤。

examples.text: I'll call you if you give me a name card.
examples.translationZh: 给我一张名片吧,我会打电话给你。

examples.text: Most people call me Bob. How do I address you?
examples.translationZh: 大家叫我鲍勃,我怎么称呼你?

meaningZh: 火山

examples.text: Vesuvius is an active volcano.
examples.translationZh: 维苏威山是一座活火山。

examples.text: The eruption of volcano makes many people lose their lives.
examples.translationZh: 火山的爆发使许多人丧失了生命。

examples.text: That volcano cast forth lots of lava and ashes.
examples.translationZh: 那火山喷了出大量熔岩和灰烬。

meaningZh: 临时的，暂时的；短暂的；n. 临时工，临时雇员

examples.text: He suffered a temporary loss of memory.
examples.translationZh: 他暂时丧失了记忆。

examples.text: My love for you is not a temporary madness.
examples.translationZh: 我对你的爱意,并不是暂时的疯狂。

examples.text: The two parties procured a temporary agreement.
examples.translationZh: 双方达成了临时协议。

meaningZh: 讨论，谈论；论述，详述；商量

examples.text: We will discuss the proposal at the meeting.
examples.translationZh: 我们将在会议上讨论这项提议。

examples.text: They said they had an important matter to discuss with you.
examples.translationZh: 他们说有要事与你相商。

examples.text: The causes of stress have already been discussed in Chapter 3.
examples.translationZh: 压力产生的原因在第三章就已经论述过了。

meaningZh: 失败，不及格；倒闭，破产；缺乏

examples.text: We must hang together,or our plan will fail.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须齐心协力,否则我们的计划就会失败。

examples.text: He never fails to write to his mother every week.
examples.translationZh: 他从来没有忘记每周给母亲写信。

examples.text: He studied hard only to fail in the exam.
examples.translationZh: 他这么用功，结果竟然考场失利。

meaningZh: 别的,其他的,另外的

examples.text: Ask somebody else.
examples.translationZh: 问问别人。

examples.text: Would you like anything else to drink?
examples.translationZh: 你还要喝点别的什么吗?

examples.text: Yesterday, we went to the department store and nowhere else.
examples.translationZh: 昨天我们到百货公司去了, 其他什么地方也没去。

meaningZh: 印；给…以深刻印象；使铭记

examples.text: Their honesty and hospitality leave an indelible impress on her life.
examples.translationZh: 他们的诚实与好客给她一生留下了难以磨灭的印象。

examples.text: I had a chance to impress her with my efficiency and I muffed it up.
examples.translationZh: 我本来有机会使她对我的办事效率有印象,但是我错过了这个机会。

examples.text: She impressed me as a scholar.
examples.translationZh: 她给我留下了学者的印象。

meaningZh: 塞子；插头；消防栓

examples.text: She pulled the plug out of the bathtub and the dirty water ran away.
examples.translationZh: 她把浴缸的塞子拔掉，脏水流走了。

examples.text: She put the electric plug into the socket.
examples.translationZh: 她将电插头插到了插座里。

examples.text: The TV compere gave her new record a plug.
examples.translationZh: 电视节目主持人极力推荐她的新唱片。

meaningZh: 千米，公里

examples.text: The bridge is almost 2 kilometres long.
examples.translationZh: 这座桥差不多有两公里长。

examples.text: Sound travels about one kilometre in three seconds.
examples.translationZh: 声音在三秒钟里大约传播一公里。

meaningZh: 评估；评价；（应偿付金额的）估定

examples.text: His assessment of the situation was spot-on.
examples.translationZh: 他对形势判断得很正确。

examples.text: Your assessment is substantially correct.
examples.translationZh: 你的估计基本正确。

examples.text: It was a shrewd assessment and probably pretty close to the truth.
examples.translationZh: 这个评估很有道理，可能相当正确。

meaningZh: 海滨；海边；adj. 海边的

examples.text: He is walking down the seaside.
examples.translationZh: 他正沿海边走去。

examples.text: We had an outing to the seaside last summer.
examples.translationZh: 我们去年夏天去海边旅行。

examples.text: The seaside fish market is a ready food supply for scavenging seabirds.
examples.translationZh: 海边鱼市是觅食海鸟现成的食物供应地。

meaningZh: 到达，来；发生

examples.text: We shall arrive soon after.
examples.translationZh: 我们将很快就到达。

examples.text: You must arrive at the airport two hours early.
examples.translationZh: 你必须提前两小时到达机场。

examples.text: The great day has arrived.
examples.translationZh: 伟大的日子已经到来。

meaningZh: 了解，理解；知识（表示多方面的知识时有复数knowledges这一用法）；学科

examples.text: He is poor in money, but rich in knowledge.
examples.translationZh: 他贫于金钱， 但富于学问。

examples.text: She has a detailed knowledge of this period.
examples.translationZh: 她对这段时期的情况了解地相当详细。

examples.text: Child as he is, he knows much knowledge of science.
examples.translationZh: 尽管还是个孩子,他懂得很多科学知识。

meaningZh: 使转动；旋转；使改变方向

examples.text: The turbulence caused the plane to turn over.
examples.translationZh: 空气的激流导致飞机翻转。

examples.text: Men carried corpses in blankets away from the scene and a dozen others tried to turn over a car with two bodies beneath.
examples.translationZh: 搬运工把用毯子盖着的尸体搬离现场，另有十多人试图翻转汽车，搬出下面的两具尸体。

examples.text: At each turn the screw goes in further.
examples.translationZh: 每一次旋转都使螺丝钉更向里进。

meaningZh: 巨大的；庞大的；极大的

examples.text: The atomic explosion is always accompanied by huge fireball.
examples.translationZh: 原子弹爆炸总是伴随着巨大的火球。

examples.text: The huge ship was sunk by a homing missile.
examples.translationZh: 这只巨大的军舰被一枚自动寻的导弹击中。

examples.text: The destructive force of the storm is huge.
examples.translationZh: 暴风雨的破坏力是巨大的。

meaningZh: 感激的，感谢的；令人愉快的；宜人的

examples.text: I can't express how grateful I am.
examples.translationZh: 我说不出我有多么感激。

examples.text: These refugees are very grateful to the government's succor.
examples.translationZh: 这些难民非常感激政府的救援。

examples.text: I am grateful for all your past kindness.
examples.translationZh: 多蒙关照,万分感激。

meaningZh: 实现；了解，认识到；vt.& vi. 变卖，赚得

examples.text: He didn't realise how late it was.
examples.translationZh: 他并没有意识到已经有多晚了。

examples.text: You were acting like you didn't realise that.
examples.translationZh: 看起来好象你没意识到那点。

examples.text: Many a parent pins the hopes on the children to realise their unfilled ambitions.
examples.translationZh: 很多父母试图在他们的儿女身上实现他们的梦想。

meaningZh: 因为

examples.text: I bought the house simply because it was large.
examples.translationZh: 我购买了这房子，只是因为它面积大。

examples.text: An argument was inevitable because they disliked each other so much.
examples.translationZh: 争论是不可避免的，因为他们彼此非常厌恶。

examples.text: I knew she was joking because she had a big grin on her face.
examples.translationZh: 我知道她是在开玩笑，因为她脸上堆满笑容。

meaningZh: 保留；预订，预约；保留地，专用地

examples.text: I'd like to make a reservation.
examples.translationZh: 我想订票。

examples.text: I'll arrive late, but please keep my reservation.
examples.translationZh: 我会晚一点到达，请保留所预订的房间。

examples.text: Do you require a deposit to confirm a reservation?
examples.translationZh: 确定预定的旅馆房间要不要付定金？

meaningZh: 同时；在一起；一致地

examples.text: Let's join hands and struggle together.
examples.translationZh: 咱们携起手来共同斗争。

examples.text: Let us rejoice together on your success.
examples.translationZh: 让我们共同庆祝你的成功。

examples.text: They lived together as husband and wife for years.
examples.translationZh: 他们结为夫妇共同生活了很多年。

meaningZh: 创伤；伤口；伤害

examples.text: I hope her emotional wound will heal with the passing of time.
examples.translationZh: 我希望她感情上的创伤能随时间的流逝而治愈。

examples.text: She got deep psychological wounds.
examples.translationZh: 她受到很深的心理创伤。

examples.text: The soldier received a serious wound on the chest.
examples.translationZh: 这名士兵胸部受了重伤。

meaningZh: 课程；航线；行动方向

examples.text: She took a course in philosophy.
examples.translationZh: 她选读了一门哲学课程。

examples.text: She is taking a secretarial course.
examples.translationZh: 她正在上文秘课程。

examples.text: Television has arranged an English teaching course lately.
examples.translationZh: 电视台最近开设了英语讲座。

meaningZh: 西方的；欧美的；n. 西部电影，西部小说

examples.text: Britain has allied itself with other western powers for trade and defence.
examples.translationZh: 英国与其他西方强国结成了贸易及防御联盟。

examples.text: Silk handkerchiefs embroidered by hand sell well in the Western market.
examples.translationZh: 手绣的丝制手帕在西方市场销路很好。

examples.text: America is a western country.
examples.translationZh: 美国是一个西方国家。

meaningZh: 广告，宣传；公告；出公告，做广告

examples.text: A lot of people replied to our advertisement.
examples.translationZh: 有许多人对我们的广告作出了反应。

examples.text: They inserted an advertisement in the newspaper.
examples.translationZh: 他们在这家报纸上刊登一则广告。

examples.text: The wall was covered with advertisements.
examples.translationZh: 墙上贴满了广告。

meaningZh: 流行的，大众化的；民众的，大众的，公众的；通俗的，普通的，平易的

examples.text: Her charm of manner made her very popular.
examples.translationZh: 她风度优雅，备受欢迎。

examples.text: Baseball is more popular than any other sport in Japan.
examples.translationZh: 在日本，棒球比其他任何运动都受人欢迎。

examples.text: He is very interested in what are called popular songs.
examples.translationZh: 他对所谓的流行歌曲很感兴趣。

meaningZh: 女仆，侍女；少女；处女，未婚女子

examples.text: Her maid helped her to dress up for the party.
examples.translationZh: 她的女仆帮助她穿上参加晚会的礼服。

examples.text: I'll send the maid round to carry it to your house.
examples.translationZh: 我将派女仆把它送到你家去。

examples.text: The maid lowered her chin and simpered.
examples.translationZh: 那位侍女压低下额傻笑着。

meaningZh: 叹气；悲叹，悲鸣；vt. 叹气地说

examples.text: When he heard the news, he uttered a sigh.
examples.translationZh: 听到这消息时，他叹了口气。

examples.text: She heaved a sigh and became lost in thought.
examples.translationZh: 她叹了口气，随即陷入了沉思。

examples.text: The old man uttered a sigh and went out.
examples.translationZh: 那位老人叹息了一声,走了出去。

meaningZh: 小屋，村舍；（农舍式的）小别墅；（郊外的）新式住宅，（大院内的）单幢住宅

examples.text: The cottage could accommodate up to five people.
examples.translationZh: 这间小屋最多能容纳5个人。

examples.text: The cottage was a casualty of the forest fire.
examples.translationZh: 那小屋被森林大火烧毁。

examples.text: His cottage is on the gentle slope of the hill.
examples.translationZh: 他的小屋在山的缓坡上。

meaningZh: 喷嘴，喷雾；喷气式飞机；喷射流

examples.text: Developing the supersonic jet was quite an accomplishment.
examples.translationZh: 开发超音速喷气机是一项了不起的成就。

examples.text: The accident happened as the jet was about to take off.
examples.translationZh: 喷气式飞机正要起飞时出了事故。

examples.text: He left on the jet plane.
examples.translationZh: 他坐飞机离开了。

meaningZh: 奖学金获得者；学者；聪颖勤奋的学生

examples.text: He is a complete scholar.
examples.translationZh: 他是个无懈可击的学者。

examples.text: He is not so much a writer as a scholar.
examples.translationZh: 与其说他是作家倒不如说他是学者。

examples.text: He ranks high as a scholar.
examples.translationZh: 他是第一流的学者。

meaningZh: 急迫的；催促的；强求的

examples.text: They've made an urgent request for international aid.
examples.translationZh: 他们紧急请求国际援助。

examples.text: I was prevented from going by urgent business.
examples.translationZh: 我因急事不能去。

examples.text: Jean spoke, her voice low and urgent.
examples.translationZh: 吉恩说话的时候声音压得很低,感觉很急迫。

meaningZh: 走；离开；去做

examples.text: We' ll go for a walk if you feel like it.
examples.translationZh: 你愿意的话,咱们就去散散步。

examples.text: I must be going.
examples.translationZh: 我该走了。

examples.text: A few days later, things started to go wrong.
examples.translationZh: 几天后,事情开始变糟。

meaningZh: 水平，水准；水平线，水平面；水平仪

examples.text: Levels of unemployment vary from region to region.
examples.translationZh: 失业情形各地不同.

examples.text: We each perceive the outside world differently according to our level.
examples.translationZh: 我们每个人对外在世界的感觉,因个人等级不同而有所差异。

examples.text: We must increase production levels.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须提高生产水平。

meaningZh: 混合；（使）结交；相容

examples.text: You can't mix oil with water.
examples.translationZh: 你不能把油和水混合。

examples.text: If you mix blue with yellow, you'll get green.
examples.translationZh: 蓝色和黄色混合在一起就成了绿色。

examples.text: For better flavor, you can mix an egg into the batter.
examples.translationZh: 要想口味更好,你可以在面糊中加进一个鸡蛋。

meaningZh: 著名的，出名的；〈古〉一流的，极好的

examples.text: New York is famous for its skyscrapers.
examples.translationZh: 纽约以其摩天大楼著称。

examples.text: Oscar Wilde was a famous wit.
examples.translationZh: 奥斯卡·王尔德是个著名的风趣的人。

examples.text: The parks of this city are famous for their ornate fountains.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市的公园以其华丽的喷泉而著名。

meaningZh: 植物学；精纺毛纱；细羊毛

examples.text: To what degree are you interested in botany?
examples.translationZh: 你对植物学的兴趣达到什么程度？

examples.text: In learning botany, I understand much about nature.
examples.translationZh: 学习植物学使我对大自然了解了许多。

examples.text: Botany deals with the study of plants.
examples.translationZh: 植物学论述植物的研究。

meaningZh: 协定，协议；同意，一致；合同书

examples.text: We are in agreement with their decision.
examples.translationZh: 我们同意他们的决定。

examples.text: I am in entire agreement with you.
examples.translationZh: 我完全同意你。

examples.text: The teacher nodded in agreement.
examples.translationZh: 老师同意地点点头。

meaningZh: 监狱；牢笼；监禁

examples.text: The police crushed out the rebellion in the prison.
examples.translationZh: 警察把发生在监狱中的暴乱镇压了下去。

examples.text: That felon tried to escape from the prison.
examples.translationZh: 那名重罪犯试图从监狱中逃跑。

examples.text: His deliverance from the prison puzzled us.
examples.translationZh: 他被从监狱释放使我们困惑不已。

meaningZh: 组织；实施；执行

examples.text: Your conduct is not consistent with what you say.
examples.translationZh: 你的言行不一致。

examples.text: His behavior transgressed the unwritten rules of social conduct.
examples.translationZh: 他的行为违反了不成文的社交规范。

examples.text: His conduct roused the suspicion of the police.
examples.translationZh: 他的举动引起了警察的怀疑。

meaningZh: 外国的，外交的；外来的；不相干的

examples.text: Our foreign trade has expanded during recent years.
examples.translationZh: 近年来我们的对外贸易有所增加。

examples.text: As a result, we were able to attract a lot of foreign investment.
examples.translationZh: 结果,我们吸引了大量的外来投资。

examples.text: It's not easy to master a foreign language.
examples.translationZh: 掌握一门外语并不容易。

meaningZh: 实验室；实验课；研究室

examples.text: They need one laboratory technician.
examples.translationZh: 他们需要一名实验室技术员。

examples.text: The school has a large biological laboratory.
examples.translationZh: 这所学校有一个很大的生物实验室。

examples.text: The product is on trial in our laboratory.
examples.translationZh: 该产品正在由我们实验室做测试。

meaningZh: 有利条件；益处；优越（性）

examples.text: For a goalkeeper,it's a great advantage to have big hands.
examples.translationZh: 对于守门员来说,有一双大手是很大的优势。

examples.text: Rich has an advantage over you since he can speak German.
examples.translationZh: 理奇比你占优势，因为他会讲德语。

examples.text: It is an advantage if you know how to type.
examples.translationZh: 如果你会打字,对你将有利。

meaningZh: 使失望；使破灭，使落空；vi. 使失望

examples.text: The result disappointed him.
examples.translationZh: 结果使他失望。

examples.text: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
examples.translationZh: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

examples.text: I am sorry to disappoint your expectations .
examples.translationZh: 我很抱歉使你的希望落空。

meaningZh: 令人惊异的；vt. 使大为吃惊，使惊奇( amaze的现在分词)；使惊异：感到非常好奇

examples.text: Just look at it. Isn't it amazing!
examples.translationZh: 你看看。真叫人惊叹！

examples.text: We listened to her amazing story with rapt attention.
examples.translationZh: 我们全神贯注地倾听她讲的惊人故事。

examples.text: It was amazing that he knew nothing about the event.
examples.translationZh: 他对这个事件毫不知情，真让人感到诧异。

meaningZh: 信封，封皮；壳层，外壳；包裹物

examples.text: There are several enclosures in the envelope.
examples.translationZh: 信封内装有几份附件。

examples.text: I use a prepaid envelope.
examples.translationZh: 我用了一个邮资已付的信封。

examples.text: He glued a stamp onto the envelope.
examples.translationZh: 他把邮票贴在信封上。

meaningZh: 勇敢，勇气；辉煌，华丽；刚毅

examples.text: Several soldiers were decorated for bravery.
examples.translationZh: 数名士兵因英勇而受嘉奖。

examples.text: His bravery should be an example to all of us.
examples.translationZh: 他的勇敢应作为我们大家学习的榜样。

examples.text: He was awarded a merit badge for his bravery in the battle.
examples.translationZh: 他因为在战斗中的勇猛被授予一枚奖章。

meaningZh: 贮存；贮藏；储藏处，仓库

examples.text: The best place for storage of money is a bank.
examples.translationZh: 银行是存钱最好的地方。

examples.text: The cave can be used for storage.
examples.translationZh: 洞穴可以用来贮藏东西。

examples.text: You should place the goods in storage.
examples.translationZh: 你应该把货物贮藏起来

meaningZh: 流产；流产的胎儿；畸形

examples.text: Abortion is illegal in this country.
examples.translationZh: 人工流产在这个国家是不合法的。

examples.text: She decided not to go through with the abortion.
examples.translationZh: 她决定不做流产。

examples.text: Abortion issues are political dynamite.
examples.translationZh: 堕胎问题在政治上是个爆炸性问题。

meaningZh: 在楼上，往楼上；在高空；adj. 楼上的

examples.text: Jim lived upstairs.
examples.translationZh: 吉姆住在楼上。

examples.text: They tiptoed upstairs so as not to wake the baby.
examples.translationZh: 他们踮着脚上楼,生怕把孩子吵醒。

examples.text: The boy ran upstairs quickly.
examples.translationZh: 男孩很快地跑上楼。

meaningZh: （大学、银行等规模大的）机构；惯例，制度，规定，建立；社会事业机构

examples.text: The institution of school rules is necessary.
examples.translationZh: 制定学校规则的是很有必要的。

examples.text: Marriage is an institution in most societies.
examples.translationZh: 婚姻是大多数社会早已确立的制度。

examples.text: Marriage is love. Love is blind. Therefore marriage is an institution for the blind.
examples.translationZh: 婚姻就是爱情,爱情是盲目的,所以婚姻是一所收容盲人的机构。

meaningZh: 能；能够；可以

examples.text: You can count on me.
examples.translationZh: 你可以指望我。

examples.text: How can you say that?
examples.translationZh: 你怎么可以这样说？

examples.text: I don't have a pen. Can yon lend me one?
examples.translationZh: 我没有笔,你能借我一支吗?

meaningZh: 犯罪，做错事；把…托付给；保证（做某事、遵守协议或遵从安排等）

examples.text: They committed outrages on innocent citizens.
examples.translationZh: 他们对无辜的市民犯下了暴行。

examples.text: He committed suicide rather than sell out to the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 他宁愿自杀而没有向敌人投降。

examples.text: He didn't commit himself to anything.
examples.translationZh: 他没有作任何承诺。

meaningZh: 呼喊，叫喊；高声说或发出喊叫声；n. 大叫

examples.text: He opened his mouth to shout, but no sound came out.
examples.translationZh: 他张开嘴呼喊,但是没有发出声音。

examples.text: He didn't shout, he just glared at me silently.
examples.translationZh: 他没有喊叫，只是默默地怒视着我。

examples.text: The children on the sand were shouting with excitement.
examples.translationZh: 沙滩上的孩子们兴奋得大喊大叫。

meaningZh: 道歉，认错；辩解，辩护

examples.text: He apologizes to her for not going to her party.
examples.translationZh: 他因未出席她的派对向她表示歉意。

examples.text: I apologize if I hurt your feelings.
examples.translationZh: 如果我伤害了你的感情,那我道歉。

examples.text: You must apologize to him for your fault.
examples.translationZh: 你必须为你的过失向他赔罪。

meaningZh: 英里；很远的距离；一英里赛跑

examples.text: My son hoofs a mile to school each day.
examples.translationZh: 我的儿子每天步行一英里去上学。

examples.text: It's not less than a mile to the station.
examples.translationZh: 到火车站至少有一英里路。

examples.text: He had come up from deep down in the water as the dark cloud of blood had settled and dispersed in the mile deep sea.
examples.translationZh: 鱼深暗色的血在一哩深的海里，像云朵般地扩散开来，鲨鱼闻到血腥味便由深水中游过来。

meaningZh: 爵士乐，爵士舞（曲）

examples.text: She's potty about jazz.
examples.translationZh: 她迷上了爵士音乐。

examples.text: I don't dig modern jazz.
examples.translationZh: 我不喜欢现代爵士乐。

examples.text: Does jazz hold any appeal for you?
examples.translationZh: 你对爵士乐有兴趣吗？

meaningZh: 很少，罕见；难得；不大

examples.text: He seldom eats breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 他很少吃早餐。

examples.text: The apple tree is seldom fruitful.
examples.translationZh: 这棵苹果树很少结果。

examples.text: I have seldom seen such brutality.
examples.translationZh: 我很少见到这种暴行。

meaningZh: 无聊的，无趣的；令人厌烦的；单调的，乏味的

examples.text: It is awfully boring.
examples.translationZh: 太叫人厌烦了。

examples.text: It is boring to listen to the same story.
examples.translationZh: 听相同的故事是令人厌烦的。

examples.text: His long boring story made me yawn.
examples.translationZh: 他的冗长的故事听得我直打呵欠。

meaningZh: 三明治；夹心面包；状似三明治的东西

examples.text: I had a ham sandwich as lunch.
examples.translationZh: 我吃了一个火腿三明治作午餐。

examples.text: I'll try a chicken salad sandwich.
examples.translationZh: 我想尝尝鸡肉色拉三明治。

examples.text: I'm busy today but I will sandwich that job after supper.
examples.translationZh: 今天我很忙，但我会在晚饭后挤出时间干那件事。

meaningZh: 更，更多；达到或处于更大的范围或程度；此外，更加

examples.text: There are more cars on the road in the summer than in the winter.
examples.translationZh: 夏天路上的车子比冬天多。

examples.text: We need two more pairs of bath slippers.
examples.translationZh: 我们另外再要两双洗澡用拖鞋。

examples.text: They are proud of taking more power.
examples.translationZh: 他们以掌握更大的权力为荣。

meaningZh: 补偿，赔偿；报酬；抵消

examples.text: Nothing can compensate for the loss of one's health.
examples.translationZh: 什么都不能补偿健康受损。

examples.text: She was compensated by the insurance company for her injuries.
examples.translationZh: 她受伤后获得保险公司的赔偿。

examples.text: You will have to compensate us for the loss.
examples.translationZh: 你必须赔偿我们的损失。

meaningZh: 机场；航空站

examples.text: The plane circled the airport before landing.
examples.translationZh: 飞机在着陆之前在机场上空盘旋。

examples.text: There was a great outcry about the construction of the new airport.
examples.translationZh: 公众强烈反对修建该机场。

examples.text: You must arrive at the airport two hours early.
examples.translationZh: 你必须提前两小时到达机场。

meaningZh: 可爱的；令人愉快的；有趣的

examples.text: We spent many hours in a pleasant conversation.
examples.translationZh: 我们畅谈了好几个小时。

examples.text: This tiny flower gives forth a pleasant fragrance.
examples.translationZh: 这种小花散发出一种令人愉快的香味。

examples.text: Peter is so pleasant that everyone likes him.
examples.translationZh: 彼得很风趣，人人都喜欢他。

meaningZh: 喜欢；（与 would 或 should 连用表示客气）想；想要

examples.text: At a distance he looks a bit like James Bond.
examples.translationZh: 从远处看，他有点像詹姆斯·邦德。

examples.text: It'll rain this afternoon, as like as not.
examples.translationZh: 今天下午很可能要下雨。

examples.text: I like movies, but I don't like Westerns.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢电影,但不喜欢西部牛仔片。

meaningZh: 机器人；遥控装置；自动机

examples.text: The toy robot moved forward with quick jerky steps.
examples.translationZh: 玩具机器人一颠一颠地走得很快。

examples.text: Japanese industry is making increasing use of robots.
examples.translationZh: 日本工业越来越多地使用机器人。

examples.text: The robot is a marvel of modern engineering.
examples.translationZh: 机器人是现代工程技术的奇迹。

meaningZh: 短上衣，夹克；土豆皮；书籍的护封

examples.text: He wore a pair of dark glasses and a jacket all day long.
examples.translationZh: 他整天戴一副墨眼镜，穿一件短上衣。

examples.text: My jacket is made of otter skins.
examples.translationZh: 我的皮夹克是用水獭皮做的。

examples.text: She wore a leather jacket studded with rhinestones.
examples.translationZh: 她穿了一件镶有人造钻石的皮外套。

meaningZh: 怎样；健康状况如何；到何种地步

examples.text: How can we divert her thoughts from her sad loss?
examples.translationZh: 我们怎样才能使他不再想到她可悲的损失？

examples.text: How can I drive away these feelings of sadness?
examples.translationZh: 我该怎样做才能驱散忧伤？

examples.text: How pleasant it is to dine on Chinese food!
examples.translationZh: 吃上中餐是多么令人愉快啊！

meaningZh: 从…以来；自从…之后；自从

examples.text: He must have taken the book since it isn't here.
examples.translationZh: 他一定是把书拿走了,因为书已不在这里了。

examples.text: Since you can't answer the question, perhaps we'd better ask someone else.
examples.translationZh: 既然你无法回答这个问题，我们最好再问问别人。

examples.text: He had spoken to her only once since the party.
examples.translationZh: 自从那次聚会以来,他只跟她说过一次话。

meaningZh: 葬礼，丧礼；〈比喻〉不愉快的事，操心的事，有关系的事；adj. 葬礼的

examples.text: Funeral customs vary with different religions.
examples.translationZh: 葬仪的习俗因宗教不同而不同。

examples.text: The bishop conducted her funeral service.
examples.translationZh: 主教引导了她的葬礼仪式。

examples.text: He asked for no funeral oration.
examples.translationZh: 他不要人在葬礼上宣读悼词。

meaningZh: 冠军；捍卫者，拥护者；战士

examples.text: He is a champion of women's rights.
examples.translationZh: 他是妇女权利的卫士.

examples.text: He is the undisputed champion.
examples.translationZh: 他是无可争辩的冠军。

examples.text: He is a champion at writing familiar essays.
examples.translationZh: 他是写小品文的好手。

meaningZh: 失去知觉的，无意识的；无意的，不自觉的；不知道的

examples.text: He lay unconscious in a pool of blood.
examples.translationZh: 他失去知觉，躺在血泊之中。

examples.text: This wounded soldier was unconscious from his loss of blood.
examples.translationZh: 这名伤员由于失血过多而昏迷不醒。

examples.text: He is unconscious of having made a serious error.
examples.translationZh: 他未察觉到已犯了严重的错误。

meaningZh: 手电筒；闪光信号灯

examples.text: I signaled to them with a flashlight.
examples.translationZh: 我用手电筒向他们发信号。

examples.text: He took a flashlight lest it should get dark before he returned.
examples.translationZh: 为了预防回来以前天就黑了，所以他带着手电筒。

examples.text: You can use the flashlight when you take a photo indoors.
examples.translationZh: 在室内拍照时可用闪光灯。

meaningZh: 乳房，乳腺；胸脯，胸部；心窝，胸怀

examples.text: The little baby can take nourishment from the breast.
examples.translationZh: 小婴儿可以从乳房中吸取营养。

examples.text: The baby was being nursed at its mother's breast.
examples.translationZh: 那个孩子正在吃母亲的奶。

examples.text: The bird's breast is flecked with brown.
examples.translationZh: 这只鸟胸前有棕色斑点。

meaningZh: 绳子，带子；线丝，植物纤维；串

examples.text: Puppets are worked by strings.
examples.translationZh: 木偶是用线来操纵的。

examples.text: The E string of the violin needs screwing up.
examples.translationZh: 这只小提琴的E弦需要调紧些。

examples.text: We have had a string of complaints about the program.
examples.translationZh: 我们已经收到了对该节目的一连串投诉。

meaningZh: 趣闻，轶事；[复数]秘史

examples.text: He departs from the text to tell an anecdote.
examples.translationZh: 他没讲课文而讲了一段轶事。

examples.text: He preceded his lecture with a humorous anecdote.
examples.translationZh: 他以一个幽默的轶事开始他的演说

examples.text: He told me some anecdotes about our English teacher.
examples.translationZh: 他告诉我几个关于英语老师的掌故。

meaningZh: 营养，滋养；营养品；营养学

examples.text: Variety is not a guarantee of good nutrition.
examples.translationZh: 品种多并不能确保营养好。

examples.text: This food provides all the nutrition your dog needs.
examples.translationZh: 本食品含有狗所必须的一切营养。

examples.text: A balanced diet provides nutrition for your body.
examples.translationZh: 均衡的食物使你的身体获得营养。

meaningZh: 大的；重要的；（计划）庞大的

examples.text: New York is a big commercial city.
examples.translationZh: 纽约是一座大的商业城市。

examples.text: His business yields big profits.
examples.translationZh: 他的生意带来巨大的利润。

examples.text: Don't cry, you are a big boy now.
examples.translationZh: 别哭，你现在已经是大男孩了。

meaningZh: 把…除外；不计；prep. 除…外

examples.text: They all went to sleep except me.
examples.translationZh: 除我之外，他们都去睡觉了。

examples.text: It's a poor tune, except to be dancing to.
examples.translationZh: 这支曲子不好,除非用它作舞蹈的伴奏曲。

examples.text: They didn't open their mouths except to complain.
examples.translationZh: 除了抱怨他们从不开口

meaningZh: 方向；趋势；方面

examples.text: Which direction does your room face?
examples.translationZh: 你的房间面向哪个方向？

examples.text: The investigation was carried out under the direction of a senior police officer.
examples.translationZh: 调查是在一位高级警官的指导下进行的。

examples.text: Simple directions for assembling the model are printed on the box.
examples.translationZh: 盒上印有装配模型的简要说明。

meaningZh: 同伴；[天]伴星(=~star)；（用于书名）指南

examples.text: He is a good companion on the journey.
examples.translationZh: 他是个好旅伴。

examples.text: He had always considered her an ideal companion for his son.
examples.translationZh: 他一直以为她是他儿子的理想伴侣。

examples.text: The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.
examples.translationZh: 过去十年来,这只狗一直与她形影不离。

meaningZh: 创造，创作；产生；封爵，把…封为（贵族）

examples.text: Some people believe that God created the world.
examples.translationZh: 有些人相信上帝创造了世界。

examples.text: An artist should create beautiful things.
examples.translationZh: 一个艺术家应该创造美丽的东西。

examples.text: This is the kind of atmosphere we want to create.
examples.translationZh: 我们就想造成这种氛围。

meaningZh: 借入；借钱，借用；[数]由上位借

examples.text: He uses his house as security to borrow the money.
examples.translationZh: 他用房子作借钱的抵押。

examples.text: May I borrow your roller skates?
examples.translationZh: 我可以借你的旱冰鞋吗？

examples.text: You can borrow this dictionary from the library.
examples.translationZh: 你可以从图书馆借到这本字典。

meaningZh: 签名；署名；识别标志，鲜明特征

examples.text: He traced his signature laboriously.
examples.translationZh: 他吃力地签上自己的名字。

examples.text: Her signature was an illegible scrawl.
examples.translationZh: 她的签字潦草难辩。

meaningZh: 假定；猜想，推测；认为

examples.text: Suppose you have a thousand dollars, what will you do with it.
examples.translationZh: 假设你有一千美元，你会用它做什么。

examples.text: Let us suppose another planet with conditions similar to those on the earth.
examples.translationZh: 让我们假定另外有一个具有和地球上相似条件的行星。

examples.text: Some religions suppose that there is a Heaven physically above the earth.
examples.translationZh: 一些宗教认为地球上面真有一个天国。

meaningZh: 船；宇宙飞船；（舰船上的）全体船员

examples.text: The ship was due to sail the following morning.
examples.translationZh: 这艘船定于第二天启航。

examples.text: A terrible storm forced the ship to put back.
examples.translationZh: 可怕的风暴迫使这条船返航了。

examples.text: The paint on the ship's sides was coming off.
examples.translationZh: 舰壳两边的漆开始脱落。

meaningZh: 过道，走廊；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所

examples.text: The lecture is to be delivered at the hall.
examples.translationZh: 演讲将在大厅进行。

examples.text: There was a low murmur of conversation in the hall.
examples.translationZh: 大厅里有窃窃私语声。

examples.text: A multitude of people gathered at the gate of the exhibition hall.
examples.translationZh: 大群人聚集在展览大厅的门口。

meaningZh: 比赛；对手；相配的人（或物）

examples.text: He was very good at tennis, but he met his match when he played McEnroe.
examples.translationZh: 他的网球打得很好，但当他与麦肯罗对打时，他遇到对手了。

examples.text: I am no match for her when it comes to language.
examples.translationZh: 在语言能力方面我根本不是她的对手。

examples.text: The smoker tossed away the lighted match and so caused a fire.
examples.translationZh: 那个抽烟的人随手扔掉火柴棒，引起了一场火灾。

meaningZh: 你的，你们的；尊；玉

examples.text: Your work falls short of my expectations.
examples.translationZh: 你的工作未达到我的期望。

examples.text: Please advise us of any change in your plan.
examples.translationZh: 你们的计划倘有变更,请告诉我们。

meaningZh: 地理（学）；地形，地势；布局

examples.text: How's the new geography teacher?
examples.translationZh: 新的地理老师怎么样？

examples.text: The geography paper was difficult.
examples.translationZh: 地理试题很难。

examples.text: I have only a sketchy knowledge of geography.
examples.translationZh: 我对地理只是一知半解。

meaningZh: 结果，成果；[逻]结论；重要性

examples.text: It terrified me to contemplate the consequence of your action.
examples.translationZh: 一想到你行动的后果,我就感到害怕。

examples.text: He studied hard, and in consequence he passed the exam.
examples.translationZh: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

examples.text: Happiness is not a reward it is a consequence.
examples.translationZh: 幸福不是报偿，而是结果。

meaningZh: 咖啡馆，小餐厅

examples.text: This cafe keeps late into the night.
examples.translationZh: 这家咖啡馆一直开到深夜。

examples.text: The uproar in the cafe lasted long after midnight.
examples.translationZh: 咖啡馆的喧闹一直持续到午夜之后很久。

examples.text: The police came and ejected the noisy youths from the cafe room.
examples.translationZh: 警察来了,把那些吵吵嚷嚷的青年人从咖啡馆里撵了出去。

meaningZh: 构架；框架；（体系的）结构

examples.text: They established a basic framework of ground rules for discussions.
examples.translationZh: 他们建立了讨论的基本准则的基本框架。

examples.text: Government is the one who establishes national policy framework.
examples.translationZh: 国家政策体系的是由政府建立的。

examples.text: It's a bridge of steel framework.
examples.translationZh: 那是座钢铁结构的桥梁。

meaningZh: 勘查， 探测， 勘探；[医]探查（伤处等），探索，研究；vt. 探索， 探究， 仔细查看

examples.text: The experts are exploring every part of the island.
examples.translationZh: 专家们正在勘查这个岛的各个部分。

examples.text: He had an itch to get away and explore.
examples.translationZh: 他等不及要动身去探险。

examples.text: Can you explore the market possibility for us?
examples.translationZh: 您能为我们考察一下市场前景吗？

meaningZh: 农业的，耕种的；农艺的，农学的

examples.text: Agricultural development simply must precede economic development.
examples.translationZh: 农业的发展必须在整个经济发展中处于领先地位。

examples.text: Agricultural workers pass the bigger part of their lives in the open.
examples.translationZh: 搞农业的人一生中大部分时间在户外度过。

meaningZh: 权威；权力；学术权威

examples.text: The government is the highest authority in the country.
examples.translationZh: 政府是国家的最高权力机构。

examples.text: Authorities say the fires do look suspicious.
examples.translationZh: 官方表示，火灾看起来确实很奇怪。

examples.text: Both the authorities and the media wondered whether insider dealing had been going on.
examples.translationZh: 官方跟媒体都在怀疑这里面是不是存在内幕交易。

meaningZh: 短语；成语；说法

examples.text: The new phrase is now on the tongue of men.
examples.translationZh: 这个新短语现在正十分流行。

examples.text: The teacher dictated the phrase to the class.
examples.translationZh: 老师让全班同学听写这个短语。

examples.text: He hashed a phrase in order to colour the sentence.
examples.translationZh: 他反复推敲一个习语以使该句增色。

meaningZh: 头发，毛发；（动、植物的）毛；一丝丝，些微

examples.text: I'll have my hair trimmed tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我要修剪头发。

examples.text: She wears her hair in a bun.
examples.translationZh: 她把头发盘成一个髻。

examples.text: Hair is easy to collect and convenient to store.
examples.translationZh: 毛发既容搜集又便于保存。

meaningZh: 意义；意思；重要性

examples.text: Few people realized the significance of the discovery.
examples.translationZh: 很少有人意识到这一发现的重要性.

examples.text: They failed to appreciate significance of the precautions.
examples.translationZh: 他们没有意识到这些预防措施的重要性。

examples.text: Our boss urged on us the significance of punctuality.
examples.translationZh: 老板向我们强调守时的重要性。

meaningZh: 超级的，极度的，过分的，超等的，极好的；面积的，平方的；n. 特级品，特大号商品

examples.text: Now that's absolutely super!
examples.translationZh: 这简直好极了。

examples.text: I bought some pomegranates in the super market.
examples.translationZh: 我在超市上买了一些石榴。

examples.text: I've discovered a super restaurant near here!
examples.translationZh: 我在附近找到一家一流的餐馆！

meaningZh: 专家，能手；权威；行家，高手

examples.text: She is a reputable expert.
examples.translationZh: 她是个有声望的专家。

examples.text: According to expert opinions, they gave up the experiment immediately.
examples.translationZh: 根据专家们的意见，他们马上放弃了这项试验。

examples.text: He is an expert in unarmed combat.
examples.translationZh: 他是徒手格斗的能手。

meaningZh: 攀登；爬；登山

examples.text: I have some climbing plants in the garden.
examples.translationZh: 我的花园里长着一些攀缘植物。

examples.text: We go to climb mountains every Sunday.
examples.translationZh: 每个星期天我们都去爬山。

examples.text: The road climbs steeply for several miles.
examples.translationZh: 这条路有几英里向上倾斜得很陡。

meaningZh: 女主人；（夜总会的）女招待；（电视或广播节目的）女主持人

examples.text: The hostess made her guests comfortable.
examples.translationZh: 女主人使客人们感到舒适自在。

examples.text: The hostess gave us a cordial greeting.
examples.translationZh: 女主人热忱地欢迎我们。

examples.text: You need a lot of tact to be an air hostess.
examples.translationZh: 当空中小姐言行需十分得体。

meaningZh: 在…的下方；（表示等级）低于；（表示状态）在…掩饰之下

examples.text: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.
examples.translationZh: 他们在一堆树叶下面发现了那具尸体。

examples.text: The earth lay beneath a blanket of snow.
examples.translationZh: 大地被厚厚的白雪覆盖。

examples.text: He is beneath his brother intellectually.
examples.translationZh: 他在智力方面不如他兄弟。

meaningZh: 秋；秋天；成熟期

examples.text: The autumn or winter term start in September.
examples.translationZh: 秋季或冬季学期九月份开始。

examples.text: Autumn crops promised to be equally good.
examples.translationZh: 秋季作物看来收成也会同样很好。

examples.text: The chill of autumn is in the air.
examples.translationZh: 秋天的寒意到处感觉得到。

meaningZh: 清洁剂；保洁员；吸尘器

examples.text: No, but we need a part-time cleaner.
examples.translationZh: 没有，不过我们需要非全日工作的清洁工。

examples.text: The cleaner dumped all the rubbish into a big bin.
examples.translationZh: 清洁工把所有垃圾倒入一个大桶里。

meaningZh: 使惊恐，使恐慌；吓走，赶走；vi. 害怕，惊恐

examples.text: It is illegal to frighten a pigeon.
examples.translationZh: 惊吓鸽子是违法的。

examples.text: They tried to frighten the public into obedience.
examples.translationZh: 他们企图吓唬群众使他们屈服。

examples.text: He frightened the old man into giving him all the money.
examples.translationZh: 他恐吓那位老人把所有的钱都给了他。

meaningZh: 决定；决心；解决

examples.text: That decided me to leave my job.
examples.translationZh: 那件事使我决定离职。

examples.text: A chance meeting decided my career.
examples.translationZh: 偶然的会面决定了我的事业。

examples.text: He decided to get married.
examples.translationZh: 他决定结婚。

meaningZh: （使）集中，（使）聚集；调整（镜头，眼睛）焦点[焦距]以便看清；vt. 调整（眼睛或者镜头的）焦距

examples.text: He always wants to be the focus of attention.
examples.translationZh: 他总想成为注意力的焦点。

examples.text: He took out the binoculars and adjusted the focus.
examples.translationZh: 他取出双筒望远镜并调整了焦距。

examples.text: The main focus of this manual is the management of fresh ground water resources.
examples.translationZh: 本指南的主要中心是地下淡水资源的管理。

meaningZh: 玩具，玩物；小装饰品；无实用价值的东西

examples.text: He was appointed to superintend the toy department.
examples.translationZh: 他获任玩具部的负责人。

examples.text: The child clutched his toy.
examples.translationZh: 那个孩子紧抓着他的玩具不放。

meaningZh: （常pl.）烟火，烟花；（热情，怒气等的）迸发

examples.text: Bang went the fireworks.
examples.translationZh: 焰火砰地爆开了。

examples.text: The firework exploded in a shower of sparks.
examples.translationZh: 烟火炸开放出一阵火花。

examples.text: They're a good team, but don't expect any fireworks.
examples.translationZh: 他们是一个很好的团队，但是不要期待有多大的热情。

meaningZh: 容器；箱，匣；集装箱，货柜

examples.text: A reactor is a container for chemical reaction.
examples.translationZh: 反应器是进行化学反应的容器。

examples.text: The volume of this container is 2 cubic meters.
examples.translationZh: 这个容器的容量是两立方米。

examples.text: The goods are packed in airtight container.
examples.translationZh: 货物被装在密封的集装箱内。

meaningZh: 家庭作业；功课

examples.text: He has done only a fraction of his homework.
examples.translationZh: 他只做了家庭作业的一小部分。

examples.text: I must finish my homework first.
examples.translationZh: 我必须首先做完家庭作业。

meaningZh: 而且；此外；以及

examples.text: No one writes to me besides you.
examples.translationZh: 除你以外，没有人给我写信。

examples.text: There will be five of us for dinner, besides John.
examples.translationZh: 除约翰外，还有我们五个人要一起吃饭。

examples.text: He has been to Mexico but nowhere besides.
examples.translationZh: 他曾去过墨西哥但没去过别的地方。

meaningZh: 平民，百姓；市民；文官

examples.text: He resigned his commission to take up a civilian job.
examples.translationZh: 他辞去军职而从事平民工作。

examples.text: People are indignant by their shooting of innocent civilians.
examples.translationZh: 对于他们枪杀无辜平民，人们感到义愤填膺。

examples.text: A civilian was killed by a stray bullet.
examples.translationZh: 一个平民被流弹打死。

meaningZh: 没有东西；没有事情；无关紧要的东西

examples.text: The sound faded into nothing.
examples.translationZh: 声音逐渐消失了。

examples.text: Two minus two leaves nothing.
examples.translationZh: 二减二等于零。

examples.text: His latest play is nothing.
examples.translationZh: 他的新戏一文不值。

meaningZh: 令人感兴趣的，有趣的；引起兴趣的；有趣的

examples.text: This book is interesting.
examples.translationZh: 这本书很有趣。

examples.text: There is an interesting program on television tonight.
examples.translationZh: 今天晚上有一个有趣的电视节目。

examples.text: She is an interesting person but her husband is a real nothing.
examples.translationZh: 她是个很有趣的人，但是她的先生却一无是处。

meaningZh: 诱骗；使受限制；困住

examples.text: The police set a trap to catch the thief.
examples.translationZh: 警察设下了捉拿窃贼的圈套。

examples.text: The only thing the wolf could do was climbing up to the ground from the trap.
examples.translationZh: 那只狼惟一能做的就是从陷阱里爬到地面上来。

examples.text: To break out of the poverty trap they need help from the government.
examples.translationZh: 为了摆脱贫困的处境，他们需要政府的帮助。

meaningZh: 幻想；空想的产物；幻想作品

examples.text: The young always live in a world of fantasy.
examples.translationZh: 年轻人总是生活在幻想中。

examples.text: He is unable to divorce fantasy from reality.
examples.translationZh: 他不能将幻想与现实分开。

examples.text: He fantasies himself a doctor.
examples.translationZh: 他想像自己是一位医生。

meaningZh: 达到，获得；遂愿；经过努力到达某事物

examples.text: We can attain whatever goal we set in our mind.
examples.translationZh: 我们设定了什么目标，就能实现什么目标。

examples.text: We should be able to attain that goal.
examples.translationZh: 我们应该能够实现这个目标。

examples.text: The country attained its independence in 1972.
examples.translationZh: 这个国家在1972年获得了独立。

meaningZh: 举起，抬起；vt. 举起；提升

examples.text: He was too weak even to lift his hand.
examples.translationZh: 他虚弱得连手都抬不起来。

examples.text: The helicopter lifted the entire team to the meet.
examples.translationZh: 直升飞机把全队空运到运动会现场

examples.text: She was caught lifting make-up from the supermarket.
examples.translationZh: 她在超级市场偷窃化妆品时被捉住了。（《牛津高阶英汉双解词典》）

meaningZh: 沙；沙滩；沙色

examples.text: Dry sand absorbs water.
examples.translationZh: 干沙吸收水份。

examples.text: Ouch! The sand is so hot! I can burn my feet.
examples.translationZh: 哎哟！沙子这么烫！会烫伤脚的。

examples.text: A grain of sand made my right eye tear.
examples.translationZh: 一粒沙子弄得我右眼淌泪。

meaningZh: 资格，授权；条件，限制；合格证书

examples.text: What sort of qualifications do you need for the job?
examples.translationZh: 做这项工作需要什么资格？

examples.text: He's got all the right qualifications but he is temperamentally unsuitable.
examples.translationZh: 他具备一切合格的条件,惟独性情不适合。

examples.text: The plan was approved without qualification.
examples.translationZh: 这项计划获得无条件批准。

meaningZh: 更喜欢；提升，提拔；给予（债权人）优先权

examples.text: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out on such a rainy day.
examples.translationZh: 在这种雨天，我宁可待在家也不出门。

examples.text: All this gracious living is not for me；I prefer the simple life.
examples.translationZh: 这种优裕的生活对我不合适；我还是更喜欢简朴的生活。

examples.text: Which one do you prefer, an apple or an orange?
examples.translationZh: 你想要哪个，苹果还是橘子？

meaningZh: 宽慰，安心；免除，减轻；救援物资

examples.text: The pills gave her some relief.
examples.translationZh: 药片减轻她一些痛苦。

examples.text: This medicine will give you quick relief.
examples.translationZh: 这种药将迅速解除你的病痛。

examples.text: A doctor's life is consecrated to the relief of suffering.
examples.translationZh: 医师的一生奉献于解除世人的疾苦。

meaningZh: 信誉，信用；[金融]贷款；荣誉

examples.text: Credit counseling helped us get out from under.
examples.translationZh: 信用咨询使我们免除了忧虑

examples.text: Where can I see my credit score?
examples.translationZh: 我在哪能看到我的信用分数?

examples.text: They are working hard for the credit of China.
examples.translationZh: 他们在为中国的荣誉而努力工作。

meaningZh: 多数；（获胜的）票数；成年

examples.text: The majority of people seem to prefer TV to radio.
examples.translationZh: 多数人喜欢电视胜过广播。

examples.text: Racism is abhorrent to the majority of people.
examples.translationZh: 种族主义是大多数人都憎恨的。

examples.text: The Democrats became the majority in the election.
examples.translationZh: 民主党在这次选举中变成了多数党。

meaningZh: （使）前进；将…提前；预付

examples.text: Advance in the jungle was very slow.
examples.translationZh: 在丛林中行进很慢。

examples.text: There have been great progresses in medicine in the past decade.
examples.translationZh: 在过去十年里,医学取得了巨大的进步。

examples.text: She asked for an advance on her salary.
examples.translationZh: 她请求预支薪水。

meaningZh: 狐,狐狸；狡猾的人

examples.text: The fox lay dying in a pool of gore.
examples.translationZh: 狐狸倒在血泊中奄奄一息。

examples.text: The fox went to ground under a rocky escarpment.
examples.translationZh: 狐狸钻进了石崖下面的洞里。

examples.text: He's a crafty old fox.
examples.translationZh: 他是一只狡猾的老狐狸。

meaningZh: 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油

examples.text: Gas is now widely used for cooking and heating.
examples.translationZh: 现在普遍用煤气烧饭和取暖。

examples.text: She lit the gas and gave the coffee another warm.
examples.translationZh: 她点燃煤气，把咖啡重新热了一下。

examples.text: Hydrogen and oxygen are gases.
examples.translationZh: 氢和氧是气体。

meaningZh: 篮球；[体]篮球运动

examples.text: We will play basketball tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 我们明天打篮球。

examples.text: The basketball players are working out at the gym.
examples.translationZh: 篮球运动员们正在体育馆进行训练。

examples.text: We are going to play neither basketball nor volleyball.
examples.translationZh: 我们既不将打篮球也不将打排球。

meaningZh: 暴力，强暴，暴虐；猛烈，激烈；歪曲（事实），曲解（意义）

examples.text: The wind blew with great violence.
examples.translationZh: 风异常猛烈地吹着。

examples.text: The violence of his words alarmed her.
examples.translationZh: 他言语上的猛烈使她产生了警觉。

examples.text: She slammed the door with violence.
examples.translationZh: 她砰的一声用力关上了门。

meaningZh: 人；（语法）人称；身体

examples.text: You are just the person I want to see.
examples.translationZh: 你正是我要见的人。

examples.text: He is a very nice person to work with.
examples.translationZh: 他是一个很好共事的人。

examples.text: Every person is accountable for his own work.
examples.translationZh: 每个人都要对自己的工作负责。

meaningZh: 前进地；向前；至将来

examples.text: He is forward in his English.
examples.translationZh: 他的英语有进步。

examples.text: We can see the forward part of the ship.
examples.translationZh: 我们可以看见船的前部。

examples.text: A little forward planning at the outset can save you a lot of expense.
examples.translationZh: 一开始就为未来作点打算能节约很多开支。

meaningZh: 离开，离去；起程；背离

examples.text: We made our departure in the early morning.
examples.translationZh: 我们一大早就起程了。

examples.text: All the arrangements should have been completed prior to our departure.
examples.translationZh: 全部安排都应该在我们出发之前完成。

examples.text: Her arrival coincided with our departure.
examples.translationZh: 她来到时我们正好离开。

meaningZh: 研讨班，讲习会；研讨小组；研讨会

examples.text: The old professor had presided over a seminar for theoretical physicists.
examples.translationZh: 老教授主持了一次理论物理学家的研讨会。

examples.text: I attended almost every lecture and seminar when I was at college.
examples.translationZh: 我上大学时,几乎每一个讲座和研讨会都去参加。

examples.text: He also told me that your attendance at his tutorial and seminar had was poor.
examples.translationZh: 他还告诉我说你的辅导课和讨论课出勤率不高。

meaningZh: （法国、瑞士、比利时等国的货币单位）法郎

examples.text: I need to change my dollars into francs.
examples.translationZh: 我需要把美金换成法郎。

examples.text: He give me two 10 franc coin in my change.
examples.translationZh: 他找给我两个10法郎的硬币。

examples.text: The ticket fare of the train for pairs is 77 Franc.
examples.translationZh: 去巴黎的火车票售价是77法郎。

meaningZh: 政府；政体；治理的形式

examples.text: The government will garrison the coastal towns.
examples.translationZh: 政府将派军驻守沿海的城镇。

examples.text: The government would not even consider his claim for money.
examples.translationZh: 政府甚至不考虑他的赔款要求。

examples.text: He is a man of some influence in the government circles.
examples.translationZh: 他是个在政府内有一定势力的人。

meaningZh: 基督教徒；信奉基督教的; 基督教的; 基督教徒的

examples.text: He is a pious Christian.
examples.translationZh: 他是一名虔诚的基督教徒。

examples.text: My husband is a Christian and I’m going to turn.
examples.translationZh: 我丈夫是基督徒，我也准备皈依基督教。

examples.text: The man was excommunicated from the Christian Church.
examples.translationZh: 那人被驱逐出基督教会。

meaningZh: 马拉松赛跑；长距离比赛；需要长时间努力或耐力的事件或活动

examples.text: It takes stamina to run a marathon.
examples.translationZh: 跑马拉松要有耐力。

examples.text: He can hardly run a mile, much less the marathon.
examples.translationZh: 他连一哩都跑不了，更不用说马拉松了。

examples.text: Towards the end of the marathon several runners showed signs of distress.
examples.translationZh: 马拉松赛接近终点时，有些参赛者显出极难受的样子。

meaningZh: 把…奉献（给），把…专用（于）；奉献

examples.text: You must devote your attention to your work.
examples.translationZh: 你必须专心于工作。

examples.text: After he graduated, he continued to devote himself to the research.
examples.translationZh: 毕业以后,他继续潜心于这项研究。

examples.text: He devoted himself entirely to music.
examples.translationZh: 他将一生奉献给了音乐。

meaningZh: 收割；收获季节；收成

examples.text: It happened that the harvest was bad in 1988.
examples.translationZh: 碰巧一九八八年的收成很糟。

examples.text: The fine summer harvest was not easily come by.
examples.translationZh: 夏季的好收成不是容易得来的。

examples.text: The harvest has been safely gathered in.
examples.translationZh: 庄稼已妥善收获完毕。

meaningZh: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.text: She clung to the hope that her son was still alive.
examples.translationZh: 她始终抱着儿子还活着的希望。

examples.text: Are your grandparents still alive?
examples.translationZh: 你的祖父母还在世吗？

examples.text: Although he is eighty, he is still very much alive.
examples.translationZh: 他虽有八十岁了，但仍然充满了活力。

meaningZh: 可能的；适合的；有希望的

examples.text: I'm likely to be very busy tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我可能很忙。

examples.text: They'll very likely ask for an increase in the budget.
examples.translationZh: 他们很可能会要求增加预算。

examples.text: I've heard whispers that the firm is likely to go bankrupt.
examples.translationZh: 我听到传闻说公司很可能要破产。

meaningZh: 营地，工地宿舍；阵营（指观点相同且与持不同观点者对立的集团）；兵营

examples.text: We're going to have a sports camp in the countryside during our summer vacation.
examples.translationZh: 暑假期间我们要在乡下搞一次运动野营。

examples.text: They spent the summer in a camp in the mountains.
examples.translationZh: 他们在山中野营度过夏天。

examples.text: The travellers set up a camp near the river.
examples.translationZh: 旅游者在河边架起了帐篷。

meaningZh: 倾向，趋势；（话或作品等的）旨趣，意向；性情

examples.text: There is a tendency towards regional cooperation.
examples.translationZh: 有一种地区性合作的趋势。

examples.text: There is a growing tendency for people to work at home instead of in offices.
examples.translationZh: 人们在家里而不是在办公室里工作的趋势日益增长。

examples.text: Today there is a tendency for people to opt out of social activity.
examples.translationZh: 现在,越来越多的人倾向于不参加社会活动。

meaningZh: 民族；人们；〈口〉家属，亲戚
