examples.text: A lot of folks are upset at the changes.
examples.translationZh: 许多人对这些变化感到不安。

examples.text: This is no place for young folk.
examples.translationZh: 这可不是年轻人该去的地方。

examples.text: The town folk know him as Mr. Dickey.
examples.translationZh: 镇上的人们都知道他是迪基先生。

meaningZh: 宇宙；天地万物；经验领域

examples.text: The universe exists in space.
examples.translationZh: 宇宙存在于太空。

examples.text: The depth of the universe is immeasurable.
examples.translationZh: 宇宙无限深广。

examples.text: The Earth is only one of the numerous planets in the universe.
examples.translationZh: 地球只是宇宙中众多星球中的一个。

meaningZh: 播（种），播种于；vt. 灌输；激起

examples.text: These seeds should be sown in April.
examples.translationZh: 这些种子应在四月播种。

examples.text: His words had sowed the seeds of suspicion in their minds.
examples.translationZh: 他的话已在他们心中播下怀疑的种子。

examples.text: The enemy tried to sow discontent among our men .
examples.translationZh: 敌人企图在我们的士兵中间散布不满情绪。

meaningZh: [化学]碳；（一张）复写纸；[电]碳精棒[片，粉]，碳精电极

examples.text: Carbon dioxide consists of carbon and oxygen.
examples.translationZh: 二氧化碳是由碳和氧组成的。

examples.text: He decided to use carbon because it does not melt.
examples.translationZh: 于是，他决定用碳，因为碳不易熔化。

examples.text: I make a carbon copy of my documents.
examples.translationZh: 我用复写纸复写文件。

meaningZh: 东方的，东部（地方）的；朝东的；来自东方的

examples.text: The eastern situation is similarly intense.
examples.translationZh: 东部的情况同样紧张。

examples.text: A road leads through the eastern commercial hub of Bukavu, Congo.
examples.translationZh: 一条马路穿过刚果布卡武东部的商业区。

examples.text: Eastern Gnosticism took a somewhat different course.
examples.translationZh: 东方的诺斯替派有些不同的实践。

meaningZh: 复制品；一份；（报刊等的）稿件

examples.text: The painting is a copy of one in the museum.
examples.translationZh: 这幅画是博物馆中的一幅画的复制品。

examples.text: He asked his secretary to make a copy of the document.
examples.translationZh: 他叫秘书把文件复制一份。

examples.text: This copy does not correspond with the original.
examples.translationZh: 这抄本与原件不符。

meaningZh: 日常饮食；规定饮食；vt.& vi. （使）节制饮食

examples.text: Too rich a diet (ie Too much rich food) is not good for you.
examples.translationZh: 吃太多油腻的食物对你身体不好。

examples.text: You should eat more high-protein diet.
examples.translationZh: 你应该多吃些高蛋白食物。

examples.text: Her diet restricts her to 1500 calories a day.
examples.translationZh: 她的规定饮食限制她每天摄入1500卡的热量。

meaningZh: 软件；软体；软设备

examples.text: There are many sorts of software in my computer.
examples.translationZh: 我的计算机里有很多软件。

examples.text: Some publishers are now diversifying into software.
examples.translationZh: 有些出版社目前正兼营软件。

examples.text: We deal in hardware but not software.
examples.translationZh: 我们只经营硬件而不经营软件。

meaningZh: 跑；移动；（使）流动

examples.text: The little boy ran off to get his brother.
examples.translationZh: 这个小男孩跑去找他的哥哥。

examples.text: We ran into port for supplies.
examples.translationZh: 我们驶进港口装补给品.

examples.text: I can't make this machine run properly.
examples.translationZh: 我无法使这部机器正常运转。

meaningZh: 宗教的；神圣的；受崇敬的，值得崇敬的

examples.text: In India the cow is a sacred animal.
examples.translationZh: 在印度，牛是神圣的动物。

examples.text: We use them to protect our sacred grounds.
examples.translationZh: 我们使用它们来保卫我们神圣的土地。

examples.text: Nothing is sacred to these wild youths.
examples.translationZh: 这些狂野的年轻人什么都不尊重。

meaningZh: 运输，输送；（旧时载客的）四轮马车；〈英〉火车客车车厢

examples.text: The carriage passed through the palace gate.
examples.translationZh: 马车进入了宫殿的大门。

examples.text: The carriage that he had ordered duly arrived, and we drove off.
examples.translationZh: 他叫的马车按时到，我们就坐上去走了。

examples.text: I'll be sitting in the 3rd carriage from the front of the train.
examples.translationZh: 我将坐在第三节车厢。

meaningZh: 代表；继任者；议员

examples.text: That representative brought forth an amendment to the press law.
examples.translationZh: 那位代表提出了一项对新闻法的修正案。

examples.text: A senator takes precedence over a Representative.
examples.translationZh: 参议员的地位高于众议员。

examples.text: The tiger is a representative of the cat family.
examples.translationZh: 老虎是猫科动物的典型。

meaningZh: 描述；形容；种类

examples.text: He gave a description of what he had seen.
examples.translationZh: 他描述了他所见到的一切。

examples.text: The scenery is beautiful beyond descriptions.
examples.translationZh: 那风景美丽得难以形容。

examples.text: He is very good at the description about the characters of different figures in his book.
examples.translationZh: 他非常擅长在书中刻画不同人物的性格。

meaningZh: 认可，同意；v. 赞成或同意；批准

examples.text: Okay Squirrel, you can play with us.
examples.translationZh: 你可以和我们一起玩儿。

examples.text: Is itl okay to stke in the office?
examples.translationZh: 在办公室里抽烟可以吗？

examples.text: Okay, alright, I was sharp shooting.
examples.translationZh: 行，好吧，我是锋利的射击。

meaningZh: （级别、地位等）较高的；资深的；年长的

examples.text: He is senior to me, though he is younger.
examples.translationZh: 他地位比我高，虽然他比我年轻。

examples.text: She was unfit for such a senior position.
examples.translationZh: 她不能胜任这样的高级职位。

examples.text: Lying north of the church is a girls' senior high school.
examples.translationZh: 位于这座教堂以北的是一所女子高中。

meaningZh: 围巾，领巾；嵌接；桌巾，台巾

examples.text: The price of this scarf is below ten dollars.
examples.translationZh: 这条围巾价格不到10美元。

examples.text: She twisted the long scarf round her head.
examples.translationZh: 她把那条长围巾围在头上。

examples.text: She threw a scarf over her shoulders.
examples.translationZh: 她在肩上披上一块肩巾。

meaningZh: 真的，真正的；可信的，可靠的；有根据的

examples.text: This is an authentic medieval sword.
examples.translationZh: 这是一把真正的中世纪剑。

examples.text: He found out the most authentic restaurants.
examples.translationZh: 他找到了最正宗的餐馆。

examples.text: The details of the costume were totally authentic.
examples.translationZh: 这件古装的每个小地方都完全真实。

meaningZh: 罪犯，犯人；adj. 刑事的；犯罪的

examples.text: The criminal was sentenced to prison for theft.
examples.translationZh: 那个犯人因偷窃被判入狱。

examples.text: Murder and stealing are criminal acts.
examples.translationZh: 谋杀和偷盗都是犯罪行为。

examples.text: I have no criminal record in my whole life.
examples.translationZh: 我一生无犯罪纪录。

meaningZh: 梦想；做梦；梦见

examples.text: I had some very strange dreams last night.
examples.translationZh: 昨晚我做了很奇怪的梦。

examples.text: I have a recurrent dream that I've turned into an elephant.
examples.translationZh: 我屡次梦见自己变成了大象。

examples.text: My son's dream is to be an astronaut.
examples.translationZh: 我儿子的理想是当宇航员。

meaningZh: 事件，大事；活动，经历；结果

examples.text: It was quite an event when a woman first became prime minister.
examples.translationZh: 首次由女人任首相倒是件大事。

examples.text: The new book was the cultural event of the year.
examples.translationZh: 这本新书的出版是今年文化界的大事。

examples.text: Don't get caught up in this event.
examples.translationZh: 不要卷入这个事件。

meaningZh: 攻击，进攻，抨击；n. 攻击；抨击

examples.text: The police are launching a major attack on drug dealers.
examples.translationZh: 警方对毒品贩子发动了大规模的攻击。

examples.text: His attack on the government was pure vitriol.
examples.translationZh: 他纯粹出于恶意抨击政府。

examples.text: The enemy attacked us at night.
examples.translationZh: 敌人在夜里向我们进攻。

meaningZh: 传达，表达；显示：清晰地揭示；表明

examples.text: He has communicated his wishes to me.
examples.translationZh: 他已经把他的愿望告诉了我。

examples.text: I like to communicate with my family.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢和我的家人沟通。

examples.text: The door communicates with my room.
examples.translationZh: 这门和我的房间相通。

meaningZh: 教室，课堂；教学活动，教学方法

examples.text: The classroom was crammed with students.
examples.translationZh: 教室里挤满了学生。

examples.text: Teachers rule in classroom teaching.
examples.translationZh: 在课堂教学中教师占主导地位。

examples.text: Don't confine your study only to the classroom.
examples.translationZh: 不要把自己的学习只局限于课堂。

meaningZh: 女主席，女议长

examples.text: The new chairwoman was very well-spoken.
examples.translationZh: 新上任的女主席很会说话。

examples.text: A suitable answer has already been put forward by the chairwoman.
examples.translationZh: 一个合适的解决办法已由女主席提出。

examples.text: The chairwoman started her working life on the shop floor.
examples.translationZh: 这位女董事长的职业生涯是从车间基层干起的。

meaningZh: 噪音；嘈杂声，喧闹声；声音，声响

examples.text: The loud noise from the nearby factory chafed him.
examples.translationZh: 附近工厂的噪声使他烦燥。

examples.text: The dog perked its ears at the noise.
examples.translationZh: 一听到噪声，狗就竖起了耳朵

examples.text: There is so much noise in this restaurant; I can hardly hear you talking.
examples.translationZh: 这个餐厅里太嘈杂了，我几乎听不到你说话。

meaningZh: 地区；区域，范围；面积，平地

examples.text: The farm has an area of 100 square kilometers.
examples.translationZh: 这个农场占地100平方公里。

examples.text: The area of the office is 35 square meters.
examples.translationZh: 办公室的面积是35平方米。

examples.text: This area has not been covered by the communication net.
examples.translationZh: 这个地区还不在通讯网的覆盖之内。

meaningZh: 地面，地板；楼层；底部

examples.text: Father asked me to flushed off the garage floor.
examples.translationZh: 父亲让我刷洗一下车库的地面。

examples.text: The floor was moist and slippery.
examples.translationZh: 地面潮湿而光滑。

examples.text: We put the books in piles on the floor.
examples.translationZh: 我们把书在地板上堆起来。

meaningZh: 运转；操作；经营

examples.text: It's too difficult for him to operate this new sophisticated machine.
examples.translationZh: 对他来说,操作这台复杂的机器太难了。

examples.text: The lift doesn't operate properly.
examples.translationZh: 这台电梯运转不正常。

examples.text: They operate three factories and a huge warehouse.
examples.translationZh: 他们经营三家工厂和一个大仓库。

meaningZh: 烦恼，忧虑；担心；撕咬

examples.text: The dog was worrying a rat.
examples.translationZh: 那条狗撕咬著一只老鼠。

examples.text: Don't worry her; she is busy.
examples.translationZh: 别去烦她，她很忙。

examples.text: The noise doesn't seem to worry them.
examples.translationZh: 这种嘈声好像并不影响他们。

meaningZh: 结束，终止；推断；议定

examples.text: From his appearance we may safely conclude that he is a chain smoker.
examples.translationZh: 从他的外表，我们可以有把握地断定他烟抽得很凶。

examples.text: The two countries are reported to have concluded a military convention.
examples.translationZh: 据报导,这两个国家已缔结军事协定。

examples.text: He conclude the negotiation with dispatch.
examples.translationZh: 他迅速结束谈判。

meaningZh: 面包房，面包店；烘烤食品（面包、糕点等的总称）

examples.text: The bakery serves us with fresh bread daily.
examples.translationZh: 面包店每天都给我们提供新鲜面包。

examples.text: We were in luck, for the bakery was still open.
examples.translationZh: 我们总算走运，面包店还开着。

meaningZh: 家乡，故乡；“home town”的变体

examples.text: I can come back to my hometown some day.
examples.translationZh: 总有一天我会回到家乡。

examples.text: His hometown is an insignificant city on the map.
examples.translationZh: 他的家乡只是地图上一个不起眼的小城。

examples.text: My hometown is in the upper reaches of the river.
examples.translationZh: 我的家乡在这条河的上游地区。

meaningZh: 岩,岩层；岩石,礁石；大石块,大圆石

examples.text: The ship struck on a rock and sank.
examples.translationZh: 船触礁沉没。

examples.text: The deer is standing on the edge of the rock.
examples.translationZh: 那只鹿正站在岩石的边缘。

examples.text: The 1970s were best known for rock music.
examples.translationZh: 20世纪70年代以摇滚乐而闻名。

meaningZh: 结论；结局；断定，决定

examples.text: I found the conclusion of her story very exciting.
examples.translationZh: 我觉得她那故事的结尾很激动人心。

examples.text: Some found the conclusion of the film Titanic very disappointing.
examples.translationZh: 有些人觉得电影《泰坦尼克号》的结尾是令人失望的.

examples.text: Your information is inaccurate and your conclusion is therefore wrong.
examples.translationZh: 你的信息不准确，所以你的结论是错误的。

meaningZh: 节省，俭省；不用，抽出，省掉；宽恕，饶（命），救命，使某人免遭（麻烦等）

examples.text: Do you have a spare tire?
examples.translationZh: 你有备用轮胎吗?

examples.text: Please stay with us. We have a spare room for you.
examples.translationZh: 请住下吧,我们有给你的备用房间。

examples.text: What do you like doing in your spare time?
examples.translationZh: 你在闲暇时喜欢做什么？

meaningZh: 代理人；代理商；药剂

examples.text: I have been instructed by my agent that you still owe me 100 pounds.
examples.translationZh: 我的代理人通知我，你还欠我100磅。

examples.text: The agent priced the house at the right level for the market.
examples.translationZh: 代理商按市场价格给这所房子定了价。

examples.text: This is a chemical agent that destroys plants or inhibits their growth.
examples.translationZh: 这是一种能除草或抑制其生长的化学药剂。

meaningZh: 伸开；展开；（使）传播

examples.text: The radio spread the news as soon as the accident happened .
examples.translationZh: 事故一发生,收音机就把这条消息传播出去了。

examples.text: The rumor was widely spread among the crowd.
examples.translationZh: 谣言在人群当中广泛地传播开来。

examples.text: She spread her wings and flew lightly down.
examples.translationZh: 她展开双翅轻轻飞下。

meaningZh: 吃，喝；vi. （食物）吃起来感到；咬

examples.text: I often eat oatmeal as breakfast.
examples.translationZh: 我经常吃燕麦粥当早饭。

examples.text: Do you always eat lunch at school?
examples.translationZh: 你总是在学校吃午饭吗？

examples.text: If you eat too much chocolate you'll get fat.
examples.translationZh: 吃巧克力太多会发胖。

meaningZh: 通常的，常有的，常见的；平常的，普通的；平时的，平日的

examples.text: My usual bedtime is nine o'clock.
examples.translationZh: 我通常九点钟上床睡觉。

examples.text: His speech followed the usual pattern.
examples.translationZh: 他按照通常的方式讲话。

examples.text: The vintage was later than usual.
examples.translationZh: 那次葡萄采收期比平常年份晚。

meaningZh: 箭,矢,箭状物；箭号,箭头

examples.text: The arrow just split the apple in half.
examples.translationZh: 箭把苹果分成两半。

examples.text: The arrow flew straight and true to its mark.
examples.translationZh: 那箭不偏不斜地直朝目标飞去。

examples.text: The bow twanged and the arrow whistled through the air.
examples.translationZh: 那张弓发出“崩”的一声,箭随之呼啸而去。

meaningZh: 广阔的；巨大的；大量的

examples.text: That is a vast and lavish party.
examples.translationZh: 那是个规模盛大、极其铺张的宴会。

examples.text: A vast crowd turned out to watch the match.
examples.translationZh: 大群的观众到场观看比赛。

examples.text: There is always a vast chasm between rich and poor.
examples.translationZh: 贫富的鸿沟始终存在。

meaningZh: 对…不忠；背叛；出卖

examples.text: He betrayed his country.
examples.translationZh: 他背叛了他的国家。

examples.text: He promised never to betray the organization.
examples.translationZh: 他发誓永不背叛组织。

examples.text: He was seduced to betray his friend.
examples.translationZh: 他受唆使而出卖朋友。

meaningZh: 录音机；直笛；记录员

examples.text: He works as a recorder in the city court.
examples.translationZh: 他在市法院当记录员。

examples.text: The recorder chalked it up as soon as the athlete beat a new record.
examples.translationZh: 运动员一打破记录，记录员就立即公布。

examples.text: Use Recorder to record keystrokes or mouse actions to play back later.
examples.translationZh: 用记录器记录击键或鼠标行为，以备后来播放。

meaningZh: 报告；成绩报告单；传闻

examples.text: He is reading a report of the state of the roads.
examples.translationZh: 他正在看一篇关于道路状况的报告。

examples.text: I have only reports to go on.
examples.translationZh: 我的依据只是谣传而已。

examples.text: My son got an excellent report last semester.
examples.translationZh: 我儿子上学期成绩出色。

meaningZh: 适应于，适应不同情况（或环境）(to)；vt. 改编，改写；改变…以适合(for)

examples.text: This novel has been adapted for radio from the Russian original.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说已由俄文原著改编成无线电广播节目。

examples.text: She adapted herself quickly to the new climate.
examples.translationZh: 她很快就适应了这种新气候。

examples.text: You must adapt to the norms of the society you live in.
examples.translationZh: 在社会中生活就要遵循社会行为准则。

meaningZh: 可视电话，电视电话，视像电话

examples.text: Your wristwatch videophone suddenly rings.
examples.translationZh: 突然，你手表上的可视电话响了。

examples.text: In the future, shopping can be done by videophone.
examples.translationZh: 在将来，购买东西能在可视电话中进行。

meaningZh: 牛仔裤；瘦腿紧身裤

examples.text: Every other girl except me is wearing jeans.
examples.translationZh: 除了我以外，其他姑娘都穿著牛仔裤。

examples.text: He wears an oily old pair of jeans.
examples.translationZh: 他穿着一条沾满油污的旧牛仔裤。

examples.text: Both my sister and I like to wear jeans.
examples.translationZh: 我姐姐和我都喜欢穿牛仔裤。

meaningZh: 逃脱；逃离；躲过

examples.text: The prisoner has escaped.
examples.translationZh: 犯人逃走了。

examples.text: To my surprise, he could escape from that big fire.
examples.translationZh: 令我惊讶的是,他能够从那场大火里逃脱出来。

examples.text: I had left England to escape from my own future.
examples.translationZh: 我离开英国是为了逃避自己的命运。

meaningZh: 少数；少数民族；未成年

examples.text: Only a minority of British households do not have a car.
examples.translationZh: 英国只有少数家庭没有汽车。

examples.text: A small minority voted against the motion.
examples.translationZh: 投票反对该提议的人占少数。

examples.text: The question of which state the minority group should belong to was decided by (a) plebiscite.
examples.translationZh: 该少数民族应归属哪一州的问题已由公民投票表决。

meaningZh: 理发店；理发店四重唱

examples.text: She opened up a barbershop of her own.
examples.translationZh: 她开了一个自己的理发店。

meaningZh: 忽视，忽略；瞭望；检查

examples.text: My room overlooked the garden.
examples.translationZh: 我的房间俯瞰花园。

examples.text: We overlook the church from our house.
examples.translationZh: 我们可从家中俯瞰教堂。

examples.text: My room overlooks the sea.
examples.translationZh: 从我的房间可眺望大海。

meaningZh: 工作室，画室；[影]演播室，电影制片厂

examples.text: Upstairs he has a studio where he paints a little.
examples.translationZh: 他在楼上有一个画室，有时在那里作一点画。

examples.text: I was talking to her in the studio.
examples.translationZh: 我那时正在工作室跟它谈话。

examples.text: The studio is being wired for sound.
examples.translationZh: 这个播音室正在安装音响设备用的电线。

meaningZh: 我们，咱们；笔者，本人；朕

examples.text: We have seen the film.
examples.translationZh: 我们已经看过这部电影。

examples.text: We are fully aware of the gravity of the situation.
examples.translationZh: 我们十分清楚形势的严峻性。

meaningZh: 鄙视地说；嗅；深深吸入

examples.text: The dog was sniffing at the lamppost.
examples.translationZh: 那条狗在街灯柱旁嗅来嗅去。

examples.text: They are training these dogs to sniff out drugs.
examples.translationZh: 他们训练狗嗅出毒品来。

examples.text: His generous offer is not to be sniffed at.
examples.translationZh: 对他的慷慨厚意不可嗤之以鼻。

meaningZh: 幼儿园，学前班

examples.text: It is noisy in the kindergarten.
examples.translationZh: 幼儿园里很嘈杂。

examples.text: These children hit it off well in the kindergarten.
examples.translationZh: 这些小孩在幼儿园里相处得很好。

examples.text: The nurse walked the children out of the kindergarten.
examples.translationZh: 保育员把孩子们带出了幼儿园。

meaningZh: 资料，材料；datum的复数；[计算机]数据，资料

examples.text: The data should be updated once a week.
examples.translationZh: 这些数据应该每星期更新一次。

examples.text: In Name, type a name for the data source.
examples.translationZh: 在“名称”中,为数据源键入名称。

examples.text: Very little data is available.
examples.translationZh: 现有的资料十分不足。

meaningZh: 消遣（方式）；娱乐（方式）；重建，重现

examples.text: In other words, we had better take sufficient recreation to relax after work.
examples.translationZh: 换句话说，我们最好工作后，消遣消遣来轻松一下。

examples.text: Art is both creation and recreation.
examples.translationZh: 艺术是创作，同时也是消遣。

examples.text: Some films combine education with recreation .
examples.translationZh: 有些影片把教育同娱乐融合在一起。

meaningZh: 复杂的；难懂的；复合的

examples.text: It was a complex problem.
examples.translationZh: 这是一个复杂的问题。

examples.text: This enhances the complex flavors and bouquet of the wine.
examples.translationZh: 这加强了酒的合成的味道。

examples.text: Complex briary fruit with smoldering oak.
examples.translationZh: 有复合的水果香和烟熏橡木香。

meaningZh: 秘密的；机密的；表示信任的

examples.text: He has been on confidential missions to Berlin.
examples.translationZh: 他前往柏林执行秘密任务。

examples.text: He told me the confidential information.
examples.translationZh: 他向我透露了这个秘密的信息。

examples.text: He was an author whose works were so little known as to be almost confidential.
examples.translationZh: 他这位作家的著作是如此不为人所知，以致几乎等于机密文件。

meaningZh: 习惯，习性；气质；宗教服装

examples.text: He is in the habit of rising early.
examples.translationZh: 他有早起的习惯。

examples.text: I have to bear with his bad habit.
examples.translationZh: 我不得不忍受他的坏习惯。

examples.text: My colleague has broken off the habit of smoking.
examples.translationZh: 我的同事已经戒掉了吸烟的习惯。

meaningZh: 抱有希望的；给人以希望的；n. 有成功希望的人

examples.text: I'm hopeful that they'll fulfil the task on time.
examples.translationZh: 他们会按时完成任务，对这一点，我是抱有希望的。

examples.text: I am very hopeful that we will be able to reach an agreement.
examples.translationZh: 大家都作一点让步，那么达成协议很有希望的。

meaningZh: 近似地，大约；许

examples.text: The plane will be taking off in approximately five minutes.
examples.translationZh: 飞机大约五分钟后就起飞。

examples.text: Approximately it has 400 pages when this book is completed.
examples.translationZh: 当这本书完成时大约有四百页。

examples.text: There were approximately fifty people there.
examples.translationZh: 那儿大约有五十个人。

meaningZh: 爸爸；爹；甜心爸爸（在年轻女子身上乱花钱的阔老头）

examples.text: I've lost my daddy, ' the little boy cried/sobbed/wept/whimpered/wailed.
examples.translationZh: ｀我找不到爸爸了，＇小孩哭著[抽抽搭搭地/哭哭啼啼地/呜呜咽咽地/痛哭流涕地]说。

examples.text: Because of the age difference, Rosemary's older companion had the reputation of being a sugar daddy.
examples.translationZh: 因为年龄的差异，罗斯玛丽的老男友有在少女身上滥花钱的老色迷之名声。

examples.text: `Give me a ride on your shoulders, Daddy.'
examples.translationZh: ｀爸爸，让我在你肩膀上骑一会儿吧.

meaningZh: 键盘；琴键；电子琴

examples.text: The computer has a normal qwerty keyboard.
examples.translationZh: 这台计算机有标准的英文键盘。

examples.text: You will be asked to choose your keyboard layout.
examples.translationZh: 将让你选择键盘布局。

examples.text: You can type in the command with a keyboard.
examples.translationZh: 你可以用键盘输入命令。

meaningZh: 福利；幸福；繁荣

examples.text: The welfare of the individual is bound up with the welfare of the community.
examples.translationZh: 个人的福利与社会的福利有着密切的关系。

examples.text: These are matters that bear on the welfare of the community.
examples.translationZh: 这些都是与社会福利有关的问题。

examples.text: The government decided to promote public welfare.
examples.translationZh: 政府决定发展公共福利。

meaningZh: 扫帚；金雀花；[无线]自动搜索干扰振荡器

examples.text: We use broom to sweep the floor.
examples.translationZh: 我们用扫帚扫地。

examples.text: He picked up the broom to help me sweep the floor.
examples.translationZh: 他拿起扫帚帮我扫地。

examples.text: He stopped sweeping and rested on the broom.
examples.translationZh: 他停止扫地，倚着扫帚休息。

meaningZh: 完美的；正确的；优秀的

examples.text: Laurel was a perfect girl in every way.
examples.translationZh: 从各方面讲，罗拉都是一个完美的女孩。

examples.text: No one expects you to be perfect, but we do expect you to do your best always.
examples.translationZh: 没人指望你完美无缺，但是我们盼望你永远尽最大的努力。

examples.text: One day being perfect health is much.
examples.translationZh: 获得一天完全的健康也不算少。

meaningZh: 同样的，相似的；adv. 同样地；两者都，同样地

examples.text: We are much alike in character.
examples.translationZh: 我们的性格很相似。

examples.text: The two brothers are very much alike.
examples.translationZh: 这两兄弟非常相像。

examples.text: The sisters are as alike as two peas.
examples.translationZh: 两姐妹长得一模一样。

meaningZh: 故意地；深思熟虑地；从容不迫地

examples.text: You have deliberately acted against my wishes.
examples.translationZh: 你故意和我的想法对著干。

examples.text: He's being deliberately obtuse.
examples.translationZh: 他装糊涂。

examples.text: She had deliberately shifted our relations.
examples.translationZh: 她故意地改变了我们的关系。

meaningZh: 冰；雪糕；冷淡

examples.text: The bird picked a hole in the ice with its beak.
examples.translationZh: 那鸟在冰上啄出了一个洞。

examples.text: The ice cracked as I stepped onto it.
examples.translationZh: 我一踩冰就裂了。

examples.text: The boy especially likes the ice on the cake.
examples.translationZh: 那个男孩特别喜欢吃蛋糕上的糖霜。

meaningZh: 小提琴家；小提琴演奏者

examples.text: The drummer doubles in brass as a violinist.
examples.translationZh: 这鼓手还是一个小提琴手。

meaningZh: 注意；布告；警告

examples.text: He walked so fast that he didn't notice his wife.
examples.translationZh: 他走得太快了,连他夫人都没注意到。

examples.text: I notice you aren't quite convinced.
examples.translationZh: 我感到你还不太相信。

examples.text: As soon as your application is approved, I will personally notice you.
examples.translationZh: 核发登记证时我会通知您。

meaningZh: 分析；分解；细察

examples.text: He analysed the food and found that it contained poison.
examples.translationZh: 他对这种食物做了化验，发现有毒。

examples.text: Let's analyse the problem and see what went wrong.
examples.translationZh: 让我们分析一下这道题，看什么地方出错了。

examples.text: The coach tried to analyse the cause of our defeat.
examples.translationZh: 教练努力设法分析我们失败的原因。

meaningZh: 车库；汽车修理站；飞机库

examples.text: He sent his car to the garage for repair.
examples.translationZh: 他把汽车送到修车厂修理。

examples.text: My car broke down and had to be towed to a garage.
examples.translationZh: 我的汽车出故障了，得拉到修理厂去。

examples.text: There is a garage built onto the side of the house.
examples.translationZh: 这所房子的一侧建有一个车库。

meaningZh: 整洁的，整齐的；（数量）相当大的；相当好的

examples.text: She keeps her house very tidy.
examples.translationZh: 她保持她的住所整整齐齐。

examples.text: They sat in her neat and tidy kitchen.
examples.translationZh: 他们坐在她那干净整齐的厨房里。

examples.text: He has a tidy mind.
examples.translationZh: 他的思维有条理。

meaningZh: 愉快；娱乐；令人高兴的事

examples.text: She took no pleasure in her work.
examples.translationZh: 她觉得自己的工作毫无乐趣。

examples.text: I will remember this meeting with pleasure.
examples.translationZh: 我会愉快地记着这次的会晤。

examples.text: She seemed to take pleasure in our suffering.
examples.translationZh: 她似乎对我们的痛苦幸灾乐祸。

meaningZh: 使惊奇；突袭；意外发现

examples.text: John turned around and looked at me in surprise.
examples.translationZh: 约翰转过身来,惊奇地望着我。

examples.text: It was a great surprise to learn of her marriage.
examples.translationZh: 得知她结婚是一件十分令人惊喜的事。

examples.text: I tried to conceal my surprise when she said she was only 22.
examples.translationZh: 当她说她只有22岁时,我尽力掩饰自己的惊讶。

meaningZh: 短的，短暂的；矮的；短缺的

examples.text: You've cut my hair very short.
examples.translationZh: 你把我头发剪得太短了。

examples.text: In contrast with his brothers, Tom is rather short.
examples.translationZh: 与几位兄弟相比,汤姆的个子相当矮。

examples.text: Let's take a short break for lunch.
examples.translationZh: 让我们休息一会儿，去吃午饭。

meaningZh: 等候室，候诊室，候车室

examples.text: We were shown into the waiting room.
examples.translationZh: 我们被领进等候室。

examples.text: She's been sitting in the waiting room since two-thirty.
examples.translationZh: 自两点半她就坐在等候室了。

examples.text: There's always plenty to read in the waiting room.
examples.translationZh: 候诊室里总是有许多可供阅读的。

meaningZh: 剃刀，刮面刀；vt. 剃；用剃刀刮

examples.text: He shaved his face with a razor.
examples.translationZh: 他用剃刀刮脸。

examples.text: He was honing his razor although it's very sharp.
examples.translationZh: 尽管他的剃刀十分锋利了，可他还是不停地磨它。

examples.text: This electric razor is our latest promotion.
examples.translationZh: 这种电剃刀是我们的最新产品。

meaningZh: 误会，误解；曲解

examples.text: They pretend to misunderstand my complaint.
examples.translationZh: 他们假装误解了我的投诉。

examples.text: His remarks show that he misunderstood my position on the question.
examples.translationZh: 他的话说明他误解了我在这一问题上的立场。

examples.text: He wrote her a letter for fear she misunderstand him.
examples.translationZh: 他给她写了封信，免得她误会。

meaningZh: 东，东方；东方国家；〈诗〉东风

examples.text: Take the east road, it's the shortest way.
examples.translationZh: 走东边这条路吧,这是最近的路。

examples.text: He traveled east.
examples.translationZh: 他向东旅行。

examples.text: China is in the east of the world.
examples.translationZh: 中国位于世界的东方。

meaningZh: 从…落下；离开；从…去掉

examples.text: The singer was led off the stage by the maestro.
examples.translationZh: 歌唱家由那位著名的指挥领着离开了舞台。

examples.text: Off campus, they faced hostility.
examples.translationZh: 在校园之外，他们遭人敌意。

examples.text: The plane took off and ascended steadily until it was out of sight.
examples.translationZh: 飞机起飞之后平稳地逐渐升空直到消失在视野之外。

meaningZh: 安全；安全性；安全处所

examples.text: The new car design incorporates all the latest safety features.
examples.translationZh: 新的汽车设计具备最新安全措施的一切特点。

examples.text: The safety of the ship is the captain's responsibility.
examples.translationZh: 确保船只的安全是船长的责任。

examples.text: The management took all reasonable safety precautions.
examples.translationZh: 管理部门采取了一切合理的安全措施。

meaningZh: 小说家

examples.text: I dreamed of becoming a novelist.
examples.translationZh: 我梦想成为一个小说家。

examples.text: He was an unknown novelist then.
examples.translationZh: 当时他是位不出名的小说家。

examples.text: I put her in the top rank of modern novelist.
examples.translationZh: 我把她看做是当代第一流的小说家。

meaningZh: 出价，投标；努力争取；喊价

examples.text: She bid 500 for the painting.
examples.translationZh: 她喊价500买这幅画。

examples.text: Several firms have bid for the contract to build the new concert hall.
examples.translationZh: 有几家公司投标，争取建造新音乐厅的合同。

examples.text: Several companies are bidding for the contract to build the bridge.
examples.translationZh: 有几家公司在投标争取承包建桥工程。

meaningZh: （反身代词）她自己；（用以加强语气）她亲自，她本人

examples.text: She kept on muttering to herself.
examples.translationZh: 她老是一个人嘀嘀咕咕。

examples.text: She braided her hair by herself.
examples.translationZh: 她自己梳辫子。

examples.text: After her swim she dried herself with a towel.
examples.translationZh: 游泳后，她用毛巾擦干身子。

meaningZh: 种族的；人种的；存在或发生于种族之间的

examples.text: We should not have racial discrimination.
examples.translationZh: 我们不该有种族歧视。

examples.text: This hatred was generated by racial prejudice.
examples.translationZh: 这种仇恨是由种族偏见引起的。

examples.text: Genuine racial equality still seems light-years away.
examples.translationZh: 真正的种族平等似乎仍遥遥无期。

meaningZh: （使）适合；安装；合身

examples.text: I don't see fit to tell you all my plans.
examples.translationZh: 我认为把所有的计划都告诉你是不适宜的。

examples.text: The soil is fit for cotton planting.
examples.translationZh: 这种土壤适宜种棉花。

examples.text: The room was a fit place for study.
examples.translationZh: 这个房间适宜读书。

meaningZh: 出口，输出；vt. 传播，输出（思想或活动）；n. 输出，出口

examples.text: Prohibition was laid on the export of coal.
examples.translationZh: 禁止煤炭输出。

examples.text: The company's gearing up for the big export drive.
examples.translationZh: 公司正为大规模输出作好准备。

examples.text: Consultancy, insurance and tourism are also parts of the export trade.
examples.translationZh: 咨询,保险及旅游也是出口贸易的一部分。

meaningZh: 方便，便利；便利设施；个人的舒适或利益

examples.text: It's a great convenience to live in town.
examples.translationZh: 住在城市里有很大的方便。

examples.text: I stock upon grocery at the convenience store.
examples.translationZh: 我到便利商店买食品备用。

examples.text: The hotel combines comfort with convenience.
examples.translationZh: 这家旅馆既舒适又方便。

meaningZh: 报酬；报答；赏金

examples.text: An act of kindness deserves a reward.
examples.translationZh: 做好事,当然要有报答。

examples.text: By rights, half the reward should be mine.
examples.translationZh: 按理说，有一半奖赏应该是我的。

examples.text: You have received a just reward.
examples.translationZh: 你已得到了应有的报酬。

meaningZh: 散文；随笔，杂记文；尝试，企图

examples.text: This essay is admirable in all respects.
examples.translationZh: 这篇文章在各方面都很值得欣赏。

examples.text: I had turn over my essay to the professor.
examples.translationZh: 我已经把论文交给教授了。

examples.text: This essay represents a considerable improvement on your recent work.
examples.translationZh: 这篇论文说明你最近的工作取得了相当大的改进。

meaningZh: 切，切开；雕刻；创制，开创

examples.text: The statue was carved out of marble.
examples.translationZh: 这座雕像是用大理石雕刻的。

examples.text: We will look for a pumpkin, to carve into a jack-o-lantern.
examples.translationZh: 我们将要找一颗南瓜来雕刻成南瓜灯。

examples.text: He carved me some very nice pieces of chicken.
examples.translationZh: 他为我切了几块很好的鸡肉。

meaningZh: 屋顶，房屋；最高部，顶部；最高限度

examples.text: The wind was whispering in the roof.
examples.translationZh: 屋顶上风声飒飒。

examples.text: Has your roof a sharp slant?
examples.translationZh: 你的屋顶是否有一个陡峭的斜面？

examples.text: Snow sifted through the crack in the roof into the room.
examples.translationZh: 雪从屋顶上的裂缝飘进屋里。

meaningZh: 相反的；违反的，反对的；对立的

examples.text: Hot and cold are contrary terms.
examples.translationZh: 热与冷是相反的词语。

examples.text: My sister's taste in dresses is contrary to my own.
examples.translationZh: 在服装方面，我妹妹的爱好和我完全不同。

examples.text: Mrs. Smith is too contrary to make friends easily.
examples.translationZh: 史密斯太太过于固执而不易交朋友。

meaningZh: 细菌（复数为bacteria）

examples.text: Most of disease is caused from bacterium.
examples.translationZh: 大多数疾病都是由细菌引起的。

examples.text: A bacterium was identified as the cause for his duodenal ulcer.
examples.translationZh: 一种细菌被断定为造成他十二指肠溃疡的根源。

meaningZh: 豌豆，豌豆类；豌豆状物；〈美俚〉棒球

examples.text: This kind of pea has a long pod.
examples.translationZh: 这种豌豆长着长豆荚。

examples.text: Pea pods burst open when overripe.
examples.translationZh: 豌豆过熟就会爆裂。

examples.text: We have a bowl of very salty pea and ham soup.
examples.translationZh: 我们喝了一碗非常咸的豌豆火腿汤。

meaningZh: 某一；必然的；已确定的

examples.text: It's certain that every effect must have a cause.
examples.translationZh: 无疑，每个结果必定有其原因。

examples.text: I can tell you for certain that I am always honest.
examples.translationZh: 我可以肯定地告诉你, 我一向是老实的。

examples.text: Certain things are still open to discussion.
examples.translationZh: 有些事还需要商量。

meaningZh: 社会主义者；adj. 社会主义的；社会党的

examples.text: The state protects socialist public property.
examples.translationZh: 国家保护社会主义的公共财产。

examples.text: They all support socialist policies.
examples.translationZh: 他们都拥护社会主义的政策。

examples.text: He is a socialist.
examples.translationZh: 他是一位社会主义者。

meaningZh: 发音，读；vt. 宣布，宣称；演讲，讲述

examples.text: I don't know how to pronounce this word.
examples.translationZh: 我不知道这个单词怎么发音。

examples.text: People pronounce the word differently in this part of the country.
examples.translationZh: 在国内这一地区，这个单词的发音不同。

examples.text: The doctors pronounced that he was no longer in danger.
examples.translationZh: 医生宣称他已脱离危险。

meaningZh: 欲望；胃口，食欲；嗜好，爱好

examples.text: She is suffering from lack of appetite.
examples.translationZh: 她食欲不振。

examples.text: The long walk has given me a good appetite.
examples.translationZh: 走了长路使我食欲大振。

examples.text: Mary has no appetite for hard work.
examples.translationZh: 玛丽不想干艰苦的工作。

meaningZh: 故事，传说；历史，沿革；内情

examples.text: The story stirred her sympathy.
examples.translationZh: 这故事激起了她的同情心。

examples.text: The story took place in a serene summer night.
examples.translationZh: 故事发生在一个宁静的夏夜。

examples.text: This novel has been developed out of a folk story.
examples.translationZh: 这部小说脱胎于民间传说。

meaningZh: 适当地；恰当地；正确地

examples.text: He has disposed of the rubbish properly.
examples.translationZh: 他已经适当地处理了垃圾。

examples.text: The heater in my car doesn't work properly.
examples.translationZh: 我汽车里的暖气设备出了点毛病。

examples.text: I'm learning German, but I still can't speak it properly.
examples.translationZh: 我正在学习德语，但还说不好。

meaningZh: [生]恐龙；守旧落伍的人，过时落后的东西

examples.text: The blue whale is bigger than the biggest dinosaur.
examples.translationZh: 蓝鲸比最大的恐龙还要大。

examples.text: We reconstructed what the dinosaur looked like from a few of its bones.
examples.translationZh: 我们根据恐龙的一些骨头重组恐龙的原貌。

examples.text: His movie of the extinction of dinosaurs was a great success.
examples.translationZh: 他的关于恐龙灭绝的电影取得了巨大的成功。

meaningZh: 对不起的；无价值的，低等的；遗憾的

examples.text: I'm frightfully sorry, but I can't see you today.
examples.translationZh: 太对不起了，我今天不能见你。

examples.text: I'm sorry to obtrude on you at such a time.
examples.translationZh: 我很抱歉在这个时候打扰你。

examples.text: Don't feel sorry about the broken glass.
examples.translationZh: 别再为那打破的杯子难过了。

meaningZh: 产生；出现；起身，起立

examples.text: An opportunity has arisen.
examples.translationZh: 机会来了。

examples.text: Tell our comrades to keep calm when problems arise.
examples.translationZh: 告诉同志们遇事要沉着。

examples.text: Notice what emotions arise within you.
examples.translationZh: 注意到在你内心升起的情绪。

meaningZh: 使满意，满足；vt. 使确信；符合，达到（要求、规定、标准等）

examples.text: Some people are very hard to satisfy.
examples.translationZh: 有些人是很难使其满意的。

examples.text: We always satisfy our customers with good service.
examples.translationZh: 我们总是以良好的服务来满足顾客。

examples.text: We must satisfy the people's needs.
examples.translationZh: 我们要满足人民的需要。

meaningZh: 于是，因此；如此，这样，像这样，例如；到这程度，到这地步，这么

examples.text: Hold the wheel in both hands, thus.
examples.translationZh: 用双手握住方向盘

examples.text: The text runs thus.
examples.translationZh: 原文如此。

examples.text: He forgot to turn on the radio and thus missed the program.
examples.translationZh: 他忘了打开收音机，因此错过了那个节目。

meaningZh: 幸存，生存；幸存者；遗物

examples.text: Hopes are fading for the survival of the missing climbers.
examples.translationZh: 失踪的登山者幸存的希望越来越渺茫。

examples.text: The miraculous survival of some people in the air crash was widely reported by the press.
examples.translationZh: 空难事件中有些人大难不死被新闻界广泛报导。

examples.text: She is the only survival in the accident.
examples.translationZh: 她是事故中的惟一幸存者。

meaningZh: 交响乐，交响曲；序曲，插曲；〈古〉和谐，和谐的东西

examples.text: The first movement of the symphony is beautiful.
examples.translationZh: 这部交响乐的第一乐章是很优美的。

examples.text: I like listening to the symphony.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢听交响乐。

meaningZh: 疾病；弊端；不安

examples.text: The disease is still in its primary stage.
examples.translationZh: 这疾病仍然在初发阶段。

examples.text: The entire population was wiped out by the terrible disease.
examples.translationZh: 所有的居民都被可怕的疾病夺去了生命。

examples.text: The rapid spread of the disease is alarming the medical authorities.
examples.translationZh: 这种疾病的迅速蔓延使医疗当局感到忧虑不安。

meaningZh: 服务，服侍；服务业；维修服务

examples.text: The volunteers for community service are doing a good job.
examples.translationZh: 社区服务的义工做得很出色。

examples.text: We all complain about the poor service in the hotel coffee lounge.
examples.translationZh: 我们都抱怨饭店咖啡休息室的劣质服务。

examples.text: You must run fast enough to return his service.
examples.translationZh: 你必须要跑得很快才可能接起他的发球。

meaningZh: 点,小圆点

examples.text: We are all fellow passengers on a dot of earth.
examples.translationZh: 我们都是一小块土地上的过客。

examples.text: The ship became a mere dot on the horizon.
examples.translationZh: 船在远处的水平线上成了一个小点。

examples.text: On the map towns were marked by a red dot.
examples.translationZh: 在地图上，城镇是用小红点标出的。

meaningZh: 歌剧；歌剧艺术， 歌剧业；作品( opus的名词复数 )

examples.text: Have you heard the opera sung in French?
examples.translationZh: 你听过用法语唱的这场歌剧吗？

examples.text: Opera houses were packed out whenever she was singing.
examples.translationZh: 她一演唱剧院就满座。

examples.text: That opera singer has good lungs.
examples.translationZh: 那位歌剧演员声音宏亮。

meaningZh: 天气， 气象；暴风雨；vt.& vi. 晒干， 风化

examples.text: What is the weather like today?
examples.translationZh: 今天天气情况怎样？

examples.text: The meteorologist drew a picture of the weather.
examples.translationZh: 气象学者画了一张气象图。

examples.text: The past years had known him in many weathers.
examples.translationZh: 过去的岁月里,他起起落落。

meaningZh: 版次，版本；（报纸、杂志的）一份；（广播、电视节目的）一期

examples.text: The second edition greatly improves on the first edition.
examples.translationZh: 第二版比第一版好了许多。

examples.text: It has just entered the seventh edition.
examples.translationZh: 它刚出版了第七版。

examples.text: This edition of the dictionary is sold out.
examples.translationZh: 这个版本的字典已售完了。

meaningZh: [宗]教堂；[宗]教徒；[宗]教派

examples.text: Church begins at 9 o' clock.
examples.translationZh: 礼拜仪式9点开始。

examples.text: Christians go to church on Sundays.
examples.translationZh: 基督教徒每个星期日到教堂去做礼拜。

examples.text: Everyone in church knelt in prayer.
examples.translationZh: 教堂里每个人都跪着祈祷。

meaningZh: 接来（某人）；使发出；吸引

examples.text: Fetch me the tape from my drawer.
examples.translationZh: 请把我抽屉里的磁带取来。

examples.text: Shall I fetch your coat for you?
examples.translationZh: 我去把上衣给你取来好吗?

examples.text: This house should fetch a good price.
examples.translationZh: 这所房子应该卖个好价钱。

meaningZh: 纸；文件；论文

examples.text: That paper has yellowed with age.
examples.translationZh: 那张纸因年代久远而泛黄了。

examples.text: The letter was written on a single sheet of paper.
examples.translationZh: 这封信只用一张纸写成。

examples.text: He refused to subscribe his name to the paper.
examples.translationZh: 他拒绝在这文件上签字。

meaningZh: 在户外；向户外；n. 户外

examples.text: There is intolerable noise outdoors.
examples.translationZh: 门外是难以忍受的嘈杂声。

examples.text: Though it is cold, the children are playing outdoors.
examples.translationZh: 虽然天气冷,但孩子们仍在户外玩。

examples.text: Cuildren usually prefer playing outdoors.
examples.translationZh: 孩子们通常喜欢在野外玩耍。

meaningZh: 增加；补充；附带说明

examples.text: If you add 4 to 5, you get 9.
examples.translationZh: 四加五等于九。

examples.text: If the tea is too strong, add some hot water to it.
examples.translationZh: 如果茶太浓,加点开水。

examples.text: He added some wood to increase the fire.
examples.translationZh: 他加了一些木柴，使火旺些。

meaningZh: 过剩的；多余的；n. 剩余额

examples.text: Mexico has a large surplus of oil.
examples.translationZh: 墨西哥有大量过剩的石油。

examples.text: Countries with surplus are called creditor nations.
examples.translationZh: 有顺差的国家则称为债权国。

examples.text: Surpluses of food can be sold for cash.
examples.translationZh: 多余的食物可卖钱。

meaningZh: 一起；向前；进展

examples.text: We walked along the road.
examples.translationZh: 我们沿着路走。

examples.text: The procession passed along the street.
examples.translationZh: 游行队伍沿着街道前进。

examples.text: You can go straight along this street to the traffic light.
examples.translationZh: 你可以顺着这条街一直走到红绿灯处。

meaningZh: 工资；报应；vt.& vi. 实行，进行，作（战等）

examples.text: A postman's wages are 180 per week.
examples.translationZh: 邮递员的工资为每周180英镑。

examples.text: In our family both my husband and I are wage earners.
examples.translationZh: 在我们家里，丈夫和我都挣工资。

examples.text: In order to circumvent the straitjacket of national wage rates, employers in many cities offer non-pecuniary rewards to their workers.
examples.translationZh: 为了避免全国工资率的约束，许多城市的雇主不以金钱的形式付给工人报酬。

meaningZh: 妈咪

examples.text: If it is Mommy, it must be hugged.
examples.translationZh: 如果它是妈咪，我一定要抱抱它。

examples.text: Mommy made many muffins this morning.
examples.translationZh: 妈咪今天早上做了很多松饼。

meaningZh: 侥幸的，幸运的；带来幸运的，吉利的；n. 有好运的人

examples.text: It's fortunate you didn't forget.
examples.translationZh: 幸好你没忘。

examples.text: The girl was fortunate enough to have her mother as a bosom friend.
examples.translationZh: 这个女孩非常幸运，她的妈妈是她的知心朋友。

examples.text: The couple forfeited their independence in order to help those less fortunate.
examples.translationZh: 这对夫妇把富裕出的钱都拿出来帮助那些受难的人。

meaningZh: 释义 宾果游戏；太好了，好极了

examples.text: I'll hazard a dollar on the bingo game.
examples.translationZh: 我在这局宾果游戏上赌一元钱。

examples.text: It is now available at Bingo Runner.
examples.translationZh: 它现在是可利用的在宾果游戏赛跑者。

meaningZh: 纤维；性格；硬纸板纤维板

examples.text: The ribbon of the rifle is fabricated with fibre.
examples.translationZh: 来复枪的带子是用纤维制作的。

examples.text: Scientists are recommending that people eat more fibre.
examples.translationZh: 科学家建议人们多吃些纤维素。

examples.text: We have produced a cloth made of pineapple fibre, closely resembling.
examples.translationZh: 我们生产出了一块由菠萝纤维制成的衣料,很像棉布但质地更结实。

meaningZh: 云；云状物；一团

examples.text: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 云是天空中的水汽团。

examples.text: When there are black clouds you can tell it's going to rain.
examples.translationZh: 有乌云的时候，就知道快下雨了。

examples.text: His sudden departure cast a cloud upon our scheme.
examples.translationZh: 他的突然离去给我们的计划投下一层阴影。

meaningZh: 鹰；鹰状标志；[高]比标准杆少两杆的分数

examples.text: The eagle held a mouse in its claws.
examples.translationZh: 鹰用爪抓住了老鼠。

examples.text: The eagle dived down on the rabbit.
examples.translationZh: 那只鹰向兔子猛扑下来。

examples.text: The eagle poised in mid-air ready to swoop on its prey.
examples.translationZh: 那鹰在半空中盘旋准备扑向猎物。

meaningZh: 洋；海洋；大海

examples.text: These creatures live in the depth of the Pacific Ocean.
examples.translationZh: 这些生物生活在太平洋的海底。

examples.text: The day's drive still left us a hundred miles short of the ocean.
examples.translationZh: 我们整天驱车，但离大海还有100英里。

examples.text: It's almost impossible to find him in the immense ocean.
examples.translationZh: 在无边无际的海洋中要找到他几乎是不可能的。

meaningZh: 牛，公牛；牛属动物

examples.text: An ox pulls a wagon into the village.
examples.translationZh: 有只牛拉着一台四轮车进入村庄。

examples.text: The frequent, unreasonable whips angered the ox.
examples.translationZh: 这种经常而无理的鞭打激怒了牛。

examples.text: Farm owner feeds the ox with the wheat.
examples.translationZh: 农场主用麦子喂牛。

meaningZh: 因此；所以；故

examples.text: He was the only candidate; therefore, he was elected.
examples.translationZh: 他是唯一的候选人，因此，他当选了。

examples.text: We do not have enough money. Therefore we can not afford to buy the new car.
examples.translationZh: 我们的钱不够,因此买不成这辆新车。

examples.text: I was ill, and therefore I could not come.
examples.translationZh: 我病了,所以没能来。

meaningZh: 事实，实情；实际；真相，证据

examples.text: This is an objective fact no one can deny.
examples.translationZh: 这是谁也无法否认的客观事实。

examples.text: Before we make detailed plans, we need some more facts and figures.
examples.translationZh: 我们需要更多的事实和数据才能制定出详细的计划。

examples.text: I can find out the truth of the fact.
examples.translationZh: 我能查出事实的真相。

meaningZh: 全体员工；（与复数动词连用）人员，员工；人事部门

examples.text: The personnel are not happy to change these rules.
examples.translationZh: 全体工作人员对改变这些规定很不高兴。

examples.text: The company's main problem is the shortage of skilled personnel.
examples.translationZh: 这家公司的主要问题是缺少有技术的人员。

examples.text: Army personnel are often forbidden to fraternize with the civilian population.
examples.translationZh: 军职人员常被禁止与平民百姓友好往来。

meaningZh: 使负重担；消耗精力；向…征税

examples.text: She was fined for tax evasion.
examples.translationZh: 她因逃税而被罚款。

examples.text: Her accountant was good at exploiting tax loopholes.
examples.translationZh: 她的会计善于利用税收漏洞。

examples.text: The care of six children is a tax on her energy.
examples.translationZh: 照料六个孩子成了她精力上很大的负担。

meaningZh: 粘贴；张贴；插入

examples.text: A walking stick is a must for me now.
examples.translationZh: 如今我行走离不开手杖了。

examples.text: We made the fire out of dry sticks.
examples.translationZh: 我们用干柴枝来生火。

examples.text: Hold the stick against crosswind.
examples.translationZh: 向侧风方向压住杆。

meaningZh: 纪念碑；遗迹；遗址

examples.text: The monument was fronted with stone.
examples.translationZh: 纪念碑的正面是石料做的。

examples.text: Nelson's Column is a famous monument in London.
examples.translationZh: 纳尔逊纪念碑是伦敦著名的纪念碑。

examples.text: The monument is in honor of a scientist.
examples.translationZh: 那座纪念碑是为纪念一位科学家而建的。

meaningZh: 处罚；严厉对付；贪婪地吃喝

examples.text: The teacher blazoned she would punish the bad student.
examples.translationZh: 老师宣布她将惩罚那个坏学生。

examples.text: Their teacher punished them for their rudeness.
examples.translationZh: 老师因为他们态度粗鲁而责罚他们。

examples.text: Dangerous driving should be severely punished.
examples.translationZh: 危险驾驶应受严惩。

meaningZh: 上升；增强；（数量）增加

examples.text: The sun heats the earth, causing the air to rise and the winds to blow.
examples.translationZh: 太阳给地球热量,引起空气上升,刮起风来。

examples.text: The higher we rise, the smaller we appear to those who do not know how to fly.
examples.translationZh: 我们上升得越高,我们在那些不懂飞翔的人眼里就显得越遥远。

examples.text: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
examples.translationZh: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

meaningZh: 硕士；主人（尤指男性）；大师

examples.text: The dog remained faithful to his master.
examples.translationZh: 这条狗始终忠于它的主人。

examples.text: I can be a master of myself in learning.
examples.translationZh: 我可以做自我学习上的主人。

examples.text: He is a Master of Science.
examples.translationZh: 他是理科硕士。

meaningZh: 联系,关系；连接,接合,结合；有息债券

examples.text: An industrial firm issues bond to collect money and will pay back with interest.
examples.translationZh: 工厂发行债券集资并偿还利息。

examples.text: Marriage should be a permanent bond.
examples.translationZh: 婚姻应该是永恒的结合。

examples.text: We entered into a solemn bond.
examples.translationZh: 我们缔结了一项正式协定。

meaningZh: 几乎，差不多；险乎

examples.text: Nearly all of them kept aloof from such doctrines.
examples.translationZh: 他们几乎都不接受这种教条。

examples.text: That fever nearly finished him off.
examples.translationZh: 那场热病几乎送了他的命。

examples.text: He plays golf nearly every weekend.
examples.translationZh: 他差不多每个周末都打高尔夫球。

meaningZh: 失业；失业率；失业状况

examples.text: Mass unemployment may lead to social upheaval.
examples.translationZh: 大批失业会导致社会动乱。

examples.text: The specter of unemployment haunted the land.
examples.translationZh: 失业的恐怖笼罩全国。

examples.text: The decrease in unemployment was 30 percent.
examples.translationZh: 失业人数减少了百分之三十。

meaningZh: 心，心脏；感情；要点

examples.text: My heart was thumping with excitement.
examples.translationZh: 我激动得心怦怦跳。

examples.text: Mr Jones has a long history of heart trouble.
examples.translationZh: 琼斯先生有长期的心脏病史。

examples.text: He has a kind heart.
examples.translationZh: 他心地善良。

meaningZh: 同意，赞同；vi. [语]一致，符合；商定，约定

examples.text: We agreed to leave at once.
examples.translationZh: 我们同意立即离开。

examples.text: I, for my part, totally agree with you.
examples.translationZh: 至於我,我完全同意你的看法。

examples.text: I didn't agree from the very beginning.
examples.translationZh: 我从一开始就不赞成。

meaningZh: 家具；设备；附属品

examples.text: We will buy some furniture for our new house.
examples.translationZh: 我们得给我们的新房子买些家具。

examples.text: This old table is a valuable piece of furniture.
examples.translationZh: 这张旧桌子是一件很珍贵的家具。

examples.text: The antique furniture was made in 1700.
examples.translationZh: 这件古老的家具是1700年制造的。

meaningZh: 同一的；相同的，同样的；pron. 同一事物

examples.text: He praised my work and in the same breath told me I would have to leave.
examples.translationZh: 他称赞我工作好，刚说完这话就让我离职。

examples.text: I resigned on Friday and left that same day.
examples.translationZh: 我星期五辞职後当天就离开了。

examples.text: Father sits in the same chair every evening.
examples.translationZh: 父亲每晚都坐在同一张椅子上，

meaningZh: 搜寻，搜索；调查；搜查

examples.text: Search!
examples.translationZh: 搜索！
examples.author: LeviHighway

meaningZh: 关心；担心；照顾

examples.text: It makes me feel good that you care about me.
examples.translationZh: 你关心我,我感到很高兴。

examples.text: She will care for the children while I am away.
examples.translationZh: 我不在的时候,她会照顾那些孩子。

examples.text: He doesn't care for fish.
examples.translationZh: 他不喜欢吃鱼。

meaningZh: 仆人，佣人，雇工；[美]奴仆，奴隶；官吏，公务员，服务员

examples.text: Satan is still a servant of God.
examples.translationZh: 撒旦仍是上帝的奴仆。

examples.text: The servant enjoyed his master's confidence.
examples.translationZh: 这仆人深得主人的信赖。

examples.text: He is a humble and submissive servant.
examples.translationZh: 他是个恭顺的仆人。

meaningZh: 成熟的；（智力、思想、行为）成熟的；成年人的

examples.text: Child who is not accompanied by an adult will not be admitted.
examples.translationZh: 儿童无成人带领不得入内。

examples.text: The bear was a fully grown adult.
examples.translationZh: 那只熊已完全发育成熟.

examples.text: He spent his adult life in Canada.
examples.translationZh: 他在加拿大度过了他的成年时期。

meaningZh: 欢乐,高兴；乐事,乐趣

examples.text: He is in immeasurable joy.
examples.translationZh: 他沉浸在巨大的欢乐之中。

examples.text: I saw the joy in her smiling face.
examples.translationZh: 从她的笑脸上我看到欢欣。

examples.text: Tears of joy streamed down her face.
examples.translationZh: 喜悦的泪水从她的脸上流下来。

meaningZh: 一半的，半个的；n. 半；一半

examples.text: Half of them are here.
examples.translationZh: 半数人来了。

examples.text: At best we can do only half as much as last year.
examples.translationZh: 我们至多只能做到去年的一半。

examples.text: The game didn't heat up until the second half.
examples.translationZh: 游戏玩到后半场才热闹起来。

meaningZh: 国家；国民；乡下

examples.text: China is a developing country.
examples.translationZh: 中国是一个发展中国家。

examples.text: After many years abroad, he wanted to return home to his country.
examples.translationZh: 在国外多年后，他想回到故乡。

examples.text: The country is very green in spring.
examples.translationZh: 春天的时候，乡村一片青葱碧绿。

meaningZh: 意思，意义；含义；意图

examples.text: These words are empty of meaning.
examples.translationZh: 这些话毫无意义。

examples.text: This battle is of historic meaning.
examples.translationZh: 这一战具有历史意义。

examples.text: I can't apprehend your meaning.
examples.translationZh: 我不明白你的意思。

meaningZh: 物理学；物理现象；物理成分

examples.text: He does well in physics.
examples.translationZh: 他的物理学得很好。

examples.text: I prefer chemistry to physics.
examples.translationZh: 我喜欢化学甚于物理。

examples.text: She majored in maths and physics at university.
examples.translationZh: 她在大学期间主修数学和物理。

meaningZh: 顺从，服从；甘受，忍受；vt. 使服从，使顺从

examples.text: We will submit ourselves to the court's judgement.
examples.translationZh: 我们服从法庭的判决。

examples.text: We have to submit ourselves to discipline.
examples.translationZh: 我们必须遵守纪律。

examples.text: He submitted his proposal for urban development to the city council.
examples.translationZh: 他将城市发展建议提交市议会。

meaningZh: 生活，生计；生命，性命；一生，寿命

examples.text: Surely, I will keep the secret for my whole life.
examples.translationZh: 当然,我会一生保守这个秘密。

examples.text: He had a car accident and his life was in danger.
examples.translationZh: 他遭遇车祸,有生命危险。

examples.text: I prefer country life to city life.
examples.translationZh: 我喜爱乡村生活,不喜爱城市生活。

meaningZh: 视觉的，看得见的；光学的，视力的；形象化的

examples.text: Her designs have a strong visual appeal.
examples.translationZh: 她的设计在视觉上很有感染力。

examples.text: He has a good visual memory.
examples.translationZh: 他有良好的视觉记忆力。

examples.text: His failed to pass his visual test.
examples.translationZh: 他没有通过他的视力测试。

meaningZh: [C]愿望,欲望,心愿；vt. 要求,请求；vt. 期望,渴望

examples.text: I am filled with the desire to go back home.
examples.translationZh: 我心中充满了回家的渴望。

examples.text: Young people have no desire to work for the government.
examples.translationZh: 年轻人没有在政府部门工作的意愿。

examples.text: Her desire to dominate other people has caused trouble in her family.
examples.translationZh: 她想支配他人的欲望在家庭中引起了麻烦。

meaningZh: 城镇，市镇；小村庄；城镇居民

examples.text: The town was invaded by reporters.
examples.translationZh: 这个城市涌进了大批记者。

examples.text: It's a great convenience to live in town.
examples.translationZh: 住在城市里有很大的方便。

examples.text: Would you rather live in a town, or in the country?
examples.translationZh: 你愿意住在城市还是乡下？

meaningZh: 挑选；认为…比其它更可取；决定或选定

examples.text: It's up to you to choose where we should go.
examples.translationZh: 我们要去的地点,由你负责选择。

examples.text: He will choose banking as his career.
examples.translationZh: 他将选择银行业做为职业。

examples.text: He chose not to go home until later.
examples.translationZh: 他决定晚一点才回家。

meaningZh: 癌症，恶性肿瘤；弊病，社会恶习；迅速蔓延的恶劣的或危险的事物

examples.text: He was afflicted with cancer.
examples.translationZh: 他患了癌症。

examples.text: The patient finally died from cancer.
examples.translationZh: 那位病人最终死于癌症。

examples.text: He's got a cancer in his liver.
examples.translationZh: 他得了肝癌。

meaningZh: 自主的；不相关连的；无党派的

examples.text: The former colonial possessions are now independent states.
examples.translationZh: 以前的许多殖民地现已成为独立的国家。

examples.text: You should learn to be independent of your parents.
examples.translationZh: 你应该学习不要依赖父母。

examples.text: Two independent investigators have reached virtually the same conclusions.
examples.translationZh: 两个调查人员各自做出的结论简直完全一致。

meaningZh: 飓风，十二级风；飓风般猛烈的东西；（感情等的）爆发

examples.text: The hurricane destroyed the whole village.
examples.translationZh: 飓风把整个村子都毁掉了。

examples.text: The hurricane screamed outside.
examples.translationZh: 外面飓风呼啸著。

examples.text: The hurricane has a speed of 73 miles per hour.
examples.translationZh: 飓风每小时73英里。

meaningZh: 使结合；使化合；兼有

examples.text: Two parties will combine to defeat the third.
examples.translationZh: 两党派将联合以击败第三党。

examples.text: We can't always combine work with pleasure.
examples.translationZh: 我们并不总是能在工作中享受到乐趣。

examples.text: He combines creative imagination and true scholarship.
examples.translationZh: 他同时具有创造性想象力和真正的治学谨严学风。

meaningZh: 候选人；应试者；申请人

examples.text: There are three candidates for the vacancy.
examples.translationZh: 这一空缺有三名候选人。

examples.text: She had been nominated as candidate for the presidency.
examples.translationZh: 她已被提名为总统候选人。

examples.text: He made several favorable comments about their candidate.
examples.translationZh: 他对他们的候选人发表了一些有利的评论。

meaningZh: 乒乓球

examples.text: He drubbed his opponent in the table tennis match.
examples.translationZh: 他在乒乓球比赛中大胜对手。

examples.text: Yes, table tennis is an Olympic sport.
examples.translationZh: 是的，乒乓球是奥运项目。

meaningZh: 绷带；vt. 用绷带绑扎

examples.text: The nurse eased away the bandage from the wound.
examples.translationZh: 护士小心翼翼地解开伤口处的绷带。

examples.text: I twisted the bandage round her knee.
examples.translationZh: 我用带缠住了她的膝盖。

examples.text: The waitress put a bandage round his hand.
examples.translationZh: 女服务员用绷带将他的手包扎起来。

meaningZh: 害怕的；担心的；恐怕

examples.text: I'm afraid we can't come.
examples.translationZh: 很抱歉，我们不能来。

examples.text: I'm afraid I didn't quie catch what you said.
examples.translationZh: 对不起,我没听清你刚才所说的话。

examples.text: I didn't mention it because I was afraid of upsetting him/afraid (that) I might upset him.
examples.translationZh: 我没有提起那件事，因为我怕他心烦意乱。

meaningZh: 体贴的，体谅的；深思熟虑；到

examples.text: It was considerate of you to bring me my raincoat.
examples.translationZh: 你为我带来雨衣,真是想得周到。

examples.text: It is considerate of you to call on your relatives from time to time.
examples.translationZh: 你时时拜望亲戚很周到啊。

examples.text: He is no more considerate of others than his brother is.
examples.translationZh: 他不体谅别人，就跟他弟弟一样。

meaningZh: 都市的；具有城市或城市生活特点的；市内

examples.text: In some developing countries more and more people are migrating to urban areas.
examples.translationZh: 在某些发展中的国家,越来越多的人向市区迁移。

examples.text: The quality of urban living has been damaged by excessive noise levels.
examples.translationZh: 城市生活的质量已被过度的噪音所破坏。

examples.text: You can find out many advantages in urban life.
examples.translationZh: 你会发现都市生活中有许多便利之处。

meaningZh: 学期；条款；术语

examples.text: Are there any exams at the end of this term?
examples.translationZh: 这个学期期末有考试吗？

examples.text: I am not familiar with chemical terms.
examples.translationZh: 我不熟悉化学术语。

examples.text: Another firm has offered more advantageous terms than yours.
examples.translationZh: 另一家公司提出的条件比你们的优惠。

meaningZh: 吟颂，咏唱；反复有节奏地喊叫（或唱等）；n. 咏唱，咏唱的话语

examples.text: Surviving books which contain complete written repertories of the chant with music do not appear before the tenth century, and are well established in the eleventh.
examples.translationZh: 一些保存下来的古书中完整记载着十世纪音乐还没出现前的圣歌和在十一实际已经很好的配上音乐的圣歌。

examples.text: What we call Gregorian chant today first appears distinctly in the Roman repertory of the fifth and sixth centuries.
examples.translationZh: 我们现在说的格立高圣歌最早清楚的出现在5和6世纪的罗马剧目中。

examples.text: The chant of the crowd was "Work for all".
examples.translationZh: 群众反复有节奏地呼喊的是"给大家工作"。

meaningZh: 欠…债；感激；应归功于

examples.text: I gotta get back there, I owe it to them.
examples.translationZh: 我要回到那,我欠他们的。

examples.text: Incidentally, I think you still owe me some money.
examples.translationZh: 顺便说一句, 我想你还欠我一些钱。

examples.text: I owe you one.
examples.translationZh: 我欠你一个人情。

meaningZh: 感觉，官能；意识，观念；理性

examples.text: I lost my sense of taste.
examples.translationZh: 我丧失了味觉。

examples.text: I had the sense that he was worried about something.
examples.translationZh: 我感觉他有心事。

examples.text: I'm afraid I haven't got a very good sense of directions, so I easily get lost.
examples.translationZh: 恐怕我的方位感很差，因此我容易迷路。

meaningZh: 良心；道德心

examples.text: She was afflicted with conscience.
examples.translationZh: 她受良心责备。

examples.text: The thief's conscience smote him.
examples.translationZh: 那个贼突然良心发现。

examples.text: She gave him back the money she'd stolen for the sake of her conscience.
examples.translationZh: 为了不受良心的谴责，她把从他那偷来的钱还给他了。

meaningZh: 保护；护照；[经]保护贸易制，保护政策

examples.text: He's devoted his whole life to the protection of the rare animals.
examples.translationZh: 他终生献身于珍稀动物的保护。

examples.text: She put on dark glasses as a protection against the strong light.
examples.translationZh: 她戴上墨镜以防强光的照射。

examples.text: She subscribes to an animal protection society.
examples.translationZh: 她捐款给一个动物保护协会。

meaningZh: 建筑物；楼房；房屋

examples.text: The heat had blistered the paint of the building.
examples.translationZh: 酷热使建筑物上的油漆起了浮泡。

examples.text: The building faces north.
examples.translationZh: 这栋建筑物朝北。

examples.text: The building does not conform to safety regulations.
examples.translationZh: 这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

meaningZh: 烟；吸烟；vi. 冒烟

examples.text: The stove let out a puff of smoke.
examples.translationZh: 炉子里冒出一股烟。

examples.text: The smoke from chimney is spreading out in the sky.
examples.translationZh: 烟囱冒出的烟正在空中散开。

examples.text: The smoke of the burning house could be seen many blocks away.
examples.translationZh: 着火的房子的冒出的烟在几个街区外都能看到。

meaningZh: 一致；舆论；一致同意，合意

examples.text: The two parties have reached a consensus.
examples.translationZh: 这两个政党达成了一致意见。

examples.text: It would be a good idea to predict which proposal is most likely to achieve consensus.
examples.translationZh: 不妨研究一下哪项提案最有可能获得一致同意。

examples.text: Yet the events of the past two years have called that consensus in question.
examples.translationZh: 然而,过去两年来发生的各种事件使人们对这一共识产生了疑虑。

meaningZh: 野餐郊游；供野餐吃的食品；猪的肩肉

examples.text: Let's go for a picnic by the riverside.
examples.translationZh: 我们到河边野餐去吧。

examples.text: We had a lot of fun at the picnic on the beach.
examples.translationZh: 我们在海滩上野餐，趣味无穷。

examples.text: It's no picnic having to look after 6 small children all day.
examples.translationZh: 整天照看6个小孩子可不是轻松愉快的事。

meaningZh: 时间；时刻；时代

examples.text: Only time will tell if you are right.
examples.translationZh: 只有时间才能证明你是否正确。

examples.text: Reading occupies most of my free time.
examples.translationZh: 阅读占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

examples.text: I referred to my watch for the exact time.
examples.translationZh: 我看了一下手表好知道准确的时间。

meaningZh: 混合，混杂；混杂的事物[人群]；混合（状态）

examples.text: You need a spoon to beat the mixture smooth.
examples.translationZh: 你需要用一把调羹来搅均混合液。

examples.text: Air is a mixture, not a compound of gases.
examples.translationZh: 空气是气体的混合物，不是化合物。

examples.text: The bottom layer is a mixture of sand and clay.
examples.translationZh: 最下面的一层是沙和泥的混合物。

meaningZh: 住处；适应；便利

examples.text: There travelling students found accommodation at moderate terms.
examples.translationZh: 旅游的学生们感到那儿的膳宿费是公道的。

examples.text: If labour and management don't reach an accommodation there will be a strike.
examples.translationZh: 如果劳资双方达不成妥协，就会发生罢工。

examples.text: We can provide accommodation for six people at a push.
examples.translationZh: 如情况需要，我们可以安排六个人的住处。

meaningZh: 坚决主张；提出理由证明；说服，劝告

examples.text: We argued her into joining us.
examples.translationZh: 我们说服她参加了宴会。

examples.text: The United States should, he argues, attempt to remain aloof.
examples.translationZh: 他认为，美国应保持超然态度。

examples.text: As we've seen, the experts argue about which diet is best.
examples.translationZh: 正如我们所看见,而专家们争论,是最好的饮食。

meaningZh: 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动

examples.text: She hurried to the airport.
examples.translationZh: 她匆匆赶往机场。

examples.text: He picked up his bag and hurried off along the platform.
examples.translationZh: 他拿起提包沿着站台匆忙地走了。

examples.text: Don't let anyone hurry you into making a decision.
examples.translationZh: 不要在任何人的催促下匆促作出决定。

meaningZh: 有效的；有法律效力的；正当的

examples.text: Please provide a valid screen name.
examples.translationZh: 请输入有效的显示名。

examples.text: A credit card is not a valid proof of identity.
examples.translationZh: 银行发的支票保付卡不是有效的身份证明文件。

examples.text: Whether or not you believe the lawsuit is fair or valid, it is vital that you act on the summons.
examples.translationZh: 无论这起诉讼是否是公平的或者是有根据的，认真对待传票对当事人来说是至关重要的。

meaningZh: 紫色的；帝王的；词藻华美的

examples.text: The plant has a brilliant purple floweret.
examples.translationZh: 那棵植物开着鲜艳的小紫花。

examples.text: That girl likes to wear purple dresses.
examples.translationZh: 那个女孩喜欢穿紫色的衣服。

examples.text: He used to write purple prose.
examples.translationZh: 他过去常写绚丽矫饰的散文。

meaningZh: 例子；榜样；范例

examples.text: It is a classic example of how not to design a new city centre.
examples.translationZh: 这对设计新市中心是个最佳的反面教材。

examples.text: This church is a classic example of medieval architecture.
examples.translationZh: 这座教堂是中世纪建筑风格的典型实例。

examples.text: Her diligence has set an example to the others.
examples.translationZh: 她的勤奋为其他人树立了榜样。

meaningZh: 小路，路；路线，路程；〈比喻〉（人生的）道路

examples.text: A bullet describes a curved path in the air.
examples.translationZh: 子弹在空中作曲线运动。

examples.text: We bumped up and down along the gravel path.
examples.translationZh: 我们沿砾石小路颠簸而行。

examples.text: They went out for a walk on the gravelled path.
examples.translationZh: 他们在碎石小径上散步。

meaningZh: 使用；完成（困难的事）；经营

examples.text: He managed the company when his father was away.
examples.translationZh: 他父亲离开的时候,由他管理公司。

examples.text: The success of the restaurant lies in that it is well managed.
examples.translationZh: 这个餐厅的成功在于它的完善经营。

examples.text: I shall be able to manage it without help.
examples.translationZh: 我一个人能行。

meaningZh: 水；雨水；海水

examples.text: The rain water drips from the roof.
examples.translationZh: 雨水从屋顶滴下来。

examples.text: I satisfied my thirst with a glass of water.
examples.translationZh: 我喝了一杯水解渴。

examples.text: Oceania is a separate landmass, but it is separated from Asia by very shallow water.
examples.translationZh: 大洋洲是一块单独的陆地,但它与亚洲之间只隔着很浅的海域。

meaningZh: （飞机上的）女服务员，空中小姐

examples.text: An airline passenger is talking to the stewardess in-flight about a briefcase he has left behind.
examples.translationZh: 一位旅客正和女乘务员谈话，讲他遗失了公事包，忘了带上飞机。

meaningZh: 限制；限量，限度；界限

examples.text: Her ambition knows no limit.
examples.translationZh: 她的野心没有限度。

examples.text: I'll help as much as I can, but there is a limit to what I can do.
examples.translationZh: 我会尽力帮忙，但我所能做的也是有限度的。

examples.text: His speech ran over the time limit.
examples.translationZh: 他的讲话超过了规定的时间限制。

meaningZh: 渡船；渡口；摆渡

examples.text: There's a good duty-free shop (ie one selling such goods) on the ferry.
examples.translationZh: 渡船上有个挺不错的免税商店。

examples.text: The sway of the ferry made him feel sick.
examples.translationZh: 渡船摇摇晃晃，他感到恶心。

examples.text: We crossed the river by ferry.
examples.translationZh: 我们坐渡船过了河。

meaningZh: 色拉

examples.text: It only takes a minute to make a salad.
examples.translationZh: 做色拉用不了多少时间。

examples.text: I think I'll go for the fruit salad.
examples.translationZh: 我想我还是要水果色拉吧。

examples.text: Onions must be chopped up to make a salad.
examples.translationZh: 要做凉拌菜得把洋葱剁碎。

meaningZh: 国籍；国家；民族性

examples.text: She has dual nationality.
examples.translationZh: 她有双重国籍。

examples.text: She storied about her nationality.
examples.translationZh: 她谎报自己的国籍。

examples.text: There are two main nationalities in our village.
examples.translationZh: 我们村子有两大民族。

meaningZh: 田,地,牧场；(作某种用途的)场地,场所；(矿物的)产地

examples.text: Many farmers are working in the fields.
examples.translationZh: 许多农民在田里干活。

examples.text: He has become famous in his own field.
examples.translationZh: 他在自己的领域里已经出名了。

examples.text: The crowd cheered as the teams entered the field.
examples.translationZh: 球队入场时观众们为之欢呼。

meaningZh: 建造，构筑；建立；开发

examples.text: That house is built of bricks.
examples.translationZh: 那座房子是砖造的。

examples.text: They planed to build a new laboratory.
examples.translationZh: 他们计划建造一个新的实验室。

examples.text: It is not an easy task to build a business.
examples.translationZh: 创业并不是一件容易的事情。

meaningZh: 动物园；（铁路货车的最后一节）守车；核粒子园

examples.text: He saw some amazing sights at the zoo.
examples.translationZh: 他在动物园里看到一些珍禽异兽。

examples.text: Did you see any elephants in the zoo last week?
examples.translationZh: 上星期你在动物园里看到大象了吗？

examples.text: I'll meet you at the entrance of the zoo tomorrow.
examples.translationZh: 明天我会在动物园的入口处和你见面。

meaningZh: 羽毛，翎毛；状态，心情；种类

examples.text: Feather is very light, so that we say "as light as a feather".
examples.translationZh: 羽毛很轻，因此我们说“轻如鸿毛”。

examples.text: A feather floated down on the wind.
examples.translationZh: 一根羽毛随风飘落。

examples.text: The peacock displayed its fine tail feather.
examples.translationZh: 那只孔雀展现其美丽的尾部羽毛。

meaningZh: 无条件的，绝对的；无限制的；无保留的

examples.text: Discharge may be conditional or unconditional.
examples.translationZh: 解除责任可以是有条件或无条件的。

examples.text: On the plaintiff's application for summary judgment the master give the defendant unconditional leave to defend.
examples.translationZh: 原告一提出即判决申请后，法院书记官无条件允许被告进行辩护。

examples.text: This war's objective is less than the unconditional defeat of the enemy.
examples.translationZh: 这场战争的目的决不是无限制地打败敌人。

meaningZh: 的复数

examples.text: They make a profit of ten pence on every copy they sell.
examples.translationZh: 他们每售出一本获利十便士。

examples.text: It's not worth haggling over a few pence.
examples.translationZh: 为几便士争论不休实在不值得。

meaningZh: 山谷，溪谷，峡谷，谷地，深谷；流域；[建筑]屋顶排水沟，屋面斜沟

examples.text: They traversed the valley on foot.
examples.translationZh: 他们徒步走过这座山谷。

examples.text: The river twines through the valley.
examples.translationZh: 这条河流蜿蜒穿过山谷。

examples.text: The valley was hidden from view in the mist.
examples.translationZh: 溪谷隐没在雾霭之中，看不见了。

meaningZh: 大老鼠；似鼠动物；鼠辈，卑鄙小人

examples.text: He was regarded as a rat.
examples.translationZh: 大家叫他变节者/叛徒。

examples.text: The dog was worrying a rat.
examples.translationZh: 那条狗撕咬著一只老鼠。

examples.text: The dog nosed out a rat.
examples.translationZh: 那只狗闻到了老鼠的气味。
